postings.title: Sales Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Revenue Operations analysts who will support a team of experts growing and managing our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. The Revenue Operations teams drive continuous policy, process and data quality improvement which enable us to analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will support the leadership of the team, providing insights to drive improvements and partnering with Canonical’s teams across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. Successful candidates will demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

The role entails

• Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally

• Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing

• Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions

• Supporting other Revenue Operations Analysts and leadership team to report on and improve data quality, sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks.

• Supporting planning, monitoring and improving revenue operations, across new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals. Delivering insight that enables improved territory and quota management, channel development and sales productivity.

• Assisting the team with automation and streamlining of the end-to-end Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path

• Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations

• Experience working as an analyst in revenue/sales operations or related fields such as financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing

• Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and data-driven, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Planning and organisational skills, including the ability to interact and work with stakeholders across functions and at all levels of the organisation

• Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, including comfort working with teams under commercial pressure

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

• Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events

Nice-to-have skills

• Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business

• Understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including within a team based remotely in multiple time zones

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

If you are a detail-oriented accountant who is excited about the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets, this role was made for you.

Your day-to-day will involve:

• Preparing and maintaining monthly rollforwards for BTC, ETH, LTC, and other supported digital assets — ensuring accuracy and completeness across all crypto holdings.

• Reconciling wallet balances to blockchain data and internal subledgers — performing wallet data cleanup, validation, and exception resolution with precision.

• Performing fair market value (FMV) calculations and remeasurements for digital asset holdings — and supporting position checks and proof-of-reserves style reconciliations.

• Processing and accounting for crypto donations, rewards, and incentives — and recording and reconciling hardware wallet activity including Trezor and cold storage.

• Preparing and posting journal entries for month-end close — including balance sheet account reconciliations, flux analysis, and variance explanations.

• Maintaining fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules — and assisting in preparing financial reporting schedules and audit support packages.

• Developing spreadsheet reports, verifying financial information, and reconciling accounts — contributing to a culture of accuracy, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Analyzing current accounting policies and procedures — recommending improvements, contributing to SOP development, and supporting cross-functional teams on accounting processes.

✅ What You'll Need

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.

• Working knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain fundamentals is required — this role is specifically focused on digital asset accounting and crypto transaction processing.

• Excellent organizational skills and sharp attention to detail — you meet deadlines, maintain accuracy under pressure, and never let things slip through the cracks.

💼 What We Offer

• 💸 Competitive salary in USD — paid consistently every month, no matter where you are!

• 🌴 10 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.

• 💻 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.

• 🚀 A fast-paced, high-growth environment at the forefront of global fintech and cryptocurrency — where your accounting work directly supports operations across thousands of locations and multiple international markets.

• 🤝 A collaborative, supportive culture through Veta Virtual and our client — where precision, curiosity, and continuous improvement are genuinely valued from day one.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to bring your accounting skills into the world of digital assets, support a world-class fintech team, and grow at the cutting edge of cryptocurrency finance — apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short 2-minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first opportunity to show us your expertise, your attention to detail, and what makes you the right person for this role. We can't wait to meet you!

Process Optimization

• Technical Troubleshooting: Independently navigate complex accounting hurdles, acting as a functional owner who can move from "chaos" to "order" without constant supervision.

• Communication: Technical capability and a growth mindset are prioritized; while English proficiency is required, we value technical accuracy over linguistic fluency.

Technical Knowledge Deep-Dive

• Integration Logic: Understanding the "plumbing" between Shopify, A2X, and QBO.

postings.title: Senior Accountant | Climate Tech & Energy Transition Startups (AR)
postings.descriptionText:
Summary

• Role : Accounting and finance ops for a portfolio of venture-backed climate tech companies.

• Preferred experience: 4–10 years, including time at a leading national or regional accounting firm

• Location: Remote — US or LATAM (working hours that overlap with US time zones)

• Expected start : Dec '26 or Jan '27

Overview
Planetary Scale partners with climate and energy-transition companies as their strategic finance arm, working alongside founders from seed through growth. We help them refine their business model, raise venture funding, manage their finances and get through the hardest moments on the path to scale.

For many of these companies, we also maintain their books, prepare financial reports, and handle day-to-day finance work like paying bills, invoicing customers and running payroll. Founders rely on us to get the numbers right and make sure everyone gets paid on time. That side of our work is growing, and we're hiring a Senior Accountant to take on a group of clients and work closely with the rest of our team to provide world-class finance function support.

The Role
You'll run the accounting and day-to-day finance work for several client companies at once, alongside a peer accountant who looks after a separate set of clients. For each company, you'll work with our engagement lead who owns the relationship, and often with the founder and their team directly. Our clients primarily use QuickBooks Online or Xero, plus bank, bill-pay and payroll tools. We also have a set of internally developed tools to make the monthly close process flow smoothly and help to share context across our accounting and strategic finance work.

You'll be in real client work from your first week, paired with experienced teammates while you learn each company's financial picture and the nuances of working with early-stage companies that are commercializing complex new technologies.

• You'll own the month-end close for each of your companies: reconciliations, accruals, prepaid and fixed-asset schedules, and financial statements you've reviewed yourself before they reach the engagement lead and the founder.

• Where a company relies on us for its payables and receivables, you'll run them, including bill-pay runs in tools like Bill.com and Brex, as well as invoicing and collections, so vendors are paid on time and cash comes in when it should.

• For some clients, you'll also run payroll and take care of occasional filings like Delaware Franchise Tax, state sales tax returns or year-end 1099s.

• You will figure out and apply the correct accounting treatment for various revenue recognition scenarios, government grants, venture debt and multi-currency transfer pricing. You'll need good judgement on when to ask others for help.

• You'll support audits and investor diligence, preparing schedules and answering auditors' and investors' questions so the founder can focus on running the company. At year end, you'll prepare each company's package for its outside tax preparer.

• You'll help make our close faster and more consistent across clients, noticing where a checklist, template or automation would save the team time.

About You
You hold yourself to a high standard — and you want to work somewhere that does the same. A few things that matter here:

• Accuracy is your baseline. Founders, their boards and their investors make decisions from the numbers you close, and a wrong one can undermine a founder's credibility at the worst possible moment. You tie out every balance before you call a month closed, and you'd rather catch your own mistake than have a founder find it.

• You dig in, and you ask when you're not sure. When a balance won't reconcile or a transaction looks off, you trace it back to its source and find out why. If you're unsure how something should be treated, you ask before you book it.

• You're a good teammate. You'll work alongside a peer accountant and each client's engagement lead. You keep them up to date, leave workpapers anyone could follow, and help out when someone else is stretched.

• You aspire to be great at what you do. You put in the time to sharpen your technical skills, including the less common topics our clients run into, like grants and venture debt. When part of the close is slow or easy to get wrong, you build a better way of doing it.

• You take ownership before you're asked. When something needs doing, you do it. If you see the wrong info being communicated, you jump in to fix it before it becomes a bigger issue. At a firm this size, if you assume something is someone else's job, it usually doesn't get done.

Beyond that, for this role specifically:

• You learned the craft at a leading accounting firm. You've spent time at a leading national or regional accounting firm, in audit, assurance or client accounting, and you've owned a close from start to finish. You know US GAAP well enough to handle accruals, fixed assets and revenue recognition with confidence, and you're hands-on in QuickBooks Online or Xero.

• You're a CPA, or hold your country's equivalent qualification. It's what we generally expect. If you don't hold one yet but you're exceptional in every other way, we'd still like to hear from you.

• You communicate clearly in English and work US hours. Our clients and most of our team are in the US, so professional written and spoken English is a must, and so are working hours that overlap fully with at least one US time zone.

• You care about this work specifically. Climate and the energy transition matter to you, and you want your accounting to support the companies building a better future.

It helps a lot if you've also worked inside a venture- or private-equity-backed company, or at an outsourced accounting firm that serves them. Beyond that, experience with sales tax, payroll or year-end tax work, or with a company's first audit, is a plus.

What makes this different

• Working directly with founders. You'll work with people building some of the most consequential companies in climate and energy — exposure and ownership that typically takes far longer to reach at a larger firm.

• A steep curve and a supportive team. Hands-on work alongside experienced team members, frequent and direct feedback, and real client exposure from day one. We hold a high bar and invest seriously in getting you there.

• Something new every week. We work with a diverse set of high growth companies bringing novel technologies to market. You will learn about many different markets, verticals and business models and get exposure to a wide range of interesting accounting and finance topics.

We're fully remote with team members in the US, Colombia, Poland and the Philippines. Our offer includes performance bonus, client equity exposure and 30 days of PTO.

EEO
Planetary Scale is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on their merits and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

postings.title: General Ledger (GL) Accountant - Buenos Aires, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

We're looking for a highly proactive, self-driven General Ledger Accountant to own the day to day accounting across multiple entities in a high transaction volume environment. This is a hands-on role at the center of our finance operations: bank reconciliations, AP/AR, cost allocations, intercompany, and month end close  all run primarily in QuickBooks Online (QBO).

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. We need someone with an active, ownership-driven personality who spots what needs to happen and makes it happen who chases down discrepancies, follows up with stakeholders without being prompted, and takes full responsibility for keeping the books accurate and on time across all business units.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor multiple bank accounts, capture movements in QBO, and perform daily bank reconciliations across entities.

• Own AP end-to-end: capture, route invoices for approval, archive and post in QBO, and manage vendor/contractor payment runs.

• Own AR end-to-end: issue and track invoices, monitor outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments.

• Oversee the billing process, ensuring invoicing is completed accurately and on time (e.g., by the 1st business day).

• Capture and reconcile deposits across QBO and related platforms; tie and allocate incoming payments to the correct business unit.

• Process intercompany transactions and recharges between business units, HQ/Corp and Holdco, ensuring both sides reconcile.

• Manage cost allocations, internal BU recharges, amortization, accrued liabilities, and ensure all transactions are allocated to a BU.

• Review credit card expenses (200+ transactions/month), cross-check Credit Cards statements against the QBO GL, and ensure accuracy.

• Produce daily and month-end reporting; support month-end close end-to-end.

• Proactively identify, investigate and resolve discrepancies — bringing the root cause and a proposed fix, not just the problem.

• Follow up directly with internal stakeholders (tax, billing, managers, other entities) to keep processes moving.

• Continuously identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities.

What We're Looking For

• A genuinely proactive, self-starting personality someone who takes initiative, works independently, and drives tasks to completion without needing to be pushed.

• Ownership mindset: treats the accuracy and timeliness of the books as their personal responsibility.

• Resourceful and resolutive: comfortable with ambiguity, chases down answers, and solves problems rather than escalating them unresolved.

• 3+ years of hands-on general ledger / full-cycle accounting experience, ideally in a high-volume, multi-entity environment.

• Strong, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) is required.

• Experience with intercompany transactions, cost allocations, and bank reconciliations.

• Comfortable working across multiple bank accounts and foreign-currency payments.

• Strong attention to detail and the discipline to perform high-volume, recurring work accurately every day.

• Comfortable with reporting and tech-savvy including using AI and automation tools to streamline workflows.

• Excellent English (written and spoken), for working with internal stakeholders.

Why CKH is the best choice?

CKH is a boutique accounting & financial services firm that provides local expertise aided by global experience. We have presence in Atlanta, South Africa, Ukraine, Poland, Azerbaijan, Germany, Spain and Greece.

Our Tree Logo Is Representative Of CKH's Ideals

• The roots of the tree remind us to stay grounded and humble.

• The trunk represents the support we have for each other, making our team strong. But we also like to shake the tree!

• Churning up new ideas and positive change as the world around us grows.

• The fruit our tree grows reminds us to never stop growing, producing the best quality service for our clients.

• The treetop helps us reach higher, always stretching to new heights and goals.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Expensify, or similar expense-management tools.

• Experience with automation / workflow tools (Zapier, Make, Power Automate, or similar).

• Experience working with US-based companies or clients.

Finance

Bachelor, Master

Como Financial Accountant gestionarás tareas financieras para un equipo de 10 colegas. Tu rol es clave para brindar soporte administrativo en contabilidad y finanzas. Crecerás profesional y personalmente en un entorno saludable en Rijk Zwaan Argentina.

Tu trabajo en Rijk Zwaan

Como Financial Accountant, reportará a los directores de Rijk Zwaan Argentina y será co-responsable de la contabilidad general de la empresa, que incluye:

• Mantener registros y estados contables para asegurar que las transacciones queden registradas con precisión.

• Valuación y control de Stock y Preparación para auditorías.

• Realizar inventario trimestral de stock junto con Soporte de Ventas

• Preparar informes contables; preparar declaraciones de IVA, documentación de reintegros de IVA y otras; procesar y dar seguimiento a los pagos;

• Realizar informes periódicos a organismos oficiales (p. ej., estadísticas nacionales);

• Realizar validación y registros de declaración de gastos.

• Dar seguimiento a la cobranza de deudores y gestionar pagos;

• Mantener contacto estrecho con el/la Especialista de Soporte de Ventas, el departamento Comercial, otros departamentos internos y proveedores respecto de los asuntos diarios.

• Preparar reportes de la operación comercial, analizar e interpretar datos y reportar a la Dirección.

• Contabilidad - Extraer datos del sistema contable y realizar cálculos, identificar y analizar anomalías y explicar diferencias.

• Preparar declaraciones, mensuales y anuales de impuestos, y declaraciones mensuales de impuestos de importación/exportación.

• Otras tareas operativas y de back office.

Además, trabajarás en diversos proyectos financieros, o prestarás apoyo a tus compañeros con algunas tareas administrativas.

Tu aporte

Buscamos un/a Contador/a Financiero/a con:

• Título universitario (Lic./BSc.) en Contabilidad, Economía/Administración o Finanzas;

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia relevante en un área/departamento de Contabilidad;

• Habilidades sólidas y comprobables en finanzas y contabilidad;

• Conocimiento de normas contables, laborales y tributarias de acuerdo con la legislación argentina;

• Nivel de inglés al menos intermedio (laboral);

• Experiencia de trabajo en entorno M365 será una ventaja adicional.

Además:

Si tú residencia es en CABA / AMBA.

Ser una persona honesta y confiable, en quien tus colegas pueden apoyarse.

Te entusiasma el desafío de formar parte de una empresa internacional.

Sos alguien “hands on”, con interés amplio en funciones administrativas, y que te guste trabajar de manera independiente y autónoma en un equipo chico dentro de la oficina.

Con buenas habilidades analíticas, meticuloso/a y buena comunicación.

Que te guste colaborar y coordinar con colegas en un entorno internacional para lograr el mejor resultado.

Que te gusten los equipos unidos y valoras el equilibrio entre la vida y el trabajo.

¿Qué podés esperar de nosotros?

Como Financial Accoutant vas a ser parte del equipo de la oficina. Vas a cumplir un rol importante apoyando a nuestros managers y asegurando que puedan trabajar de forma fluida.

Nos alegra ofrecerte:

• Contrato permanente desde el inicio;

• Equilibrio entre vida personal y vida laboral;

• Seguro médico para el grupo familiar;

• Un entorno de trabajo emprendedor, con desafíos constantemente nuevos;

• Capacitaciones internas y externas, tanto profesionales como personales;

• Un programa de onboarding completo, posiblemente con el acompañamiento de un/a colega internacional.

Rijk Zwaan: ¿tu próximo empleador?

La oficina de Rijk Zwaan Argentina. está en la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires y cuenta con actividades comerciales dentro de Argentina y actividades de Importación / Exportación de productos. Nuestro equipo está dedicado a acompañar a nuestros distribuidores y clientes en cada una de las zonas productivas, abordando los desafíos del mercado hortícola. Como la cultura corporativa de Rijk Zwaan está enfocada en las personas, vas a contar con todas las oportunidades de desarrollo dentro de Rijk Zwaan.

Rijk Zwaan es una empresa multinacional familiar con una cultura centrada en las personas. Rijk Zwaan se encuentra al inicio de lo que es la cadena alimenticia. Desarrollamos variedades de frutas y hortalizas y vendemos globalmente las semillas producidas a partir de ellas a productores y otros socios de la cadena. Desde nuestra posición estratégica contribuimos al abastecimiento mundial de alimentos.

Todo lo que hacemos tiene que ver con el crecimiento saludable: el crecimiento de productos naturales y saludables que exportamos a todo el mundo.

El crecimiento de nuestra empresa; y, por, sobre todo, el crecimiento de nuestra gente: le damos a los colaboradores todas las oportunidades para tomar iniciativa propia y alcanzar su máximo potencial.

Responsibilities

Job Description

• Perform General Ledger and monthly close activities, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with US GAAP, Argentine accounting standards, GM policies, and internal controls.

• Prepare journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, account reconciliations, variance analyses, and supporting working papers.

• Identify and analyze accounting risks, unusual balances, and complex transactions, applying sound technical judgment and escalating significant matters when required.

• Prepare the conversion of financial information from local currency to the USD functional currency and analyze foreign exchange impacts.

• Prepare statutory trial balances, US GAAP-to-Local GAAP adjustments, inflation accounting calculations, and complete statutory financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.

• Prepare statutory and government reports and support filings with IGJ and other applicable authorities.

• Coordinate external audit requirements and ensure timely resolution of audit requests and accounting matters.

• Execute internal controls and SOX-related procedures, maintaining complete and review-ready documentation.

• Partner with Finance, shared service centers, and regional teams to obtain inputs and resolve accounting and reporting matters.

• Support process improvement and automation initiatives using data-analysis tools.

• Provides direction to a team of individuals with similar functional responsibility

• Research and interpret new accounting standards and brainstorm how each applies to GM as well as comply with external 10-Q/10-K reporting requirements

Required Experience

Mandatory

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) degree.

• Strong knowledge of Argentine Professional Accounting Standards.

• Proven experience with inflation accounting adjustments.

• Experience preparing complete financial statements, including notes and supporting schedules.

• Conversion of financial statements into USD functional currency.

• Preparation of financial information for external audits.

• Proficiency in excel,

Preferred

• Proven experience in general accounting, month-end closing, and financial reporting.

• Experience working within complex corporate groups.

• Hands-on experience managing month-end close processes under tight deadlines.

• Experience with statutory reporting and filings before the IGJ (General Inspection of Justice) or other public entities.

• Advanced SAP knowledge, preferably SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI).

• Advanced Excel skills and experience handling large volumes of data.

• Ability to prepare auditable journal entries and working papers.

• Knowledge of US GAAP and reconciliation with Argentine accounting standards.

• Intermediate or higher English proficiency to interact with regional teams.

• Experience in Big Four

• 3-4 years of exprience

• Experience with data automation and analytics tools such as Power Query, Power BI, or KNIME (preferred) Google workspace

Required Competencies

• Ability to independently execute complex activities with minimal supervision.

• Strong technical judgment to identify appropriate accounting treatments and assess risks.

• Excellent organizational skills and discipline to work within financial close calendars.

• Strong attention to detail and focus on internal controls.

• Analytical skills to investigate discrepancies and explain variances.

• Ability to document processes thoroughly and in an organized manner.

• Team player with strong communication skills, capable of effectively interacting with both accounting and non-accounting teams.

• Ensure that calculations, reconciliations, and supporting documentation are complete and traceable.

postings.title: Talent Aquisition Partner, LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

The role

You’ll run full-cycle recruiting for our LATAM teams, with a focus on customer-facing roles like Customer Support and Onboarding. You’ll own the process from intake to signed offer: sourcing, screening, managing hiring managers, and making sure every candidate has a great experience. You’ll work closely with our recruiting team and with hiring managers, and you’ll have real influence on how we hire in the region.

What you’ll do

• Run full-cycle searches end to end, from intake through offer and close

• Source proactively across LinkedIn, local job boards, communities, and referrals. Don’t wait for applicants.

• Run high-quality recruiter screens and give hiring managers clear, honest recommendations

• Partner with hiring managers to set expectations, calibrate on the bar, and keep searches moving

• Keep Ashby clean, and use pipeline data to flag risks and bottlenecks early

• Build market knowledge across LATAM: talent pools, compensation, and what works in each market

• Help improve our process, from outreach and screening to candidate experience

What we’re looking for

• 3-5 years of recruiting experience, agency or in-house, with full-cycle ownership

• Experience hiring in Latin America

• Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken.

• Strong sourcing instincts and comfort running high-volume and niche searches at the same time

• Sound judgment on candidates and the ability to give hiring managers direct, data-backed advice

• Organized and fast, with a bias toward action and clear communication

• Comfortable working async and across time zones, with overlap with US hours

Big plus

• Experience recruiting for Customer Experience roles (Support, Onboarding, Success, or similar), especially at scale

• Experience at a startup or high-growth company

• Experience with Ashby or a comparable modern ATS

Pay And Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $50,000-$60,000 USD converted to your local currency. Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, a remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, and extra fun perks.

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

postings.title: Recruiter
postings.descriptionText:
Job title: Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist

Type: Full-time
Schedule : Monday–Friday
Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Pacific Time / 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time
Work Environment: Remote

About the Role
Talent Global is looking for a sharp, fast-moving, and highly proactive In-House Recruiter to help identify, evaluate, and present exceptional talent for our clients.

This role is ideal for someone who can quickly understand different types of positions—from digital marketing and creative roles to sales, operations, and other specialized functions—and translate those requirements into an effective recruiting and interview strategy.

We want someone who thinks quickly, adapts easily, asks the right questions, and takes ownership of finding strong candidates.

Speed matters in this role. The right person will be able to work with urgency while maintaining a high standard for the talent selection process, communication, and candidate evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct Interviews: Perform structured Zoom interviews daily to evaluate candidates’ experience, communication skills, technical capabilities, professionalism, and overall fit for roles across Marketing, Design, Sales, Operations, and other functions.

• Evaluate Candidates: Review applications, resumes, work samples, and portfolios to determine whether candidates meet client expectations. This includes evaluating graphic design and advertising portfolios when relevant.

• Understand New Roles Quickly: Rapidly learn the responsibilities, terminology, required skills, and performance expectations of unfamiliar positions before beginning candidate evaluation.

• Maintain a High Talent Bar: Identify strong candidates rather than simply candidates who meet minimum requirements. Exercise sound judgment around experience, communication, problem-solving ability, professionalism, and overall quality.

• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with account managers and talent sourcers to understand client hiring requirements, priorities, feedback, and changes in recruiting strategy.

• Present Candidates: Prepare clear, professional, and accurate candidate summaries and evaluations for shortlisted candidates presented to clients.

• Manage the Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain a strong pool of pre-vetted professionals for recurring client needs and frequently requested positions.

• Maintain CRM & Documentation: Keep candidate records, interview notes, evaluations, compensation expectations, and recruiting activity accurate and up to date in internal systems.

• Develop Interviews & Assessments: Create role-specific interview questions, scorecards, assignments, and assessments that accurately measure candidates’ capabilities.

• Stay Market-Informed: Continuously learn about trends, terminology, tools, compensation, and expectations across digital marketing, creative, sales, and other commonly recruited functions.

• Contractor Follow-Up: Check in with placed contractors after hiring to support onboarding, identify issues early, and help maintain successful placements.

• Negotiate Rates: Discuss compensation expectations with candidates and negotiate rates within client budgets while protecting both candidate quality and company margins.

• Improve Recruiting Operations: Help improve internal recruiting systems, assessment scoring, reporting, data visualization, and workflow efficiency through automation using AI, Make.com, and related tools.

• Work Independently & Collaboratively: Manage responsibilities independently while maintaining fast, clear communication with talent sourcers, account managers, and the sales team.

What We Are Looking For
The ideal candidate is:

• Fast-moving: Works with urgency and maintains strong output without needing constant follow-up.

• Sharp: Quickly identifies important details, inconsistencies, strengths, weaknesses, and potential hiring risks.

• A fast learner: Can understand a new role, industry, or skill set quickly enough to evaluate candidates intelligently.

• Accurate: Moves quickly without becoming careless. Candidate evaluations and documentation must be dependable.

• Highly proactive: Does not wait to be told every next step. Identifies problems, asks questions, follows up, and pushes recruiting processes forward.

• Adaptable: Comfortable switching between very different roles, priorities, clients, and recruiting situations.

• Highly selective: Has a strong standard for talent and is willing to reject average candidates rather than lowering the bar to fill a pipeline.

• Curious: Actively researches unfamiliar terminology, tools, industries, and job functions rather than interviewing candidates with only surface-level knowledge.

• Decisive: Can form clear candidate opinions and explain the reasoning behind them.

• Organized: Able to manage multiple interviews, candidates, roles, and follow-ups without losing important details.

• Clear communicator: Communicates efficiently and professionally with candidates and internal teams.

• Process-minded: Looks for ways to make recruiting faster, more consistent, and more scalable through better systems and automation.

Success in This Role
A strong recruiter in this position should be able to receive a new job requirement, truly understand what the client actually needs quickly, develop the right evaluation criteria, interview candidates intelligently, and confidently distinguish exceptional candidates from average ones.

The goal is not simply to conduct interviews or move candidates through a pipeline.
The goal is to find strong talent quickly, evaluate them accurately, and maintain a consistently high hiring standard.

- Gestionar el Workforce Planning incluyendo la definición de las variables del modelo (capacidades requeridas, análisis del mercado y otras), la estrategia de staffing, la planificación y el despliegue, articulando con las áreas especialistas para asegurar la sustentabilidad del talento, necesario para el desarrollo del negocio.
- Liderar el diseño organizacional del negocio junto al área especialista desafiando las necesidades propuestas, detectando proactivamente oportunidades de rediseño y definiendo soluciones óptimas en cuanto a span de control y niveles organizacionales, que aseguren la eficiencia organizacional.
- Impulsar y gestionar la “Cultura definida” a través de planes de acción concretos, asegurando el impacto de estos.
- Participar en el proceso de selección mediante entrevistas de candidatos para los grupos de interés definidos.

- Proponer y establecer las prioridades de aprendizaje junto al área especialista, en acuerdo con el negocio.

Formación: graduados en Recursos Humanos, Relaciones Laborales, Psicología, Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería o carreras afines. Se valorará la especialización o posgrado en Negocios, Transformación Organizacional o Gestión Estratégica de Personas, serán valorados.

• Participación en procesos de transformación, digitalización, rediseño organizacional y gestión del cambio.

• Fuerte orientación al negocio y capacidad para construir relaciones de confianza con líderes senior.

• Mentalidad digital y capacidad para comprender el impacto de la tecnología en la estrategia de personas.

• Experiencia en People Analytics, métricas de rrhh y toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Conocimientos sólidos de legislación laboral, desarrollo organizacional y gestión del talento.

• Capacidad para liderar entornos dinámicos, gestionar prioridades múltiples e influir sin autoridad formal.

• Perfil consultivo, con visión sistémica y orientación a resultados.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, facilitación y gestión de stakeholders.

Idioma : Inglés avanzado.

Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.
Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.
Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.
Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.
¡Este puesto es para vos!

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma y que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:
🤩 Ser protagonista de tu desarrollo con programas de formación continua.

About Wirestock
Wirestock provides creator-sourced, licensed data solutions for generative AI. We work with leading AI labs and enterprise customers to deliver high-quality, scalable datasets used to train and improve AI models. Our creators - illustrators, video artists, game artists, designers are at the center of everything we build.

About the role
We're looking for someone who is deeply embedded in creative communities - design, illustration, video, game art, 3D, motion and has spent years building genuine relationships with freelance creators. You're not a traditional recruiter. You're a connector. You know where creators hang out, what they care about, and how to get them excited about new projects. You'll be responsible for building and growing Wirestock's global network of freelance creators and mobilizing that network to staff high-volume, fast-moving projects.

While this role is listed as remote, we have an office in San Francisco and prefer a hybrid setup for candidates based in the area; relocation to San Francisco can also be considered.

What you'll do

• Build, grow and manage a large network of freelance creators across disciplines: photo, video, illustration, game art, 3D, motion design and more

• Identify and connect with creators through platforms and niche creative communities

• Match creators to projects based on skill set, availability, and project brief requirements

• Onboard creators to projects quickly and smoothly, ensuring they understand deliverables and timelines

• Maintain strong ongoing relationships with creators to ensure reliable, high-quality delivery

• Collaborate closely with project and content teams to understand briefs and translate them into the right creator profiles

• Keep the network growing, always finding new talent, especially across Latin America and other emerging creative markets

• Support people-ops tasks such as scheduling, onboarding, and other administrative duties as needed

What we're looking for

• You have a genuine, existing network of freelance creators - designers, illustrators, video artists, game artists, 3D artists

• 3+ years of experience in a role that involved building or managing creative talent communities, this could be at a creative agency, talent marketplace, creator platform, or similar

• Experience working with freelance creator communities at scale

• Background managing large pools of contractors or freelancers in creative fields

• You understand creative disciplines deeply, you know the difference between a motion designer and a 3D generalist, and what each project needs

• Strong relationship-building skills

• Comfortable working at high volume and fast pace, managing many creators and projects simultaneously

• Excellent English communication; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a strong plus

Bonus points

• Active presence in creative communities online and offline

• Existing network of creators in Latin America

• Background in creative production, art direction, or community management

What we offer

• Full ownership and autonomy from day one

• A fast-moving, globally distributed team at the intersection of creativity and AI

• Direct impact: the creators you bring in power AI training datasets for leading labs worldwide

postings.title: Recruitment Marketing Manager (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
We’re hiring a Recruitment Marketing Manager to attract qualified candidates through social media, paid campaigns, and other channels across Latin America.

About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.

Why we’re opening this role

We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.

Responsibilities

- Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.
- Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.
- Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.
- Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.
- Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.
- Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead and new team members.

Requirements

- Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.
- Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).
- End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.
- Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.
- AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.
- Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.

Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.

Location
Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.

Benefits

- 100% remote work, forever.
- Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.
- Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
- Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
- Parental leave and flexible support.
- A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

How we hire

A focused process: application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

🔎 Important Notice: All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (e.g., Instagram, Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.

The Specialist independently manages assigned learning projects of varying complexity from initiation through implementation, with primary ownership of medium-complexity initiatives. The Specialist assumes day-to-day project ownership and coordinates timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and implementation readiness to support successful delivery.

The Specialist serves as a key connection point between project stakeholders and learning delivery teams, ensuring project requirements, decisions, timelines, and learner impacts are translated into clear and actionable plans.

• Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.

Required Qualifications/Experience

• 4+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing projects or initiatives of moderate complexity.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, deliverables, reviews, and approvals to support successful project execution.

• Experience translating business or project requirements into actionable plans for delivery teams.

• Experience identifying project risks and dependencies, coordinating mitigation actions, and escalating significant issues appropriately.

• Experience supporting learning initiatives and/or working within Learning & Development strongly preferred.

We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What The Digital Adoption & Enablement Senior Manager does at Worldwide

This person sits within the Global Organizational Learning & Development Team (GOLD), reporting into the People Strategy & Culture function. This role leads enterprise digital adoption, systems learning, and workforce enablement across in-scope corporate systems, while directly managing two Organizational Learning Advisors, Enterprise Systems.

Functional teams retain ownership of technical deployment, configuration, validation, security, compliance programs, and business outcomes; this role leads the learning and adoption strategy required to help employees use systems effectively and consistently.

What You Will Do

- Lead enterprise digital adoption and systems enablement strategy across Medidata, Certinia, LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams Rooms, Zoom, and other assigned systems, including governance, intake, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, annual planning, and KPI re-baselining.

- Partner with EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, HRIS, QA/compliance, system owners, process owners, SMEs, Corporate Communications, instructional designers, LMS administrators, and business leaders to scope needs, validate readiness, coordinate approvals, and reverse-plan from go-live or release milestones.
- Ensure enablement coverage for Medidata and Certinia, including Medidata CTMS, Clinical Data Studio/CDMP, Rave Study Conduct/EDC, eTMF/RCM, eCOA/ePRO, RTSM/IRT/IWRS, RBQM/OPRA-related workflows, and Certinia time entry, resource management, forecasting, reporting, project management, revenue, financial operations, and related Salesforce-based workflows.
- Ensure enablement coverage for corporate platforms such as LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams Rooms, Zoom, collaboration tools, and other business systems, with emphasis on workflow adoption, practical use, accessible performance support, and measurable proficiency.
- Publish a recurring Digital Adoption & Enablement scorecard with adoption insights, utilization trends, learning completion, proficiency indicators, support trends, remediation themes, business value narratives, and recommended actions.
- Coordinate learning plans with business-owned communications so learners understand required actions, business rationale, system impact, and available support.
- Represent GOLD in cross-functional forums related to enterprise systems, clinical systems, financial/project operations systems, HR systems, LMS strategy, Copilot/AI, digital adoption, process adoption, and workforce capability.
- Maintain reusable governance artifacts, templates, communication assets, release materials, adoption toolkits, measurement approaches, embedded guidance standards, and AI-enabled content methods to scale support across systems, functions, regions, and roles.
- Use learner, SME, helpdesk, system owner, and stakeholder feedback to improve training, performance support, adoption, and remediation cycles.
- Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What You Bring To The Role

- Ability to translate complex system workflows, compliance expectations, financial or operational processes, and role-based tasks into clear learning and performance support.
- Ability to manage a portfolio of enterprise systems adoption work across platforms, stakeholders, priorities, release timelines, regions, and functions.
- Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills in a matrixed, global environment.
- Analytical mindset with ability to measure learning effectiveness, adoption outcomes, proficiency gaps, support trends, and remediation needs.
- Excellent written, verbal, visual, and executive communication skills.

Your Experience

- Prior L & D people management experience, including coaching, goal setting, performance management, workload prioritization, capacity planning, team development, and quality oversight.
- Experience leading or overseeing systems training and adoption across platforms such as Medidata, Certinia/CAIR, Salesforce-based tools, LMS, Workday, Percipio, Microsoft 365, Copilot, collaboration tools, ERP, HCM, CRM, or other global corporate systems.
- Experience partnering with system owners, SMEs, EPMO, IT, Clinical Systems, Finance, Project Operations, process owners, QA/compliance, HRIS, Corporate Communications, LMS administrators, and business leaders to scope needs, validate content, manage review cycles, coordinate publishing, and maintain materials after launch.

- Ability to define, monitor, and act on learning and adoption metrics such as completion, readiness, proficiency, utilization, feature adoption, time-to-competency, support trends, remediation needs, and post-launch outcomes.

In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. You’ll be responsible for building strong connections with user-facing teams (support, sales, success, etc), ensuring a tight product feedback loop and owning the chat load there. In some cases, you will also work directly with top users, learning more about their use cases and problems as you help them get more out of the product.

• Ability to build empathy for user problems and translate them into solutions.

• Strong multitasking and prioritization skills.

• Detail-oriented with a problem-solving mindset and a hands-on approach.

• Basic technical knowledge of software development (experience with payment systems is a plus).

• Strong SQL and presentation skills.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

• We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As the largest jewellery brand in the world, we a give a voice to millions of people’s loves every day. Our beautiful products empower people all around the world to express themselves. We are proud to be part of their stories and the most important moments in their lives.

Where original thinking is welcomed, and can turn into positive impact in a heartbeat, we can dream big, dare to act, and deliver with care and passion. At Pandora where you can each craft far more than just an incredible career.

Do you want to make an impact and drive the growth of a global brand? We are looking for a Human Resources Generalist (Temporary - 8 months) to join our Argentina team, based in Buenos Aires , Argentina .

Main Purpose Of The Role

Under the direction of the HR Business Partner, the Human Resources Generalist (Temporary) acts as a strategic and operational partner to the business, supporting leaders and employees across the employee lifecycle with a strong focus on people management, employee relations, talent development and engagement. The role works in close collaboration with Payroll/Departmento Pessoal (DP), ensuring alignment and effective communication, while payroll execution and statutory ownership remain with the Payroll function.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Health (Non-Operational)

• Partner with HRBP and Talent Acquisition team to support workforce planning and hiring strategies, while end-to-end recruitment execution is owned by the dedicated Recruiter.

• Act as a strategic partner to recruitment in cases of high turnover, repeated vacancies or operational risk, particularly in retail or specific business units.

• Analyze hiring patterns and onboarding effectiveness, providing insights and recommendations to HRBP, Recruiter and business leaders.

• Support hiring managers in addressing structural or people-related issues impacting attraction, retention and performance.

• Participate in interviews or selection discussions when required due to business criticality or employee relations risks.

• Ensure alignment between Talent Acquisition efforts and broader HR initiatives related to engagement and retention.

Employee Relations, Ethics & Employee Support

• Act as a primary HR point of contact for employees on people-related matters, providing guidance on policies, processes and employee lifecycle topics.

• Act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on employee relations, performance management, conduct and conflict resolution.

• Support leaders through coaching, feedback and performance improvement guidance.

• Mediate and support workplace-related complaints and allegations, including conduct, harassment, ethics and labor-related matters.

• Support and participate in internal investigations, in coordination with HRBP and Legal, ensuring confidentiality, neutrality and due process.

• Ensure appropriate documentation, escalation and compliance in sensitive employee relations cases.

• Partner with Payroll/DP and Legal to monitor labor relations topics and mitigate people-related risks.

Partnership with Payroll / DP (Non-Operational)

• Partner with Payroll/DP to support employee understanding of payroll-related matters, acting as a facilitator when communication or context is required.

• Ensure payroll-related inquiries are properly routed to Payroll/DP, maintaining clear ownership and accountability.

• Provide contextual HR information to Payroll/DP when needed, without executing payroll calculations or statutory processes.

Talent Management & Development

• Partner with HRBPs and business leaders (DSM/RSM) to support performance management, talent mapping, succession planning, and development initiatives.

• Identify organizational and individual development needs, including training mapping per role, and support the design and delivery of targeted learning solutions.

• Collaborate with Retail Excellence to align training programs with capabilities priorities.

• Support employee retention through development-focused action plans.

Compliance, Policies & Governance

• Ensure HR practices align with local labor legislation, internal policies and global guidelines, in partnership with HRBP, Payroll/DP and Legal.

• Support the creation, update and communication of HR policies and procedures.

• Act as an HR representative during audits or inspections related to HR practices (excluding payroll execution).

Engagement & Culture

• Lead and support employee engagement initiatives, team building activities and internal communications.

• Promote company culture, values and employee experience initiatives.

Reporting & HR Analytics

• Ensure People Portal (employee data system management) is consistently updated and maintained as the central source of HR information and reporting.

• Collect, analyze, and interpret HR data related to turnover, engagement, recruitment, and performance.

• Provide actionable insights and reports to HRBPs and leadership to support informed decision-making.

Craft Your Career With Us If You Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of experience as an HR Generalist, preferably within retail, complex, or multi-unit environments.

• Strong experience in employee relations, talent management, and HR business partnering, ideally supporting retail or field-based teams.

• Proven experience working collaboratively with Payroll/DP and external vendors in a fast-paced, operational setting.

• Willingness to travel as required to support multi-unit or store operations within territory.

• Strong interpersonal, communication and conflict management skills

• Ability to influence leaders and manage sensitive situations with professionalism

• High level of confidentiality and ethical judgment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and HR systems

• Fluent English

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in this role and want to be part of Pandora’s future, we encourage you to apply. We process applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

postings.title: HRIS Integrations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Evocs Overview

EVOCS was founded with a clear purpose: to help businesses operate more effectively, solve complex challenges, and create opportunities for growth through practical expertise and technology solutions.

As an IT consulting firm, we work with our clients to understand their needs, identify the right technologies, and deliver solutions that improve performance and support their business objectives.

Today, EVOCS is a trusted technology partner to a growing number of organizations and industry leaders. Our team combines technical expertise, business understanding, and a commitment to quality to deliver effective solutions and build lasting client relationships based on responsiveness, consistency, and results.

🎯 Role Overview

At EVOCS, we’re looking for an experienced HRIS Integrations Specialist to join our HiBob Practice on a flexible, project-based basis.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, documenting, and delivering integrations between HiBob and third-party systems. You’ll collaborate closely with our implementation consultants and HiBob Practice Lead to develop integration solutions that meet our clients’ business and technical needs.

This is an on-demand, hourly opportunity , rather than a full-time or ongoing contract position. Engagements will vary based on client needs, ranging from individual discovery sessions to multi-week integration projects. You'll coordinate your availability with the HiBob Practice Lead for each engagement.

🧩 What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

• Lead technical discovery sessions with clients to understand integration requirements, data flows, and system constraints.

• Assess integration feasibility based on HiBob API capabilities and third-party system requirements.

• Define integration scope, assumptions, and deliverables in collaboration with the Project Manager and HiBob Practice Lead.

• Design end-to-end integration solutions, including data mapping, transformation logic, error handling, and reconciliation processes.

• Recommend the most suitable integration approach, whether through native connectors, middleware, custom APIs, or SFTP.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data mapping specifications, authentication and security requirements, testing criteria, and post-go-live runbooks.

• Build and configure integrations using HiBob REST APIs, middleware platforms such as Make.com, Workato, or Boomi, and custom scripts.

• Develop and support SFTP-based integrations for payroll, benefits, and other business systems.

• Perform unit testing, end-to-end testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure successful integration delivery.

• Deploy integrations to production, validate functionality, and provide troubleshooting and post-go-live support as needed.

• Collaborate with internal teams to communicate project progress, identify risks, and proactively address technical challenges.

• Contribute to pre-sales activities when needed, including solution design, technical recommendations, and effort estimates.

🧠 What You Will Bring

The top candidate will have the following skills:

• Hands-on experience working with HiBob (Bob) REST APIs, including authentication, endpoints, rate limits, and data models.

• Proven experience designing, developing, and implementing API-based integrations between HRIS/HCM platforms and third-party systems such as payroll, ATS, benefits, or ERP solutions.

• Proficiency with at least one integration or middleware platform, such as Make.com, Workato, Zapier, or similar tools.

• Experience developing and maintaining integration scripts using Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell.

• Knowledge of SFTP-based data exchange, including PGP encryption and file format specifications.

• Strong technical documentation skills, including architecture diagrams, data mapping specifications, and operational runbooks.

• Ability to independently manage integration projects, prioritize tasks, and communicate proactively with stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration challenges.

• Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

Ideally you have…

• Previous experience delivering HiBob integrations in an HRIS implementation, consulting, or client-facing environment.

postings.title: Account Executive, USA
postings.descriptionText:
Join our US sales team and win consumer businesses, with e-commerce as a key segment, using a proven product and playbook.

• Location: Remote, anywhere

• Hours: US working hours

• Languages: Native-level English

• Base salary: $5,000–$10,000 gross/month ($60k–$120k/year)

• Commission: 10% recurring revenue share, uncapped

• Bonus: Ramp bonus

Where you land in the range depends on your skills, experience, and track record.

About Octocom
Every day, support teams spend thousands of hours on the same questions. Where is my order? How do I return this? Which product should I choose? Can I change my delivery address?

Octocom builds AI agents for support and sales for consumer businesses. Our agents handle conversations independently across chat, email, and phone, from order tracking and returns to product guidance and order changes. Businesses get faster responses, lower support costs, and more sales.

We grew 10x in 2025 and are on track to do it again in 2026. Our AI has already handled hundreds of millions of customer conversations. We keep things direct: few meetings, no politics, clear responsibility, and honest feedback.

The role
You'll join our team of Account Executives in the US and own your pipeline from first conversation to close.

You'll sell a product US brands already rely on, with an established playbook and close support from the founders and the rest of the team.

What you'll do

• Build your pipeline. Find high-potential US consumer businesses, with e-commerce as a key segment. Start conversations and create qualified opportunities.

• Run the full sales cycle. Discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation, and closing.

• Win long-term customers. Turn opportunities into accounts that stay and grow.

• Build local partnerships. Agencies, technology partners, e-commerce platforms, and other channels that accelerate growth.

• Stay close to customers. Support early onboarding and bring market feedback straight into product and strategy.

• Make the team better. Share what's working in your deals so the whole US team closes more.

Who we're looking for
The most important thing is hunger. We want someone who works hard, has big ambitions, and is excited to build something meaningful. Everything else is secondary.

None of these are strict requirements, but they're strong advantages:

• Native-level English.

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, partnerships, or growth.

• Startup experience, especially early-stage or fast-growing. Ex-founders and operators are especially welcome.

• Comfortable owning the full cycle, from cold outbound to close.

• Commercially sharp and confident with senior decision-makers.

• High ownership, independence, and a bias toward action in a remote setup.

If you're ambitious, competitive, and learn fast, we'd rather talk to you than reject you because your CV doesn't look perfect.

Commission that compounds
You earn 10% of the revenue from every customer you close. Customers pay monthly or yearly, so your commission recurs for as long as they stay. There is no cap.

• One customer: Customers paying $10,000/mo ≈ $1,000/mo to you, every month

• A grown portfolio: Customers paying $50,000/mo ≈ $5,000/mo to you, every month

On top of your base salary and ramp bonus. The bigger the book you build, the more you earn every month.
