postings.title: Data Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Campari Group es hoy un actor importante en la industria global de bebidas espirituosas de marca, con un portafolio de más de 50 marcas premium y super premium, comercializadas y distribuidas en más de 190 mercados en todo el mundo, con posiciones de liderazgo en Europa y América.

Con sede en Milán, Italia, Campari Group posee 25 plantas en todo el mundo y tiene su propia red de distribución en 26 países, empleando aproximadamente a 4.700 personas.

Las acciones de la empresa matriz Davide Campari - Milano N.V. están listadas en la Bolsa de Valores Italiana desde 2001. Hoy, Campari Group es el sexto mayor actor mundial en la industria de bebidas espirituosas premium.

Detrás de cada decisión comercial hay un dato, y alguien que lo hizo confiable. En Sales Intelligence de Campari Argentina buscamos un/a Analytics Engineer que quiera aplicar su experiencia en datos al mundo comercial. Vas a trabajar junto a los equipos de ventas, construyendo la base de información que usan para decidir cómo llegan nuestras marcas a cada canal del país.

Misión del puesto:

Liderar la arquitectura de información comercial del área: transformar datos crudos y dispersos en una capa de datos única, versionada y confiable, sobre la cual Sales Intelligence construye insight, no reportes.El foco es lograr la construcción y el mantenimiento del sistema de información comercial del área, unificando fuentes de datos hoy fragmentadas (sell-in/sell-out, scentia,precios, ejecución, inversión) en una capa de datos única y confiable, sobre la cual el equipo construye tableros que se actualizan de forma automática.

El impacto al negocio es reducir el tiempo que los recursos de Sales Intelligence, gerentes de canales, KAMs y KAEs invierten en actualizar y reconciliar reportes, y redirigir ese tiempo a generación de insight y toma de decisión comercial.

Principales Responsabilidades y Actividades

• Diseñar y mantener el modelo de datos comercial único (“single source of truth”), integrando fuentes de distribuidores (sell-in/sell-out, scentia,precios, ejecución, inversión)

• Construir y automatizar la capa de tableros, priorizando que se actualicen de forma autónoma en lugar de requerir armado manual periódico.

• Definir estándares de calidad y estandarización del dato para que los prinicpales stackeholders (sales intelligence, gerentes de canal, KAMs y KAEs, CCCM) operen sobre un número confiable sin verificarlo dos veces.

• Traducir necesidades de negocio en modelos de datos, trabajando en conjunto con el equipo de Sales Intelligence y las áreas comerciales.

• Priorizar qué procesos automatizar primero en función del impacto en horas-analista liberadas, no de la complejidad técnica del desafío.

Relaciones Clave

• Internas:

• Gerentes de Venta de Canales: Coordinación de estrategias y ejecución comercial por zona

• Sales Intelligence: Seguimiento de los KPI´s de planes de canal y marca.

• Equipo IT: Coordinacion de proyectos

• Externas:

•

• Proveedores de Información: Scentia, Lacarss, Compass, etc.

Competencias Clave

• Capacidad para actuar como puente entre las necesidades del negocio y los equipos técnicos, traduciendo requerimientos en soluciones de datos.

• Experiencia en análisis de calidad de datos, detección de inconsistencias, investigación de problemas y resolución de causas raíz.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, gestión de stakeholders y coordinación de iniciativas transversales.

• Conocimiento de gobierno de datos, gestión de metadatos, definiciones de negocio y marcos de calidad de datos.

Perfil Buscado

• Power BI a nivel de modelado de datos, no solo de visualización.

• Manejo de terminología comercial de consumo masivo (sell-in, sell-out, drop size,, cobertura, share, etc) — condición excluyente para asegurar que el rol entienda al negocio, no solo a la base de datos.

• Formación en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Estadística, Ciencias de Datos o carreras afines.

• Experiencia en posiciones de Data Analytics, Business Intelligence o Data Science.

• Conocimientos en segmentación, modelado predictivo, visualización y análisis de datos.

• Experiencia trabajando con áreas de Finanzas, IT Corporate, Comercial

• Perfil analítico, estratégico y orientado a resultados.

Nuestro compromiso con la Diversidad e Inclusión:

En Campari Group creemos en construir más valor juntos, por lo tanto, vemos la diversidad en todas sus formas como una fuente de enriquecimiento. Nuestras políticas y prácticas de empleo aseguran que estamos comprometidos a proporcionar igualdad de oportunidades de empleo en todos los aspectos del empleo sin importar la raza, religión, credo, color, origen nacional, ascendencia, discapacidad física, discapacidad mental, condición médica, información genética, estado civil, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género o características o expresión, afiliación o actividad política, edad, estado de veterano, ciudadanía o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Campari Group cree que la compensación justa y las oportunidades iguales son cruciales para el bienestar, empoderamiento y compromiso de los empleados. Nuestros esfuerzos para asegurar un pago justo nos han valido la Certificación de Pago Justo por Fair Pay Workplace, una organización independiente dedicada a terminar con las disparidades salariales basadas en el género, la raza y su intersección.

Nota para los candidatos:

Tu solicitud será evaluada en función de tus habilidades, experiencia y conocimientos generales, no por alguna información confidencial, privada o secreta que puedas poseer. No debes divulgar a Campari Group ninguna de esas informaciones. En caso de que se te haga una pregunta que no puedas responder sin divulgar información confidencial, privada o secreta (incluyendo de un empleador actual o anterior, sus proveedores o clientes), debes negarte a responder la pregunta.

Nota para las agencias de headhunting:

Por favor, evite contactar o enviar correos electrónicos directamente a nuestro equipo de liderazgo ejecutivo o a la comunidad de recursos humanos. El departamento de Adquisición de Talento gestiona las operaciones de reclutamiento centralizadas a nivel mundial, incluyendo la selección y gestión de proveedores externos. Actualmente, nuestra lista de proveedores preferidos está a plena capacidad. Para asegurarnos de tener su información en archivo para una consideración futura, le pedimos amablemente que complete el formulario en línea proporcionado aquí.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly detail‑oriented individual to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with numbers, thrives in analytical work, and is motivated by bringing simplicity from complexity.

They will work closely with project managers, workstream leads and across operational teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain and update resource allocation plans across teams and workstreams

• Accurately track utilization, capacity, and upcoming resource needs

• Support scheduling decisions by surfacing constraints, risks, and alternative options

• Liaise with workstream leads to confirm assignments and resolve conflicts

• Assist with creating and maintaining project budgets and forecasts

• Reconcile planned vs. actuals; flag variances and work with teams to understand corrective action

• Prepare draft PowerPoint files for EY Executive Management (Vice-Chairs, SL/SSL Leaders, etc.)

• Numeric analysis using Excel/Pivot

• Produce simple, digestible summaries from large datasets

• Ask clarifying questions whenever requirements or data are unclear

• Support documentation of processes and maintain clear guidance for others

• Accept project-based work, of their choosing, when not engaged with work items which are core to this role

Skills & Qualities Needed

Must-Have

postings.title: Assortment & Promotions Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Job Description

En PedidosYa, no solo entregamos pedidos; diseñamos el futuro del supermercadismo.

Como Assortment & Promotions Specialist , serás el/la estratega responsable de diseñar la oferta comercial y el catálogo perfecto para nuestra vertical de Supermercados. Tu misión principal será doble: asegurar que tengamos el surtido más completo y atractivo del mercado ( Choice ) y liderar la agenda de promociones de alto impacto que traccionen volumen, todo esto garantizando una inversión eficiente y una relación estratégica con las principales CPGs (marcas de consumo masivo).

Buscamos un perfil con un fuerte equilibrio entre mentalidad analítica (para detectar desvíos y oportunidades en datos de mercado) y habilidades comerciales/negociación para ejecutar planes tácticos con velocidad y visión de negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades

• Estrategia de Surtido y Disponibilidad (Assortment): Responsable absoluto por asegurar la maximización de choice en términos de surtido en la plataforma. Identificar proactivamente categorías con desvíos de share respecto al mercado y al consumo interno de la App, liderando junto al equipo de Accounts iniciativas tácticas para revertirlos.

• Higiene y Salud del Catálogo (Health & Quality Assortment): Velar por la excelente calidad del surtido en la plataforma, garantizando un proceso ágil de alta de productos, la correcta actividad del catálogo y altos niveles de disponibilidad. Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de Accounts para auditar y mejorar continuamente estos estándares en cada una de las marcas.

• Data Scraping & Auditing (Precios y Disponibilidad): Implementar y supervisar procesos de scraping y auditoría automatizada para monitorear en tiempo real el surtido, la disponibilidad de stock, los precios y las mecánicas promocionales de la competencia versus nuestra oferta en la App. Transformar estos datos en alertas y planes de acción comerciales inmediatos.

• Optimización del Catálogo por Clúster Geográfico: Monitorear de forma continua la disponibilidad del surtido y la activación de promociones a nivel regional y por zonas específicas de delivery. Diseñar planes tácticos junto a los equipos comerciales para corregir asimetrías geográficas, garantizando que todos los usuarios tengan una experiencia comercial consistente sin importar su ubicación.

• Diseño de Campañas de Promocionalidad: Liderar de punta a punta la creación de promociones atractivas y exclusivas para PedidosYa. Definir la propuesta de productos clave, mecánicas comerciales eficaces y la duración óptima de las campañas para traccionar volumen y penetración de mercado.

• Eficiencia de Inversión y Relación con CPGs: Definir y optimizar la inversión eficiente en campañas promocionales, liderando la negociación del co-financiamiento con las marcas de consumo masivo (CPGs) para maximizar el ROI del promo spend.

• Monitoreo y KPIs: Dar seguimiento diario/semanal a métricas clave de surtido y promocionalidad para detectar desvíos y llevarlos a planes de acción para mejorarlos.

• Business Intelligence & Reporting: Construir, iterar y supervisar tableros de gestión (dashboards) que permitan monitorear estos ejes de trabajo proveyendo insights clave para la toma de decisiones de todas las áreas involucradas.

Qualifications

• Profesional de las carreras de Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía o afines. Se valorará un MBA o Posgrado en Negocios Digitales o Business Analytics.

• Experiencia: Mínimo de 3-4 años en roles de Performance, Category Management ,Growth. (idealmente en consumo masivo - CPGs, cadenas de Retail moderno o plataformas de E-commerce/Marketplace)

• Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de datos (Tableau, Looker o Power BI). Conocimiento de SQL y manejar Excel/Sheets a nivel experto.

• Capacidad para proponer estrategias de alto impacto de forma autónoma, no solo gestionar lo existente.

• Mentalidad Analítica: Capacidad para traducir datos complejos en estrategias comerciales concretas.

• Comodidad trabajando en entornos de alta incertidumbre y ritmo vertiginoso, donde el dato de ayer ya es viejo.

• Habilidades Blandas: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo de proyectos cross-functional (intersección entre Marketing, Comercial y Finanzas). Proactividad, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

Additional Information

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

postings.title: Product Analytics Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos convertimos en una marca de confianza en Venezuela.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Senior Analytics Engineer para ser el referente técnico del equipo de Analytics Engineering. Tu misión principal será diseñar y mantener la Single Source of Truth (SSoT) del negocio, estructurando modelos de datos escalables, gestionando el catálogo de datos y construyendo la capa semántica que habilitará el autoservicio de los Business Analysts (BAs). Trabajarás en la intersección entre tecnología y negocio, definiendo estándares de desarrollo y optimizando el contexto de nuestros datos para herramientas de IA.

Responsablidades

• Modelado y SSoT: Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos de datos limpios, testeados y transformados dentro del Data Warehouse (usando dbt/Dataform) como la única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

• Analítica de Comportamiento (Behavioral Analytics): Diseñar y gobernar la arquitectura de eventos de producto (tracking plans) para potenciar herramientas basadas en eventos como Amplitude o Mixpanel. Tu trabajo habilitará a los analistas a construir embudos (funnels), analizar el user journey y medir la retención con alta precisión.

• Integración de Eventos y Pipelines: Contribuir al desarrollo y orquestación de pipelines en BigQuery mediante el uso de Airflow y dbt, cruzando el comportamiento del usuario en la app con nuestra data transaccional para consolidar una visión 360 del cliente.

• Capa Semántica y Autoservicio: Crear la capa semántica y mantener actualizado el Catálogo de Datos para garantizar que los BAs puedan construir dashboards y análisis operativos sin fricción ni ambigüedad.

• Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.

• Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la organización.

• Liderazgo Técnico: Establecer buenas prácticas de desarrollo (DataOps, revisión de PRs, control de versiones) y mentorear a otros Analytics Engineers del equipo.

• Colaboración Cruzada: Coordinar con Data Platform e Ingeniería la integración de pipelines y definición de contratos de datos (Data Contracts).

Requisitos

• Experiencia: 5+ años trabajando en entornos de datos, con al menos 3 años especializados en Analytics Engineering.

• Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).

• Product Analytics: Experiencia sólida trabajando con arquitecturas de datos basadas en eventos (event-driven analytics) y gobernando la ingesta/salida para herramientas como Amplitude, Mixpanel o similares.

• Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).

• Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.

• Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.

• Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

• Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

• Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

• Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

postings.title: CRO Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Want to run A/B tests every week across fast-growing Shopify brands, and see your experiments increase RPV and revenue?

We’re Fuelerate, a growth partner for Shopify brands.

We work with Shopify brands doing up to $4M/month in sales , where a winning experiment can translate into hundreds of thousands of dollars in additional revenue.

We scale eCommerce stores through customer research, experimentation, and conversion-focused design.

We test everything from offers, pricing, bundles and buy boxes to messaging, landing pages, listicles, navigation and PDPs , then use those learnings to keep pushing RPV higher.

Now we’re hiring an experienced CRO Strategist who loves building hypotheses, prioritizing experiments, analyzing results, and figuring out why customers buy, or don’t.

If you enjoy digging into GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, customer research and test data , then turning those insights into experiments that actually move revenue, this is your role.

What you’ll do

You’ll own CRO strategy across multiple Shopify brands and help them increase RPV through research, experimentation, and continuous iteration:

• build and prioritize A/B testing roadmaps based on potential impact, data, and customer research

• develop and run experiments across offers, pricing, bundles, buy boxes, PDPs, landing pages, listicles, messaging, positioning, navigation, upsells, and more

• analyze test results, understand why something won or lost , and turn those learnings into the next hypothesis

• review CRO redesigns using our internal framework

• analyze GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, customer behavior, and quantitative + qualitative data

• identify conversion bottlenecks and uncover opportunities across the funnel

• turn data into clear hypotheses and actionable recommendations

• work closely with designers and developers to take experiments from hypothesis → design → development → live test

• own the CRO strategy and performance of your assigned accounts

• lead client communication with clarity and confidence

• run onboarding calls and recurring strategy calls

• send progress updates and communicate test results, learnings, and next steps

• keep accounts moving forward and constantly look for the next opportunity to improve RPV

You’ll work across multiple brands, run experiments constantly, and see the commercial impact of your ideas, not spend six months waiting to ship one test.

What you bring

• 3+ years of hands-on CRO experience , ideally within an agency environment

• a strong track record of running A/B tests and producing measurable wins

• hands-on experience with Shopify and DTC/eCommerce brands

• you already understand experimentation—you don’t need to be taught how to build a hypothesis, read a test, or prioritize an experimentation roadmap

• strong experience with GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and behavioral data

• you can look beyond whether a test won or lost and understand why

• strong commercial thinking—you understand that CRO is ultimately about increasing RPV and revenue, not just CVR

• strong communication, curiosity, and speed

• well written and spoken English

• confidence presenting strategy, defending your thinking, and communicating results directly to clients

• ability to manage multiple accounts without losing clarity or momentum

Bonus points for:

• deep experience with offer testing, pricing, merchandising, PDPs, landing pages, and funnels

• CRO copywriting

• basic HTML/CSS

• experience with Intelligems / Convert / VWO / Optimizely

• experience running experiments on high-traffic Shopify brands with enough volume to reach statistical significance quickly

Why Fuelerate

We’re not a slow corporate agency.
CRO isn’t an add-on service here. It’s what we do every day.

You’ll work with Shopify brands doing serious volume, giving you enough traffic, data, and opportunities to run meaningful experiments and learn fast.

Your ideas won’t sit in a 50-page audit. You’ll have designers and developers who can turn hypotheses into live experiments, and you’ll get to see whether they actually work.

We move fast, focus on impact, and give real ownership.

• fully remote

• no pointless meetings

• high volume of experiments and real customer data

• work directly with experienced designers and developers

• ownership over CRO strategy—not just execution

• mentorship & growth

• real impact on high-growth DTC brands

The volume and variety of experiments you’ll run across multiple brands means you’ll be constantly exposed to new problems, hypotheses, and learnings.

Challenges (honest bit)
This is not a passive role.

You will:

• manage multiple clients

• switch contexts quickly

• make decisions when the data isn’t always perfectly clear

• come up with new hypotheses constantly—not recycle the same CRO playbook

• lead client conversations, not hide behind internal work

• defend your thinking when necessary and change your mind when the data proves you wrong

• take responsibility for CRO strategy, experimentation velocity, account momentum, and results

If you want a predictable role where you execute the same CRO checklist on every store, this probably isn’t for you.

If you love experimentation, move fast, think commercially, and get genuinely excited when a hypothesis wins and moves RPV , you’ll probably thrive here.

Details

• Type: Full-time (40h/week)

• Location: Remote

• Pay range: $34,000 – $45,000/year , depending on experience

(For exceptional candidates with a strong CRO track record, we are open to considering higher compensation)

• Reports to: Head of CRO

👋 Ready to Own CRO Strategy & Results?

If you’re an experienced CRO Strategist who has already run a high volume of experiments , thinks commercially, and loves turning customer insights → hypotheses → experiments → revenue , we want to meet you.

Submit your application through the official link only.

Briefly tell us about the experiments you’ve run, your biggest wins (and learnings from losses), the brands you’ve worked with, and how your work impacted CVR, RPV, or revenue.

Applications sent via DM or email will not be considered.

postings.title: Actuary - Dental Pricing
postings.descriptionText:
Join MetLife’s Financial Management Group (FMG), a strategic financial engine driving critical decision-making through financial planning, analysis, and risk management. As a member of the team, you'll be involved in topics including financial reporting, treasury, corporate actuarial, tax, investor relations and mergers and acquisitions. Positioned at the intersection of finance and strategy, you'll help ensure that MetLife meets customer obligations while supporting strategic objectives. Develop expertise across disciplines in a collaborative, results-driven environment while maintaining the financial strength and competitive edge of one of the world's leading institutions.

The Opportunity

As an Actuary on the Dental Pricing team, you will play a central role in maintaining and advancing the pricing capabilities that support MetLife’s Dental business. You will own critical pricing tools, systems, actuarial studies, and regulatory deliverables, using your technical expertise and business judgment to influence pricing strategy, financial performance, and customer value.

This role offers broad exposure across the Dental organization and the opportunity to become a trusted subject-matter expert for Underwriting, Product, Contracts and Compliance, Valuation, and other business partners. You will lead work ranging from state rate filings and pricing-system updates to renewal analysis, product initiatives, and actuarial studies. If you enjoy solving complex business problems, modernizing established processes, and translating detailed analysis into clear recommendations, this role provides a strong platform for professional growth and organizational impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and enhance critical dental pricing tools, by recommending and implementing data-driven updates, maintaining sound calculations, clear documentation, and effective controls while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring work.

• Manage pricing system updates and implementation activities in support of accurate manual and experience rating. Coordinate requirements, testing, validation, communication, and production implementation so that Underwriting has accurate and timely pricing capabilities.

• Lead recurring financial and strategic analysis, including renewal cycle reviews, experience studies, and data analysis supporting pricing and finance decisions. Translate results into clear recommendations for leaders and business partners.

• Lead dental regulatory pricing work, including rate filings, Minimum Loss Ratio filings, and other state regulatory requests. Prepare actuarial support, respond to objections, and partner with Contracts, Compliance, Legal, and state regulators to secure required approvals.

• Serve as a strategic actuarial partner for Underwriting, Product, Contracts and Compliance, Segment Finance, Centers of Excellence, and Valuations. Support product initiatives such as incentive provisions, connected benefits, benefit expansions, and pricing methodology enhancements, while responding to complex business inquiries and emerging priorities.

Required Qualifications

• Strong experience with actuarial or financial modeling, large datasets, and analytical problem-solving, including the ability to evaluate results, identify risks, and develop practical business recommendations.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with programming, database, or data-analysis tools such as SQL, Alteryx, Databricks, or comparable platforms.

• Proficiency using AI-enabled tools, such as Copilot or generative AI platforms, to accelerate analysis, improve documentation, automate repeatable work, and support decision-making, along with a commitment to responsible use and continued AI fluency.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex actuarial and financial concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and work with external regulatory stakeholders.

• A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, thoughtful documentation, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, finance, or a related field; actuarial credentials or demonstrated progress toward an actuarial designation.

• Experience with insurance pricing, including familiarity with claims experience, pricing systems, state rate filings, regulatory requirements, and renewal analysis.

• Experience modernizing processes through Power BI, Qlik Sense, Alteryx, Databricks, AI-enabled tools, or similar data and automation technologies.

• Associate of the Society of Actuaries designation.

Beneficios que Ofrecemos

Nuestros beneficios están diseñados para cuidar tu bienestar integral mediante programas de salud física y mental, bienestar financiero y apoyo a las familias. Ofrecemos cobertura de atención médica para ti y tu familia, descuentos en seguros para proteger tu hogar, automóvil y mascotas, así como licencia parental. También ofrecemos una membresía premium de gimnasio para ti y tus familiares directos, tiempo libre para voluntariado, descuentos en universidades seleccionadas, viernes flexibles, reembolso de gastos de conectividad y mucho más.

Acerca de MetLife

Reconocida por Fortune entre las compañías más admiradas del mundo y los mejores lugares para trabajar, MetLife es una de las compañías líderes de servicios financieros a nivel global. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Con presencia en más de 40 mercados, ocupamos posiciones de liderazgo en Estados Unidos, Latinoamérica, Asia, Europa y Medio Oriente.

Como parte de nuestra estrategia New Frontier, estamos construyendo un futuro centrado en las personas e impulsado por la Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos personas curiosas, adaptables y con mentalidad de crecimiento, que quieran aprovechar el potencial de la IA para transformar la forma en que trabajamos, mejoramos la experiencia de nuestros clientes y generamos valor para nuestras comunidades. En MetLife, la IA es una herramienta que complementa el criterio humano, potencia la creatividad y promueve la mejora continua, siempre de manera responsable y ética.

Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. Guiados por nuestros valores Ganamos Juntos, Hacemos lo Correcto, Generamos Impacto por Encima de la Actividad y Pensamos en el Futuro, trabajamos para transformar el futuro de los servicios financieros.

#AllTogetherPossible. Súmate a MetLife.

postings.title: Finance Business Partner – Accounting + FP&A
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.

Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.

The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.

We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner to connect the accounting numbers with the people who run the business at a high-growth US company, working remotely from Argentina.

You will partner with department heads on their budgets, forecasts, and spend, and make sure what they plan ties back to what is actually recorded. A strong accounting foundation is what makes the role work: you will support the close for your areas, so your analysis starts from numbers you understand and trust.

What You'll Own

Business Partnering and FP&A
• Budget owners: Act as the finance partner to department heads, helping them plan, track, and explain their spend and headcount.
• Budget and forecast: Build and maintain departmental budgets and the rolling forecast, and feed them into the company plan.
• Variance analysis: Explain budget-versus-actual results each month, with clear root causes and recommended actions.
• Reporting and KPIs: Build reporting packages and dashboards that give leadership a reliable view of performance.

Accounting Support
• Close support: Prepare accruals, prepaids, and reclasses for your areas, and review department-level P&L coding before the close is finalized.
• Spend control: Work with AP and procurement on vendor spend, approvals, and cost allocation.
• Data integrity: Reconcile planning data to the general ledger so forecasts and actuals stay consistent.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience across accounting and FP&A, with a solid accounting foundation
• Experience building budgets, forecasts, and budget-versus-actual analysis
• Working knowledge of accrual accounting and the month-end close under US GAAP or IFRS
• Substantial exposure to clients or entities in the US, UK, Canada, or Australia
• Strong financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets
• Experience working directly with non-finance stakeholders and explaining numbers in plain terms
• Experience with a major ERP or accounting system, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online, or Xero
• Strong written and spoken English for daily work with US teams
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification

Preferred

• CPA, Contador Público, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent strongly preferred
• Experience using AI tools in finance workflows, with the judgment to review and correct AI-generated output
• Experience with planning or BI tools such as Adaptive, Pigment, Mosaic, Power BI, or Looker
• SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including ARR and unit economics
• Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed company

Who This Role Is For

A finance professional who is equally at home in the general ledger and in a budget review, and who would rather help a department head make a better decision than simply report what they spent.

Why Join Through MAVI

• Partner directly with department heads and finance leadership at a high-growth US company
• Build a combined accounting and FP&A profile, the foundation for senior finance roles
• Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll
• USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope
• Progress toward Senior Finance Manager, FP&A Manager, and Finance Manager opportunities through MAVI

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role with a single client company for the duration of the engagement. Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET); part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours.

This role partners with business leaders, external advisors, and cross-functional teams to assess inorganic growth opportunities through market analysis, financial modeling, due diligence, transaction execution, and post-merger integration planning.

• Conduct industry, market, competitor, and target-company research to identify potential acquisition candidates.

• Develop and maintain financial models to evaluate merger, acquisition, and divestiture opportunities, including valuation analyses and business case assessments.

• Coordinate and manage cross-functional due diligence processes involving finance, legal, tax, HR, operations, and commercial teams.

We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.

Como Treasury & Credit Manager , serás responsable por liderar la gestión integral de tesorería y riesgo de crédito en Argentina, garantizando una adecuada liquidez para la operación, optimizando el capital de trabajo y fortaleciendo las relaciones bancarias. Como parte de la cultura de mejora continua, vas a participar en proyectos y actividades de Lean Thinking (EAI – Electrolux Always Improve).

• Inglés intermedio o superior para interactuar en entornos regionales e internacionales.

• Bank & account reconciliations: Reconcile bank, credit card, merchant, and loan accounts; investigate and clear discrepancies.

• Process improvement: Standardize checklists, close calendars, and SOPs; suggest tech automations (rules, workflows, integrations).

• Run payroll accurately: Calculate wages, deductions, and withholdings; coordinate approvals; ensure on-time processing.

• Data quality & controls: Maintain organized, audit-ready files and strong documentation across periods and entities.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline

• Strong command of English (written & spoken), client-facing communication, and service-oriented mindset.

• Ownership mentality: organized, deadline-driven, and able to manage multiple clients without sacrificing accuracy.

The Ideal Candidate

• You’ve closed books for US entities and can hit the ground running with minimal supervision.

• You balance precision with practicality—you know when to dive deep and when to move fast.

• You enjoy creating order (SOPs, templates, checklists) and love clean ledgers and tidy reconciliations.

• You’re tech-curious and look for ways to automate routine work and reduce errors.

• You build trust with clients through consistent delivery, transparency, and simple explanations.

Compensation & Perks

• Monthly compensation in USD: $1,600–$3,500 depending on experience and portfolio complexity.

• Permanent WFH with company-provided equipment (laptop, monitor, accessories).

• 15 days PTO annually + public holidays

• Exposure to diverse US industries and modern remote practices.

• Supportive, documentation-first culture with clear review standards.

Contract Status & Exclusivity:

Nuestro equipo de Ingeniería

En el equipo de Ingeniería desarrollamos soluciones innovadoras para problemas complejos, desarrollando productos que generan impacto real en la vida de miles de personas emprendedoras. Como Staff Software Engineer, tendrás un papel central en la evolución técnica de la organización, actuando no solo en el desarrollo de código, sino también como una referencia técnica que influye en decisiones de arquitectura, producto y negocio. Trabajarás codo a codo con líderes de ingeniería, producto y negocio, ayudando a definir la dirección tecnológica a mediano y largo plazo asegurando que nuestras soluciones sean escalables, resilientes y estén alineadas con la estrategia de la empresa.

El tamaño de tu desafío

• Garantizar la observabilidad, el monitoreo y la escalabilidad de las soluciones en producción, con una mentalidad de ingeniería de largo plazo.

• Conducir revisiones arquitectónicas y técnicas que trascienden los límites de un solo equipo, impactando positivamente toda la plataforma.

Lo que buscamos

• Experiencia liderando iniciativas técnicas de alto impacto que involucren múltiples equipos o áreas.

• Capacidad para influir y alinear a stakeholders técnicos y no técnicos.

• Perfil proactivo, con visión sistémica y pragmatismo para encontrar soluciones simples a problemas complejos.

• Fuerte conexión entre tecnología, producto y negocio.

• Experiencia con metodologías ágiles y trabajo colaborativo a gran escala.

• Uso eficiente y estratégico de herramientas de IA (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.): optimización de contexto/tokens y validación estricta del código generado.

Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos

• Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);

• Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;

• Reintegro del servicio de Internet;

• Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;

• La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;

• Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;

• 15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;

• Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;

• Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;

• Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;

• Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.

Política de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.

Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

postings.descriptionText:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, we empower businesses to unlock the full potential of their customer data. Our clients are industry leaders making bold investments in cutting-edge customer data infrastructure. As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you’ll join a highly motivated and collaborative engineering team to develop advanced data pipelines, create flexible marketing solutions, and integrate powerful AI capabilities enabling our clients to gain deeper insights and activate their data strategically. You’ll work on a world-class, mission-critical platform that sits at the heart of our customers’ data ecosystems, directly influencing how they understand and engage with their audiences.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning. If you’re excited about working on complex challenges, driving innovation, and helping industry-leading brands thrive through data-driven strategies, we’d love to hear from you.

postings.title: Findur Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

Bridgenext is seeking an experienced Findur Developer to join the Derivatives Technology team and design, develop, test, maintain, customize, integrate, and support solutions on the ION Findur (OpenLink Endur) platform. The platform serves as a core system of record for derivative transactions, valuations, risk metrics, and accounting.

The role requires deep hands-on Findur expertise, strong full-stack and integration development capabilities, and a solid understanding of OTC derivatives across the complete trade lifecycle. The developer will build reliable, secure, and scalable solutions that support General Account (GA) and Investment Management (IM) trade-servicing functions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, operations analysts, Business Analysts, Product Owners, technology, security, vendor teams, and cross-functional delivery squads to translate requirements and deliver high-quality, production-ready software solutions.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

• Design, develop, configure, and unit test Findur customizations in accordance with approved functional and technical standards.

• Enhance and support derivative trade-servicing capabilities across General Account (GA) and Investment Management (IM).

• Implement and maintain Findur workflows for trade booking, confirmations, valuations, risk calculations, collateral events, accounting, reporting, and settlement.

• Build and maintain custom scripts, modules, interfaces, and supporting applications within and around the Findur platform.

• Develop and support integrations with upstream and downstream platforms, including trade capture, market data, confirmation, settlement, accounting, risk, and reconciliation systems.

• Work with enterprise and vendor platforms such as Bloomberg EMSX, FX Connect, MarkitServ, BAIS, SLAS, SCD, APEX, AcadiaSoft, RMDB, and IDRMS.

• Develop and support FPML file generation, validation, transmission, and processing.

• Support Findur databases and reporting queries using strong SQL and data-analysis practices.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, source-control practices, code recompilation, release management, and deployment automation aligned with the DevSecOps delivery model.

• Participate in Findur platform upgrades, including version-impact assessment, code recompilation, version testing, regression testing, and deployment validation.

• Participate in sprint planning, story refinement, estimation, and Program Increment (PI) planning ceremonies.

• Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Owners to clarify business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.

• Support cloud resilience and disaster-recovery capabilities, including Findur workloads hosted on AWS EKS where applicable.

• Apply least-privilege access, security-group controls, access reviews, encryption, audit logging, and other enterprise security standards.

• Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit testing, technical documentation, and adherence to approved engineering standards; participate in technology evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives.

• Provide production support, including troubleshooting, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and system optimization.

Must Have Skills

• Deep hands-on knowledge of the ION Findur (OpenLink Endur) platform, including scripting, configuration, administration, trade booking, valuations, risk modules, and accounting modules.

• Experience developing and maintaining Findur customizations, scripts, interfaces, integrations, and modules.

• Strong derivatives domain knowledge covering OTC products such as swaps, options, futures, and forwards.

• End-to-end understanding of the derivatives lifecycle: booking, confirmation, valuation, collateral, settlement, accounting, and reconciliation.

• Experience with interface and integration development across upstream and downstream trade, market-data, confirmation, settlement, accounting, risk, and reconciliation platforms.

• Strong database and SQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting, reporting, and support of Findur's underlying data stores.

• Practical understanding of valuation and risk concepts, including market data, pricing, Greek sensitivities, and volatility surfaces.

• Functional knowledge of trade lifecycle events such as partial buyouts, corporate actions, and qualified purchases.

• Knowledge of collateral management processes, including cleared swaps, futures margining, and Uncleared Margin Rules (UMR) reconciliation.

• Experience supporting production systems, diagnosing incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and optimizing performance.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Bloomberg EMSX, FX Connect, MarkitServ, BAIS, SLAS, SCD, APEX, AcadiaSoft, RMDB, or IDRMS integrations.

• Knowledge of FPML standards and derivative trade-message processing.

• Experience with repository management, code compilation, CI/CD pipeline automation, and DevSecOps practices.

• Exposure to AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes/EKS, cloud resilience, disaster recovery, and OSFI-aligned controls.

• Understanding of security and access management, including least-privilege provisioning, security groups, access reviews, cryptographic standards, and audit/DEVO logging.

• Knowledge of IFRS and NAIC accounting standards, including hedge accounting, journal entries, and regulatory reporting.

• Awareness of regulatory expectations such as OSFI B-10 and relevant operational-resilience requirements.

Professional Skills

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

• Collaborative team player who can also work independently with limited supervision.

• High standards of professionalism, ownership, and quality, with composure during production or delivery-critical situations.

• Analytical problem solver who can translate complex derivative-processing requirements into reliable technical solutions.

• Flexible and open-minded, with a continuous-improvement approach and willingness to propose creative solutions.

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

Hiring Manager: Matthew Sedlacek

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation :

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

• Application submitted (you are here)

• Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

• Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)

• Interview with recruiters (30 min)

• Interview with engineers (1 hour)

• Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)

• Offer!

What You'll Do:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.

• Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.

• Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.

• Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.

• Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.

• Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.

• Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

• Design software applications and features in Golang

• Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.

• Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly

• Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products

• Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products

• Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.

• Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

• At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience

• Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward

• Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.

• Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.

• Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus

• Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.

• Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.

• Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.

• Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS

• Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

• Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python

• Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native

• Backend: Golang

• Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch

• DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

• Version Control: Git

• CI/CD: Gitlab

• Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

• Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.title: Sr/Ssr Software Engineer - Agent Platform
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Kleva

Kleva construye agentes de IA que deciden cuándo y cómo contactar a cada persona, y después llaman, conversan y resuelven. Hoy recuperan deuda para bancos, fintechs y empresas de servicios en 8 países de América Latina, con miles de llamadas concurrentes. No somos una agencia de cobranzas ni un dialer con IA.

Nuestra visión es ser la voz de las empresas en Latam, y cobranzas es el primer paso. Los modelos de IA están disponibles para todos; lo difícil es lo que está alrededor: que la persona atienda, que la llamada suene real, que el agente sepa qué decir y que cada conversación cueste poco. Eso es lo que construye nuestro equipo de ingeniería.

Conocé Kleva en video

El rol

Buscamos a una persona que se sume al equipo que construye la plataforma con la que se crean, configuran, orquestan y evalúan nuestros agentes. La plataforma ya está en producción: vas a evolucionarla y escalarla de punta a punta, en frontend y backend.

No es un rol de forward deployed ni de implementación. No vas a construir agentes para clientes: vas a trabajar en la plataforma sobre la que se diseñan, prueban, despliegan y operan todos nuestros agentes.

Problemas en los que vas a trabajar

• Cómo modelamos un agente para que sea versionado, testeable y reutilizable, sin perder la flexibilidad que pide cada cliente?

• Cómo sabemos, antes de que hable con una persona real, que un cambio de prompt no rompió una negociación? Evals antes de cada cambio, con simulación y regresión sobre sistemas no deterministas

• Cómo hacemos que el agente recuerde entre llamadas y canales? Si alguien dijo que cobra después del 10, no lo llamamos el 5. Si rechazó una propuesta, no se la repetimos

• Cómo elegimos, llamada por llamada, qué voz, tono y guion rinden mejor con cada perfil, y cómo dejamos que la plataforma pruebe variantes y se quede con la que gana?

• Cómo decidimos a quién contactar, cuándo, por qué canal y cuándo frenar, respetando los horarios, la frecuencia máxima y los registros de no llamar de cada país?

Qué vas a hacer

• Desarrollar features de punta a punta, frontend y backend, con ownership completo: desde entender el problema del cliente hasta tenerlo en producción

• Diseñar el modelo de configuración de agentes: prompts, herramientas, reglas, voces y políticas por cliente, versionadas, con rollback y con variantes para experimentar

• Desarrollar la infraestructura de evals junto a QA: deudores simulados, suites de regresión y scoring automático, para que ningún cambio de agente o de prompt llegue a producción sin pasar por ella

• Construir la memoria y el contexto por persona que alimentan cada conversación, entre llamadas y canales

• Desarrollar el motor de orquestación de campañas y canales: ejecuta las decisiones de timing y priorización del equipo de data, sigue la conversación por WhatsApp si no atienden y aplica las reglas de cumplimiento de cada país

• Diseñar e implementar las APIs, contratos, webhooks e integraciones con los sistemas enterprise de cada cliente: carga de carteras, consulta de deuda, registro de promesas y confirmación de pagos

• Contribuir a la arquitectura del sistema a medida que escala en volumen y países

• Resolver incidentes en producción. Si surge un problema crítico, esperamos que te involucres y ayudes a resolverlo

Stack

• Frontend: TypeScript, React y Next.js

• Backend: Node.js con TypeScript, Go y Python

• Datos: PostgreSQL y Redis

• Infraestructura: AWS y Docker

Contexto del rol

• Reporta a: Head of Engineering

• Trabaja con: Producto, Operaciones, Delivery, QA y Data

Qué no buscamos

• Quien siente que ya llegó al nivel profesional que quería

• Perfiles que necesitan un spec cerrado para arrancar. Acá recibís un problema, no un ticket. Si necesitás tres reuniones para empezar a codear, no es tu lugar

• Quien necesita certeza antes de avanzar. Ir rápido significa equivocarse seguido, hacer y rehacer; lo aceptamos porque equivocarnos rápido enseña más que acertar tarde. No hay PMs que te mastiquen tickets

• Quien construye la plataforma antes de entender el patrón. Primero entendemos cómo opera cada cliente; después generalizamos

Requirements

• 4+ años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo de software

• Dominio de TypeScript, React, Next.js y Node.js

• Sólido manejo de PostgreSQL y experiencia con bases NoSQL

• Experiencia diseñando REST APIs, contratos y webhooks, y modelos de datos que aguanten el cambio

• Comodidad con Git, CI/CD y AWS

• Mentalidad de plataforma: pensás en abstracciones reutilizables y sabés cuándo todavía no conviene generalizar

• Capacidad de trabajar de forma independiente, tomar ownership y resolver sin supervisión constante

• Uso intensivo y crítico de asistentes de código con IA (Claude Code o Cursor). La IA escribe; el criterio y lo que mergeás son tuyos

Deseable

• Experiencia construyendo con LLMs en producción: prompting, tool use, structured outputs y evals

• Experiencia en plataformas de agentes, workflow engines, motores de reglas o developer tooling

• Experiencia construyendo copilots o asistentes conversacionales que operan sobre APIs de producto

• Experiencia en Go

• Sistemas multi-tenant, de alta concurrencia o altamente configurables

• Arquitecturas event-driven y colas

• Background en fintech, cobranzas o productos B2B enterprise

• Experiencia en startups early stage

Benefits

• Salario competitivo en dólares

• Tres semanas pagas de vacaciones por año

• Esquema híbrido en Buenos Aires. Al menos 1 día por semana vamos a la oficina.

• Un equipo chico donde lo que construís llega a producción en días

• En cada interacción, valoramos los resultados por encima de los egos o jerarquías

Cómo es trabajar en Kleva

• Equipos chicos, talentosos y emprendedores. Vas a trabajar en equipos autónomos y orientados a resultados, junto a personas excepcionales

• Una oportunidad excepcional para crecer. Hacemos todo lo posible por contratar personas con un potencial fuera de lo común, y después nuestra prioridad es ponerlas en el lugar ideal para que se destaquen. En Kleva, la responsabilidad se gana con resultados, no con antigüedad:

• Amplificá tu impacto con IA. Integrá las herramientas de IA más potentes en todo tu flujo de desarrollo (diseño, implementación, testing y documentación) para ir más rápido sin bajar la vara en calidad, confiabilidad y mantenibilidad

• Simplificá sin descanso. Cuestioná cada capa de complejidad. Mejorá arquitecturas, pipelines y codebases para construir sistemas más simples, más escalables y más fáciles de mantener

postings.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Staff Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year.

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/.

Location & Remote Work for technology and remote-first roles

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Argentina. We also offer the option of working from our Buenos Aires offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

As a Staff Software Engineer , you will act as a premier technical anchor and individual contributor for our engineering organization. Operating with a line-level and organization-wide scope of impact, you will own the technical strategy and architectural roadmap of complex, large-scale products or platforms that are critical to the company's long-term vision.

We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. This is an advanced leadership role that requires navigating cross-team technical architecture, managing technical alignment with stakeholders, and handling organizational and product dynamics across multiple structures.

Key Responsibilities (What you will do):

• Architectural direction & strategy: Set the core architectural direction for complex platform scopes. Identify and generate new org-wide technical opportunities, defining the technical strategy and roadmap required to execute them.

• Simplifying complex challenges: Break down vague, unstructured, and highly ambiguous problems into execution-ready technical scope. Create simple, highly maintainable systems with clear documentation and well-defined interfaces that can be easily operated even by junior engineers.

• Engineering excellence & trade-off ownership: Drive the technical quality for larger or complex team scopes by establishing engineering standards and best practices. Act as a technical advisor, defining policies and proactively mitigating obstacles for software, product, and data quality across multiple domains.

• Team influence & mentorship: Act as an absolute reference in technical leadership within Engineering. Provide senior technical assessments to management to inform project strategy and composition. Actively mentor senior engineers (including B6 and B7 levels), accelerating their technical growth without relying on formal authority.

• Guard the tech bar: Act as a lead interviewer for senior and principal technical roles, setting the bar during our hiring, sourcing, and internal allocation processes.

Position & technical challenges:

Because we are scaling multiple strategic fronts simultaneously, we run a unified hiring process for our Staff positions. Instead of locking you into a single team from day one, we focus on assessing your leadership, systemic thinking, and architectural skills first.

At the final stage of the process, we will present you with 2 or 3 of our most critical technical challenges across different products and platforms. Together, we will choose the allocation that best aligns your expertise and career aspirations with our highest-impact business needs.

Regardless of the final allocation, your day-to-day will deeply involve solving systemic issues where multiple services cannot be understood in isolation. You will step into environments requiring high-concurrency solutions, complex data consistency, and the decoupling of mission-critical systems.

What we are looking for (Requirements):

• 10+ years of experience in software development, with a consolidated background leading the delivery of high-volume, high-concurrency, and mission-critical distributed systems.

• Deep knowledge of modern software architecture paradigms, distributed data consistency, fault tolerance, and system optimization.

• Proven ability to analyze and articulate engineering trade-offs concretely (e.g., simplicity vs. flexibility, velocity vs. reliability, build vs. buy).

• Demonstrated capability to remove barriers to collaboration, conduct difficult structural conversations smoothly, build strategic roadmaps, and foster an inclusive engineering culture.

• Experience designing systems that cross team boundaries and remain maintainable as teams and products scale.

• Fluency in Spanish and excellent English skills (verbal and written) are mandatory, as we use English daily for code, architecture documentation, and global alignment.

Important

• Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.

• All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

• Application

• Technical CV screening

• People Interview with Recruiters

• Tech Screening with Engineering Team (Code AI live case)

• Technicals Interviews (architecture live cases and tech leadership)

• Offer

Benefits

• Medical plan

• Wellhub

• Extended parental leave

• Reinstatement of Guarderia

• Telework expenses (monthly amount)

• Discounts on day-to-day services

• Free day for compleaños, Father's Day and Mother's Day

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

postings.descriptionText:
About Chainlink

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Data Feeds team, you’ll collaborate with an experienced technical team of other engineers, distributed systems computing experts, and security experts, who are all committed to building a world-changing decentralized infrastructure. You’ll develop and build highly scalable, secure, and reliable software that will change the way smart contracts function at a fundamental level, with a focus on Data Feeds. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and master the latest research concerning distributed systems, cryptography, blockchains, game theory, consensus algorithms, and decentralized applications. You will be given a high level of autonomy/ownership over your projects, the opportunity to expand your scope of knowledge, and the chance to help build the decentralized infrastructure of the future.

Your Impact

• Designing and implementing new features within the Data Product space, such as trust-minimized off-chain computation & the aggregation of external data in various blockchain environments, and many more problems

• Design and own the end to end delivery of new and existing data products that power the largest market share of Defi by total value secured (TVS)

• Learn more about the underlying technology in the blockchain ecosystem (Solana, Avalanche, Polygon, Ethereum, and more).

• Build our core products with Smart Contracts using Solidity, Move, and Rust.

• Partner with the research team to build cutting-edge products
