postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

• Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.

• Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.

• Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.

• Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.

• Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.

• Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.

• Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.

• Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams.

What We Are Looking For In You

• Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation

• Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.

• Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques

• Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills

• Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal

• Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.

• You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

• Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP

• Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)

• Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.

• Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.

• Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Software Development Engineer II
postings.descriptionText:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, we empower businesses to unlock the full potential of their customer data. Our clients are industry leaders making bold investments in cutting-edge customer data infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer, you’ll join a highly motivated and collaborative engineering team to develop advanced data pipelines, create flexible marketing solutions, and integrate powerful AI capabilities enabling our clients to gain deeper insights and activate their data strategically. You’ll work on a world-class, mission-critical platform that sits at the heart of our customers’ data ecosystems, directly influencing how they understand and engage with their audiences.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning. If you're excited about working on complex challenges, driving innovation, and helping industry-leading brands thrive through data-driven strategies, we’d love to hear from you.

Interesting Problems

• Process and understand large amounts of structured and unstructured customer, product, and event data

• Building delightful, full-stack experiences and toolsets to help users visualize their data, understand their customers and surface the most impactful insight

• Use the latest data science and AI advancements to build experiences that accelerate the time to value for data developers and marketers

• Integrate our system into the operating core of the businesses we serve

• Improve how marketers use their customer data

Success Measures

• Production Feature Delivery:: Take end-to-end ownership of building and releasing reliable application features, data workflows, and AI capabilities, driving tasks from design to 100% completion ("done means done") to move the business forward.

• Customer-Centric & Value: Develop intuitive full-stack user experiences and data visualization toolsets that simplify complex customer data, directly accelerating time-to-value for marketers and data developers.

• Pragmatic Functional Engineering: Write clean, scalable code in functional paradigms across data and application layers, ensuring tools and pipelines focus on tangible operational efficiency rather than unnecessary complexity.

• Collaborative Growth & Regional Hub Culture: Help establish Amperity’s new engineering footprint in Argentina by partnering closely with global cross-functional teams, giving and receiving feedback with candor and care, and contributing to shared team wins.

About You

• 5+ experience including 3+ years developing enterprise software

• 3+ years of experience building applications on database technologies experience with big data technologies

• 3+ years working in a production environment. In this duration, you have shown an ability to get products and features released to customers

• Excited about using or learning functional languages (like Clojure!) in a production environment

• Passionate about building elegant user experiences on top of complex technology

• Collaborative, inclusive, and inspired by your customers’ success

Technologies We Use

We don’t expect you to have experience with everything we use—but if you’re excited about learning, you’ll do great here. Our tech stack includes:

• Large-scale data engines like Apache Spark, Presto, and Kafka.

• Functional programming languages including Clojure, ClojureScript, and the React ecosystem.

• Cloud-native infrastructure built with Kubernetes and Terraform, deployed across multiple cloud providers.

• Machine learning models and systems including random forests, logistic regression, and probabilistic databases.

Location

Argentina - Remote

This role is remote, with a small number of meaningful in-person gatherings designed to support alignment and collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package, along with benefits designed to support your well-being and long-term growth. Our total rewards program includes base compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to participate in our company’s equity plan.

Amperity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and reproductive health choices), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as someone with a disability, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

postings.title: Senior Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

• Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues

• Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops

• Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis

• Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets

• Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues

• Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

• Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing

• Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)

• Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management

• Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)

• Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting

• Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

• Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)

• Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration

• Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

• Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances

• Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring

• Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage

• Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

• Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build

• Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions

• Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback

• Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead

• Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications

• 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale

• Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack

• Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling

• Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)

• Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns

• Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack

• Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications

• AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)

• Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)

• Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services

• Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)

• Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)

• Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

• Pay in USD

• 100% remote work

• Generous holidays and flexible PTO

• Competitive phantom equity

• Paid for exams and certifications

• Peer bonus awards

• State of the art laptop and tools

• Equipment & Office Stipend

• Individual professional development plan

• Annual stipend for Learning and Development

• Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements.

These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals.

If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner.

If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com

Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

postings.descriptionText:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About The Role

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the backend team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody that cares about code quality and not just get things done, but get things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline and you want to thrive in a fast paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

During your first month at Fever (Onboarding period):

You’ll join a structured onboarding program designed to help you ramp up smoothly. During this period, you will:

• Meet your buddy and team, and get to know Fever’s culture and ways of working.

• Set up your local environment and become familiar with our Python-based stack, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.

• Learn about our architecture and observability tools while contributing small improvements and fixes.

• Have your first code running in production and a clear understanding of our delivery flow and processes.

• By the end of the onboarding, you’ll be ready to join your long-term squad and start contributing to larger initiatives.

After 3 months at Fever:

You’ll be confidently collaborating and delivering at full speed. You will:

• Design and implement end-to-end features within your squad.

• Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements across our services and APIs.

• Work with event-driven systems and focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Data, and other Engineering teams to enhance our platform and developer experience.

By your 6th month at Fever:

You’ll be fully established as a key contributor in your team. You will:

• Take ownership of core components and help evolve their architecture.

• Lead by example through code reviews, design sessions, and mentoring.

• Contribute to best practices in areas like scalability, observability, and system design.

• Drive continuous improvement and have a visible impact on how we build high-performing services at scale.

• Become an expert of your domain, using business context and technical excellence to drive strategic initiatives forward

About You

Must have skills:

• Strong knowledge on good practices, testing and design patterns

• You are proficient in business English

• You know how to deliver code from development to production

• Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)

• Knowledge of relational databases and SQL

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

• Django/Flask

• PostgreSQL

• Redis

• Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

• Experience working on agile methodology

• Event communication between services

• Handling services with more than 1000 request/second.

• AWS, Docker and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

• "Relación de dependencia" contract.

• Osde 410 as medical insurance

• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences

• Home office friendly anywhere in Argentina

• English Lessons

• WellHub Membership

• PedidosYa Plus

• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader

• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth

• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

• Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance (including Base, Variable, and Stock Options).

About The Process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

• Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.

• Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.

• Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

About Backblaze

Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage supports data-intensive workloads including backup, media, analytics, and modern AI pipelines. Our teams focus on building durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on developer experience and operational efficiency.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks, and example applications that make Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage a natural part of how AI workflows are constructed and deployed. This is a front-row seat to the AI ecosystem as it evolves, working directly with the latest AI startups, open source frameworks, and developer tools. This role is expected to actively use the latest AI coding agents and tools as part of everyday development work.

The primary objective is to build and contribute production-quality open source integrations, new frameworks, and end-to-end example applications that demonstrate how B2 supports AI workflows. A practical understanding of AI workflows, agent-based systems, and data orchestration is required. This role demands continuous learning and hands-on testing of emerging AI frameworks and APIs as they mature, and is best suited for someone genuinely excited to work at the forefront of AI development.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Use AI coding agents to build coding harnesses to accelerate the development, testing, and maintenance of public and internal applications, SDKs, notebooks, and reference implementations that demonstrate AI and cloud storage best practices.

• Implement and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks and example applications using languages commonly used in the open source ecosystem, including Python, TypeScript, Go, and Rust.

• Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate implementation while validating correctness, security, and performance.

Tools and Technologies

• Open source AI frameworks and tooling

• AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex

What We’re Looking For

• Software engineer with experience contributing to open source projects in one or more widely used open source languages.

• Practical understanding of AI workflows, including data ingestion, preprocessing, inference, and agent-based systems.

• Experience writing production-quality code with strong testing and documentation practices.

Why Backblaze

• Remote-first culture supporting work-life balance.

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer - Insurance
postings.descriptionText:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About The Role

Our mission is to evolve the platform architecture and workflows that let Insurance scale across more customers, more products, and new markets, and to close the gap between AI capabilities built centrally and their reliable adoption in production.

As a Staff Software Engineer - Insurance, you will be a senior technical leader across two connected fronts: diagnosing and evolving our service architecture as the platform scales, and leading the rollout of AI/agentic tooling across the team's engineering workflow, from spec and code generation to testing and validation.

You will operate at platform scale, building infrastructure and practices other teams depend on, while partnering closely with Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and Insurance partners. You'll be part of a lean, entrepreneurial team that delivers outsized business impact while protecting millions of customers, sitting at the intersection of embedded insurance, Nu's most important customer surfaces, and our insurer partners. This team is also one of the earliest adopters of agentic engineering within Nubank, putting you at the center of how that transformation actually happens.

You’ll be responsible for

• Diagnosing and evolving our platform architecture to remove constraints on scale, supporting a growing user base, expanding product portfolio, and global expansion.

• Providing AI-first engineering leadership, setting the standards and practices for how the team builds and evolves with AI/agentic tooling.

• Cutting through ambiguity, surfacing trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Security, Compliance, Insurance partners) around clear outcomes.

• Ensuring observability for AI systems and platform services in production (tracing, logging, alerting).

• Mentoring engineers on technical approach across both architecture and AI/agentic best practices, raising the team's execution level over time.

• Evaluating and incorporating both internal (Nubank) and external AI tools and agents into our workflows, based on what best fits our needs.

• Partnering with Nubank's central AI/platform teams and other BUs to share learnings and stay aligned on tooling direction.

• Enabling more Nubankers to safely contribute to AI-powered products over time (engineers and non-engineers)

• Embedding responsible, auditable practices in everything shipped, across platform and AI systems alike, per applicable regulations and internal risk standards.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

• Proven technical leadership as a senior/staff engineer delivering high-impact, large-scale software systems in production.

• Track record of mentoring and uplifting peers on technical approach and AI-native workflows.

• Strong systems/platform engineering experience: architecture, CI/CD, test automation, able to evolve infrastructure to support reliable adoption of new technology.

• Genuine interest and foundational knowledge of AI/LLM concepts, ready to build hands-on fluency with our agentic tooling.

• Ownership mindset for rolling out AI/agentic tooling across a team, driving adoption of testing, CI/CD validation, and evaluation practices, not just personal use.

• Strong full-stack thinking: ability to design maintainable codebases and APIs that bridge model inference/orchestration layers with user-facing surfaces.

• Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional projects that require coordination across multiple business units and stakeholders.

• Demonstrated strategic acumen, linking technical initiatives to business drivers such as operational efficiency, risk, and customer acquisition or engagement.

• Experience in fintech or other regulated industries (e.g., financial services, insurance, payments) or similarly complex domains.

• Advanced English for daily collaboration in a global environment.

Nice to Have

• AI-first mindset with professional experience implementing LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and/or RAG systems in real-world products.

• Solid understanding of prompt engineering, tool calling, context management, and agent loops, with ability to contribute to shared agent libraries and commands.

• Experience building or contributing to automated test/CI-CD evaluation frameworks that catch and fix failures with minimal human intervention.

• Background in insurance or embedded insurance products.

• Experience scaling products across international markets and languages.

• Familiarity with Portuguese and/or Spanish to read or review customer-facing copy (optional).

• Prior experience in AI-first startups or big-tech environments with strong AI/ML teams.

Location for this opportunity

• São Paulo, Buenos Aires

Work Model for this Role

• Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our Benefits

For this role, we offer a competitive, global-level package that currently includes:

• Competitive compensation and company equity

• Bi-annual trips to Brazil to build relationships with coworkers

• Top-tier Medical Insurance

• Top-tier Dental and Vision Insurance

• Generous time off and company holidays

• Life Insurance and AD&D

• Extended maternity and paternity leaves

• NuLanguage – our language learning program

• NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program

Specific benefits may vary slightly by country and will be detailed during the process.

Join us

If you want to help evolve the architecture and AI-powered workflows that let Nubank’s Insurance platform scale across products and markets — combining deep systems thinking with hands-on agentic engineering — we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to be our Staff Software Engineer – Insurance.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

postings.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
AI Systems

En Accenture buscamos un/a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer para integrarse en la operación de nuestros clientes, entender cómo trabaja su gente y construir soluciones de inteligencia artificial que resuelvan problemas concretos.

Vas a involucrarte desde el discovery: conversar con usuarios, observar procesos, revisar datos y restricciones, e identificar dónde se pierde tiempo, costo o calidad. Vas a participar en decidir qué se construye, por qué y cómo se mide si funciona. Después, vas a diseñar, programar, integrar y desplegar la solución, acompañando su uso y evolución en producción.

Es una posición de contribuidor individual senior , con liderazgo técnico y participación directa en el código. Tendrás autonomía para priorizar y ajustar la solución con evidencia, dentro de los objetivos y límites acordados con el cliente. El éxito se mide por la adopción sostenida, el impacto operativo y la confiabilidad de lo que construís. La solución debe quedar con responsables claros y capacidad de continuidad cuando cambies de proyecto.

Qué vas a hacer

• Entender procesos de negocio de punta a punta junto con usuarios y equipos del cliente, identificando objetivos, fricciones, restricciones y riesgos.

• Priorizar casos de uso, definir una primera versión útil y acordar criterios de éxito y métricas de impacto.

• Diseñar y construir soluciones de GenAI con LLMs y agentes cuando aporten valor. Elegir código determinístico o workflows tradicionales cuando sean la mejor respuesta.

• Integrar las soluciones con APIs, bases de datos, documentos y sistemas empresariales.

• Desplegar y operar en cloud con evaluación de calidad, testing, observabilidad, manejo de fallas, mecanismos de recuperación y seguimiento de costo y latencia.

• Implementar controles de identidad y permisos, protección de datos y secretos, auditoría, límites de acción y supervisión humana cuando corresponda.

• Validar con usuarios, medir adopción y resultados, y reformular la solución cuando la evidencia contradiga la hipótesis inicial.

• Documentar decisiones, preparar la transferencia de conocimiento y convertir aprendizajes en componentes y prácticas reutilizables, respetando la confidencialidad y los acuerdos de cada proyecto.

Qué buscamos

• Experiencia significativa construyendo y sosteniendo sistemas en producción, con responsabilidad directa sobre decisiones técnicas y resultados.

• Práctica hands-on reciente y sustancial: escribir, revisar y desplegar código, operar sistemas y resolver problemas en producción. Dominio de Python o un lenguaje equivalente y capacidad para pasar de la arquitectura a la implementación.

• Fundamentos sólidos de ingeniería de software: APIs e integraciones, modelado de datos, autenticación y autorización, testing, CI/CD y manejo de fallas.

• Experiencia con sistemas basados en LLMs en producción: evaluación, trazabilidad, calidad de respuesta, costo, latencia y detección de respuestas plausibles pero incorrectas. Criterio para decidir cuándo usar un agente y cuándo elegir otro enfoque.

• Profundidad en al menos una plataforma cloud, como Azure, AWS o GCP, y capacidad para trasladar patrones de arquitectura, seguridad y operación a otros entornos.

• Capacidad para trabajar directamente con usuarios y referentes de negocio, cuestionar supuestos con evidencia, explicar decisiones y construir acuerdos.

• Autonomía para avanzar con información incompleta, validar hipótesis, cambiar de rumbo y reconocer cuándo una decisión requiere escalar riesgos o compromisos.

• Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito, para participar con claridad en conversaciones de negocio y técnicas, explicar decisiones y elaborar documentación.

Experiencias que suman

• Trabajo integrado a equipos de clientes y experiencia en industrias reguladas.

• LLMOps, evaluación automatizada, tracing e infraestructura como código.

• RAG, integración de herramientas con LLMs, gestión de contexto y bases vectoriales.

• Liderazgo técnico sin autoridad jerárquica.

Los productos propios, proyectos con usuarios reales, contribuciones públicas y certificaciones pueden aportar evidencia adicional. Son opcionales: nos interesa lo que construiste, las decisiones que tomaste y cómo funcionó en la práctica. Valoramos trayectorias y formaciones diversas que demuestren el nivel requerido.

Cómo será el proceso

El proceso contempla tres instancias: una conversación inicial con Recruiting, una entrevista con el Hiring Manager sobre un caso que hayas llevado a producción y una sesión técnica de trabajo sobre código, diseño y operación.

La evaluación técnica se basa en situaciones representativas del rol, con material preparado para la entrevista o casos que puedas compartir respetando la confidencialidad.

Si te interesa combinar trabajo con clientes e ingeniería, postulate y contanos sobre una solución que hayas construido y sostenido en producción , tu contribución y lo que aprendiste.

Ok… si llegaste a leer hasta acá, te adelantamos lo que también es necesario que sepas: parte de nuestros grandes beneficios:

👨‍👩‍👦‍👦 Licencias de Paternidad & Maternidad Extendida

💰 Ayuda Económica para Guardería y muchos ➕!

So… ARE YOU READY TO ROCK? 💥

🌎 Trabajá desde cualquier parte de la Argentina de forma 100% remota. También ¡tenemos oficinas a disposición en CABA, Córdoba, Mar del Plata y Rosario!

EN ACCENTURE, LA IGUALDAD IMPULSA LA INNOVACIÓN

postings.title: Software Engineer Full Stack & AI First
postings.descriptionText:
En Homie estamos transformando la forma en que las personas rentan vivienda en LATAM. No somos un portal de anuncios: administramos la renta de principio a fin en representación de los propietarios desde la captación y las visitas hasta el contrato, la gestión de la renta y la dispersión a los dueños.

Después de casi diez años operando, estamos modernizando y reconstruyendo el núcleo de nuestra tecnología sobre bases AI-first: sistemas simples, bien probados y altamente apalancados en IA, capaces de operar todo el ciclo de renta con velocidad y calidad.

Buscamos a alguien que construya con criterio: que use la IA como multiplicador real no como autocompletado, que sepa exactamente qué no construir y que se obsesione con la simplicidad, la calidad y los datos limpios. Si te emociona resolver problemas de negocio reales con apalancamiento de IA y tener impacto directo en un producto que mueve el mercado, queremos conocerte.

Misión del rol Diseñar y construir con alto apalancamiento de IA, un núcleo de software simple, robusto y bien probado que habilite una mejor experiencia para propietarios, inquilinos y equipos internos, y que pueda evolucionar rápido sin acumular complejidad ni deuda.

Tu trabajo no es solo escribir código: es construir los sistemas, las barreras de calidad y la observabilidad que permiten al equipo y a la IA entregar rápido y con confianza.

Elevas el estándar técnico, mantienes los datos como activo central del negocio y aseguras que todo lo que sale a producción esté probado, sea reproducible y aporte valor real.

Tareas

• Construir de punta a punta (full-stack), diseñas e implementas funcionalidades completas del ciclo de renta de la base de datos a la interfaz, con ownership end-to-end y comodidad para moverte por todo el stack.

• Usas agentes de IA (p. ej. Claude Code) como forma principal de construir, orquestándolos para generar código, pruebas, documentación y exploración de soluciones, siempre bajo tu criterio y revisión.

• Revisas y validas críticamente el código propio, del equipo o generado por IA detectando errores lógicos, alucinaciones, riesgos de seguridad, ineficiencias y problemas de mantenibilidad.

• Pruebas unitarias, de integración y end-to-end, CI/CD y "barreras de salida" que impidan que algo roto llegue a producción. Esa automatización es lo que hace seguro apalancarse en IA.

• Instrumentas tracking de errores, de generaciones de IA y de producto; detectas problemas antes que el usuario y cierras el ciclo de mejora idealmente hasta conectar el error con una propuesta de solución.

• Mantienes infraestructura, configuración y proveedores versionados y reproducibles, de modo que todo sea trazable y reversible, nada de configuraciones críticas que vivan solo en el panel de un proveedor.

• Modelas con claridad las entidades centrales del negocio (propietarios, propiedades, inquilinos, contratos, pagos) en un core de datos bien estructurado, multipaís y multimarca, pensado para reutilizarse.

• Priorizas sin piedad, eliminas complejidad y te enfocas en el 80% que mueve el negocio. Resistes la tentación de lo "brillante" que no aporta valor.

• Diseñas con foco en optimización de recursos y control de costos en AWS, tratando la salud financiera del stack como parte del trabajo de ingeniería.

• Incorporas seguridad desde el diseño y proteges el activo más valioso de Homie: sus datos. En dónde viven, cómo se acceden y qué los toca.

• Propones estándares, documentación y mejores prácticas que multiplican la capacidad de toda la organización con IA no solo la tuya, y colaboras de cerca con Producto y Operaciones para traducir necesidades reales en soluciones simples.

Requisitos

• Experiencia sólida como ingeniero full-stack senior: dominio de TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js y Node, además de servicios de backend y modelado de datos (SQL). Cómodo y con ganas de tomar ownership de extremo a extremo.

• Experiencia real construyendo con agentes de IA (Claude Code o similares) como forma principal de desarrollo, no solo autocompletado, con el criterio para revisar, probar y corregir lo que producen.

• Disciplina fuerte de testing (unitarias, integración, e2e), CI/CD y observabilidad.

• Experiencia con AWS y mentalidad de costo/eficiencia.

• Conocimiento sólido de seguridad en el desarrollo, aplicada desde el diseño.

• Sesgo por la simplicidad: capacidad de modelar datos limpios y de elegir la solución más simple que resuelve el problema. Aplicas buenos patrones y criterio de ingeniería al servicio de la mantenibilidad, no de la complejidad.

• Alta autonomía, pensamiento sistémico, criterio de negocio, ownership y sentido de urgencia.

• Comunicación clara para explicar decisiones técnicas y colaborar con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos. Español fluido; inglés para documentación y herramientas.

Valoramos si:

• SaaS multitenant / multipaís, idealmente en LATAM.

• Dominio en real estate, fintech o productos financieros.

• React Native (tenemos en el horizonte una app para propietarios).

• Familiaridad con stacks legados (Ruby on Rails, Java) para apoyar la transición mientras construimos lo nuevo.

• Experiencia integrando plataformas de negocio como HubSpot.

Cómo trabajamos

• AI-first, con humanos al mando. La IA construye gran parte del código; las personas deciden qué construir y responden por la calidad. Primero invertimos en hacer la base segura para que la IA contribuya bien.

• Preferimos un núcleo simple y sólido a una constelación de sistemas. Decidir dejar de hacer cosas es parte del trabajo.

• Calidad y datos como cimiento. Testing, observabilidad y un core de datos limpio desde el día uno.

• Apalancamiento a nivel organización. El objetivo no es darle una herramienta a cada ingeniero, sino elevar la capacidad de todo Homie.

Colaboración interna

Este rol trabaja principalmente con el equipo de Tecnología en el diseño, construcción y evolución de la plataforma. También colabora de cerca con Producto para traducir necesidades del negocio en soluciones técnicas simples; con Operaciones para entender flujos internos, automatizaciones y puntos de fricción; y con las áreas comerciales y de servicio cuando haya que construir soluciones que impacten directamente la experiencia de propietarios, inquilinos o equipos internos.

En Homie creemos que los mejores equipos se construyen con perspectivas distintas. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias, trayectorias, identidades y contextos, porque nos ayuda a tomar mejores decisiones y a construir soluciones más completas.

Buscamos un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar con libertad, aprender, retarse y crecer. Si quieres sumarte a una empresa que está construyendo una mejor experiencia de renta para LATAM y te interesa la tecnología con impacto real, nos gustaría conocerte.

postings.title: Senior Agentic AI Developer
postings.descriptionText:
About Us
Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a strong technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We work closely with international teams and partners, creating technology that makes a difference.

More information: http://coderio.com

The Role
We are seeking a Senior Enterprise AI & Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent workflows and conversational agents at scale. This role bridges the gap between advanced AI development (Python, LLMs) and enterprise operations (Microsoft Stack, Azure).

You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of mission-critical AI solutions: developing custom agents, integrating them with enterprise data platforms (Snowflake), and ensuring robust observability (Splunk) in cloud environments. If you thrive in complex ecosystems and know how to turn AI capabilities into tangible business value—while leveraging tools like Cursor IDE or GitHub Copilot to accelerate your own delivery—this high-impact role is for you.

What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)

• AI & Agentic Development: Design and build conversational solutions, custom copilots, and agentic workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and custom Python architectures.

• Enterprise Integration: Connect AI agents and automated workflows seamlessly with enterprise data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake and SharePoint.

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Architect and operate resilient, large-scale cloud infrastructures on Azure, managing deployments via CI/CD pipelines (YAML, GitOps patterns).

• Observability & Governance: Develop advanced monitoring, logging, and auditing strategies using Splunk to track agent performance, latency, and operational bottlenecks.

• Engineering Excellence: Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools (Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate coding, improve code quality, and set best practices for the team.

• Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional, global teams, providing technical direction, participating in client discussions, and recommending emerging AI technologies.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Automation roles with demonstrated impact at an enterprise scale.

• 4+ years of hands-on experience developing with Python (building robust backend services, APIs, and data integrations).

• 2+ years of experience designing and deploying solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or Power Virtual Agents) and Power Automate.

• Proven experience building agentic workflows or AI pipelines, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into business processes.

• Solid cloud expertise, strongly focused on Azure (AWS is a plus).

• Experience integrating applications or agents with Snowflake.

• Proven background in building high-volume logging and monitoring ecosystems (e.g., Splunk, multi-region ingestion, automated reporting).

• Daily active user of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, ChatGPT) to optimize engineering workflows.

• Bilingual English

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, artifacts, YAML).

• Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen).

• Experience with SharePoint integrations, reusable modules, and reproducible infrastructure standards.

Benefits

• 100% remote work.

• High-impact strategic role with autonomy and ownership.

• Opportunity to scale cloud and automation practices in global environments.

• Collaborative senior engineering culture with strong technical leadership.

• Clear growth pathway and access to leadership opportunities.

Why Join Coderio?
At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a fully remote company passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment with real growth opportunities. If you are motivated to design scalable cloud infrastructures, elevate DevOps practices, and build AI-powered automation that makes a difference, we’d love to meet you.

Apply now.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: NetSuite Developer
postings.descriptionText:
To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.

Job Title: Senior NetSuite Developer

About The Company

Our client is a growing powersports and recreational vehicle business that sells UTVs, ATVs, motorcycles, and other outdoor mobility products.

Job Description

Our client is looking for an experienced Senior NetSuite Developer. You will lead and support the development, customization, integration, and improvement of their business systems. You need extensive experience with Oracle NetSuite. You also need hands-on knowledge of Celigo integration tools. Experience integrating NetSuite with Shopify and other business applications is required. This role focuses on improving system functions, making business processes smoother, keeping integrations working well, and ensuring accurate data flow. This includes e-commerce, inventory, order management, and financial systems.

You will play a key role in making sure business systems work together efficiently. You will support business growth with scalable technical solutions and reliable system integrations.

Responsibilities Of The Role

• Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle NetSuite solutions.

• Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions, including SuiteScript 2.x.

• Customize NetSuite records, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, and reports.

• Build and maintain scripts, scheduled processes, and automated business workflows.

• Develop and maintain Suitelets, RESTlets, User Event scripts, and Client scripts.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of existing solutions.

• Translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Maintain clear technical documentation for customizations, scripts, and system changes.

• Develop, configure, monitor, and maintain integrations using Celigo integrator.io.

• Build and optimize integration flows between NetSuite, Shopify, and other business applications.

• Manage data synchronization for orders, customers, products, inventory, fulfillment, and financial transactions.

• Troubleshoot integration failures, data mapping issues, and synchronization errors.

• Implement error-handling processes, logging, monitoring, and recovery procedures.

• Optimize integration flows to improve data accuracy, processing speed, and reliability.

• Maintain integration documentation and ensure changes are tested before deployment.

• Maintain and improve the integration between Shopify and NetSuite.

• Ensure accurate synchronization of product information, inventory levels, customer records, and sales orders.

• Support order processing, fulfillment updates, cancellations, returns, refunds, and related workflows.

• Troubleshoot discrepancies between Shopify transactions and NetSuite records.

• Improve automation across e-commerce order management and back-office operations.

• Collaborate with e-commerce and operations teams to identify opportunities for improved system functionality.

• Support additional Shopify-related integrations and custom development.

• Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation.

• Develop solutions that support inventory management, order processing, purchasing, fulfillment, and financial operations.

• Improve data consistency and reduce manual entry across connected systems.

• Collaborate with finance, inventory, e-commerce, and operations teams to understand system requirements.

• Recommend improvements to NetSuite configuration, integrations, and business processes.

• Help ensure systems can support increasing transaction volumes and business growth.

• Investigate and resolve complex NetSuite, Celigo, and Shopify integration issues.

• Perform unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support.

• Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues.

• Manage system updates, code changes, deployments, and ongoing maintenance.

• Follow development best practices, including version control, change management, and technical documentation.

• Ensure system changes are implemented carefully to minimize disruption to business operations.

• Provide technical support and guidance to internal stakeholders.

• Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define technical solutions.

• Lead complex development and integration projects from planning through implementation.

• Provide recommendations on system architecture, integration design, and automation opportunities.

• Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical team members.

• Help establish development standards and maintain the quality of technical solutions.

• Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

Required Experience And Qualifications

• Significant professional experience as a NetSuite Developer or in a comparable senior ERP development role.

• Strong knowledge of Oracle NetSuite customization, development, and administration.

• Hands-on experience with SuiteScript 2.x and NetSuite APIs.

• Proven experience developing and maintaining integrations using Celigo integrator.io.

• Practical experience integrating NetSuite with Shopify.

• Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, data mapping, and integration architecture.

• Experience working with JSON, XML, and other data exchange formats.

• Understanding of ERP workflows, including order management, inventory, fulfillment, and financial transactions.

• Experience troubleshooting complex system and integration issues.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

• Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.

• Excellent documentation, communication, and project management skills.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical projects.

Preferred Skills

• Experience supporting e-commerce or direct-to-consumer businesses.

• Experience with Shopify order management, product catalogs, inventory synchronization, and fulfillment workflows.

• Familiarity with NetSuite financials, purchasing, inventory management, and warehouse-related processes.

• Experience with additional integration platforms, middleware, or third-party APIs.

• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.

• Experience with sandbox environments, deployment processes, and release management.

• NetSuite certifications or relevant technical certifications.

• Experience managing high-volume e-commerce transactions and complex system integrations.

Personality

• You are a senior-level developer who combines deep NetSuite technical expertise with practical experience connecting ERP systems to e-commerce platforms.

• You are comfortable managing complex integrations, writing and maintaining SuiteScript, and working with Celigo integration flows.

• You can ensure that Shopify and NetSuite exchange accurate information reliably.

• You can understand broader business processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend solutions that improve automation and operational performance.

• You are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of taking ownership of projects with minimal supervision.

Software & Tools

• Oracle NetSuite

• Celigo integrator.io

• Shopify

• SuiteScript 2.x

• NetSuite APIs

• REST APIs

• JSON

• XML

• Git (preferred)

Schedule

Full-Time

Monday–Friday

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time (CT)

Must be available to work consistently during the scheduled Central Time business hours.

Salary And Benefits

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

About The Team

The Platform Engineering team builds the tools and services that accelerate the software development life cycle of the software engineers at Mural.

We work on tools that provide a reliable development environment, on tools to easily test locally and remotely, on integrations with Github and Github Actions, and a few other pieces throughout the many stages in our build, test and release pipelines. Our work is essential to Mural's success, as we maintain the backbone of the platform, enabling seamless user experiences and fostering innovation across the company.

YOUR MISSION

As a Platform Engineer, you will play a crucial role in driving the performance and efficiency of the software development life cycle across the organization. You will be responsible for understanding, maintaining, and evolving existing systems while designing and implementing advanced automation tools and optimized workflows. By enabling developers to build, test, and deploy software rapidly and reliably, your work will directly enhance development cycle performance, boosting productivity and quality across the entire development team. This makes your role essential to Mural's ongoing success.

What You'll Do

• Design, implement and maintain the build infrastructure for a large Typescript and NodeJS codebase

• Collaborate with software developers and platform engineers to define and refine the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery processes and its best practices.

• Identify and address bottlenecks, performance issues, and opportunities for automation within the development pipeline in order to speed up the whole development experience.

• Develop and maintain scalable platform features, ensuring the reliability, availability, and scalability of our software delivery processes.

• Care deeply about the problems and needs of our customers, which are all the engineers in the organization, and on training and supporting them to better use the tools we build to improve their quality of life

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of experience working on the backend, integrations or CI/CD pipelines of a high-performing engineering team

• Experience building reusable components and libraries, with an understanding of scalable architecture.

• Excellent communication skills, with a focus on documenting solutions and providing clear technical guidance

• A strong sense of ownership over critical problem areas

• A thorough understanding of Linux, Docker and CI tools like Github Actions or similar

• Experience in designing, implementing and documenting API services

• Understanding of the NodeJS and Typescript ecosystems, and its automated build and testing tools is a plus

• Kubernetes, Python, Golang, Terraform and Azure Cloud knowledge is another plus

• Experience managing stateful Kubernetes workloads, including operating, scaling, troubleshooting, and improving the reliability of production-grade services

• Comfortable designing and programming custom operators to automate platform workflows, extend infrastructure capabilities, and improve reliability across development and delivery systems

• Experience designing and building AI-powered platform capabilities that improve developer productivity, automate engineering workflows, or enhance CI/CD, observability, testing, and release processes

• A proactive, ownership-driven approach to troubleshooting and supporting critical technical areas

• Experience in making data-driven decisions

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. .

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

postings.descriptionText:
Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

This is an independent contractor engagement in Argentina. Deel will serve as Contractor of Record and will contract with and pay the independent contractor. The independent contractor will provide services to Greenhouse on a non-exclusive basis, may provide services to other clients, and will be responsible for determining the manner and means of performing the services, subject to the applicable statement of work and agreed deliverables. This engagement is not an employment relationship with Greenhouse. No employment relationship, social benefits, or labor entitlements under Argentine Law 20,744 are created by this engagement.

Through this arrangement, Deel is hiring an independent contractor to provide services to the Governance team. This team owns how permissions and authorization work across the Greenhouse product.

This role will support the development and maintenance of the Company’s web-based applications as part of an approximately 12-month engagement.

This is a collaborative, execution-focused, non-exclusive engagement. You will spend the majority of your time in the code building features, fixing bugs, and ensuring our products remain stable and performant for users.

Contract & location details

• Contract duration: Approximately 12 months

• Engagement type: A non-exclusive contract role engaged through a Contractor of Record (COR) via Deel in Argentina

• Location: Argentina (remote)

• Working model: Collaboration with a distributed, US & Canada-based team with reasonable availability for coordination with Greenhouse stakeholders

Who Will Love This Job

• A Pragmatic Builder - You enjoy the craft of coding and take pride in writing clean, readable code. You aim for the simplest solution that satisfies the business requirement.

• A Full-Stack Contributor - You are comfortable moving across the stack, whether updating a PostgreSQL schema or building a new UI component in React.

• A Quality Advocate - You believe a feature isn’t “done” until it’s tested. You regularly write unit and integration tests to catch regressions early.

What You’ll Do

• Build, modify, and maintain features using Ruby on Rails and React, following established engineering patterns

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that aligns with existing architectural standards

• Maintain RESTful APIs and update PostgreSQL data models to support evolving feature needs

• Write comprehensive unit and integration tests (e.g., RSpec, Jest) to ensure feature stability

• Collaborate closely with other engineers through code reviews, standups, and technical discussions

• Participate in a shared support rotation during working hours, diagnosing and resolving issues to maintain application health

You should have

• 2+ years experience in contributing production code (required)

• Experience contributing to projects, helping drive them to completion (required)

• Experience with Ruby, C#, Java, or Python (Ruby preferred)

• Direct experience with AI and agentic software development (Claude code, Codex, etc)

• Proficient understanding of Javascript or Typescript fundamentals, including React

• Experience working in the full stack

• Proficient understanding of architectural patterns

• REST/web development experience

• Experience partnering closely with Product and Design partners

• Experience with Rails, preferred

• Experience with authorization and permissions, a plus

• Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

Who We Are

At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row.

–

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to accommodations@greenhouse.io.

postings.title: AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Ryz Labs is looking for an AI Engineer to work with one of our clients, a company in the real estate investment industry that develops AI-powered solutions to automate and optimize investment processes, including deal sourcing, financial analysis, due diligence, and portfolio monitoring. They work with real estate investment funds, institutional investors, and family offices to help them make better, data-driven decisions.

This is an AI engineering role with a forward-deployed edge. You'll split your time between:

• Building our core AI systems: the agents, pipelines and evaluation infrastructure behind everything Smart Bricks does

• Deploying them with clients: working embedded with real estate private equity funds, institutional investors and family offices to solve their hardest problems with AI

You write production code, ship it and own it. On client work you partner with our GTM team: they open the door and frame the problem, you scope, build and deploy the solution. What you learn in the field goes straight back into the platform, so every deployment makes the product better.

What you'll do:

• Build agentic systems: multi-step agents, tool use and workflows that handle real investment work: sourcing, underwriting, due diligence, IC memos and portfolio monitoring

• Own the AI stack: RAG and document pipelines, model routing across frontier and open models, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs into Excel and IC formats

• Make it trustworthy: build evals and observability for accuracy, cost, latency and reliability. In finance, every number has to trace back to source

• Build reusable infrastructure: connectors, data pipelines and components that make each new deployment faster than the last
