postings.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build the AI components of a governed data foundation used by AI agents, applications and business teams.You will work inside AI Labs, where most engagements start as an ambiguous business problem (complex legal documents, scanned and digital; extraction, classification, assistants, agents) and end as a working system with measurable quality. Hence, this is a hybrid of engineer and scientist. You write production-grade Python and ship it through CI/CD, and you treat model quality as an engineering discipline: you do not say "it works" — you show the eval. Curated datasets, graded criteria, baselines, regression thresholds wired into CI. You know that an LLM feature without evals is an untested feature, and you build the measurement before you build the demo.

You are vendor-agnostic and cost-aware: you choose models based on business constraints, and design solutions between the whole catalog of in-context learning options and new available tools. You use AI tools daily to accelerate your own work, with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to. Because we are a consultancy company, you are also client-facing: you demo live, explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, size effort honestly in pre-sales, and turn what you learn into assets the rest of the company can reuse. You might be needed to record videos, design prototypes, and help all through the creative process of a solution.

You'll work in a small team (solution architect, data engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client's engineers, who will run what you build.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with production ownership — not notebooks handed off to someone else.

• 2+ years building LLM systems used by real users or delivered to clients.

• Advanced Python: clean, tested, reviewable code; async, typing, packaging, dependency management.

• Structured extraction from unstructured documents.

• Hands-on RAG experience: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, reranking and the ability to explain how retrieval quality was measured.

• Hands-on Agents with tool use and MCP experience.

• Awareness of LLM security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling in a client-data context.

• Experience designing and running evals: building eval datasets, defining graded criteria, establishing baselines and regression thresholds, and using them as a release gate. Candidates who have only eyeballed outputs will not pass this bar.

• CI/CD and engineering hygiene: Git, automated tests, reproducible builds, containerization; ability to ship without a platform team holding your hand.

• Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, or equivalent) and the judgment to work without one.

• Cloud deployment of AI/ML workloads, preferably AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS, S3) or demonstrable equivalent on GCP/Azure.

• Practical understanding of cost and latency engineering for LLM systems: token accounting, caching, model routing, streaming.

• AI-first working style: daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) with the judgment to know when to trust the output.

• Senior judgment: operate autonomously, challenge an ill-posed problem, prioritize by risk and business impact, own outcomes.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable in a fully remote, distributed, client-facing team.

Preferrable

Experience with AI in Databricks environments.

Permission-aware or multi-tenant retrieval for customer-facing AI.

Experience with an eval or LLM-observability framework (LangSmith, Langfuse, Weave, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, DeepEval, Ragas, or similar).

Knowledge pipelines that stay in sync with changing sources, with human review.

Databricks and MLflow (tracing, evaluation).

Contracts, finance or regulatory documents.

Experience building LLM-as-judge graders and validating judge/human agreement.

MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC, model/prompt versioning and registries.

Serving open-weight models (vLLM, Ollama, Bedrock/SageMaker endpoints) and reasoning about GPU cost.

Legal, Financial, Or Other Regulated-domain Document Experience.

Consulting or client-facing delivery experience; live demos, discovery, pre-sales.

Public evidence of craft: open-source contributions, papers, talks, or a track record of writing about applied AI.

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

postings.title: Senior Data Engineer (LATAM based)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks , used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.

Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.

You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models

• 3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity Catalog

• Expert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plus

• Strong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the start

• Data quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for data

• Reconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master data

• Incremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targets

• Practical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start

• Has built APIs or services that serve data

• Senior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagement

• Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the output

• C1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client team

Preferrable

• Exposing data to applications through APIs or MCPs

• Multi-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testing

• Finance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)

• Consolidating data across acquired companies or business units

• Ingesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured data

• Turning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholders

• FinOps / cost attribution on data platforms

What This Person Will Own And Do Day-to-day

Ingestion and source strategy

Build and maintain ingestion and ETL pipelines from business systems (ERP, CRM, product databases), operational tools, and document repositories. Build data lakes in Databricks that software, people, and AI agents can all query. Decide per source whether to ingest, index and link, or query live, based on volatility, volume, and which system is the record. Work with raw data in its source-system shape without waiting on upstream cleanup.

Entities and facts

Implement the entity model defined with the solution architect and resolve identity across systems, reusing existing matching work and sending ambiguous matches to the owner who decides. Model facts with source, validity period, validation status, and documented exceptions. Turn business definitions validated by their owners into certified tables, recording who signed off. Implement authority rules per data item and keep unresolved conflicts visible. Deliver finance numbers that are deterministic, reproducible, and traceable to source records.

Access and isolation

Implement access policies in Databricks and carry them into derived data. Enforce isolation at the database, tool, and application layers for consumers who aren’t Databricks users, such as external customers. Build isolation tests at the data and API layer, including similarly named customers, and run them as a release gate.

Structured sources and freshness

Integrate the structured sources each increment needs (CRM, ERP, payment processors, product data, spreadsheets), starting from what’s already in Databricks . Meet freshness targets and expose freshness with each fact. Track dependencies so facts and certified tables are updated or flagged when a source or definition changes. Own data quality checks, observability, and cost visibility.

Data interfaces

Build the APIs, webhooks, and MCP tools that query and filter facts deterministically, carrying the caller’s identity and permissions on every request. Log every access with the sources it used.

Collaboration and handover

Give the AI engineer the facts, entity IDs, and access rules that knowledge and agents depend on. Work with the full-stack engineer on the owners’ review interface and with the data quality lead on acceptance criteria. Be the technical voice on data feasibility in discovery and design sessions, and document and hand over your work to the client’s team.

AI-augmented engineering

Use AI tools daily for SQL and Python , schema mapping, definition drafting, test generation, and documentation. Review every AI-assisted output with care: a force multiplier, not a shortcut.

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

This is a hybrid builder role, not a narrow back-end development position. Some work will call for Flow, configuration, data analysis, and production support. Other work will require reading or changing Apex, troubleshooting integrations, improving legacy automation, or helping rebuild a business process that no longer scales. You should be comfortable moving between those modes and explaining your decisions to both technical and business partners.

The team is bringing more technical ownership in-house. You will have room to shape how we build, test, document, and operate Salesforce while working on practical AI-assisted capabilities, CPQ modernization, and the cleanup of inherited solutions.

The right person for this role: owns outcomes, asks good questions, documents what they learn, and can make progress in an inherited enterprise environment without waiting for perfect requirements.

Responsibilities

• Own Salesforce work from discovery through release: clarify the problem, propose a design, estimate the work, build or configure the solution, test it, document it, and support it after launch.

• Develop and maintain solutions using Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, platform configuration, and Salesforce APIs. Choose code or declarative automation based on maintainability, scale, and platform limits.

• Modernize inherited automation and custom code. Simplify overlapping Flows, legacy Apex, fragile integrations, and undocumented dependencies without breaking the business processes that rely on them.

• Support quote-to-cash capabilities, including Salesforce CPQ, product and pricing logic, approvals, amendments, renewals, and integrations with downstream finance or billing systems.

• Build and support integrations between Salesforce and internal or third-party applications using REST or SOAP APIs, asynchronous processing, and secure data-handling patterns.

• Help introduce governed AI-assisted workflows into the sales platform. Focus on clear business value, data protection, traceable outcomes, and human control rather than novelty.

• Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and leave behind useful runbooks and monitoring so the same problem is easier to diagnose the next time.

• Work directly with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, business analysts, and Salesforce administrators to turn business needs into maintainable technical solutions.

• Use source control, peer review, automated tests, and structured release practices. Contribute to technical standards and raise risks early when a proposed approach will create avoidable debt.

Candidates based in the Buenos Aires, ARG, or Mexico City, MX vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience supporting Salesforce in an enterprise environment as an administrator, technical analyst, developer, or a combination of those roles.

• Salesforce Certified Administrator.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with designing, developing, and integrating within Sales Cloud and core platform components.

• Demonstrated experience building custom REST/SOAP integrations and managing data models at scale.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience using source-driven development practices and DevOps tools (Git, GitHub, Copado, or Visual Studio Code).

• Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal). This role works directly with business partners and must turn unclear requests into specific decisions and documented requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on Apex or Lightning Web Components development and a Platform Developer I or II certification.

• Service Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or broader quote-to-cash experience in a subscription software business.

• Product catalog, pricing, renewals, contracting, billing, or revenue-recognition processes.

• Git-based development, CI/CD, Copado, Salesforce CLI, scratch or development environments, and automated release validation.

• Enterprise GTM applications such as LeanData, Outreach, Zendesk, e-signature tools, or billing and ERP integrations.

• Performance tuning, governor-limit analysis, bulk data processing, and asynchronous Apex.

• Building or governing AI features that use CRM data, including prompt controls, data minimization, auditability, and human review.

• Ability to read and debug Apex and understand how triggers, asynchronous jobs, integrations, and Lightning components fit together. You do not need to be a career Apex specialist, but you must be able to reason about code safely.

postings.title: Software Architect - Containers / Virtualisation
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a software architect for Canonical LXD and MicroCloud.

Our goal is to make clusters of compute, with system containers or virtual machines, "just work". It should be trivial to stand up a small cloud using one, two or twenty servers. This is a challenging exercise in distributed systems, virtualisation, container technology, networking and storage. As with the Ubuntu desktop, our goal is to make it easy and to make it reliable for people to focus on the things that really matter to them rather than the OS and infrastructure.

LXD is a modern Golang system container and virtual machine orchestrator widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI. As a software architect, you will drive the architecture, design and evolution of LXD, and also Canonical MicroCloud which combines LXD with Ceph and OVN to make a lean, easy to use and resilient cluster-scale cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for an outstanding software architect and engineer with experience in Golang and C, with the leadership qualities needed to rally a team to ship outstanding products. Knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure offerings, their APIs and their underlying technologies is a must.

postings.title: Feature Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

We are looking for a Feature Architect to support application architecture for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform in the tax domain with multiple concurrent delivery streams. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role intended for someone who has progressed beyond individual feature implementation and can confidently lead the technical design and delivery of features. The ideal candidate has experience operating as a Senior Software Engineer or Technical Lead, with responsibility for solution design, technical decisions, code quality, and supporting other engineers through implementation.

The role requires strong technical judgment and application architecture knowledge, but its scope is primarily at the feature and solution level. Success in the role comes from being close to the code and delivery teams, making practical design decisions, and ensuring solutions are implemented well. Candidates should be comfortable owning technical decisions independently while remaining actively involved in design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and implementation

Workplace: This is a remote opportunity open to candidates residing in Argentina or Columbia only

What You Will Do

• Own architecture for assigned feature streams from specification through delivery

• Define application and integration design patterns across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and external systems

• Drive reuse-versus-build decisions for existing platform assets, native-app patterns, and shared components

• Review and refine specifications and technical plans for clarity, feasibility, and architectural alignment

• Establish practical architecture guardrails that enable delivery speed without over-engineering

• Own architecture direction for AI-enabled application capabilities, including tool orchestration boundaries and tenant-safe context handling

• Define how agent tools are exposed, gated, and governed across user context, role, and tenant boundaries

• Help shape the agentic operator implementation model, interfaces, and control points at feature level

• Partner with team leads to break architecture into incremental, deliverable slices

• Identify cross-workstream dependencies and integration risks early, and support mitigation planning

• Ensure non-functional requirements are addressed, including security, reliability, observability, and operational supportability

• Validate implementation alignment with agreed architecture patterns and integration contracts

• Contribute to architecture checkpoints, pull request quality gates, and Definition of Done standards

How We Work

• Architecture participates from specification and planning stages, not only at final review.

• We work in pods with feature ownership and close collaboration across architecture, engineering, QA, and product.

• We use structured technical reviews, protected branches, and green CI as merge requirements.

• We combine AI-assisted delivery with mandatory human technical review for architecture-impacting changes.

• We optimize for delivery speed, risk coverage, maintainability, and long-term platform consistency.

Must Have Skills

• Own Architecture or senior technical design roles for enterprise applications

• Strong understanding of application architecture, system integration, and API-driven design

• Experience working in multi-team delivery models with cross-functional collaboration

• Practical experience writing and reviewing technical specifications, architecture notes, and design documentation

• Hands-on understanding of multi-tenant concepts, including isolation of data, configuration, and contextual boundaries

• Working knowledge of secure design fundamentals, including role-based access control, secret handling, and least-privilege access patterns

• Practical experience with AI agent implementations in production-grade applications

• Experience with MCP-style tool ecosystems, including tool exposure, context-aware gating, and controlled tool orchestration

• Practical understanding of RAG-backed application features, including retrieval-context design and grounding patterns

• Experience integrating with Azure services, including SQL, Key Vault, and AI services

• Experience working within CI/CD workflows, pull request review practices, and release governance

• Strong communication skills with the ability to align engineering, product, and stakeholder groups

• Pragmatic technical judgment with focus on delivery, maintainability, and risk control

Preferred Skills

• Experience defining and monitoring AI quality metrics in production, such as precision, recall, groundedness, hallucination rate, and answer relevance

• Experience designing evaluation strategies for AI-enabled features, including golden datasets, semantic assertions, and LLM-as-judge approaches

• Deeper understanding of RAG quality levers, including chunking strategies, embedding and vectorization choices, retrieval tuning, and context-window optimization

• Experience implementing observability for AI behavior, including traceability of prompts, tool calls, retrieval steps, and failure patterns

• Experience in tax, financial services, or other regulated domains with strong traceability and audit requirements

• Experience with asynchronous integration patterns such as queues, jobs, retries, and workflow orchestration

• Experience collaborating with QA/SDET teams on testability architecture for complex and non-deterministic behavior

• Experience supporting pod-based delivery models with multiple technical leads

Professional Skills

• Solid written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

• Strong team and individual player

• Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature

• High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results

• Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention

• Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer (LLMs & Agentic AI)
postings.descriptionText:
About You
You are a Senior AI Engineer passionate about building production-grade LLM applications and agentic AI systems. You thrive in collaborative environments where you design, implement, and optimize AI capabilities that power conversational experiences and intelligent workflows.

You enjoy solving complex AI challenges, integrating cutting-edge LLM technologies, and continuously improving production systems through experimentation, evaluation, and engineering best practices. You're comfortable making production design decisions autonomously within a small, lightly-managed team, and defending those decisions directly to engineering leadership.

Note: This role operates under a contractor model and requires availability to work in the U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.

• Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices for production backend services (APIs, async I/O, typing/schema validation, error handling, and testing).

• Strong SQL skills working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).

• Hands-on experience building production-grade LLM and agentic AI applications.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying MCP servers in production (server-side, consumed by other users or systems), including tool and resource definitions, context management, and multi-step orchestration.

• Understanding of MCP transports (stdio vs. Streamable HTTP) and authentication/authorization patterns for remote servers (OAuth/OIDC, scoped and resource-level access).

• Experience integrating hosted LLM APIs such as Anthropic and OpenAI into production environments.

• Experience with prompt engineering, prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and cost/latency optimization, with direct ownership of these concerns in production.

• Experience designing intent classification and routing solutions for natural language applications, resolving user intent into the correct API and data-source calls.

• Experience building conversational AI solutions or multi-API orchestration workflows.

• Experience developing LLM evaluation methodologies and demonstrated ability to reverse-engineer and work within a partially documented, brownfield Python codebase.

• Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to explain your own technical work in first-person depth under sustained technical questioning, clearly distinguishing what you personally built, what you contributed to, and what you only observed.

• Strong spoken English (B2+) to discuss technical scenarios live with US-based stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

• Experience deploying, fine-tuning, and evaluating open-source models using Hugging Face.

• Experience with GPU acceleration and inference optimization.

• Experience implementing MLOps practices, including CI/CD, observability, and reproducible pipelines.

• Experience with vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

• Applied NLP experience.

• Experience building client-facing AI products.

• AWS experience (Batch, ECS, Lambda, SQS).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain MCP servers, tool and resource definitions, and context management capabilities.

• Design and implement intent evaluation, classification, and routing workflows, including orchestrating resolution into the correct API and data-source calls, with aggregation across multiple sources.

• Integrate Anthropic and OpenAI models into production environments.

• Manage prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and LLM performance optimization.

• Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to validate model quality and production performance.

• Write SQL against model inputs and outputs to support evaluation and monitoring.

• Support the backend behavior of the chat / MCP interface.

• Work within an existing, partially documented codebase, tracing behavior and making safe, incremental changes.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers and AI specialists to deliver production-ready AI solutions.

• Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to AI platform design.

• Continuously improve AI systems through experimentation, optimization, and engineering best practices.

Qualifications

• Experience building production AI applications with Python and LLM technologies.

• Must have personally authored/built an MCP server deployed in production and used by other users or systems (not simply integrated, consumed, or built as a local proof of concept ).

• Hands-on brownfield experience, adding significant features to a production Python codebase.

• Experience designing and deploying conversational AI or agentic AI solutions.

• Strong experience with prompt engineering, LLM integrations, and evaluation methodologies.

• Strong spoken English (B2+)

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

postings.title: AI Systems Lead
postings.descriptionText:
AI Systems Lead
Sustain Media | Remote | Full-time contractor | $5,000 to $7,000/month

Sustain Media helps home service businesses get more customers through local SEO and Google Ads. We're hiring an AI Systems Lead to build and run the internal systems our team uses to deliver that work.

A big part of this job is turning ideas into builds. Someone on the team describes a problem they deal with every week. You ask the right questions, whiteboard a solution with them, and turn it into a system the team can depend on.

We run a lot of the business off Viktor, an AI agent that lives in our Slack. It pulls data from our ad accounts and tools, runs SEO audits, tracks rankings and builds reports. A lot of work has already gone into Viktor and it runs well. Your job is to keep making it better and to build what comes next, including our own CRM and suite of SEO/Ads automations. You'll also own the systems around Viktor, including our Airtable bases. We need someone who can take a problem from the first conversation through launch and keep the system working after people start using it.

The kind of builder we want

You're practical. You'd rather ship a working version this week than spend a month on the perfect setup. But you don't leave a mess behind. You document what you built well enough that the team can use it and another engineer could pick it up.
You also think about where a system will be in a year. When you pick a tool or decide how data is structured, you can explain why, and you've checked that it won't box us in once we have twice the clients and twice the team. Choosing Airtable as our system of record is the kind of call we mean.

What you'll own

• Turn ideas into builds. Sit with our SEO, Google Ads and client success teams and learn how the work runs today. Take their user stories, whiteboard a solution with them, and turn a rough idea into a clear plan before you build. You're comfortable doing this live in front of a group. Tell us when something isn't worth automating.

• Connect our tools. Most of the work runs through Airtable, Slack, Google's ad and search tools, and LLM APIs. Write custom code when an existing connector falls short. Use n8n or Zapier when that's the faster call.

• Make Viktor perform way better. You don't need to build an agent from scratch (for now). Most of the work is tuning one that's already built: improve its instructions and workflows, connect it to the right data, and pick the right model for each job. When we do build new agents, you harden them with test cases, scheduled jobs and reviews so they stay on the path they're meant to follow.

• Make architecture decisions you can defend. Write down why you chose a tool, a data structure or a place for data to live, so the next person understands it and we don't get stuck later.

• Own reliability. Test before launch, handle missing data and duplicate events, and validate data on the back end, not just the front end. Set up canaries, logs and alerts so nothing fails without someone knowing, and fix failures before they become recurring problems.

• Make the systems usable. Write simple documentation and handoff guides so a non-technical manager can understand what you built and train the team on it. Adjust the workflow when it does not fit the team's day-to-day work.

• Keep projects moving. Set clear milestones, flag blockers early, and explain what shipped, what changed and what you're working on next.

Examples of the work

Some of this is already running and some is on the list: an onboarding portal for new clients, a Google Maps rank tracker, AI-drafted replies to Google reviews, a flow that hands tasks to the right person on the team, billing clients based on their Google Ads spend, and research that runs automatically before sales calls. You'll inherit some of it, improve it and build the rest. You'll help choose and scope new work based on its value to the business.

What we're looking for

• You've built automations that real teams rely on. You can show what you personally built, explain the decisions you made, and describe what happened after launch.

• You've worked on both the front end and the back end. You understand back-end validation and authentication, and you know how to make an AI-built app safe before it goes live. Ideally you were writing code before AI tools made it easy.

• You can read and understand a new API quickly and work within MCP connections. You can write and debug JavaScript or Python, including checking and repairing AI-generated code.

• You've built and managed databases that a team uses every day, in Airtable or other tools. You understand why different systems structure data the way they do, and you spot data problems that will break a workflow later.

• You've used LLMs inside working systems. You understand structured outputs, tool calling, model selection, testing, cost and the limits of model reliability.

• You can explain your choices. When you design a system, you can say why you built it that way, what you traded off and what would make you change it.

• You're easy to work with. You ask good questions before building, troubleshoot on your own, and can explain how a system works to people who aren't engineers. You're comfortable telling us when an idea won't work.

• Experience with marketing agencies, SEO, Google Ads, reporting or CRMs is incredibly useful. So is experience running or tuning your own models. We care most about the quality of your work and your ability to take ownership. A specific degree or AI framework is not required.

You're probably not a fit if

• You care more about code quality scores and server setups than whether the team's problem got solved.

• Your experience is mostly prompts and LLMs, and you haven't connected real apps through APIs.

• You'd rather get a finished spec than talk to the people doing the work.

What success looks like
When the team brings you an idea, it turns into a working system quickly. The team spends less time moving data, checking routine work and chasing information. They trust the systems because the outputs are accurate, failures are visible, and someone owns the fix. Your documentation makes it possible for another person to understand and maintain what you built.

Why this role
You'll work directly with the team and the people using your systems, and you'll see the effect of your work. You'll have room to recommend better ways of doing things and influence which problems we tackle next. This role grows with the company, with room for bonuses and a clear path to higher pay. You won't manage people or run operations. The job is building, with a lot of time spent talking to the people you build for.

postings.title: Freelance Forward Deployed AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Company Intro

At Toloka AI we create data that powers leading GenAI models and innovations. We work with frontier labs, big tech, renowned AI startups, enterprises and non-profit research organizations worldwide. We use a combination of Experts + Crowd + Tech Platform to teach AI models to reason and evaluate their efficacy and safety. We have experts in more than 50 different domains - from doctors and lawyers to physicists and engineers - and boast one of the most diverse global crowds, representing over 100 countries and speaking 40+ languages . We are a well-funded startup with an enviable portfolio of clients including Anthropic , Amazon , Microsoft , Poolside , Recraft , and Shopify .

Recently, we secured strategic investment led by Bezos Expeditions and Nebius Group with participation from Mikhail Parakhin , CTO of Shopify and board advisor to leading GenAI companies, who now serves as our Chairman of the Board. Our remote-first team is globally distributed around the world: USA , UK , the Netherlands , Serbia , and more.

About the position

The Freelance Forward Deployed AI Engineer is Toloka's most senior client-facing technical role. You will partner directly with CTOs, VPs of Engineering and ML, research leaders, and applied AI teams, helping them solve complex AI data challenges and translate ambitious model goals into practical, scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on role . You will design and build the data-generation , labeling , and evaluation pipelines t hat power the next generation of AI models . Rather than training the models yourself, you'll help clients identify the right data strategy and own the solution from problem discovery through implementation and delivery.

Beyond delivering client solutions, you'll help shape how Toloka approaches AI solution engineering - establishing best practices, raising the technical bar across engagements, and mentoring Solution Engineers and Technical Consultants .

Why this role is different

Every engagement is different. One week you might be designing evaluation pipelines for frontier foundation models, the next helping an enterprise build domain-specific reasoning datasets or synthetic data workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of consulting, engineering, and AI. You'll work directly with some of the world's leading AI companies, helping shape how next-generation models are trained and evaluated.

What you'll do

Executive partnership

• Act as the primary technical counterpart to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and research/engineering leadership.

• Lead executive conversations using a structured, answer-first (BLUF) approach.

• Manage escalations and expectations with composure and integrity.

• Build long-term trusted relationships by recommending evidence-based solutions.

Data strategy & needs diagnosis

• Ask excellent questions to uncover the client's real need - the "question behind the question." Understand their model, which metrics they want to move, and how they intend to train or evaluate it.

• Draw on a solid understanding of how LLMs are trained and fine-tuned to have credible conversations with their technical leaders, understand their data strategy, and proactively propose the data that will solve their problem - with options and rationale ("based on your goal, you likely need this, or this").

Solution engineering & delivery (hands-on)

• Design and build the data solutions yourself: configure data-labeling components and quality controls, develop user interfaces and AI-driven solutions (e.g. agentic systems, RAG, synthetic data generation), and integrate them into automated, multi-stage pipelines that produce data for AI training and evaluation.

• Architect and reason about complex, multi-stage solutions end to end; run experiments to prove the pipeline delivers data of the required quality and speed; iterate from MVP toward production.

• Provide technical leadership across multiple client engagements, establish reusable engineering standards and best practices, and mentor Solution Engineers and Technical Consultants to raise the overall technical bar of the organization.

Commercial ownership

• Own delivery end to end - timelines , quality , and scalability - and the commercial outcome : Gross Margin and Contribution Margin, with the levers, trade-offs, and next checkpoints named, not just described.

• Identify and drive expansion opportunities.

About You

• Executive communication. You can confidently lead conversations with CTOs, VPs, and senior technical stakeholders - clear, concise, structured, persuasive, and calm under pressure.

• Strong understanding of modern LLM development. You understand how modern LLMs are trained, fine-tuned, and evaluated (including SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, DPO/PPO, reward modeling, and LoRA/PEFT). You're comfortable discussing these topics with senior technical stakeholders and translating their goals into effective AI data solutions.

• Hands-on solution engineering. You've designed complex AI solutions, built multi-stage pipelines, and developed AI-driven systems (e.g. agentic workflows, RAG, or synthetic data generation). You're comfortable working in Python (NumPy, Pandas), integrating APIs, and independently prototyping LLM-powered solutions.

• Solid software engineering foundations. You understand version control, testing, MVP thinking, and iterative development. Experience building production software is a strong plus.

• Exceptional discovery and problem framing. You enjoy working through ambiguity, asking the right questions, and translating business or research goals into clear AI data and evaluation strategies.

• Seniority and track record. 8+ years delivering complex AI, ML, or data projects end to end, with experience influencing technical direction beyond individual projects. Experience establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, or leading cross-functional technical initiatives is highly valued. Experience in top-tier strategy consulting (McKinsey, Bain, BCG) and/or as an applied ML / LLM engineer is a strong advantage.

• Ownership mindset. You take responsibility for outcomes, make thoughtful trade-offs between time, cost, and quality, and are comfortable owning both technical and commercial success.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs and/or building agentic systems (helps you reason about client needs - though the role itself is about building data solutions, not training models).

• Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in AI, CS, or a related field.

• Experience in crowdsourcing and/or data-centric AI, and with fast-paced, multi-project delivery for frontier AI clients.

What we can offer

• Full-time independent contractor engagement (B2B) through the Ontop contractor platform , working via your own company or business entity;

• Flexible, fully remote schedule ( 40 hours per week );

• Work at the leading edge of AI development, alongside a dedicated and dynamic team of experts;

• Projects with customers that are AI industry leaders and well-known household names;

• Friendly community.

To learn how we collect, use, disclose, and store personal data, check out our Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Implementation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Kleva

Kleva construye agentes de IA que deciden cuándo y cómo contactar a cada persona, y después llaman, conversan y resuelven. Hoy recuperan deuda para bancos, fintechs y empresas de servicios en 8 países de América Latina, con miles de llamadas concurrentes. No somos una agencia de cobranzas ni un dialer con IA.

Nuestra visión es ser la voz de las empresas en Latam, y cobranzas es el primer mercado. Los modelos de IA están disponibles para todos; lo difícil es lo que está alrededor: que la persona atienda, que la llamada suene real, que el agente sepa qué decir y que cada conversación cueste poco.

Conocé Kleva en video

El rol

En Kleva, el onboarding no es una fase previa al producto: es parte del producto. Cada cliente tiene su cartera, sus tramos de mora, sus reglas y sus sistemas, y alguien tiene que traducir todo eso en un agente que funcione bien en producción.

Buscamos a esa persona. Vas a ser responsable de la implementación técnica de nuevos clientes: configurar sus agentes en nuestra plataforma, integrar sus datos y acompañar las primeras campañas hasta que den resultados. El objetivo es que cada cliente salga en vivo en menos de 15 días.

No es un rol de forward deployed. La mayor parte del trabajo es remoto y con el equipo; vas a sumarte a llamadas con clientes y, de vez en cuando, a alguna visita presencial.

Problemas en los que vas a trabajar

• Cómo convertimos la operación de cobranzas de un banco, con sus tramos, excepciones y reglas, en un agente que la ejecute bien desde el primer día?

• Por qué una campaña contacta menos de lo esperado, y qué cambiamos: el horario, el guion, la base o la telefonía?

• Qué parte de lo que hicimos a mano para este cliente debería ser producto para el próximo?

Qué vas a hacer

• Llevar la parte técnica del onboarding de nuevos clientes, desde el kickoff hasta el go-live

• Configurar agentes en nuestra plataforma: prompts, flujos, herramientas, voces y reglas de negocio de cada cliente

• Probar los últimos modelos y herramientas de IA apenas salen, y decidir con datos cuáles llegan a producción

• Integrar las carteras y los sistemas de cada cliente por API, webhooks, SFTP o archivos, validando y limpiando los datos

• Automatizar todo lo que se repite: construir herramientas internas y agentes que llevan el onboarding de cada cliente nuevo de días a horas

• Probar cada agente con QA antes de salir en vivo y monitorear las primeras campañas con métricas de contacto, conversación y resultado

• Sumarte a llamadas técnicas con clientes y, cuando haga falta, a visitas presenciales

Qué no buscamos

• Quien quiere un rol 100% de código, sin contacto con clientes

• Quien prefiere un proceso cerrado a resolver un problema distinto cada semana

• Quien da por terminada una implementación cuando el agente sale en vivo. Para nosotros termina cuando el cliente ve resultados

Contexto del rol

• Reporta a: Delivery Lead

• Trabaja con: Ingeniería, Producto, QA y Customer Success

Requirements

• 2+ años en roles de desarrollo de software

• Manejo de REST APIs, JSON y webhooks. Sabés leer documentación y probar una integración con Postman o similar

• SQL para consultar y validar datos, y scripting en Python o JavaScript para automatizar tareas

• Experiencia con CI/CD, idealmente GitHub Actions

• Experiencia práctica con LLMs: escribir prompts, probar conversaciones e iterar con criterio

• Foco en la experiencia del usuario: pensás en cómo vive el cliente cada configuración y en cómo suena el agente para quien atiende

• Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y de negocio. Sabés explicar qué se puede hacer, qué no y para cuándo

Deseable

• Experiencia en implementación u onboarding de plataformas SaaS B2B enterprise

• Experiencia con contact centers o plataformas de voz

• Background en fintech, bancos o cobranzas

• Experiencia en startups early stage

Benefits

• Salario competitivo en dólares

• Tres semanas pagas de vacaciones por año

• Esquema híbrido en Buenos Aires. Al menos 1 día por semana vamos a la oficina.

• Un equipo chico donde lo que construís llega a producción en días

• En cada interacción, valoramos los resultados por encima de los egos o jerarquías

Cómo es trabajar en Kleva

• Equipos chicos, talentosos y emprendedores. Vas a trabajar en equipos autónomos y orientados a resultados

• Una oportunidad excepcional para crecer. Hacemos todo lo posible por contratar personas con un potencial fuera de lo común, y después nuestra prioridad es ponerlas en el lugar ideal para que se destaquen.

• Amplificá tu impacto con IA. Integrá las herramientas de IA más potentes en todo tu flujo de trabajo para ir más rápido sin bajar la vara en calidad y confiabilidad

• Simplificá sin descanso. Cuestioná cada capa de complejidad en procesos, configuraciones e integraciones para que cada implementación sea más simple que la anterior

postings.title: Oracle Database Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Why Pythian

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why You

As a Database Consultant you will work as part of Pythian's Oracle team and supply complete support for all aspects of database and application infrastructure to a variety of our customers. Our collaborative environment means everyone works together to solve complex puzzles and develop innovative solutions for our customers.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian, reach out to us and find out!

Intrigued to see what a life is like at Pythian? Check out #pythianlife on LinkedIn and follow @loveyourdata on Instagram!

Not the right job for you? Check out what other great jobs Pythian has open around the world! Pythian Careers

What You Will Be Doing

Database Management & Technical Expertise:

• Solution Design & Implementation: Coordinate, analyze, design, implement, and administer IT solutions, including database server configuration and ongoing maintenance.

• Infrastructure Analysis & Improvement: Analyze client infrastructure and processes, recommending best practices to enhance current operational procedures. This includes ensuring maximum uptime and recoverability for all databases.

• Backup & Disaster Recovery: Administer backup procedures and disaster recovery plans. This involves proactive monitoring to prevent issues, responding to alerts, and troubleshooting operational problems.

• Data Integrity & Recovery: Oversee backup, clustering, mirroring, replication, failover, and the restoration of corrupted databases.

• Action Plan Development: Develop and review action plans for maintenance, deployment, and upgrades, ensuring all relevant client documentation is completed. Maintain a thorough understanding of client information, including warnings, handoffs, and briefing notes.

• Data Architecture: Develop, implement, and maintain complex data architectures (e.g., normalized and/or dimensional data models and DDL generation). Perform data transformation and migration using scripts or stored procedures.

• Problem Management: Lead problem management efforts by assessing incidents for recurring patterns, designing technical procedures for regular requests and changes, and developing/reviewing action plans and associated documentation.

• Oncall: Participate equally in the team’s on call rotation, typically one weekend per month.

Client Engagement & Communication

• Client Commitments: Make, manage, and meet client commitments in collaboration with team members.

• Reporting & Communication: Prepare client status and incident reports, review client reports regularly, and respond to client requests and inquiries.

• Client Alignment: Maintain alignment with client operating procedures, including change control, and manage client allotments, alerting the Team Manager to any pacing concerns.

• Technical Client Affinity: Take on technical client affinity as assigned by the Team Manager.

Process Improvement

• Innovation & Improvement: Participate in and, at times, lead efforts to suggest, recommend, and potentially design/implement new monitoring checks, enhancements to DBC toolkits, and other process improvements (e.g., Initial Reviews, Performance Reviews, Audits). Focus on initiatives that increase the value Pythian provides to clients.

What We Need From You

• Knowledge and experience in installing, configuring and upgrading Oracle databases & tools relevant in Oracle Administration.

• Automation technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Chef, SALT experience.

• Debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot methodically, identifying and applying fixes for known errors, and when necessary, capacity to think outside of the box to resolve complex issues

• Very good documentation skills.

• Nice to haves include; Understanding of current IT service standards such as ITIL. Being a contributor to projects relevant to Oracle, or other database or infrastructure software.

• Experience with cloud-native and managed database monitoring tools, including AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Operations (Stackdriver), and Azure Monitor. This includes configuring monitoring solutions, analyzing performance metrics, setting up alerts, and troubleshooting database issues in cloud environments.

• Experience in database migrations from different database engines, including Oracle, MySQL, and MSSQL, to PostgreSQL. Using migration tools such as ora2pg, AWS/GCP/Azure Database Migration Services (DMS), and other CDC-based techniques to ensure a smooth transition with minimal downtime.

• Experience migrating between on-premises and cloud-based databases.

• Experience analyzing and optimizing schema conversions, SQL compatibility issues, and performance tuning post-migration. Experience with Debezium and Striim is not mandatory but beneficial.

• Experience in monitoring PostgreSQL databases using industry-standard tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds, pgAdmin, Zabbix, Nagios and Datadog is an asset.

• Experience administering PostgreSQL in virtualized and cloud environments, especially AWS, GCP or Azure is considered an asset.

• Experience with scripting (bash/python) and software development (C++, Java, Go) is considered an asset.

What You Will Receive

• Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.

• Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.

• Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!

• Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!

• Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!

• Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

Hiring Disclaimer

• The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.

• Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. Our Talent Acquisition Team reviews all AI-generated recommendations, and the system is subject to regular bias audits to ensure fairness and compliance with all applicable employment and human rights laws. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. By applying for this position, you consent to Pythian’s use of these AI tools in the evaluation of your application. You have the right to request a human review of any solely AI-driven decision or to request an accommodation. Should you require further details regarding the processing of your data, please reach out to us.

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations.

The platform brings together CRM functionality, leasing workflows, maintenance operations, payments, owner and vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, staff dashboards, tenant/owner/vendor portals, third-party integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system.

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the platform, lead the engineering team, evaluate the existing technology, strengthen the architecture, and help move the product toward a stable commercial launch.

About The Role

This is not a purely advisory architecture position.

You will be expected to understand the existing application at a deep technical level, challenge weak technical decisions, lead developers, review engineering quality, identify technical and architectural risks, and determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt.

You will serve as a senior technical authority for the platform and work directly with company leadership and product management.

The right candidate will combine deep hands-on engineering experience with architecture expertise and engineering leadership.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

What You Will Do

• Take technical ownership of the architecture, engineering quality, technical audit, and launch readiness of Revun.

• Conduct a detailed assessment of the existing frontend, backend, databases, APIs, integrations, AI workflows, infrastructure, security, permissions, financial workflows, deployment processes, and overall codebase.

• Determine what should be retained, improved, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt based on technical risk, business impact, development effort, and long-term scalability.

• Identify technical debt, architectural weaknesses, security vulnerabilities, scalability risks, data-integrity issues, incomplete workflows, development problems, and launch blockers.

• Lead and provide technical direction to remote frontend, backend, integration, AI/automation, DevOps/cloud, and QA engineering resources.

• Evaluate developer capabilities, technical output, estimates, code quality, productivity, and ability to execute assigned work.

• Review code and pull requests, challenge weak engineering decisions, resolve technical blockers, and ensure developers follow established architectural and development standards.

• Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical solutions and engineering plans.

• Work closely with the Technical Product Manager to evaluate technical feasibility, dependencies, complexity, timelines, and trade-offs before development begins.

• Strengthen platform architecture across APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, permissions, workflow automation, and system integrations.

• Review financial-system reliability across payments, owner/vendor payouts, ledger activity, reconciliation, transaction history, audit trails, and reporting.

• Evaluate AI/LLM functionality for reliability, structured outputs, hallucination risk, privacy, security, monitoring, cost control, and measurable business value.

• Improve integration reliability through APIs, webhooks, queues, retries, rate-limit handling, logging, monitoring, idempotency, and failed-sync recovery.

• Establish and enforce engineering standards covering code reviews, branching, testing, QA, CI/CD, deployments, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and production release controls.

• Provide leadership with clear assessments of technical risks, engineering performance, development progress, architecture decisions, resource requirements, and launch readiness.

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field.

• 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant hands-on development experience.

• 4+ years in software architecture or senior technical leadership, such as Senior Software Architect, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, or equivalent.

• Demonstrated experience architecting and leading the development of complex, production SaaS applications.

• Strong backend and platform architecture expertise, including databases, APIs, distributed systems, authentication, authorization, RBAC, security, scalability, performance, and data integrity.

• Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture and the ability to evaluate frontend engineering decisions and code quality.

• Experience inheriting an existing software platform and determining what should be retained, refactored, replaced, or rebuilt.

• Experience leading and technically managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, including frontend and backend developers.

• Ability to evaluate developer capability, challenge estimates, identify weak engineering practices, and hold technical resources accountable for their work.

• Strong experience designing and integrating APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, queues, retries, logging, monitoring, rate-limit handling, and failure-recovery mechanisms.

• Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, production deployments, QA processes, incident management, security, and launch readiness.

• Experience with complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech/payment, PropTech, field-service, or other multi-user operational platforms.

• Practical experience integrating AI/LLM functionality into production applications, including evaluation, monitoring, privacy, hallucination risk, human review, and cost management.

• Ability to move between high-level architecture and detailed technical investigation when necessary.

• Excellent English communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership.

Nice to Have

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 15+ years of software engineering experience.

• Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Senior Architect, Technical Architect, Engineering Lead, or similar senior technical authority.

• Experience taking an existing SaaS product through technical stabilization and commercial launch.

• Experience in PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, CRM platforms, maintenance/field-service platforms, fintech, payments, compliance systems, or marketplace applications.

What Success Looks Like

You Will Be Expected To Develop a Deep Understanding Of Revun's Existing Technology And Give Leadership a Clear, Evidence-based View Of

• What needs improvement or refactoring.

You should be comfortable challenging existing decisions when necessary, but equally comfortable recommending that existing technology remain untouched when rebuilding it would provide little business or technical value.

We are looking for someone who can make sound technical decisions and lead engineers through executing them , not simply produce architecture diagrams or recommendations.

Sr. Staff Data Engineer (L7)

Yalo

Preferably candidates based in Córdoba, Argentina. Also open to Guatemala City, São Paulo, and Mexico City. This is a Hybrid role.

Hi! We're Yalo! We're on a mission to revolutionize how businesses sell in an omnichannel way with our intelligent sales platform and intelligent agents powered by cutting-edge AI. Imagine a world where businesses seamlessly connect with their customers across every channel—offering personalized experiences, anticipating needs, and delivering what they want with ease. That's the reality we're building at Yalo.

Born in Latin America and driven by its spirit of innovation, we're transforming sales for businesses around the globe. From empowering businesses in emerging markets to helping enterprises scale intelligently, we're redefining how companies engage with their customers and drive growth.

At Yalo, we believe the future of sales is personalized, omnichannel, intelligent, and conversational. Join us as we empower businesses to build stronger relationships and achieve remarkable results worldwide!

Job Summary 🧾

We're looking for a Sr. Staff Data Engineer to own the data platform that powers Yalo's analytics, dashboards, and AI agents. This is a senior technical ownership role — not a management track. You'll define the architecture, set the standards, and be the deepest technical authority on how data moves from raw platform events to governed, trusted, agent-ready information. If you think in systems that need to be reliable at 99.9% uptime, care as much about a clean semantic layer as a fast pipeline, and want your technical judgment — not your headcount — to be your leverage, this one's for you.

Your mission?

Own and evolve the infrastructure that turns Yalo's raw platform events into the trusted data foundation for dashboards, business decisions, and AI agents like IRIS. You'll work daily with Engineering (event generation), Business Analytics (dashboard consumers), and the ML/AI team (agent consumption) — without owning any of those teams — to keep the whole pipeline reliable, well-governed, and fast to build on.

What are the responsibilities for this role? 🧠

• Own and evolve Yalo's data platform, ensuring 99.9% uptime and clear SLAs across analytics and AI use cases.

• Define a modular, real-time, agent-ready data architecture — modeled for both human dashboard consumers and LLM-based agents like IRIS.

• Own the semantic layer — the single source of truth that keeps metrics consistent across Looker, Power BI, and IRIS. Prevent the dashboard sprawl and definition drift that comes from ungoverned, ad hoc modeling.

• Build and maintain a semantic and annotated data layer that lets both agents and humans reason over Yalo's core business concepts, not just query raw tables.

• Own data governance — the tiered, role-based access framework (CSM/PM/Ops/Power User) that routes all access through governed data.

• Define stage ownership and interfaces — the explicit boundary between Data Engineering (ingestion/modeling) and Business Analytics (dashboard build), so both teams can move independently without stepping on each other's data.

• Drive cost governance across BigQuery, dbt, Kafka, and Airflow — targeting 20%+ infrastructure cost efficiency improvement, continuing the team's track record (a prior tooling consolidation already cut one cost line by 95%).

• Lead technical incident response when pipelines break or produce incorrect data, especially where client-facing dashboards or agent outputs are affected.

• Set technical standards and mentor engineers across teams who touch the data layer — through code review, documentation, and architecture decisions, not people-management authority.

• Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, the incoming Analytics PM (stakeholder synthesis), Business Analytics, and the ML/AI team to keep the full pipeline — events → ingest/model → dashboards/agents — running end to end.

Job Requirements? 💻

Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.

Experience: 8+ years in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering, including significant time operating at a staff/principal level of technical ownership (architecture decisions, cross-team standards) rather than as a people manager.

Technical Skills

• Deep, hands-on expertise with modern data stacks: Airflow, dbt, BigQuery, Kafka, and GCP-native tooling.

• Strong understanding of streaming pipelines, orchestration, ELT, and real-time data systems.

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent).

• Experience designing and operating semantic/metrics layers (dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Cube, or equivalent) serving multiple downstream consumers.

• Familiarity with ML systems in production well enough to architect data for them — monitoring, drift detection, A/B testing context — without owning the model deployment itself (that's a separate function).

• Experience with data governance and access-control frameworks (role-based access, data classification, audit trails).

Problem-Solving: Comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-team architecture problems — this role exists specifically because "who owns which stage of the data pipeline" hasn't had a clear technical owner.

Soft Skills that matter to us 🫀

• Agentic mindset – You think in systems that act, not just flow. You build infrastructure to enable autonomy, not just availability.

• Ownership – Accountable from architecture to uptime, without needing direct reports to get there.

• Clarity communicator – Explains complex systems in business terms and aligns stakeholders without jargon.

• Influence without authority – Sets technical direction and raises the bar for teams you don't manage, through credibility and documentation.

• Proactivity – Doesn't wait for roadblocks; prevents them.

• Customer obsession – Cares about internal data customers (CS, Product, leadership) as much as the end user.

Metrics to measure 📈

• 99.9% uptime of critical data pipelines.

• 95%+ of core KPIs covered by the semantic layer or a governed data API (vs. raw/ungoverned sources).

• ≥20% cost reduction across BigQuery, dbt, and streaming infrastructure.

• 100% of critical pipelines migrated to automated, observable frameworks.

• Time-to-build for new dashboard/agent data needs, trending down as the semantic layer matures.

What do we offer? 🥰

• Unlimited PTO policy

• Competitive rewards on the market range

• Remote/Hybrid working available (Córdoba preferred; Guatemala City, São Paulo, Mexico City also open)

• Flexible time (driven by results)

• Start-up environment

• International teamwork

• You and nothing else limit your career here

We care,

We keep it simple,

We make it happen,

We strive for excellence.

At Yalo, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that embodies our core values: caring, initiative, excellence, and simplicity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusivity, where everyone's unique perspectives, experiences, and talents contribute to our collective success. As we embrace and respect our differences, we strive to create something extraordinary for the benefit of all.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal opportunities to individuals regardless of race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our commitment to fairness and equality is a fundamental pillar of our company.

At Yalo, we uphold a culture of excellence. We constantly challenge ourselves to go above and beyond, delivering remarkable results and driving innovation. We encourage each team member to take initiative and make things happen, empowering them to bring their best ideas forward and contribute to our shared goals.
