postings.title: Senior Data Engineer (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
What You'll Do

We're looking for someone genuinely exceptional: not broadly experienced, but specifically excellent in a way you can name and prove. This role is for a data engineer who can walk into a platform someone else built, work out what is actually wrong with it, and decide what to fix first.

You'll join a small, senior Data & Analytics team at a real estate investment firm that has built a sophisticated data platform on Snowflake, pulling together 40+ data sources. Your job is to stabilize the environment, make reporting reliable, and automate the manual work, so that people can focus on the investment and operating decisions that matter.

Your work will support three areas of the business:

• Transactions: buy/sell decisions, commercial leasing, and valuation

• Reporting and source of truth: benchmarks, fund and asset performance, and management reporting

• Day-to-day decision making: giving teams faster, better access to the information they need to run the business

You'll work directly with the client's technical and business teams, assess whether the platform is as strong as it looks, and raise the standard around you through code review, documentation, and the willingness to push back when something isn't right.

What we’re looking for

Depth in data engineering is the starting point. Beyond that we’re looking at judgment: knowing which problem to solve first in an environment with a lot of moving parts, and being able to explain that choice to people who aren’t engineers. We also pay attention to how AI shows up in the way you work.

You must bring:

• 5+ years in data engineering, with real ownership of a production platform rather than contributing to someone else’s

• Hands-on Snowflake: warehouse sizing and cost management, MERGE patterns, streams and tasks, clustering

• Experience diagnosing and fixing pipelines you didn’t write: slow queries, unexplained cost, silent data quality failures

• Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration across many sources

• Strong data modeling: stating and enforcing grain, clean layering from raw through staging to marts, handling corrections and late-arriving data

• Advanced SQL, including window functions and query performance work

• Experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent) and an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)

• A working relationship with AI that shows up in how you build, not just in the tools you’ve tried

• Comfort owning work end to end: from design through deployment and support

• A quality mindset: clean code, good documentation, thoughtful testing, and attention to data quality and lineage

• Strong English communication, async collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to problems

• The ability to understand the business behind the data, not just the ticket in front of you

Bonus points for asset management or commercial real estate experience, familiarity with systems such as Yardi, MRI, RealPage, Argus, VTS, or CoStar, building analytics-ready models for BI tools (Power BI in particular), AWS Glue or EMR alongside Snowflake, exposure to workflow automation tools (Power Automate, UiPath), and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Real impact. You'll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference.

An outstanding team. Talented, kind, hard working people who care about their craft and about each other. No egos. No politics.

Growth. You'll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility, at your own pace.

A culture of excellence. We care about doing the right thing for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high quality work, delivered sustainably.

Variety and stability. We're profitable, independent, and over two decades strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You'll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn't. You should skip this opportunity if:

• You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate toward a clear hierarchy and well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

• Distributed work isn't your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation, and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won't suit you.

• Inheriting an existing environment doesn't appeal. This role starts by stabilizing and improving a platform someone else built, with a lot of moving parts. If you only want greenfield projects, you'll find it frustrating.

• Feedback doesn't excite you. We're obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means feedback that's sometimes nitpicky. If refining work until it's excellent feels over the top, this won't be a fit.

• Change makes you uncomfortable. Priorities shift and processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, if this sounds like fuel, we'd love to talk.

How to Apply and What to Expect in the Interview Process

• Your work. Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We'll look at depth, the quality of your thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

• Lateral team fit. You'll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

• Work trial. You'll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

• Engineering deep dive. A collaborative session with our engineers.

• Project fit. An interview focused on prioritisation, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the messy middle.

postings.title: MLOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Promtior
Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we’ve helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients’ teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).
We’re a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role
We’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our Engineering team as the senior technical reference for ML and AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.

Key Responsibilities
You will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. You will balance reliability, performance and cost for ML workloads, working closely with SRE, Infrastructure and FinOps.
You will be the go-to reference for complex MLOps questions, reviewing and challenging the design of new models and data pipelines so they meet platform standards and non-functional requirements. You will partner with product squads such as Fraud and Anomaly Detection to establish clear SLAs and SLOs, proper logging, metrics and alerting, and you will strengthen on-call readiness through playbooks, dashboards and incident reviews.
A core part of the role is using agents and AI services to automate as much of MLOps as possible: feature store operations (pipelines, backfills, parity checks, data quality and drift monitoring), training and evaluation pipelines, promotion gates and rollbacks, runbook generation, alert triage and incident enrichment, and cost optimization recommendations. You will define the infrastructure, contracts and guardrails to consume these AI services safely, and contribute to their evaluation, observability and safety (prompts, policies, PII redaction and auditability) together with the AI team.
You will also set technical standards for model and data access control, PII handling, auditability of model changes and deployments, and environment separation, working with InfoSec and Architecture to stay aligned with regulatory requirements while keeping the platform practical for engineers and data scientists. Finally, you will mentor MLOps and Data/ML engineers on system design, reliability, observability and CI/CD for ML, and lead design and architecture reviews that help teams converge on simple, robust solutions.

Required Experience

• Solid experience owning or designing MLOps platforms or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams.

• Strong hands-on experience building and operating production ML workloads on Databricks, including Feature Store (ideally with Unity Catalog), MLflow experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, and batch and real-time model deployment.

• Experience building production-grade ML pipelines: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for models and data pipelines, and online and batch inference at scale.

• Strong background in distributed systems and data/stream processing (Spark, Flink or similar).

• Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) and container-based deployments.

• Strong understanding of observability for ML systems: metrics, logs and traces, as well as data and model drift, freshness and quality checks.

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating infrastructure and AI/ML trade-offs into business language.

Especially Valued

• Experience rolling out AI assistants inside engineering organizations (code or infra copilots, AI-powered log analysis), including policies and best practices.

• Exposure to LLM and AI infrastructure such as gateways, vector stores and evaluation harnesses.

• Prior experience as Technical Referent, Tech Lead or Architect for platforms or shared services.

• Contributions to internal standards, RFCs, guilds or tech communities.

Benefits

• 20 paid days off per year.

• Hybrid work model.

• Flex Days: monthly team activities.

• Professional development courses.

• Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

Location
Montevideo, Uruguay.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

Position Overview

Proofpoint is seeking a DevOps and Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of platform engineering and data infrastructure—you will own the reliability, automation, and delivery of the systems that power Proofpoint's data pipelines and analytics capabilities. You will build and maintain the cloud infrastructure (AWS-first), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling that enable data engineering teams to ship high-quality data products faster and more safely.

What You'll Do

• Implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) for automated testing, deployment, and promotion of AWS Glue ETL jobs, Athena views, and related data infrastructure.

• Build and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform and/or AWS CDK)—covering S3 buckets, IAM roles, Glue resources, Athena workgroups, Lake Formation permissions, VPCs, and supporting services.

• Own the observability stack for data pipelines define and instrument metrics, logs, and alerts (CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent) to ensure SLA compliance and fast incident response.

• Manage container and compute infrastructure (Docker, ECS/EKS, or Lambda) used to support data ingestion microservices and orchestration workers.

• Build and maintain AWS Glue ETL jobs (PySpark) for large-scale data ingestion and transformation across the data lake on S3.

• Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and security teams to translate requirements into scalable, automated infrastructure solutions.

Required

What You Bring to the Team

• 2+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, with at least 2 years of hands-on data engineering work.

• Expertise with AWS core services S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Secrets Manager, and CloudFormation/CDK.

• Hands-on experience with AWS data services Glue (ETL jobs, Crawlers, Data Catalog), Athena (workgroup management, query tuning, federated queries), and S3 (lifecycle, encryption, event notifications).

• Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools—Terraform and/or AWS CDK—for managing production cloud environments.

• Strong CI/CD experience designing and maintaining pipelines in GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.

• Experience with container technologies (Docker) and container orchestration (Amazon ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes).

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Deequ, or similar) and experience integrating them into CI/CD.

• Familiarity with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and lakehouse patterns.

• Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or security-data analytics environments.

postings.title: Senior AI Compute Infrastructure Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken is building a dedicated AI Compute and Infrastructure team to power the next generation of model training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation across the exchange. This team sits within engineering leadership and owns the infrastructure layer that lets Kraken run AI workloads with control, speed, reliability, and cost discipline.

The team is responsible for GPU and accelerator infrastructure, cluster operations, scheduling, model serving, observability, capacity planning, and cost-efficient compute at scale. This is the backbone that allows Kraken to train, serve, evaluate, and iterate on AI systems in-house where it matters for privacy, latency, reliability, cost, or product differentiation.

You will join a small, senior, high-impact team working directly with AI/ML researchers, platform engineers, security teams, and product teams. The mandate is simple: make Kraken's AI ambitions real by building compute infrastructure that is fast, dependable, efficient, and production-grade.

The opportunity

• Own and operate GPU and accelerator clusters used for training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation, including drivers, runtimes, kernels, device plugins, node configuration, scheduling primitives, and workload isolation.

• Design infrastructure that enables Kraken teams to run models locally on GPUs where it is strategically and economically preferable, reducing unnecessary dependency on external providers and containing compute costs.

• Build and improve scheduling, orchestration, placement, quota management, and utilization systems across heterogeneous accelerator environments.

• Optimize inference pipelines for latency, throughput, reliability, memory efficiency, and cost using frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, or equivalent serving stacks.

• Partner with ML engineers and researchers to remove bottlenecks in training, evaluation, batch inference, online inference, deployment, and production debugging workflows.

• Build observability for GPU utilization, memory pressure, queue depth, saturation, token throughput, request latency, failed workloads, capacity pressure, and spend.

• Drive reliability, incident response, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident improvements for always-on AI compute infrastructure.

• Evaluate and integrate new hardware, cloud instance families, specialized accelerators, runtimes, schedulers, and serving frameworks as the AI infrastructure landscape evolves.

• Build tooling that makes GPU usage visible, accountable, and easier for internal teams to consume without needing to become infrastructure experts.

• Contribute to long-term architecture decisions that balance performance, cost efficiency, scalability, operational simplicity, and production safety.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with significant time spent on GPU compute, ML infrastructure, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or large-scale production platforms.

• Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or accelerator-backed infrastructure in production or production-like environments, including scheduling, orchestration, utilization monitoring, and cost optimization.

• Strong systems engineering fundamentals across Linux, networking, storage, containers, Kubernetes, distributed runtimes, and production debugging.

• Experience with ML serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, TorchServe, KServe, Ray Serve, or equivalent systems.

• Proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, debugging, integration, and operational workflows.

• Practical understanding of performance tradeoffs across batching, concurrency, memory usage, GPU utilization, model size, latency, throughput, availability, and cost.

• Track record of optimizing compute costs while maintaining clear performance, reliability, and availability expectations.

• Experience building observable systems with useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, and incident workflows.

• Comfortable working in high-stakes, always-on environments where uptime, throughput, correctness, and operational discipline are critical.

• Clear communicator who can translate infrastructure tradeoffs for researchers, product teams, platform engineers, security stakeholders, and engineering leadership.

Nice to haves

• Experience at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, high-frequency trading firm, research platform, or high-scale ML organization.

• Familiarity with custom silicon or specialized accelerators such as TPUs, AWS Trainium, Gaudi, or similar platforms.

• Background in capacity planning, procurement input, reserved capacity strategy, cloud accelerator economics, or GPU fleet cost management.

• Experience with distributed training frameworks such as DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, FSDP, Ray, or equivalent systems.

• Experience debugging CUDA, NCCL, kernel, driver, runtime, memory, networking, or low-level performance issues.

• Experience with Rust, C++, Go, CUDA, or other systems languages used for performance-critical infrastructure.

• Crypto, financial services, trading infrastructure, or security-sensitive production infrastructure experience.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

At AspenView, we are passionate about transforming the way organizations approach technology. We specialize in creating high-performing, nearshore IT teams to help North American clients innovate faster and more efficiently.

About The Role

AspenView is seeking a Senior Data Architect with a strong data engineering foundation to join a large-scale data modernization initiative for a financial services client. In this role, you will own the physical design and engineering of the analytical data platform, building dimensional models on Amazon Redshift and the transformation and orchestration layers that power enterprise reporting and Business Intelligence.

You will work within a Data Mesh operating model alongside business-focused data modelers, domain teams, and BI stakeholders, turning logical designs into performant, well-governed data products. This is a full-time position, contractor agreement, with 100% dedication to the project, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

What You Will Do

• Physical Dimensional Modeling: Design, implement, and evolve physical dimensional models (facts, dimensions, and aggregates) in Amazon Redshift, translating conceptual and logical designs into scalable, production-ready structures.

• Redshift Performance & Optimization: Define distribution styles, sort keys, compression, and workload management strategies, and continuously tune queries and storage to meet performance and cost targets.

• Transformation Engineering with dbt: Build and maintain modular, tested, and well-documented dbt models, establishing standards for layering, naming, testing, and version control across the transformation codebase.

• Pipeline Orchestration with Airflow: Design and operate Airflow DAGs that orchestrate ingestion and transformation workflows, including dependency management, scheduling, retries, monitoring, and alerting.

• Data Mesh Enablement: Help domain teams deliver discoverable, reliable, and interoperable data products, applying shared modeling conventions, data contracts, quality checks, and governance standards.

• BI Enablement & Collaboration: Write and review advanced SQL, support BI and analytics teams with performant semantic structures, and partner with architects and business modelers to align technical delivery with business requirements.

What You Bring

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

• Proven senior-level experience as a Data Architect or Data Engineer delivering enterprise analytical platforms.

• Extensive hands-on experience with Data Mesh, Data Warehousing, and Business Intelligence solutions.

• Demonstrated experience with physical dimensional modeling on Amazon Redshift.

• Experience in financial services or banking environments is a strong plus.

Technical Expertise

• Amazon Redshift at an expert level (L400), including design, tuning, and operation of large-scale warehouses.

• dbt at an expert level (L400), including model design, testing, documentation, and deployment practices.

• Apache Airflow at an advanced level (L300+), including DAG design, orchestration patterns, and operational monitoring.

• SQL at an expert level (L400), including complex analytical queries and performance optimization.

Nice to Have

• Teradata Financial Services Industry Data Model (FSI-LDM) or Oracle Financial Services (FSI) Industry Data Models.

• BIAN (Banking Industry Architecture Network) certification.

• Experience with Control-M, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and Amazon SageMaker within a Data Mesh architecture.

Additional Requirements:

• 100% dedication to the project.

• Hybrid rol.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Visa Sponsorship

AspenView does not sponsor employment visas for this role. Applicants must be permanently authorized to work in their country of residence and must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Equal Opportunity Employer

AspenView is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe in creating an environment where all employees feel welcome, valued, and empowered to succeed. We celebrate diversity and strive to build a culture of inclusion where all individuals, regardless of their race, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other characteristic, can thrive. We encourage applicants from all walks of life to join our team and make a lasting impact.

postings.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer (PostgreSQL)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

The Database Services team at Medallia owns the production database systems that power a highly reliable global SaaS platform. Database Reliability Engineers (DBREs) are responsible for the availability, performance, and lifecycle of those systems, and for the platform capabilities that let engineering teams consume database services safely. We work as peers to Site Reliability Engineering, with the same expectations for reliability, incident response, and automation applied to the data layer. PostgreSQL is the largest part of our estate, and the team is evolving to support additional database technologies, primarily Apache Cassandra. Our databases run mostly in Kubernetes environments hosted in Medallia Cloud. We are currently looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer who combines deep PostgreSQL expertise with an automation mindset. A substantial part of the role is hands-on production work: operating clusters, diagnosing incidents, tuning performance, and executing upgrades. You will use that experience to identify recurring operational pain, fix the underlying causes, and turn repeatable procedures into automation the whole team relies on. As a Senior DBRE you will lead incident reviews, define service objectives for the platform, and mentor othe DBREs.

Responsibilities

• Own the availability and performance of production PostgreSQL clusters, measured against defined service level objectives.

• Own the database lifecycle: provisioning, configuration, maintenance, major-version upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning.

• Own backup, recovery, replication, and high availability, including regular restore tests and failover drills against agreed recovery point and recovery time objectives.

• Manage capacity planning and growth of the PostgreSQL estate.

• Build monitoring and alerting that reflects symptoms and service objectives rather than individual failures, and keep operational noise low.

• Build production-quality automation, tooling, and services that replace recurring manual procedures across the database lifecycle.

• Build standardized, supported workflows and self-service capabilities so engineering teams can provision and operate databases with less direct DBRE involvement.

• Collaborate with product-engineering teams: review schema migrations and query patterns, and guide them on PostgreSQL best practices.

• Troubleshoot complex problems that span the database, operating system, network, and application layers.

• Lead incident response for database systems, followed by blameless root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools where they accelerate troubleshooting, automation, and documentation.

• Mentor other DBREs and review technical work.

• Maintain runbooks and documentation that others can follow and progressivelyautomate.

• Be part of the Database Services on-call rotation and planned maintenance windows.

Candidates based in the Buenos Aires vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

We’re hiring a Staff Software Engineer, Developer Productivity to define and drive the future of how Webflow engineers build, test, and deliver software. In this role, you’ll operate as a technical leader owning the end to end deployment strategy and shaping the systems that enable engineering velocity at scale. This is a high impact role focused on reducing cycle time, increasing reliability and enabling world-class developer experience across Webflow.

Requirements

You’ll thrive as a/an Staff DevOps Engineer, Delivery Loop if you:

• Have deep expertise in modern deployment systems, including Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, and tools like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.

¡Hola! Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos convertimos en una marca de confianza en Venezuela.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Lead Analytics Engineer para ser el referente técnico del equipo de Analytics Engineering. Tu misión principal será diseñar y mantener la Single Source of Truth (SSoT) del negocio, estructurando modelos de datos escalables, gestionando el catálogo de datos y construyendo la capa semántica que habilitará el autoservicio de los Business Analysts (BAs). Trabajarás en la intersección entre tecnología y negocio, definiendo estándares de desarrollo y optimizando el contexto de nuestros datos para herramientas de IA.

Responsablidades

• Modelado y SSoT: Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos de datos limpios, testeados y transformados dentro del Data Warehouse (usando dbt/Dataform) como la única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

• Capa Semántica y Autoservicio: Crear la capa semántica y mantener actualizado el Catálogo de Datos para garantizar que los BAs puedan construir dashboards y análisis operativos sin fricción ni ambigüedad.

• Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.

• Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la organización.

• Liderazgo Técnico: Establecer buenas prácticas de desarrollo (DataOps, revisión de PRs, control de versiones) y mentorear a otros Analytics Engineers del equipo.

• Colaboración Cruzada: Coordinar con Data Platform e Ingeniería la integración de pipelines y definición de contratos de datos (Data Contracts).

Requisitos

• Experiencia 6+ años trabajando en entornos de datos, con al menos 3 años especializados en Analytics Engineering.

• Experiencia 2+ liderando equipos especializados en Analytics engineering .

• Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).

• Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).

• Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.

• Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.

• Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

• No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

• Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

• Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

• Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

• Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

This specific team is responsible for the functional verification of the firmware that controls communication devices in data centers. To achieve this, we develop and maintain a modular testing platform in Python, built in-house, which allows us to automate testing processes and support devices across different technologies. Additionally, we are responsible for collecting and analyzing data to optimize product quality.

postings.title: Senior Data Engineer (LATAM based)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks , used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.

Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.

You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models

• 3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity Catalog

• Expert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plus

• Strong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the start

• Data quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for data

• Reconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master data

• Incremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targets

• Practical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start

• Has built APIs or services that serve data

• Senior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagement

• Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the output

• C1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client team

Preferrable

• Exposing data to applications through APIs or MCPs

• Multi-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testing

• Finance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)

• Consolidating data across acquired companies or business units

• Ingesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured data

• Turning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholders

• FinOps / cost attribution on data platforms

What This Person Will Own And Do Day-to-day

Ingestion and source strategy

Build and maintain ingestion and ETL pipelines from business systems (ERP, CRM, product databases), operational tools, and document repositories. Build data lakes in Databricks that software, people, and AI agents can all query. Decide per source whether to ingest, index and link, or query live, based on volatility, volume, and which system is the record. Work with raw data in its source-system shape without waiting on upstream cleanup.

Entities and facts

Implement the entity model defined with the solution architect and resolve identity across systems, reusing existing matching work and sending ambiguous matches to the owner who decides. Model facts with source, validity period, validation status, and documented exceptions. Turn business definitions validated by their owners into certified tables, recording who signed off. Implement authority rules per data item and keep unresolved conflicts visible. Deliver finance numbers that are deterministic, reproducible, and traceable to source records.

Access and isolation

Implement access policies in Databricks and carry them into derived data. Enforce isolation at the database, tool, and application layers for consumers who aren’t Databricks users, such as external customers. Build isolation tests at the data and API layer, including similarly named customers, and run them as a release gate.

Structured sources and freshness

Integrate the structured sources each increment needs (CRM, ERP, payment processors, product data, spreadsheets), starting from what’s already in Databricks . Meet freshness targets and expose freshness with each fact. Track dependencies so facts and certified tables are updated or flagged when a source or definition changes. Own data quality checks, observability, and cost visibility.

Data interfaces

Build the APIs, webhooks, and MCP tools that query and filter facts deterministically, carrying the caller’s identity and permissions on every request. Log every access with the sources it used.

Collaboration and handover

Give the AI engineer the facts, entity IDs, and access rules that knowledge and agents depend on. Work with the full-stack engineer on the owners’ review interface and with the data quality lead on acceptance criteria. Be the technical voice on data feasibility in discovery and design sessions, and document and hand over your work to the client’s team.

AI-augmented engineering

Use AI tools daily for SQL and Python , schema mapping, definition drafting, test generation, and documentation. Review every AI-assisted output with care: a force multiplier, not a shortcut.

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact, guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We’re hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the structured core of a governed data foundation on Databricks , used by AI agents, applications, and business teams. You own everything that has to be exact: business entities reconciled across systems that use different identifiers, facts with their source and validity period, business definitions turned into certified tables, access control, and the APIs and MCP tools that serve this data with the caller’s permissions.

Conflicting definitions and identifiers are business problems as much as joins. The right person has spent years on Databricks making data correct and consistent, has enforced access control in production, and knows where platform controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start. You work autonomously with business stakeholders and ask the uncomfortable questions about definitions and permissions early.

You’ll work in a small team (solution architect, AI engineer, full-stack engineer, data quality lead, product and project managers) alongside the client’s data platform team. You follow their conventions and hand over what you build. The AI engineer owns the parts that need a model: knowledge from documents, retrieval, agent behavior, and evals. You give them the trusted data those parts depend on. AI tools speed up your modeling, SQL, testing, and documentation every day, and you know exactly when to trust the output and when not to.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of professional data engineering, building production-grade pipelines and data models

• 3+ years hands-on with Databricks in production, including Unity Catalog

• Expert SQL and Python: writes, debugs, optimizes, and refactors pipelines unaided. Spark/PySpark a plus

• Strong data modeling, including history-aware techniques (SCD Type 2, effective dating, temporal validity), with provenance and lineage designed in from the start

• Data quality and testing discipline: tests and expectations in pipelines (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) and CI/CD for data

• Reconciling data across systems: entity resolution or master data

• Incremental and change-driven processing (CDC, streaming, or incremental frameworks) against freshness targets

• Practical data governance: has implemented access control in production (row-level security, column masking, or role/attribute-based access) and knows where platform-level controls stop and application-level enforcement has to start

• Has built APIs or services that serve data

• Senior judgment: works autonomously, challenges unclear definitions, prioritizes by risk, owns outcomes without micromanagement

• Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar), with the judgment to know when to trust the output

• C1 English; comfortable working fully remote and directly with a client team

Preferrable

• Exposing data to applications through APIs or MCPs

• Multi-tenant data isolation for customer-facing products, with security and negative testing

• Finance or CRM data (NetSuite, Salesforce)

• Consolidating data across acquired companies or business units

• Ingesting and governing unstructured content (documents, wikis, contracts) alongside structured data

• Turning business definitions into a shared semantic or metrics layer with business or finance stakeholders

• FinOps / cost attribution on data platforms

What This Person Will Own And Do Day-to-day

Ingestion and source strategy

Build and maintain ingestion and ETL pipelines from business systems (ERP, CRM, product databases), operational tools, and document repositories. Build data lakes in Databricks that software, people, and AI agents can all query. Decide per source whether to ingest, index and link, or query live, based on volatility, volume, and which system is the record. Work with raw data in its source-system shape without waiting on upstream cleanup.

Entities and facts

Implement the entity model defined with the solution architect and resolve identity across systems, reusing existing matching work and sending ambiguous matches to the owner who decides. Model facts with source, validity period, validation status, and documented exceptions. Turn business definitions validated by their owners into certified tables, recording who signed off. Implement authority rules per data item and keep unresolved conflicts visible. Deliver finance numbers that are deterministic, reproducible, and traceable to source records.

Access and isolation

Implement access policies in Databricks and carry them into derived data. Enforce isolation at the database, tool, and application layers for consumers who aren’t Databricks users, such as external customers. Build isolation tests at the data and API layer, including similarly named customers, and run them as a release gate.

Structured sources and freshness

Integrate the structured sources each increment needs (CRM, ERP, payment processors, product data, spreadsheets), starting from what’s already in Databricks . Meet freshness targets and expose freshness with each fact. Track dependencies so facts and certified tables are updated or flagged when a source or definition changes. Own data quality checks, observability, and cost visibility.

Data interfaces

Build the APIs, webhooks, and MCP tools that query and filter facts deterministically, carrying the caller’s identity and permissions on every request. Log every access with the sources it used.

Collaboration and handover

Give the AI engineer the facts, entity IDs, and access rules that knowledge and agents depend on. Work with the full-stack engineer on the owners’ review interface and with the data quality lead on acceptance criteria. Be the technical voice on data feasibility in discovery and design sessions, and document and hand over your work to the client’s team.

AI-augmented engineering

Use AI tools daily for SQL and Python , schema mapping, definition drafting, test generation, and documentation. Review every AI-assisted output with care: a force multiplier, not a shortcut.

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

postings.descriptionText:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Buenos Aires, Argentina; Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico . Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience building machine learning solutions and working with technical customers.

• Experience designing cloud enterprise solutions and supporting customer projects to completion.

• Experience building and deploying custom ML models into production, including experience with deep learning frameworks and with designing and deploying agentic AI workflows for business process automation.

• Experience coding in Python, including data structures, algorithms, and software design.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently as this is a customer-facing role.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning.

• Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost).

• Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including data warehouse technical architectures, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments (e.g., Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).

• Understanding of the auxiliary practical concerns in production machine learning systems.

About The Job

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will design and implement machine learning solutions for customer use cases, leveraging core Google products including TensorFlow, DataFlow, and Vertex AI. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to apply machine learning in their business, and travel to customer sites to deploy solutions and deliver workshops to educate and empower customers. Additionally, you will work closely with Product Management and Product Engineering to build and constantly drive excellence in our products.

In this role, you will work with key Google Cloud customers. Together with the team you will support customer implementation of Google Cloud products through: architecture guidance, best practices, data migration, capacity planning, implementation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and much more.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

• Be a trusted technical advisor to customers and solve complex machine learning challenges.

• Coach customers on the practical challenges in machine learning systems: feature extraction and feature definition, data validation, monitoring, and management of features and models.

• Work with Customers, Partners, and Google Product teams to deliver tailored solutions into production.

• Create and deliver best practice recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, and sample code.

• Travel up to 30% in-region for meetings, technical reviews, and onsite delivery activities.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in building application extensions in SAP BTP

• Significant experience in a customer service role and business management role

• Work experience in a professional services industry, preferred

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

postings.title: Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Hands-on architecture leadership for EY Fabric, EY’s global technology platform

This is an architecture role for someone who combines strategic judgement with practical engineering delivery. The successful applicant will shape direction and define robust designs, while staying close to implementation through prototyping, code and design reviews, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with engineering teams.

The opportunity and EY Fabric

EY Fabric is EY’s global foundational technology platform for building, running and scaling technology solutions. It brings together reusable cloud, data, intelligence, developer and business-enablement capabilities, supported by self-service workflows and built-in governance, so teams can deliver secure products faster and more consistently.

In this role, you will be part of the Client Technology Architecture function and will work within a team leading key aspects of the architecture of EY Fabric, part of the wider Fabric engineering function. You will work across business, product, architecture, security, platform and engineering teams to translate outcomes into pragmatic technical direction and successful delivery.

The role spans the full delivery lifecycle. You will help shape product vision and roadmaps, develop architecture options and detailed designs, support planning and investment decisions, and remain actively engaged hands-on as solutions are built, tested, operated and improved. You will be expected to move comfortably between senior stakeholder conversations and detailed technical work with engineers, doing hands-on coding and engineering where needed to progress work through to production.

Key responsibilities

• Partner with Product Managers and other stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements and translate them into pragmatic product and platform architecture.

• Lead aspects of the EY Fabric architecture, owning or guiding the technology and design direction for assigned platform capabilities from early concept and option analysis through delivery, adoption, operation and evolution.

• Ensure designs work coherently across EY Fabric, including its platform APIs, developer workflows, portal and user experience, reusable cloud capabilities, identity and access patterns, data services, observability and integration points.

• Produce clear architecture blueprints, designs, architectural decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance, using your judgement as to what is required.

• Design secure, scalable and reusable services, APIs, integration patterns, datastores, user-facing capabilities and common platform components.

• Work directly with engineering teams to turn architecture into working software, including hands-on prototyping, proof-of-concept development, code review, pair design, troubleshooting and design assurance.

• Solve complex problems where an established solution may not exist by evaluating technologies, testing assumptions, considering build-versus-buy options and presenting evidence-based recommendations.

• Provide technical leadership throughout delivery, ensuring implemented solutions remain aligned with the intended architecture, quality expectations and enterprise standards.

• Participate in product and delivery planning, estimation and forecasting; manage architecture work and technical debt; balance cost, risk, quality, security, maintainability and time to market.

• Mentor engineers and architects, encourage experimentation and knowledge sharing, and contribute to architecture and engineering communities.

• Monitor relevant technology and industry trends, including AI-assisted engineering, and apply them responsibly where they provide measurable value.

Required Skills And Experience

• Significant experience in solution or technical architecture within complex, large-scale product or internal developer platform environments, with a strong record of successful implementation and adoption.

• Demonstrable hands-on software engineering capability in at least one modern language such as C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, together with confidence reading, reviewing and improving production code.

• Broad architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data and security, with the judgement to balance governance, technical quality and delivery pace.

• Practical Microsoft Azure or other cloud experience across compute, storage, networking, security and identity, including Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy and tenant-aware identity patterns.

• Expertise designing distributed and scalable products and platforms using APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes, preferably AKS, across cloud or hybrid environments.

• Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and DevSecOps practices.

• Knowledge of modern API design and API Management, including topics such as security, versioning, discoverability, etc.

• Understanding of secure-by-design practices, compliance expectations, in-application security and operation within enterprise technology standards.

• Experience designing for reusability, reliability, maintainability, observability, performance, cost optimisation and effective technical debt management.

• Working knowledge of architecture and design patterns, including microservices, containerised systems, event-driven architecture, data streaming and data platforms.

• Strong analytical, collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex decisions to senior stakeholders and work effectively across globally distributed teams.

Desirable experience

• InnerSource, internal developer platforms, reusable engineering assets, platform marketplaces or shared-services models.

• AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools and workflows, with an understanding of appropriate security, quality and governance controls.

• Low-code or no-code capabilities, workflow automation, enterprise user-experience patterns, data management or data governance.

• Architecture or security certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, TOGAF, SAFe or comparable credentials.

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, computer science, information technology or a related discipline.

What we are looking for

A self-starting, collaborative architect who enjoys solving difficult problems and taking responsibility for outcomes. You should be equally credible with senior stakeholders and engineering teams, comfortable operating across multiple initiatives, and willing to engage directly in design and implementation detail. This role suits someone who views architecture as an active delivery discipline and who can lead through both influence and practical contribution.

postings.title: Consultor/a SAP IS-Oil Retail – Estaciones de Servicio (SSR / RFNO)
postings.descriptionText:
Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Front-End y Back-End | Argentina y LATAM

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca Consultores/as SAP RFNO (Retail Fuel Network Operations) , para roles Front-End y Back-End, para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.

Los roles se integran a una célula ágil de consultores funcionales y técnicos, con foco en la operación de la red de estaciones de servicio, sus movimientos y liquidaciones.

EL DESAFÍO

La red de estaciones de servicio genera un volumen enorme de movimientos diarios: ventas, entregas, mediciones y liquidaciones que tienen que reflejarse correctamente en el sistema.

Según el rol, vas a ser referente funcional o soporte especializado de RFNO dentro de una célula ágil, sosteniendo la operación diaria y llevando adelante evolutivos sobre S/4HANA.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

• Front-End: ser referente funcional de SAP RFNO en el servicio de soporte y evolución.

• Back-End: dar soporte funcional y resolver GAPs del módulo junto al referente.

• Gestionar los procesos de operación de la red de estaciones, movimientos y liquidaciones.

• Relevar requerimientos con usuarios clave y traducirlos en diseño funcional.

• Configurar el módulo y acompañar desarrollos, pruebas integrales y pruebas de aceptación (UAT).

• Resolver incidentes y evolutivos dentro de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio, con análisis de causa raíz.

• Documentar soluciones y transferir conocimiento al equipo y a los usuarios.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

• Experiencia funcional comprobable en SAP RFNO (Retail Fuel Network Operations), según el rol: Front-End (referente funcional), al menos 10 años en la especialidad; Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs), al menos 3 años.

• Experiencia en procesos de redes de estaciones de servicio: movimientos, conciliaciones y liquidaciones.

• Experiencia real en SAP S/4HANA (proyectos o servicios AMS). No aplica experiencia limitada a R/3 / ECC.

• Ciclo funcional: relevamiento de requerimientos, diseño funcional, configuración y pruebas.

• Para el rol Front-End: experiencia con SAP Activate o ASAP.

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES

• Experiencia previa en IS-Oil SSR (Service Station Retailing) y migración a RFNO.

• Integración con SD, FI y sistemas de punto de venta.

• Experiencia previa en la industria Oil & Gas.

CONDICIONES DE LA POSICIÓN

Modalidad: Remoto, con reuniones presenciales puntuales en Puerto Madero (CABA) para residentes en AMBA

Dedicación: Full time

Contratación: Freelance / contractor

Rol: Front-End (referente funcional, senior experto) o Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs)

Inicio: A coordinar

Duración: Servicio de largo plazo

Ubicación: Argentina o Latinoamérica

Para residentes en Argentina, prepaga de salud 100% bonificada. El CV es evaluado por el cliente final, que puede entrevistar a los candidatos antes de la incorporación.

POSTULACIÓN

Si querés trabajar en una solución clave para la operación de una de las principales compañías de energía de la región, esta es tu oportunidad.

Postulate por este mismo medio con tu CV actualizado, indicando tarifa pretendida por hora (con moneda), país de residencia y disponibilidad para comenzar.
locations: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina

postings.title: Senior Salesforce Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Estamos en busqueda de un Senior Salesforce Developer para incorporarse a un proyecto de alcance internacional.

Buscamos un profesional con sólida experiencia en Salesforce, enfocado principalmente en desarrollo declarativo y configuración de la plataforma, capaz de diseñar e implementar soluciones escalables que respondan a necesidades de negocio complejas.

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar soluciones en Salesforce utilizando herramientas declarativas como Flow, Process Builder y Workflow Rules.

• Colaborar con stakeholders para relevar requerimientos y optimizar procesos de negocio.

• Mantener y evolucionar aplicaciones existentes asegurando performance y estabilidad.

• Desarrollar componentes en Lightning y programaciones en Apex cuando sea necesario.

• Realizar testing, debugging y despliegue de nuevas funcionalidades.

• Generar documentación técnica y funcional.

• Brindar soporte y capacitación a usuarios finales.

• Mantenerse actualizado sobre nuevas funcionalidades y mejores prácticas de Salesforce.

Requisitos técnicos

• Inglés avanzado.

• Título universitario en Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines.

• +5 años de experiencia en Salesforce Development.

• Experiencia trabajando con Sales Cloud y Service Cloud.

• Sólidos conocimientos en herramientas declarativas de Salesforce.

• Experiencia en Lightning Components y Apex.

• Conocimiento de APIs, integraciones y migración de datos.

• Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de resolución de problemas y comunicación.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Salario dolarizado liquidado en pesos al cambio del dólar BNA venta.

• Relación de dependencia con Capgemini.

Beneficios

• Reintegro de gastos virtuales.

• OSDE como medicina prepaga.

• Beneficios en Megatlón y CUI para ingles, frances y portugues.

• Días hábiles de vacaciones + día de cumpleaños libre

Postulate y se parte de nuestro equipo!

postings.title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring talented Software Engineers with strong Python, Packaging and Linux skills and who want to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap, rock and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you

• You have expertise in Python.

• You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.

• You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.

• Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.

• Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem

• Work with external open source and commercial projects to understand how we can better serve community needs.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Sr Data Engineer (Databricks)
postings.descriptionText:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Job Description

¡Sumate a Capgemini!

Buscamos un/a Senior Data Engineer con fuerte experiencia en Databricks para incorporarse a proyectos globales de datos y analítica, colaborando con equipos distribuidos y participando en iniciativas de modernización de plataformas de datos.

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones de datos basadas en Databricks.

• Construir y mantener pipelines de datos escalables.

• Implementar prácticas de DataOps y automatización.

• Definir estándares de gobierno y calidad de datos.

• Colaborar con equipos de negocio y tecnología para entregar soluciones analíticas.

Requisitos

• +7 años de experiencia en Data Engineering.

• Experiencia sólida en Databricks y Apache Spark (PySpark/Spark SQL).

• Experiencia con dbt, Airflow o Databricks Workflows.

• Dominio de SQL y Python.

• Conocimientos de arquitectura Lakehouse y modelado de datos.

• Experiencia trabajando sobre AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.

• Inglés intermedio/avanzado.

Deseables

• Experiencia con Kafka, Fivetran o Pub/Sub.

• Conocimientos de Unity Catalog e Immuta.

• Experiencia con Power BI.

• Certificación Databricks Data Engineer Professional.

• Conocimientos de AI/ML o soluciones GenAI.

Beneficios

Reintegro por gastos de virtualidad

Prepaga OSDE

Beneficios en Megatlon y Fiter

Descuento del 70% en CUI (inglés, francés y portugués)

Cursos y Certificaciones en Udemy y Next

Job Description - Grade Specific

Has more than a year of relevant work experience. Solid understanding of programming concepts, software design and software development principles. Consistently works to direction with minimal supervision, producing accurate and reliable results. Individuals are expected to be able to work on a range of tasks and problems, demonstrating their ability to apply their skills and knowledge. Organises own time to deliver against tasks set by others with a mid term horizon. Works co-operatively with others to achieve team goals and has a direct and positive impact on project performance and make decisions based on their understanding of the situation, not just the rules.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.
