postings.title: Senior Shopify Developer
postings.descriptionText:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Shopify Developer for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products and growth features.

What we are looking for:

• 3+ years of dedicated experience architecting and scaling Shopify Plus stores, including advanced theme development using Shopify CLI, Liquid, and Online Store 2.0 JSON templates.

• 5+ years of core web development experience using modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and React.js. Expertise in building responsive, accessible, and ultra-fast user interfaces without relying on excessive app code injections.

• Hands-on experience developing with Shopify Storefront API and Admin API (GraphQL and REST). Experience with headless e-commerce architectures using Hydrogen / Remix or Next.js is a significant advantage.

• Proven ability to build custom apps and extensions utilizing Shopify Functions (custom discount, shipping, and payment logic) and Checkout Extensibility.

• Mastery of site speed optimization (Core Web Vitals, asset minification, lazy loading) and A/B testing implementation (e.g., VWO, Optimizely) to continuously boost store conversion rates.

• Experience setting up reliable data pipelines between Shopify and external systems like ERPs (Netsuite, SAP), CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce), and Subscription platforms (Recharge, Skio).

Nice-to-have:

• Experience migrating legacy Shopify stores from vintage Liquid templates to Online Store 2.0 or Headless solutions.

• Experience building public or private Shopify Apps using Node.js / Remix / GraphQL.

• Familiarity with internationalization (Shopify Markets), multi-currency, and localization setups.

Responsibilities:

• Architect and maintain pixel-perfect, mobile-first Shopify themes, utilizing modular Liquid components, custom sections, and metafields.

• Build custom Theme App Extensions and Shopify Functions to solve complex business logic (e.g., custom bundling, tiered pricing, subscription flows) while keeping the site lean and performant.

• Audit and refactor front-end code to maintain high Core Web Vitals scores, fast DOM rendering, and instant checkout transitions.

• Connect Shopify storefronts to third-party APIs, fulfillment partners, warehouse management systems (WMS), and marketing platforms using webhooks and GraphQL middleware.

• Maintain clean version control workflows using GitHub and Shopify CLI, enforcing automated code checks, staging previews, and safe production deployments.

What we offer:

Get paid, not played
No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

Predictable project hours
Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

Flex days, so you can recharge
Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.

Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies
Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.

Hand-picked opportunities, just for you
Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.

One seamless process, multiple opportunities
A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.

Compensation
Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

postings.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer - Remote - Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior DevOps Engineer (Databricks).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or DevOps Engineering.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Extensive experience administering and optimizing Databricks on AWS in enterprise environments.

• Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for cloud infrastructure automation.

• Hands-on experience automating Databricks jobs, clusters, and serving endpoints using REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code.

• Strong experience designing and maintaining GitHub Actions workflows and reusable CI/CD frameworks across multiple repositories.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with a solid understanding of data engineering workflows.

• Strong understanding of Apache Spark and distributed data processing.

• Experience implementing automated code quality and security checks using tools such as SQLFluff, PyLint, and GitHub Actions.

• Proven experience establishing SDLC guardrails, branch protection, code ownership, approval workflows, deployment controls, and secure secret management.

• Hands-on experience managing Databricks Unity Catalog, including access controls and data lineage.

• Strong understanding of AWS IAM, Databricks RBAC, identity providers, and least-privilege access principles.

• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability for cloud and data platforms.

• Experience designing scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient multi-environment data platform architectures.

• Familiarity with Snowflake and modern data engineering platforms is a plus.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Data Engineer.

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

postings.title: Senior, Data Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Ready to move with intent? As a Senior Data Engineer, you take ownership of complex data workflows that power digital transformation. You will design and implement scalable data solutions that bridge the gap between raw information and actionable marketing insights.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Develop and deploy production-grade data pipelines using modern orchestration tools like Airflow or dbt.

• Optimize data models for performance and cost-efficiency within cloud environments.

• Perform code reviews and mentor Core Engineers to ensure high standards of "getting sh*t done".

• Collaborate with Data Scientists and Analysts to ensure data readiness for advanced modeling.

• Implement data security and privacy best practices in line with global standards.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Proven experience in designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines in a professional environment.

• Deep proficiency in SQL and Python for data processing.

• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Knowledge of data modeling techniques (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).

• Ability to act fast and adapt to the evolving needs of global brands.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is at its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure engineer to join our Market Data Services team, focusing on our high-impact Market Data Distribution program .

As a Lead Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within our Market Data Services team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering third party data, via cloud-based Data Platforms for business use across JPMorgan including AI/ML. You will be working within an Agile project environment, participating in two-week sprint cycles, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Building and maintaining AWS EKS Environments

• Configure monitoring for cloud environments

• Extract Transform Load data from Third Parties into AWS Databases

• Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to ensure data solutions align with business and regulatory requirements.

• Manage the risk profile of Market Data applications in line with Cyber Security Control Procedures

• Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and two-week sprint cycles.

Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

• Strong hands-on expertise with AWS EKS and Terraform for building and maintaining clusters

• Experience with build pipelines Jenkins and Spinnaker

• Deep familiarity with Docker containerizing applications

• Experience with AWS Lambda, AWS Neptune, AWS Glue.

• Proficient in SQL for Oracle and No-SQL DSL for ElasticSearch.

• Experience working in Agile teams.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Datadog, Cloudwatch or Dynatrace experience

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

Any experience with S3, Karpenter, Kustomize and Istio will be favorable.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as an Agentic GCP DevOps Engineer.

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional Software Engineering / DevOps experience.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows and agentic AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) integrated into daily development routines.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Production experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically managing services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, and GKE.

• Proven track record of designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications in production environments.

• Hands-on Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) experience using Terraform or Deployment Manager to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.

• Production experience with containerization and orchestration, including Docker and Kubernetes (GKE).

• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions using tools such as Google Cloud Observability (Stackdriver), Prometheus, or Grafana.

• Demonstrated experience optimizing GCP infrastructure for scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay in your local currency.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• English Classes.

• Ample opportunity for career advancement.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Depending on your location other benefits may apply.

FullStack is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form, which can be provided upon request during our hiring and interview process.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Consultor/a SAP Commodity Management / Trading (GTM)
postings.descriptionText:
Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Front-End y Back-End | Argentina y LATAM

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca Consultores/as SAP GTM (Global Trade Management) , para roles Front-End y Back-End, para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.

Los roles se integran a una célula ágil de consultores funcionales y técnicos, con foco en los contratos de trading y los procesos de compra y venta asociados.

EL DESAFÍO

Los contratos de trading de commodities concentran operaciones de alto valor: precios, cantidades y vinculaciones entre compras y ventas tienen que estar correctamente modelados de punta a punta.

Según el rol, vas a ser referente funcional o soporte especializado de GTM dentro de una célula ágil, sosteniendo la operación diaria y llevando adelante evolutivos.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

• Front-End: ser referente funcional de SAP GTM en el servicio de soporte y evolución.

• Back-End: dar soporte funcional y resolver GAPs del módulo junto al referente.

• Gestionar contratos de trading y los procesos de compra y venta asociados.

• Relevar requerimientos con usuarios clave y traducirlos en diseño funcional.

• Configurar el módulo y acompañar desarrollos, pruebas integrales y pruebas de aceptación (UAT).

• Resolver incidentes y evolutivos dentro de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio, con análisis de causa raíz.

• Documentar soluciones y transferir conocimiento al equipo y a los usuarios.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

• Experiencia funcional comprobable en SAP GTM (Global Trade Management), según el rol: Front-End (referente funcional), al menos 10 años en la especialidad; Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs), al menos 3 años.

• Experiencia específica y documentada en SAP GTM: contratos de trading y procesos de compra y venta asociados (detallarla en el CV).

• Ciclo funcional: relevamiento de requerimientos, diseño funcional, configuración y pruebas.

• Para el rol Front-End: experiencia con SAP Activate o ASAP.

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES

• Experiencia en SAP S/4HANA.

• Experiencia en Commodity Pricing Engine (CPE) y asociaciones de trading.

• Integración de GTM con SD, MM y TSW.

• Experiencia previa en la industria Oil & Gas.

CONDICIONES DE LA POSICIÓN

Modalidad: Remoto, con reuniones presenciales puntuales en Puerto Madero (CABA) para residentes en AMBA

Dedicación: Full time

Contratación: Freelance / contractor

Rol: Front-End (referente funcional, senior experto) o Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs)

Inicio: A coordinar

Duración: Servicio de largo plazo

Ubicación: Argentina o Latinoamérica

Para residentes en Argentina, prepaga de salud 100% bonificada. El CV es evaluado por el cliente final, que puede entrevistar a los candidatos antes de la incorporación.

POSTULACIÓN

Si querés trabajar en una solución clave para la operación de una de las principales compañías de energía de la región, esta es tu oportunidad.

Postulate por este mismo medio con tu CV actualizado, indicando tarifa pretendida por hora (con moneda), país de residencia y disponibilidad para comenzar.

Resource On-board Date

Solution Architect

As the Lead Solution Architect for the Innovation Team, you will drive the evaluation, prototyping, and adoption of emerging technologies for our customers across diverse industry sectors. You will act as a technology generalist, leveraging your broad expertise across full stack development, AI/ML, MEAN stack, databases, cloud platforms, and more, to guide customers in identifying, assessing, and implementing innovative solutions that deliver business value.

Position Summary

• 5+yrs of experience in a similar profile with strong service delivery background

• Design technical specifications for AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, NLU, NLG projects and implement the same.

• Exposure to Generative AI, AI Agents design and development using opensource frameworks and Azure AI Services.

• Contribute to products or tools built on Artificial Intelligence technologies and paradigms, that can enable high-value offerings.

• Building AI solutions would involve the use and creation of AI and ML techniques including but not limited to deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, search, information retrieval, information extraction, probabilistic graphical models and machine learning.

• Hands on experience as leads in designing and developing applications/tools using Microsoft technologies - ASP.Net, C#, HTML5, MVC, Angular/React/Node Js

• Analyses tools and solutions to identify issues, errors or problems, and determine suitable debugging tools and techniques

• Applies basic debugging tools and techniques to reproduce, simplify and resolve solution errors or problems

• Proven track record in evaluating, designing, and implementing solutions using emerging technologies.

• Strong understanding of architectural patterns, integration approaches, and technology adoption frameworks.

• Experience with cloud-native architectures, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices.

• Ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies in unfamiliar domains.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

• Experience leading technical teams and driving cross-functional collaboration.

• Exposure to industry-specific challenges and technology use cases is a plus.

• Identifies internal and external factors which may impact requirements

• Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis and mapping, e.g., automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements

• Analyses relevant information from stakeholders and participates in the preparation of preliminary mapping of business requirements to existing processes to identify gaps and/or opportunities

• participates in identifying the costs, benefits and process impact of updating, upgrading or adding new components; documents and measures direct and indirect costs and projected benefits

• Documentar soluciones y transferir conocimiento al equipo y a los usuarios.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

• Experiencia funcional comprobable en SAP TSW (Trader's and Scheduler's Workbench), según el rol: Front-End (referente funcional), al menos 10 años en la especialidad; Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs), al menos 3 años.

• Experiencia en planificación y programación de movimientos de hidrocarburos, nominaciones y proyección de inventarios.

• Experiencia real en SAP S/4HANA (proyectos o servicios AMS). No aplica experiencia limitada a R/3 / ECC.

• Ciclo funcional: relevamiento de requerimientos, diseño funcional, configuración y pruebas.

• Para el rol Front-End: experiencia con SAP Activate o ASAP.

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES

• Experiencia en Stock Projection Worksheet, nominaciones y ticketing de TSW.

• Conocimiento de IS-Oil e integración de TSW con TD, MM y SD.

• Experiencia previa en la industria Oil & Gas.

CONDICIONES DE LA POSICIÓN

Modalidad: Remoto, con reuniones presenciales puntuales en Puerto Madero (CABA) para residentes en AMBA

Dedicación: Full time

Contratación: Freelance / contractor

Rol: Front-End (referente funcional, senior experto) o Back-End (soporte funcional y GAPs)

Inicio: A coordinar

Duración: Servicio de largo plazo

Ubicación: Argentina o Latinoamérica

Para residentes en Argentina, prepaga de salud 100% bonificada. El CV es evaluado por el cliente final, que puede entrevistar a los candidatos antes de la incorporación.

POSTULACIÓN

Si querés trabajar en una solución clave para la operación de una de las principales compañías de energía de la región, esta es tu oportunidad.

Postulate por este mismo medio con tu CV actualizado, indicando tarifa pretendida por hora (con moneda), país de residencia y disponibilidad para comenzar.

postings.title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

• Build and lead a team of engineers in your region

• Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development

• Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals

• Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders

• Lead modern, agile software development practices

• Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values

• Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation

• Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines

• Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

• Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills And Experience

• You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it

• You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development

• You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software

• You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies

• You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

• Software development experience in Python or Golang

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Site Reliability Engineer (GCP).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or backend engineering.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Experience owning production reliability, incident response, on-call operations, and service availability.

• Strong background with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), compute, networking, and managed services.

• Proven experience building and improving monitoring, alerting, and observability systems using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Datadog, or similar platforms.

• Proven experience with Docker, containerized workloads, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience improving reliability through root cause analysis, incident prevention, blameless postmortems, and measurable reliability metrics.

• Strong background optimizing PostgreSQL performance, including connection pooling, query optimization, indexing, read replicas, and capacity planning.

• Experience improving infrastructure scalability, performance, availability, and cost efficiency.

• Familiarity with automating incident response and developing or integrating AI agents for alert triage and auto-remediation.

• Experience supporting ML or data infrastructure, including training pipelines and model monitoring, is a plus.

• Knowledge of infrastructure as code using Terraform or similar tools is a plus.

• Experience supporting physical or IoT systems, edge devices, cameras, or on-site hardware is a plus.

• Familiarity with bare-metal infrastructure, hardware monitoring, redundancy, failover, and high availability is a plus.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

postings.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Overview

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

Our IT Culture

We don’t expect to be perfect, but we are always proactively seeking out ways to help solve bottlenecks within our infrastructure and user community. We build strong relationships with team members around the globe. Medallia IT is a global, no-nonsense flat organization where the best ideas are implemented, no matter where they come from

We love technology and we are always after the latest technologies to learn and share with our team. We are not afraid of failing when we are experimenting with different technologies, development methodologies, and tools. We’ve got a culture focused on smarts, kindness, continual learning, and feedback

IT in Medallia is creating a world class delivery and capabilities organization that will simplify the landscape for support efficiency while, and Designing, Planning and delivering quality new solutions that are, cost effectively

The Role

As a Senior AI Systems Engineer specialized in AI Automation, Frameworks & Enterprise Integrations at Medallia, you will play a key role in shaping and scaling Medallia's internal AI-enabled automation capabilities across the enterprise. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior AI Systems Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in shaping and executing the vision and roadmap of our internal AI automation and enterprise workflow orchestration initiatives. Beyond traditional automation responsibilities, this role requires strong experience with AI frameworks, workflow automation platforms, low-code/no-code orchestration tools, APIs, and enterprise systems such as n8n, Claude Code, ServiceNow, and modern AI services, ensuring a holistic approach to enterprise automation.

The Senior AI Systems Engineer will work closely with teams across IT, Security, Engineering, People, Finance, Support, and business operations, architecting, designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable, and secure automation solutions that connect business systems, workflows, and services while maintaining governance, stability, and operational rigor.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a key contributor in defining the vision, standards, and technical roadmap for internal AI automation and enterprise workflow orchestration within Medallia IT.

• Design and maintain scalable patterns for AI-enabled workflows, agentic orchestration, API integrations, prompt handling, logging, error management, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, and IT leadership to ensure automation and AI implementations align with governance, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.

• Help standardize the enterprise automation stack, including orchestration tools, integration patterns, connectors, approval flows, and observability practices.

• Evaluate platforms, frameworks, and vendors to support long-term maintainability, interoperability, and cost efficiency.

• Work directly with internal stakeholders to identify manual, repetitive, or high-friction workflows that can be improved through automation, integration, and AI-assisted processes.

• Build, test, deploy, and support workflow solutions using tools such as n8n, Zapier, ServiceNow, and other orchestration or integration platforms.

• Develop proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value, efficiency gains, and improved user experience.

• Translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable automations, system integrations, and service workflows.

• Design and maintain reusable components, templates, and integration patterns to reduce duplication and accelerate delivery.

• Architect and implement integrations between enterprise platforms such as ITSM, collaboration tools, identity systems, knowledge systems, ticketing platforms, and AI services.

• Build and maintain automation flows that leverage REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven triggers, database connectors, and secure credential handling.

• Support AI use cases involving LLM APIs, prompt orchestration, tool calling, workflow routing, contextual enrichment, and response validation.

• Collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure automations are resilient, observable, and aligned with platform best practices.

• Contribute to environment setup, release processes, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance for automation services.

• Monitor automation health, reliability, usage trends, error rates, and performance across platforms and workflows.

• Troubleshoot complex workflow failures, integration issues, API errors, authentication problems, and data handling gaps across systems.

• Establish support processes, technical documentation, runbooks, and operational standards for ongoing maintenance and service continuity.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational cost, simplify workflows, and increase platform adoption.

• Track platform usage and help optimize licensing, vendor utilization, and AI/API consumption where applicable.

• Partner with cross-functional technical and business teams to prioritize automation opportunities and align execution with Medallia IT goals.

• Present architecture recommendations, implementation plans, status updates, and technical proposals to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Mentor peers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.

• Act as an escalation point for complex L3 issues related to workflow automation, orchestration, integrations, and enterprise platform logic.

• Work onsite at our office as needed to collaborate and drive initiatives forward; flexible work arrangements available otherwise.

Candidates based in the Buenos Aires vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

postings.title: Software Engineer - Growth Foundations
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Foundations team is a new, dedicated team within Growth focused on establishing foundational frontend infrastructure, best practices, and component systems that serve Kraken's entire .com platform. We are building the standards and tools that enable all frontend development across the organization to move faster, maintain higher quality, and align with modern development practices. The team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Design to create a robust component library and establish best practices that set the gold standard for frontend development at Kraken. Our mission is to empower teams across the organization with well-architected, reusable components and clear guidelines that accelerate development while ensuring consistency, quality, and maintainability across all Kraken customer-facing experiences.

This is a fast-moving, delivery-focused team. You'll ship a steady stream of projects rather than settle into long-term platform maintenance, and the work is very UI-heavy .

The opportunity

• Design, build, and ship a comprehensive component library and design system using React.js and our custom-built CMS that serves as the foundation for all .com experiences

• Build and document reusable, accessible components and integrate with our custom CMS to enable dynamic content management and component configuration across the platform

• Deliver polished, pixel-perfect UI implementations that faithfully translate designs into production, working closely with Design to get every detail right

• Move quickly across multiple projects and initiatives, balancing speed of delivery with quality

• Establish and evolve frontend best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns that become the model for development across the organization

• Create comprehensive component documentation and guidelines that empower developers across teams to build consistently and efficiently

• Set the standard for high-quality code, mentor junior and senior engineers, and significantly influence technical decisions and strategy discussions

• Design and implement scalable, well-documented systems that support growth and complexity across multiple teams and initiatives

• Optimize component performance, accessibility, and developer experience to accelerate team velocity and reduce friction in the development workflow

• Drive process improvements and lead by example, establishing patterns and practices that become foundational to frontend development at Kraken

What You Bring

• A keen eye for design and a passion for pixel-perfect implementation

• A strong understanding of component-driven design and reusable architecture patterns

• Experience building and maintaining design systems or component libraries at scale

• A track record of thriving in fast-paced environments and delivering projects quickly

• A passion for establishing best practices and improving developer experience across teams

• Strong communication skills to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers across the organization

Skills You Should HODL

• 4+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on web and component-driven applications

• Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and proficiency with React framework

• Strong UI engineering skills, including advanced CSS and translating design mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces

• Experience building or contributing to design systems or component libraries

• Strong experience with modern frontend build tools and tooling (webpack, vite, etc.)

• Experience with API design and integration (RESTful APIs, GraphQL)

• Proficiency with frontend testing frameworks and component testing best practices

• Experience working with or integrating a CMS (custom-built or headless)

• Strong understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and UI/UX best practices

• Experience within a large technology organization or fast-growing startup

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to haves

• Knowledge of the cryptocurrency industry and blockchain technology

• Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering patterns

• Familiarity with TypeScript in a large codebase

• Experience mentoring other engineers on component architecture and best practices

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Linux devices software engineer - snapd
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Linux devices software engineer on our SnapD team to work on mission-critical Golang code, focused on software delivery, containers, security sandboxing, telemetry and device management.

Snaps are next-generation software packaging and delivery for Linux. They are designed for safety, security and robustness, with application-specific confinement of containers optimised for IoT devices, desktops and servers. Our goal is that snaps work across multiple Linux flavors to ensure that publishers have the simplest way to reach the whole Linux world.

This role requires an obsession with quality and performance, for work at the heart of the operating system. It also requires an interest in the software publishing and consumption experience. Applicants should be passionate about open source software development. We value collaboration, peer reviews, good unit/integration testing and maintainable code. General knowledge and experience with Linux as a developer platform is required. Having previous experience with Golang is very nice to have.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or Americas regions

The role entails

• Collaborate proactively with a distributed team

• Write high quality code to create new features

• Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them

• Review code produced by other engineers

• Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions

• Obsess over how to achieve robustness despite unexpected events like power outages

• Work from home with global travel for up to two weeks, twice a year

What We Are Looking For In You

• You love technology and working with brilliant people

• You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable

• You value soft skills, are thoughtful and self-motivated

• You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

• You have professional software development experience using Go, Python, C, or C++

• You know Linux system-level fundamentals, e.g. cgroups, namespaces, apparmor

• Commitment to software testing, code reviews and maintainable code

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Analista Funcional Cloud Oracle Alloy
postings.descriptionText:
En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio. Buscamos personas que impulsen resultados con foco en la satisfacción de nuestros clientes con impacto en el negocio, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y actuando con integridad en cada decisión.

Tu rol será:

Ser el nexo funcional entre la operación de Oracle Alloy y la plataforma de comercialización CloudBlue Commerce. Esto implica conocer en profundidad las capacidades del catálogo de servicios cloud propios, traducirlas en configuración comercial sobre la plataforma y sostener el conocimiento certificado que el programa de partners de Oracle requiere.

Tus principales desafíos serán:

• Conocer en profundidad las capacidades y el modelo operativo de Oracle Alloy como infraestructura cloud propia de la compañía (IaaS, PaaS y SaaS), para asesorar funcionalmente sobre qué servicios incorporar al portafolio comercial.

• Relevar necesidades de negocio para nuevos servicios o paquetes sobre Oracle Alloy, evaluar su viabilidad y definir catálogo, pricing y condiciones de suscripción junto a los referentes de negocio.

• Traducir el catálogo de servicios de Oracle Alloy en la configuración funcional de CloudBlue Commerce: productos, planes, pricing y ciclo de vida del cliente.

• Obtener y mantener las certificaciones Oracle requeridas para sostener el rol de partner/operador del programa Alloy, participando activamente de las instancias de formación que ofrece Oracle.

• Actuar como referente funcional de Oracle Alloy hacia el resto del área de Sistemas y hacia las áreas de negocio que definen la oferta comercial sobre esa infraestructura.

• Dar seguimiento a las novedades del programa Alloy —nuevos servicios, cambios de condiciones, actualizaciones de la plataforma— y anticipar su impacto en el catálogo comercializado.

• Coordinar con Oracle las tareas de escalamiento y soporte que exceden las tareas operativas de primera línea que la compañía asume como operador de Alloy.

• Documentar las reglas de negocio, condiciones comerciales y capacidades del catálogo Oracle Alloy, asegurando una lectura consistente hacia toda la organización.

Qué necesitamos de vos:

• Estudios completos o avanzados en carreras de Ingeniería en Sistemas, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o afines.

• Experiencia en análisis funcional o gestión de requerimientos, con capacidad de traducir necesidades de negocio en definiciones de catálogo, pricing y condiciones comerciales.

• Conocimiento o experiencia con Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) o específicamente con el programa Oracle Alloy.

• Se valorará contar con certificaciones Oracle vigentes (por ejemplo, del ecosistema Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) o disposición para obtenerlas como parte del rol.

• Se valorará experiencia trabajando con equipos de desarrollo bajo metodologías ágiles, manejo de herramientas de gestión (Jira o similar) y práctica en la redacción de historias de usuario y criterios de aceptación.

• Se valorará conocimiento de plataformas de comercialización y gestión de productos cloud (CloudBlue Commerce u otras similares), del negocio B2B de la compañía (canales indirectos, resellers, facturación)

• Inglés técnico (excluyente)

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Orientación a Resultados: Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes. Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

• Excelencia: Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad. Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.

• Integridad: que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.

El puesto tiene sede en: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires o Córdoba Capital

postings.title: Senior Database Administrator (SQL Server)
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

We're seeking a Senior Database Administrator to own the health, performance, and reliability of our on-premises Microsoft SQL Server estate, with growing exposure to Azure SQL. This is a hands-on role for a seasoned DBA who is equally comfortable tuning a stubborn query, architecting a high-availability topology, and troubleshooting the Windows Server layer beneath the database. You'll be the senior technical authority on all things SQL Server and a key partner to engineering, infrastructure, and application teams.

Responsibilities

• Database Administration & Operations

• Install, configure, patch, and maintain SQL Server instances across production, staging, and development environments

• Manage database security: logins, roles, permissions, encryption (TDE), and auditing

• Own backup and recovery strategy, including regular restore testing and RTO/RPO validation

• Manage capacity planning, storage growth, and database file/filegroup layout

• Performance & Optimization

• Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks using execution plans, wait statistics, DMVs, Query Store, and Extended Events

• Tune indexes, statistics, and T-SQL; partner with developers to improve query and schema design

• Establish and maintain performance baselines, alerting, and monitoring

• High Availability & Disaster Recovery

• Design, implement, and maintain HA/DR solutions: Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, log shipping, and replication

• Conduct failover testing and maintain documented, tested recovery procedures

• Windows Systems Administration

• Administer the Windows Server layer supporting SQL Server: OS patching, service accounts, disk/storage configuration, and Windows Failover Clustering

• Troubleshoot at the intersection of OS, storage, network, and database

• Manage Active Directory service accounts, group policy considerations, and NTFS/share permissions relevant to SQL Server

• Automation & Maintenance

• Automate routine administration, deployments, and monitoring using PowerShell and T-SQL (e.g., dbatools, SQL Agent jobs, Ola Hallengren's maintenance solution)

• Build and maintain repeatable, documented processes for provisioning and configuration

• Cloud (Azure SQL)

• Administer and support Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance workloads

• Assist with hybrid connectivity and on-prem-to-Azure migration efforts as the estate evolves

Must Have Skills

• 6+ years of hands-on SQL Server database administration in production environments

• Deep expertise in performance tuning, query optimization, and index strategy

• Proven experience designing and operating HA/DR solutions (Always On AGs, clustering, log shipping, replication)

• Strong Windows Server administration skills, including Windows Failover Clustering, storage, and service account management

• Proficiency with T-SQL and PowerShell scripting for automation

• Solid understanding of backup/recovery, security, and disaster recovery best practices

• Experience with SQL Server monitoring and diagnostic tooling (DMVs, Query Store, Extended Events, Profiler/traces)

• Strong troubleshooting instincts and a calm, methodical approach under pressure (including on-call/incident response)

• Documentation discipline and a bias toward automating repetitive work

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance and hybrid cloud environments

• Familiarity with the dbatools PowerShell module and community maintenance solutions

• Experience with SSIS/SSRS/SSAS or related BI components

• Exposure to CI/CD for database changes (e.g., dacpac deployments, source-controlled schema)

• Relevant certifications (Microsoft SQL Server / Azure Database Administrator Associate)

• Experience across multiple SQL Server versions and large or highly transactional estates

Professional Skills

• Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain database concepts to non-DBA stakeholders

• Collaborative partner to developers, infrastructure teams, and application owners

• Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature

• High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results

• Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention

• Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Consultor/a SAP JVA – Especialista, Senior y Semi Senior | Oil & Gas
postings.descriptionText:
Remoto | Full Time | Freelance | Especialista / Senior / Semi Senior | Argentina y LATAM

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group busca un/a Consultor/a SAP JVA (Joint Venture Accounting) (Especialista, Senior o Semi Senior) para sumarse a un servicio AMS de largo plazo sobre SAP S/4HANA en una compañía líder del sector energético / Oil & Gas.

El rol se integra al servicio con foco en la contabilidad de joint ventures: distribución de costos, cash calls y facturación a socios.

EL DESAFÍO

La exploración y producción se opera en asociación con otras compañías: cada costo tiene que distribuirse entre socios con precisión y transparencia.

Vas a integrarte a una célula ágil de consultores funcionales y técnicos que sostiene la operación diaria y los evolutivos sobre SAP S/4HANA.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

• Especialista: liderar funcionalmente el módulo y resolver necesidades complejas del negocio.

• Senior: realizar el diseño funcional y definir la solución.

• Semi Senior: brindar soporte funcional y configurar el módulo.

• Gestionar ventures, equity groups y distribución de costos entre socios.

• Dar soporte a cash calls, facturación a socios (billing) y cierres de JVA.

• Resolver incidentes y evolutivos dentro de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio.

• Acompañar pruebas integrales y de aceptación (UAT) y documentar las soluciones.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES

• Experiencia funcional comprobable en SAP JVA (Joint Venture Accounting).

• Especialista: más de 8 años en el módulo y al menos 6 proyectos, de los cuales al menos 2 como especialista.

• Senior: más de 6 años en el módulo y al menos 4 proyectos, de los cuales al menos 2 como Senior.

• Semi Senior: más de 3 años en el módulo y al menos 2 proyectos.

CONOCIMIENTOS DESEABLES

• Experiencia en SAP S/4HANA y en servicios AMS.

• Integración JVA con PS, PM y MM.

• Experiencia en upstream / exploración y producción.

Company Description

Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

• Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

• Cloud & Application Services: We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.

• Management & Innovation Consulting: We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Front-End Developer with strong expertise in modern Angular to join our team and contribute to the development of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable web applications.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of front-end development experience, with advanced knowledge of Angular 16 or later, TypeScript, reactive programming, and automated testing. You will play an important role in defining technical standards, improving application performance, and ensuring code quality while collaborating closely with technical and functional teams.

This role requires a high level of autonomy, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to share knowledge and support other developers.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable front-end applications using Angular 16+ and TypeScript.

• Build reusable, responsive, and accessible user interfaces following modern web development standards.

• Implement state management solutions using NgRx, including Store, Effects, Selectors, and Signal Store.

• Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and corporate design systems, component libraries, and Web Components.

• Develop and maintain automated tests, ensuring the quality, reliability, and maintainability of the codebase.

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to the definition and implementation of coding standards and best practices.

• Identify technical debt and propose improvements to application architecture, performance, and maintainability.

• Collaborate with technical and functional stakeholders to analyse requirements and deliver effective solutions.

• Document and communicate technical decisions, share knowledge, and provide technical guidance to other developers.

• Participate in a mandatory 24/7 on-call rotation , covering Monday to Sunday on a rotating basis. The expected frequency is approximately one week every 3–4 months, depending on the team's schedule.

Qualifications

• At least 5 years of professional experience in Front-End Development.

• English proficiency at B2 level or above.

• Advanced knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and front-end best practices.

• Strong experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.

• Mandatory hands-on experience with Angular 16 or later , including:

• Standalone components.

• Angular Signals, computed(), and inject().

• RxJS and reactive programming.

• NgRx state management, including Store, Effects, Selectors, and Signal Store.

• Experience integrating and working with design systems, corporate component libraries, and Web Components.

• Experience integrating REST APIs.

• Proficiency with Git and repository management workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and conflict resolution.

• Strong experience with automated testing, including unit, integration, and component testing for services, components, and state management.

• Knowledge and practical application of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and/or Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD).

Nice to Have

• Experience with React and Redux.

• Experience working with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum.

• Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

• Full-time, permanent employment contract.

• 100% remote set-up

• Professional growth and career development opportunities , with access to continuous learning.

• The opportunity to join a multicultural and international environment , collaborating with colleagues and teams across different countries.

• A comprehensive range of benefits designed to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing.

• Smart Office Pack to support your remote working experience.

If you have read this far and you are looking forward to joining this challenge, do not hesitate to apply... we would be delighted to meet you!

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a React Native engineer to join a cross-functional Consumer pod focused on building and scaling core Krak experiences. You'll build alongside Product, Frontend and Backend Engineers in your pod, delivering seamless, performant user experiences across our Krak app, holding the features you ship to a high bar for UX, technical quality, and reliability. It's an opportunity to build high-impact, consumer-facing functionality used daily by a global user base.

The opportunity

• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript, with a strong product focus and outcome-oriented mindset

• Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned Krak features, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration, working closely with product strategy and customer needs

• Build screens and components that are maintainable, performant, and resilient, applying established architecture and design patterns

• Write clean, well-tested code and take an active part in code review, applying the team's engineering standards consistently

• Contribute to technical design discussions within your pod, raising clear proposals and trade-offs for the work you own

• Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and the Rust backend engineers in your pod to deliver features with measurable customer value

• Help improve code quality, shared components, and tooling across the Krak mobile codebase, keeping current with the React Native ecosystem

What You Bring

• 3+ years of software development experience with a proven track record shipping large-scale, product-facing consumer mobile apps using React Native

• Solid working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on experience with APIs, mobile performance, frontend testing, and modern build pipelines

• Strong product engineering mindset. Comfort working closely and iteratively with product and design teams to ship customer value

Nice to haves

We are seeking a talented and motivated Mobile Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Software Engineer focused on our mobile app, you will be responsible for solving challenges in our highest-traffic applications, with your work having a direct impact on our customers and product. Day-to-day, you’ll partner with your team to build out features and products in our React Native-based mobile app. In this role, you’ll also provide support for our mobile app as a platform, working closely with engineers from multiple teams to support larger product releases. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

Compensation:

Sezzle is a U.S. based company listed on NASDAQ. Salary ranges are:

• Mid: $3,000 - $4,500 USD per month

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

• Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
