postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients’ problems, no matter where you are in the world.

THE ROLE

DEPT® is looking for a Business Analyst who owns a workstream independently. A Senior Business Analyst at DEPT leads the translation of complex business needs into actionable product and technology solutions. They'll work across clients, strategists, product managers, designers, engineers, and QA teams, to create alignment from discovery through delivery and ensure that solutions address the intended business and user outcomes, all with minimal oversight. Our business analysts move between clients, industries, and delivery models, balancing client expectations against delivery constraints while working inside multidisciplinary agency teams.

GenAI fluency is core to this role, and you'll be expected to use AI tools daily, including drafting requirements and user stories, summarizing discovery sessions, generating first-pass documentation, all while applying the judgment built through years or rigor to critically review and correct the output, rather than trusting it blindly. Additionally, a good candidate for this role should have a willingness to push the field forward, eager to create new ways of using these tools to build clarity for their teams.

What You'll Own

• Requirements and acceptance criteria for your workstream, start to finish

• Traceability from business goals through requirements, stories, and delivered outcomes

• Stakeholder alignment on scope and expected outcomes

• UAT strategy, including scenarios, readiness criteria, and validation

What You'll Do

• Run Discovery: Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops, turning what you hear into clear, testable requirements and user stories.

• Document Process & Gaps: Map current and future-state processes — flowcharts, personas, use cases, data mappings — and close gaps before they hit delivery.

• Work the Team's Cadence: Follow Agile/Scrum or Kanban practices, adapting to the team's rhythm.

• Resolve Stakeholder Conflict: Build trust-based relationships and resolve conflicting priorities directly, translating between technical and business language.

• Define the Details: Business rules, data requirements, integrations, dependencies, and exception scenarios.

• Mentorship: Guide junior team members on documentation standards and technique.

What You Bring

• Independent Ownership: 2–4 years of BA experience, with a track record of owning a workstream independently rather than assisting under a senior BA.

• Information Gathering & Documentation: Comfort running discovery and producing user stories, acceptance criteria, process diagrams, and functional specs.

• Methodology: Working knowledge of Agile and the Software Development Lifecycle.

• Tools: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Lucidchart, Miro, FigJam, and/or Adobe Workfront.

• Platform Exposure: Familiarity with platforms like the Adobe stack (especially AEM), Salesforce (especially Commerce Cloud), and CMS platforms like Contentful or Optimizely a plus.

• Agency Experience: Comfort moving between clients, industries, and delivery models in multidisciplinary teams, while balancing client expectations against delivery constraints. Ideal candidates will have experience working in Advertising.

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

How You Work

• Clear Communication: Adjust the level of detail for executives, clients, or engineers as needed.

• Facilitation & Curiosity: Run workshops that end in decisions, not just discussion, and ask the question that gets past the stated ask to the real problem.

• Influence & Judgment: Build alignment through evidence and clear tradeoffs, and push back on unclear requirements or shaky solutions, respectfully but directly.

• Ownership & Adaptability: Flag risks early, document decisions, and stay effective when priorities or teams shift under you.

• Coaching: Give junior analysts real, actionable feedback.

What Success Looks Like

• Early Risk Detection: Risks, assumptions, and dependencies surface early.

• Documentation: Decisions and changes are documented clearly.

• UAT: Validates business outcomes, not just feature completion.

• Mentorship: Junior analysts get consistent guidance and feedback.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

postings.title: Senior Product Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Description

At Nybble Group we've spent 20 years building software for companies in the US and Canada. We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join a client team at a global leader in travel and hospitality. You'll work every day with their product and engineering teams.

About the role

You'll run day-to-day product development for the client's air travel products and report to their Product Manager. You'll own the customer-facing air experience: the web platform for searching, booking and managing flights. The first focus is launching seat selection and ancillary products for customers across the client's brands. You'll be the product lead for the engineering team. That means turning the roadmap into clear requirements, managing the backlog and priorities, and making sure every release meets the quality bar. You're the daily link between product strategy and engineering, and you keep delivery on track against roadmap commitments.

Key responsibilities

Product ownership and delivery

• Act as product owner for the engineering team: own the backlog, write and prioritize user stories, and define clear acceptance criteria

• Follow the roadmap set by the Product Manager and make sure priorities are delivered on schedule

• Lead the agile ceremonies: backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews and daily standups

• Make day-to-day scope and priority decisions within the roadmap, and escalate trade-offs to the Product Manager when needed

Requirements and analysis

• Gather, document and validate business and functional requirements from business stakeholders, including seat selection, ancillary products and how they integrate with airline and booking systems

• Turn business needs into detailed user stories, process flows and functional specs the engineering team can build from

• Analyze current processes and systems to find gaps, dependencies and opportunities to improve

Quality and release readiness

• Define acceptance criteria and work with QA so test coverage matches the business requirements

• Run user acceptance testing and story acceptance, and sign off that delivered work meets the definition of done

• Triage production issues and defects, and prioritize fixes against roadmap work

Stakeholder communication

• Be the daily point of contact between the engineering team and the Product Manager

• Report sprint progress, delivery risks and blockers to stakeholders promptly and openly

• Support release planning, launch readiness, and tracking adoption and performance after launch

Required qualifications

• 3+ years as a product analyst, business analyst or product owner on software development teams

• Proven experience as a product owner in an agile/Scrum environment: backlog management, story writing, sprint ceremonies and acceptance

• Strong requirements-gathering and documentation skills, including turning vague business needs into clear, testable user stories

• Experience working directly with engineering and QA teams through the full software development lifecycle

• Working knowledge of agile tools such as Jira and Confluence

• Strong analytical skills, and comfortable using data to set priorities and measure product outcomes

• Advanced English, written and spoken, for daily work with technical and business teams in the US

• Bachelor's degree in business, computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

• Experience in air or flight booking, or in travel and hospitality technology, especially seat selection, ancillary merchandising (bags, upgrades, extras) or airline distribution (GDS/NDC)

• Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), PMI-PBA or a similar certification

• Familiarity with APIs and system integrations, and able to discuss technical constraints with engineers

• Experience in a large enterprise, coordinating across several stakeholder groups

What success looks like

• The engineering team always has a refined, prioritized backlog with clear acceptance criteria at least one sprint ahead

• Roadmap commitments for the air product ship on time, and risks are raised early, not at the deadline

• Released features meet quality expectations, with few defects reaching production and clean UAT sign-offs

• Stakeholders and the Product Manager trust your status reports and rely on you as the day-to-day voice of the product

What we offer

• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

• Opportunities for growth and professional development.

• Comprehensive leave policies, including PTO, sick leave, and study leave.

• Access to employee discount programs.

• Monthly connectivity allowance.

About Us
At Nybble Group, we are dedicated to transforming businesses with the power of technology. For over 20 years, we have helped clients optimize operations and increase productivity through process automation, smart document processing, and advanced data analytics. We believe in fostering a collaborative and innovative culture where every team member can thrive.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Payments Implementation Manager to work on high-impact payments initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing

• Driving end-to-end regional integration and rollout of newly assigned payment networks, schemes, and product rails

• Scoping, producing, and validating technically precise business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure smooth integration

• Acting as a main technical or operational point of contact for external partners, payment scheme operators, and central banks

• Building, tracking, and deep-diving into live performance dashboards using SQL to monitor transaction behaviours

• Taking functional ownership of system health by analysing logs and troubleshooting complex routing or payment failures

• Establishing robust operational controls, tracking performance metrics, and proactively alerting leadership to regulatory or service level gaps

• Building repeatable frameworks, process documentation, and localised standard operating procedures entirely from scratch in ambiguous environments

What You'll Need

• 4+ years of experience in payment operations, integration management, or technical product management

• Knowledge of payment standards, messaging protocols, or card processing workflows

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder integration projects, or full product market launches and migrations

• Solid communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders

• The ability to deep-dive into topics, leveraging expertise and tools

• Autonomy in planning and executing actions, such as constructing processes from scratch and updating them, following service indicators, building reports, etc.

• Fluency in English

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech or banking

• Familiarity with launching banking products

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

• Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.

• Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.

• Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.

• Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.

• Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.

• Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

• Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.

• Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.

• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.

• Coordinate with technical consultants and developers as needed to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

• Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.

• Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.

• Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.

• Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

• Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.

• Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.

• Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.

• Coordinate with software vendors and client stakeholders as needed to resolve issues and implement agreed enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

• Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.

• Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.

• Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.

• Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing with other consultants as appropriate.

• Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

• Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.

• Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.

• Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.

• Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.

• Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

About Us

Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

postings.title: Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary Of Position

The Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist serves as a technical advisor for the implementation, configuration, optimization, and deployment of Teladoc Health patient care devices, software solutions, and integrated technologies across customer healthcare environments. This role is responsible for independently leading complex implementation activities and providing technical expertise throughout the customer onboarding and deployment lifecycle.

As a primary customer-facing technical resource, the Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist partners closely with healthcare administrators, clinical stakeholders, customer IT teams, project managers, logistics teams, and internal cross-functional partners to ensure successful implementation outcomes. The role requires advanced knowledge of networking, hardware, software, workflow integration, and troubleshooting methodologies to resolve technical challenges and drive customer adoption.

This position exercises significant judgment in managing multiple concurrent implementations, identifying and mitigating risks, resolving complex technical issues, and recommending solutions that align with business objectives and customer requirements. The Associate, Technical Product Implementation Specialist also contributes to process improvement initiatives, implementation standards, and knowledge-sharing efforts that support organizational growth and operational excellence.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Implementation Leadership

• Independently lead customer implementation activities from pre-deployment planning through successful go-live and project closure.

• Manage multiple complex implementation projects simultaneously while meeting quality, timeline, and customer satisfaction objectives.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact during implementation activities.

• Partner with Technical Project Managers to execute implementation plans and support overall program delivery goals.

• Coordinate with logistics, support, engineering, product, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful deployments.

Technical Expertise

• Configure, deploy, validate, and optimize Teladoc Health hardware and software solutions.

• Evaluate customer technical environments and provide recommendations related to infrastructure readiness and implementation requirements.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.

• Collaborate with customer IT teams to assess firewall, routing, wireless, VPN, and network configurations.

• Ensure all deployed systems meet operational, clinical, and performance requirements.

• Conduct validation testing and acceptance activities to confirm successful implementation outcomes.

Customer Engagement

• Build and maintain productive relationships with customer technical and operational stakeholders.

• Communicate implementation requirements, project milestones, risks, and technical recommendations to customer leadership and technical teams.

• Deliver customer training and knowledge transfer activities to support successful adoption and ongoing use of Teladoc solutions.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Risk Management and Problem Resolution

• Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and challenges proactively.

• Develop and execute mitigation plans to maintain project objectives and delivery schedules.

• Escalate critical issues appropriately and provide timely resolution recommendations.

• Drive issue ownership through completion while maintaining strong customer communication.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

• Contribute to the development and refinement of implementation standards, playbooks, and best practices.

• Provide feedback to Product, Engineering, and Operations teams regarding system enhancements and customer experience improvements.

• Analyze implementation trends and recurring issues to recommend process and technology improvements.

• Participate in pilot deployments, new product introductions, and implementation readiness activities.

Documentation and Quality

• Maintain accurate and complete implementation records, technical documentation, testing results, training documentation, and deployment acceptance materials.

• Ensure all implementation deliverables support operational, compliance, and revenue recognition requirements.

• Adhere to established quality standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

• Support emergency troubleshooting and repair activities when necessary.

Additional Responsibilities

• Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced implementation team members.

• Share technical knowledge and contribute to team capability development.

• Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Key Areas Supported By This Role Include

• Technical Product Implementations

• Device Deployment and Configuration

• Software Installation and Validation

• Network and Connectivity Optimization

• Product and System Integrations

• Clinical Workflow Enablement

• Customer Technical Readiness

• Implementation Process Improvement

• Technical Escalation Management

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected For Position

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in technical implementation, healthcare technology, network administration, field services, systems deployment, or related technical environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading customer-facing implementation projects.

• Experience supporting enterprise software and hardware deployments.

Technical Knowledge

• Advanced understanding of Windows operating systems and endpoint support.

• Advanced troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and connectivity environments.

• Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, wireless technologies, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall configurations.

• Understanding of healthcare technology environments and clinical workflows.

• Familiarity with remote management and support tools.

• Knowledge of system integration methodologies and implementation best practices.

• Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data security requirements.

Professional Skills

• Strong customer relationship management skills.

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Exceptional organizational and project management skills.

• Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities.

• Ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting virtual care, telehealth, medical device, or healthcare technology platforms.

• Experience working in healthcare systems, hospitals, or integrated delivery networks.

• CCNA certification.

• CompTIA A+ certification.

• CompTIA Network+ certification.

• ITIL Foundation certification.

• Experience supporting enterprise implementations across multiple customer locations.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Why join Teladoc Health?

• Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

• Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

• Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

• Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.

• Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.

• Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

About The Role

• Own end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform.

• Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes.

• Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model.

• Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery.

• Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes.

• Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform.

• Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience.

• Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating.

• Contribute directly to how we deliver: developing/deploying Ai to speed up delivery and enhance the customer experience, refining templates, sprint cadences, and design-phase practices as we continually evolve our methodology.

• Mentor junior delivery team members and, where relevant, partner-side consultants on delivery standards and quality bar.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

• Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff.

• Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers.

• Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them.

• Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus.

• Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components.

• Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

• Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies.

• Excellent at client-facing communication, comfortable presenting to and influencing senior finance stakeholders.

• Formal Project Management Qualifications are a plus, not a requirement.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation including equity package

• Competitive vacation policy

• Medical Insurance

• L&D budget

• Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

• Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

A comienzos de este año, Unilever anunció un acuerdo para combinar su negocio de Foods con McCormick & Company, creando una potencia global de sabores a escala. La combinación propuesta reuniría marcas icónicas de Foods, incluyendo Hellmann’s y Knorr, con el portafolio de McCormick para crear un líder global en especias, condimentos, aderezos y categorías de alimentos complementarias, respaldado por sólidas plataformas de retail y foodservice. McCormick aporta más de 135 años de trayectoria, presencia en más de 150 países y territorios, y un portafolio de marcas de confianza. La transacción sigue sujeta a aprobaciones regulatorias y a otras condiciones habituales de cierre, con finalización estimada para mediados de 2027.

¿QUIÉNES SOMOS?

¿Quieres ser parte de una compañía que hace la diferencia alrededor del mundo? En Unilever, tenemos un propósito claro - Iluminar la vida diaria de las personas a través de sus productos y servicios, así como también promover un estilo de vida sustentable -. A través de nuestras 400 marcas que llegan a 2.5 mil millones de personas todos los días, nuestro objetivo es generar un impacto social positivo a nivel mundial y local.

Liderar la estrategia de transformación digital del site, impulsando la adopción de tecnologías digitales, analítica avanzada, automatización, inteligencia artificial y ciberseguridad industrial para mejorar la eficiencia operativa, la confiabilidad de los procesos, la toma de decisiones basada en datos y la resiliencia de los sistemas de manufactura. postings.title: Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About You
You are an experienced Product Manager who enjoys transforming complex business needs into clear, actionable product solutions. You bring a strong analytical mindset and the ability to look beyond initial requirements, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and anticipate scenarios that could impact product decisions and delivery.

You thrive in environments where business priorities and technical considerations must come together. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, facilitating conversations with diverse stakeholders, and making thoughtful decisions about priorities, scope, and product direction. You bring a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and curiosity, leveraging AI tools to improve how you research, analyze, document, and communicate product requirements.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.

• Senior-level experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles, preferably with 5+ years of relevant experience.

• Proven experience making product-related decisions, managing priorities, evaluating scope, and balancing business needs with delivery considerations.

• Strong experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, including business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.

• Experience managing product roadmaps, prioritizing requirements, and supporting product delivery throughout development and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including facilitating discussions, managing expectations, negotiating scope changes, and aligning business and technical teams.

• Ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguous requirements, anticipate edge cases, and assess the impact of changes on scope, dependencies, and priorities.

• Experience collaborating directly with Developers, QA Engineers, and other technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate solutions against business needs.

• Working knowledge of software development processes, system dependencies, and technical concepts to translate business needs into product requirements. Programming experience is not required.

• Experience creating and maintaining product documentation, including Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and related artifacts.

• Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or Gemini for research, requirements analysis, user story development, and product documentation.

• Experience using product management, ticketing, and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Wiki, or equivalent platforms for requirements tracking and traceability.

• B2+ English proficiency.

Nice to Have

• Experience working in software development companies, software factories, or nearshore environments across multiple clients, products, or industries.

• Experience with revenue forecasting, financial planning, sales forecasting, demand planning, budgeting, or similar business planning solutions.

• Experience in aviation, aeronautics, or Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) environments.

• Familiarity with prioritization frameworks such as MoSCoW or RICE.

• Experience conducting formal product discovery and creating PRDs or BRDs from scratch.

• Familiarity with business process mapping and visualization tools such as Miro, Lucidchart, FigJam, or Microsoft Whiteboard.

• Experience using design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Figma Make, or Claude Design to communicate product concepts and visualize workflows.

• Experience defining or managing AI-enabled product features, including AI augmentation, predictive capabilities, or machine learning applications.

• Experience managing products throughout the full lifecycle, from discovery and development through production and continuous improvement.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflows, requirements, and expected outcomes.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

• Evaluate product requirements and priorities based on business value, stakeholder needs, dependencies, scope, and delivery considerations.

• Proactively identify missing information, ambiguous requirements, conflicting expectations, business rules, and edge cases before development begins.

• Maintain accurate and traceable product documentation, including requirements, meeting notes, approved decisions, and scope changes.

• Facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical teams to clarify expectations, resolve questions, and reach agreement on product requirements.

• Assess change requests, communicate their impact on scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery expectations, and document agreed decisions.

• Collaborate with Developers, QA Engineers, and technical stakeholders to clarify expected behavior, investigate blockers, and ensure solutions align with approved requirements.

• Support product roadmap planning and ongoing prioritization to enable informed decisions about product evolution and delivery.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating business scenarios, reviewing reported defects, clarifying expected behavior, and determining whether issues fall within the agreed scope.

• Leverage AI tools to improve research, analyze information, refine requirements, develop user stories, and enhance product documentation while validating outputs for accuracy and relevance.

• Follow up on open questions, pending decisions, dependencies, and action items to maintain stakeholder alignment and support timely delivery.

Qualifications

• Senior-level Product Management or Product Ownership experience, preferably 5+ years.

• Strong Business Requirements Analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.

• Proven experience with product prioritization, scope management, and stakeholder alignment.

• Experience collaborating with Software Development and QA teams throughout delivery and UAT.

• Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.

• Practical use of AI tools in Product Management workflows.

• B2+ English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

postings.title: Product Management Intern
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support

• Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support

• Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Payment Workflow Analysis

• Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.

Documentation & Process Tracking

• Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Agile Meetings

• Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.

What We Look For:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field

• A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood

• Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out

• Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved

• Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required

• Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps

• Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.

• You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

#Full-time

En Furlong Fox nos encontramos en la búsqueda de una persona con formación y orientación hacia los procesos y la mejora continua, cuyo principal desafío será trabajar de manera transversal y colaborativa con las distintas áreas de Furlong Fox para identificar oportunidades de mejora, impulsar iniciativas de optimización y acompañar su implementación.

El objetivo será contribuir a mejorar la productividad y eficiencia de los equipos, simplificando procesos, optimizando recursos y promoviendo nuevas formas de trabajo que acompañen el crecimiento de la compañía.

Buscamos una persona con potencial de desarrollo, iniciativa y orientación a la acción, que pueda poner en práctica sus conocimientos, desarrollar una mirada integral del negocio y crecer profesionalmente junto a Furlong Fox.

Sus principales tareas serán

• Relevar y analizar los proyectos e iniciativas en curso de las distintas áreas, comprendiendo sus objetivos, necesidades y principales desafíos.

• Centralizar y mantener actualizada la información en un panel de control, contemplando avances, plazos, responsables y riesgos.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y sinergias entre áreas, detectando duplicaciones, cuellos de botella, desvíos y oportunidades de optimización.

• Diseñar e implementar una metodología común de gestión, promoviendo la planificación, colaboración, seguimiento y orientación a resultados.

• Impulsar proyectos de automatización, digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial, incorporando nuevas herramientas que aporten valor y eficiencia.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a o estudiante avanzado/a de Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Sistemas, Organización Industrial o carreras afines.

• Experiencia trabajando con proyectos interdisciplinarios y múltiples áreas.

• Conocimiento de metodologías de Project Management.

• Se valorará experiencia en automatización de procesos, transformación digital y utilización de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.

Beneficios

• Prepaga Swiss Medical para vos.

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida

• Furlong Fox Day día de cumpleaños libre.

• Dos días personales al año.

• Reintegro de gastos por conectividad.

• SportClub 50% de descuento.

• Promociones en productos Unilever, Molinos RP y más.

Furlong-Fox es la unión de dos de las más prestigiosas y sólidas empresas de servicios y gerenciamiento de viajes de la Argentina Furlong World Travel Service fundada en 1954 y Fox Tour fundada en 1985.

En diciembre de 2002, fusionamos nuestras operaciones dando origen a Furlong-Fox y nos convertimos en la agencia corporativa de capitales nacionales más grande del país.

En 2019 nos aliamos con FCM Travel Solutions, una de las cuatro principales compañías mundiales de viajes corporativos, lo que nos permitió valernos de nueva tecnología y poder brindar una atención más personalizada, lo que nos convierte en el socio ideal para aquellas empresas que piensan estratégicamente a la hora de hacer viajar a sus colaboradores.

Nuestra pasión es hacer que las cosas sucedan. Tenemos un equipo motivado por prestar un servicio de excelencia para que nuestros clientes tengan los mejores resultados.

Nos apoyamos en nuestro conocimiento, tecnología y experiencia para brindarte calidad, flexibilidad y atención personalizada a la hora de viajar y organizar tus eventos. Porque haciendo que las cosas sucedan cumplimos nosotros también nuestros sueños y metas.

Éste es nuestro propósito que juntos podamos llegar más lejos.

postings.title: Platform Product Owner
postings.descriptionText:
About The Company

At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder.

Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Platform Product Owner to help shape and deliver OneClick Code’s customer-facing SaaS platform, data products, reports, APIs, and partner integrations

This role will own product definition through release and adoption. You will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Data, Sales & Customer Success to translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure whether released solutions create the intended value.

This is not a project coordinator or requirements-taking role. We are looking for someone who can develop a strong understanding of our customers and industry, bring structure to ambiguous problems, make informed recommendations, and take accountability for product outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines the execution discipline of a Product Owner with the customer and commercial mindset of a Product Manager. Your primary focus will be to own the backlog and execute an established roadmap, while understanding the “why” behind each initiative, challenging assumptions, and recommending improvements based on customer needs, business value, and product data. You will work closely with Product leadership to inform priorities and measure outcomes beyond delivery.

What You’ll Do

• Partner with stakeholders to identify user problems, workflow gaps, business opportunities, and product risks

• Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable requirements and acceptance criteria, resolving open questions with stakeholders before development begins.

• Work closely with Product Design to create, evaluate, and refine workflows, prototypes, and user experiences.

• Analyze market trends, user behavior, and product performance to generate actionable insights and inform product roadmap..

• Help validate product assumptions before significant development investment is made.

• Track KPIs and product metrics, ensuring alignment with company objectives.

• Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog aligned with company objectives, customer value, revenue opportunities, and technical dependencies.

• Make day-to-day scope and priority decisions while escalating material tradeoffs when appropriate

• Review completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes.

• Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to recommend iteration, expansion, repositioning, or discontinuation.

• Maintain clear product documentation and communicate progress, decisions, risks, and results to stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

• A prioritized backlog with clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and visible dependencies.

• Day-to-day ownership of assigned initiatives, with significant decisions escalated alongside clear recommendations.

• Released improvements evaluated through customer feedback and agreed product metrics to inform next steps.

Qualifications

• 3–5 years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, or a closely related role supporting software products.

• At least 1–2 years of direct ownership for a SaaS or digital product backlog, feature area, or product initiative with demonstrated ability to prioritize based on customer needs and business value, make scope tradeoffs, and evaluate results after launch.

• Experience partnering directly with software engineers and product designers in an Agile development environment.

• Strong analytical skills with experience in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc.) ; ability to interpret performance metrics and translate into recommendations.

• Experience using product and delivery tools such as Asana, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, HotJar or comparable platforms

• Strong communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience working with APIs, third-party integrations, data products, or enterprise SaaS platforms.

• Experience supporting product launches, beta programs, or customer validation efforts.

This is a remote position open to qualified candidates located in the United States select international markets. Candidates located outside the US must be able to work with substantial overlap during standard U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

Compensation: USD $3,500–$4,100 per month, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

Benefits

• 15 days of paid time off in your first year, increasing to 20 days in your second year, covering vacation, personal time, and sick leave.

• Paid company-observed U.S. holidays.

• Reimbursement of up to USD $125 per month toward your own medical coverage.

Location: Remote — Latin America. Candidates must be available to work with substantial overlap during standard U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Compensation: CAD $48,000–$60,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

About Revun

Revun is a SaaS, CRM, AI, and property operations platform that brings together leasing, maintenance, payments, owner/vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, portals, dashboards, integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system.

Revun is a complex operational platform requiring strong product judgment, workflow design, technical understanding, and the ability to translate real business operations into clear software requirements.

About The Role

Revun is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager to own product requirements, roadmap priorities, workflow design, UX alignment, and product delivery.

You will work directly with leadership to determine what should be built, why it should be built, how it should work, and what should be prioritized.

You will work closely with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead, who owns technical architecture and engineering execution, while providing product direction to UX/UI, engineering, and QA.

This is not a backlog administration role. We are looking for someone who can challenge unclear ideas, simplify complex workflows, make strong product decisions, and turn business requirements into clear development execution.

What You Will Do

• Own the product roadmap, backlog, feature priorities, and product-side launch readiness.

• Translate business needs into clear requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets.

• Determine what should be built now, delayed, simplified, or removed.

• Map complex workflows across CRM, leasing, maintenance, payments, reporting, AI, integrations, and portals.

• Define product requirements across multiple user roles, permissions, dashboards, and workflows.

• Provide product direction to UX/UI and ensure designs reflect user needs, business rules, workflows, and edge cases.

• Work with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead on technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, estimates, and trade-offs.

• Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/automation, integration, QA, and DevOps resources throughout development.

• Define requirements for AI-powered features and determinewhere AI, automation, or human review should be used.

• Work with QA on test scenarios, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and user acceptance testing.

• Review completed functionality and determine whether it meets the original product and business requirements.

• Identify product gaps, workflow conflicts, unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, dependencies, and launch blockers.

• Conduct product discovery and use stakeholder feedback, user needs, workflow analysis, and product data to guide decisions.

• Define measurable success criteria for major features and evaluate performance after release.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. A technical degree is strongly preferred.

• 7+ years of product management, technical product management, or comparable product ownership experience.

• 4+ years working on complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech, PropTech, field-service, or multi-user operational platforms.

• Strong experience creating product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and development-ready specifications.

• Experience taking complex features from initial business requirements through UX/UI, development, QA, release, and post-release evaluation.

• Strong working knowledge of APIs, integrations, databases, permissions, system dependencies, AI functionality, and modern SaaS platforms.

• Experience working closely with senior engineers, software architects, QA, and Product/UX/UI Designers.

• Experience with product discovery, user research, backlog management, prioritization, UAT, release planning, and launch readiness.

• Ability to challenge unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, unrealistic timelines, and weak product decisions.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience with PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, fintech, field service, compliance, marketplace, or operational SaaS platforms.

• Experience with AI/LLM workflows, AI automation, document processing, communications, task routing, reporting, or decision support.

• Experience with payments, payouts, reconciliation, accounting, ledger, or other financially sensitive workflows.

• Experience inheriting an existing SaaS platform and identifying product gaps, workflow problems, UX issues, and launch blockers.

• Experience preparing a complex SaaS product for commercial launch.

• Experience working with remote or offshore engineering teams.

• Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.

Ideal Candidate

You are not simply someone who manages tickets or maintains a backlog.

You Should Be Able To Determine

• What problem are we actually solving?

• Is this the right solution?

• Does the workflow make sense?

• What happens in the edge cases?

• Is this important enough to build now?

• Can it be simplified?

• How will we know whether it worked?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and turning incomplete business ideas into clear product decisions that designers, architects, developers, and QA can execute.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will understand the existing platform, clarify major workflows, improve product requirements and backlog quality, align UX and engineering priorities, identify launch-critical gaps, and establish a clear path toward commercial launch.

Leadership should have clear visibility into what is being built, why it is being built, what is blocking progress, and what should happen next.

Schedule

Full-time, Monday to Friday, remote.

Availability during core Eastern Time business hours is required.

How To Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

postings.title: TechOps SAP FI Senior Consultant - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

As an SAP FI Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in transforming financial operations through the implementation and optimization of SAP FI solutions. Your primary responsibilities will include managing revenue accounting processes, ensuring compliance with IFRS standards and providing expert guidance on revenue and cost-related matters. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze business requirements and deliver tailored solutions that enhance financial reporting accuracy.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

• Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.

• 3+ Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FI preferably with Global client

• Specialization in configuring and implementing SAP FI (S/4HANA)

• Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles

• Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi-platform environment

• Extensive in client management working with various regions in a global setting

• Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams

• Strong leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve excellence

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization

• Strong client management, analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions

• Responsible for providing support SAP FI module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.

• Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.

• Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed-up and addressed timely.

• Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.

• Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.

• Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite model.

• Defect resolution and defect analysis related to FI.

• Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.

• Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

Ideally, you’ll also have:

• Integration knowledge with SAP SD, CO, and SAP BRIM

• Strong knowledge of CO integration points with other SAP modules like MM, SD, HR, PP and PM.

• SAP Certification in SAP FI

What you will do:

• Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management and problem management as Level 2 or 3 Application Management Specialist

• Lead and mentor the entire CO team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement

• Lead and Coordinate the Resolution of Complex Technical issues and System Outages including root cause analysis and corrective action.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, assess business needs and provide advice on SAP FI solutions and designs.

• Develop and maintain documentation including configuration, user guides and test scripts.

• Mentor and train junior SAP FI Team Members, sharing best practices and providing guidance on issues and troubleshooting techniques.

• Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation

• Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.

• Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)

What We Look For

• A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

• An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

• Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What working at EY offers:

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now!

At Accenture, we believe your career is about what you want to be and who you want to be. It’s about bringing your skills, your curiosity, and your best true self to your work. You are accountable for evolving relationship management tools, workflows, and methodologies, ensuring they are intuitive, integrated, and aligned with the needs of our practitioners. • Serve as the primary link between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business requirements into scalable solutions.

• Drive the adoption, optimization, and evolution of relationship management tools, including Salesforce and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

• Develop business cases, success measures, and adoption strategies for new capabilities and enhancements.

• Lead or support the launch and integration of new capabilities across Relationship Management and Sales Excellence.

• Partner with internal and external technology providers to explore, design, and implement innovative solutions.

• Excellent project management skills, ability to work independently, propose solutions to problems, and implement feedback

• Passion for new technology, tools and innovation to evolve ways of working

• Strong experience in Salesforce, Microsoft Office (xls specifically), and other relationship centric tools

• An open mind to learn, collaborate, jump into projects, and train others for wide-scale adoption

• Experience of working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders

• Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience

Extra credit if you have:

• Sales enablement-related background

You may also need:

• Ability to adjust working hours as needed to collaborate effectively within a global organization while maintaining balance.

• Must have good internet connectivity and a distraction-free environment for working at home, in accordance with local guidelines.

EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas. Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad. 

Acerca del área

Desde Business Transformation para la industria financiera buscamos ayudar a nuestros clientes de Banking, FinTech, Payments e Insurance a transformar sus negocios en una era dinámica y disruptiva. Colaboramos en estos procesos aportando una visión integral que combina negocio, personas y tecnología.

Nuestras propuestas incluyen planes estratégicos, reinvención de modelos de negocio, transformación de modelos operativos, efectividad comercial, eficiencia operacional y diseño e implementación de programas de transformación integral. Dentro de esta agenda, buscamos fortalecer y desarrollar la práctica de Finance Transformation, integrando conocimiento contable, FP&A y FinOps (Operaciones y Finance), procesos y tecnología.

Responsabilidades

 

Este es un rol de liderazgo. Serás parte de un equipo talentoso que trabajará para llevar lo mejor de EY a nuestros clientes, construyendo soluciones a partir de sus necesidades y conformando equipos diversos para resolver desafíos complejos.

• Liderar el gerenciamiento y la ejecución de proyectos de planificación estratégica, transformación y rediseño de Modelos de Finance, con una visión integral de estrategia, procesos, personas y tecnología.

• Diseñar y transformar modelos operativos de Finanzas, Accounting y operaciones, promoviendo la automatización, estandarización, eficiencia, escalabilidad y calidad de los procesos.

• Identificar e implementar oportunidades de eficientización y automatización de procesos financieros y contables, incluyendo cierres, conciliaciones, liquidaciones, controles y operaciones de back office.

• Gestionar, coordinar y desarrollar equipos de trabajo de mediana y gran escala, promoviendo autonomía, colaboración y orientación a resultados.

• Generar propuestas de valor para los clientes y transformarlas en proyectos concretos, contribuyendo activamente al desarrollo y consolidación de la práctica de Finance Transformation.

• Actuar como referente ante stakeholders clave y equipos multidisciplinarios, articulando necesidades de negocio, requerimientos contables y soluciones tecnológicas.

Requisitos

• Formación universitaria en Contabilidad, Administración de Empresas, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines. Maestría o posgrado será considerado un plus.

• Experiencia de 5 años liderando proyectos vinculados con contabilidad, operaciones financieras, transformación financiera, optimización de procesos o consultoría de gestión.

• Sólida experiencia en procesos contables end-to-end, incluyendo cierres contables complejos, conciliaciones de alto volumen, análisis de cuentas y variaciones, controles internos y cumplimiento.

• Experiencia comprobable en la eficientización, estandarización y automatización de procesos de Finanzas, con capacidad para diseñar e implementar iniciativas de Finance Transformation.

• Experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos de trabajo. Se valorará la gestión de estructuras numerosas en roles de Manager, Team Lead o equivalentes.

• Conocimiento y experiencia en sistemas contables, ERPs, plataformas financieras y herramientas tecnológicas o de automatización aplicadas a la función de Finanzas.

• Experiencia en la industria de servicios financieros, especialmente en Banking, FinTech o Payments.

• Conocimiento de adquirencia y emisión de medios de pago, chargebacks y contracargos, liquidaciones bancarias, esquemas de fees e interchange, retenciones e impuestos transaccionales, y conciliación entre sistemas operativos y contables.
