postings.descriptionText:
In Accenture, within the Strategy & Consulting – Global Network area, we work with leading organizations across Communications, Media & Technology (CMT)—with a core focus on our High Tech industry practice—to design and implement strategies that drive transformation, innovation, and sustainable growth. As part of our team, you will collaborate on projects that combine business strategy, data, technology, and execution, helping global technology leaders tackle their most complex challenges.

🏢 ¡Work with purpose. Make your vision come true!

Transform leading High Tech organizations by solving complex business challenges and enabling new ways of working, operating, and growing through technology, data, and innovation.

• Work at the heart of global High Tech organizations, collaborating on high-impact projects across strategy, transformation, operations, and technology.

• Make change happen by integrating skills and experience in strategy, consulting, digital, data, AI, technology, and operations to help technology clients reinvent themselves.

HOW WILL YOUR EVERYDAY BE? 💥

Collaborate with global High Tech clients (enterprise technology, hardware, software, semiconductors, and platforms) to design and execute business and transformation solutions across areas such as Marketing, Go-To-Market (GTM), Sales Operations, and business operations.

Analyze business performance, sales pipelines, operational flows, and management information to identify opportunities for improvement and support data-driven decision making.

Design, map, and improve business processes, translating business needs into structured solutions, actionable roadmaps, and execution plans.

Lead or support project management and PMO activities, coordinating workstreams, timelines, deliverables, risks, and multiple stakeholders across local and global teams.

Leverage data analytics, business intelligence, visualization, and AI capabilities to generate insights and enable more effective business outcomes.

Work alongside multidisciplinary teams and client stakeholders to support transformation initiatives, including workflow redesign, automation, and the adoption of Gen AI and emerging technologies.

We are looking for people who are eager to learn, have a growth mindset, and love working in a dynamic environment with an amazing culture.

• 🔌 Connectivity and electricity reimbursement

• 🏋️‍♂️ VIP Gym Pass – 100% covered

• 🌴 Flexible holidays

• ⏰ Flexible work shifts

• 🎓 Bonus for higher education certifications

• 🎉 Day off on your birthday

• 💰 Performance bonuses

• 👶 Extended maternity & paternity leave

• 🧸 Daycare reimbursement

• ➕ And many more!

🏢 We have offices available in CABA, Córdoba, Mar del Plata, Rosario, Salta, and Mendoza! And if you’re located in other provinces, our positions are remote, so you can work from home! 🌎

📍 IF YOUR PROFILE MATCHES THESE REQUIREMENTS:

• Education: Completed Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Business, Industrial Engineering, Systems, or a related field.

• Industry Experience: 4–8 years of professional work experience, including at least 2 years in High Tech or other CMT companies.

• Languages & Tools: Advanced English (spoken and written) is mandatory to interact effectively with global clients and teams, along with advanced Excel skills.

• Project Governance: Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience in Project Management / PMO.

• Financial Acumen: Solid understanding of basic financial statements (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Statement of Cash Flows), accounting concepts, and financial ratios.

• Analytics & BI: Advanced knowledge in Data Analytics, Reporting, and Business Intelligence, including advanced knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI or Tableau; practical work experience is highly desirable).

• Data & AI: Knowledge of Data & AI concepts, including Gen AI and Agentic AI, is mandatory.

DESIRABLE:

• Postgraduate studies in Digital Business, Data Science, Digital Transformation, AI, or Gen AI, or an MBA.

• Experience in Management Consulting and tech-transformation programs.

• Functional experience in Marketing, Go-To-Market (GTM), or Sales Operations (e.g., Sales Pipeline Analysis, Operations, and ADM Staff Management).

• Experience in Process Design, Mapping, and continuous improvement.

• Experience working in or alongside multidisciplinary teams embedded in client environments to deliver end-to-end workflow transformation, including OpenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) environments.

• Familiarity with MLOps / LLMOps (model deployment, monitoring, and AI lifecycle management).

• Knowledge of Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks.

• Understanding of international regulatory frameworks and compliance standards (IFRS, US GAAP, SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, NIST).

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Jira, Jira Align).

• Experience in Change Management and Value Realization Office (VRO).

📍 KEY COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:

• Proven ability to analyze complex business challenges in tech environments and formulate structured, data-driven solutions

• Strong project management and PMO capabilities, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, deliverables, and stakeholders

• Ability to translate business needs and strategic objectives into concrete process improvements, roadmaps, and execution plans

• Strong analytical mindset with advanced knowledge of business intelligence, reporting, and data visualization

• Solid understanding of financial metrics and business performance indicators

• Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills in English

• Strong collaborative spirit and ability to work effectively with distributed, global delivery teams

• Growth mindset and adaptability to new technologies, data-driven ways of working, and emerging AI capabilities

AT ACCENTURE, EQUALITY DRIVES INNOVATION

Did you know that Accenture was chosen as the most diverse and inclusive company in the world? We believe that the workforce of the future is an equal workforce for everyone.

All decisions related to the recruitment and selection process will be made without any distinction, exclusion, or preference based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, political or union opinion, nationality, socioeconomic background, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, that could result in the nullification or impairment of equal opportunity or treatment among candidates.

• Gestionar cronogramas, riesgos, issues, dependencias, avances y entregables.

• Preparar reportes ejecutivos y brindar visibilidad sobre avances y desvíos.

Requisitos

• Experiencia comprobable como Project Manager SAP Sr.

• Experiencia gestionando implementaciones, rollouts, migraciones, upgrades o proyectos SAP end-to-end.

• Manejo de metodologías como SAP Activate, Agile, Waterfall o modelos híbridos.

• Experiencia gestionando múltiples stakeholders y prioridades.

• Experiencia en seguimiento de riesgos, entregables, presupuesto, forecast y control económico de proyectos.

• Manejo de herramientas como Jira, SAP Cloud ALM, MS Project, ServiceNow o similares.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, organización y gestión ejecutiva.

Se valorará

• Experiencia en proyectos SAP bajo modalidad T&M y/o llave en mano.

• Jornada: Full-time.

Buscamos perfiles Senior con fuerte capacidad de gestión, organización y comunicación ejecutiva, que puedan coordinar múltiples frentes, anticipar y destrabar situaciones, alinear interlocutores y brindar visibilidad clara del proyecto en contextos SAP de alta complejidad.

Si contás con experiencia como Project Manager SAP y te interesa participar en iniciativas estratégicas sobre S/4HANA, esperamos tu postulación.

Para postularte, envianos tu CV actualizado a través de este mismo medio, indicando tu pretensión de remuneración bruta mensual en AR$.

postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Banking Platform
postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $8,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.

You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.

Ideally you’ve built something like this before. If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.

What You'll Do:

• Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.

• Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.

• Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.

• Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.

• Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.

• Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.

• Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.

• Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.

• Use data to prove it works. Write your own SQL. Define platform KPIs — posting latency, reconciliation break rate, settlement accuracy, failure rates — and monitor them relentlessly.

• Manage risk early. Anticipate technical risks, edge cases, race conditions, and dependencies before they become incidents. Money movement defects are the expensive kind.

• Operate with urgency. Deliver against an evolving regulatory and business timeline with incomplete information.

What We Look For:

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical discipline (required).

• 5–10 years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on financial infrastructure rather than only customer-facing surfaces.

• Real ownership in at least one of the following. You do not need all of them, and we care much more about depth in one than exposure to several:

• Ledgers, general ledger, or balance and transaction systems

• Payments processing, orchestration, or money movement — ACH, card networks, transfers, settlement, or the LATAM equivalents (PIX, SPEI, PSE, CCE)

• Card issuing or card program management

• Deposit, wallet, or account platforms

• Lending origination or loan servicing platforms

• Product work at a processor, BaaS provider, or core banking vendor

• Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts as they show up in software — debits and credits, sub-ledgers, accruals, reconciliation — or a genuine appetite to get comfortable with them quickly.

• Deep technical understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, idempotency, distributed system failure modes, batch vs. real-time processing, and data flows.

• Strong SQL skills and comfort querying and interpreting data independently.

• Experience working directly with Compliance, Legal, Finance, or Treasury as stakeholders — not only Engineering and Design.

• Comfortable working in ambiguity and making sound, documented decisions with incomplete information.

• Strong written and verbal communication — can hold your own in an engineering standup, a Finance review, and an executive discussion.

• Hands-on familiarity with AI tools, data models, or generative AI applications—personally, professionally, or better yet, both!

Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience with a core banking platform, in-house or vendor (Thought Machine, Mambu, 10x, Finxact, Temenos, Technisys, Galileo, Pismo, or similar).

• Experience with a core migration, conversion, or major ledger replacement.

• Experience at a chartered or licensed financial institution, or supporting a charter, banking licence, or deposit insurance application.

• Familiarity with consumer finance regulation — US (Reg E, Reg DD, Reg CC, Reg Z, TILA, FCRA, BSA/AML) or equivalent local regimes.

• Background in consumer credit or BNPL, card products, or bank-fintech sponsorship programs.

• Experience with third-party risk management and vendor oversight in a regulated environment.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world.

Job Description

Innovid is looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented, and technical Salesforce Administrator to join our global Revenue Operations team in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role sits within Innovid’s Revenue Operations (RevOps) organization—a cross-functional team structured across specialized pillars: Enablement, Systems, Commissions, Insights, AI, and Operations.

As a key technical anchor of the System and Operations pillars, the Senior Revenue Operations Salesforce Manager will partner closely with RevOps Leadership to own the day-to-day administration, configuration, integration, and optimization of our Salesforce (SFDC) ecosystem. This role may cover the end-to-end commercial lifecycle—executing pre-sales and post-sales system updates, automating workflows, maintaining clean data architecture, and embedding modern Salesforce AI capabilities into daily commercial operations.

This is a high-impact position for a seasoned SFDC expert who combines deep platform configuration skills with a strong understanding of revenue workflows across Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and Operations.

The Impact You'll Make:

Salesforce Administration, Automation & Core Configuration

• Own end-to-end administration and ongoing configuration of Innovid's Salesforce instance, supporting both pre-sales revenue motions (lead management, opportunity lifecycle, CPQ, pipeline tracking) and post-sales processes (client onboarding, account hygiene, renewal management, expansion workflows).

• Build and maintain custom objects, fields, validation rules, page layouts, and Flows, including complex multi-step automation that spans several objects or systems.

• Execute regular maintenance releases, system updates, and platform enhancements, ensuring high system uptime, performance optimization, and seamless user experience across pre- and post-sale tools.

• Serve as the primary technical point of escalation for complex bug resolution, system troubleshooting, and tier-2/tier-3 operational support.

System Integrations & Tech Stack Architecture

• Manage, maintain, and optimize third-party integrations across the sales funnel (e.g., Marketo, Planhat, Chorus, ERP/Billing systems, sales engagement tools) via APIs, native connectors, and middleware.

• Maintain strict data architecture standards, user access controls (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules), and data hygiene to ensure audit-ready reporting and analytics.

Commercial AI & Salesforce Agentforce Deployment

• Support the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Salesforce AI features (including Agentforce, Salesforce Einstein, Prompt Builder, Einstein Copilot/AI Agents, and predictive/generative AI tools) to drive commercial productivity.

• Partner with the RevOps AI and Insights pillars to integrate predictive scoring, automated activity logging, and AI-driven recommendations into pre-sales lead prioritization and post-sales renewal/health monitoring workflows.

• Continuously evaluate emerging SFDC features and tools, bringing forward proactive solutions that streamline sales workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Cross-Functional Execution & Governance

• Translate business requirements from Sales, Client Success, Enablement, and Commissions leaders into clear technical specifications and scalable system builds.

• Oversee sandbox deployment pipelines, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and comprehensive technical documentation.

• Partner with Enablement to ensure smooth change management and user adoption for new system rollouts.

What You Will Bring:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce Administration, configuration, and architecture within a B2B SaaS, AdTech, or high-growth tech environment.

• Full Revenue Lifecycle Expertise: Deep operational understanding of both pre-sale (Lead-to-Opportunity, CPQ, Pipeline) and post-sale (Renewals, CS health, Expansion) operations.

• Integration Expertise: Proven track record connecting SFDC with third-party sales tools, marketing automation platforms, CS tools, and billing engines via APIs or middleware.

• Advanced Flow & Automation Skills: Mastery of complex Salesforce Flows, data modeling, validation logic, and sandbox deployment management (DevOps Center, Copado, or Change Sets).

• Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator and/or Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator required; Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I or CRM Analytics/Einstein Specialist certifications strongly preferred.

• Location & Language: Based in or near Buenos Aires, Argentina (hybrid working model) with advanced/fluent English communication skills (both written and verbal) for daily collaboration with global teams across North America and EMEA.

• Problem-Solving & Communication: Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills—able to bridge technical build details with commercial business outcomes.

Nice To Have:

• SFDC Development Skills: Experience writing or maintaining Apex classes/triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL, and custom API integrations.

• Hands-on AI Experience in Salesforce: Direct, practical experience implementing or administering SFDC AI solutions (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, or predictive/generative AI workflows).

What We'll Offer:

Additional Information

There is no such thing as the perfect resume, or someone that checks every box. At Innovid, we are generous with our time and knowledge, and always ready to teach. postings.title: Product Manager, Orchestration Platform
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

About The Role

We've built an orchestration platform that runs our remittance transaction flow end to end. It handles the long-running, stateful, failure-prone work between "customer pressed send" and "money arrived": routing, compliance checks, partner calls, payouts, reconciliation, retries and compensation when a step fails.

Remittance is the first product on the platform. Our intent is for future products to launch on this layer rather than rebuild transaction orchestration. This is the senior product role for that piece of core company infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Platform strategy: Define what the orchestration platform is and isn't: its boundaries, guarantees, and non-goals. Decide which capabilities are platform primitives and which belong in consuming products, and hold that line under pressure.

• The path to multiple products: Own the sequencing and core changes needed before a second product can onboard, and the migration approach for remittance as the platform evolves underneath it.

• The product surface: Define the contracts teams build against — workflow interfaces, idempotency, retry and compensation semantics, timeouts, state visibility, SLAs — and the docs, onboarding and observability tooling that make the platform self-serve and operable.

• Roadmap and delivery: Run the platform engineering team's roadmap, balancing remittance reliability against platform investment, and own the platform's success metrics (workflow success rates, time-to-completion, manual intervention rate, time to resolve stuck workflows, time-to-integrate).

• Stakeholders and architecture: Represent the platform to operations, compliance and finance; partner with the engineering lead on architecture decisions with product consequences.

Requirements

• 5+ years in product management with at least 3 years owning a platform, infrastructure, API, or backend product whose primary customers were other engineering teams. You have shipped something other teams built on, lived with the consequences of its abstractions, and can talk concretely about what you got wrong.

• Strong grounding in distributed-systems concepts: asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, idempotency, compensation versus rollback, and the failure modes of long-running workflows. You can hold a design conversation with senior engineers as a peer.

• Payments, remittance, banking, ledger or transaction-processing experience. You understand settlement, reconciliation, payout partners and compliance screening well enough to know where the domain-specific logic ends.

• Exceptional written communication. Your specs and contracts will be the reference others depend on.

• Direct comfort with data: querying, reading dashboards, investigating anomalies without an intermediary.

• A track record of saying No to powerful internal stakeholders and being right often enough that they kept coming back.

postings.title: Product Specialist, Cattle - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

We're looking for a Product Specialist to be Halter's boots on the ground as we launch Halter in South America. This is a pioneer role. You'll be working directly with our earliest producers as we deploy Halter onto their farms, learning what it takes to make the product work brilliantly in this environment, and feeding those insights back to the rest of the company so we can build and iterate accordingly.

You'll work closely with Halter's HQ in New Zealand and our commercial teams in South America to make sure the product delivers undeniable value from day one and that we're building the right things for South American producers.

Halter is one of the world's fastest-growing agritech companies, and the most transformative technology available in pasture-based grazing. With Halter's cattle collars and app, producers can virtually fence and shift their cattle, and proactively monitor cattle locations and behaviour.

We're looking for big thinkers who know how to get stuff done — people who are natural problem-solvers and are comfortable in a dynamic, high-energy environment where they'll be challenged daily. Our ideal person is someone deeply committed to understanding our product and our customers' needs. Above all, you'll care about the cattle and the producers who work with them, and you'll champion their interests across Halter.

National and International travel will be required in this role.

About The Role

What your day could look like:

• Getting out onto farms to help deploy Halter with our first customers — this is hands-on work, not desk work.

• Building close relationships with our pioneering producers, deeply understanding how they operate, and learning what the product needs to do to deliver real value in this context.

• Feeding those learnings back clearly and rigorously to our product and engineering teams in New Zealand, so we're always building what matters most.

• Helping us understand the nuances of South American cattle production. The animals, the land, the practices and sharing that context throughout the company.

• Thinking critically about the product end-to-end and identifying what we need to fix, improve, or build next.

• Working with our first customers to make sure they're getting the most out of Halter and seeing real results.

• Partnering across the commercial team to maintain strong alignment as we scale.

• Whatever else it takes to make Halter succeed in South America.

What we're looking for:

• Experience working in South American cattle production. This is a must-have.

• Passionate about animals and the future of agriculture in the region.

• Tech-savvy and genuinely curious about how our product works under the hood.

• A strong communicator who can translate what they're seeing in the field into clear, actionable feedback for a remote product and engineering team.

• Proven ability to think critically about a problem and reach strong, innovative conclusions

• Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage market entry and things will be imperfect; you'll thrive on that rather than be frustrated by it.

• Fast learner with the drive to work hard alongside a team doing things that have never been done before.

• A get-stuff-done attitude with the resilience to push through challenges.

• Willing to travel and work flexibly, including weekends when needed.

• Spanish fluency required.

• English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: RevOps Analyst & Salesforce Admin
postings.descriptionText:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

Role summary

Abacum is a Series B FP&A platform that helps finance teams plan, report and forecast. Our Strategy & Operations team is the engine behind the company: we run the systems, data and processes that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners and Leadership depend on every day.

As our Salesforce Administrator, you'll own the platform the whole go-to-market organization runs on. You'll report to our Revenue Operations Lead, work directly with GTM leaders, and turn a steady stream of requests into clean, scalable systems.

Why this role

• Impact from day one. You'll be our first in-house Salesforce admin and own real problems from your first week, with full accountability for how things get built and how they turn out.

• A role that grows. We're automating routine admin with AI (e.g. Claude connected to Salesforce, flagging records that need cleanup every morning). As that matures, your scope expands into new workflows and systems such as lead routing and data enrichment.

• Shape a global organization. Join a fast-moving team that operates worldwide. Processes exist, so you won't start from zero, but you'll have the mandate to challenge and reshape them.

• Visible, company-wide work. Every team that touches a customer relies on what you build, and you'll partner directly with S&O and GTM leadership.

What success looks like: reps get fast, reliable answers; Salesforce stays clean and well-documented; and most changes ship in-house, safely, without a consultant.

What you'll do

Your first priority is to master Salesforce and become the go-to owner of the platform. As automation takes over routine admin, your time shifts from fixing to building.

Run the front door (~50% of time at start, falling as you automate)

• Own the Salesforce support queue: triage, resolve and close requests from Sales, Marketing, Partners and CS.

• Handle data hygiene and governance across our GTM systems, including record cleanup, field standards, and regular audits, to keep pipeline, ownership, and attribution data accurate and reliable for reporting.

• Manage users, profiles, permission sets, licenses and access across Salesforce and connected GTM tools (Gong, Sales Navigator, Apollo, Nooks, Default).

• Maintain picklists, fields, page layouts and reports.

Build and maintain the platform (~35%)

• Build and maintain Flows (screen and record-triggered), validation rules, and approval logic.

• Own the permission model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, role hierarchy.

• Monitor flow errors, API usage and integration health (HubSpot, Default, Gong, Clay, Vitally, Introw); fix or escalate.

• Run deployments through a sandbox with documented change control.

Make it self-serving (~15%)

• Document every flow, rule and integration so nothing lives in one person's head.

• Reduce request volume at the source: self-serve options, better defaults, smarter guardrails.

• Use AI tools (e.g. Claude with Salesforce access) to automate hygiene checks and repetitive admin work.

• Scope larger projects and manage external Salesforce developers when work goes beyond in-house capacity.

Requirements

Must have

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration in a B2B SaaS or high-volume sales environment.

• Has been the sole or primary admin of an org (roughly 50 to 300 users), not one of many admins at a large enterprise.

• Salesforce Certified Administrator, or willing to get certified within your first 6 months.

• Builds in Flow Builder: has shipped and maintained record-triggered and screen flows in production, and can walk through one end to end.

• Confident managing profiles, permission sets and role hierarchy, and troubleshooting access issues.

• Builds reports and dashboards independently.

• Understands the B2B SaaS funnel: leads, opportunity stages, ARR, renewals.

• AI literacy: uses AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) in day-to-day work and looks for ways to automate repetitive tasks with them.

• Fluent English. Spanish a plus.

• Builder mindset: you fix root causes, not just tickets. When the same issue shows up twice, you fix the system that creates it, and you have the backbone to push back, ask why, and route requests properly.

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, especially the HubSpot and Salesforce sync.

• Platform App Builder or Advanced Administrator certification.

• Experience with other GTM tools: Gong, Apollo, Default, Clay, Sales Navigator.

• Exposure to forecast categories, attribution and lead routing.

• Basic SQL.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation including equity package

• Competitive vacation policy

• Medical Insurance

• L&D budget

• Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

• Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

What You Will Do

What You Bring

Experience

• Extensive experience in financial services, modernizing business processes through data-intensive applications.

Technical Expertise

Additional Requirements:

postings.title: CRM Lead
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

At Félix , we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

About the role

We are looking for someone to lead Lifecycle & CRM at Félix, build and manage the team, and own how we engage with users throughout their relationship with Félix.
The role has three core mandates: grow LTV while effectively managing our incentives budget, generate customer insights, and identify opportunities to make Félix more relevant to our users . That means continuing to grow our core remittance business through activation, frequency, retention, and reactivation, while increasingly driving adoption of new products and expanding share of wallet.
This person will also own the governance of our user touchpoints across WhatsApp, primarily post-transaction, email, and app push. User attention is limited real estate , so they will define clear rules around communication frequency, post-transaction messaging, channel selection, and prioritization, ensuring every communication has a clear objective and that the highest-value message reaches the right user at the right moment.
They will build and continuously optimize a structured portfolio of lifecycle communications against each objective, rigorously measuring incrementality through control groups. They will also determine not only what we should communicate, but where it should live : what deserves a CRM touchpoint versus what should become part of the product experience, such as the chatbot or main menu.
The role will work closely with Product, Growth, Brand, Data, Operations, and regional teams, turning CRM into both a measurable growth lever and one of Félix’s strongest sources of customer intelligence.

Responsibilities

• Own the lifecycle strategy end to end , from signup and first transaction through repeat usage, activation, retention, reactivation, cross-sell, and long-term customer value.

• Grow LTV across the customer base , identifying the highest-leverage opportunities to increase transaction frequency, retention, product adoption, and share of wallet.

• Own the incentives strategy and budget , determining where incentives create true incremental behavior versus subsidizing activity that would have happened anyway.

• Build a rigorous experimentation engine across the lifecycle, using control groups, holdouts, segmentation, and incremental measurement to understand the true impact of campaigns and incentives.

• Build and manage the Lifecycle & CRM team , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, standards, and a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes.

• Own Félix’s communication governance , defining how often we contact users, through which channels, for what purposes, and how competing messages are prioritized.

• Manage the portfolio of lifecycle communications across WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and other relevant channels, ensuring every touchpoint has a clear objective and measurable value.

• Develop increasingly sophisticated segmentation and personalization , using customer behavior, transaction history, lifecycle stage, geography, product usage, and other signals to make communications more relevant.

• Partner closely with Product to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience itself.

• Drive adoption of new products and use cases , helping Félix expand from remittances into a broader financial relationship with its users.

• Build a strong customer intelligence function in close partnership with the Data team , systematically extracting insights from behavioral data, campaign performance, customer conversations, research, and qualitative feedback.

• Turn customer insights into action , identifying unmet needs, friction points, new product opportunities, and ways Félix can become more useful and relevant in customers’ everyday financial lives.

• Create closed feedback loops across teams , ensuring insights from Lifecycle & CRM inform Product, Growth, Brand, Operations, and regional strategy.

• Build the reporting and operating framework for Lifecycle , making performance, experiments, learnings, and opportunities visible across the company.

Requirements

• Strong experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Retention, or Customer Growth in a consumer business, ideally with high transaction frequency or recurring usage.

• Strong business judgment , with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on expected customer impact, incremental value, cost, and scalability

• Proven track record driving incremental growth across activation, repeat usage, retention, reactivation, and cross-sell.

• Strong understanding of incrementality and experimentation , including control groups, holdouts, uplift measurement, and causal thinking.

• Experience managing incentives and promotional budgets , with the ability to distinguish true incremental behavior from subsidized activity.

• Deep expertise in segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle journey design across channels such as WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and in-product surfaces.

• Strong analytical mindset and experience working closely with Data teams to define audiences, measurement frameworks, customer insights, and opportunities.

• Experience identifying and driving multi-product adoption , including second-product conversion, cross-sell, and increasing products per active user.

• Strong understanding of churn, retention, and reactivation dynamics , with experience building programs to prevent churn and recover inactive users.

• Ability to turn behavioral data, campaign performance, customer research, and qualitative feedback into clear product and growth opportunities .

• Strong product judgment , with the ability to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience.

• Experience building and managing high-performing teams , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, and a high bar for execution.

• Ability to work closely with Product, Growth, Data, Brand, and Operations , influencing priorities and turning customer insights into action.

These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

Key Metrics

• Incremental Transactions

• Incremental Users

• Cost per Incremental User (CPiU)

• Cost per Incremental Transaction (CPiT)

• Transaction Volume / TPV Growth

• Retention & Reactivation Lift

• Share of Wallet Growth

• Customer LTV

• Incremental Multi-Product Users

• Multi-Product Adoption Rate (cross-selling)

• Incremental ROI on CRM & Incentives

This Role Works Well If You…

• You think of Lifecycle & CRM as a growth and customer strategy function , not a campaign calendar or messaging operation.

• You are commercially minded and naturally prioritize based on incremental impact, economics, and scalability rather than activity or vanity metrics.

• You are obsessed with understanding what actually changes customer behavior , and you want to prove it through experimentation rather than correlation.

• You are comfortable asking “Would this have happened anyway?” before taking credit for a transaction, retained user, or successful promotion.

• You treat incentives as an investment , not just a marketing expense, and are disciplined about where and when Félix should spend to influence behavior.

• You combine strong analytical thinking with customer intuition , moving comfortably between cohorts, experiments, behavioral data, customer research, and qualitative feedback.

• You think beyond individual campaigns and build systems, journeys, and portfolios of interventions that compound over time.

• You believe user attention is scarce , and that sending fewer, more relevant messages can be more valuable than maximizing communication volume.

• You have strong product judgment and are comfortable deciding that the best CRM idea should actually become a product experience.

• You naturally look for opportunities to increase the depth of the customer relationship , from greater frequency and retention to new use cases, products, and share of wallet.

• You are comfortable operating with high ownership and ambiguity , building the team, processes, measurement frameworks, and operating model as Félix continues to scale.

• You enjoy working at the intersection of Growth, Product, Data, and Customer Insights , and can turn what you learn about customers into concrete actions across the company.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Initial stock options grant

• Annual performance bonus

• Health, dental, and vision plans

• Work model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid set up

• Continuous learning opportunities

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

• Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

postings.title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

• Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

• Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

• Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

• Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

• Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

• Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Mandatory:

• 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

• 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

• Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

• Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

• Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

• Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

• Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

• Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

• Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

What You Bring

postings.descriptionText:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Hybrid

Full-Time

Latin America is one of Payoneer's highest-priority growth regions. We are looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to own Payoneer's product strategy for LATAM, the bridge between central Product and the regional go-to-market engine.

Reporting to the Product leadership for the region, you will be the voice of the LATAM customer inside Product and the single product point-of-contact for the LATAM GTM team. You will translate regional strategy into concrete roadmaps and partner deeply with central Product, Engineering, Banking & Treasury, Compliance, Operations, and GTM to grow Payoneer across the region.

This role is ideal for a senior, hands-on product manager with deep cross-border payments expertise who combines market intuition, data fluency, execution excellence, and the ability to drive outcomes through influence across a complex matrix organization.

What You'll Do

• Own LATAM product strategy end-to-end and the regional roadmap, prioritizing across a portfolio of initiatives to deliver the greatest impact for the region.

• Translate ambiguous regional customer, regulatory, and GTM needs into clear requirements, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

• Run discovery directly with customers, through interviews and pilots, and convert it into product requirements and pilot decisions.

• Partner hands-on with central Product, Engineering, Banking & Treasury, Compliance, and Operations to make practical build, integrate, and partner calls for regional rails (PIX, SPEI/TEF, virtual accounts, FX, reconciliation).

• Be the single product point-of-contact for LATAM GTM: source pilot customers, coordinate comms, and unblock enablement.

• Use funnel, activation, and revenue data to build the argument for prioritization and defend LATAM priorities inside the central product org.

Who You Are

• 7+ years of Product Management experience, the majority in fintech / cross-border payments.

• Deep understanding of money movement: collections, payouts, virtual accounts, FX, reconciliation, and the bank/partner integrations behind them.

• Strong command of LATAM market dynamics: local rails (PIX, SPEI/TEF, boletos), capital controls, and tax/regulatory context (e.g. IOF/IRRF, KYC/AML doc bars), and how they shape product.

• Proven ability to drive outcomes through influence across a matrix (product, banking, compliance, ops, GTM) rather than direct authority.

• Data-driven: comfortable pulling and reasoning over funnel / activation / revenue data to build the case for prioritization (SQL / BI fluency a strong plus).

• A senior individual contributor who can lead complex product domains from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

• A systems thinker who connects technology, product, regulation, user experience, and business outcomes.

• Able to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

• Execution-oriented and structured, comfortable moving between strategy, detailed requirements, prioritization, delivery, and GTM.

• Strong executive communication, turning regional complexity into decision-ready narratives.

Advantagious If You Have

• AI product experience

• Working Spanish and/or Portuguese.

• Standing up bank-partner or treasury integrations.

• Compliance / KYC onboarding-funnel experience.

• Stablecoins / digital-asset payment products.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

postings.title: Senior Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Sr. E-commerce Accountant

Remote from LATAM | International Independent Contractor | $3,000–$4,000 USD/month

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing connected fitness equipment company specializing in innovative stair climbers and expanding its product line to include treadmills, performance equipment, and fitness accessories.

The company sells through multiple channels, including direct-to-consumer e-commerce, national retail partners, and commercial fitness accounts. With manufacturing overseas and products imported into the United States, the finance function involves inventory accounting, landed costs, customs duties, tariffs, multi-channel revenue, and lender reporting.
They are looking for a highly capable accounting professional who can take genuine ownership of the accounting function and grow with the business.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Accountant with the level and title determined by experience.
Reporting directly to the VP of Finance, you will play a critical role in managing the company's day-to-day accounting operations, monthly close, AP, AR, inventory accounting, treasury support, and financial reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys ownership and variety. You won't simply review work completed by others—you'll be responsible for doing the work, improving processes, identifying issues, and building documentation as the company scales.

For the right person, this role has the potential to grow into a finance leadership position with a team reporting into it over time .

Schedule & Languages

• Minimum 6 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time

• Core hours: 9:00 AM–3:00 PM CT

• Professional English proficiency required

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Own the full AP cycle in NetSuite, including bill entry, coding, purchase order matching, approvals, and payment preparation.

• Reconcile vendor statements, including high-volume international manufacturing partners.

• Investigate and resolve vendor discrepancies.

• Maintain a clean and accurate AP aging.

• Follow up on missing invoices, credits, and overdue balances.

• Execute payment runs and maintain accurate remittance records.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Own invoicing and cash application across direct-to-consumer, retail, and commercial channels.

• Manage collections and proactively follow up on past-due balances.

• Communicate directly with U.S. customer AP departments.

• Investigate and resolve unapplied payments and credits.

• Reconcile customer accounts and prepare statements as needed.

• Provide regular commentary on AR aging and collection activity.

Month-End Close & Reconciliations

• Manage the monthly close according to an established close calendar.

• Prepare accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset and depreciation entries, and recurring journal entries.

• Reconcile balance sheet accounts, including bank, credit cards, AP, AR, inventory, and intercompany accounts.

• Ensure subledgers reconcile accurately to the general ledger.

• Prepare reconciliation packages with complete supporting documentation.

• Analyze and explain material month-over-month fluctuations.

• Continuously improve and streamline the close process.

Inventory, Landed Cost & Import Accounting

• Record inventory receipts and match them against purchase orders and supplier invoices.

• Investigate receiving delays and discrepancies.

• Accurately calculate and allocate landed costs, including freight, customs duties, tariffs, and brokerage.

• Accrue and reconcile U.S. customs and tariff obligations.

• Maintain schedules of expected duty and tariff outflows.

• Reconcile inventory subledgers to the general ledger.

• Investigate inventory variances and support cycle counts and reserve analysis.

Treasury & Financial Reporting Support

• Prepare recurring borrowing base certificates, including AR eligibility testing and supporting schedules.

• Assist with reporting required under the company's credit facility.

• Track covenant compliance dates and reporting requirements.

• Support the rolling 13-week cash forecast.

• Maintain AP and AR inputs and reconcile forecasts against actual results.

• Prepare daily and weekly cash position reporting across bank accounts.

Operational Finance Support

As part of the seniority of this position, you'll also help remove administrative work from senior finance leadership by managing:

• Expense reports and receipt collection.

• Corporate card coding.

• Vendor onboarding documentation, including W-9/W-8 forms and banking information.

• Finance document and file management.

• Vendor and customer master data in NetSuite.

• SOP creation and maintenance for processes you own.

Systems You'll Use

• NetSuite and Intuit — Current & future primary accounting ERP

• Mercury — banking

• Shopify — direct-to-consumer sales

• Justworks — payroll

• Asana — task and project management

• Google Workspace

• Excel & Google Sheets — advanced proficiency expected

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience , including at least 2 years at a senior or supervisory level.

• Proven full-cycle accounting experience . You have personally managed or owned a month-end close.

• Experience with inventory accounting in a physical-product business , such as manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, or e-commerce.

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite . Strong candidates with experience in another mid-market ERP such as Sage Intacct, Dynamics 365 Business Central, or SAP Business One may also be considered.

• Professional written and spoken English fluency .

• Comfortable communicating directly with U.S. vendors and customers.

• Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, large-file reconciliations, and complex workbooks.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to independently investigate and resolve discrepancies.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience with international imports, customs duties, tariffs, landed costs, and brokerage.

• Exposure to asset-based lending, borrowing base certificates, eligibility testing, or covenant reporting.

• Multi-entity or multi-currency accounting and consolidation experience.

• Shopify or other e-commerce accounting experience.

• Contador Público or equivalent local accounting qualification.

• Experience working in a small or rapidly scaling company where you were responsible for executing the work, not simply reviewing it.

This Role May Not Be For You If...

• You need every process to be fully documented before you can get started.

• You prefer a narrowly defined accounting function.

• You're uncomfortable working across AP, AR, close, inventory, and treasury.

• You don't enjoy communicating directly with U.S. vendors and customers.

• You prefer reviewing work rather than taking ownership of the underlying processes.

Much of the company's current processes are still being built and documented. The person joining this role will be expected to help create the structure as they take ownership .

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

First 30 Days

• Learn the company's systems, processes, and general ledger.

• Take ownership of AP entry and payment run preparation.

• Produce a clean, accurate AP aging with written commentary.

• Build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

Days 31–60

• Take full ownership of AR and collections.

• Communicate directly with customers regarding outstanding balances.

• Complete a supervised first pass of the month-end close.

• Resolve outstanding unapplied cash and credits.

Days 61–90

• Own the month-end close end to end.

• Take ownership of the reconciliation package and borrowing base preparation.

• Document AP and AR processes through clear SOPs.

• Identify and present the first three process improvements you would prioritize.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a lean, growing company where your work will have a direct impact on the business.

You'll work closely with finance leadership, gain exposure to areas of accounting that are often reserved for much larger organizations, and have the opportunity to build processes rather than simply inherit them.

The environment is collaborative, direct, and low on bureaucracy. The expectation is simple: take ownership, communicate proactively, and bring solutions—not just problems.
If you're a hands-on senior accounting professional who wants meaningful responsibility and room to grow into leadership, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be responsible for managing key client relationships, driving adoption and satisfaction, and ensuring successful outcomes for our global clients. Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, you will work cross-functionally to enhance the customer experience, deliver insights to our Product team, and help shape the growth of our Customer Success department.

Responsibilities:

• Maintain strong relationships with clients to meet retention and adoption goals, driving loyalty and long-term partnership

• Manage the onboarding process to ensure clients are set up for success and have a clear understanding of our product's value and capabilities

• Track and analyze customer health metrics and identify opportunities to increase engagement and resolve potential issues proactively

• Partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure alignment on customer needs, challenges, and objectives

• Act as the voice of the customer, providing structured feedback to Product teams to enhance user experience and align with evolving client needs

• Work with internal tools and refine processes to improve Customer Success efficiency and impact

• Collaborate with Sales to identify cross-sell opportunities, drive renewals, and generate leads for additional solutions where appropriate

Requirements

Qualifications:

• 2+ years in a Customer Success role, preferably in B2B SaaS or technology companies, with a passion for delivering value and building relationships

• Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects, with a focus on meeting deadlines and exceeding client expectations

• Experience in tracking and managing customer success metrics, with a focus on client retention, satisfaction, and engagement

• Strong verbal and written skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and contribute to a positive, dynamic work environment

• Comfort with learning software programs and configuring products to meet specific customer needs

• Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with the ability to manage and adjust to change effectively

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is mandatory for this role

Commission: 20% annual base salary paid quarterly contingent upon meeting retention goal

Upsell commissions: 10% of all recurring revenue upsells, 2% of non-recurring revenue upsells.
