At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

• Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A Day In The Life

The Vertical Data Operations Lead (B2B & Lead Gen) is a senior individual contributor embedded at the intersection of new business, marketing measurement, and complex pipeline data delivery. This role serves three distinct functions: supporting the pre-sales process on large B2B and Lead Gen engagements, contributing to Power Digital's marketing measurement programs, and owning the data onboarding and integration experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature.

You are a B2B and Lead Gen data specialist. You understand the full pipeline data landscape, CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation tools (Marketo, Pardot), demand generation platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), call tracking and form capture tools (CallRail, Unbounce), and the messy reality of lead data that arrives in every format imaginable: CSV dumps, screenshot imports, manual spreadsheets, and custom-built ingress pipelines. You know how to bring structure to unstructured data, where pipeline attribution breaks down, and what it takes to connect marketing activity to revenue outcomes for clients where the sales cycle is long and the data is rarely clean.

This role reports to the Director of Data Operations & Enablement and works closely with the Appraisal team, the Measurement team, Analytics Engineering, and client account leads.

Responsibilities

B2B & Lead Gen Vertical Client Delivery:

• Own the end-to-end data onboarding experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature — from scoping through integration validation and measurement readiness

• Lead structured data intake sessions to document lead definitions, pipeline stage mapping, CRM field configuration, conversion logic, and any known attribution nuances

• Coordinate standup of B2B and Lead Gen data pipelines — CRM connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot), MAP integrations (Marketo, Pardot), demand gen platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), and call/form tracking tools (CallRail, Unbounce)

• Own the ingestion and normalization of unstructured lead data sources — CSV imports, manual spreadsheets, screenshot-based reporting, and custom ingress tooling — leveraging AI-assisted schema mapping and data extraction where applicable

• Validate integrations are live and pipeline data is landing correctly before handing off to analytics engineering for modeling

• Maintain living integration documentation per client, usable by any team member

Pre-Sales Support

• Join sales calls and pitch meetings for large B2B and Lead Gen prospects — speak credibly to Power Digital's data capabilities, CRM integration experience, and onboarding process

• Conduct pre-signature data audits: assess the prospect's CRM setup, lead data quality, attribution methodology, and integration complexity — flag custom data requirements and surface red flags before contract

• Partner with the Appraisal team to scope data complexity into deal pricing — translate CRM fragmentation, unstructured data ingress, and pipeline attribution requirements into effort estimates

• Produce pre-sales data profiles that set accurate expectations for what onboarding will require and what measurement programs are viable

Measurement & Meridian Support

• Support the Measurement team's data readiness requirements for MMM programs, with specific focus on B2B and Lead Gen clients where offline conversion data and long sales cycles create unique modeling challenges

• Own data input preparation for pipeline-focused measurement models — ensuring lead volume, qualified pipeline, and closed revenue data are reconciled, validated, and delivered to spec

• Serve as the B2B and Lead Gen data subject matter expert for incrementality and attribution programs that require clean mapping of marketing touchpoints to pipeline and revenue outcomes

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

• 4+ years in data operations, marketing analytics, or marketing technology with direct client or stakeholder-facing responsibilities

• Deep hands-on experience with B2B and Lead Gen data ecosystems — CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation (Marketo, Pardot), and demand generation tools (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase)

• Proven experience handling unstructured and non-standard lead data ingestion — CSV imports, manual data entry reconciliation, screenshot-to-data workflows, and custom ingress pipelines

• Solid SQL skills and hands-on Snowflake experience — you can write queries, validate data, and troubleshoot without engineering support for day-to-day tasks

• Comfort in client-facing settings: you can speak to data capabilities in a sales conversation and gather requirements from a non-technical marketing stakeholder in the same day

• Familiarity with AI-assisted data tooling for unstructured data extraction, schema mapping, or data normalization

• Familiarity with ETL tools (Fivetran, Funnel) and data pipeline concepts

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

B2B/CSV Client Data Coverage

• Target: ≥70% at 6 months → 100% at 12 months

• Measurement: % of active B2B/Lead Gen clients with validated data landing in novaCloud / Omega

Data Onboarding SLA

• Target: 95% of onboardings completed within 3 weeks of start date

• Measurement: Tracked from contract-sign or kickoff date; exceptions logged with root cause

Unstructured Data Ingestion Success Rate

• Target: ≥ 90% of non-standard sources (CSV, screenshot, manual) normalized, validated, and confirmed landing in novaCloud / Omega within 5 business days of receipt

• Measurement: Tracked per-source, per client; re-submissions count against first-pass rate

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Data Depth: Be the go-to for any question about how B2B and Lead Gen pipeline data is structured, where it breaks, and how to make it usable — across clean CRM exports and messy unstructured ingress

• Unstructured Data Ingestion: Own the hardest part of B2B data onboarding — bringing structure to data that arrives in every format imaginable, using AI-assisted tooling where applicable

• Pre-Sales Credibility: Show up in sales conversations as a data expert who builds prospect confidence and sets accurate onboarding expectations

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. The Information Management Data Coordinator is part of the Major Capital Project (MCP) Information Management Team. Asset Data Management

• Own the Asset Register template and specifications, aligning them with company IM data standards and the requirements of each business unit and project.

• Design and implement a data validation process based on defined business rules to keep data quality and integrity consistent throughout the project lifecycle.

• Analyze and compare equipment and tag data from multiple sources, producing data analysis reports to identify and resolve gaps early in the project.

• Generate data reconciliation and comparison reports between company and EPC data management systems to identify and address discrepancies.

Applied AI Engineer, AI Center of Excellence

Who We Are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark .

We are looking for a hands on Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI problem solving. You will help build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, and product partners to turn customer and product problems into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient AI systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on building, measuring, and continuously improving real AI products.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• Translate product requirements into practical AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software where appropriate.

• Build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Implement reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Build event driven workflows using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, and help select models based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build and run AI evaluations using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Debug hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

What We’re Looking For

• 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• At least 1 year of hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with production experience strongly preferred.

• Strong Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Good backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Hands on experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures is required.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building or contributing to a RAG or knowledge grounded system, including retrieval, embeddings, indexing, context construction, and evaluation.

• Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling, with exposure to Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a regular part of software engineering work.

Nice to have.

You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand the core engineering patterns needed to make AI systems reliable in production.

• Understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, caching, and streaming responses.

• Ability to use experiments and evaluations to compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How You’ll Work

You will often receive a product goal or technical direction rather than a fully specified implementation. You should be able to break the problem into manageable pieces, validate assumptions, implement the solution, and work with senior engineers when architecture tradeoffs require discussion.

• Turn product goals into testable technical tasks and prototype alternatives when the best approach is not obvious.

• Choose simple, maintainable solutions and avoid using an agent or LLM when a deterministic approach solves the problem better.

• Measure quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost and use those signals to improve the solution over time.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support for assigned features.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving testing discipline, security, maintainability, and code quality.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience contributing to customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, automated evaluations, or high scale backend platforms.

Curiosity, strong problem solving, solid software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly and turn ideas into reliable production features are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. postings.title: Senior Data Integration Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
We are seeking a Senior Data Integration Engineer to build production data models and semantic layers that serve both business teams analyzing account health and pipeline velocity and autonomous AI agents running automated meeting preparation, account research, and relationship tracking through Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain production data models in dbt and Snowflake that track account health, engagement velocity, and customer intent signals

• Combine structured records and unstructured interaction data (Gong call transcripts, emails, Salesforce CRM objects, and product usage telemetry) into clean account-level dimensions

• Establish consistent modeling patterns, naming conventions, and metric definitions across GTM datasets

• Build and maintain an enterprise semantic layer (such as the dbt Semantic Layer or MetricFlow) to eliminate conflicting metric calculations across business tools

• Prepare clean, context-rich datasets structured for retrieval, search, and reasoning within Snowflake Cortex, Snowflake Intelligence, and internal AI agents

• Design feature tables and context stores that power LLM agents for automated meeting prep, competitive intelligence, and account research

• Manage metadata and data enrichment patterns so AI agents correctly interpret account stages, customer sentiment, and relationship history

• Write automated tests, schema validations, and freshness monitors in dbt for both structured metrics and unstructured data transformations

• Maintain data governance, role-based access controls (RBAC), and audit trails across sensitive sales pipeline and customer interaction data

• Partner with Revenue Operations and governance teams to document data lineage and maintain clear dataset ownership

• Work within an agile sprint cadence, contributing to backlog planning, design reviews, and technical standards

• Deliver self-service data models and documentation that enable analysts and product teams to query data independently

Requirements

• 3+ years of commercial experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data architecture roles

• Proficiency in advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, analytical queries, and execution plan optimization

• 3+ years of production dbt experience, including modular project structure, Jinja macros, custom tests, incremental models, and snapshots

• Practical experience with Snowflake, including virtual warehouse sizing, query profile analysis, clustering keys, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, and access control

• Hands-on experience modeling B2B SaaS revenue and interaction data (Salesforce CRM, Gong, Marketo, or subscription billing data)

• Understanding of Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions SCD 1/2/4, conformed dimensions) and semantic layer design

• Daily comfort with Git workflows, branching strategies, code reviews, and automated CI test runs

• Flexibility to use AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to speed up modeling work, test coverage, and documentation

• English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

• Practical experience or working familiarity with Snowflake Cortex AI functions (Cortex Search, LLM functions, embeddings)

• Familiarity with vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for conversational text

• Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation (Pandas), API extraction, or pipeline automation

• Experience with metadata and lineage tools such as Alation, Collibra, DataHub, or dbt Docs

• Experience designing data models for self-service consumption in Tableau, Looker, or Power BI

We offer

• International projects with top brands

• Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers

• Healthcare benefits

• Employee financial programs

• Paid time off and sick leave

• Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses

• Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses

• Global career opportunities

• Volunteer and community involvement opportunities

• EPAM Employee Groups

• Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

postings.title: Security Management - Data Engineer - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
Security Management – Data Engineer

Assistant Director

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information, which means that data is even more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and therefore everyone in EY Information Security has an important role to play. Join a global team of almost 1200 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond when things go wrong. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology service solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through secure solutions and information systems.

The Opportunity

As a Security Data Engineer within Security Technology Services (STS), you will join a global team responsible for engineering, integrating and enhancing security data platforms that support EY’s multi-cloud and on-premises environments.

You will develop scalable data ingestion, integration, automation and analytics capabilities that provide centralized visibility across multiple security, and operational technology platforms. Working across Azure, you will use modern cloud-native services and ETL frameworks to onboard, transform, enrich and analyze enterprise data.

The role will also design and support Azure-based data pipelines, automation solutions and reporting capabilities using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and SQL technologies to improve operational efficiency, data quality and decision-making.

You will support the implementation and ongoing management of SaaS applications and enterprise security technologies used by Information Security teams globally. This includes partnering with Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, Engineering teams and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable and data-driven solutions, while providing technical guidance for complex integrations.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Design build and maintain enterprise-scale ETL/ELT processes and Azure data integration frameworks across multiple cloud environments (primarily Azure) from both security and enterprise tools

• Build and support data ingestion, orchestration and automation solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Logic Apps and related Azure services.

• Collect, transform, validate, enrich and analyze data from enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, SaaS applications and third-party technologies.

• Develop SQL-based data pipelines, database objects, stored procedures, data models, dashboards and reporting solutions for business, compliance and security needs.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to onboard data sources and deliver scalable integration, automation, reporting and analytics capabilities.

• Support enterprise data platforms through performance tuning, troubleshooting, monitoring, automation, upgrades, cloud migration, change management and continuous improvement.

• Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, support runbooks and data flow documentation.

• Work across multi-cloud environments with Microsoft Azure as the primary platform

The successful candidate will have:

• Experience with Azure Databricks, data warehousing, data lake architecture and Azure native data platforms for large-scale transformation and analytics.

• Exposure to Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSDT, SSRS, SSIS, relational databases, stored procedures and reporting frameworks.

• Experience developing REST API integrations and consuming web services for enterprise data onboarding and automation.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud automation and deployment automation practices.

• Experience with, integrating large amounts of security data across multiple cloud environments (primarily Azure) from both security and non-security tools.

• Experience implementing monitoring and alerting for cloud services, data pipelines, integrations and automation workflows.

• Knowledge and exposure to Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI a plus.

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for individuals with practical experience working as a Data Engineer in a large Azure global environment with strong knowledge in analytics and reporting

The successful candidate will have:

• Strong understanding of data engineering principles, including ETL/ELT, data modelling, transformation, lifecycle management, master data management, data warehousing, data lakes and enterprise data architecture.

• Experience designing scalable, resilient and secure Azure-native data ingestion, integration, automation, analytics and reporting solutions.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Storage Accounts, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Azure App Services and related integration services.

• Strong SQL and data analysis experience across relational databases, SQL Server technologies, stored procedures, reporting frameworks and analytics platforms.

• Ability to work with structured, semi-structured and API-driven data from cloud platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise systems and security technologies.

• Proficiency in Python, PowerShell or similar scripting languages for automation, cloud operations, data transformation, monitoring and systems integration.

• Strong understanding of Azure cloud security concepts including identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, authentication, authorization, secure API integration and governance.

• Experience developing automated workflows that improve efficiency, data quality, compliance monitoring, platform resilience and service reliability.

• Knowledge of DevOps practices including CI/CD, source control, deployment automation, environment management and release processes.

• Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across cloud platforms, databases, APIs, data pipelines, automation workflows and enterprise applications.

• Experience integrating large amounts of data from various SaaS and OnPrem platforms and tools into centralized platforms for reporting, analytics, governance and decision-making.

• Ability to collaborate across engineering, infrastructure, operations, security, architecture and business teams to deliver end-to-end technical solutions.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and consulting skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

• Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, optimization, operational excellence and emerging cloud technologies.

• Knowledge and exposure to Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI a plus.

• Knowledge of creating and maintaining Power BI dashboards/reports.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• Detailed knowledge of Azure cloud data engineering, enterprise integrations, data platforms, database technologies, networking fundamentals, API-based architectures and scripting languages.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, SQL development, ETL/ELT frameworks, data integration patterns, cloud automation and enterprise reporting solutions.

• Experience designing, supporting and troubleshooting enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, integrations and analytics solutions for operational, compliance or security use cases.

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Engineering,

• 3+ years of demonstrated engineering experience in large, global and virtual enterprise environments.

• Strong understanding of Azure cloud technologies, enterprise integrations, and data architecture.

• Excellent time management, organizational and decision-making skills.

• Ability to document processes, procedures, architecture designs, data flows and technical solutions clearly for internal teams and customers.

• Experience working with external vendors and suppliers across technology services.

• Technical proficiency with APIs, automation frameworks and scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Ansible or similar platforms.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have

• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Microsoft Azure or technology certification programs.

• Experience in project management, service introduction, service readiness, and technology lifecycle management.

What We Look For

This role is ideal for someone with strong problem-solving, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.

We are looking for individuals who work effectively with culturally diverse onshore and offshore teams, navigate ambiguity with confidence and balance security, cloud engineering, data engineering and operational priorities.

Independent thinkers with strong technical foundations, collaborative mindsets and a commitment to automation and continuous improvement will thrive in this role.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial, and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

postings.descriptionText:
About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

Position Overview

Proofpoint is seeking a Senior DevOps and Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This is a hybrid role that sits at the intersection of platform engineering and data infrastructure—you will own the reliability, automation, and delivery of the systems that power Proofpoint's data pipelines and analytics capabilities. You will build and maintain the cloud infrastructure (AWS-first), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling that enable data engineering teams to ship high-quality data products faster and more safely. At the same time, you will actively contribute to the design and operation of data pipelines using AWS Glue, Athena, and S3, bringing a strong operational mindset to data engineering. If you thrive at the boundary between platform and data, love automating toil, and care deeply about reliability and developer experience, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

• Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) for automated testing, deployment, and promotion of AWS Glue ETL jobs, Athena views, and related data infrastructure.

• Build and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform and/or AWS CDK)—covering S3 buckets, IAM roles, Glue resources, Athena workgroups, Lake Formation permissions, VPCs, and supporting services.

• Own the observability stack for data pipelines define and instrument metrics, logs, and alerts (CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent) to ensure SLA compliance and fast incident response.

• Develop and maintain the DataOps platform—self-service tooling, pipeline templates, and shared libraries that allow data engineers to spin up production-grade pipelines quickly.

• Manage container and compute infrastructure (Docker, ECS/EKS, or Lambda) used to support data ingestion microservices and orchestration workers.

• Design and operate workflow orchestration environments (Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions) including upgrades, scaling, and reliability hardening.

• Build and maintain AWS Glue ETL jobs (PySpark) for large-scale data ingestion and transformation across the data lake on S3.

• Drive security best practices across the data platform secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store), least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, and compliance controls.

• Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and security teams to translate requirements into scalable, automated infrastructure solutions.

• Lead incident response for data platform outages on-call participation, root-cause analysis, and post-mortem-driven improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers on DevOps and data engineering practices, conduct code and design reviews, and contribute to architecture decision records.

Required

What You Bring to the Team

• 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, with at least 2 years of hands-on data engineering work.

• Deep expertise with AWS core services S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Secrets Manager, and CloudFormation/CDK.

• Hands-on experience with AWS data services Glue (ETL jobs, Crawlers, Data Catalog), Athena (workgroup management, query tuning, federated queries), and S3 (lifecycle, encryption, event notifications).

• Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools—Terraform and/or AWS CDK—for managing production cloud environments.

postings.title: Manager, Data Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
Want to help us, help others? We’re hiring!

GoFundMe is the world’s most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes—for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.

We are seeking a Manager, Data Platform to lead the team that builds and operates the foundation every other data team depends on. This role is accountable for the infrastructure, capabilities, and tooling that make our data platform observable, reliable, cost-efficient, and ready to scale with current and future traffic. You will translate platform strategy into a clear roadmap, establish owners and deadlines, and deliver measurable improvements in reliability, visibility, and efficiency. You will partner closely with Data, ML/AI, and Product Engineers, Data Scientists, Security, and Privacy teams to manage risks and dependencies and make clear trade-off decisions. You will also hire, coach, and develop engineers while partnering with Staff+ engineers and architects on technical direction. Success will be measured by platform reliability and scalability, cost transparency and efficiency, team health, and the productivity of the teams who build on the platform.

Candidates considered for this role will be located in Buenos Aires, Argentina. There will be an in-office requirement of 3x a week.

The Job

• Own the Platform Roadmap & Outcomes: Partner with data product management to build the team's roadmap and backlog, tying platform investments to measurable outcomes such as reliability, scalability, cost savings, and developer productivity.

• Build Observability into the Platform: Lead the design and delivery of monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities, including pipeline health, data freshness and quality signals, distributed tracing, SLOs/SLAs, and incident detection, so issues are found before our stakeholders find them.

• Deliver Cost Visibility & Optimization: Build the tooling and practices that give teams clear attribution of compute, storage, and pipeline spend. Drive FinOps habits such as budgets, anomaly detection, and efficiency targets without sacrificing reliability.

• Scale for Current & Future Demand: Own capacity planning, performance engineering, and architecture evolution so batch and streaming systems handle growth, seasonal spikes, and viral fundraising moments.

• Build Self-Service Tooling & Paved Roads: Create reusable frameworks, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, orchestration standards, and templates that let data teams ship quickly, safely, and consistently.

• Drive Reliability & Operational Excellence: Establish on-call practices, incident response, postmortems, runbooks, and sustainable support models. Use operational metrics to continuously improve.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Build strong relationships with Data, ML/AI, and Product Engineers, Data Scientists, Security, and Privacy teams to understand platform needs and communicate priorities, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly.

• Drive Delivery & Accountability: Set clear owners, milestones, and deadlines; hold the team accountable for commitments; and communicate progress and decisions transparently.

• Lead, Grow & Manage Performance: Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team through regular feedback, 1:1s, performance management, and meaningful career development.

• Manage Risks & Dependencies: Proactively identify and resolve delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, migration challenges, and blockers before they affect outcomes.

• Make Prioritization & Trade-Off Decisions: Balance new capabilities against reliability, security, cost, technical debt, and team capacity, and explain the rationale clearly.

• Partner on Technical Direction: Work with Staff+ engineers and architects to align architecture and tooling decisions with business priorities and long-term platform strategy.

postings.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

EY focuses on high ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

• AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.

• Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.

• Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.

• Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.

• AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

• Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.

• Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.

• Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.

• Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.

• Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.

• Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.

• Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.

• Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.

• Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.

• Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.

• Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.

• Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.

• Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.

• Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.

• Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.

• Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.

• Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.

• Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.

• Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

• At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.

• Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.

• Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.

• Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.

• Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.

• Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.

• Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.

• A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.

• Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.

• Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.

• Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

• Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

• Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.

• Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.

• Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.

• Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.

• Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.

• Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.

• Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Build your legacy with us.

Apply now.

postings.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, engineers work in small, collaborative feature teams. As an SDE IV, you'll contribute across teams that move quickly, embracing rapid, iterative development to solve meaningful customer problems and improve the platform. Engineers are involved in shaping what we build and how we build it, working with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams to create high-impact features and seamless customer experiences. We keep our processes lightweight, our communication clear, and our focus on delivering value.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning.

Interesting Problems

• Ingest and understand large amounts of structured customer, product, and event data

• Create probabilistic knowledge graphs by training ML models to unify this data across different systems

• Take research algorithms and realize them in production for extremely high-scale usage

• Build visual experiences and toolset to help users visualize their data, understand their customers and surface the most impactful insights

• Integrate our system into the operating core of the businesses we serve

• Automate the management of thousands of VMs running data processing jobs

Success Measures

• High-Scale Distributed Systems & Architecture: Guide architectural decisions across teams, productionizing complex research algorithms into probabilistic knowledge graphs and serving as an authoritative technical backstop for critical distributed platform operations.

• Customer-Centric Feature Delivery: Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and GTM teams to translate complex data ingestion and visualization challenges into high-impact, seamless customer experiences.

• Infrastructure Automation & Scalability: Build high-performance functional systems and automate the management of thousands of data-processing VMs, delivering measurable platform efficiency rather than operational complexity.

• Engineering Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Raise the execution bar across the engineering organization through active coaching, technical guidance, high-standard interviewing, and sharing deep domain judgment.

• Forward-Deployed Value & Technical Delivery: Partner directly with enterprise customer teams to deploy, tailor, and embed complex data platform solutions into their operational core, delivering high-impact technical work that earns customer trust and measurably moves their business performance.

About You

• 12+ years industry experience working in SaaS and distributed systems environments

• Experience working with large-scale data-oriented systems on a major cloud provider

• You show deep technical judgment, expanding to the depths of your team's technology ownership. You impart this judgment on others and are sought for advice on all aspects of your team's product, process, and technology.

• You can guide architectural decisions on your team and across teams with an eye to high-level tradeoffs, and know when and how to explore novel approaches. You are a backstop for oncall issues on your team.

• Passionate about building scalable infrastructure systems for both internal and external customers

postings.title: Lead / Principal GenAI Engineer

This is a forward-deployed AI engineer role sitting within a newly formed, dedicated AI team at a large-cap private equity firm.

You will work directly with our portfolio companies to assess, design, build, and hand off high-impact AI solutions at pace.

The model is deliberately lean. You will work as part of a small, highly specialised pod alongside an AI product manager. Together you are the team. You will be embedded within portfolio companies with full credentials, access, and credibility.

The goal is not to embed indefinitely. It is to get a portfolio company to the point of scaling an AI opportunity and then hand it off, including helping them hire and build their own capability.

Requirements

What You'll Do

• Assess AI feasibility during diligence, and set technical direction for the systems that follow: data products, retrieval pipelines, model orchestration, agentic workflows, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

• Design and build LLM workflows, retrieval systems, and agentic applications directly against a portco's real enterprise data and infrastructure

• Define secure, scalable reference architectures appropriate to each portco's environment, across major cloud and AI platform services as needed

• Establish evaluation and observability standards for what you build, test sets, automated evals, tracing, quality scoring, latency/cost monitoring, and regression testing, so handoff teams can trust and maintain it

• Build in human-in-the-loop controls and sound data/security practices by default, even where a formal governance function doesn't yet exist at the portco

• Develop working prototypes that can evolve into production systems, and transfer that knowledge directly to portfolio company technical teams to support handoff and their own hiring

• Evaluate emerging models, frameworks, and tools, and bring back a practical point of view on what's worth adopting versus what's prototype-only

What You'll Bring

• 8+ years of professional software development experience with a deep understanding of full-stack architectures

• Meaningful, hands-on experience shipping production AI/ML systems, not just prototypes, including generative AI or agentic AI

• Deep fluency in agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot) and in agentic architecture patterns: single- and multi-agent workflows, supervisor/worker patterns, state and memory management, orchestration, and safe action execution

• Strong grasp of modern GenAI patterns: advanced RAG, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, re-ranking, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and context engineering

• Proficiency with modern AI engineering frameworks, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable, and strong Python skills

• Working knowledge of cloud AI/ML platforms (e.g., Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI) and enterprise data ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, vector databases) sufficient to work inside whatever stack a given portco already runs

• Comfort setting LLMOps/MLOps standards on the fly, versioning, CI/CD, containerisation, cost and performance optimisation, in environments that may have none of this today

• Ability to structure codebases and specifications to produce reliable, context-efficient AI output

• Sound judgement on architecture tradeoffs, model selection, retrieval strategy, latency, cost, security, vendor lock-in, and the ability to explain those tradeoffs plainly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Comfortable engaging with both executives and frontline users

• Forensic attention to detail, extreme ownership, and a positive, can-do mindset

• Experience on Agile/Scrum teams and on large, complex systems

Benefits

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Applied AI Engineer

Who We Are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark .

We are looking for a hand on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering with practical AI problem solving. You will build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.

You will take ambiguous customer and product problems, evaluate different approaches, and independently turn the strongest solution into reliable, secure, observable, and cost-efficient production systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on shipping real AI products.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• Translate loosely defined product problems into practical AI solutions, choosing between LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software.

• Design and build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Build reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Design event driven systems using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, back pressure, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Experiment with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, selecting the right model for quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Create AI evaluation pipelines using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Diagnose hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, testing, debugging, and refactoring.

What We’re Looking For

• 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• Hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with meaningful production exposure.

• Advanced Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Production experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building at least one RAG or knowledge grounded system with measurable quality and latency outcomes.

• Strong PostgreSQL and data modeling skills, with experience using Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a core part of daily software engineering.

Nice to have.

You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand how modern AI systems behave, fail, and scale in production.

• Strong understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, model routing, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, and streaming responses.

• Ability to design experiments and evaluations that compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How You’ll Work

You will often start with an ambiguous customer or product goal rather than a detailed implementation plan. You should be able to independently break the problem down, validate assumptions, choose an approach, and drive the solution through production.

• Turn product goals into testable technical hypotheses and rapidly prototype alternatives when needed.

• Choose the simplest architecture that solves the problem well rather than using an agent or LLM by default.

• Define quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost targets and measure production performance against them.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving architecture quality, testing discipline, security, and maintainability.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience building high scale customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, or automated agent evaluation systems.

Strong problem solving, excellent engineering judgment, and the ability to independently move from ambiguity to a production quality solution are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.

postings.title: AI Platform Engineer, Enablement and Governance Operations
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Enterprise Transformation owns Kraken's internal AI platform. AI tooling is deployed at scale across the org. Tiered spend controls are live, a governed integration gateway is in production, and a system inventory is being built against real regulatory obligations. The next constraint is not access. It's capability. The frontier moves every few weeks, and most of what arrives is a protocol, API, or primitive that someone has to turn into something the rest of the company can safely use.

The opportunity

• Design and build the technical layer of the AI platform, from integration surface to production runbook. Identify capability gaps between what's possible and what the organization can safely use, then close them by evaluating vendors or building internally.

• Own the governed integration gateway as an engineering surface. You'll handle connector onboarding, authentication flows including OAuth and federated identity, reliability, and vendor escalation when things break.

• Build internal tooling that extends the platform. Think agent scaffolding, reusable skills and prompt assets, evaluation harnesses for model changes, provisioning automation, and integrations between AI tooling and your systems of record.

• Configure and operate tiered spend controls across the AI estate. Set caps by role and tier, build alerting rules, manage exception queues, run monthly reconciliation against vendor commitments, and eliminate the current single author risk in cap automation.

• Implement the technical controls behind policy on data handling, retention, and model eligibility. This means identity integration, SSO and SCIM, entitlement by role and tier, and workspace configuration where retention terms differ by model class.

• Work directly with teams to unblock them. Sit with them, understand the workflow, build or configure the thing that enables them to get real leverage from the tools.

• Run technical enablement. Deep dives for tool rollouts, office hours for model releases, and authority over the engineering detail in knowledge base material.

• Administer the enterprise AI estate end to end. Model turn ups, feature enablement, deprecation, provisioning queue, vendor configurations, and seat true ups.

What You Bring

• Enterprise SaaS administration at 1,000+ seats, ideally including an AI or LLM platform.

• Demonstrated ability to build and ship working software, not just configure vendor products. Python or a comparable language should be natural to you. Version control, CI, containers, and secrets management are everyday tools.

• Experience integrating against LLM and SaaS APIs with working familiarity of agent and tool use patterns, including MCP or equivalent tool calling architectures.

• Working knowledge of identity and access. Okta or an equivalent IdP, OAuth, SCIM, SSO, and federated machine identity are things you've worked with.

• Operational discipline. You understand intake queues, SLAs, runbooks, escalation hygiene, and the instinct to document a fix the first time you make it.

• Genuine teaching ability. You can explain a technical capability three different ways on the same day to compliance, traders, and backend engineers.

• Clear written communication for technical documentation, runbooks, and policy pages.

• Judgment about what to build. You can tell the difference between a capability the organization actually needs and a demo that will be abandoned in a month.

Nice to haves

• Experience standing up an internal developer or AI platform, including the self service and guardrail layers.

• Exposure to FinOps or software asset management practice.

• Experience with low code or workflow automation platforms.

• Atlassian administration depth in Jira, Confluence, or JSM.

• Familiarity with regulated industry audit and evidence work in financial services.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Business Insights Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.

We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.

We are looking for a Business Insights Analyst to join our growing Strategy & Insights Team to help shape the future of customer experiences powered by Generative AI. As a key member of ASAPP's Customer Growth organization, you will partner with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams to deliver strategic insights and maximize the value that the world's largest brands derive from our platform. Your analysis will directly influence how customers interact with leading brands, while your recommendations will help guide the direction of our evolving AI products.

In this role, you will analyze large-scale Generative AI deployments, draw insights from conversational data to uncover and communicate growth opportunities, and craft compelling narratives around performance and impact.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytically minded, has a strong grasp of customer behavior, and a track record of translating data-driven insights into actionable recommendations.

This role is right for you if you

• Thrive at the intersection of data analysis and strategic thinking

• Enjoy turning complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences

• Are organized and able to manage multiple priorities at once

• Are skilled at uncovering patterns in large, complex datasets

• Want to build a foundation in strategy and analytics

• Are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn about new technologies and industries

What you'll do

• Support Customer Success and Strategy teams with client requests beyond standard deliverables, strengthening the client partnership

• Handle ad-hoc requests from internal and external stakeholders based on priority

• Develop analytical insights that measure client performance across key inputs such as performance metrics and customer experience

• Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to shape account strategy, create forecasts, and quantify impact of technology

• Identify creative new ways to analyze data at scale

What you'll need

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or related field; or equivalent work experience

• 2+ years of experience in consulting, business intelligence, data analytics, or a similar role

• Demonstrated experience connecting data analysis to business drivers

• Exposure to client or stakeholder communication

• Ability to manage and prioritize across competing requirements

• Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write new queries and interpret existing queries

• Proficiency in creating impactful presentation materials in PowerPoint or Google Slides to communicate insights clearly to cross-functional audiences

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

What we'd like to see

• Experience with data visualization or analytics tools

• Experience leveraging large language models for analytics purposes

• Specific experience analyzing customer behavior

Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Stock options

• Healthcare for the family group

• Mac equipment

• USD 150 per month in flexible benefits

• 3 weeks of vacation

• English lessons

ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
