postings.title: BI Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

The Role

We are seeking a BI Analyst to help design, build, and evolve scalable data solutions for digital marketing and advertising use cases. Working closely with our Media and Solutions Engineering teams, you will be responsible for end-to-end business intelligence activities—from conducting data discovery and maintaining ETL pipelines to supporting reporting solutions for our clients.

This is a hybrid client-facing and internal delivery role, working with the regional Monks team and various international clients.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain robust dashboards, reports and visualizations that track media campaign performance and KPIs.

• Analyze complex data sets in-depth to identify trends, callout issues, and gather insights.

• Maintain integration pipelines (ETL/ELT) in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure) that integrate marketing and advertising data across DSPs, ad servers, and third-party platforms to create reporting solutions for Media teams

• Data Quality & Governance: Implement auditing, data validation rules, security protocols, and compliance frameworks to maintain data integrity. Establish QA frameworks and build internal/external tools for automated data validation and proactive monitoring.

• Work directly with clients and internal teams to understand their measurement needs, configure reports, and present findings that support data-driven decisions.

• Document data solutions to ensure transparency with our clients and reproducibility

• Drive continuous improvements in reporting processes, templates and automation to scale delivery and reduce manual effort.

• Research, evaluate, and adopt emerging tools, technologies, and industry best practices in data analytics to drive innovation and efficiency.

Tools

We are looking for someone experienced with (or familiar with) the following tools and technologies:

• BI/visualization tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI.

• Experience with SQL databases

• Cloud platforms such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

• Data modeling and transformation tools (ETL/ELT), such as DBT

Experience working with data connectors (e.g., Supermetrics, Funnel, Tracer, etc) is a plus Knowledge of media reporting UIs / APIs (e.g., DV360, SA360, Meta) is a plus GitHub and GitHub Actions (CI/CD processes) is a plus Python is a plus Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Dataform, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Dataflow, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Storage Transfer Service) is a plus Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex) for accelerating implementation is a plus

What we’re looking for

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in industrial engineering, informatic engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field—or equivalent work experience.

• 2+ years of experience with any combination of analytics, marketing analytics, and analytical techniques for marketing, customer, and business applications.

• Hands-on experience with BI/visualization tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI.

• Strong SQL skills, including experience with regular expression functions, CASE expressions, and common table expressions (CTEs).

• Hands on experience with Cloud infrastructure such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

• Self-starter with strong time and project management skills, and high attention to detail

• Excellent problem-solving skills including the ability to analyze and resolve complex problems using data

• Strong communication skills — you can explain technical implementation details to non-technical stakeholders and document your work clearly

• Advanced English. This will be tested during the selection process

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

postings.title: Senior Data & Reporting Analyst, Finance (FP&A)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview of Position

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Data & Reporting Analyst to build, automate, and maintain data and business intelligence solutions for the Renters Insurance Financial Planning & Analysis team. This role serves as the primary technical owner of reporting and analytical solutions, translating FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into scalable technical solutions through data acquisition, validation, modeling, reporting, automation, and analysis.

Approximately 70-80% of the role focuses on data, reporting, business intelligence, analytics, and technical solution development, while the remaining portion is dedicated to understanding financial and business context. This position offers significant autonomy and ownership, allowing the analyst to influence decision-making, enhance reporting capabilities, drive automation initiatives, and explore the application of AI and emerging technologies within Finance.

What makes us different?

• Significant autonomy and ownership of reporting and analytical solutions from end to end.

• Opportunity to directly influence how data is leveraged for business and financial decision-making.

• Empowerment to recommend new analyses, process improvements, and scalable reporting solutions.

• Exposure to innovative technologies, including AI-driven solutions within Finance.

• Collaborative environment partnering with Finance, technology teams, and business stakeholders.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Translate FP&A reporting and analytical requirements into technical solutions that support actuals, budgets, forecasts, revenue, expenses, profitability, operational metrics, and KPIs.

• Explore, understand, and maintain knowledge of databases, data warehouses, reporting environments, business rules, and data dependencies.

• Assess data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and fitness for purpose.

• Extract, combine, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources.

• Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and maintain recurring reporting solutions and ad hoc analytical tools.

• Design, build, enhance, and support Power BI dashboards, data models, measures, and reporting solutions.

• Explore and integrate AI solutions into reporting and analytics development processes.

• Recommend reporting enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and scalable solutions.

• Document data sources, calculations, assumptions, controls, lineage, and operating procedures.

• Partner with data owners and technology teams while maintaining ownership of FP&A reporting and analytics deliverables.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting development, and analytics.

• Advanced SQL experience in a professional environment.

• Strong hands-on Power BI experience, including report development and data modeling.

• Advanced Excel skills for analysis, validation, financial modeling, and reporting.

• Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• Experience with DAX, Power Query, testing, deployment, performance optimization, and production support within Power BI.

• Experience with Alteryx, Python, or similar tools for data preparation, integration, automation, and analysis.

• Exposure to financial planning systems, ERP platforms, general ledger data, or transaction-level data.

• Experience automating recurring reporting and analytical workflows.

• Experience supporting FP&A, Finance, Accounting, Commercial Analytics, Operations Analytics, or other data-driven business functions.

• Ability to interpret results, identify opportunities for deeper analysis, and recommend practical process improvements.

• Experience in insurance, financial services, or another data-intensive industry.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands.

How much should I expect to travel?

No regular travel is expected for this position.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

postings.descriptionText:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We provide reporting solutions/requirements through finance, markets and operations reporting along with cyclical and critical controlling processes such as Forecasting, Financial Planning, Revenue Planning, Markets Leadership Planning and Cash Reporting to help you take better business decisions. With projects like Mercury, we also support business transformation, and we are continuing to expand our services to support all Regions with their reporting and analytics needs.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Intelligent Insights Specialist to join EY GDS ES Finance Reporting and Data Analytics team. The Intelligent Insights Specialist is responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that inform business decisions. This role involves conducting comprehensive analytical analysis, creating compelling data visualizations, and communicating findings effectively to leadership teams across the globe. The specialist must possess a deep understanding of the business context and have robust financial domain knowledge to support strategic initiatives and enabling informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Analysis and Insight Generation

• Derive and deliver meaningful and actionable business insights through an end-to-end understanding of the data

• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and objectives, ensuring alignment with business strategies

Communication and Presentation

Business and Financial Acumen

• Proficiently translate financial data into business insights

• Collaborate with finance and business teams to align data insights with organizational goals.

• Contribute to the team's efforts by accomplishing related tasks as needed.

• Stay abreast of industry trends, developments in business intelligence, data analytics and the competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions.

Technical Proficiency

• Design and create SQL queries, interpret advance SQL queries, and extract or manipulate data for reporting and analysis purposes.

• Leverage Power BI for creating interactive reports and dashboards.

• Employ advanced Excel skills for data analysis, including the use of formulas, pivot tables, and charts

Documentation and Reporting

Requirements

• Critical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and able to take initiative.

• Proficient in data integration, data processes, analytical thinking.

• Solid grasp of SQL and the foundational principles of data warehousing.

• Skilled in analytical reasoning, resolving complex issues, and steering project execution.

• Strong communicator, adept at leading discussions with key stakeholders.

• Knowledgeable in financial domain, leveraging advanced analytics

• Capable of managing a multiple project portfolio with exceptional efficiency.

• Excellent time management and organizational abilities.

Skills & Attributes For Success

• Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

• Experience with financial modeling and forecasting.

• Detail-oriented with an unwavering commitment to accuracy and quality.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong documentation skills, with a keen eye for detail and organization.

• Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a team towards achieving common goals.

Qualifications:

What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. postings.title: Senior Business Analyst, Credit & Analytics
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves extends credit to thousands of businesses across Latin America and beyond, and the quality of those decisions depends on the quality of our data. Our Credit & Analytics team has a clear roadmap: reliable portfolio monitoring, better risk models, and more automated credit decisioning. All of it depends on first getting our data foundation right — connecting and maintaining external data sources and cleaning up customer data consents — and today that work competes with day-to-day execution for the same few people.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Business Analyst to own that foundation and build on it. In your first months you'll lead the work to connect and validate external data (bureau, banking, open finance and tax data), clean up consent records so we can use that data reliably, and turn manual processes into repeatable ones. From there you'll use that data to shape credit policy: underwriting criteria, credit limit strategies, portfolio monitoring and early-warning signals that help us catch losses before they happen.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to get into the data themselves. You'll partner closely with data science, engineering, product, collections and sales, and your work will directly shape how Jeeves makes credit decisions as we scale. It is not a people-management role today.

Location : This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

Data Foundation

• Lead the integration and validation of external data sources — credit bureaus, bank and open finance data, tax and financial data — partnering with engineering on pipelines and data quality

• Own the cleanup of customer data consents and connections so external data can be pulled and refreshed reliably and in line with local requirements

• Replace manual credit and portfolio processes with repeatable, documented SQL/Python workflows

• Define data quality checks and documentation so the team can trust what it's looking at

Credit Policy & Strategy

• Use internal performance and external data to develop and refine underwriting criteria and credit limit strategies

• Design customer management strategies, including credit line increases, decreases and reinstatements

• Identify high-risk customers early and build processes to mitigate losses

• Partner with Sales and Business Development so growth strategies stay consistent with Jeeves's credit policy

Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Support

• Define portfolio KPIs and build dashboards to track portfolio health and strategy performance

• Build early-warning signals and monitoring routines that flag deteriorating accounts

• Give Collections the segmentation and prioritization insights they need to improve recovery

• Contribute to loss forecasting and risk-adjusted return analysis with Finance

Models & Automation

• Apply statistical methods (logistic regression, segmentation, clustering) to uncover risk drivers and inform strategy

• Develop, validate and monitor credit risk models

• Help define the rules and data requirements for automated credit decisioning with Product and Engineering

• Translate model results into clear recommendations for credit leadership and business partners

Working With AI

• Use AI tools to support your analysis, and verify their outputs against source data

• Suggest and help build improvements to our AI workflows as you see what works and what doesn't

Minimum Requirements:

• 3–7 years of analytics experience in credit risk, with hands-on work on commercial or SMB credit in cards, payments, lending or a related industry

• Advanced SQL — you write your own queries against large, messy datasets and are comfortable validating data quality

• Working proficiency in Python for analysis and statistical modeling (regression, segmentation, clustering)

• Experience with version control (e.g., GitHub) for sharing and maintaining code is a plus

• Able to work independently and take ownership

• Direct experience working with external or alternative data sources (bureau, banking, open finance, tax or similar), ideally including integrating or cleaning them

• Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini in your analytical work, and curiosity about using them more

• A track record of turning analysis into a credit policy or strategy change that was implemented, with measurable results

• Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a model result or data issue to a non-technical stakeholder

• Professional fluency in English — Jeeves is a global company and English is the language we use internally to communicate between regions

• Able to work with meaningful overlap with Latin American business hours

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of Latin American credit data and open finance ecosystems (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)

• Experience implementing, validating or monitoring risk and scoring models alongside data science teams

• Experience supporting collections strategy or early-warning programs

• Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, Metabase, Claude Visualization Tools.

• Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese

• Experience in a high-growth startup or fintech

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

This role is focused on Jeeves’s growth programs and emerging revenue channels — including our partnerships channel and new market expansion initiatives — where we need rigorous, scalable analytics to match the pace of growth.

You’ll be responsible for the analytical layer that connects our sales activity to revenue outcomes: building the dashboards our leadership relies on, maintaining shared responsibility for the integrity of our performance data, and proactively surfacing the insights that shape how we operate. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership.

The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know.

Key Responsibilities
GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights

• Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership.

• Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made.

• Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart).

• Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators.

Revenue Planning & Target Analysis

• Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized.

• Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled.

• Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely.

• Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments.

AI-Driven Operations & Scale

• Use AI tools, including Claude and other frontier models, as active parts of your workflow: automating repetitive reporting tasks, accelerating data synthesis, and building scalable analytical programs that would otherwise require a much larger team.

• Identify RevOps processes that can be operationalized or significantly improved through AI, and take ownership of building those solutions, not just flagging the opportunity.

• Apply AI-assisted analysis to extract insights at scale from large, multi-source datasets: pipeline signals, rep activity, customer behavior, and market trends.

• Help establish Jeeves’s AI-first approach to RevOps as a model for how the broader GTM team operates.

Data Quality & Systems Integration

• Share responsibility for data quality across our revenue stack (HubSpot CRM, Tableau, and financial systems), conducting audits for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

• Connect disparate data sources (CRM, marketing automation, financial tools, and proprietary revenue data) so that reporting on growth programs is unified and trustworthy.

• Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic so the team works from a shared understanding of what we’re measuring and why.

Stakeholder Partnership

• Develop enough context on our GTM motion to contribute meaningfully in planning and pipeline review cycles alongside sales leadership, bringing data that drives decisions, not just awareness.

• Serve as a reliable analytical resource to the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM leadership: scope requests clearly, pull the data, and return clear answers quickly.

• Identify process gaps and proactively propose improvements to how we collect, manage, and act on GTM data (especially across new and growing channels).

What We’re Looking For
Technical & Analytical Skills

• Tableau mastery: able to write complex calculated fields, build multi-source dashboards, and design views for diverse audiences from reps to the C-suite.

• Advanced Excel and Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivot tables, and financial modeling — you reach for the right tool for the job, not just the most impressive one.

• Strong SQL skills: you can get to an answer independently without waiting for a data engineer to pull it for you.

• Data integration experience: comfortable connecting CRM, marketing automation, and financial data into unified reporting environments.

• Business metrics fluency: deep understanding of conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), pipeline coverage, ramp curves, revenue attainment, and customer health.

• Data modeling: able to design clean structures that support accurate forecasting, compensation analysis, and multi-region rollups.

AI Fluency (Required, Not Optional)

• You actively use AI tools, Claude Copilot/Code, or equivalent, as part of your day-to-day workflow, not as a novelty.

• You’ve used AI to automate reporting pipelines, accelerate analysis, or build operational programs that scale beyond what a single analyst could do manually.

• You’re curious about where AI can go next in RevOps and you bring ideas, not just execution.

Soft Skills & Ways of Working

• Hungry and driven: you want to build something generational, and you bring the energy and output to match. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else will hold you to.

• Thrives in high-velocity environments: you’re not just comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — you’re energized by them. You find a way through, not a reason to wait.

• High agency: you don’t wait for a ticket. You’re already thinking about what the data might be missing or what question leadership will ask next week.

• Sharp communicator: your outputs — whether a Slack message, a Tableau dashboard, or a business review slide — are concise, structured, and ready for a senior audience.

• Strong time management: you’re comfortable managing multiple live workstreams, setting expectations on timelines, and delivering reliably under pressure.

• Low ego and collaborative: Jeeves is building something ambitious across complex markets. You’re here to make the whole team better, not just your function.

postings.title: Marketing Analyst, New Business and M&A
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.

Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.

Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.

This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.

• Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.

• Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal.

• Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.

• Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.

• Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.

• Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.

• Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.

• Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.

• Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal, quickly learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.

• Shadow key teams to learn the core of each new business and its paid acquisition channels.

In the first month, expect to:

• Understand the marketing data generated and where/how it is stored, especially as it relates to the Business Analytics team.

• Obtain a basic understanding of each business’s paid advertising channels, spend, and operations.

• Assess the current state of tracking, attribution, performance metrics, reports, dashboards, and models in use, and identify gaps and discrepancies.

• Begin supporting business leaders with relevant paid performance insights and reports for leadership meetings.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Develop proficiency in the marketing data elements of each business and obtain a robust understanding of the paid acquisition funnel from ad spend to revenue.

• Deliver a first version of the marketing data infrastructure and ROAS/LTV reporting for the new businesses, and gain the ability to assess the drivers and impacts of marketing decisions on financial performance.

• Begin identifying new opportunities to explore in the quest to improve performance continually while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Begin to solve real business problems as a team that will move the needle on key marketing performance metrics and financial performance.

• Help us align and standardize LTV, ROAS, and other metric definitions across the new businesses and the company.

• Perform detailed root cause analysis to expose critical drivers of channel performance, and stand up a repeatable playbook for onboarding the marketing data of newly acquired companies.

In the first year, expect to:

• Inform significant strategic initiatives, goals, priorities, and performance indicators, including budget allocation and channel strategy for the new businesses.

• Become an expert both on marketing process and data flow, and help build an outstanding marketing analytics function for new businesses and M&A.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

• 3+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.

• Demonstrated experience analyzing paid advertising performance (e.g., Google Ads and other paid media platforms) and translating it into metrics such as LTV, CAC, and ROAS is required.

• Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required.

• Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.

• Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).

postings.title: Senior Sales Operations – Forecasting & Revenue Analytics IRC301291
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Why This Role

A role that drives the business

Company has a new GTM strategy — and Sales Operations is being re-built to support it. This role requires a candidate who will design and build annual targets and forecasting frameworks, BI infrastructure, territory, quota and capacity models — and own the process end-to-end.

High visibility, real influence

This role produces work that will be seen and used by Sales Leadership, executive leadership (including the CRO) and cross-functional teams. Analysis from this role will shape how the go-to-market organization makes decisions on pipeline, quota, investments and resource allocation.

Broad scope with real ownership

This role owns forecasting and reporting — but arguably more important are the analytics: territory design, customer segmentation, ICP definition, TAM analysis, and capacity and quota modeling. This role is expected to develop and connect these inputs into a consolidated picture of where the business is today and what is needed to grow.

A Company That Takes Analytics Seriously

This role reports to the VP of Sales Operations and will work alongside Sales Leadership. The expectation for the role is to leverage data and insights to influence decisions and drive outcomes across sales.

Requirements

Advanced English

Analytical Modeling & Quantitative Depth

• Expert-level Excel — dynamic arrays, Power Query, complex nested formulas, and large dataset modeling; builds from scratch, not from templates

• Proven ability to build assumption-driven, scenario-based models with clearly documented inputs, auditable logic, and executive-ready outputs

• Hands-on Tableau dashboard development; experience with AI-augmented BI tools a strong plus

• Salesforce reporting and data extraction proficiency; SQL or similar query language a plus

• Strong command of GTM metrics: ACV, TCV, ARR, win rate, pipeline velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment curves

Forecasting & Revenue Mechanics

• Deep familiarity with sales forecasting methodologies — pipeline coverage, weighted forecasts, stage-based probability, and bottoms-up/tops-down reconciliation

• Ability to connect bookings data to revenue recognition principles; partner to Finance / Delivery on bookings-to-revenue modeling

• Experience building capacity and quota coverage models with scenario-based outputs and clearly documented assumptions

Communication & Influence

• Translates quantitative analysis into clear, action-oriented narratives for senior leadership

• Comfortable presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders in high-stakes settings

• Self-directed with strong organizational skills; manages competing priorities independently and drives work to completion

• Builds presentation materials and dashboards that meet executive-ready standards, in partnership with the VP of Sales Operations

Required

Experience & Education

• 6+ years of experience in an analytical, quantitative role with a track record of building structured models that drove real decisions

• Demonstrated experience documenting assumptions, building scenario-based models, and presenting findings to senior leadership

• Hands-on Tableau dashboard development experience

• Proficiency in Salesforce reporting and data management

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Business, or a related analytical field

Backgrounds We Value

• Management consulting — especially commercial due diligence, GTM strategy, or sales force effectiveness work

• Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a high-growth B2B or SaaS company where forecasting was taken seriously

• Corporate strategy or business operations at a data-driven company

• FP&A or financial planning with exposure to go-to-market or commercial modeling

• GTM analytics, business intelligence, or sales finance in a complex B2B environment

• MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative discipline a plus, but not required

Job responsibilities

Senior analytical leader within the Sales Operations team.

This role owns the full spectrum of sales forecasting, pipeline reporting, territory and capacity modeling, and business intelligence — and is expected to bring both the technical depth and business judgment to analyze data that drive business decisions and outcomes.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across teams. He will design and build the target & forecast frameworks, BI infrastructure, and capacity and quota models for the sales organization. Strong candidates will be equally comfortable developing a bottoms-up capacity model in Excel as they are presenting forecast assumptions to senior leadership.

The ability to think in scenarios, document assumptions clearly, and deliver insights that drive action is essential. This role owns the development and build of all analytics, dashboards, and presentation materials in partnership with the VP of Sales Operations. The role will interact with Sales Leaders and cross-functional teams regularly and is expected to influence outcomes. Work product should be executive-ready — clear, well-structured, and suitable for senior audiences without significant rework.

Essential Responsibilities

Segmentation, Territories & TAM

• Define and maintain Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) — incorporating firmographic, behavioral, and performance data to guide targeting, segmentation, and go-to-market prioritization.

• Analyze the existing customer base and prospect universe to develop and refine segmentation — by industry vertical, region, company size, revenue tier, and buying behavior.

• Map segmentation outputs to total addressable market (TAM) data to identify whitespace, growth opportunities, and resource gaps.

• Build and maintain territory models that balance market potential, historical performance, and headcount capacity — recommending realignments as the business evolves.

• Partner with Sales Leadership on annual and mid-year territory assignments; maintain underlying models to support rapid scenario planning.

Capacity & Quota Modeling

• Build and maintain detailed capacity models — incorporating headcount plans, ramp curves, productivity assumptions, attrition, and coverage ratios — to project achievable bookings targets.

• Develop bottoms-up and tops-down quota models that translate company-level bookings targets into rep, team, and regional allocations; clearly document all assumptions.

• Create scenario models (e.g., attainment curves, new hire ramp, segment mix shifts) to support executive planning cycles and mid-year adjustments.

• Monitor quota attainment and capacity utilization in-period; flag risks to plan and recommend corrective actions.

Forecasting & Pipeline Management

• Own all bookings and pipeline forecasting — monthly, quarterly, and annual — with accountability for forecast accuracy.

• Build and maintain a structured, repeatable forecasting process; collect, validate, and reconcile rep and manager forecasts against pipeline data in Salesforce.

• Develop and publish weekly forecast packages for Sales Leadership and executive stakeholders, including pipeline health, coverage ratios, risk/upside flags, and trend analysis.

• Monitor pipeline movement, stage progression, and deal velocity weekly; surface actionable signals to Sales Leadership proactively.

• Partner with Finance to align bookings forecasts with revenue recognition models and establish shared reporting standards.

Analytics, Dashboards & BI

• Design, build, and own Tableau dashboards, AI-powered BI tools, and executive-ready presentation materials — in partnership with the VP of Sales Operations — delivering real-time visibility into bookings performance, pipeline health, rep productivity, and revenue trends for Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Develop a standardized suite of sales KPIs and operating metrics; automate reporting to eliminate manual processes and reduce time-to-insight.

• Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer strategic questions from Sales Leadership and the CRO — delivering clear, concise, and actionable outputs.

• Translate large, complex data sets into business narratives that drive decisions; present findings to senior audiences with confidence and clarity.

• Serve as the primary owner of sales data integrity — partner with Salesforce admins to enforce CRM hygiene and reporting standards.

What we offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to work on market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules.We offer you the best quality of work life so that you exceed the expectations of our clients, while achieving your professional and personal ambitions.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes English classes, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. We also offer the chance to travel internationally

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, extended paternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what's needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs.

What You Will Do
B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics

• Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working

• Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next

• Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read

• Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time

• Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels

B2C Growth & Registration Analytics

• Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform

• Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them

• Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day

• Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions

• Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates

• Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer

• Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on

Analytical Rigor & Influence

• Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation

• Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated

• Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold

• Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team

• Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped

• Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche's data

• Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear "so what"

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus

• 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function.

• Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation.

• Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations.

• Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business.

• Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect.

• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question.

• Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change.

• Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar.

• Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work.

• Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn't.

• A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back.

• Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Python or R.

• Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement.

• Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer.

• Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments.

• Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges.

Interview Process
Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

• Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

• Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 Minutes

• Team Interview - 3 separate 30 Minute Interviews

• Case Study & Presentation

• Hiring Manager follow-up - 30 Minutes

We are currently recruiting for this role in ARGENTINA ONLY. We will not be considering US based candidates at this time. All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

• Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors.

Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

Buenos Aires is one of JP Morgan's key strategic hubs with over 3,100 employees supporting different areas like Operations, Technology, Finance, Credit Risk, Human Resources, Legal... among others, providing value-added services, products and solutions to our clients located in various countries around the world.

The Global Capital Markets Business Management team sits under the Global Finance & Business Management (F&BM) organization of the firm and provides analytical, strategic and operational thought leadership to the management teams while driving the priorities of the business through strategic initiatives and everyday solutions.

The team is aligned to the Debt and Equity Capital Markets business, a group formed by approx. 600 bankers and generating $5.0bn in revenues per year.

Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, you will work closely with the business management team locally and in New York, supporting the preparation of business performance reports, creating and delivering analytical work to help inform the management team's decisions, and measuring success of the business key initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Fee & pipeline analysis: Track and understand trends in Equity Capital Markets by analyzing booked fees and future deal pipeline activity. Provide insights on drivers of change to F&BM partners and management team

Market & competitor analysis: Analyze competitor data, in particular League Tables, to benchmark JPMorgan's performance against other Investment Banking peers and assist the management team in understanding underlying trends behind competitor trends

Management Reporting: Provide weekly updates to senior management on deals announced/closed/priced, new mandates, changes in pipeline and forecast and other relevant performance metrics

Business performance reviews & presentations: Prepare content in Business Reviews and Town Halls. Review revenue and expense trends and competitor metrics to provide insights on performance highlights as well as risk areas

Data management: Built and/or maintain various databases to monitor proprietary deal-related information not available in public sources to facilitate enhanced business analyses

Business optimization efforts: Facilitate and manage various data-based initiatives around banker time tracking analyses, client coverage organization; headcount and organization projections; talking points for senior management meetings

Ad hoc projects and analysis: Assist with ad-hoc requests and projects to support the growth and development of our business

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Bachelor's Degree required

• Strong analytical background to perform analysis, with ability to take initiatives

• Ability to work independently. Organized and rigorous.

• Resourceful team player with a positive attitude

• Microsoft Office experience including Excel, PowerPoint and Word required

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

postings.title: Credit Profitability Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀

Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles.

Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión.

Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1100 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá!

#LoMejorEstáPorVenir

Buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Credit Profitability Analyst que tendrá como misión diseñar, evaluar y optimizar las estrategias de pricing y la estructura de rentabilidad de productos crediticios y de captación maximizando el margen y el retorno financiero del portafolio.

Tendrás El Desafío De

• Estructurar propuestas de pricing diferencial por cluster de riesgo y plazos para préstamos personales, tarjetas y POS, evaluando curvas de tasas y su impacto en la rentabilidad.

• Desarrollar, mantener y monitorear modelos de crédito (riesgo, pricing, pérdida esperada), asegurando su precisión, vigencia y mejora continua.

• Diseñar, monitorear y evaluar experimentos de pricing (Champion-Challenger / Test de tasas) midiendo la conversión (CR), ticket promedio, plazo e impacto en mora temprana (FPF).

• Ejecutar el seguimiento diario y por cosecha de la originación, asegurando el backtesting de la política (Loan loss, tenors, precancelaciones, gastos y métricas TIR/ROE).

• Colaborar con ALM, Underwriting y Credit Risk para garantizar el alineamiento entre targets de retorno, Unit Economics y proyecciones de incobrabilidad.

• Realizar análisis de Unit Economics, margen neto, payback y valor del cliente por cohortes. (cosecha), identificando desvíos versus lo planeado y sus causas raíz.

• Participar activamente en la construcción de procesos de Forecast y Budget dentro de la vertical, liderando el armado de escenarios y supuestos.

• Elaborar y revisar informes de gestión periódicos, garantizando la integridad de los datos y la claridad en el análisis.

Qué buscamos para este rol

• Experiencia de 1 a 2 años en posiciones analíticas de Pricing, Rentabilidad, Planning & Control o Riesgo de Crédito en entidades financieras, fintechs o bancos (deseable)

• Manejo sólido y fluido de bases de datos mediante SQL y BigQuery (excluyente).

• Universitario completo o en curso en carreras afines a Finanzas, Economía, Administración, Ingeniería o Sistemas.

• Manejo de herramientas de visualización de datos como Looker Studio, Tableau o Power BI (excluyente).

• Conocimiento en metodologías de rentabilidad (deseable).

• Comprensión de métricas de riesgo crediticio (Loan Loss, FPF, Bad Rates, Provisiones) (deseable).

• Uso de asistentes analíticos de IA para optimización de queries y automatización.

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?Queremos compartir con vos...

• Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional.

• Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras.

• Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más.

• También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.

#Sumate

postings.title: Analista de Excelencia Operacional Sr
postings.descriptionText:
Hola, somos L’Oréal. No solo construimos marcas, estamos definiendo cómo el mundo experimenta la belleza (y se necesitan muchos trabajos geniales para lograrlo). ¿Te intriga? Sigue leyendo, esta podría ser la oportunidad que estabas buscando.

Un día en la vida

Te integrarás a nuestro equipo de Distribución Física, Procesos y Calidad de Operaciones en el centro de distribución NORLOG Benavídez (Buenos Aires) , liderando la cultura de mejora continua y la transformación hacia la Industria 4.0 en nuestra red logística.

• Gestión del Desempeño Operativo: Monitorearás y analizarás KPIs (productividad, costo por unidad, mermas y calidad), diseñando paneles en Power BI y liderando reuniones de gestión visual (Daily, Weekly, Monthly).

• Optimización y Proyectos Lean: Diagnosticarás cuellos de botella y liderarás proyectos de punta a punta aplicando Lean, Kaizen, 5S y análisis de causa raíz (Ishikawa, A3, PDCA).

• Estandarización y Procesos: Diseñarás y auditarás procedimientos operativos estándar (SOPs), analizando tiempos, métodos, layout y capacidad de flujos para maximizar eficiencias operativas.

• Sustentabilidad y Seguridad: Colaborarás con EHS y Calidad en iniciativas de 'L’Oréal for the Future' para mitigar riesgos y reducir desperdicios en la operación de NORLOG.

Lo que buscamos

Buscamos un perfil con mentalidad analítica, liderazgo de influencia y sólida capacidad de gestión del cambio.

• Graduación universitaria en Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Trayectoria demostrada liderando proyectos de mejora continua y optimización de procesos en centros logísticos o de distribución.

• Dominio de herramientas de análisis de datos (Power BI, Excel avanzado) y conocimiento operativo de sistemas WMS; certificación Lean o Six Sigma Green Belt deseable.

• Competencia operativa fluida en inglés (B1/B2/C1).

• Disponibilidad para trabajar presencialmente en nuestro centro de distribución en NORLOG Benavídez.

• Competencias clave: Lean Management, Process Optimization, Physical Distribution Management, Problem Solving, Analytical Thinking.

Qué hay para vos

• Un lugar para salir de tu zona de confort y crecer más allá de tu potencial.

• Responsabilidad real desde el día 1, aquí nadie se queda mirando desde la banca.

• Un entorno inclusivo donde todos son aceptados y celebrados.

• ¡Un lugar donde puedes contribuir a algo más grande!

Quiénes somos

Nuestro audaz equipo de Operaciones ayuda a crear una belleza sostenible e inclusiva junto a nuestros socios al diseñar, abastecer, producir y entregar de manera segura millones de productos en todo el mundo, impulsando la transformación hacia la Industria 4.0 en nuestros 158 centros de distribución.

Nos comprometemos a garantizar procesos de selección inclusivos y éticos, prohibiendo estrictamente la discriminación.

postings.title: Sr. COE Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
¿Estás listo para formar parte de una empresa que no solo habla del futuro, sino que lo está construyendo activamente? Únete a The AES Corporation, la mayor empresa global de energía con sede en Estados Unidos, con un equipo de 8.300 empleados en 12 países.

AES ha sido clasificada como #1 por BloombergNEF en ventas de energía renovable a empresas en EE. UU. y las Américas durante cinco años consecutivos, proporcionando electricidad a millones de personas en todo el mundo.

Nos enorgullece fomentar una sólida cultura laboral, obteniendo posiciones destacadas en los rankings de Great Place to Work™ en los mercados donde operamos. AES también fue nombrada una de las Empresas Más Éticas del Mundo por 13.º año consecutivo en 2026, lo que refleja nuestro compromiso con la integridad, la transparencia y las prácticas empresariales responsables.

Nuestro espíritu de innovación continúa siendo reconocido en la industria. AES es la única empresa galardonada siete veces con los Edison Awards del Edison Electric Institute en el siglo XXI, una distinción que reconoce el liderazgo global en el avance de la industria de la energía eléctrica.

Si estás listo para formar parte de una empresa que no solo se adapta al cambio, sino que lo impulsa, AES es el lugar para ti. No solo estamos construyendo un futuro más sostenible, lo estamos potenciando.

Postúlate ahora y potencia tu carrera con un verdadero líder en energía global.

En AES nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Sr. COE Analyst.

Su misión será evaluar, proponer e implementar iniciativas de estandarización, automatización, digitalización y mejora continua para procesos de negocio. Coordinar proyectos de transformación, optimización operativa y adopción de nuevas tecnologías, promoviendo la armonización de procesos, la eficiencia operativa y la mejora de la experiencia de usuario. Alcance regional y constante interacción con equipos globales, stakeholders de negocio y áreas tecnológicas.

Principales responsabilidades

• Priorizar y administrar el portfolio de iniciativas y proyectos de transformación, mejora continua y optimización de procesos,

• Identificar oportunidades de automatización, digitalización y eficiencia operativa, evaluando procesos actuales y proponiendo soluciones escalables,

• Articular con equipos operativos, áreas de negocio y equipos digitales para impulsar iniciativas de mejora y transformación,

• Analizar datos e indicadores, desarrollando reportes y dashboards para monitorear performance, identificar tendencias y apoyar la toma de decisiones,

• Participar en la definición, adopción e implementación de soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial, automatización y otras tecnologías digitales,

• Gestionar la comunicación, el cambio organizacional y la adopción de nuevas herramientas, procesos e iniciativas,

• Participar y/o liderar proyectos de implementación de herramientas, migraciones, transformaciones digitales y mejoras operativas, brindando soporte a los equipos involucrados durante su ejecución,

Requisitos

• Profesional universitario/a de carreras de Administración, Ingeniería, Sistemas, Ciencias Económicas o afines,

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en mejora de procesos, gestión de proyectos, transformación digital, operaciones compartidas o funciones de excelencia operacional,

• Inglés avanzado oral y escrito (excluyente),

• Conocimiento de herramientas de gestión y análisis de datos: Excel avanzado, Power BI avanzado (excluyente),

• Conocimiento de herramientas de automatización e Inteligencia Artificial (Copilot, Power Platform, herramientas de IA generativa, RPA u otras tecnologías similares) será valorado.

• Experiencia trabajando con sistemas corporativos como SAP, Workday, ServiceNow u otras plataformas empresariales será valorada.

• Capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y orientación a la mejora continua.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, gestión de stakeholders y trabajo colaborativo.

• Capacidad de organización, planificación y gestión simultánea de múltiples iniciativas.

En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. postings.title: Analista Reporting
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.

En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Analista de Reporting SEC y Análisis de Resultados para sumarse al equipo de Contabilidad y Reporting. La posición tendrá un rol clave en la preparación y revisión de información financiera, contable y de negocio destinada a organismos regulatorios tales como la SEC y la CNV, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requerimientos normativos vigentes. Asimismo, será responsable del análisis de resultados y la elaboración de reportes para la gerencia, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones mediante información precisa y oportuna. Se valorarán perfiles analíticos, con sólidos conocimientos contables, y capacidad para interactuar con distintas áreas de la organización.

¿Qué valoramos como diferencial?

• Formación: Graduados en Ciencias Económicas

• Idioma: Inglés avanzado

• Conocimientos: Office, Power BI

• Competencias:

• Capacidad analítica: Para interpretar información compleja, identificar desvíos y explicar variaciones de resultados.

• Atención al detalle: Fundamental para asegurar la calidad y precisión de los reportes.

• Pensamiento crítico: Para evaluar situaciones complejas, cuestionar información y proponer soluciones.

• Organización y planificación: Dado que trabajará con múltiples entregables y plazos exigentes.

• Comunicación efectiva: Para transmitir conclusiones de manera clara a distintos niveles de la organización.

• Trabajo en equipo y colaboración.

• Proactividad: Para anticipar necesidades, detectar riesgos y promover mejoras en los procesos de reporting.

• Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo: Especialmente importante en entornos cambiantes.

• Orientación a resultados: Manteniendo el cumplimiento de deadlines críticos sin descuidar la calidad.

• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión: Particularmente durante cierres contables y presentaciones al mercado.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad y cumplimiento de la información reportada ante la SEC y la CNV, en línea con los plazos establecidos.

• Analizar y explicar las principales variaciones de resultados.

• Coordinar el proceso de elaboración de reportes financieros con múltiples áreas de la compañía, asegurando consistencia y alineamiento de la información.

• Mantenerse actualizado respecto de cambios en la normativa contable y regulatoria aplicable (SEC y CNV), evaluando su impacto en los reportes de la compañía.

• Participar activamente en procesos de cierre y reporting y auditorías externas, brindando soporte técnico y documentación de respaldo.

• Impulsar mejoras en los procesos de reporting y análisis de resultados, promoviendo mayor eficiencia, automatización y calidad de la información.

• Transformar información compleja en análisis claros y accionables para la alta gerencia y otros usuarios internos.

Si sos una persona que:

• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

• Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

• Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.

• Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.

¡Este puesto es para vos!

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.

Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:

🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.
💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.
🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.
