postings.title: Decision Support Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
The Decision Support Analyst will manage financial reporting, forecasting, variance analysis, Financial Outlook review, Business Plan support, and performance commentary for the assigned asset. Responsibilities include coordinating monthly, quarterly, and year-end close reporting processes; analyzing actual results versus forecasts and performance objectives; preparing management insights; supporting recurring performance discussions; and responding to ad hoc requests from Business Unit management and corporate stakeholders. The role is expected to work under limited supervision, support projects of medium scope and complexity, and apply detailed knowledge of the work function to improve business outcomes.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

Financial Analysis, Forecasting & Performance Management

• Analyze financial and operational performance, including Actuals vs. Forecast vs. Business Plan, current month vs. prior month, YTD, quarterly, and full-year results for CAPEX, OPEX, production, earnings, and cash flow.

• Provide clear, decision-focused commentary on key drivers, trends, risks, and opportunities to support management reviews and business performance discussions.

• Support forecast cycles, Business Plan preparation, and monthly Financial Outlook reviews by developing analysis, insights, and qualitative explanations for leadership and stakeholders.

• Perform financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate business alternatives, strategic opportunities, and potential performance issues.

• Support capital investment or divestment decisions by translating financial and operational data into actionable insights.

Reporting, Close & Data Stewardship

• Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end reporting processes related to budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting deliverables.

• Prepare monthly reporting commentary and ad hoc reports to explain variances and support Business Unit and corporate management needs.

• Validate data between source tools, reporting files, and operational systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, alignment, and consistency.

postings.title: Senior Refinery Planning & Economics Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Analyst responsible for optimizing refining margin through the economic evaluation of crudes, products and operating configurations, and for developing and executing the production schedule. The role combines economic and financial modelling, linear programming (LP) optimization and close coordination across trading, refining, logistics and commercial teams, acting as the technical reference for the team and as a strategic partner to management.
Key Responsibilities:

• Perform economic evaluations of crudes and feedstocks (assays, netbacks, differentials) and maintain valuation models to maximize refining margin.

• Build and update the LP model (PIMS) and the operating schedule (crude and unit scheduling, blending), aligned with sales, inventories and logistics constraints.

• Monitor crude, product and freight markets (Platts, Argus), identify arbitrage opportunities and margin risks, and support hedging decisions together with trading.

• Coordinate with Operations, Logistics, Trading and Commercial to ensure the plan is feasible and executed; track plan vs. actual performance and propose corrective actions.

• Support turnaround planning, assessing the economic impact and evaluating alternative supply and sales options.

• Produce executive reports and KPI dashboards (margins, yields, efficiency) and lead ad-hoc studies on new crudes and investment projects.

• Mentor and train junior analysts and contribute to the continuous improvement of the area's processes, models and tools.

Requirements:

• Degree in Engineering (Chemical, Petroleum or Industrial), Economics or a related field; a postgraduate degree (MBA or a Master's in Finance or Energy) is a plus.

• 5–8 years of experience in oil economics, refinery planning or crude and products trading, within a refining or integrated energy company.

• Proven experience with linear programming software (Aspen PIMS, Haverly GRTMPS, RPMS or similar), assay management and refinery process economics.

• Advanced Excel/VBA skills; Python, SQL or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and market data platforms (Platts, Argus, S&P Global) are valued.

• Advanced English.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Executive communication skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

postings.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

• Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

• A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.

• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

• World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will help create and execute the growth strategy for McKinsey clients' digital sales.

In this role, you will build top-performing B2B and B2C paid media programs and social advertising platforms as well as owned channels. You will be responsible for helping our marketing teams through the generation of significant insights. You will conduct data analysis, generate insights, and verify them with appropriate organizations within marketing, and you will share your recommendations with key business decision-makers.

You will tell stories with the data and enable growth marketing to make strategic decisions based on growth potential. You’ll work with data scientists and engineers, analysts and researchers to compile recommendations, develop capabilities and define requirements for projects that will help activate our strategic insights into the business. You will work with partners across digital marketing to improve the performance of clients' websites and digital marketing campaigns.

You will be based in our Buenos Aires or Santiago de Chile office as part of McKinsey Digital. McKinsey Digital brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses.

As part of this group, you’ll join a global team working on everything from IT modernization and strategy to agile, cloud, cybersecurity and digital transformation. You’ll typically work on projects across all industries and functions and will be fully integrated with the rest of our global firm. You’ll also work with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help our clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences and businesses, both on technology and non-technology topics.

Our office culture is casual, fun and social with an emphasis on education and innovation. We have the freedom to try new ideas, experiment and are expected to be constantly learning and growing. There is also a strong emphasis on mentoring others in the group, enabling them to grow and learn.

Your Qualifications and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree ideally in economics, business or engineering; advanced degree or specialization in digital is a plus

• 2+ years of experience in digital marketing industry is a must

• Knowledge of primary paid media, own media & analytics tools

• Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively - both verbally and in writing - in English and Spanish

• Willingness to travel

• Ser responsable de la generación, emisión y correcta ejecución de las Órdenes de Compra de las distintas marcas, definiendo cantidades y fechas en base a forecast, ventas, stock y tránsito, y coordinando con Comercial, Compras y Operaciones.

Seguimiento de Órdenes de Compra

• Realizar el seguimiento end-to-end de las POs, monitoreando fechas, cantidades, embarques y arribos, anticipando riesgos de demora o faltante y dando visibilidad a los equipos y a las marcas sobre su estado.

• Coordinar el seguimiento de las distintas etapas de las compras importadas (producción, embarque, tránsito, nacionalización y arribo), controlando diariamente embarques y movimientos de mercadería contra lo planificado.

Control y Gestión del PSI

• Liderar la preparación, actualización y controls del PSI semanal de Nintendo y de las demás marcas, consolidando compras, ventas y stock, validando la consistencia de la información y comunicando las conclusiones y acciones a seguir.

Control de Stock y Disponibilidad

• Monitorear el stock propio, en tránsito y en canales, calculando cobertura y rotación, detectando quiebres, sobrestock y producto de baja rotación, y proponiendo acciones para corregirlos en conjunto con Comercial y Operaciones.

• Velar por la exactitud del inventario, detectando discrepancias entre sistemas, depósito y reportes, y promoviendo su corrección.

• Mantener comunicación proactiva con Operaciones sobre la mercadería en tránsito y recibida (incluyendo Costa Oriental), consolidando y comunicando la disponibilidad a los equipos correspondientes.

Seguimiento y Análisis de Ventas

• Consolidar y analizar la información de Sell In y Sell Out por cliente, canal, categoría y SKU, identificando tendencias, estacionalidad, desvíos contra forecast y contra objetivos, y elaborando conclusiones accionables para Comercial y las marcas.

Gestión de Desvíos e Incidencias

• Detectar, analizar y dar seguimiento a desvíos o incidencias relacionados con Órdenes de Compra, stock, ventas e información, identificando la causa raíz y articulando con las áreas correspondientes para lograr una resolución ágil.

Forecast y Planificación

• Participar activamente en la construcción y actualización del Forecast y la planificación comercial, contrastándolo con las ventas reales, explicando variaciones relevantes y proponiendo ajustes.

• Colaborar en el armado del presupuesto, las metas de ventas y las proyecciones por marca, cliente y categoría, considerando rentabilidad y disponibilidad de producto.

Seguimiento de KPIs e Indicadores

• Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de Planning (cumplimiento de forecast, cobertura y rotación de stock, cumplimiento de fechas de POs, disponibilidad, avance de ventas por cliente, campaña y lanzamiento), detectando desvíos de manera temprana.

• Presentar periódicamente los resultados y las acciones correctivas propuestas a Comercial, Operaciones y las marcas.

Reportes y Herramientas de Planning

• Diseñar, mantener y mejorar los reportes, dashboards (Power BI / Looker Studio), bases de datos y trackers del equipo para el seguimiento de ventas, stock, órdenes de compra, lanzamientos y PSI, asegurando su confiabilidad y actualización.

• Preparar reportes periódicos y análisis ad-hoc solicitados por Planning, Comercial, Dirección o las marcas.

Propuestas de Mejora

• Analizar los procesos y la información de Planning, identificar oportunidades de mejora (eficiencia, calidad de datos, automatización, niveles de stock, tiempos de abastecimiento) y elaborar propuestas con su impacto esperado.

• Ejecutar e implementar las mejoras aprobadas, haciendo seguimiento de resultados y ajustando cuando sea necesario.

• Impulsar, junto con Sistemas, el uso de herramientas de BI, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial para reducir tareas manuales y mejorar la eficiencia y la calidad de la información.

Calidad de Datos y Sistemas

• Asegurar la correcta carga de información en los sistemas internos y el mapeo de productos y SKUs, detectando inconsistencias en la información recibida y coordinando su resolución con los equipos comerciales y/o clientes.

Soporte a Lanzamientos de Software

• Participar en las reuniones de nuevos lanzamientos, consolidando la información para su comunicación a Ventas y eCommerce, y dar seguimiento operativo hasta el arribo al país.

Reuniones con Marcas

• Participar en la preparación y presentación de información en las reuniones con las marcas, aportando análisis de ventas, stock, órdenes de compra y propuestas.

Acompañamiento del Equipo

• Ser referente funcional del Analista de Planificación Comercial, guiando su trabajo, revisando la calidad de sus entregables y compartiendo criterios y buenas prácticas.

Requisitos y Competencias

• Estudiante de Administración, Comercialización, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing o afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en Planning, Supply Chain, Compras, Comercial, Operaciones o posiciones similares (deseable en consumo masivo, tecnología, electrónica o gaming).

• Experiencia comprobable en gestión y seguimiento de Órdenes de Compra, importaciones, y control de stock e inventarios.\

• Excluyente: dominio avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets (tablas dinámicas, funciones avanzadas, análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos).

• Excluyente: conocimiento de herramientas de BI y visualización (Power BI y/o Looker Studio).

• Experiencia en armado de presupuestos, metas de ventas y proyecciones, deseable.

• Conocimiento de comercio exterior e importaciones (Incoterms, tiempos de nacionalización, logística), deseable.

• Experiencia con sistemas ERP y con herramientas de reporting, deseable.

• Uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al análisis y la productividad, valorado.

• Inglés avanzado, deseable.

• Competencias: iniciativa y proactividad, capacidad de análisis, orientación a resultados y a la mejora continua.

• Organización y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y deadlines, con autonomía en sus responsabilidades.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y trabajo colaborativo con Comercial, Operaciones, Compras, Finanzas, clientes y partners.

La persona seleccionada recibirá una oferta de empleo condicional, sujeta a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes realizada por un proveedor externo contratado por la compañía. Los requisitos específicos de verificación podrán variar según la posición y pueden incluir uno o más de los siguientes: verificación de antecedentes penales, verificación crediticia, validación de experiencia laboral, verificación de estudios académicos y revisión del historial de conducción.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Master Planning Specialist to support forecasting and demand planning activities across a designated product portfolio. The successful candidate will play a key role in improving forecast accuracy, supporting inventory planning decisions, monitoring product lifecycle transitions, and providing reporting and analytical insights that enable effective business and operational planning. Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain demand forecasts across multiple product categories, planning horizons, and business segments, utilizing statistical analysis and business inputs.

• Prepare, maintain, and validate forecasting models, attach-rate plans, and volume plans to support operational planning activities.

• Coordinate forecasting reviews with Product Managers, Marketing Operations, and Commercial teams to ensure business assumptions are accurately reflected in planning outputs.

• Support Supply Planning and Inventory Management teams by providing demand insights related to inventory optimization, new product introductions, product transitions, and phase-outs.

• Monitor forecast performance and key planning metrics, including forecast accuracy, serviceability, inventory health, and planning effectiveness.

• Maintain data quality within demand planning systems, ensuring accurate reporting, master data integrity, and timely updates to planning assumptions.

• Prepare dashboards, planning reports, business reviews, and executive presentations to support decision-making and cross-functional alignment.

Required Qualifications

• Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, modeling, reporting, and large dataset management.

• Fluent English, with strong verbal and written communication skills for collaboration with global stakeholders.

• Experience with demand planning, forecasting, or supply chain planning tools.

El objetivo principal de la posición es garantizar la disponibilidad de los productos importados, brindar soporte integral a la fuerza de ventas, específicamente dentro del canal OFF Trade, y mantener actualizados y precisos los datos maestros en SAP.

Para ello, sus principales responsabilidades serán

• Gestión de pedidos y facturación Procesar pedidos de venta en SAP. Gestionar las modificaciones solicitadas de SKUs/cantidades, ejecutar débitos a terceros y gestionar los procesos de refacturación.

• Datos maestros y alta de clientes Gestionar de punta a punta la creación y el mantenimiento de las cuentas de clientes (internos y externos), actualizando datos de contacto, cronogramas de entrega y registros fiscales.

• Soporte al equipo comercial y al canal Off-Trade Mantener las carteras de los ejecutivos, actualizar las estructuras de descuentos y generar reportes de descuentos. Dar soporte al canal OFF Trade mediante el seguimiento de volúmenes de venta, presupuestos, datos de mercado y acciones de Trade Marketing.

• Cumplimiento y registros Gestionar los registros ante el Instituto Nacional de Alimentos para productos destilados, mantener las licencias de importación, realizar el seguimiento de certificados de baterías y supervisar el cumplimiento del etiquetado de importación.

Proyectar los pagos previstos de impuestos y aranceles para Tesorería.

Nivel Educativo Título universitario en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Comercio Exterior o carreras afines.

Experiencia requerida Entre 2 y 3 años de experiencia profesional en posiciones de Demand Planning, análisis comercial o planificación. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia previa en gestión de importaciones y procesos aduaneros.

Competencias conductuales Buscamos una persona metódica, organizada, proactiva, dinámica y flexible, con capacidad para adaptarse y gestionar múltiples requerimientos y prioridades. Deberá contar con sólidas habilidades analíticas, atención al detalle y excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales. Se valorará la capacidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa con los equipos comerciales.

Beneficios

• Target Bonus Anual

• Cobertura de Salud SMG para vos y tu grupo familiar primario

• Seguro Vida Adicional (12 Salarios)

• Reintegro de guarderia hasta 4 Años (Inclusive)

• Descuentos en Wellhub

• Beneficios de Licencia Parental

• 15 días hábiles de vacaciones

• Día libre de cumpleaños

• Modalidad híbrida 3x2

• Viernes Flex

• Celular Compañía

• Canasta Trimestal de Productos MH

• 45% - 50% de descuento en productos propios MH

• 46% - 48% de descuento en Cosméticos y Perfumes LVMH

• 20% - 30% de descuento en nuestras bodegas y bistrós Chandon Argentina y Terrazas de los Andes

Moët Hennessy, la división de vinos y espirituosos de LVMH, agrupa veinticinco Maisons . Nuestra misión es "Crafting Experiences". Nuestra visión es liderar el futuro de los vinos y espirituosos de lujo desde la naturaleza hasta las comunidades.

postings.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Insights & Analytics

ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.   

What You’ll Do

• Lead research engagements to understand how reimbursement dynamics, prior authorization burdens, and step therapy requirements shape prescribing and patient access

• Leverage analytic techniques to use data to guide client and ZS team decision-making.

• Build pricing and access strategy recommendations grounded in payer intelligence, competitive dynamics, and product value narratives

• Synthesize and communicate results to clients and ZS teams through oral and written presentations.

• Develop client relationships and serve as key point of contact on aspects of projects.

• Manage key project workstreams end-to-end, coordinating research design, recruitment, fieldwork, and analysis on deadline

• Design custom analyses in software such as R, Tableau, SAS, SQL, Visual Basic and Excel to investigate and inform client needs.

• Provide client and ZS teams project status updates.

• Create project deliverables and implement solutions.

• Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities;

• Guide and mentor Associates on teams.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor's or master's degree required in any discipline with strong record of academic success in quantitative and analytic coursework such as operations research, applied mathematics, management science, data science, statistics, econometrics or engineering.

• 3+ years of post-collegiate consulting experience in market access, payer strategy, or reimbursement research experience in or serving the pharmaceutical industry.

• Understanding of pharmaceutical pricing strategy, including WAC, net pricing, contracting, and value-based arrangements

• High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative.

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

• Empathy, adaptability and emotional intelligence.

• Close attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset.

• Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks.

• Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, working in teams.

• Fluency in English

• Client-first mentality

• Intense work ethic

• Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

• Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways

• Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities

• Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in Argentina, visit ZS Argentina office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To complete your application:

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

postings.descriptionText:
En Mercado Libre estamos democratizando el comercio y los servicios financieros para transformar la vida de las personas de América Latina. ¡Sumate a este propósito!

A través de Mercado Crédito, ofrecemos créditos para satisfacer las necesidades de las personas que utilizan nuestros servicios y para ayudar a potenciar el negocio a quienes venden a través de nuestra plataforma.

• Vibran energía emprendedora: se mueven por la curiosidad, nunca se rinden y se enfocan en superar sus propios límites.

• Dan el máximo porque les gusta trabajar con compromiso y dedicación.

• Viven los cambios como oportunidades y aprenden de sus errores.

• La excelencia y la ejecución son claves en su forma de hacer las cosas.

• Promueven el buen clima, aportan alegría y diversión.

• Saben cómo construir con otras personas y disfrutan trabajando en equipo.

Imaginate emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de:

• Realizar análisis cuantitativos del negocio sobre mora, adopción, rentabilidad con aperturas de segmentos, cohortes y modelos, a fin de potenciar el negocio.

• Coordinar el backtesting de modelos de Machine Learning: Churn, BHV, Adoption, Sales forecasting, entre otros, aplicando las mejores prácticas.

• Llevar adelante el diseño, lanzamiento y análisis de A/B testings sobre distintas bases de usuarios, armado de encendidos, cuantificación de bases y comunicación a la unidad de negocios del impacto en las ofertas de crédito.

• Tener experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos, indicadores financieros y riesgo crediticio.

• Contar con conocimientos avanzados de Excel y SQL.

Te proponemos:

• Ser parte de una compañía con espíritu emprendedor en la que nos encanta pensar en grande y a largo plazo.

• Ser protagonista de tu desarrollo en un ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizaje, crecimiento, expansión y proyectos desafiantes.

• Compartir y aprender en equipo junto a grandes profesionales y especialistas.

postings.descriptionText:
Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Job Summary

The GDS Alliance Business Intelligence & Operations Strategist will function out of the GDS AlliancePartner Operations COE and be responsible for providing ongoing data and operations support for the EY-Microsoft Alliance. Leveraging a deep understanding of and focus on the EY-Microsoft Alliance business, this role will collaborate with the Financial Reporting function to: prepare comprehensive reporting, analyze business trends/ variances/ discrepancies, identify and help mitigate data issues, address stakeholder concerns and work to resolution of complex data issues. This role will also be involved in the day-to-day operations of the Alliance as outlined below.

Essential Functions Of The Job

• Act as a trusted advisor to the Microsoft Alliance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders by translating complex data, operational signals and competing priorities into practical recommendations, scenario options and leadership actions

• Provide Alliance leadership with business insights and effective reporting which includes collaborating with the Finance function to:

• Perform extensive analysis of weekly, monthly, and annual results

• Produce customized Revenue, Sales and Pipeline visualizations, analsyses, and insights

• Support Opportunity Management via taxonomy, keywords, and solution mapping across EY and Microsoft products

• Prospect tracking and reporting; key wins tracking for leadership reporting

• Spearhead digital transformation initiatives in coordination with the Finance Reporting team

• Act as the voice of the business to drive, design, develop, deploy, and maintain a BI-driven transformation of both business and financial reporting using Power BI and SQL

• Develop/refine a sophisticated and Microsoft focused reporting infrastructure beyond the global dashboards, ensuring seamless report generation for global Alliance operations

• Enhance efficiency through automation and digital integration to improve processes and foster business growth

• Lead cross-functional alignment across alliance teams, sales, finance, enablement, marketing, sectors, regions, technology and data teams to ensure reporting and analytics outcomes support strategic goals, stakeholder needs and enterprise priorities

• Help shape executive narratives for monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews, steering committees, strategic planning cycles, investment reviews, leadership forums and governance discussions, including clear “so what” interpretation of trends, variances and performance drivers

• Program Manage various initiatives around processes and tools provided by Alliance Partners which may include: Administration and maintenance of partner tools, portals, etc. Access request tracking, access issue resolution Certifications tracking; skill and competency tracking.

• Ensure Alliance-related reference material is systematically reviewed and refreshed; facilitate and track access to these materials in Sharepoint and other tools

• Manage onshore stakeholder expectations, plans and communication

• Maintain strong stakeholder governance by preparing materials, facilitating leadership discussions, documenting actions, tracking follow-ups and ensuring disciplined communication across senior stakeholder groups.

• Partner with onshore Alliance Enablement contacts on strategic projects and initiatives as and when required

Knowledge And Skill Requirements

• Executive-level understanding of business performance management, revenue operations, alliance operations, business intelligence, sales operations, pipeline reporting, KPI governance, investment tracking, value realization and leadership dashboarding.

• Strong commercial and strategic acumen across pipeline, revenue influence, sales motions, partner ecosystem performance, opportunity management and lifecycle, solution activation, go-to-market programs, co-investment and growth performance.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, surface inconsistencies, frame trade-offs and convert business performance insights into practical executive decisions and action plans.

• Strong understanding of alliance-led growth priorities, partner ecosystem models, joint go-to-market motions, business reviews, enablement priorities, investment governance and the way these translate into performance measures and leadership actions.

• Advanced capability in executive reporting and storytelling, including creation of board-style narratives, scenario options, performance commentary, risk posture summaries, leadership briefings and concise “so what” insights.

• Data Analytics: experience working with large data sets and analyzing through a business lens

• Collaboration: experience working in a matrixed environment and translating between functional areas to achieve the best outcomes

• Problem-Solving: proven ability in evaluation, root cause analysis, and mitigation, with strong interpersonal skills and analytical thinking

• Technology Aptitude & Proficiency: experience and/or academic background demonstrating proficiency in technology; advanced skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint; competence in Power BI

• Stakeholder Management: experience working with senior onshore stakeholders and an ability to develop trusted advisor relationships

• Global Mindset: experience with virtual working across multiple geographies, demonstrating cultural sensitivity

• Project Management: competence in managing project budgets, execution, and tracking, with strong time management abilities to prioritize and organize multiple projects with varying deadlines

• Decision-Making: strong ability to make decisions that enhance processes and drive business growth

• Communication: excellent written and oral communication in English, with strong business writing skills and the ability to create content independently

• Knowledge Sharing: ability to foster an environment that encourages knowledge sharing and best practices

• Teamwork and Multitasking: promote effective teamwork while managing multiple tasks efficiently

• Alliance/Partner Programs: experience working with Alliance or Partner programs in a professional services or technology environment

• Organizational Knowledge: understanding of EY & GDS operations, including organizational structure and operating models (for internal candidates), and Big 4 consultancy experience in leadership support or strategic environments (for external candidates)

Job Requirements

Academics: Bachelor's Degree - Project/Program Management and certification would be an added advantage

Experience:15+ Years of work experience

Working Hours: Flexible, based on assignment

Note:

This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the job. However, it is not an all-inclusive listing of the required job functions and functions may vary depending business requirements, on the geographic location of the job and/or the manager. Further, the job description is subject to change at the discretion of management.

Position Overview

We are seeking a motivated senior analyst to support and maintain multiple reporting and analytics applications, including SAP BI (WebI), Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services (Cubes), SAS Business Rules, Workiva, ARM and related tools. • Apply logical reasoning and SQL knowledge to understand report logic, data filtering, validations, and performance optimization.

• Strong logical reasoning skills and practical experience with SQL.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Power Query, and Power BI.

• Experience in reporting, analytics, or application support roles, with a focus on user support and issue resolution.

postings.title: Workforce Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando un/a Workforce Analyst para sumarse a nuestro equipo regional de Operaciones. ¿Te sumas?

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

• Gestionar las proyecciones de demanda y carga de recepciones por tienda, día y hora a través de flujos de trabajo estandarizados.

• Asegurar la parametrización del sistema de planificación para determinar las necesidades de personal (staffing) necesarias por tienda, integrando información de los mercados locales.

• Coordinar la planificación de turnos para PedidosYa Market a nivel regional mediante modelos escalables de generación de curvas y ajustes operativos.

• Analizar los turnos planificados en los mercados de LATAM, detectando desvíos de cobertura y oportunidades de mejora para maximizar la precisión en la asignación.

• Desarrollar análisis estadísticos para optimizar la asignación y distribución de tareas operativas mediante nuestras plataformas de planificación.

Requisitos

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

• Formación universitaria completa o avanzada en Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

• Manejo avanzado y autónomo de SQL para la consulta, extracción y procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de información.

• Capacidad analítica sólida con enfoque en la resolución de problemas complejos, identificando causas raíz y entendiendo el "por qué" detrás de cada métrica.

• Mindset orientado a la toma de decisiones basadas en datos, con habilidad para transformar diagnósticos en recomendaciones con impacto directo en el negocio.

• Interés por la optimización de procesos operativos y la comprensión integral del ecosistema de planificación de la compañía.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

postings.title: Rider Payments Optimization Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando un/a Rider Payments Optimization Specialist para impulsar la mejora continua de la performance de la flota de repartidores en LATAM.

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

• Definir la estrategia regional de la propuesta de valor de pagos, analizando el comportamiento de los repartidores y competidores para optimizar la retención y disponibilidad.

• Diseñar y optimizar esquemas de pago dinámicos, garantizando una estructura competitiva para los repartidores y sostenible para la operación.

• Liderar las proyecciones y la planificación de costos regionales de entrega, evaluando su impacto en el estado de pérdidas y ganancias (P&L) junto al área de Finanzas.

• Establecer marcos de trabajo y mejores prácticas regionales para la optimización continua de los mecanismos de monetización de la flota.

• Liderar la experiencia de usuario de pagos dentro de la aplicación de repartidores, mejorando la usabilidad y transparencia de ganancias, balances y propinas.

Requisitos

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Formación universitaria completa en Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.

• Experiencia profesional previa en estrategia, planificación financiera, análisis de rendimiento (performance), pricing o analítica de productos.

• Dominio avanzado y autónomo de SQL, Excel y plataformas de visualización de datos (se valorará experiencia en Python, R o producto digital).

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de modelos de costos, seguimiento de KPIs financieros/operativos y análisis cuantitativos end-to-end.

• Nivel de idioma inglés avanzado (oral y escrito) para la comunicación y trabajo diario con equipos globales.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; capable of presenting findings and technical details clearly to both technical and business audiences.

• Aptitude for rapid learning and a proactive approach to adapting new technologies, methodologies, and industry trends.

• Fluency in English.

Additional Skills:

• Familiarity with un-structured data processing techniques .

• Comfortable utilizing Gen AI-powered productivity tools and understanding of their impact on project delivery and efficiency.

• Familiarity with web development fundamentals, front-end frameworks, API & Web Services, business process engineering .

How you’ll grow:

• Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways

• Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities

• Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in Argentina, visit ZS Argentina office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Are you a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of complex data and real-world operations? We are seeking a high-impact Senior Analyst to join our team as a core functional specialist. This is a mission-critical role where you will not just support the operation—you will actively architect the strategies that drive it.

This is a holistic role that acts as the connective tissue across all operational teams, ensuring alignment and driving high-velocity execution.

You will serve as the engine behind our most ambitious operational goals. We aren't looking for someone to just execute tasks; we are looking for a proactive problem-solver who sees the "big picture," identifies inefficiencies, and transforms them into scalable competitive advantages. From city-level portfolio management to large-scale cross-functional projects, you will own the outcome, the process, and the insight.

In this role, you'll be...

You will be the functional specialist driving analysis and execution, evolving our systems and processes. Your core responsibilities will include:

• Strategic Architect: Design and deploy growth strategies for a portfolio of cities, moving beyond simple management to setting the objectives that teams depend on.

• Operational Bridge: Act as the primary operational authority, facilitating seamless cross-team collaboration and ensuring data flows effectively to drive decision-making.

• Insight-Driven Performance: Own the narrative behind our metrics. You won't just monitor city performance; you will derive the actionable insights that influence our business strategy.

• Project Leadership: Take the reins on complex, high-stakes initiatives. You will define the roadmap, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure we move with speed and precision.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

• Experience: 3+ years in Strategy, Operations, or Analyst roles. While direct product experience is a plus, we prioritize candidates with a high "learning velocity" and a proven track record of solving tough, ambiguous problems.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Engineering, Economics, or related discipline).

• Data-Driven Mindset: SQL proficiency is essential, and you are fluent in the language of data, able to translate complex data into clear, persuasive business strategies.

• Language Proficiency: Professional proficiency in English.

• Collaborative Influence: You are a "people-person" who can align disparate teams around a single goal and adapt communication to influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Independent Ownership: You excel with minimal guidance, identifying problems proactively and solving them with autonomy and agility.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Resumen De Trabajo

Proporciona soporte técnico experto al canal de servicio de Cummins Inc.

Responsabilidades Clave

Lidera la investigación de los problemas del producto o del sistema, entiende los mecanismos causales, recomienda acciones apropiadas. Respalda el proceso de análisis de fallas en modos de falla comunes (p. ej., solicitud de información del producto, [Product Information Request, PIR], fallas de causa común [Common Cause Failures, CCR], fallas difíciles de diagnosticar [Hard to Diagnose, HTD], solicitud de soporte técnico [Technical Support Request, TSR]).

Documenta los resultados de las acciones de diagnóstico y reparación en la base de datos adecuada de forma clara y concisa.

Lleva a cabo la gestión del conocimiento al compartir el conocimiento adquirido con otros equipos a través del sistema de gestión del conocimiento (Knowledge Management System, KMS), tickets de servició rápido en línea (Quick Serve Online tickets, QSOL), capacitaciones, etc.

Brinda soporte de recursos de expertos técnicos en el sitio cuando sea necesario.

Realiza aportes técnicos para el análisis y las decisiones sobre políticas.

Se comunica para garantizar que los territorios estén bien informados y que se programen reuniones con regularidad entre los grupos de equipos/funciones/clientes.

Investiga problemas emergentes, así como problemas relacionados con los productos o procesos en el campo y ofrece soluciones técnicas sólidas.

Ayuda con las campañas de acción de campo y programas de cuidado inicial/introducción al paquete de valor (Value Package Introduction, VPI) cuando sea necesario y esté disponible.

Prioriza la seguridad en todo lugar con el objetivo de que no se sufran lesiones.

Brinda orientación a técnicos con menos experiencia sobre problemas técnicos y resolución de problemas para respaldar a nuestros clientes de una manera más eficiente.

Proporciona soporte al cliente y al producto en el campo y, a la vez, actúa como un enlace durante las derivaciones al gerente técnico del territorio (Technical Territory Manager, TTM)/ingeniería para la mejora y reparación de productos. Implementa las mejoras del paso 3 después de obtener las aprobaciones correspondientes.

Habilidades

Investigación de campo y apoyo - Recopila y comunica información técnica, tanto interna como externamente, entre solucionadores de problemas técnicos y el canal de servicio sobre problemas relacionados con productos o procesos mediante el uso de técnicas comprobadas de resolución de problemas para que los problemas se resuelvan rápidamente y para satisfacción de los clientes.

Informes de fallas del producto y sistemas de acción correctiva/preventiva - Define y lidera un proceso para registrar, priorizar y resolver fallas de productos utilizando revisiones interfuncionales, métodos rigurosos de resolución de problemas, procesos fallidos de transferencia de piezas, herramientas de administración de datos y prácticas de administración de proyectos para mejorar de manera efectiva y eficiente la confiabilidad del producto.

Solución de problemas del producto - Resuelve problemas de productos usando un proceso que protege al cliente; determina la causa asignable; implementa soluciones sólidas basadas en datos; e identifica las causas principales sistémicas y las acciones recomendadas para evitar la recurrencia del problema.

Gestión técnica del cliente - Representa a Cummins para nuestros clientes al ser la interfaz para todos los aspectos técnicos; proporciona datos de ingeniería, documentación y capacitación a los clientes para apoyar el diseño y la integración de los equipos; asegura de que el negocio del cliente no se vea interrumpido por la administración de los cambios de productos de Cummins a través del uso de nuestros procesos de cambio y las comunicaciones regulares con el desarrollo de productos y el cliente.

Resiliencia - Capacidad para recuperarse de los contratiempos y la adversidad cuando se enfrentan situaciones difíciles.

Colabora - Crear asociaciones y trabajar en colaboración con otras personas para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.

Comunica efectivamente - Desarrollar y generar comunicaciones multimodales que transmitan una clara comprensión de las necesidades exclusivas de diferentes audiencias.

Enfoque en el cliente - Cultivar relaciones sólidas con los clientes y ofrecer soluciones centradas en el cliente.

Empuje por obtener resultados - Lograr resultados de manera consistente, aun bajo circunstancias difíciles.

Maneja la complejidad - Dar sentido a una gran cantidad de información compleja, y a veces contradictoria, para resolver problemas de manera eficaz.

Ingenio - Conseguir y desplegar recursos de manera eficaz y eficiente.

Aplicación de diagnóstico - Traduce quejas de clientes p/ desarrollar plan de solución de prob.; soluciona el prob. después de flujos de trabajo guiados, procedimientos, equipos especializados como hmtas. de servicio mecánicas y electr., y diagnostica software de PC p/ aislar componentes fallidos p/ permitir reparación exitosa; valida reparación duplicando la queja p/ asegurar que se ha resuelto; documenta resultados de solución de prob. en sist. comerciales p/ comunicar lo que se ha hecho p/ pago y seguimiento histórico.

Documentación de servicio - Crea y verifica el cliente, el equipo y la información técnica; captura datos específicos mediante las herramientas de servicio necesarias; sigue los procedimientos y documentos requeridos de la información en el sistema de gestión de servicios para tener un registro preciso del trabajo realizado.

Escalada técnica - Obtiene información sobre el problema técnico del producto y utiliza los recursos disponibles, incluidas las herramientas de gestión de datos; eleva los problemas a un nivel más alto de experiencia, equilibrando la puntualidad de la respuesta del cliente con los esfuerzos de investigación; captura todos los pasos de solución de problemas en la base de datos adecuada para garantizar transiciones perfectas y respuestas precisas para la resolución de tickets de manera oportuna.

Valora las diferencias - Reconocer el valor que las diferentes perspectivas y culturas aportan a una organización.

Educación, Licencias y Certificaciones

Se da máxima prioridad a los candidatos que cuenten con un título terciario, universitario o equivalente en ingeniería o en un área relacionada, o es obligatorio contar con experiencia equivalente relevante.

Este cargo puede requerir licencias para cumplir con controles de exportación o regulaciones de sanciones.

Experiencia

Es obligatorio contar con un nivel básico o intermedio de experiencia laboral relevante. Se da prioridad a los candidatos con experiencia en un rol técnico.

El Administrador de Desempeño y Confiabilidad es responsable de monitorear, analizar y gestionar el desempeño operacional de la flota bajo contrato en el Proyecto Vicuña, asegurando la integridad de la información técnica, operacional y contractual necesaria para la toma de decisiones, mejora de confiabilidad y cumplimiento de los objetivos del negocio.

Actúa como nexo entre la operación onsite, el equipo comercial, Supply Chain y el cliente, transformando información operativa en indicadores de gestión, análisis de tendencias y reportes ejecutivos que permitan optimizar la disponibilidad de los equipos, reducir tiempos de inactividad y mejorar la eficiencia de las operaciones de mantenimiento.

Responsabilidades Locales

Gestión de KPI Operacionales

• Monitorear y reportar los principales indicadores operativos del contrato.

postings.title: Strategic WFM Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Role Overview

The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modelling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM maths and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity.

What You’ll Do

• Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.

• Modelling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage.

• Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature roll outs, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius.

• Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments.

• Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership.

• Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths.

• Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs.

• Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine.

What We’re Looking For

• Strategic WFM Maths: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modelling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python.

• Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk.

• Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with back tested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority.

• Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction.

• WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler.

Hiring Process

• Application

• Diagnostic Case Study

• Case Study Interview - Technical & Capacity Interview

• Executive Judgement & Strategic Interview

• Culture Interview (People Ops)

• Offer

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $50K - $110K

postings.title: RevOps Lead
postings.descriptionText:
See something that should exist? Build it.

See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific , every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

What makes someone a Terrific RevOps Lead?

This role is for someone who wants to own the commercial operating layer, not just maintain it.

A strong Terrific RevOps Lead brings structure where there is ambiguity, discipline where there is leakage, and visibility where there are blind spots. They know how to build clean systems across HubSpot, forecasting, commissions, and reporting — and they understand that the point of doing that well is to help the company sell, scale, and make better decisions.

They are energized by high ownership, strong standards, and the opportunity to support a revenue motion at the intersection of social commerce, e-commerce, and media .

About The Role

Terrific is hiring a Revenue Operations Lead to build the operating backbone of our revenue organization.

Right now, no one fully owns pipeline hygiene, HubSpot, reporting, or forecasting. This role is designed to architect it.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a hands-on build role for someone who can bring structure, discipline, and visibility to the revenue engine. You will help leadership understand pipeline health, forecast more accurately, track performance more clearly, and eliminate invisible leakage across the commercial team.

You should be excited by the opportunity to take a messy but high-leverage environment and turn it into a reliable operating system.

What You’ll Own

• HubSpot administration and structure

• Pipeline hygiene and stage discipline

• Forecasting model and forecast reporting

• Commission and quota tracking

• Weekly revenue reporting for leadership

• Core revenue operations processes across the sales team

What Success Looks Like In The First 90 Days

• HubSpot is fully structured with clear stages, owners, close dates, and ARR values

• Weekly revenue report is automated and sent every Monday to leadership

• Forecast model is live and actively used

• Pipeline visibility is materially cleaner, more accurate, and more actionable

• Core revenue processes are operating with more consistency and accountability

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain a clean, scalable HubSpot environment

• Define and enforce pipeline stages, required fields, ownership rules, and deal hygiene standards

• Improve CRM discipline across deal stages, close dates, next steps, and ARR values

• Build dashboards and reports that give leadership clear visibility into pipeline, conversion, forecast, and revenue performance

• Design and manage commission and quota tracking from scratch

• Stand up a practical forecasting model that leadership can rely on

• Support weekly revenue operating rhythms through accurate reporting and system discipline

• Identify process gaps, inconsistencies, and sources of commercial leakage, then fix them

• Work closely with leadership to improve commercial visibility and operating rigor

• Help create a stronger operating foundation for a scaling revenue organization

Requirements

• 3-5+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations

• Strong hands-on experience as a HubSpot or Salesforce administrator

• Experience building or rebuilding CRM structure, pipeline stages, dashboards, workflows, and reporting from scratch

• Experience designing and managing commission and quota tracking

• Strong understanding of core SaaS revenue metrics, including:

• ARR

• churn

• NRR

• pipeline coverage

• Strong grasp of forecasting mechanics and pipeline management discipline

• Comfortable working in an early or scaling environment where systems still need to be built

• An understanding, and passion, for social media commerce, e-commerce and media

This role is not for you if

• You’ve mainly supported RevOps processes but haven’t truly owned them

• You prefer maintaining existing systems over building structure from scratch

• You need a large team around you to execute

• You are strongest as a report-builder but weaker on commercial logic and operating discipline

• You are looking for a broad operations title without wanting deep accountability

Why this role matters

This role has immediate leverage across the business.

By fixing CRM structure, forecasting, reporting, and incentives, you will help eliminate invisible revenue leakage and give leadership a much clearer view of performance. This is a role with direct commercial impact from day one.

Required:

• Deep experience in at least one of Terrific’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1

• Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English

Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.

Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific.

Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

• Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to gather analytics requirements, translate them into scoped technical projects, and produce Point of Views (POVs) on measurement trends or platform changes as needed.

• Stay current on privacy-driven shifts in measurement, including consent mode, server-side tagging, and cookieless tracking, and bring practical responses to those changes into the team's standard approach.

• Experience building and maintaining proactive monitoring infrastructure, including Looker Studio dashboards and GA4 or GTM-based alerts, to detect data quality issues such as traffic drops or tag failures across multiple client properties before clients report them.

Who You Are:
What We Really Want:

• Someone who still enjoys the implementation craft but is ready to be responsible for more than their own output. You can write a data layer spec, spot a broken tag, and explain what the data means to a non-technical stakeholder, all in the same week. • Experience with server-side tagging via GTM Server and working knowledge of consent management platforms (CMPs).

• Familiarity with mobile app analytics implementation using Firebase or AppsFlyer.

• Exposure to additional TMS platforms such as Tealium or Adobe Launch is a plus, as is experience with CDPs like Tealium AudienceStream or BlueConic.

• A track record of producing clean technical documentation, including SDRs and tag collection guides, that others can actually work from.

• Some experience managing or mentoring others, formally or informally.

How You Succeed:
You're succeeding when the tracking is solid, the documentation is trusted, and the analysis is changing how people make decisions. Your team ships clean implementations, QA is thorough before anything goes live, and stakeholders come to you first when something looks wrong in the data or a new measurement requirement lands on the table.

postings.title: Sr. Applied Data Scientist
postings.descriptionText:
About You

You are an experienced Data Scientist with strong applied Machine Learning expertise and a track record of building and evaluating models using real-world, messy, large-scale data. You are comfortable working with embeddings, semantic similarity, LLMs, NLP, classification, and both supervised and unsupervised learning. You approach ambiguous problems through structured experimentation, clearly defined hypotheses, baselines, metrics, and error analysis.

You are highly autonomous, intellectually honest about experimental results, and able to clearly communicate technical recommendations and trade-offs to engineering and business stakeholders.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

• 5+ years of professional Data Science / Machine Learning experience.

• Strong applied Machine Learning fundamentals.

• Excellent Python and SQL skills.

• Hands-on experience with embeddings and semantic similarity.

• Practical experience applying LLMs to real-world problems.

• Experience with supervised and unsupervised learning.

• Strong experience with classification and NLP.

• Working knowledge of neural networks and transformer architectures.

• Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, PyCaret, or equivalent ML frameworks.

• Experience retraining or maintaining classification models in production.

• Strong experimental design and model evaluation skills.

• Experience defining baselines, metrics, test sets, and error-analysis processes.

• Ability to evaluate model quality and demonstrate measurable improvements.

• Strong understanding of scalability and ML inference costs.

• Strong English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

• Entity resolution, record linkage, or deduplication experience.

• Ranking and similarity scoring.

• Retrieval, clustering, or candidate-generation techniques.

• LLM/embedding solutions designed for cost and scale constraints.

• Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.

• Experience with company, domain, website, or firmographic data.

• Experience working with multilingual datasets.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

• Build and evaluate ML approaches for company/entity matching.

• Develop embedding and LLM-based matching approaches.

• Develop scoring and ranking methodologies to identify true matches and distinguish them from duplicates, lookalikes, and unrelated entities.

• Work with messy data, including names, aliases, domains, websites, firmographic attributes, multilingual records, and data hierarchies.

• Define benchmark datasets, metrics, baselines, and error-analysis processes.

• Design and execute experiments to validate hypotheses.

• Compare LLM-assisted approaches against lower-cost alternatives.

• Analyze model behavior, edge cases, and trade-offs.

• Consider inference economics and scalability from the beginning.

• Communicate experimental findings and recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders.

• Independently establish experimental pipelines and research approaches.

• Clearly document both successful and unsuccessful experiments.

What Sets You Apart

• Strong analytical and experimental mindset.

• Intellectual honesty and willingness to communicate negative results.

• Strong autonomy and self-direction.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Ability to defend technical recommendations with stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills.

• Comfort working with ambiguity and large-scale datasets.

• Ability to balance model quality, cost, and scalability.

Additional Information
About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Algunos de los desafíos del rol

• Definir y ejecutar el roadmap de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial, alineado con la estrategia de adopción de IA de la compañía.

• Priorizar la demanda de iniciativas considerando valor esperado, factibilidad, madurez de datos y nivel de riesgo.

• Gestionar el portafolio de casos de uso, realizando seguimiento de resultados, impacto generado y oportunidades de mejora.

• Trabajar de manera coordinada con equipos de Data Engineering, Data Governance, Self Service, RPA y otras áreas de Tecnología para garantizar soluciones integradas y escalables.

• Acompañar a las áreas de negocio en la formulación de problemas, definición de métricas de éxito y desarrollo de productos basados en datos.

• Liderar el ciclo de vida completo de soluciones de machine learning e inteligencia artificial, desde la conceptualización y validación hasta la puesta en producción y monitoreo.

• Definir estándares técnicos, metodologías y criterios de calidad para el desarrollo y operación de modelos.

• Impulsar iniciativas de innovación mediante la identificación y evaluación de nuevas tecnologías aplicadas a desafíos concretos del negocio.

• Participar en la construcción del marco de gobierno de productos de IA, promoviendo prácticas de desarrollo responsable, trazabilidad y monitoreo.

• Liderar, desarrollar y acompañar al equipo de Data Scientists, ML Engineers y especialistas en IA, promoviendo su crecimiento técnico y profesional.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a Retail/CPG project focused on pricing and demand analytics. In this role, you will build the models that help the business decide how to price, promote and position its products, measuring how price changes affect demand, how products influence each other, and where cannibalization erodes margin.

Your work will have a direct impact on sales and profitability. You will take problems from data exploration to production-ready AI/ML solutions, working closely with engineering and product teams, and translating complex findings into clear recommendations for key stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Process and analyze structured and unstructured data to uncover trends, patterns and actionable insights that inform business strategy.
