postings.title: Technology Development Program Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

About The Department

The Technology Development group is an integral organization of Allegro that includes Device Development, Foundry Operations, Modeling, ESD/EMC, and Design Enablement teams. The group facilitates all semiconductor devices and design automation research and development programs from concept through maturity. We ensure that the technology roadmap is aligned with the product roadmap and work across organizations. We manage partnerships with external foundries and suppliers to deliver cutting-edge semiconductor devices and design automation tools to support the product roadmap.

The Opportunity

The Technology Development Program Manager will report to the Principal Technical Program Manager and is responsible for the semiconductor technology development process, managing technology development communications, and driving the cross-functional engineering level technology development. The Program Manager serves as an interface to internal cross-functional teams (Advanced Packaging, Product Development, Sourcing, Quality, Assembly/Test, etc.). Candidate will drive consistent technology development business processes across the programs and continually improve those processes. Leadership, project management, technology expertise, process improvement, and problem solving are key qualities to be able to influence internal cross-functional engineering teams, Allegro leadership, and foundries to make sure that the technology development plans are on track to support the product roadmap and that the teams are using the best business processes to efficiently achieve this goal. The candidate will help to proactively identify and resolve cross-functional issues that arise during technology research and development.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for successful delivery of semiconductor development programs with a clear plan to deliver on schedule.

• Work closely with project sponsor, business owners, cross-functional teams, and assigned engineers to plan and develop scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, budget, and timing for new initiatives.

• Effectively communicate program/project status, tradeoffs, risks, and changes to cross-functional teams and stakeholders including, but not limited to, senior executive management.

• Understand and utilize internal project management tools and processes related to development and release through various project phases.

• Partner with existing project teams and business leaders to accelerate project delivery

• Improve and optimize cross-organizational role and processes for opportunity pursuit across the company.

• Identify tasks, determine dependencies, identify and assign specific resources, communicate expectations to team members, obtain task effort and duration estimates from team members, and create/track the project schedule.

• Assess risk and identify issues. Coordinate resources with other functions. Review user and technical requirements for completeness and clarity.

• Determine alternate solutions when faced with potential delays to the program.

• Lessons learned workshops to ensure proliferation of knowledge and best practices across the company.

What You Will Bring

• Bachelor's degree in engineering and a minimum of 2 years of experience in engineering industry. Project/program management experience is preferred.

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects/ tasks simultaneously and effectively prioritize projects and tasks.

• Proven track record of working under critical deadlines and milestones.

• Strong cross functional collaboration skills and an ability to influence.

• Experience with complex projects in a global team environment.

• PMP or formal project management certification is plus.

• Excellent leadership, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• PMP certification is highly desirable.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of Real Innovation , empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.

Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.

You’ll experience Real Connection , collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.

postings.title: NPD Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Founded in 2020, unybrands is the next-generation brand accelerator platform built to acquire, integrate, and scale digital-first consumer brands. Headquartered in Miami, with offices in New York, London, Berlin, and Shenzhen, our 240+ team brings deep expertise across e-commerce, brand management, consumer retail, operational scaling, and M&A.
Since inception, we have acquired 30+ brands across Pet Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Supplements, Baby & Juvenile, Garden & Outdoor, Sports & Fitness, and Home & Lifestyle — completing 20+ acquisitions and delivering 16 consecutive quarters of like-for-like organic growth post-integration.
Our competitive advantage lies in a fully integrated operating system purpose-built to transform digital brands into omni-channel category leaders. Powered by a proprietary technology stack built on NetSuite ERP with 200+ data integrations, our platform enables brands to thrive across marketplaces, direct-to-consumer channels, and brick-and-mortar retail.
We focus on acquiring digital-first brands within carefully selected verticals, then applying tailored value creation playbooks that drive growth through innovation, expansion, and automation. We believe the next generation of consumer brands will be built differently — and we're building the AI-enabled retail tech platform to help them consolidate and win.
OVERVIEW
The NPD Specialist owns execution of the refresh and supplier-led line-extension pipeline for an assigned brand cluster. You are the person who makes sure nothing stalls, nothing surprises us and nothing ships that we would not be proud to put our name on.
You will learn the full system — the stage-gates, the supplier playbooks, the trackers, the way claims get locked at design rather than at launch. Master this and you become the reason products move.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Pipeline execution. Drive your assigned slate of refresh and line-extension projects through every stage-gate, keeping the launch tracker honest and current.

• Supplier coordination. Work with suppliers on samples, specs and timeline commitments. Hold suppliers to committed dates and chase the detail others miss. Partner with Sourcing on commercial topics.

• Stage-gate hygiene. Prepare clean, complete gate packages so reviews are decisions and not status updates.

• Cross-functional handoffs. Be the connective tissue between engineering, design, claims and regulatory, testing, marketing and operations so handoffs are seamless.

• Keep specs, briefs and approvals organized in the team systems so the whole organization can trust a single source of truth.

• Post-launch learning. Capture what worked and what did not on each launch so the next project starts from a better baseline.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 2 plus years in product development, sourcing, project coordination or a related CPG or consumer hardware role.

• A bias for follow-through. You close loops, confirm details and never assume.

• Comfort juggling many projects at once without dropping the ball on any of them.

• Clear, direct communication with suppliers and internal partners alike.

• Curiosity about how products are made and a genuine interest in the categories we play in.

• Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools.

WHERE THIS LEADS
Level 1 is your foundation. Demonstrate that you can run a cluster cleanly and the next step is Level 2 — heavier, more complex work, deeper autonomy and the first people looking to you for guidance.

postings.title: Analista de Sourcing & Product Development
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre el equipo

En Elevva desarrollamos y compramos el producto que después vendemos en cuatro mercados de LatAm. El equipo de Sourcing & Product Development trabaja con cerca de 70 proveedores en Asia y la region; y con más de 300 desarrollos nuevos al año.

No somos un área de compras que ejecuta pedidos definimos qué producto existe. Cada especialista es dueño de su portafolio de marcas de punta a punta — encuentra la oportunidad, la convierte en producto, negocia con la fábrica, emite la orden y responde por que llegue a tiempo, al costo y con la calidad acordada.

El desafío

En Elevva buscamos personas que quieran construir algo grande.

El rol de Sourcing & Product Development Analyst será responsable del portfolio de productos para las categorías de deportes, fitness y outdoor (Kano y Droplet) y será clave para armar su surtido temporada a temporada, desarrollar los proveedores que lo hacen posible y ejecutar la compra cumpliendo los objetivos de costo, plazo y condiciones de pago del área.

Responsabilidades

Desarrollo de producto y surtido

• Liderar los Line Reviews estacionales de tus marcas qué se renueva, qué se discontinúa y qué se incorpora.

• Detectar oportunidades de nuevas categorías y subcategorías, y armar el Business Case que las sustente (unidades, inversión, GMV, margen) para defenderlo ante el comité regional.

• Gestionar el ciclo completo de muestras especificación, evaluación, ajustes, packaging y aprobación final.

• Analizar mercado y competencia — tendencias de la categoría, benchmarking internacional y precios — para fundamentar cada decisión de surtido.

• Trabajar con los Country Managers de los cuatro países para alinear el surtido y alimentar el ciclo de S&OP.

Sourcing y negociación

• Buscar, evaluar e incorporar proveedores nuevos, y desarrollar a los existentes.

• Negociar precio FOB, MOQ, plazos de producción y condiciones de pago.

• Participar de ferias internacionales y visitas a fábrica en Asia.

• Evaluar de forma periódica el desempeño de cada proveedor y accionar sobre los que no cumplen.

Datos y procesos

• Mantener la información de tu portafolio limpia y actualizada en los sistemas es el input de la planificación de compra de toda la región.

• Hacer seguimiento de tus indicadores y presentar resultados y planes de acción en el reporte mensual del área.

Requisitos

Qué buscamos

Excluyente

• Formación profesional en Administración, Economía, Ingeniería, Comercio Internacional o afines.

• Al menos un año de experiencia en Sourcing, Procurement, Category Management o Desarrollo de Producto, con responsabilidad directa sobre negociación con proveedores.

• Inglés avanzado vas a negociar y desarrollar producto en inglés todos los días.

• Excel avanzado y capacidad analítica real — el rol se apoya en datos, no en intuición.

• Experiencia trabajando con proveedores de Asia o disposición clara a construirla, incluidos viajes.

Deseable

• Experiencia en categorías de deporte, fitness, outdoor o productos técnicos de consumo.

• Conocimiento de comercio exterior Incoterms, documentación de embarque, costeo de importación.

• Manejo de herramientas de análisis de mercado y de visualización de datos.

Nuestro ADN Cultural

postings.title: Implementation & Systems Consultant (Remote: US, Canada & Latin America)
postings.descriptionText:
About InAir

InAir is a forward-thinking, fully remote consulting firm with a stronghold in Texas. We are proud experts in Airtable consulting services, partnering with mid-sized to large enterprises. Our mission is to harness the power of low-code platforms, enabling businesses to optimize their workflows, foster collaboration, and achieve ambitious outcomes through Airtable.

At our company, we foster a culture of honesty, responsibility, and accountability. These core values create a successful, innovative, and transparent workplace. Our remote work setting is built on trust, respect, and open communication, allowing team members to shine and grow.

The Role

You will turn how a business actually runs into a scalable, automated system, owning the client relationship from the first discovery call to final delivery. If you have ever been the person at your company who "figured out the tools" and ended up running the whole operational process, this role was built for you.

You own the client, the delivery plan, and the system build (primarily using modern relational/no-code platforms like Airtable, and integration tools like Make/Zapier). A dedicated internal Engineer handles custom code—your focus is architecture, configuration, project governance, and client success.

What You'll Do

• Lead Discovery: Run client sessions to map complex workflows, identify operational bottlenecks, and translate business requirements into clean technical specifications.

• Design Systems at Scale: Architect data models, relational schemas, automated workflows, and client-facing interfaces built to handle enterprise scale (ensuring a build that works for 10 records scales seamlessly to 100,000+).

• Hands-on Configuration: Build and configure solutions directly. You won't write custom code from scratch, but you will build and own the core system structure.

• Run Project Delivery: Own scope, milestones, status reports, and timelines across a portfolio of enterprise clients while coordinating technical execution with internal Engineers.

• Optimize Existing Architectures: Audit clients' current system setups to make them cleaner, faster, and easier to scale.

What You'll Need

• Systems-Building Track Record: You have shipped working systems in relational, low-code, or operations platforms (Airtable, Notion, Retool, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier/Make, or similar) that real teams rely on. Your background can be in solutions consulting, technical project management, operations, or engineering.

• Relational Data Instincts: Deep understanding of relational database principles—linked records, primary keys, foreign keys, one-to-many/many-to-many relationships, and why schema structure matters at scale.

• Client-Facing Project Ownership: Proven experience running client meetings, managing scope/expectations, and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• Ownership: You thrive when you own the outcome, not just a to-do list.

• Accountability: You own outcomes across multiple projects at once and don't wait to be told what's next.

• Location & Availability: Based in the US, Canada, or Latin America, with English level of C1+ communication and alignment with US business hours (EST/CST/PST).

Nice to Have

• Formal database or data modeling experience (SQL, ERDs, schema normalization).

• Hands-on experience with Airtable, ClickUp, or similar workflow platforms.

• Background in B2B consulting, technical agencies, RevOps, or business operations.

Work Structure

• Type: Full-time (40 hours/week), fully remote.

•

• EST/CST/PST (dedicated availability aligned with US business hours)

• Engagement: Contractor agreement via Rippling.

postings.title: Program manager (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Type : Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)

Location : Remote, based in Central or South America (Americas time zones)

Language Requirements: Spanish fluency required

Reports to: Head of Growth

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on.

The role

We need a remote, relationship-driven, commercially-minded Program Manager who is technically fluent, someone who can speak credibly about our platform, integrations, and data workflows with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, to keep our existing customers happy, engaged, and growing, and to help us stand up program management as a function for the very first time.

We are hiring our first Program Manager to own and grow relationships with OpenFn's existing customers as we transition to a subscription model built around packaged product-and-services bundles.

As our first Program Manager in this market, you will own the full portfolio of existing subscription customers and be accountable for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You will be the trusted advisor customers turn to, the person who makes sure they are getting real value from OpenFn, and the internal owner of the commercial health of each account.

OpenFn is a technical product: our customers use it to build integrations, move data between systems, and automate complex digital workflows. You do not need to be an engineer, and you will not be doing hands-on implementation work; we have solution architects and implementation consultants for that. But you do need to be technically fluent: able to understand how customers use the platform, hold a credible conversation with their technical teams, spot when something is going wrong, and know when to bring in a specialist. That technical credibility is what will make you a genuine trusted advisor rather than just a point of contact.

Because this is a foundational hire, you will both build and execute. You will not inherit a mature playbook; you will help create it, establishing the processes, cadences, and tooling that a strong program management function depends on, while carrying a live book of business from day one.

Requirements

Own & grow customer relationships

• Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of existing subscription customers

• Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across each customer organization, from day-to-day users through to senior decision-makers

• Develop and maintain account plans that map each customer's objectives to the value OpenFn delivers

• Plan and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other regular check-ins

Bring technical fluency to the relationship

• Develop a strong working understanding of the OpenFn platform and how each of your customers uses it

• Hold credible, substantive conversations with customers' technical teams about their integrations, data workflows, and use cases

• Translate fluently between customers' technical staff and their non-technical decision-makers

• Spot technical adoption risks early, and know when to bring in solution architects or implementation consultants

Drive retention & expansion

• Own gross and net retention for your portfolio, and be accountable for renewals

• Forecast renewals accurately and manage the end-to-end renewal process

• Proactively identify at-risk accounts and lead recovery plans before they churn

• Identify and pursue opportunities to grow accounts, including tier upgrades and cross-sell of additional services

• Negotiate renewals and expansions in line with our pricing and packaging model

Deliver value & coordinate delivery

• Ensure a smooth handoff from sales and implementation into ongoing program management

• Monitor product usage and adoption, and work with customers to close gaps and deepen engagement

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, channeling feedback to our product and services teams

• Coordinate with support and implementation teams to meet SLA commitments and deliver project-based work

• Manage escalations, bringing the right internal people together to resolve issues quickly

Build the program management function

• Establish the playbooks, cadences, and health-scoring approach that will let program management scale as OpenFn grows

• Maintain accurate account data, activity, and forecasts in our CRM, and report on core retention/growth metrics to leadership

• Help migrate existing customers from legacy project-based arrangements onto the new subscription model

Required Qualifications

• 3-7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related customer-facing commercial role at a SaaS or subscription business

• A proven track record of retaining and growing a portfolio of customers, including owning renewals, forecasting, and driving upsell or expansion

• Experience managing customers for a technically substantive product, with a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on how a product actually works

• Genuine technical fluency: comfort discussing concepts such as APIs, integrations, data exchange, and workflow automation, and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences

• Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust with both technical users and senior stakeholders

• Experience running customer cadences such as QBRs, service reviews, and success planning

• Hands-on proficiency with a CRM, and a data-informed approach to managing account health and forecasts

• Fluent, professional-level English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, multicultural team

• Fluency in Spanish, in addition to English

• A self-starter mindset suited to a foundational role where you build as well as execute, and the ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country located in Central or South America (compatible with Americas time zones)

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience helping a business (or its customers) transition from project or services-based revenue to a subscription model

• A technical background (e.g. a computer science degree, or prior experience in engineering, technical support, solutions, or implementation), including hands-on experience with integration tooling, data pipelines, or APIs

• Experience managing government, NGO, public sector, or other international customers, ideally within the digital public goods or open source ecosystem

• Working knowledge of CRMs such as Salesforce or Odoo

• Additional language skills relevant to our customer base (e.g. French, Portuguese)

• Experience selling and/or delivering complex digital transformation, business process transformation, or data integration projects

Benefits

• Financial compensation includes a base salary plus variable pay tied to the retention and growth (upsell and expansion) of your portfolio. Total pay is commensurate with experience, per OpenFn's Equal Pay for Equal Work framework; the detailed variable-pay mechanics are shared during the interview process

• N.B.: Selling to NGO and government customers, we don't offer Silicon Valley pay scales, but high quality of life and fair, transparent, and competitive compensation is important to us

• Flexible working schedule

• We're fully remote, with team meetups across Europe and Africa (our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar)

• Exposure to the hottest industry and technology trends and leading health, humanitarian, and government digital transformation interventions in the sector

• Opportunity for leadership and advancement; you will be a key contributor to our company's strategy and direction

• The opportunity to shape our strategy and impact millions of lives through our open source software in a small, mission-driven organization

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Business Developer , serás responsable de diseñar, comunicar, desarrollar e implementar la estrategia de negocio y marketing para el portafolio de Banco de Sangre y Serología dentro de la subregión de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia (SAN). En este rol, actuarás como un nexo estratégico clave con el mercado , capturando oportunidades con agilidad e incorporando la inteligencia de mercado y tendencias emergentes. Trabajarás de manera colaborativa y estrecha con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad y equipos multidisciplinarios para expandir la participación de mercado, asegurar la ejecución comercial de punta a punta, aportar valor a los clientes y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Planificación Estratégica: Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con el Disease Management Squad. Contribuir a la definición de la estrategia y priorizar las tácticas para el portafolio asignado, adaptando los lineamientos globales/regionales al contexto de la red SAN y definiendo el posicionamiento de precios.

Actuarás como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto dentro de tu área de especialidad.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno e integrando la perspectiva del cliente en los squads y redes regionales (EMEA-LATAM).

• Relaciones Estratégicas y Co-creación: Identificar nuevas oportunidades junto a los equipos de campo y co-crear los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración con los Key Account Managers (KAMs). Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas, efectivas y de confianza con clientes, partners y stakeholders clave del sector científico e institucional (sociedades científicas, planes nacionales y provinciales) para influir en la estrategia.

• Sinergia Interna: Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de Ventas, Finanzas, Supply Chain, Healthcare Manager y Experiencia del Cliente para optimizar los indicadores clave de negocio, alocación de recursos y planes financieros (BP & IP).

Who you are

• Formación Académica: Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica, Biotecnología o carreras afines. Es muy valorable contar con estudios de posgrado o MBA.

• Experiencia Laboral: Experiencia previa comprobable en roles de desarrollo de negocios, marketing de productos, especialista de aplicaciones o ventas dentro de la industria del diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) o farmacéutica.

• Conocimientos Técnicos Críticos: Trayectoria demostrable y conocimientos técnicos profundos y actualizados tanto en serología como en biología molecular. Es indispensable contar con un entendimiento sólido en técnicas de diagnóstico y, específicamente, en pruebas de tamizaje NAT (Nucleic Acid Testing) para bancos de sangre.

• Idiomas: Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (nivel B2, C1 o C2) para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global, corporativo y con las funciones regionales de la compañía.

• Habilidades Blandas y Competencias: * Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y alta capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders.

• Fuertes habilidades interpersonales para trabajar bajo modelos operativos ágiles y colaborativos

• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico y estratégico basado en datos, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio.

• Movilidad: Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red del clúster SAN (Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia).

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

postings.title: Tech & Marketing Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

We're looking for a proactive, resourceful, and AI-forward Tech & Marketing Operations Specialist to manage our technology projects, keep our learning platforms running seamlessly, and power the marketing engine that brings students to them

This role suits someone with a broad technical fluency who thrives on coordination, troubleshooting, and hands-on building. You don't need to be a professional developer, but you do need to be comfortable using tech tools to design, prototype, and ship real solutions.

The position will be based at the Buenos Aires office with a hybrid work model.

What You’ll Do

Platform & Systems Management

• Tech project management: Manage technology-related projects end to end — defining requirements, building timelines, tracking progress, and identifying improvements that serve broader project goals.

• LMS management (WordPress & LearnDash): Own the day-to-day health of our WordPress-based LMS and LearnDash plugin — user administration, course administration, email flows, bulk imports, new features, configuration, and troubleshooting.

• CRM & Marketing Automation (Salesforce & Salesforce Marketing Cloud): Act as first point of contact for Salesforce and SFMC — build and test journeys, landing pages, and lead magnets; investigate and resolve issues the Operations team can't solve; escalate and follow up when needed.

• System integration: Serve as the architect making sure LMS, CRM, Marketing Cloud, and Power BI talk to each other correctly — designing and implementing the technical architecture for data flows between platforms, including low-code integrations.

• Data integrity & reporting: Review data integrity across LearnDash, Salesforce, and Power BI; execute queries and build reports/extracts for non-technical stakeholders; handle large-scale data reviews (including million-row datasets) when needed.

• Website support: Provide general technical support for the website and coordinate with relevant resources to resolve issues.

• Compliance & security: Help bring the LMS environment up to the organization's IT and security standards, acting as liaison between the Education team, developers/cloud providers, and Security/Legal/IT.

Marketing Operations & Growth

• Campaign execution: Build, test, and launch email and lifecycle campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud — segmentation, audience building, A/B tests, send scheduling, and deliverability hygiene.

• Landing pages & lead capture: Build and ship landing pages and forms based on designs provided by the internal design team; ensure correct lead routing into Salesforce, field mapping, deduplication, and follow-up automation.

• Tracking & attribution: Own the measurement layer — GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, UTM taxonomy and enforcement — so that every campaign, source, and channel is measurable end to end.

• Lifecycle & retention automation: Design automated flows across the student lifecycle (onboarding, course progress nudges, re-engagement, certification, upsell) connecting LMS events to CRM and Marketing Cloud triggers.

• Martech stack & compliance: Own the marketing technology stack and its integrations; keep consent management, cookie compliance, and data handling aligned with privacy requirements and company policy.

• AI for marketing: Apply the same builder mindset to marketing — AI-assisted copy and creative variants, campaign localization at scale, automated performance summaries, and audience insight tooling.

Technical Bridge & Coordination

• Stakeholder liaison: Serve as a primary point of contact between internal stakeholders (especially the development team) and business operations, translating business needs into functional technical specifications.

• Specification writing & QA: Write clear technical specs, replicate scenarios, and fully test in QA and production before rollout.

• Documentation: Keep the operations manual and technical documentation current and useful for the team.

• Cross-functional project leadership: Lead multi-month initiatives (e.g., new catalog builds, platform redesigns, global/language expansions, migrations) from scoping through to launch — defining KPIs, coordinating between design/development/vendors, and testing at every step.

AI Development & Innovation

• AI builder mindset: Go beyond being “AI-savvy” — actively explore, prototype, and build AI-powered solutions that improve how the team works and how students learn (e.g., translation tools, automation of repetitive data tasks, AI-assisted reporting).

• Tool development: Design and build practical AI tools and workflows (e.g., custom Gemini/Claude “gems”/assistants, scripts, or low-code automations) to solve real operational bottlenecks — not just use off-the-shelf AI features.

• Exploration & evaluation: Stay current on emerging AI tools and platforms relevant to EdTech operations, and proactively propose where they could create value (efficiency, personalization, translation, content scaling, etc.).

• AI project ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of AI-driven initiatives — from investigating alternatives and setting up integrations, to testing and rolling out to production (as previously done with AI-powered course translation tooling).

• Responsible use: Use AI tools in a way that's compliant with company confidentiality and data-security standards, and only with company-approved systems.

What You Need For This Role

• You have a solid, broad understanding of technology and digital platforms, and you're comfortable getting hands-on rather than just directing others.

• You have 5+ years of experience managing Education and Marketing tech projects.

• You are genuinely curious about AI and see it as a tool to build with, not just a topic to discuss — you've built something with AI before (a workflow, an automation, an integration, a tool).

• You bring project management skills with a track record of leading initiatives from scope to delivery.

• You're a strong communicator who moves comfortably between technical and non-technical audiences.

• You're a proactive problem-solver, able to identify needs and find the right solutions, people, and tools without waiting to be asked.

• You understand marketing funnels and growth metrics (CPL, CAC, conversion rate, LTV) and can translate them into technical requirements.

• Hands-on experience with marketing automation and campaign tooling (Salesforce Marketing Cloud strongly preferred) is highly valued.

• Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking setups is a strong plus.

• You are comfortable owning both the plumbing and the outcome — not just that the campaign sends, but that it performs.

• Experience with WordPress and/or LMS platforms (ideally LearnDash) is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce/Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred) and data/BI tools (Power BI) is highly valued.

• You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple concurrent projects.

• You're a self-starter, comfortable working independently.

What Will Make Us Really Love You

• You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.

• You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.

• You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.

• You have an eye for detail.

• You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit.

• You’re genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.

• You have the ability to engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.

What You’ll Love About Us

• We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position

• Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising

• Be part of a company with a truly global footprint, working with leading brands, platforms, and publishers across 90+ markets.

• We foster a dynamic environment where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged and celebrated.

• Join a diverse, multicultural team that values and embraces different perspectives, experiences, and talents.

• At Aleph, your work directly contributes to connecting brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising.

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

#ALEPH

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at [email protected] .

postings.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.

We are a global technology group, headquartered in London.
We deploy experts and frontier technology, like AI, to help organisations thrive through change.
We have over 600 professionals (>75% hands-on technical talent) spread across Europe, North + South America and Asia, and are backed by Marlin Equity Partners.
We help customers:
Work smarter - Building modern, scalable infrastructure, apps and workflows that actually improve your bottom line.
Engage personally - Creating digital experiences that capture attention, convert sales, and keep customers coming back.
Stay secure - Establishing the security, governance and compliance systems that protect you from threats, fines, and downtime.
We work with some of the world's biggest brands to solve their biggest problems.
From highly regulated financial institutions to fast-moving tech unicorns and global retailers.

Different worlds, same standard: we ship tangible outcomes into production, fast.
Then we work alongside customers to maintain and optimise them long term, upskilling their teams along the way.
The Opportunity
We are a rapidly growing technology consultancy specialising in solutions built on Google Cloud. We help clients create and improve digital products, websites, platforms and customer experiences.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead complex engagements from discovery and planning through to launch and continuous improvement and maintenance. You'll coordinate globally distributed teams across technology, creative, strategy, product, content and quality assurance.
This is not a hands-on engineering role. You'll need enough technical understanding to manage dependencies, risks and informed conversations, but your primary focus will be creating the clarity, structure and momentum teams need to deliver successfully. Similar consultancy roles combine end-to-end delivery ownership with cross-functional leadership, client management and commercial control.

What You'll Do

• Own the end-to-end delivery of digital products, websites and platforms.

• Define and manage scope, plans, milestones, budgets, resources and dependencies.

• Coordinate globally distributed, multidisciplinary teams across multiple locations and time zones.

• Establish appropriate delivery approaches using Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.

• Act as the principal delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.

• Provide clear reporting on progress, finances, risks, issues, decisions and project health.

• Anticipate delivery challenges, remove blockers and resolve issues before they affect outcomes.

• Manage scope changes and client expectations while protecting delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Facilitate planning sessions, project ceremonies, governance meetings and retrospectives.

• Coordinate quality assurance, user acceptance testing, launch readiness and handover.

• Work with technical and creative leads to ensure deliverables meet client objectives and agreed quality standards.

• Translate technical concepts between clients, technical leads and internal engineering teams, leveraging technical fluency to bring clarity, manage expectations, and keep delivery moving forward.

• Support estimates, proposals and Statements of Work, and identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships.

• Improve delivery processes, tools and ways of working as the consultancy grows.

What You'll Bring

• Strong experience managing digital or technology projects from initiation through launch.

• A track record of delivering websites, digital products or platforms involving multidisciplinary teams.

• Experience managing scope, budgets, timelines, resources, risks and dependencies.

• Confidence working with Directors, VPs and other senior client stakeholders.

• Excellent spoken and written English, suitable for complex North American client engagements.

• Strong facilitation, presentation, negotiation and influencing skills.

• A positive, pragmatic personality and the ability to create accountability without relying on formal authority.

• Experience leading distributed teams across different disciplines, locations and time zones.

• Working knowledge of software development lifecycles and Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methods, as well as software release coordination.

• AI fluency and practical experience using modern AI tools to streamline delivery workflows, optimize project management processes, and drive operational efficiency.

• Comfort working directly within various CMS platforms, including practical experience executing content uploads and building or configuring site modules and templates to ensure seamless delivery.

• Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with engineers and architects and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong commercial awareness, including experience managing project financials and change control.

• The organisation and judgement to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving consultancy environment.

Valuable Additional Experience
Experience in either of these areas would be a significant advantage:

• Previous experience in a digital agency, technology consultancy or professional-services environment.

• Delivery of CMS-based websites, including content workflows, migrations, integrations and launch planning.

• Experience delivering analytics implementations and data-driven projects, including tracking frameworks or reporting workflows.

• Familiarity with digital performance optimization, accessibility standards testing (WCAG), or SEO best practices for web platforms.

• Familiarity with platforms such as Contentful, Adobe Experience Manager, Drupal, WordPress or Sitecore.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud ecosystem.

• Project management or Agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum or PMI-ACP.

The Finer Details

• This role is based in Buenos Aires, with two days per week in the office. You'll work regularly with North American clients, so some alignment with their working hours may be required.

• This role is aligned with Beyond's career framework at Level 3: Senior.

• Exceptional performance can lead to advancement opportunities within our career framework or internal opportunities with other departments, aligned with your career aspirations and business needs.

• If the opportunity interests you and you meet most - but not every - criterion, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits
We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:

• Work from Home Allowance

• Private Medical Insurance for family group

• Birthday leave

• 10 paid learning days per year

• Bonusly 100 points per month to recognise colleagues

Diversity and Inclusion
At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

EL PROBLEMA REAL QUE VAS A RESOLVER

Nuestros pacientes buscan tratamientos para control de peso, terapia hormonal y salud sexual. La mayoría llega con vergüenza.

No abandonan por el precio. Abandonan porque el formulario los hace sentir expuestos, porque no saben si pueden confiar en nosotros, o porque les pedimos demasiado antes de darles algo a cambio.

Resolver eso es el trabajo. No es hacer que las pantallas se vean mejor.

QUÉ VAS A HACER

• Ser dueño del recorrido completo: página de aterrizaje, registro, admisión médica, selección de tratamiento y checkout
• Rediseñar el flujo de admisión para reducir el abandono, sabiendo que las preguntas médicas son obligatorias y no se pueden eliminar
• Escribir el texto, no solo los wireframes. En este puesto las palabras son la experiencia
• Construir la experiencia en español para el mercado hispano de Estados Unidos. Hoy no hay un solo competidor directo en la primera página de búsqueda en español
• Definir la arquitectura de confianza: credenciales médicas, proveedores con licencia, qué pasa si el tratamiento no funciona, cómo se cancela
• Estudiar la experiencia de nuestros competidores a fondo y construir una mejor, punto por punto
• Priorizar qué se arregla primero según impacto, y defender esa prioridad con un argumento

QUÉ NECESITAS

• 6+ años en diseño de producto o experiencia digital, con al menos dos enfocados en conversión
• Portafolio con números. Antes, después, y la métrica que se movió. Los portafolios que solo muestran pantallas no se revisan
• Capacidad de escribir. Texto de conversión, no descripciones de funcionalidades
• Entender por qué funciona un cambio, no solo que funcionó. Te vamos a preguntar el porqué
• Usar herramientas de IA en tu flujo de trabajo, y saber dónde no sirven
• Español nativo
• Inglés suficiente para trabajar con el equipo y leer documentación técnica
• Disponibilidad durante el horario laboral del Este de Estados Unidos para videollamadas

SUMA, PERO NO ES OBLIGATORIO

• Experiencia en salud, farmacéutica, seguros o cualquier industria regulada
• Experiencia con productos de suscripción
• Experiencia diseñando para categorías sensibles o estigmatizadas
• Manejo de herramientas de análisis de comportamiento y grabación de sesiones

DÓNDE ENCAJA EL PUESTO

Reportas al Director de Marketing y trabajas directamente con el equipo de desarrollo. Hay capacidad de ingeniería asignada, no vas a esperar meses por un cambio.

QUÉ OFRECEMOS

• USD $2,600 - $3,300 mensuales, pagados contra factura
• Tarifa en el rango más alto del mercado regional. Pagamos bien y esperamos el resultado que eso implica
• Propiedad real: eres la primera contratación de este puesto, no la quinta
• Una plataforma que todavía no está optimizada. El margen de mejora es enorme y se ve de inmediato
• Decisiones rápidas. No hay comité

PARA APLICAR

Dos cosas. Las dos son parte de la evaluación.

• Un caso de tu portafolio: qué estaba roto, qué cambiaste, qué número se movió, y en cuánto tiempo.

• Responde esto en un párrafo, en español: una mujer de 38 años busca tratamiento para bajar de peso. Le da vergüenza. Llega a nuestra página desde un anuncio en Instagram. ¿Cómo diseñas las primeras tres pantallas para que no abandone, y por qué funciona cada decisión que tomaste?

No buscamos la respuesta correcta. Buscamos cómo piensas.

Las postulaciones sin el caso con números no serán revisadas.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager - Social Experience
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.

You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

The opportunity

• Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

• Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

• Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

• Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

• Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

• Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

• Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

• Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

What You Bring

• Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

• Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

• Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

• Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

• Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

• Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, Observability Tools
postings.descriptionText:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.

We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.

This is not a reporting role. You will own the tools that let builders and reviewers see, test, and trust how GenerativeAgent (GA) actually behaves — before it ever talks to a customer, and after. If builders can't confidently preview a configuration change, and reviewers can't efficiently audit what GA said, thought, and did in production, quality erodes silently and trust with our customers erodes with it. Making agent behavior visible, testable, and reviewable at scale is your product.

What You Will Do

• Own scenario creation via the simulation agent. Lead product for the tools that let builders generate and curate realistic test scenarios, so configuration changes can be validated against representative conversations before they ship.

• Own our evals surfaces, including mistake monitoring and structured data evals. Define how we detect, surface, and categorize GA mistakes at scale, and how structured data extraction is evaluated for accuracy — turning noisy conversational output into clear, actionable quality signals for builders and customers alike.

• Own the Previewer. Own the tool builders rely on to see exactly how their configurations show up in real simulated conversations, closing the loop between making a change and understanding its downstream impact.

• Own Conversation Explorer. Lead the primary surface reviewers use to read through full production conversations — including agent thoughts and actions — balancing depth for investigative review with speed for high-volume auditing.

• Build the case for simulation-driven quality. Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Research to show customers and internal stakeholders how pre-production testing and post-production review compound into fewer mistakes, faster iteration, and more defensible GA performance.

• Partner deeply with Research and Engineering on the underlying agent architecture — reasoning traces, tool calls, scenario generation methods — so product decisions are grounded in what's technically sound and what actually predicts real-world behavior.

• Manage the trust layer of the review experience. Proactively identify and resolve issues that erode confidence in what builders and reviewers see — desyncs between simulated and real behavior, incomplete traces, unclear mistake categorization — and design the UX and guardrails that keep them confident in what they're looking at.

Who You Are

We evaluate candidates against a set of principles. These aren't interview talking points — they describe how PMs are expected to operate here every day.

• Growth & Abundance Mindset: You approach new domains with curiosity and learn fast. You see collaboration as additive, not competitive. When a bet doesn't work, you extract the signal and move on.

• Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You don't wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the PM; the outcome is yours.

• High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer "what changed for the customer?" for everything on your roadmap.

• Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, research, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned.

• Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously rather than saving it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively.

What You Will Need

• 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on testing, quality, or review/analytics products in enterprise B2B SaaS.

• Direct experience building products around LLMs, AI agents, or other applied AI systems — you can reason about agentic behavior, prompt and scenario design, or model output evaluation well enough to make sharp product tradeoffs, not just talk about AI at a high level.

• Experience shipping tools that simulate, test, or preview system behavior before it reaches production, including the judgment to know when simulated behavior is a reliable proxy for the real thing and when it isn't.

• Experience building review or audit tooling for complex, unstructured content, and turning ambiguous quality signals into clear, defensible categorizations.

• Comfort partnering with research and engineering teams on system internals — reasoning traces, tool-use logs, evaluation methodology — to ground product decisions in technical reality.

• Track record of running discovery with internal or external users and translating it into structured requirements — evals, quality metrics, or review workflows.

• Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a clear PRD, a release announcement, and comfortable presenting directly to customers.

What We Would Like To See

• Experience in contact centers, conversational AI, or customer experience (CX) analytic - a plus.

• Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for generative AI systems (offline evals, human-in-the-loop review, automated mistake detection).

• Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment where the role's scope evolved as the company did

Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Stock options

• Healthcare for the family group

• Mac equipment

• USD 150 per month in flexible benefits

• 3 weeks of vacation

• English lessons

ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at [email protected] to obtain assistance.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Sr Product Manager - Growth Marketing Enablement
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements.

The opportunity

• Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.

• Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.

• Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.

• Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.

• Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.

• Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.

• Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.

What You Bring

• Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work.

• Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.

• Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.

• Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.

• Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.

• Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.

• Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.

• Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

postings.title: Product Manager Cloud
postings.descriptionText:
En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio.

Buscamos un/a Product Manager apasionado/a por la tecnología y los desafíos del mercado corporativo, responsable de liderar la estrategia, el ciclo de vida y la evolución de nuestro portafolio de servicios Cloud (IaaS, PaaS y SaaS), impulsando su crecimiento, adopción y rentabilida

Tu rol será: ser el nexo estratégico entre nuestros proveedores tecnológicos globales y el mercado corporativo, desarrollando propuestas de valor que impulsen la adopción de soluciones cloud y aseguren el crecimiento rentable del negocio.

Tus principales desafíos serán:

• Gestionar y evolucionar el porfolio de servicios Cloud asegurando su alineación con la estrategia de negocios y las tendencias del mercado tecnológico.

• Identificar oportunidades de mercado, diseñar nuevos productos/servicios y liderar su lanzamiento ( Go-to-Market ) para acelerar la adopción corporativa.

• Impulsar la colaboración con proveedores tecnológicos globales y coordinar a las distintas áreas internas para desarrollar ofertas competitivas, acelerar la adopción de soluciones y generar resultados de negocio.

• Optimizar de punta a punta el ciclo de vida del producto, monitoreando la rentabilidad, el rendimiento y la mejora continua de la propuesta de valor.

• Impulsar iniciativas comerciales y métricas de adopción ( growth & adoption ) para posicionar a Claro como referente en servicios cloud corporativos.

¿Qué necesitamos de vos?:

• Título universitario o terciario en Sistemas, Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Administración, Marketing o afines.

• Experiencia en la gestión de productos, servicios o proyectos tecnológicos. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en soluciones Cloud, infraestructura IT o servicios orientados al mercado corporativo.

• Conocimiento de plataformas de nube pública (Azure, AWS y GCP) y comprensión general de sus arquitecturas, servicios y modelos de operación en entornos multicloud.

• Experiencia interactuando con vendors/proveedores tecnológicos y ejecutando estrategias de comercialización ( Go-to-Market ).

• Inglés avanzado (excluyente para la relación con proveedores globales y lectura de documentación técnica).

¿Que esperamos de vos?

Orientación a Resultados: Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes.

Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

Excelencia : Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad.

Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.

Integridad : que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.

El puesto tiene sede en CABA

postings.title: Senior Product Operations Manager II
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

You are the ultimate problem-solver at the heart of our Payroll teams. Sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, operations, and Go-To-Market (GTM), you own the end-to-end operational lifecycle across 10+ product teams.

This is an owner role that demands resourcefulness, the ability to juggle competing demands, and the discipline to know the difference between moving paperwork and actually solving problems. You will take total accountability for complex challenges, driving them from initial friction to final resolution. Operating autonomously across global time zones, you are the crucial connective tissue that ensures what our customers need is exactly what our engineers build.

If you thrive in high-velocity environments, love distilling chaos into clarity, and have a relentless bias for action, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

• Own the product signal end-to-end: Transform raw feedback and friction from operations and customers into clear, prioritized, and actionable insights for Product Managers. You uncover what truly matters, validate the "why," and drive the prioritization of impactful solutions.

• Orchestrate global execution: You are the critical connector between distributed Product, Engineering, and GTM teams. When PMs and engineers are in different time zones, you step in to scope work, answer questions, unblock decisions, and maintain momentum. You also ensure GTM teams are fully equipped to launch, sell, and support what ships.

• Be the ultimate problem-solver: When a process breaks or a product stalls, you don't just hand it off and disappear. You dig deep to uncover the root cause - whether it’s a product gap, a documentation issue, or a systemic limitation - and you own the solution from discovery to implementation.

• Navigate and simplify complexity: You will manage competing demands coming from all directions. You excel at taking that volume, structuring the details, prioritizing ruthlessly, and taking decisive action. You don't wait for permission to move; you make informed calls and drive progress.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of experience in fast-paced, high-scale environments (Series A/B/C startups or equivalent-pace tech organizations), with a proven track record of moving quickly and juggling competing priorities.

• End-to-end ownership mentality: You have successfully operated in the space between product and ops. You can translate the distinct languages and priorities of different teams, and you know how to separate true product signals from operational noise.

• Relentless resourcefulness: When you hit a roadblock, you find a way around it. You are highly comfortable context-switching between a customer escalation, an engineering sync, and deep-dive data analysis.

• Autonomous decision-making: You are a natural problem-solver who can dig into complex issues, form a strong point of view, and make the right calls. You know exactly what is yours to decide and what requires escalation.

• Data-driven approach: You possess a strong analytical foundation. You can pull your own data, extract meaningful insights, and use them to drive product enhancements and prioritization. You are highly comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and core operational analytics.

• Precision communication: You write and speak with clarity and impact. You easily adapt your communication style depending on whether you are talking to engineers, PMs, customers, or leadership.

• Sharp product sense: You deeply understand how software is built and shipped. While you don't need to be a PM, you understand what is technically possible, how to accurately answer scoping questions, and how to spot when an initiative is off-track.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
