Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

You are the ultimate problem-solver at the heart of our Payroll teams. Sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, operations, and Go-To-Market (GTM), you own the end-to-end operational lifecycle across some of our most critical product teams

This is an owner role that demands resourcefulness, the ability to juggle competing demands, and the discipline to know the difference between moving paperwork and actually solving problems. You will take total accountability for complex challenges, driving them from initial friction to final resolution. Operating autonomously across global time zones, you are the crucial connective tissue that ensures what our customers need is exactly what our engineers build.

If you thrive in high-velocity environments, love distilling chaos into clarity, and have a relentless bias for action, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

• Own the product signal end-to-end: Transform raw feedback and friction from operations and customers into clear, prioritized, and actionable insights for Product Managers. You uncover what truly matters, validate the "why," and drive the prioritization of impactful solutions.

• Orchestrate global execution: You are the critical connector between distributed Product, Engineering, and GTM teams. When PMs and engineers are in different time zones, you step in to scope work, answer questions, unblock decisions, and maintain momentum. You also ensure GTM teams are fully equipped to launch, sell, and support what ships.

• Be the ultimate problem-solver: When a process breaks or a product stalls, you don't just hand it off and disappear. You dig deep to uncover the root cause - whether it’s a product gap, a documentation issue, or a systemic limitation - and you own the solution from discovery to implementation.

• Navigate and simplify complexity: You will manage competing demands coming from all directions. You excel at taking that volume, structuring the details, prioritizing ruthlessly, and taking decisive action. You don't wait for permission to move; you make informed calls and drive progress.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of experience in fast-paced, high-scale environments (Series A/B/C startups or equivalent-pace tech organizations), with a proven track record of moving quickly and juggling competing priorities.

• End-to-end ownership mentality: You have successfully operated in the space between product and ops. You can translate the distinct languages and priorities of different teams, and you know how to separate true product signals from operational noise.

• Relentless resourcefulness: When you hit a roadblock, you find a way around it. You are highly comfortable context-switching between a customer escalation, an engineering sync, and deep-dive data analysis.

• Autonomous decision-making: You are a natural problem-solver who can dig into complex issues, form a strong point of view, and make the right calls. You know exactly what is yours to decide and what requires escalation.

• Data-driven approach: You possess a strong analytical foundation. You can pull your own data, extract meaningful insights, and use them to drive product enhancements and prioritization. You are highly comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and core operational analytics.

• Precision communication: You write and speak with clarity and impact. You easily adapt your communication style depending on whether you are talking to engineers, PMs, customers, or leadership.

• Sharp product sense: You deeply understand how software is built and shipped. While you don't need to be a PM, you understand what is technically possible, how to accurately answer scoping questions, and how to spot when an initiative is off-track.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead

Location: India (Preferred) / Global EY Delivery Locations

Function: AI Governance & Responsible AI

Reports To: AI Governance Team Lead

Role Purpose

The AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead is responsible for operationalizing EY's AI Governance framework across all AI and Generative AI solutions developed, deployed, or consumed within the organization. This role serves as the Product Owner and Operational Lead for the AI Governance platform, built on ServiceNow, ensuring governance requirements, risk assessments, controls, and compliance obligations are consistently implemented, monitored, and evidenced throughout the AI lifecycle.

The role acts as the critical bridge between business stakeholders, AI solution teams, risk and compliance functions, and the global AI governance organization to translate governance requirements into scalable workflows, controls, and automation within the governance platform.

Key Responsibilities

AI Governance Operations

• Operationalize EY's AI Governance framework across all AI, GenAI, Machine Learning, and intelligent automation solutions.

• Ensure governance controls are embedded throughout the AI lifecycle, from ideation and development through deployment, monitoring, and retirement.

• Drive onboarding of AI solutions into the governance platform and ensure compliance with mandatory governance requirements.

• Facilitate execution of AI risk assessments, control evaluations, approvals, and periodic compliance reviews.

• Monitor governance compliance metrics and identify control gaps, policy deviations, and remediation requirements.

• Support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal compliance assessments related to AI governance.

AI Governance Platform Ownership

• Serve as Product Owner for the ServiceNow-based AI Governance platform.

• Define and prioritize platform roadmap, enhancements, user stories, and functional requirements.

• Ensure governance workflows, approval processes, and control assessment mechanisms remain aligned to evolving business and regulatory requirements.

• Manage platform configuration, testing, release planning, user adoption, and operational support.

• Work with ServiceNow development teams to implement new governance capabilities and integrations.

• Drive automation of governance activities wherever possible to improve operational efficiency and compliance monitoring.

AI Risk & Controls Management

• Support management and execution of the AI Risk and Controls Matrix (RACM).

• Ensure governance controls are mapped to applicable AI risks and regulatory obligations.

• Monitor control implementation status and effectiveness across AI solutions.

• Support implementation of Responsible AI principles, AI control standards, and compliance requirements.

• Maintain governance evidence and reporting needed to demonstrate adherence to enterprise AI policies.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Partner with AI product owners, engineering teams, architecture teams, across ET, CT and Info Sec, privacy, legal, risk management, and business stakeholders.

• Translate governance policies and standards into practical platform workflows and operational processes.

• Gather business requirements and convert them into governance platform capabilities.

• Facilitate governance review meetings and provide guidance on compliance obligations and control requirements.

• Act as the primary point of contact for platform-related governance inquiries.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Develop governance dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting.

• Track platform adoption, governance coverage, control compliance, and remediation activities.

• Drive continuous improvement of governance processes, controls, and platform functionality.

• Benchmark governance practices against industry standards and emerging regulations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Risk Management, or related discipline.

• 20+ years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, IT controls, ServiceNow, or enterprise platform management.

• Experience serving as a Governance Lead, Product Owner, Platform Manager, Business Analyst, or

• Experience working with enterprise governance, compliance, workflow, or GRC platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience managing process implementation across large, complex organizations.

Preferred Knowledge

Working knowledge of:

• AI Governance and Responsible AI frameworks

• AI Risk & Controls Matrix (RACM)

• AI Control Frameworks and AI Control Plans (AICP)

• AI risk assessment methodologies

• AI lifecycle governance processes

• Regulatory frameworks such as EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and emerging AI regulations

• ServiceNow platform capabilities, workflows, and integrations

• Technology risk, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance management

Key Competencies

• Product Ownership

• Governance & Controls Management

• ServiceNow Platform Expertise

• Stakeholder Management

• Business Analysis

• Risk & Compliance Management

• Process Design & Automation

• Data-Driven Decision Making

• Communication & Influencing Skills

Role Summary:

Lead the operational execution of EY's AI Governance framework by owning the ServiceNow-based governance platform, ensuring AI solutions comply with governance requirements, controls, and risk management standards while enabling scalable, automated, and effective governance

postings.title: Software Alliances Director, Americas
postings.descriptionText:
The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. We develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, and formulate go-to-market plans, content and processes, enabling differentiated offerings and robust product life-cycle support anchored to best-in-class Canonical products. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners’ products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has demonstrated success in business development or product management, both as a leader and an individual contributor in major accounts. If you are someone who is passionate about open source, can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for professionals with 7+ years of experience.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

The role entails

• Setting the account strategy in a major account, region, and/or vertical.

• Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.

• Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.

• Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.

• Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.

• Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.

• Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.

• Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.

What we are looking for in you

• Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and influence

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.

• Experience in software development and system architecture.

• Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.

• Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.

• Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.

• Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Nice-to-have Skills And Experience

• Experience with open source software and open source business models.

• Product management or program management experience.

• Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.

• Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.

• Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.

• Post-graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Product Engineering Lead, Keet (100% Remote, Worldwide)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

ResponsabilitiesEngineering

• Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

• Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

• Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

• Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

• Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

• Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

• Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

• Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

• Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

• Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

• Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

• Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

• Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

• Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

• Deep JavaScript and React.

• Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

• Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

Buscamos talento que piense en 10x, actúe con autonomía y genere impacto real. Si te apasiona innovar, aprender rápido y construir en equipo, este lugar es para ti

¿Qué desafíos te esperan? 🎯 Project Management con impacto real

• Asegurar compromisos y fechas con Producto, Tech, Legal, Riesgo y Comercial; escalar cuando algo se trabe

🔥 Empujar iniciativas desde el día uno

⚙️ Gobierno y seguimiento implacable

• Asegurar que cada iniciativa tenga owner, timeline y métricas de éxito

🧪 Innovación

¿Qué buscamos?

• Formación en Economía, Administración, Negocios Digitales, Ingeniería Industrial o afines

• 3 a 6 años en Project Management, Business Operations, Consultoría o roles afines en fintech, pagos, e-commerce.

• Experiencia trabajando en producto o con equipos de Producto

• Fuerte manejo de datos, forecast, análisis de impacto por iniciativa

• Capacidad para diseñar modelos de conversión, segmentación de tasas, análisis de portafolio

postings.title: ISV Technical Alliance Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. We develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, and formulate go-to-market plans, content and processes, enabling differentiated offerings and robust product life-cycle support anchored to best-in-class Canonical products. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners’ products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has a background in technology, engineering or product management and is interested in continuing to grow their career in business development. If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for early career professionals with up to 7 years of experience.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.

The role entails

• Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.

• Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.

• Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.

• Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.

• Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.

• Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.

• Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.

What we are looking for in you

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.

• Experience in software development and system architecture.

• Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.

• Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.

• Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.

• Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Nice-to-have Skills And Experience

• Experience with open source software and open source business models.

• Team leadership, product management or program management experience.

• Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.

• Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.

• Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.

• Post-graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographic location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Annual compensation review.

• Recognition rewards.

• Annual holiday leave.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Microsoft Co-Innovation Portfolio Manager (Specialist) - Assistant Director - Argentina - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Role Title: GDS Microsoft Co-innovation Portfolio Specialist

Alliance: Microsoft

Competency: Co-Innovation

Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Skill Level: High

Rank: Assistant Director

Sub Function: GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

Reports to: Microsoft Alliance Operations Lead

The opportunity

Microsoft Alliance is one of EY’s most strategic ecosystem relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this agenda, the Co-Innovation team brings together EY’s sector and service-line depth with Microsoft’s technology capabilities to shape scalable, market-relevant solutions that support client transformation and create new growth opportunities.

We are looking for a strategic, collaborative and execution-focused Portfolio Specialist to support the Microsoft Alliance Co-Innovation team. The role will help manage the solution portfolio, governance rhythm, investment prioritization, execution visibility and performance tracking for co-innovation initiatives aligned to various domains such as Finance, Customer, or Operations.

This role is designed for someone who can connect strategy with disciplined execution. You will work closely with domain leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, service-line and sector teams, solution owners, sales, marketing and GDS teams to ensure domain-focused solutions are prioritized, matured and activated with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who enjoys working at the intersection of innovation, AI, alliances, portfolio management, and go-to-market growth.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead portfolio governance and operating rhythm

• Manage the governance rhythm for the Microsoft Co-Innovation portfolio, ensuring timely visibility into solution progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes.

• Support portfolio reviews, leadership updates, business reviews and cadence forums with clear, consistent and decision-oriented materials.

• Maintain a structured view of domain-aligned solutions across lifecycle stages, including ideation, incubation, build, activation, scale and retirement.

• Strengthen portfolio discipline by helping leadership prioritize initiatives based on strategic relevance, market potential, solution maturity, resource availability and expected business impact.

• Ensure portfolio decisions are supported by accurate data, clear ownership, aligned next steps and transparent follow-through.

Drive AI and emerging technology portfolio focus

• Support the identification, tracking and maturation of AI-enabled, Copilot, Agentic AI, cloud, data, automation and Microsoft-powered solutions relevant to various transformation priorities.

• Partner with solution owners and technology stakeholders to assess solution readiness, scalability, client applicability and commercialization potential.

• Build visibility into the AI innovation pipeline, including use cases, accelerators, demos, client-zero examples, solution artifacts and go-to-market readiness.

• Promote responsible and practical AI adoption by ensuring solution discussions consider value, risk, governance, data requirements and adoption needs.

• Translate complex AI and technology themes into business-friendly portfolio narratives for leadership, sales and stakeholder audiences.

Support investment management and funding governance

• Track solution investments, funding asks, utilization status, expected outcomes and associated evidence requirements, where applicable.

• Support business case development and portfolio-level prioritization for solution build, activation, enablement and go-to-market funding opportunities.

• Coordinate with alliance, commercial, solution and delivery teams to maintain visibility across funding decisions, approvals and dependencies for domain-focused innovation initiatives.

• Assess whether investments are progressing toward intended outcomes, including maturity, activation, adoption, pipeline influence and market relevance.

• Prepare concise leadership summaries on funding status, risks, decisions required and recommended actions.

Enable stakeholder alignment and collaboration

• Act as a connector between leadership, Microsoft field teams, service-line leaders, sector stakeholders, solution owners, sales, marketing and GDS support teams.

• Support alignment across business, technology, delivery, and go-to-market stakeholders so priorities translate into executable portfolio actions.

• Coordinate working sessions, portfolio forums and leadership check-ins to make progress visible and decision points clear.

• Proactively identify stakeholder gaps, ownership ambiguities and cross-team dependencies that could affect solution activation or portfolio performance.

• Build trusted relationships across a matrixed global stakeholder network.

Drive portfolio reporting, insights and performance management

• Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, trackers and executive summaries that provide clear visibility into solution health and performance.

• Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation progress, pipeline contribution, adoption, funding utilization, marketplace readiness and business outcomes.

• Analyze portfolio trends and provide practical recommendations to improve prioritization, governance and go-to-market impact.

• Prepare materials for leadership reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and other governance forums.

• Use data and stakeholder input to tell a clear story on portfolio progress, areas requiring support and decisions needed from leadership.

Enable go-to-market readiness and market activation

• Work with sales, marketing and solution teams to support activation planning for prioritized co-innovation solutions.

• Track readiness of key solution assets, including demos, credentials, case studies, sales collateral, enablement material, marketplace content and client-facing narratives.

• Identify opportunities to scale successful domain-focused solutions across priority accounts, sectors and service lines

• Support enablement and awareness activities so client-facing teams understand the portfolio and how to activate it.

• Feed portfolio-level insights back into solution teams to strengthen commercialization, adoption and future prioritization.

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for someone who brings strategic thinking, strong discipline, analytical rigor and relationship-building capability. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior stakeholders, ambiguous priorities and evolving solution portfolios while maintaining a practical focus on measurable outcomes.

• Strong portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm experience.

• Ability to translate business priorities into structured portfolio actions and measurable outcomes.

• Comfort working with AI, cloud, data, automation and emerging technology themes at a business and portfolio level.

• Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information for leadership audiences.

• Ability to influence without authority and build alignment across matrixed teams.

• Strong analytical capability, with experience developing dashboards, trackers, performance narratives and decision papers.

• High attention to detail, strong follow-through and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Curiosity, adaptability and a genuine interest in innovation-led growth.

To qualify for the role, you must have

• 10–15 years of relevant professional experience in portfolio management, program management, consulting, alliances, innovation management, transformation, product portfolio management or strategic operations.

• Experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives across domain or global stakeholder groups.

• Experience with governance models, leadership reporting, investment tracking, portfolio dashboards and performance management.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready materials.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, proactively identify risks and drive structured follow-through in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience working with technology-enabled transformation, cloud, AI, automation, data or digital solution portfolios.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security or related solution areas.

• Experience in alliance management, co-sell motions, co-innovation programs, marketplace offerings or technology partner ecosystems.

• Experience in a Big Four, professional services, consulting or technology-led environment.

• Understanding solution commercialization, go-to-market activation, funding governance and innovation lifecycle management.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Shape the future with confidence

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

postings.title: Junior Project Manager (Keet P2P) (100% remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases. This is a great role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into technical project or product management in a deeply technical, open-source environment.

Responsibilities

• Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

• Run or support stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives across time zones (mostly async)

• Coordinate between the engine team, Keet app/UI developers, and QA so dependencies are visible early

• Write clear status updates, release notes, and meeting summaries

• Help triage bug reports and user feedback, and route them to the right engineers

• Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them

• Keep internal documentation and processes tidy and easy to follow

Mandatory:

• 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a similar role (internships and open-source involvement count)

• Excellent written English communication; you can explain technical progress clearly and concisely

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

• Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

• Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

• Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

• Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

• Some exposure to JavaScript/Node.js or experience working alongside a dev team

• Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

• Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

• Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

postings.descriptionText:
EY es una firma global líder que ofrece servicios de Auditoría, Consultoría, Estrategia y Transacciones e Impuestos, con una red integrada por más de 400.000 profesionales en 150 países del mundo.  

Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.  

EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.

Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad y buscamos alentar a que se postulen para nuestras diferentes posiciones. En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o apoyo, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.

Acerca del área

Financial Services Office (FSO) es una de nuestras áreas integrada por estrategas empresariales, tecnólogos/as y líderes de la industria que aportan un pensamiento y conocimiento fresco del sector sobre banca y mercado de capitales, seguros, gestión de activos y patrimonio.  

En FSO Business Consulting contamos con un equipo de Business Transformation que participa en una amplia cartera de propuestas de valor que sirven para ampliar y diseñar una trayectoria de transformación integral (personas, negocios y tecnología) y crecimiento para nuestro cliente. Esto puede incluir: planes estratégicos, reinvención de modelos de negocio, transformación de modelos operativos, efectividad comercial, eficiencia operacional, diseño y ejecución de la transformación integral.

Desde Business Consulting Transformation para la industria de servicios financieros buscamos ayudar a nuestros clientes de Banking, FinTech, Payment & Insurance a adoptar la transformación de sus negocios en una era tan dinámica y disruptiva como la actual. Colaboramos con la transformación con una visión holística de negocio, personas y tecnología.

Te proponemos sumarte al equipo de estrategia y transformación para la industria, para junto a equipos talentosos y multidisciplinarios, ayudar a nuestros clientes en la transformación integral que contribuyan a un mejor mundo de negocios, en ámbitos como:

• Concebir e impulsar una transformación, basada en el conocimiento de la industria e integrando las capacidades existentes dentro de los equipos EY.

• Diseñar sus negocio, servicios y modelos operativos y diseño de procesos para clientes de la industria bancaria, seguros, pagos y mercado de capitales.

• Diseñar experiencias de clientes para distintos tipos de negocio.

• Ejecutar la transformación: Participar en programas grandes y complejos que requieren visión integral (personas, tecnología y negocio), disciplina y experiencia especializadas.

EY trabaja con clientes líderes en toda la región, trabajando para resolver algunos de sus problemas más complejos. Este es el momento perfecto para unirse a un equipo en continuo crecimiento y dejar su huella en la industria de servicios financieros y en la sociedad.

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar e implementar estrategias de transformación digital en entidades financieras y aseguradoras.

• Liderar proyectos de automatización, modernización tecnológica y digitalización de procesos.

• Analizar tendencias del mercado y proponer soluciones innovadoras alineadas con los objetivos del negocio.

• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para garantizar la entrega de proyectos en tiempo y forma.

• Gestionar la relación con clientes, asegurando altos estándares de calidad y satisfacción.

Requisitos 

• Experiencia de 2 años en proyectos de transformación digital y / o en rediseño de modelos operativos, incluyendo el rediseño del mapa aplicativo. Se valorará experiencia con empresas de servicios financieros o seguros.

• Formación académica en carreras como Negocios Digitales, Tecnología de la Información, Sistemas de Información de las Organizaciones o afines.

• Conocimiento en tecnologías emergentes, metodologías ágiles y herramientas digitales (deseable).

• Habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación efectiva y orientación a resultados.

• Contar con disponibilidad para trabajar full time y con modalidad híbrida.

• Garantizar fluidez en el idioma inglés (oral y escrito).

• Mostrar flexibilidad y adaptación para el trabajo en equipo, la innovación y el aprendizaje. 

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Formar parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar (GPTW Argentina 2026).

• Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo altamente reconocido en el mercado y basado en las mejores prácticas.

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrido.

• Plataforma de entrenamiento virtual con más de 18.000 cursos disponibles, entre los cuales se encuentran los cursos de Udemy y Coursera.

• Acceso a EY Badges, programa global de certificaciones en diferentes áreas de conocimiento. EY Master in Business Analytics y Master in Sustainability, innovadores programas de aprendizaje virtual en asociación con Hult International Business School.

• Capacitación en idioma inglés: política de clases, open lessons gratuitas, webinars de doble impacto y libre acceso a la plataforma de aprendizaje virtual.

postings.title: Growth Strategy Manager- Portuguese Speaker
postings.descriptionText:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

postings.title: Associate II, Product Operations
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Krak is Kraken's consumer banking and payments product — a fast-moving team building the card, payments, and financial features that bring crypto to everyday life. The Krak Product Operations team sits at the heart of this, making sure the business can move quickly without getting blindsided by compliance, risk, vendor, or operational dependencies.

This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. You'll bring leadership to the day-to-day, working directly with compliance, legal, fraud, client engagement (CE), and external vendors to make sure new features land safely and successfully.

The opportunity

Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room.

You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. Your job is to make sure the right conversations happen at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks on the way to launch.

Compliance & risk co-ordination

• Maintain live, product-specific trackers of open compliance and legal items, including DRIs, status, and upcoming milestones

• Triage new features against regulatory requirements ahead of development; ensure sign-off is built into delivery milestones

• Work closely with fraud leads to ensure fraud controls and risk/velocity rules are factored into feature design (card, third party payments, and others)

• Ensure fraud and CE teams are operationally positioned - with the right tooling, admin access, battlecards, and support articles - ahead of new product and feature launches

• Support incident response for product-related issues and ensure post-incident reviews feed into product changes

Third party vendor management

• Maintain product-specific vendor trackers covering status, open actions, key contacts, and upcoming milestones

• Own the cadence for performance reviews with key vendors and track actions to closure

• Maintain a working view of vendor roadmaps and capabilities; produce periodic briefings on where vendor developments create product opportunities or constraints

Responding to MI & feature performance

• Ensure experiments and feature launches are supported by readily available fraud, dispute, and CE metrics alongside commercial KPIs

• Interpret fraud, dispute, CE, and auth/decline data to identify emerging issues and surface them to the right teams

• Drive follow-through on cross-functional findings - whether that's a compliance flag or a vendor issue

Strategic market intelligence

• Scan the market for competitors' changes to features, pricing, and risk positioning

• Monitor regulatory and market developments that could affect the Krak roadmap

• Identify third party vendor capabilities that could enable features not yet on the roadmap; flag where the current stack may be a constraint

What You Bring

• 3-5 years experience in a product operations, strategy, or programme management role in a consumer fintech, payments, or banking business - ideally at a company with a card or payments product

• Strong working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape for consumer financial products in one of more regions

• Experience working alongside or within fraud and risk functions; understanding of how fraud controls interact with product design

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with different stakeholders and different cadences, without dropping the ball

• Track record of turning complex operational data into clear, actionable MI for product and leadership teams

• Structured thinker who's comfortable in the detail but can step back and see the bigger picture

• Strong communicator - able to translate between the worlds of compliance, risk, engineering, and product

Nice to haves

• Experience with card issuing programmes (scheme rules, chargeback processes, fraud typologies)

• Familiarity with third party banking and payments vendors (e.g. BIN sponsors, scheme processors, TPP aggregators)

• Prior experience in a fast-scaling consumer fintech or neobank

• Exposure to crypto or digital assets products

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

EY GPO Client Solution Manager

Global Payroll Operate – Consolidated Job Description

Position Overview

The EY GPO Client Solution Manager is a client-facing lead role within EY Global Payroll Operate responsible for shaping, designing, and delivering global payroll technology and implementation solutions for multinational clients. The role bridges client stakeholders, EY technology, implementation, central, service management, and payroll teams to ensure global payroll solutions are scalable, compliant, integrated, and aligned to client business objectives.

Purpose of the Role

This Manager leads solutioning from sales handover through implementation and go-live, setting the global design approach, guiding client decisions, managing expectations, and enabling consistent local delivery across countries. The role serves as a subject matter expert for EY’s GPO technology ecosystem, including EY Payroll Command Center, EY Digital Payroll, EY Interact Payroll, EY IP Mobile, GTPW, in-country payroll, and integrations with client HCM, workforce management, general ledger, and third-party systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead global design workshops and client solutioning sessions to define requirements, solution architecture, integration scope, data flows, testing approach, conversion strategy, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

• Own and maintain global implementation deliverables, including global user stories, solution design documents, integration designs, SOR global mapping data dictionaries, testing plans, conversion plans, and deployment strategies.

• Act as the global design owner, monitoring local design decisions for impact on the overall solution and redirecting or re-solutioning where needed to preserve scalability, quality, compliance, and maintainability.

• Support sales-to-implementation handover activities, including review and clarification of MSA, SOW, LCA, PSM, scope assumptions, pricing inputs, and implementation commitments.

• Serve as the primary technology and solution point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders, articulating EY’s payroll technology capabilities and advising on implementation options, risks, and trade-offs.

• Lead cross-functional implementation teams across multiple countries or regions, managing scope, timelines, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, budgets, and project communications.

• Collaborate with EY technology, central, service management, payroll, and local implementation teams to ensure delivery aligns with EY global standards, quality requirements, client expectations, and project governance.

• Provide escalation support, issue resolution, quality assurance, and solution guidance throughout the implementation lifecycle.

• Support business development activities such as RFPs, RFIs, pricing, client pitches, technology demonstrations, feasibility assessments, and vendor evaluations.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by developing templates, tools, methodologies, lessons learned, and action plans that enhance EY GPO implementation capability and client value.

• Coach and mentor team members, support professional development, and foster a collaborative, high-performing delivery culture.

Required Experience And Skills

• 6+ years of experience in global payroll implementations, HR/payroll technology, systems integration, program management, or technology consulting within complex multinational environments.

• Proven ability to lead large-scale, multi-country payroll or HCM implementations through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.

• Strong understanding of payroll business processes, global payroll operations, regulatory compliance, data privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border payroll data requirements.

• Experience with cloud-based global payroll or HR platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, ADP, or similar systems, including inbound and outbound integrations.

• Hands-on understanding of integration technologies and data formats, including APIs, middleware, ETL, EDI, SFTP, XML, JSON, CSV, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.

• Strong project and program management capability, including scope, budget, resource, timeline, risk, issue, dependency, financial, and stakeholder management.

• Excellent communication, executive presence, facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated leadership in matrixed environments, including the ability to influence teams, resolve ambiguity, drive accountability, and deliver high-quality outcomes under tight deadlines.

• Financial acumen, including experience with project budgets, billing, margins, ERP reporting, service specifications, and Statements of Work.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, MIS, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.

• Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 preferred.

• Lean Six Sigma experience or certification preferred.

• Global payroll implementation experience or certification preferred.

• Workday, Oracle, SAP, or integration-related certification preferred.

• SAP US payroll implementation experience and background is an added value and preferred qualification.

• Experience with EY technology platforms, GPO service delivery models, or managed payroll services preferred.

• Fluency in English required; Spanish, German, French, or Portuguese language capability is an added value.

Key Success Factors

• Builds trusted advisor relationships with clients and internal stakeholders globally.

• Balances strategic solution design with pragmatic implementation delivery.

• Anticipates risks, identifies integration challenges early, and drives scalable, serviceable solutions.

• Maintains strong focus on quality, compliance, operational excellence, automation, and client experience.

• Develops people, strengthens delivery capability, and contributes to continuous improvement across EY GPO.

postings.title: Product Marketing Associate, Rewards
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $3,000 - $3,750 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research

• Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight

• Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards

• Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences

• Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans

Strategy & Execution

• Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale

• Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research

• Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels

• Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities

• Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving

• Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward

• Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift

• Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams

Qualifications

Required

• 2+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.

• Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation

• Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly

Nice to Have

• Consumer-facing or mobile product experience

• Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs

• Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)

• Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

• Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

• Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

• Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

About The Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct in-depth implementation and optimization sessions for new and cross sold customers, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

• Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

• Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to activation through a white-glove experience, providing guidance and onboarding for Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

• Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and driving value-driven adoption to achieve key business results.

• Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout the onboarding process.

• Document customer interactions and feedback meticulously, leveraging this data to continuously improve the onboarding and overall customer experience.

• Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data, providing valuable insights to optimize support strategies using the AI Agent product.

• Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting with the customer, ensuring effective project management throughout the onboarding process.

• Proactively identify and mitigate potential roadblocks to decrease time to value, assisting companies in launching quickly and effectively on Gorgias.

Who You Are

• Experience: 2-3+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager driving post-sales adoption and activation, demonstrating a successful track record. E-commerce experience is a plus!

• Consultancy and Project Management: 2-3+ years of experience crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and attention to detail skills.

• Proactive Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 30 accounts at a given time, adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants. You are a self-starter; you will be provided with a lot of autonomy in this role.

• Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

• Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption and mitigating churn.

• Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.

• AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

• Bilingual French is an asset - not required

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.
