We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

• Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

• Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

• Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

At Gorgias, we are revolutionizing customer service for ecommerce businesses. Our Customer Success team ensures clients realize measurable value from our platform by driving product adoption, automation maturity, and long-term operational impact.

We partner with leading ecommerce brands to optimize their support operations, implement AI-powered workflows, and unlock scalable growth.

As a Commercial AI Solutions Manager , you will serve as a strategic partner to a portfolio of ecommerce merchants. You will guide customers through product adoption, optimization, and long-term success by helping them implement AI-powered workflows, automate support operations, and align Gorgias with their business goals.

You will work closely with customers to uncover opportunities, deepen relationships across stakeholders, and ensure merchants are maximizing the value of the platform.

Your working hours would be 11am - 8pm.

What You’ll Do

As a Commercial AI Solutions Manager, you will:

Customer Partnership & Account Strategy

• Manage a large portfolio of commercial ecommerce customers (high-volume book of business)

• Maintain a strong pulse on your accounts through a mix of proactive and reactive engagement

• Run regular check-ins and support higher-value customers with more structured conversations

• Understand customer workflows, goals, and common blockers

• Support customers in improving how they use Gorgias in their day-to-day operations

Product Adoption & Optimization

• Drive adoption of Gorgias features including automation, AI, and integrations

• Analyze support workflows and recommend improvements for common use cases

• Help customers implement automation and AI workflows to improve efficiency

• Troubleshoot product issues and support customers in resolving blockers

• Get hands-on in customer setups when needed (reoptimizations, fixes, improvements)

Customer Health & Risk Management

• Monitor account health signals (usage, engagement, sentiment) across a large portfolio

• Identify risk signals and take action to prevent churn

• Focus on improving adoption and setup quality as key drivers of retention

• Support renewal conversations for lower-risk or flat renewals when needed

Operational Excellence & AI Enablement

• Maintain accurate customer data and engagement tracking in internal systems

• Manage your book of business in a structured and organized way

• Prioritize accounts based on impact and risk

• Use AI and internal tools to improve efficiency in your day-to-day work

• Contribute insights and patterns to improve team processes over time

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Sales, Product, and Support teams to resolve issues and improve outcomes

• Escalate when needed and ensure context is clearly communicated

• Share recurring customer challenges and insights with internal teams

Who You Are

• 2+ years in Customer Success, Support, Account Management, or a customer-facing SaaS role

• Comfortable managing a high-volume portfolio of accounts

• Strong communicator who can guide customers through practical, solution-oriented conversations

• Support-oriented and hands-on - you enjoy helping customers solve real problems

• Curious and detail-oriented - you like getting into how systems and workflows actually work

• Organized and able to prioritize effectively across many customers

• Experience with ecommerce, support operations, or automation tools is a strong plus

• Interest in AI and how it improves customer support

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

¿Cómo lo hacemos?

Funcionamos como un one team. Entregamos valor continuo, iterativo e incremental. Colaboramos en equipo con flexibilidad y confianza. Decidimos con autonomía alineada. Medimos para aprender y mejorar en ciclos cortos.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

We're building Deel's payroll operations for LATAM countries to capture a significant market opportunity. This is a greenfield build. You'll be the founding product leader for a new country, working with a dedicated engineering team to design and launch payroll, HR, time tracking, and related products that serve LATAM countries' complex regulatory and business environment.

As Country PM, you'll own end-to-end product strategy and execution. You'll work across compliance, engineering, payroll operations, HR, and time tracking to translate local requirements into products that work. You'll make critical trade-off decisions: what to build first, what gets deferred, and how to hit market timelines without overcommitting.

The context

LATAM countries represents both significant opportunity and technical complexity. You'll be working with high-value customers who need the full Deel experience, not just a payroll engine. Their requirements will expose gaps between what works globally and what LATAM countries actually needs. Scaling those solutions becomes the next phase.

We're building on Deel's internal infrastructure, which means you'll coordinate across multiple product teams and navigate technical complexity that a third-party vendor would hide. You own translating LATAM countries's requirements into engineering work and prioritizing ruthlessly against your team's capacity.

What You'll Do

• Define product strategy for the LATAM market across payroll, HR, time, and services

• Work with your dedicated engineering team to execute on the roadmap

• Coordinate across Product (payroll engine), Time, HRIS, and Services teams to align on dependencies

• Break complex requirements into iterative pieces. Ship early, learn from customers, iterate

• Own the relationship with key accounts, understanding their needs and validating your solutions

• Work with sales, implementation, and local compliance teams to ensure we're building something that can scale

• Think like an entrepreneur. This is a new market opportunity, and you're building the playbook from scratch

• Use AI to speed up the build, getting rules in and scale in collaboration with local compliance teams.

Must Have

What we're looking for

postings.title: Senior Business Analyst - Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.

You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

The Bridgenext Salesforce & Agentforce Functional Architect plays a critical role in the success of Salesforce engagements, serving as the intersection of application strategy, technical solution design, and client partnership. This role is responsible for deeply understanding client business challenges and leading the definition of innovative, scalable solutions within the Salesforce ecosystem.

As a Salesforce & Agentforce Functional Architect, you’ll guide cross-functional teams, spanning multiple time zones, through successful delivery while ensuring continuous alignment with client goals. You will serve as a strategic partner to stakeholders, foster collaboration, driving key decisions, and owning the end-to-end solution vision from discovery through enablement and handoff.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

• Own the end-to-end solution vision across multiple teams and client stakeholders

• Build trusted relationships with executive and technical client stakeholders

• Align business goals, technical architecture, and delivery strategy to drive successful outcomes

• Advise on platform capabilities and when to use declarative vs. custom solutions

• Make architecture decisions based on constraints like budget, scope, time, and available resources

• Collaborate with Technical Architects, UX Designers, and Developers to deliver a cohesive solution

• Define the technical critical path and lead teams through execution using different Agile frameworks

• Recommend solution paths that balance the competing priorities of budget, time, quality, and scope

• Provide solution design and architecture leveraging a variety of SaaS platforms and web technologies

• Apply a NorthStar framework to solution design discussions and discovery workshops

• Guide clients through the onboarding and training process, ensuring they can effectively utilize the implemented solutions

• Effectively communicate project progress and manage expectations with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, engineering, and customer team

• Identify opportunities outside of the scope of a project for future phase work and provide client with innovative ideas to solve their business challenges

Workplace: Based in LATAM working remotely. Working hours are flexible but must be available for meetings in Eastern Standard Time (EST/EDT). Some evenings hours may be required at times for coordination with offshore resources. This role supports US-based English-speaking clients so strong English communication is imperative.

Travel: Potential for up to about 10% travel for onsite client meetings

Must Have Skills

• 7+ years' experience designing complex solutions on the Salesforce platform using both out of the box solutions and Salesforce friendly customizations and includes either (or better yet, both!) implementation or product development

• 4+ years professional services consulting experience leading strategic engagements

• Have robust examples of complex implementations spanning multiple technology stacks

• Successfully led collaborative discovery workshops with client stakeholders to define business needs and align on solution direction, leveraging both customer experience insights and technical strategy

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to create technical documentation and client facing artifacts

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce declarative tools and working with development teams across multiple time zones

• Comfortable presenting to C-suite and leading enterprise engagements

• Experience leading team using Agile Frameworks, writing user stories, running sprint demos, etc.

• Multiple Salesforce certifications: App Builder, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce Specialist

• Relevant Salesforce and Agile certifications

• Examples of using Salesforce innovatively to solve problems

Preferred Skills

• FSC, Insurance, and/or Transportation domain experience

• Experience leading $1M+ programs or large enterprise initiatives

• Knowledge of managed package development and AppExchange

• Understanding of key concepts for user centered design and design thinking using the Salesforce Lightning Design System

• Experience in Classic to Lightning migrations

• Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

• Project Management Professional (PMP®)

Professional Skills

• Strong team and individual player

• Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature

• High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results

• Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention

• Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Business Analyst (Market Risk)
postings.descriptionText:
Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

• Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

• Cloud & Application Services: We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.

• Management & Innovation Consulting: We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.

Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in bridging business needs and technical solutions. In this position, you will work closely with business stakeholders and development teams, gathering and analyzing requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality solutions.

A significant part of the role involves collaborating with business users based in the United States, making strong communication skills and a high level of English proficiency essential.

Key Responsibilities

• Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

• Work closely with business stakeholders, particularly users located in the United States, to understand their needs and objectives.

• Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications and user stories.

• Define, refine, and prioritize tasks for development teams.

• Support technical teams during the implementation phase, providing clarification and guidance on functional requirements.

• Validate delivered solutions to ensure they meet business expectations and functional specifications.

• Monitor requirements throughout the project lifecycle and resolve functional queries and issues.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with business goals.

Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional analysis role.

• Strong knowledge of Market Risk concepts, processes, and related financial products.

• Experience working with: Value at Risk (VaR) and Stress Testing

• Proven ability to analyze, define, and structure complex business requirements.

• Experience working closely with software development teams in Agile and/or traditional project environments.

• Upper-intermediate to advanced English level ( minimum B2 ) with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders based in the United States.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and coordination skills.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into actionable development requirements.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

• B2B or employment contract

• Remote within CET Time zone.

• Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !

Actuar como nexo entre las áreas operativas (Producción, Ingeniería, Mantenimiento y Calidad) y los equipos de tecnología, relevando y documentando requerimientos para transformarlos en soluciones de digitalización industrial. Participará en proyectos vinculados a plataformas SCADA/HMI, Historiadores Industriales, Gemelos Digitales y tecnologías OT/IT, contribuyendo a la optimización de procesos, trazabilidad y disponibilidad de activos industriales.

REQUISITOS EXCLUYENTES (descalifican si no se cumplen):

• Requisito excluyente: Familiaridad o experiencia conceptual con arquitecturas SCADA/HMI.

• Requisito excluyente: Conocimientos básicos de protocolos de comunicación industrial (OPC UA, Modbus, Ethernet/IP) y APIs para integración de datos.

EXPERIENCIA:

• Años de experiencia: 1 a 3 años.

• Tipo de experiencia relevante:

• Relevamiento, análisis y documentación de requerimientos funcionales en entornos industriales.

• Participación en proyectos de digitalización industrial.

• Integración entre sistemas de automatización, supervisión y gestión (SCADA, MES, ERP).

• Trabajo con tecnologías de automatización, control de procesos y plataformas OT.

• Qué pesa más, años o calidad/complejidad de la experiencia:

• Se prioriza la experiencia específica en entornos industriales y proyectos de digitalización por sobre la cantidad de años.

SKILLS / TECNOLOGÍAS:

Imprescindibles:

• Análisis funcional y relevamiento de requerimientos.

• Conocimiento de ISA-95 y convergencia IT/OT.

• Arquitecturas SCADA/HMI.

• Protocolos industriales: OPC UA, Modbus, Ethernet/IP.

• Elaboración de documentación funcional, diagramas de procesos y mapas de datos (tags).

• Participación en proyectos bajo metodologías Waterfall y/o Agile (Scrum, Kanban).

Deseables:

• AVEVA System Platform / InTouch.

• AVEVA PI System.

• AVEVA PI Vision.

• Gemelos Digitales.

• Analítica de datos industriales.

• Integración con PLCs e instrumentación industrial.

• Tecnologías de robótica ABB (RobotStudio, controladores de robots, etc.).

• Experiencia en industrias manufactureras, automotrices, metalúrgicas, alimenticias o químicas.

EDUCACIÓN:

• Formación requerida:

• Ingeniería en Automatización y Control.

• Ingeniería Mecatrónica.

• Ingeniería Electrónica.

• Ingeniería Electromecánica.

• Ingeniería Industrial.

• Ingeniería de Producción.

• Ingeniería Química.

• O carreras afines con orientación a procesos industriales.

• Nivel: Graduado o estudiante avanzado.

OTROS REQUISITOS / BENEFICIOS:

• Participación en proyectos de digitalización industrial de punta a punta.

• Interacción con equipos multidisciplinarios compuestos por ingenieros de control, desarrolladores y proveedores.

• Rol orientado a innovación, automatización, robótica, gemelos digitales y mejora continua.

• Fuerte exposición a operaciones industriales y transformación digital de planta.

En Adistec Argentina estamos buscando a un Analista Funcional Semi Senior para sumarse a nuestro equipo.

Te invitamos a sumarte a una empresa líder en distribución de valor agregado de Latinoamérica y el Caribe, con más de 20 años de trayectoria en el mercado, entregando soluciones de tecnología de la información.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO

Será responsable de analizar las necesidades de procesos y sistemas informáticos de la compañía, teniendo contacto directo con los usuarios internos y proveedores de servicios externos, con el fin de diseñar soluciones funcionales que mejoren la eficiencia y productividad de los equipos que las utilicen.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Realizar el relevamiento de las necesidades y definir los requerimientos de los usuarios internos y proveedores de servicios externos.

• Analizar los sistemas y funcionalidades existentes.

• Análisis GAP o, análisis de brechas, basado en la comparación de una situación deseada por el usuario con la situación dada o de partida.

• Detectar oportunidades de mejora de los requisitos del usuarios internos y proveedores de servicios externos.

• Crear planes de cambio basados en los requerimientos analizados y documentar las especificaciones.

• Brindar soporte a los usuarios durante el entrenamiento práctico en el uso del sistema en la etapa de implementación.

• Generar y ejecutar los casos de prueba funcionales.

• Definir las pruebas que se utilizarán en QA para comprobar el cumplimiento de los requerimientos de los usuarios internos y proveedores de servicios externos.

• Escribir los manuales de usuario y crear la documentación funcional y técnica pertinente de las funcionalidades implementadas.

• Mantener actualizada la documentación funcional/manuales de uso.

• Trabajar dinámicamente con demás equipos que participan en el proceso de diseño e implementación (desarrolladores, QA, soporte, usuarios, entre otros).

• Trabajar con usuarios internos de subsidiarias en distintos países de Latino América y proveedores de servicios externos.

• Nota: La posición puede realizar otros proyectos o tareas diversas según lo solicitado o asignado.

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You provide software and applications expertise, and be responsible for implementation of the solutions.

How You Will Contribute

You will oversee the planning and execution of software and applications. To do so, you will manage an internal team and partner with external suppliers and use your deep technical and market knowledge and thorough understanding of our business goals find and deploy the right software and application solutions for the future. You will support programs to implement regional and global software and application strategies, offer input to financial planning and controls for software and applications on a regional and global level, collaborate with management and follow-up on requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, and payments, explores opportunities to leverage scale and drive savings, and ensure that support service level objectives and key performance indicators are accomplished.

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in :

• Managing staff and line responsibilities

• Managing large-scale software and application services

• Service delivery, support and excellence

• Program/Project management with experience managing multiple projects for budgets, resources, schedules and quality

• General technical background

• Process and service orientation

postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.

You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

• Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.

• Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

• Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.

• Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.

• Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.

• Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.

• Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.

• Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.

• Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

• Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.

• Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.

• Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.

• Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.

• Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.

• Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.

• Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.

• Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).

• Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.

• Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

• Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.

• Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).

• Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.

• Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.

• Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

postings.title: Director, Product Management Applied AI
postings.descriptionText:
We are looking for a product leader to run a portfolio that includes AI-powered products and to own how our Product Management team applies AI — the strategy, standards, investment decisions, governance and team capability. You will lead and develop a team of Product Managers, own product strategy and P&L across the portfolio, and raise the organization's product-AI capability.

What "Applied AI" means at Director level. The emphasis shifts from doing the hands-on AI work to judging it, funding the right AI bets and setting the guardrails. This is a product-leadership role — not an engineering, data-science or AI-research role. You set direction and standards for the specialists who build.

Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a team of Product Managers running a portfolio that includes AI-powered products; own product strategy, vision and P&L across that portfolio

• Set an AI-informed product strategy — where AI creates durable advantage, where it is commoditizing, and how to sequence the roadmap against advancing AI capability

• Make build / buy / partner and investment decisions for AI capabilities; own AI business cases and ROI; fund the right experiments and know when to stop them

• Own AI-feature economics and lifecycle across the portfolio — cost, latency, unit economics, pricing, and model-lifecycle decisions (drift, versioning, vendor change)

• Set the standards, operating model and review gates for how the team builds AI features and uses AI in its own work, so quality and responsibility are consistent

• Own responsible-AI governance — privacy, bias, security, transparency, human oversight, audit trails, incident response, and applicable regulation (e.g., EU AI Act) and sector rules

• Raise the team's AI capability through coaching, playbooks, shared prompt/agent libraries and an AI component in the hiring bar; advise business units or clients on adoption

• Direct effective collaboration across product, engineering, data, design and AI/ML teams, keeping product intent, constraints and accountability clear

• Represent the organization credibly on its AI product strategy with senior clients — setting realistic expectations rather than over-promising

Requirements

• 7+ years in Product Management, having managed products, product lines/families and/or groups, with experience leading PM/PO teams; developed and/or launched 3+ products to market, including AI-powered products or capabilities

• Ownership of product vision, roadmap and P&L, and of strategic roadmap alignment across a portfolio

• Portfolio analysis and strategy formulation; prioritizing spend by ROI and supporting financial models — including AI business cases and build/buy/partner decisions

• Track record aligning product strategy with new technologies, assessing and adopting emerging AI capabilities responsibly

• SME across multiple (3+) business domains; deep grasp of consumer trends, technological disruption and competitive factors — including how AI is reshaping the domain

• AI literacy sufficient to lead — understands AI concepts, capabilities and limitations well enough to make sound portfolio and investment decisions and to challenge technical proposals credibly; ML-engineering / data-science depth is not required

• Able to shape company product strategy, convey difficult messages to senior stakeholders and own key initiatives and business KPIs

• Leads, develops and champions a team of Product Managers across a multi-product portfolio; identifies and plans for performance improvement

• Sets the operating model for how the team applies AI, and raises its proficiency through enablement, coaching and a clear hiring bar

• AI-informed product/portfolio strategy — advantage vs commoditization, build/buy/partner, AI business cases and ROI, roadmap sequencing against AI capability

• Responsible-AI governance across the portfolio — privacy, bias, security, transparency, human oversight, audit trails/incident response and relevant regulation

• Ownership of AI-feature economics and lifecycle — cost, latency, unit economics, pricing, drift/versioning/vendor decisions

• Setting AI standards and review gates for how the team builds AI features and uses AI

• Raising team AI capability — enablement, coaching, playbooks, shared tooling, hiring bar

• Ability to evaluate AI outputs, prototypes and technical proposals and fund the right bets

• Working AI literacy — concepts, capabilities and limitations sufficient to lead and challenge

• Continued practical use of AI in own work and adaptability as AI evolves

• Ability to direct effective collaboration across engineering, data, design and AI/ML teams

Nice to have

• Deep hands-on AI prototyping or feature-building (valued, but expected to plateau here — it is the Senior PM / IC strength; the Director's job is to judge and fund, not build)

• External thought leadership on AI product management (talks, publications, community)

• Direct experience standing up an AI governance or enablement program at organization scale

We offer

• Connectivity Bonus (25,000 ARS are paid with a salary receipt at the end of each month as a non-wages concept).

• Medicina Prepaga (It covers the collaborator and direct family group).

• Paternity Leave (Two additional days are added to what is established by law, total of 4 days).

• Discounts card.

• English Training (English lessons, twice per week).

• Training Program (Access to multiple customized training plans according to the needs of each role within the company).

• Marriage bonus (The company doubles the allowance established by law that ANSES offers).

• Referral Program (Referral bonus is paid when the referral of a collaborator joins the Company).

• External Agreements and Discounts.

• Vacations: 14 calendar days a year

By applying to our role, you are agreeing that your personal data may be used as in set out in EPAM´s Privacy Notice and Policy.

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

postings.title: Team Lead, GTM Systems Business Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

The Lead GTM Systems Business Analyst is responsible for owning business intake, requirement quality, and early solution shaping across the GTM technology landscape. This role sits at the intersection of Business, Ops, and GTM Engineering, ensuring that messy, ambiguous requests are translated into clear, prioritised, and technically sound requirements that the engineering team can deliver against efficiently.

In addition to individual contribution, this role leads and coaches a team of GTM Systems Analysts, raising the bar on requirement quality, stakeholder partnership, and domain expertise across Sales, CS, Marketing, and RevOps systems.

Responsibilities

Business Intake & Partnership (Primary Focus)

• Own the front door for GTM Tech business intake across Sales Ops, CS Ops, Marketing Ops, RevOps, and adjacent teams.

• Engage early with stakeholders to understand the problem, not just the requested solution.

• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) across assigned GTM domains, proactively advising on best practices, trade-offs, and system capabilities.

• Challenge unclear, mis-scoped, or solution-led requests and reframe them into clear WHAT / WHY / OUTCOME definitions.

• Ensure all work entering delivery meets a high standard of clarity, intent, and prioritisation.

Requirements & Solution Shaping

• Translate business needs into clean, structured technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

• Partner closely with GTM Architects and Developers to shape scalable, maintainable solutions before work enters sprint.

• Ensure dependencies, risks, and downstream impacts (data, permissions, integrations) are identified early.

• Maintain consistency in how requirements are documented, reviewed, and approved across the team.

Team Leadership & Coaching

• Lead and manage a team of GTM Systems Analysts, setting clear expectations for quality, ownership, and stakeholder engagement.

• Coach analysts on:

• Effective discovery and requirement gathering

• Translating ambiguity into clarity

• Operating confidently with senior business stakeholders

• Understanding GTM systems end-to-end, not just tickets

• Establish and enforce intake standards, templates, and ways of working.

• Support individual development plans, skill growth, and progression within the team.

Delivery Enablement (Not Delivery Ownership)

• Act as the bridge between Business and GTM Engineering to ensure delivery teams are set up for success.

• Ensure work entering sprint is well-defined, prioritised, and aligned to broader GTM strategy.

• Partner with GTM Engineering Delivery Manager to continuously improve flow, throughput, and predictability.

• Support UAT readiness by ensuring business owners are clear on intent, scope, and acceptance criteria.

Data, Governance & Documentation

• Promote strong data discipline by ensuring requirements consider data quality, reporting, and downstream consumers.

• Support governance efforts by documenting business logic, process decisions, and system behaviours.

• Ensure documentation is clear, accessible, and reusable for both technical teams and business users.

Qualifications

• 6+ years of Salesforce development experience with advanced certifications.

• Proficient in Salesforce Sales Cloud and tools like Gong, Outreach, and ChiliPiper.

• Experience with GTM technologies like Hubspot, Gainsight, and DeaHub.

• Skilled with enterprise integration tools (e.g., Syncari, Workato, Mulesoft, Fivetran).

• Experience developing in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Java.

• Competent in languages like XML, JavaScript, .NET, SQL, and C++.

• Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and building integrations with Salesforce.

• Proactive in enhancing Salesforce and ensuring code best practices.

• Salesforce certifications required (e.g., Platform App Builder).

• Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical requirements for stakeholders.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

• Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

• Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

• We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy.

• For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Technical Project Manager.

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of professional software development experience with IT Technical Project Management and Agile/Scrum leadership.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Solid background in software development, engineering workflows, and full-lifecycle software delivery.

• Proven experience in guiding software engineering teams through complex delivery cycles using Scrum and Kanban.

postings.title: Analytics Scrum Master - Assistant Director - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Analytics Scrum Master – Assistant Director

Are you driven by helping analytics teams operate at their best and deliver outcomes that matter?

Do you enjoy facilitating collaboration between business leaders, technical teams and delivery partners?

Can you champion agile practices, remove delivery barriers and create an environment where teams thrive?

If so, we have a great opportunity for you!

Team: Global Finance

Job Rank: Assistant Director

The opportunity

Global Analytics is a progressive, forward-thinking, cross-functional team of approximately 25 individuals, positioned at the intersection of key decision-making processes and diverse insight use cases across the firm. Our culture is built on openness and collaboration, fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to reach their full potential and contribute to meaningful outcomes.

You will be the scrum master for the overall team, instilling and optimizing AGILE best practices, ceremonies, enabling optimal sprint management through technology and training, and continuously working across the whole team (and potentially other teams within the wider Reporting and Data Analytics function) to identify and resolve blockers and opportunities for efficiency.

You will work alongside Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and Translators to ensure the team is enabled to the greatest possible extent to meet its objectives

Your key responsibilities

You will support and collaborate closely with the Global Analytics leadership and team members to ensure our sprint planning, workflow tracking, user story best practices and communication across the team is best in class in order for the team to deliver strategic impact globally

This will involve key responsibilities such as:

• Delivering training and support to help team members follow and get the most from AGILE practices

• Develop and maintain workflow tracking reports that provide insights into the effectiveness of our planning, estimated vs actual efforts, velocity of delivered tickets and where attention is needed within the team

• Guide, consolidate and work with team member to ensure long term planning documentation is aligned with current realities and goals and build this into a presentable formal visible for the team

• Setup and manage daily stand ups, planning sessions and sprint ceremonies, proactively identifying blockers and supporting to take action to make sure relevant team members / leaders are informed and any other action needed to help unblock issues for the team

• Make you have the holistic visibility you have across the whole team each day to act as a connecter to help solve day to day issues sooner and more effectively

• Maintain and report against long term roadmaps for each of the key projects within the team

You will coach junior colleagues to enable them to develop their skills and capabilities. This may include managing of workload, quality assessment and evaluation, skill transfer and supervision, deliverable expectations and timeframes across multiple projects.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

• A strong track record of owning, leading or managing complex projects or deliverables

• Experience in identifying and proactively acting on opportunities for improvement

• A structured and organized way of working with the ability to set and get a team to work within a defined framework

• An expert level of expertise and experience with AGILE workflow practices including scrum or kanban

• Experience using project management software such as Azure Devops, JIRA, or similar to a best in class level to manage an overall teams deliverables

• Strong leadership skills with the ability and confidence to have difficult conversations where necessary with both team members and senior leaders within the team, whilst also maintaining good rapport across teams and acting as a connecter where appropriate

Ideally, you’ll also have some of the following:

• Some knowledge or experience of concepts and methodologies from the data, reporting, analytics or data engineering domains

• Experience of change management (i.e., such as proactively introducing/migrating to new technologies to teams)

What working at EY offers

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities.

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.

Plus, we offer:

• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and consulting services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Join us in building a better working world.

Apply now.

postings.title: Technology Business Management Office Lead - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Technology Business Management (TBM) Office Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and strategic use of IBM’s Apptio platform to optimize technology investments and enhance business value. This role provides leadership in implementing TBM methodologies and tools, driving transparency in technology spending, and enabling data-driven decision-making across IT and finance teams. The TBM Office Leader acts as a product owner, change agent, championing transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in technology financial management.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Lead the TBM Office, overseeing the deployment and ongoing management of Apptio solutions to track, analyze, and optimize IT costs and investments.

• Collaborate with IT, finance, and the business office to establish and maintain a TBM framework that drives transparency and aligns technology spending with strategic objectives.

• Develop and deliver actionable insights using Apptio dashboards and reports, enabling executive stakeholders to make informed decisions on technology portfolios and investments.

• Data Integration & Quality: Connect Apptio with other tools (e.g., Finance, Talent, Procurement contracts) for automated data loading, cleaning, and validation to ensure accurate reporting.

• Drive adoption of TBM best practices and Apptio platform capabilities, facilitating training, change management initiatives across the organization, and acting as the overall evangelist and subject matter expert in this regard. Educate and train stakeholders on Apptio data to enable decision-making, while bridging gaps between IT, finance, and the business office.

• Monitor and measure performance metrics, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, improved resource allocation, and increased ROI on technology initiatives.

• Financial Analysis & Planning: Support budgeting, forecasting, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), and chargeback/show back reporting.

• Serve as the primary liaison between the organization and IBM Apptio support, ensuring platform updates, troubleshooting, and enhancements meet business needs.

• Change Management: Lead initiatives to mature the organization's use of TBM / Apptio data and foster accountability across the company.

• Stay current with industry trends and regulatory requirements, adapting TBM strategies to ensure compliance, operational excellence, scalability and alignment to EY Finance and Business Office requirements and strategic objectives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Extensive experience in technology business management, IT financial management, or related fields.

• Domain knowledge: Strong knowledge of TBM methodology and detailed knowledge of IBM Apptio platform capabilities, configurations and operations (IT Planning and Cost Transparency)

• Proficiency in data analysis, data modeling, and IT service management. Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data to drive business insights.

• Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence executive decision-making, and drive organizational change.

• Communication: Proven ability to present actionable insights to cross-functional executive-level stakeholders, influence decision making and bring clarity to what would otherwise be considered complex topics.

• Experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.

• Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational goals.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for interpreting complex financial and IT data.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to foster collaboration between IT, finance, and business units.

• Proficiency with Apptio or similar TBM platforms, including dashboard and reporting capabilities.

• Leadership qualities to drive change, champion transparency, and promote accountability in technology financial management.

• Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset to respond to evolving business needs and technology landscapes.

• Solid Project management skills, including the ability to oversee complex initiatives and ensure timely delivery.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline (master’s preferred).

• Relevant experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.

• Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational objectives.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to facilitate collaboration across IT, finance, and business units.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• TBMA certification is desired but not required for this role.

What We Look For

Qualities of top performers include a continuous improvement mindset, good analytical / problem solving / reverse engineering skills, and strong customer service and organizational skills.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fuelled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

postings.title: Senior UX Designer - Data Visualization
postings.descriptionText:
¿Te apasiona transformar datos en conocimiento accionable? Queremos que tengas la oportunidad de potenciar tu carrera diseñando e implementando soluciones digitales de alto impacto en el campo de Applied Intelligence.

🚀 ¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

Se busca un perfil proactivo y entusiasta, interesado en resolver problemas de negocio a través del entendimiento de los usuarios y sus procesos, relacionado a proyectos de data science. Será responsable de llevar adelante iniciativas de UX de punta a punta, entendiendo problemas de negocio y transformándolos en propuestas de solución centradas en el usuario , basadas en el uso de datos y AI. Tendrá un rol activo en la definición, diseño y evolución de dashboards y aplicaciones, facilitando conversaciones con stakeholders y trabajando en conjunto con equipos multidisciplinarios durante su implementación.

🚀Lo que te hará exitoso – Requisitos:

• 4 a 6 años en diseño de productos digitales

• Haber trabajado en proyectos end-to-end: research, diseño, prototipado, testeo y handoff.

• Participación en productos con dashboards, reportes, mapeo de procesos (armado de blueprints) y Data & AI, preferentemente en contextos B2B, enterprise o productos con alta complejidad de información.

• Trabajo con equipos multidisciplinarios: devs, analistas de datos, data scientists, perfiles de negocio y stakeholders de cliente.

• Experiencia acompañando a otros diseñadores junior.

• Experiencia facilitando workshops de discovery, ideación, definición de procesos y co-creación con usuarios y stakeholders.

• Capacidad para trabajar con requerimientos ambiguos, estructurar problemas y proponer recomendaciones de diseño considerando necesidades de usuario, objetivos de negocio y restricciones técnicas.

• Inglés conversacional avanzado (EXCLUYENTE)

Hard skills:

UX Research:

• Entrevistas a usuarios, encuestas, pruebas de usabilidad, análisis de insights.

• Metodologias como bench marking, user journey, definición de user personas.

UI:

• Armado de wireframes, prototipado, interaccciones.

• Uso de Figma, Miro y Mural.

• Manejo y aplicación de design systems

• Principios de visualización: elegir el gráfico adecuado según el dato y el usuario.

• Diseño de dashboards claros y accionables

• Conocimiento básico de herramientas Power BI, Tableau (no excluyente).

Consultoría y facilitación:

• Capacidad para comprender necesidades de negocio y traducirlas en oportunidades de experiencia y producto.

• Facilitación de workshops y dinámicas de trabajo con usuarios, negocio y equipos técnicos.

• Presentación y argumentación de decisiones de diseño frente a stakeholders.

• Capacidad para cuestionar requerimientos, identificar oportunidades y recomendar alternativas de solución.

• Priorización de iniciativas considerando impacto en usuario, valor de negocio y viabilidad técnica.

Soft Skills:

• Comunicación clara y didáctica

• Empatía tanto con usuarios como con stakeholders.

• Pensamiento crítico (cuestionar requerimientos y proponer mejoras).

• Trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal.

• Adaptabilidad

• Autonomía y capacidad de ownership sobre iniciativas y entregables.

• Capacidad de generar alineamiento entre distintas áreas y stakeholders.

• Habilidades de acompañamiento y mentoring a perfiles de diseño con menor seniority.

Plus que suma mucho:

• Capacidad de traducir métricas y plasmarlas en visualizaciones útiles que faciliten la interpretación de información y la toma de decisiones.

postings.title: Release Train Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of Release Train Engineer .

The ERP Release Manager is responsible for governing and coordinating the end-to-end release lifecycle across SAP environments, including ECC and S/4HANA. The role ensures the successful planning, execution, and deployment of ongoing support releases, enhancement projects, upgrades, migration activities, and emergency fixes while minimizing business disruption. Working closely with technical teams, project stakeholders, and business partners, this position drives release excellence, compliance, risk management, and continuous process improvement across the SAP landscape.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

• Serve as the primary servant leader and facilitator for the ERP Agile Release Train (ART), ensuring alignment, collaboration, and execution across multiple SAP and ERP teams.

• Facilitate Program Increment (PI) Planning activities, ensuring business priorities, strategic objectives, dependencies, and team commitments are aligned.

• Coordinate cross-functional collaboration among SAP Functional Teams, Development Teams, BASIS, QA, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, Product Management, and Business Stakeholders.

• Lead and facilitate ART ceremonies, including ART Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events.

• Monitor and track delivery progress against PI Objectives, milestones, roadmap commitments, and business outcomes.

• Identify, assess, mitigate, and communicate program-level risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational impediments impacting ERP delivery.

• Drive transparency through program metrics, dashboards, reporting, and communication of delivery status to stakeholders and leadership teams.

• Promote Agile, Lean, and SAFe best practices, fostering continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivery excellence across the ART.

• Support governance processes by ensuring alignment between execution activities, business priorities, and strategic objectives.

• Coordinate planning and execution activities supporting SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration programs, ERP modernization efforts, and other transformation initiatives.

• Facilitate retrospectives, Inspect & Adapt workshops, and lessons learned sessions to improve delivery predictability, quality, and team effectiveness.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for ART-level communications, ensuring transparency and alignment across ERP stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in Agile Program Delivery, Release Train Engineering, ERP Program Management, Technology Transformations, or related leadership roles.

• Experience supporting large-scale SAP environments, including ECC and/or S/4HANA implementations, support organizations, or transformation programs.

• Strong understanding of Agile, SAFe, Lean, and enterprise delivery methodologies.

• Experience facilitating multi-team planning, dependency management, execution tracking, and stakeholder alignment activities.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, leadership, and organizational skills.

• Experience supporting enterprise applications within complex global organizations and matrixed delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA migration, ERP modernization, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• Knowledge of SAFe, Agile, Lean, DevOps, Value Stream Management, and related delivery methodologies.

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, SAP Solution Manager, or similar delivery planning and program management tools.

• Understanding of SAP landscapes, ERP delivery models, enterprise architecture principles, and cross-team dependency management.

• Experience driving Agile adoption, organizational change, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Scrum Master, Agile, or related professional certifications are preferred.

Relocation Options:

Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.
