postings.title: Senior Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Latin America , preferably working in hours that align to PT (Pacific Timezone) or ET (Eastern Timezone) . Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Project Manager, you are a champion for Project Management and Agile best-practices but are flexible, and can adjust your processes to fit your project team and clients’ needs. You are comfortable wearing multiple hats and acting as a Scrum Master. You can manage budgets, timelines and client expectations with ease. You are a consultant, a problem solver, and a “big picture” thinker while digging into the details. The ideal candidate will be solution-driven and able to handle multiple fast-paced projects while managing multiple teams and communicating with leadership. Above all , you are accountable to your team, to yourself, and to the delivery of excellence.

Responsibilities

• Own capacity and resource allocation tracking across Managed Services squads, maintaining an accurate and up-to-date view of team availability, utilisation, and workload balance and forward-looking capacity forecasts to anticipate demand across the client portfolio..

• Monitor hours consumption against retainer allocations on a regular cadence, surfacing discrepancies, overruns, or underutilisation early and escalating as appropriate.

• Proactively identify and flag delivery risks — timeline slippage, team bottlenecks, scope creep, dependency blockers — before they escalate, and coordinate resolution/mitigation plan with squad leads and tech leads.

• Manage squad-level delivery processes: maintain backlogs, track sprint progress, coordinate ceremonies (planning, retrospectives, demos), and ensure delivery cadences are followed consistently.

• Partner with the London-based Senior PM to ensure seamless handoff and alignment between client-facing commitments and internal execution capacity.

• Support the Director of Managed Services with operational reporting, including utilisation metrics, team health signals, and portfolio-level status updates.

• Maintain documentation hygiene across tools (Jira, Notion, Tempo, etc.), ensuring project data is reliable and accessible for the wider team.

• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of MgS operational processes, templates, and tooling as the practice scales.

• Coordinate onboarding logistics for new clients or new squad members, ensuring teams have what they need to start well.

REQUIREMENTS:

• 4–6+ years of experience in project management, delivery management, or operations roles within a digital agency, consultancy, or software delivery environment.

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams or client accounts with strong attention to detail and organisational discipline.

• Hands-on experience with resource or capacity management — tracking team utilisation, managing allocations, and producing operational reports.

• Solid understanding of Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and experience running or supporting sprint ceremonies.

• Proficiency with project management and delivery tooling, particularly Jira, Confluence, and Notion. Experience with time-tracking tools (e.g. Tempo) is a strong asset.

• Comfortable working with data: able to read hours reports, identify trends, and present clear summaries to stakeholders without requiring heavy data analysis support.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to communicate clearly across time zones in async-first environments.

• Experience working with or within a managed services, retainer-based, or continuous delivery model is a strong advantage.

• Thrives in a support-oriented role and measures success through team outcomes rather than individual recognition.

• A proactive, ownership-driven mindset: you flag problems before they become crises, and you follow through.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery: Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment: We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling: Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy: Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Flexible work arrangements: We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.

We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.

How to Apply

Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.

Key Responsibilities

Required Experience

• Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products

Strongly Preferred Experience

• Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions

• Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops

AI Expectations

We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.

You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With

• User-flow exploration

• Wireframe ideation

• Interface-copy options

• Product requirement organization

• Edge-case discovery

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.

The Person We Are Looking For

You are a true product thinker.

You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.

You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.

You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.

Compensation

postings.descriptionText:
Product Designer at Aios Medical — Remote, $100-200k/yr inc equity About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

• The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

• The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

• Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

• Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

• Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

• Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

• Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here:Working at AIOS

Being a Product Designer at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

You’ll be taking on a senior, high-ownership role in product design at Aios Medical. We have multiple roles in the team across our clinical software and customer facing mobile app.

You’ll be stepping into a product that has grown fast and needs stronger design leadership, judgment, and structure.

Some of this work is visible and polished. Some of it is messy and internal. You’ll own projects end-to-end. That means taking loosely defined problems, talking to the right people, understanding workflows and constraints, and shipping solutions you can stand behind. We’re looking for someone who can run with a problem independently and be trusted to get it over the line.

The work often sits at the intersection of user needs, business goals, and real constraints. You might be working with engineers on a customer app flow, untangling a complex internal workflow that’s slowing teams down, reviewing CX tickets to understand where users are breaking, or defending a design decision.

You’ll report directly to our Head of Product Design (Ryan Wu) and work closely with our Head of Product (Ben Dowdle). You’ll also work alongside the rest of our Product and Design org, as well as our engineering and CX teams. You’ll be superb at collaborating and moving fast.

This is a full-time, remote role. We’re async-friendly and flexible with hours, but overlap with European and US time zones is expected.

Key responsibilities

• Design ownership: You take ownership of design work across products and run projects independently, from problem definition to shipped solution.

• Customer apps: You design and improve customer-facing web and mobile app experiences. Mobile app work is a major focus area.

• Internal tools & workflows: You work on internal products used by clinical, ops, enrolment, and CX teams, focusing on workflow, usability, and efficiency.

• Complex problem solving: You work on products with real commercial and regulatory constraints. You understand that not everything can be changed freely.

• Business & user understanding: You start from the business problem and the user need. You can clearly explain what problem you were solving and why.

• End-to-end project ownership: You lead projects independently, including discovery, talking to users or internal teams, defining the solution, and shipping it.

• Clear communication: You can articulate your thinking, defend decisions, and hold your ground in discussions with strong opinions.

• Hands-on leadership: You’re comfortable being senior, helping shape how design works, and supporting other designers as the team grows, without stepping away from hands-on work.

Need to have

Experience: You’ve spent 3+ years designing digital products across web or mobile , including customer-facing mobile apps or internal tooling. What matters is that you’ve designed real products used by real people.

Robust Portfolio: Your portfolio shows real product work that shows off your design taste. We want to see the problem, the rules you had to work within, and the impact of your decisions - including polished screens of the output.

Ownership: You take loosely defined problems and run with them. You figure out what needs to be done, who to talk to, and how to move a project from idea to shipped solution. You don’t need constant direction, and you don’t get stuck in endless exploration.

Craft: You care about clarity and usability more than surface-level polish. You can work within fixed requirements, technical limitations, and existing systems, and still make meaningful improvements.

Clear thinking & communication: You can clearly explain what problem you were solving, why certain decisions were made, and what tradeoffs were involved. You’re comfortable defending your work and navigating discussions with strong opinions.

Nice to have

Formal or equivalent design training: You’ve studied design, computer science, or a related field - or you’ve built the same depth of thinking through real product work.

Working in regulated and complex products: You don’t need experience in healthcare specifically. What matters is that you’ve worked on products where design decisions are shaped by regulation, compliance, legal requirements, or strong business rules. You understand that some copy, flows, or elements can’t simply be removed or redesigned, and that good design often means improving clarity and usability within those realities

Design that gets built: You’re comfortable working with engineers and thinking through implementation details. You understand how design decisions show up in real code and systems.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

• Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

• Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

• Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

• If we’re average we fail: We are only interested in “insanely great”, a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

• Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn’t say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

• A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

• Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

• Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You’ll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

• Keep your head down: We’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

• The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 “You just build a f ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”*

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

• Compensation: $90,000-$150,000 (inc equity)

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

• Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

• Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays)

This role bridges design and engineering by defining flows, interaction behavior, navigation rules, and component standards that ship reliably across platforms and input methods.

Responsibilities

• Define UI flows, user journeys, and interaction models for in-game screens and features; produce clear, implementable specs

• Build and maintain a scalable UI component system, including patterns, components, variants, and states that support consistent implementation

• Author detailed behavior rules covering navigation/focus order, back behavior, input handling expectations, error/empty/loading states, and edge cases

Requirements

With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About The Role

We are seeking a passionate and highly experienced Staff Product Designer to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of our products, driving design excellence, and delivering delightful customer experiences. You will lead design initiatives across vertical and horizontal projects, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure a cohesive and impactful user experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Design Initiatives: Define and deliver product design across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with user needs and business goals. Lead the development of end-to-end features and services that resonate with our users.

• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and business partners, to build coherent, high-quality experiences that are both functional and delightful.

• Advocate for Design Systems: Champion the Deel UI/Design System strategy, driving adoption through an iterative approach that balances consistency with innovation.

• Design and Prototype at Speed: Rapidly design, prototype, and test new features based on a deep understanding of business, customers and technology, to deliver thoughtful solutions even in the face of ambiguity.

• Mentor and Guide: Provide mentorship to Product Designers, offering constructive feedback to foster growth and skill development. Lead design practice rituals and develop new standards that enhance team efficiency.

• Identify and Solve Bottlenecks: Partner with product and engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, make informed recommendations, and implement improvements that streamline process.

• Drive Clarity from Complexity: Navigate ambiguity with ease, driving clarity and actionable insights from complex situations. Equally, balance user and business needs to create solutions that are impactful and strategic.

• Outstanding Communication and Facilitation: Bring people together through inspiring design and narrative. Foster alignment across teams by effectively communicating a design vision and facilitating collaboration.

Requirements

• Extensive Experience: A minimum of 5-7 years as a Product Designer in a fast-paced environment, with at least 2 years leading holistic design as a Staff Product Designer (or equivalent title).

• Multi-Disciplinary Expertise: Strong skills in UI, UX, and visual design, with a proven track record of crafting functional yet delightful customer experiences. Comfortable working through complex flows, creating engaging interfaces, and storytelling through visuals and prototypes.

• AI: Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies; experience designing AI-assisted or AI-powered product experiences or using AI tools as part of your design workflow. A portfolio that includes examples of work related to AI-powered features, AI-assisted workflows, or experiments with AI tools.

• Data-Informed Design: Your design work is deeply rooted in ideation, experimentation and evidence, ensuring that recommendations are always backed by data.

• Comfortable with Ambiguity: Able to work at speed while maintaining high-quality and thoughtful solutions; driving clarity from complexity and ambiguity.

• Balances User and Business Needs: Equally focused on user experience and business objectives, ensuring that design solutions meet both criteria effectively.

• Strong Communicator and Facilitator: An outstanding communicator who can bring people together, build strong relationships, and gain alignment across teams. Inspires through design and narrative.

• Mentorship Experience: Experienced in mentoring Product Designers, providing guidance that enables them to learn, grow, and progress in their careers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners, developing best practices for engagement and collaboration across the organisation.

• Industry Knowledge: Strong knowledge of Payroll and Fintech, with the ability to apply this expertise to deliver impactful design solutions.

• Embedded Team Experience: Experienced in being deeply embedded within a development team, working with a light touch from the Product Manager to deliver high-quality outcomes.

postings.title: Senior Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

Location : This role is a full-time remote position.

What You’ll Do:

• Product Design

• Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

• Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

• Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

• Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

• Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

• Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

Design Systems

• Use and extend Jeeves’s existing design system and standards

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

• Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

Research & Validation

• Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

• Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

• Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

• Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves, grounded in evidence

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

• Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

• Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

• Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

• 5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

• Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

• A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

• Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

• Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

• Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

• Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

• Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

• Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

• Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

• Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

• Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

• Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

• Native or professional English and Spanish, Portuguese ability preferred

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Creative and Strategic Thinking

Collaboration and Communication

At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

postings.title: Member of Technical Staff, Product Design
postings.descriptionText:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Product Designer at Profound, you will work on our core data visualization and content workflow tools. This is an opportunity to have deep ownership over our product and ship fast and ship often, while continuing to craft the experience for our users.

What you’ll do

• Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration

• Work closely with product managers and engineers to translate strategy and ambiguous problems into clear, thoughtful solutions

• Explore multiple directions quickly through sketches, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs

• Sweat the details and fine tune layout shifts, typography, spacing, motion, and interactions

• Balance building good product focused on user needs, technical constraints, and business goals while keeping a high bar for craft

• Use user feedback, qualitative insights, and product intuition to refine and improve the product over time

• Contribute to and help evolve Profound’s design language, systems, and product vision

• Participate in Tuesday and Thursday design critiques to give and receive feedback on in-progress design work

Who you are

• You have 3 or more years of experience designing digital products, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product company

• You are a strong generalist with taste and are comfortable owning the full stack of design assets, from flows to pixels to final product

• You care deeply about craft and believe great design is defined by clarity, simplicity, and execution

• You bring an entrepreneurial and product-thinking mindset to design

• You like to experiment with AI, new tools, and ways of working, whether through new Figma plugins or tools such as v0, Cursor, or other prototyping tools

• You are good at collaborating with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to solve problems

• You have a portfolio that shows thoughtful problem-solving and high-quality visual design

• Experience working on a data visualization or B2B marketing product

• Enjoy prototyping directly in code and shipping directly to production using git and GitHub

• Blur the lines between where design ends and product or engineering work begins

• You can just do things

Note from our co-founder

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

Location

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF or Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $120,000 to $250,000 (NYC and SF). Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

postings.title: Senior Web Designer
postings.descriptionText:
About Amply
Amply is a digital design and development agency partnering with B2B SaaS, healthcare and fintech companies to build brands and digital experiences that drive growth. We take craft seriously, invest in our people, and believe great work comes from great culture.

About the role
We’re looking for a senior web designer who can own projects end to end, from brief and creative direction through design system, execution and developer handoff.

The role has changed a lot in the last year. We’ve always built exceptional Webflow sites, and we still do, but we’re increasingly working as a strategic partner to marketing leaders, and AI is reshaping how sites get designed, built and improved. Our projects are increasingly platform agnostic. The designers who do well here bring strong judgment and taste, use AI fluently as part of their process, and are curious about where this is heading rather than attached to how it used to work.

You’ll work across both project-based engagements and long-term client accounts, alongside design leads, project managers and our development team. It suits someone who enjoys ownership, thinks about the business goal behind every brief, and holds themselves to a high standard.

What you’ll do

• Own web design on your projects from kickoff to launch: concept and direction, design system, execution, developer handoff and design QA on the build

• Deliver production-ready work at a consistently high standard, with clean design systems, consistent typography and files a development team can build from

• Interpret briefs critically, define the right level of complexity for each client, and develop original directions from research and references

• Manage scope and time on your work, and flag early when either is at risk

• Present to clients and defend design decisions with clear reasoning

• Collaborate with developers on feasibility and review builds against your designs before launch

• Use AI tools throughout the process, from research and discovery synthesis to reference gathering, concept exploration and early copy

• Contribute to our design system, standards and knowledge sharing across the team

Who we’re looking for
This role isn’t suitable for junior or mid-level candidates. We’re looking for someone who already operates at a senior level and can own a project’s design outcome independently.

• 5+ years designing marketing websites, with at least 2 in an agency or multi-client environment. The pace and client dynamics are specific

• Portfolio of shipped B2B or SaaS websites where you can speak to the brief, the constraints and what you’d do differently

• Figma at a systems level: variables, local styles, auto layout, component architecture and naming conventions ready for developer handoff

postings.title: Shopify UX Designer – Customizer Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Shopify UX Designer – Customizer Specialist

Location: Remote –Argentina

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time to Full-Time Contractor

Industry: E-commerce / Digital Design / Technology

Compensation: $1,400–$2,200 USD/month

Experience: 2+ Years of Shopify Experience

English Proficiency: Strong Professional English – Client-Facing

Schedule: Flexible U.S. Business Hours | Availability between Eastern and Pacific Time business hours

Initial Engagement: 2–3 Month Paid Trial Period

Portfolio: Required

About The Company

Our client is a U.S.-based e-commerce agency specializing in Shopify design, development, migrations, and growth for mid-market brands.

The company helps e-commerce businesses build, optimize, and scale their online stores by combining UX strategy, design, development, conversion optimization, and technical Shopify expertise . Projects include new Shopify builds as well as migrations from platforms such as Magento and BigCommerce.

The remote team includes project managers, designers, and developers who collaborate throughout each project, from storefront planning and UX strategy through implementation, QA, launch, and optimization.

The company values clear communication, ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and practical problem-solving , particularly designers who understand how to create strong e-commerce experiences within Shopify's capabilities.

About The Role

We are looking for a Shopify UX Designer – Customizer Specialist who combines strong e-commerce UX thinking with hands-on Shopify implementation.

This is a UX-first role , but we're specifically looking for a designer who understands how to create beautiful, conversion-focused storefronts using Shopify's built-in capabilities rather than relying on fully custom-coded solutions.

You'll plan site structure, navigation, PDPs, collections, filtering, and overall user experiences , while also working directly inside the Shopify Theme Customizer using sections, blocks, metafields, and metaobjects.

You'll use Figma for style guides, wireframes, mockups, and designs that extend beyond theme capabilities. When custom development is truly necessary, you'll prepare clear specifications and collaborate with developers.

This is also a client-facing position. You'll present designs and recommendations, gather feedback, and help clients understand how to manage their Shopify stores after launch.

Why This Opportunity?

• Combine Shopify, UX design, e-commerce strategy, and hands-on storefront configuration in one role

• Work on real Shopify projects for established e-commerce brands

• Own work from initial UX planning through final QA

• Work directly with clients and present your recommendations and designs

• Collaborate closely with project managers, designers, and developers

• Develop deeper expertise in Shopify, CRO, Klaviyo, accessibility, and AI-assisted design workflows

• Start with a paid trial period with the opportunity to grow into a longer-term engagement

What You'll Do

Shopify UX & Strategy

• Plan site structure, navigation, menus, mega menus, and page hierarchy

• Create Web Style Guides in Figma, including typography, colors, buttons, and component styles

• Conduct UX and CRO audits and translate findings into prioritized recommendations

• Develop collection and filtering strategies, including product grouping, sorting, tagging, and filtering

• Shape Product Detail Page (PDP) strategy, including buy-box layouts, product information, and cross-sells

• Balance strong UX and visual design with what Shopify themes can realistically support

• Stay current with Shopify updates, theme capabilities, e-commerce UX best practices, and emerging AI tools

Shopify Design & Theme Customization

• Build and style homepages, product pages, collection pages, headers, footers, and content pages directly in the Shopify Theme Customizer

• Work confidently with Shopify OS 2.0, sections, and blocks

• Configure and manage metafields and metaobjects for structured content such as size guides, specifications, and FAQs

• Create responsive desktop and mobile wireframes and mockups in Figma when requirements extend beyond theme capabilities

• Configure and style Shopify apps for reviews, upsells, bundles, subscriptions, swatches, and customer support

• Verify app embeds and integrations after theme changes

• Design and build Klaviyo email templates and flows when required by individual projects

QA & Developer Handoff

• Perform QA across desktop, tablet, and mobile

• Conduct basic accessibility checks, including contrast, alt text, and keyboard order

• Identify early when a requirement goes beyond native Shopify capabilities and requires custom development

• Prepare clear developer notes and handoff specifications

• Collaborate with developers and project managers to ensure designs are implemented accurately

• Own work from initial design through final QA rather than handing it off after the design stage

Client Meetings & Training

• Participate in regular client meetings and present plans, designs, builds, and project progress

• Walk clients through wireframes, mockups, and Shopify storefront configurations

• Clearly explain UX decisions and recommendations

• Gather client feedback and translate it into practical design or implementation changes

• Create Shopify guides showing clients how to manage their stores after launch

• Record short Loom training videos covering store updates and day-to-day management tasks

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of professional experience building Shopify stores using theme-store themes

• A portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront work is required

• Portfolio should demonstrate hands-on Shopify Theme Customizer experience, not exclusively custom-coded or non-Shopify websites

• Strong experience with Shopify OS 2.0, sections, and blocks

• Hands-on experience using metafields and metaobjects in Shopify Admin

• Strong Figma skills for style guides, wireframes, and responsive mockups

• Experience planning site architecture, navigation, collections, and filtering

• Ability to conduct a UX audit and clearly explain recommendations

• Strong understanding of e-commerce UX, mobile-first design, visual hierarchy, and typography

• Ability to design attractive storefront experiences within the practical capabilities of Shopify themes

• Working knowledge of WCAG accessibility fundamentals

• Strong professional spoken and written English

• Confidence leading client-facing meetings and presenting design recommendations in English

• Ability to create clear written documentation and record short training videos

• Reliable availability during agreed U.S. business hours

• Strong organization, ownership, responsiveness, and attention to detail in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Klaviyo, including flows, templates, and signup forms

• Experience with Shopify apps such as Rebuy, Judge.me, Okendo, Yotpo, Recharge, or Gorgias

• Basic Liquid and/or HTML/CSS knowledge

• Experience with A/B testing or Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

• Experience supporting Magento-to-Shopify or BigCommerce-to-Shopify migrations

• Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and incorporating AI into design workflows

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

• Create polished, conversion-focused Shopify storefront experiences

• Combine strong UX thinking with practical hands-on Shopify execution

• Use Shopify's Theme Customizer effectively rather than unnecessarily relying on custom development

• Build intuitive site architecture, navigation, PDPs, collections, and filtering experiences

• Use metafields and metaobjects effectively to support scalable storefront content

• Deliver high-quality Figma designs that translate effectively into Shopify

• Identify technical limitations and communicate them early

• Provide developers with clear and actionable handoff documentation when custom development is required

• Deliver consistent quality across desktop, tablet, and mobile

• Communicate confidently with clients and incorporate feedback effectively

• Own work from initial strategy through final QA

Why Join Us?

• Competitive compensation of $1,400–$2,200 USD/month

• Fully remote opportunity from Latin America

• Flexible U.S. working hours, with schedules that can fall anywhere between Eastern and Pacific business hours based on team needs

• Flexible PTO, including holidays in your country plus additional paid time off

• Work on real-world Shopify projects for established e-commerce brands

• Combine UX, Figma, Shopify, CRO, and e-commerce strategy in one role

• Work directly with clients and collaborate with experienced designers, developers, and project managers

• Continue developing your expertise across modern Shopify themes, apps, Klaviyo, accessibility, and emerging AI tools

• Opportunity to begin part-time and grow into a larger, long-term engagement

Important Notes

A portfolio is required for this position. Candidates should be able to demonstrate Shopify storefronts they have personally designed and/or configured using the Shopify Theme Customizer .

Portfolios consisting primarily of custom-coded websites or non-Shopify work without demonstrated Theme Customizer experience will not be a strong match .

This is a UX-first Shopify role , but candidates must also be comfortable implementing high-quality storefront experiences using Shopify's native tools. Strong Figma, Theme Customizer, metafields, metaobjects, and client-facing English skills are essential.

The company prefers to begin the engagement part-time and gradually ramp up , although an exceptional candidate may be considered for full-time work from the beginning.

The initial engagement typically includes a 2–3 month paid trial period . As part of the selection process, portfolios will be reviewed first, and final candidates may be invited to complete a paid trial project .

Candidates must be able to provide reliable coverage during agreed U.S. business hours. The team can accommodate schedules within the range of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time through 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time .

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Imaginative, curious, and adaptable — you sweat the small stuff, because you know that great design is in the details.

You are creative, inspired, and driven to produce innovative design. You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful imagery. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Digital Designer role with Boldsky.

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Digital Designer: To shape the product development process with a user-centric mentality. You will help create visual elements for websites, mobile apps and other formats, lead user research, brainstorm ideas to inform the product development process and work with internal and external tech teams for implementation.

Responsibilities:

• Understand and implement direction from the art/copy and development teams.

• As a Designer you will switch gears, successfully juggle responsibilities, and move across multiple projects while ensuring that files are built correctly.

• Demonstrate ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint.

• Work within InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator (using Adobe CC suite) to create stand-out work.

• Must be proficient at Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD

• Social media content

• Website design

• Interactive/digital content

• Booth/Congress multimedia interfaces

• Understanding of information architecture

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.

• 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.

• Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).

• Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.

• Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.

• Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.

• 3-7 years’ experience creating mid to large scale corporate and campaign websites

• Excellence at designing a brand experience across multiple channels, including web and mobile

• Experience designing for healthcare and pharma

• Expertise in developing wireframes and prototypes

• Prototyping tools like Sketch, Figma and Adobe XD, along with Adobe Creative Suite, Jira, and MS Office Suite a plus

• You have a high-level understanding of SEO and ability to speak to it a plus.

Should also be:

• Conceptually Creative: Ability to think in abstract terms; make connections between unrelated notions; formulate innovative ideas where others cannot; seen as original and value-added in brainstorming sessions

• Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can understand creative direction based on objectives and execute creative work effectively. Understands the concept of talent-to-task and communicates well with others on workload issues & needs, progress of work and results

• Industry Application: Picks up on technical things quickly; is good at learning new industry, company, product, and/or technical knowledge developments of the client's business as well as the agency business; has the functional and technical knowledge and skills to do the job at a high level of accomplishment

• Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Demonstrates ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint

• Willingness to be Flexible: Willing to work outside of job description as needed, be flexible for the team, and ultimately the work.

At Syneos Health Communications, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

BoldSky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, flexible paid time off (PTO). Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable national/federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

postings.title: Product Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

Established in 2008, Zicasso is the most-reviewed and highest-rated luxury travel company, specializing in immersive custom tours, vacations, and safaris. Our Zicasso travel specialists are the world's top 2% of boutique tour operators and travel agents, pre-vetted and handpicked to compete in creating itineraries tailored to each of our travelers' unique preferences. Joining Zicasso, you'll play a key role in bringing our travelers' dreams to life—pushing the boundaries of what's possible with luxury travel experiences.

As a member of our team, you'll be part of a company recognized for its strong brand reputation among discerning travelers. Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and Condé Nast Traveler, to name a few. See our press coverage here.

We are a fully remote company spanning five continents, and we foster a dynamic, progressive global work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We're seeking passionate, data-driven individuals who thrive in a high-performance environment and are eager to contribute to our innovative company culture, underpinned by a consistent pursuit of excellence, integrity, and teamwork.

Our global team comes together biannually for international retreats and summits. These are typically held for a week at a new location each time, providing opportunities to share ideas, collaborate in person, and strengthen our culture, all while learning firsthand about the destinations we serve. These events embody our commitment to both professional growth and the transformative power of travel.

Join us in shaping the future of luxury travel while working towards our vision—creating a more connected humanity through travel. To learn more, visit https://www.zicasso.com/careers.

The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Product Designer to join our dynamic team and lead the design efforts for our innovative applications. As a Product Designer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the user experience and driving product strategy. This role will report into the Senior Product Manager and work closely with the engineering team, and stakeholders to deliver exceptional user-centered solutions.

This is an international, fully-remote, freelance contractor position, working from home, at a location outside of the United States. We are particularly seeking candidates who are based in Latin America.

There is flexibility in your work hours but we expect that you will generally maximize your overlap with California hours (eg. until 3pm Pacific Time Zone).

The work will all be conducted in English.

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in product strategy discussions, contributing to the overall vision and roadmap

• Collaborate with the Product and Engineering managers in leading a Product Squad, collaborating closely with stakeholders to define and implement innovative solutions for our new B2C and B2B web applications and internal platform

• Contribute to the implementation of Product Design best practices when necessary to set a new standard and increase Zicasso's product culture maturity.

• Conduct user research to gather insights, identify user needs, and inform design decisions

• Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to effectively communicate design ideas and concepts

• Create detailed handoff documentation that includes design files, component specifications (typography, spacing, colors), and interaction behaviors

• Iterate and refine designs based on feedback, user testing, and data-driven decision-making

• Ensure a consistent and cohesive visual language, driven by our core Brand ID and customer-first orientation, across all applications, adhering to established design systems and guidelines

• Advocate for a user-centered design approach and promote design best practices within the team.

Required Experience

• 4+ years of experience in product design, with a proven track record of leading design initiatives

• Extensive experience in the travel industry, and/or luxury products and services, is highly preferred.

• Experience in web design and diverse user research techniques will be appreciated

• A strong passion for travel and creating exceptional user experiences

• Proven proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or similar

• Demonstrated expertise in UI design, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders

• Proven ability to work effectively in a remote environment

• Deep understanding of agile development methodologies

• Strong understanding and experience with product strategy, metrics and OKRs

• Experience leading design reviews and mentoring other designers

• Experience in fast paced growing environments, either in start ups or nimble structures

• Experience defining and implementing design best practices

What We Offer

• Remote work from your home base and flexible hours that allow you to enjoy a great work-life balance

• Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions

• Learning and development annual budget

• Two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!

At Compass International Holdings, we are on a mission to help everyone find their place in the world. So if you dream big, obsess about opportunity, and love to learn from reality—the Product Design team at Compass International Holdings is the place for you.
We are currently undertaking the largest technology deployment in residential real estate history with the rollout of our AI-powered Home Platform—the only end-to-end platform of its kind designed specifically for real estate professionals. This platform unifies the brokerage experience across our portfolio of leading real estate brands, integrating core tools and workflows into a single, seamless ecosystem.

Who we're looking for: A Senior AI Product Designer to lead the design of our platform’s AI capabilities. In this role, you will report to a senior member of the Product Design team and be embedded as a core member of the Home Platform AI team.
You will be at the forefront of our AI strategy, responsible for designing a proactive, multimodal, voice-activated assistant that empowers agents to run their businesses hands-free. You’ll tackle complex, high-impact, agent-facing workflows—drafting emails, creating marketing collateral, updating CRM contacts, managing transaction timelines, and more—all through natural conversation on the Home Platform. You will also extend this assistant to strengthen Compass International Holdings’s operational backbone, from automating “time-to-activate” for new agents to equipping Support Engineers with AI-driven resolution tools.
As a Senior-level Design leader on the AI team, you will move beyond execution to defining the vision for conversational interfaces at Compass International Holdings. You will partner with a multi-disciplinary team of Engineers and Product Managers to build a "true business partner" for our agents—one that automates complex tasks and surfaces real-time insights—while simultaneously streamlining internal operations to make our support staff and support engineering more efficient.

Responsibilities

• Multimodal Experience Design : Design and develop AI-based conversational and multimodal experiences for the Compass International Holdings AI Assistant. You will advocate for usability and user-centered design principles to craft seamless Agent-Facing Voice Workflows (e.g., hands-free transaction management) and Internal Support Tooling (e.g., automated issue resolution).

• Conversation Design Standards : Develop and promote conversation design best practice standards, reusable interactional patterns, and processes. You will define the "System Thinking" that allows us to scale consistent, high-quality AI interactions across Web, iOS, and Android.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and stakeholders to understand priorities and collaborate on solutions.

• Strategic Balance: Balance user needs, technical constraints (e.g., LLM capabilities), and Product objectives to solve problems effectively. You will craft best-in-class multimodal user experiences that are desirable, technically feasible, and viable for the business.

• Industry Leadership : Identify, track, and monitor industry trends and drivers of customer needs to ensure Compass International Holdings remains at the forefront of the generative AI revolution in real estate, and drive initiatives to level up the AI Design skills across the Product Design team.

What you bring

• BA/BS in HCI, Interaction Design, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of UX design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing Voice UI, Conversational Design, and AI-driven products, including multimodal prototypes (voice, sound, visuals, touch, chat)

• Solid understanding of ML/NLP fundamentals and experience designing for Generative or Agentive AI (including prompt engineering)

• Strong cross-functional influence—driving ideation, validation, decision-making, and execution while communicating clearly with leadership and partner teams

• Proven ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive, user-centric experiences across native and web

• Experience designing internal workflows, support platforms, or back-office automation tools

• Skilled in UXR, interpreting behavioral, qualitative, and quantitative data to inform design decisions and operate effectively in ambiguity

• Mastery of Figma and AI-powered design tools and execution of design standards across responsive web and native apps

postings.title: AI Image Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Own AI image generation for a $1Billion+ brand. Produce hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard consistently, at production volume.

Total Annual Package: Up to USD $88,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

Location : Remote (Global)

Growth path from here is Senior AI Image Specialist → AI Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.

We've been AI-first since December 2023 : GPT Image and Nano Banana Pro are part of the working creative stack, and AI-generated imagery is used in live production work rather than kept to internal tests. You'd be building on a foundation, not evangelising one.

This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).

Role Overview
Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Image Specialist to own AI image generation for Puffy.com, covering photorealistic hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery across ecommerce and marketing, owning the prompting approaches, reference workflows and production standards behind it, and applying UI/UX design to the layouts that imagery lands in, reporting directly to the UX/UI Design Lead.

This role exists to make AI generation dependable enough to be the production route, building the prompting approaches, reference libraries and quality standards that produce brand-standard imagery at volume, to a predictable result.

The Problems You'll Own:

• Primary : Consistency at brand standard: Producing one strong AI image is straightforward; producing them consistently is not. You'll be responsible for hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard every time, with an actual Puffy mattress rendered accurately inside a fully generated environment. Every image is judged on whether it delivers the brief's objective, not on how it looks alone. The work is making AI dependable enough to be the production route.

• Secondary : Raise what the whole team can produce: The second outcome of this role is what the wider Design team can do. You'll develop the best practices, prompting techniques, reusable reference workflows and quality standards that let existing designers produce to a comparable standard, raising the whole team's output alongside your own.

The Career Accelerator
This is not a role where you run prompts written by someone else and hand the output on. The scope is scarce: very few AI image specialists own the prompting approaches, the reference workflows, the production standards, and the adoption of all three across the design team at once, with a direct line to the UX/UI Design Lead and no layers in between.

Your first 12 months: build the AI-assisted workflows behind Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery, with photorealism and product accuracy as the bar. Develop reusable prompting approaches, reference-image workflows, and the production standards that keep output consistent at brand standard. Create and test AI advertising creative with the Growth team, and take outputs through compositing and retouching to final creative. Apply UI/UX design to ecommerce page layouts and image placement with Design and CRO, strengthening visual hierarchy and mobile usability. Evaluate new image-generation tools and models, and adopt what earns it. Shape the future of creative production at Puffy, where imagery carries the product on every commercial surface.

What Is In It For You
This isn't just another AI design role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

Own the Production Standard, Not Only the Output
You set the prompting approaches, build the reference workflows, and decide when an image is ready to ship.

• You determine how Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery is produced: the prompting techniques, the reference-image workflows, the compositional control, and the retouching route to final creative.

• You hold the standard an image is measured against, on the objective in the brief, on brand consistency, and on how it performs in the live layout. You report to the UX/UI Design Lead, who sets creative direction and holds that bar with you.

Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:
🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales
🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

Embrace Radical Flexibility
Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office or a co-working space. Your output is your credential, not your location.

Become the Specialist Whose AI Work Reaches Production
In most companies, AI imagery stays a proof of concept: shown internally, rarely trusted on a live site. Here, your output publishes to a $1Billion+ ecommerce site and into paid creative carrying real budget. When a page needs a hero image or a campaign needs creative, your work is what ships. You'll build the systematic control to reproduce a winning output on demand, and the commercial judgment to make an image serve its objective. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a stock library and a retouching backlog in front of you.

What You'll Need
Exceptional portfolio demonstrating commercial AI-generated imagery, particularly photorealistic product and lifestyle work, alongside UI/UX design examples showing effective page layouts and user experiences.

AI generation and editing

• Advanced hands-on proficiency with ChatGPT Images / GPT Image models for image generation, editing, iteration and creative development.

• Advanced hands-on proficiency with Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) for professional image generation and editing.

• Strong proficiency across the wider generative-image landscape: Midjourney, FLUX/Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Adobe Firefly or equivalent platforms.

• Advanced prompt engineering and visual prompting, including reference images and multimodal inputs, together with strong image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, compositional-control and iterative-editing workflows.

Craft and production

• Places an existing physical product into generated environments without losing product fidelity.

• Works systematically enough to reproduce a winning output on demand, rather than regenerating until something lands.

• Advanced Photoshop, compositing and retouching capability to take AI outputs through to production-ready final creative.

• Fundamentals: composition, lighting, perspective, color, visual hierarchy, art direction.

UI/UX design

• Hands-on UI/UX design experience, with judgement for how an image performs inside a live interface rather than as a standalone render.

• Working knowledge of how imagery behaves in layout: crop and focal point across breakpoints, legibility of type and calls to action placed over it, and how an asset holds at thumbnail and ad-placement sizes.

• Comfortable working inside an established design system and brand guidelines, and delivering finished assets in the formats the Design team and developers build from.

• Commercial output

• Delivers hero, lifestyle, ecommerce and paid creative to a brief with a stated marketing objective, not just attractive images.

• Reads a creative brief commercially and makes the calls that serve the objective.

Good-to-Have

• DTC / ecommerce experience — especially creating product and performance-marketing imagery for consumer brands.

• Photography, CGI or 3D experience — strong understanding of lighting, composition, materials and photorealistic product visualization.

• Experience building and sharing AI creative workflows — including reusable prompts, reference libraries, templates or training that helps other designers adopt AI more effectively.

The Puffy DNA:
We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

• Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.

• Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.

• Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.

• Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.

• Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits

💰 Compensation:

• Total Annual Package: Up to USD $88,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

• Annual salary review every January

🏥 Health & Protection:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)

🌴 Time Off:

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays

💼 Work Environment:

• AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack

• Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office

• Learning & development opportunities

• International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

🏆 Rewards & Recognition:

• Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats

• Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

Ready to Shape Your Story?
Click "Apply" and take the first step.

About us We're a small, fast-growing premium home goods brand selling mainly on Amazon. With a lean team, we've scaled multiple product lines to multi-seven-figure success. Our customers are women 25–55 who want elevated design, and our look is refined, editorial and premium. We have an established brand book and visual language, and every image we publish is held to that standard.

The role We're looking for an exceptional brand designer with refined aesthetic judgment who can rapidly produce a high volume of polished, accurate and diverse creative within our established premium visual language.

This is an execution role inside an established brand. Our Creative Director sets new creative directions; you explore them and turn them into finished work. Day to day, you'll:

• Produce Amazon main images, listing images and A+ content for new product launches (our top priority)

• Build video ads using AI video tools (Higgsfield or equivalent) and edit in post editing software for final release

• Create product page, packaging and social assets as needed

• Turn product reference photos into believable, beautiful AI scenes that match the product exactly: proportions, materials, colours and logos

• Explore several genuinely different options within the brand for every brief

• Keep your work structured and the team in sync consistently. This includes being comfortable logging time, keeping tasks and projects accurate and updated, and posting clear updates each day: what changed, what's next and what's blocking you.

Requirements
• You use AI image and video generation every day and enjoy it. This is an AI-first role.

• A portfolio of premium, editorial work, including work you produced within brand guidelines

• A sharp eye for detail and product accuracy

• You work well from direction, take frequent feedback and turn it around quickly

• Self-managed and organised: you track your time, keep your files tidy and layered in Figma, and communicate clearly in writing

• Comfortable in Figma

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Photoshop for retouching and compositing (fixing AI output so it matches the real product), and video editing in Premiere or similar

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, working multiple pipelines in parallel

Nice to have
• Amazon or DTC brand experience

What it's like to work with us We're a small, fast-moving e-commerce company. Our processes are still evolving, deadlines are commercial, and feedback is direct and frequent. You'll work async with our Creative Ops Manager, and our Creative Director reviews work twice a week as well as directly with our CEO ad hoc, especially during the first few months as you get familiar with the brand. If you want full creative freedom to reinvent a brand, this isn't the right fit. If you love making a premium brand look its best, at volume and with precision, you'll do well here.

Process Screening and portfolio review, then a timed design exercise based on one of our real product launches (the same materials and time window for every candidate), then a call with the founder, followed by a decision.

🎨 Diseñador/a Gráfico/a | Perfil Creativo & Estratégico

En DepiLife 🍏 somos una empresa de estética con presencia en Argentina, Uruguay, Perú y Paraguay. Buscamos un/a diseñador/a gráfico/a que se sume al equipo de marketing para crear piezas estáticas, animaciones y videos. Queremos sumar al equipo a una persona creativa, detallista y con pensamiento estratégico, que quiera dejar huella en nuestra comunicación visual.

✏️ ¿Qué vas a hacer?

• Diseñar piezas para redes sociales (posts, stories, reels), email marketing, web y campañas pagas.

• Animar piezas estáticas: pasar un post o una story a una versión con movimiento para redes y anuncios.

• Editar videos cortos para reels, stories y anuncios: cortes, ritmo, textos animados, subtítulos y música.

• Adaptar campañas a los distintos países, cuidando las diferencias de cada uno: servicios, precios, datos de contacto y tono.

• Proponer ideas creativas y nuevas formas visuales de comunicar la marca.

• Usar herramientas de IA para generar, editar y acelerar la producción de imágenes y videos.

🧩 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Ojo estético y nivel de detalle alto. Cada pieza tiene que verse impecable.

• Orden. Manejás varias versiones de una misma pieza (por país, formato o canal) sin mezclar información. Nombrás archivos y organizás carpetas con criterio.

• Creatividad. No te quedás en la plantilla: proponés.

• Dominio de tipografía integrada a la imagen: texto detrás de la persona o el objeto, texto que sigue formas, máscaras y composiciones en capas.

• Motion y video: manejo de After Effects, Premiere o CapCut (o similares) para animar piezas y editar contenido vertical para redes.

• Manejo de IA aplicada al diseño y al video: generación de imágenes (Midjourney, Firefly, etc.), edición con IA en Photoshop (relleno generativo, expansión, remoción de fondos) y herramientas de video con IA (Runway, Kling, Veo, subtítulos automáticos, etc.).

• Manejo de Photoshop e Illustrator, y Figma o Canva como complemento.

• Valorable: experiencia en marcas de estética, cuidado personal, salud o moda.

🚀 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

• Excelente clima laboral y equipo multidisciplinario.

• Cobertura médica prepaga.

• Modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Nuñez, CABA. Horario de 9 a 18 hs.

• Espacio para proponer, crear e impulsar tu crecimiento profesional.

🔗 Para postularte, completá el siguiente forms: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1a_a_GNgi7tsv6nRtirjB1scTAV0sDPjLe-gya-euNNY/edit
