postings.title: Marketing Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

We are looking for a freelance Marketing Designer to join our design team and collaborate with our Visual Designer and Design Lead to help refine Qdrant’s visual identity across various marketing channels.

We want someone whose daily workflow is built around creative AI tools, who uses them to explore faster, produce more, and push ideas further than a traditional process allows, while maintaining a strong focus on the fundamentals: typography, spacing, and color. Art direction for AI-generated imagery is a key component of this position.

You'll help build and refine the internal AI tools and workflows that power our visual direction, then apply that direction across marketing assets, landing pages, ad creatives, email visuals, and event materials to keep the brand cohesive and polished.

What you will own

• AI tools & workflows: Help build and refine the internal AI tools and workflows we use to scale our visual direction across the team.

• Marketing assets: Design compelling visuals for campaigns, social media, blog posts, and presentations.

• Website & landing pages: Design and update website pages, including marketing and campaign-specific landing pages.

• Ad creatives: Design banner ads, LinkedIn creatives, and other performance marketing assets.

• Email design: Develop eye-catching graphics and layouts for email campaigns.

• Event & conference materials: Create slide decks, booth designs, and printed assets.

• Brand consistency: Keep every marketing visual aligned with Qdrant's visual direction and guidelines.

Who you are

• You have minimum 4 to maximum 8 years of experience designing marketing assets, websites, or both, ideally in a B2B or tech company.

• AI is central to how you work. You use tools like Midjourney, Flora AI, Higgsfield, and Claude every day and can show us how they shaped real projects in your portfolio..

• Experienced in designing websites or marketing assets, with a solid understanding of design principles and user interaction.

• Proficient in Figma, with practical experience using an established design system.

• You work fast without cutting corners. You're comfortable running several projects in parallel, switching between them easily, and you consistently ship polished work on tight timelines.

This role is probably not for you if you need someone else to:

• Hand you a fully detailed brief before you can start exploring.

• Tell you which AI tools to try or how to get better results from them.

• Keep you up to date on new creative tools and techniques.

Why join us

• A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

• A competitive salary with additional perks.

• Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

• High ownership and real impact.

• Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

• Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.

Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!

For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

postings.title: Staff Brand Designer - Consumer
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design. We turn growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, and we hold the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Staff Brand Designer, you come to the table with a strong design vision and set the visual standard for Kraken. You design static and 3D work for launches, campaigns and always-on activity, and you make sure it looks like one brand wherever someone meets it. You can take a brief or proactive idea to a finished, approved asset set, and you're equally comfortable building a clean, systemized layout in Figma and modeling and rendering a hero 3D asset in Cinema 4D.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and ownership: you set the bar for brand and 3D quality on the team, you build systems others can work from, and you're the person colleagues come to with design questions.

What You'll Do

• Design static 2D and 3D creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

• Concept, model, light, texture and render 3D assets in Cinema 4D, from hero visuals to reusable asset libraries and templates.

• Apply and extend the Kraken Consumer brand across surfaces, from organic social, lifecycle and web to illustration and foundational projects like key visual updates, keeping everything cohesive and recognizable without making it repetitive.

• Design initiative-specific work, including a distinct look and partner-branded assets for launches such as IPOs, and purpose-built illustration for go-to-market and product moments.

• Build scalable systems: Figma component libraries, marketing templates and modular campaign kits with localization-ready layouts, so other designers, other teams and our automated workflows can produce on-brand work quickly.

• Use AI-assisted production as a core part of how the brand gets made, and know when it speeds the work up and when it doesn't.

• Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Push back with a point of view when a brief is unclear or the idea can be stronger.

• Version and localize work across markets, languages and formats, with layouts that hold up under translation and market-specific requirements.

• Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

• Collaborate closely with our motion, web, performance and AI video designers so 3D and static work travels well across formats.

• Hold a high craft bar on your own work and give clear, constructive feedback on others'.

What You'll Bring

• 7+ years of brand, static and 3D design experience at a high-volume in-house team or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto or another regulated category (a competitor or similar company is a big plus).

• A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Include the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. We'd like to see brand and static work, at least one 3D piece with a short note on your process, an example of work you adapted for multiple formats or markets, and an example of a system or template set that other people built from.

• Command of Cinema 4D and the surrounding 3D workflow (modeling, lighting, materials, rendering), with shipped work to show for it.

• Expert-level Figma: components, auto layout, variables, and files that are easy to hand off and build on.

• Strong layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at small sizes and in multiple languages.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted production tools, and good judgment about where they belong in a workflow.

• Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, including layouts that accommodate risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements without compromising the design.

• Working fluency in Adobe CC (Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for light motion).

• Speed without sloppiness. You're comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

• A solid instinct for plain language and clear communication: value first, no hype, no jargon.

• Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Stay connected

Follow us on Twitter

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

postings.title: Visual Designer
postings.descriptionText:
What is the purpose of this role?

We're looking for a Visual Designer to bring DOOR's brand to life across marketing, sales, and product touch points. You'll own a wide range of creative projects, from marketing campaigns and trade show materials to product packaging and our website, while building tools and templates that empower teams across the company to create consistent, on-brand materials.

What is the role?

The Visual Designer is responsible for creating and maintaining engaging, on-brand visual content across digital, print, and physical channels. This role partners closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to develop creative assets, support company initiatives, and ensure brand consistency. The position also focuses on improving design efficiency through scalable templates, self-service tools, and creative solutions.

Reporting Structure: Reports to the Director of Product Design

Who is DOOR?

DOOR (formerly Latch) is unlocking the next era of Building Intelligence. We combine premium hardware, intuitive software, and automated operations into one seamless platform—helping multifamily properties run more efficiently, grow revenue, and deliver smarter, more connected living experiences. From smart access and in-unit automation to building-wide controls, DOOR empowers owners, operators, and property teams to reduce overhead, protect asset value, and stand out in a competitive market.

We believe smarter buildings make life simpler. At DOOR, you’ll help shape a future where buildings anticipate needs, operate effortlessly, and quietly improve life for everyone inside.

What will you do?

• Design marketing emails, campaigns, and landing pages

• Create trade show booths, signage, and event collateral

• Design packaging and instructional materials for hardware products

• Produce sales materials: decks, one-pagers, case studies

• Support the product design team with illustrations, graphics, and Lottie motion assets

• Design, build, and maintain the corporate site and landing pages in Webflow

• Build and maintain self-service creative tools (deck builders, social asset generators, templates) so teams can create on-brand assets on their own

• Help evolve and enforce brand guidelines across all output

What do you bring to DOOR?

• 3+ years in visual, brand, or marketing design (in-house or agency)

• A portfolio showing range across digital, print, and physical

• Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

• Creativity and fluency in building with AI

• Motion design skills, ideally After Effects to Lottie

• Experience designing print production files (packaging, large format)

• Comfortable juggling multiple deadlines and stakeholders

• Systems thinking: you build templates and tools, not just one-off assets

DOOR understands that job requirements sometimes exclude people who identify with historically marginalized groups from applying to jobs for which they are qualified. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements listed, or if you achieved these requirements through unconventional channels, we encourage you to apply.

What is required?

• Location: Fully remote, home-based position in SA.

• Working Hours: Must align with the U.S. Eastern/Central business hours.

• English Proficiency: Fluent written and spoken English required.

• Contractor Responsibilities: Candidates will be responsible for managing their own taxes in their country of residence

• Employment Arrangement: Independent contractor (1099) arrangement.

Joining Us Means

• Having teammates all over the world in the US, Argentina, Spain and Romania.

• Collaborating in a fast-paced environment where you can apply what you have learned in new challenges, and, more importantly, grow your career.

• Being encouraged to invent and innovate within your role and working in a company where calculated risk-taking is highly encouraged and thinking outside the box is a must.

Attention Job Seekers: Beware of job scams!

Job Scams Are On The Rise, And You Should Take Steps To Protect Yourself In Your Job Search. Here Are Some Guidelines To Help You Stay Safe If You Are Applying For a Job With Latch Or DOOR

• Communications from Latch or DOOR will always come from @latch.com or @door.com. Do not accept a job interview invitation with Latch or DOOR from anyone who does not contact you through an email that comes from @latch.com or @door.com.

• Latch never interviews candidates via Skype or in writing where you do not see the interviewer. All of our interviews happen either by video or in person.

• We will never offer you a job based on a single conversation with someone claiming to be from our People organization. In all of our job interviews, you will always speak, by video or in person, with the hiring manager for the position.

• Do not share your sensitive personal information with anyone who purports to offer you a job at Latch or DOOR unless you verified that the offer is from Latch or DOOR (check email senders addresses). We will never ask you for your bank account information or your mother’s maiden name during the interview process.

• We will never ask you to purchase any equipment with a promise that we will reimburse you after you begin working for us.

• If you believe you were a victim of a job scam, you may report it to the FBI: https://www.ic3.gov/.

Your role and impact

Family Support

Learning & Development

Ready to make the difference?
If you are ready to develop your creative career and contribute your ideas to a truly global team, we would love to meet you.

Apply now by submitting your CV in English in PDF format and including a link to your portfolio.

postings.title: Senior Multimedia Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Senior Multimedia Designer - DotYeti

Important Note: This position operates within the Argentina time zone (11 AM - 7 PM ART). Flexibility with working hours is essential.

At DotYeti, we believe great design should feel as good to make as it does to look at. We're a fully remote creative team helping businesses bring their ideas to life. Everything we make starts with two things: artistry in every detail and excellence in every delivery. The rest comes naturally: joy in the work, growth for everyone, and a team that has each other's backs.

What you'll do:

• Creative Craft: Develop product illustrations, social media graphics, logos, print designs, animations, and videos made with real artistry and the kind of detail people notice.

• Quality & Delivery: Deliver polished, high-quality, and on-brand multimedia content on time across digital and print platforms. You hold your work to a high bar before anyone else has to.

• Collaboration: Work closely with the design team to turn briefs into impactful digital assets, share feedback openly, and keep projects moving (and fun).

• Problem Solving: Optimize designs and troubleshoot technical visual challenges across Adobe tools, finding fixes that last, not just quick patches.

• Learning & Tools: Explore new tools, AI workflows, and techniques that help the team create better work.

Our ideal candidate:

• Has 5+ years of proven senior-level design experience

• Possesses a strong portfolio demonstrating successful branding and graphic design work.

• Has a great eye and cares how things look, feel, and work, not just whether they're finished.

• Takes pride in the details and doesn't call it done until it's right.

• Is naturally curious, always tinkering with a new tool, trick, or technique.

• Communicates clearly, offers help, asks for it, and celebrates wins with the team.

Bonus Points for:

• Previous startup and/or design agency experience in a lead or senior role.

• Experience handling design requests for MSMEs, large corporations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.

What We Offer:

• Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment in an independent contractor setup.

• Paid Time Off & Benefits: Generous paid time off and mental health leave.

• Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary with yearly performance-based raises.

• Equipment Allowance: Allowance provided to equip your home office.

• Professional Growth: Opportunity to grow with a talented and collaborative team.

How we hire:

postings.title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor (Part-Time)
postings.descriptionText:
Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft — and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands — emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative — and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow — to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own

Email & Retention Design

• Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue

• Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action

• Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

Web Creative & CRO Support

• Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores

• Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses — not just personal taste

• Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

Social & Ad Creative

• Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels

• Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing

• Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

Process & Quality

• Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear

• Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)

• Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients

• Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines

• Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks — while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines

Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

• An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color — your portfolio speaks for itself

• Conversion-minded — you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good

• Detail-obsessed — you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does

• A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased

• Excellent at managing your time — you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball

• AI-curious and AI-capable — you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter

• Adaptable — you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

• You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts

• You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds

• You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files

• You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production

• Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Requirements

Must-Have:

• 2-4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)

• A portfolio showing e-commerce work — ideally with context on goals and results

• Advanced proficiency in Figma

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

• Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow

• Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)

• Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices

• Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands

• Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team

Strong Differentiators:

• Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)

• Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms

• Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built

• Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data

• Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)

• Agency background preferred

Benefits

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

• Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow

• Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST

Compensation

$20-25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

postings.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
postings.descriptionText:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.

The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.

General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

• Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on

• Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly

• Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client

• Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one

• Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities

• Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets

• Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

• Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign

• Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute

• Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline

• Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work

• Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

• Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones

• Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no

• Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills

• Onboarding new designers into how we work

• Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation

• Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

• Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it

• Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from

• Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works

• Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything

• Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team

• Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director

Position Specs:

• Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours

• An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently

• Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD

• Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement

• Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing

• A 30-day notice period after the first month

• Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.

Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.

Key Requirements:

• At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design

• Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries

• Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity

• Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits

• An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches

• Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work

• The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable

• The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice

• A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus

• Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus

• Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use

• Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day

• Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones

• Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time

• Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month

• A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

postings.title: Freelance Developer
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

The Role

We are looking for a Freelance Developer to join our team and help deliver high-quality, scalable digital advertising experiences. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize dynamic creative campaigns across multiple ad serving and DCO platforms. You will work closely with Account, Project Management, Creative, and Media teams to transform campaign strategies into technical solutions, ensuring flawless execution, quality assurance, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Campaign Execution

• Develop and maintain responsive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript banners, animations (e.g., CSS and GSAP), and modular templates for Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO).

• Implement dynamic variables, business rules, and data feeds (CSV, JSON, XML, Google Sheets) to enable personalized campaigns at scale.

• Prepare publication packages, including naming conventions, packaging, tags, clickTags, and polite loading implementation.

• Upload and traffic creative assets and dynamic campaigns across DCO and ad serving platforms according to client technology stacks.

Collaboration & Operations

• Partner with Account, Project Management, and Client teams, as well as media agencies, to translate addressable marketing strategies into clear technical requirements.

• Support the definition of technical ways of working for new client accounts, including staging environments, repositories, and approval workflows.

• Estimate development effort and timelines while proactively identifying technical risks and limitations.

Quality Assurance & Launch

• Perform functional and visual QA across multiple creative variations, browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

• Validate tracking integrations (click, impression, and interaction tracking), brand safety requirements, and platform compliance.

• Provide QA documentation, including variation checklists, screenshots, and screen recordings when required.

Documentation & Technical Support

• Create and maintain technical documentation, template functionality guides, and internal implementation documentation.

• Provide technical support to Project Management and Creative teams during automation RFPs, including feasibility assessments, technical inputs, and scope definition.

• Assist with the onboarding of new platforms and tools by supporting initial setup and proof-of-concept implementations.

Continuous Improvement

• Promote and implement best practices for performance optimization, accessibility, naming conventions, and version control.

• Contribute to the evaluation of new third-party advertising solutions across display, social, and video channels through proof-of-concept projects.

Qualifications

Required

• 3–5 years of experience developing HTML5 banners and dynamic creative solutions for paid media campaigns.

• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, with experience using CSS and GSAP for animations, as well as sprite and video assets.

• Hands-on experience with DCO and ad serving platforms such as Google Marketing Platform (Studio, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360), Flashtalking, Sizmek, Celtra, or similar technologies.

• Experience working with dynamic data feeds (CSV, JSON, XML), including field mapping, business rules, and data validation.

• Experience performing cross-browser and cross-device QA, optimizing creative performance (including lazy/polite loading), and troubleshooting tags and tracking implementations.

• Experience using version control systems (Git), project management tools (Jira, Asana, Trello), and design collaboration platforms (Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud).

• Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with the ability to read technical documentation and collaborate with global teams.

Preferred

• Experience with social DCO platforms (e.g., Meta Creative Hub, Smartly or similar).

• Familiarity with Connected TV (CTV), Online Video (OLV) specifications, and VAST/VPAID standards.

• Experience with template systems, build tools (NPM), templating engines, and code quality tools such as linters.

• Understanding of data layers, UTM tracking, measurement frameworks, and privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) as they relate to digital advertising creatives.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. postings.title: Member of Technical Staff, Design Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Design engineering is core to how we build at Profound. Our founder, Dylan Babbs, started his career as a design engineer, and we hold a high bar for craft, taste, and execution. As a Design Engineer, you will work between design and engineering by shipping high-quality, highly polished experiences across our product and, at times, our marketing surfaces.

What you’ll do

• Build and ship polished, production-quality UI across our core product or marketing site

• Partner with product designers, product managers, and engineers to translate intent into precise, high-fidelity implementations

• Craft UI details including layouts, typography, responsiveness, motion, and micro-interactions using Tailwind CSS

• Contribute occasionally to the marketing site and logged-out experiences while maintaining the same bar for quality and performance

• Contribute to shared UI foundations including components, patterns, and design tokens

• Work across the stack using React, Next.js, and TypeScript to deliver fast, reliable interfaces

• Optimize for performance, accessibility, and maintainability without compromising on design

• Raise the bar for frontend craft through code reviews, critiques, and shared standards

Who you are

• Strong experience with React, Next.js, Tailwind, and TypeScript in production environments

• Exceptional CSS skills with a proven ability to build pixel-perfect, resilient user interfaces

• Strong eye for design and interaction with taste you can both defend and implement

• Comfortable owning work end to end from early exploration through shipped code

• Experience working closely with designers and engineers in fast-moving product teams

• Portfolio that demonstrates high-craft frontend or design engineering work

• Thrive in a startup environment that values speed, iteration, and quality

• Enjoy experimenting and working on side projects to stay current with leading edge technologies

• Strong product thinking and builder mindset, comfortable working across design, product, and engineering to ship work

• Can just do things

Note from our co-founder

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

Location

It measures what works and gets better every day.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to define and shape how Profound looks and feels across every channel, from campaigns and events to the visual systems that scale our brand as we grow.

This is a hands-on design role. The Brand Designer works closely with the Creative Director and Brand lead to shape the visual language of the brand, build the systems that make it scalable, and push it into new territory as Profound expands.

You'll sit on the marketing team and collaborate closely with content, demand gen, product, and leadership. You'll be the person in the room with a strong opinion on what the brand should look like, with the craft to back it up.

What You'll Do

Define and evolve the visual brand. You will shape the look and feel of Profound across all brand touchpoints: campaigns, website, events, social, and beyond. You'll build the systems to get it there consistently.

Build flexible, scalable design systems. You'll create and maintain a brand design system that gives the broader team, including our Visual Designer, the building blocks to execute on-brand work at speed. Systems that hold up under pressure and leave room to push.

Design campaign creative. You'll work on visual direction for marketing campaigns from concept through execution, ensuring every asset, digital and physical, tells a coherent, compelling story about what Profound is and why it matters.

Shape brand experiences. From in-person conferences and events to OOH activations, you'll extend the brand into physical and experiential formats. You'll think about how the brand feels, not just how it looks.

Push the creative bar. You'll participate in design reviews alongside the Brand lead and Creative director, and be a visible standard-setter for craft across the marketing team. You'll make the work around you better.

Experiment and challenge. Profound's visual identity has room to grow. We want a designer who can bring their ideas to life and execute on them, and who is curious about where the brand could go next.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in brand design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual identity work, not just execution

• Experience designing for SaaS, martech, or data/AI products

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
ASSEMBLY INDUSTRIES

Job Title - Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Also known as: Client Services Engineer

• Solutions Engineer

• Implementation Engineer

About Assembly

Assembly Industries is The Workforce Modernization Company. For fifty years, software — the single greatest lever for business efficiency and productivity — has been gated behind two doors: buy it from a vendor, or hire an engineering team to build it. Coding agents have fundamentally changed that. Our mission is to make every employee a builder: we convert often non-technical subject-matter experts into prolific builders of software through training, a platform to execute on, and a partner standing beside them every day after launch.

Assembly Platform is our end-to-end application lifecycle platform — from problem discovery and requirements through architecture, production deployment with IT, adoption, and ongoing maintenance. The prototype is just the tip of the iceberg; Assembly Platform and our team handle everything below the waterline. Our vision is to help existing businesses build their own software operating system from the inside out.

Role Overview

We are onboarding our first 50 Assembly Platform customers, and every one of them will build their first production-grade application with us. You are the partner standing beside them. You will be the hands-on engineer and client-facing lead who takes each customer from onboarding to a live, production application — running calls, building alongside them, debugging their vibe-coded projects, and owning the path to launch. You will use Assembly Platform alongside our customers, helping them turn business requirements into production applications and leaving them able to continue building after launch.

This is a rare hybrid role: half forward-deployed engineer, half client services. You will be one of the earliest hires shaping how Assembly delivers on its promise to the Founding customer cohort.

What You'll Do

Client Services & Delivery

• Own the customer relationship day-to-day: lead onboarding calls and training sessions with professionalism and high-proficiency English.

• Run the follow-through: send meeting follow-ups, share project plans, and deliver regular status updates so customers always know where their build stands.

• Keep momentum: follow up with customers after onboarding sessions and schedule their next onboarding and training sessions.

• Translate customer problems into clear application requirements, implementation plans, and launch criteria.

• Lead product discovery with customers: uncover the real problem behind the request, challenge weak assumptions, prioritize the highest-value workflows, and define what should — and should not — be built.

Building & Support

• Build production-grade applications: assist each of our first 50 customers in taking their first application from prototype to production on Foundry.

• Support customers in Slack: respond quickly, dig into their code and vibe-coded projects, and figure out what's going on.

• QA and ship: test applications, build features on customers' behalf, and squash bugs standing between them and launch.

• Run the board: maintain a project board per customer and always know the open items remaining to get the first application to production.

• Turn business workflows into sound data models, permissions, integrations, and user experiences.

• Maintain engineering quality across application architecture, API boundaries, authentication, source control, testing, and deployment.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Vibe coding portfolio: you must be able to point to at least five fully vibe-coded, productionized applications you've built. We will ask to see them.

• AI-native builder: genuinely excited about AI-assisted software development. You use modern coding agents as part of your daily workflow and actively follow relevant frameworks, tools, and open-source projects.

• Engineering foundation: strong grounding in system design and software architecture. You can structure and productionize a full-stack application — not just prompt one into existence — and are comfortable with modern frontend development, APIs, authentication, data modeling, Git, testing, and cloud deployment.

• Exceptional product judgment: you can enter an unfamiliar business domain, understand how work actually gets done, identify the highest-leverage product opportunity, and turn ambiguity into a simple, coherent application. You know how to prioritize, control scope, challenge customer requests constructively, and make strong UX decisions without waiting for a complete specification.

• Client-facing experience: you've worked directly with customers before and communicate professionally, in speech and in writing, in high-proficiency English.

• Support instincts: experience handling customer issues — triaging, debugging unfamiliar codebases, QA-ing, and closing the loop.

• Experience: 3+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Availability: comfortable working US hours (PST).

Nice-to-Haves

• Previous consulting, professional-services, solutions-engineering, implementation, or forward-deployed experience.

• Experience with React and TypeScript or a comparable modern full-stack web stack.

• Experience integrating third-party systems and working with enterprise authentication, permissions, or workflows.

This is a remote based position for candidates based out of Argentina.

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

Please note: This is a temporary, 3-month contract position running from October through the end of December.

Join our creative team as a Senior Designer. We're seeking a passionate and detail-oriented technical designer with a strong foundation in both digital and print design. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with art directors and clients, serving as the quality assurance expert for all deliverables, from setting the art direction for a campaign to ensuring pixel-perfect assets across various formats.

A keen eye for detail, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to producing high-quality work are essential. You should be able to adapt your design style to create visually appealing work that resonates with diverse audiences. Additionally, you should be able to seamlessly transition between print and digital design, delivering high-quality files that meet both organizational and aesthetic standards.

In This Role You Will

• Collaborate with Creative and Design Directors to produce impactful visuals.

• Receive file and direction handoffs from Art Directors and finalize emails, direct mail packages, banners, individual image assets, and mock-ups according to agreed-upon specifications.

• Adhere to brand guidelines while also developing new styles and creative proposals.

• Work with business leaders to understand and translate vision and strategy into effective visuals.

• Adapt, retouch, and scale a variety of assets for both digital and print formats.

• Design presentations tailored to various audiences, from internal executives to large external events.

• Seamlessly transition between digital and print production.

• Collaborate with clients, executives, strategists, and creatives to refine rough sketches and concepts into polished, professional, launch-ready files.

• Demonstrate strong time management skills and efficiently manage multiple projects with the support of your lead and Project Managers.

Hard Skills

• Strong English communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Proven experience working with assets at scale, adapting them for multiple formats and localizations.

• A meticulous eye for detail and a passion for process improvement. Your files should be meticulously organized and pixel-perfect.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign.

• Desirable: After Effects knowledge.

• Proficiency in Figma.

• Advanced photo retouching skills.

• Fluency in Google Workspace, including Drive, Docs, Slides, and Sheets.

Soft Skills

• Proven ability to mentor and manage junior team members.

• Patience and passion for design.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Strong time management and organizational skills.

• Proactive and self-motivated approach.

• Ability to iterate on designs and work efficiently under tight deadlines.

• Humble and collaborative attitude.

Experience You Already Have

• A well-curated online portfolio showcasing exceptional presentation design skills, with additional media work to demonstrate versatility.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in digital and print production, ideally in an agency environment.

• Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Art Direction, or a related field.

postings.title: Senior Graphic Designer
postings.descriptionText:
Description

Imaginative, curious, and adaptable you sweat the small stuff, because you know that great design is in the details.

You are creative, inspired, and driven to produce innovative design. You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful imagery. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Sr Graphic Designer role with Boldsky.

This position provides critical day-to-day studio support for creative teams in the production of print and digital/interactive materials.

Responsibilities:

Senior Level Graphic Designer: Able to leads projects, involved from beginning to end, considered a subject matter expert. Seniors will take on more responsibilities that may include overseeing the work of the Junior and Mid-Level co-worker.

The position reports to the Discipline Lead for day-to-day project assignments but also collaborates with the Agency’s creative and creative services team members for implementation and direction.

• Responsible for building production-ready files for print and digital tactics, making edits to existing layouts with some opportunities for initial design.

• Prepare electronic mechanical print files according to vendor specifications and adhering to the brand style guides set by the clients.

• Work closely with Agency account, creative and creative services departments as part of an integrated team.

• Adhere to agency vision for quality and uphold the creative process while maintaining client style guidelines.

• Work with project managers on schedule and hours requirements.

• Maintain server structure and organization and oversee creative department personnel for file creation efficiencies and server organization.

• Perform other duties as assigned, such as on-boarding of file organization and studio process for new employees.

• Control tactical workflow within the brand, is the “go-to” person for agency creatives and is the keeper of brand assets and logos.

• Self-motivated: Able to deliver a quality product on time and on budget (allocated hours).

• Champion the studio and strive to improve processes.

• Traditional graphic art and studio support, such as, building mock-ups and presentation materials.

Requirements:

• Bachelors degree in Graphic Design or related field, creative studio and/or agency experience

• 5-10 years’ experience in Graphic Design

• In-depth knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat) as well as comprehensive knowledge of Macintosh computers

• Experience with Sketch and/or Figma a plus

• Experience with PPT, animation, digital and/or video applications a plus

• Candidate should:

• have good design skills and understand page layout: composition, hierarchy, color space, imagery, and typography

• have good organizational skills

• be a team player

• complete work efficiently within deadlines and budget

• have acute attention to detail

• be capable of handling multiple tasks and projects.

• Management experience a plus

• Experience with email and task management applications, including electronic routing a plus

• Experience working in Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems a plus

Should also:

• Understand and Implement Direction: Can understand creative direction based on objectives and execute creative work effectively. Understands the concept of talent-to-task and communicates well with others on workload issues & needs, progress of work and results

• Apply Knowledge to Industry: Pick up on technical things quickly; good at learning new industry, company, product, and/or technical developments of the client, as well as the agency business; possess the functional and technical knowledge and skills to do the job at a high level of accomplishment

• Demonstrate Ownership and Proactivity: Demonstrates ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas and solutions proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint.

• Willing to be Flexible: work outside of job description as needed, be flexible for the team, and ultimately the work.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $X to $Y. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health Communications, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

BoldSky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies’ creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

WorkHere Matters Everywhere| How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled) At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, flexible paid time off (PTO). Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable national/federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Newsweek is looking for a Magazine Designer/Art Editor with a passion for strong editorial layout, publication design, and visual storytelling—plus experience overseeing weekly production and collaborating across editorial channels. This role is central to the visual output of Newsweek’s flagship magazine and will play a key role in managing the production cycle from layout to press. 
Responsibilities:  

•  Design weekly long-form feature stories and editorial layouts for Newsweek’s print magazine, ensuring top-tier visual quality, and composition.

• Oversee the smooth flow of each issue through the production cycle, coordinating with editors, art director, and photo teams to meet tight weekly deadlines.

• Work closely with the editors and art director to ensure each issue is visually cohesive and on-brand across platforms.

• Prepare files for print production, ensuring all layouts meet technical and editorial standards.

• Support content adaptation across digital formats when needed.

• Adapt badge designs to be used in different formats.

• Create bespoke illustrations for brand website

Qualifications: 

• 4+ years of professional experience in magazine or editorial design, preferably in a fast-paced, weekly or daily newsroom.

• Exceptional layout skills and a deep understanding of publication structure, grid systems, and visual hierarchy.

• Advanced skills in Adobe InDesign, with excellent knowledge of creating tables for long lists, and expert use of paragraph and character stylesheets. Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. Knowledge of Figma, Canva and PowerPoint is a plus.

• Proven ability to juggle multiple pages, deadlines, and collaborators under pressure.

• Experience commissioning and directing editorial visuals is a plus.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong editorial design and layout is essential.

• Excellent written and spoken English; flexibility in working hours.

• Familiarity with AI design tools

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Motion Designer with a strong technical profile—someone who can not only craft high-quality animated content, but also develop scripts and automation solutions to optimize workflows within After Effects and other post-production environments. This role is critical to scaling team productivity and maintaining an agile, organized, and efficient pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and animate content for digital platforms, social media, campaigns, and branded content.

• Develop reusable templates, toolkits, and assets.

• Collaborate closely with editors, designers, creative teams, and producers.

• Create scripts, expressions, and tools to automate repetitive tasks in After Effects.

• Integrate workflows across platforms (e.g., Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere, custom panels, external systems).

• Optimize rendering processes, versioning, and project organization.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and improve team efficiency.

• Contribute ideas and collaborate with creative teams to enhance output.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in motion graphics.

• Advanced proficiency in After Effects (mandatory).

• Strong working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere.

• Experience with scripting and expressions in After Effects (ExtendScript, JavaScript, AE Expressions).

• Proven experience in workflow automation (custom scripts, plugins, or APIs).

• Background in template creation and task automation.

• Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of additional tools and technologies.

• Experience with 3D tools and workflows.

Soft Skills

• Strong technical problem-solving abilities.

• Curious, self-driven, and innovation-oriented mindset.

• High attention to detail and strong aesthetic judgment.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Proactive approach to improving processes and building internal tools.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

This role is part of our Global Studios team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.

This role is dedicated exclusively to Creative Automation—using technology to produce creative assets at scale. You will be designing and animating templates in Adobe After Effects that integrate with Lightspeed, our proprietary automation engine, to render the assets at scale.

You need to be naturally curious, technically-minded, and eager to experiment. We’re looking for candidates who never shy away from a challenge, are excited to find new and novel solutions to creative problems and who, most importantly, enjoy the more technical side of motion design and animation.

WHAT YOU BRING:

Shift: PST/MST

Job Type: Remote

Job Summary:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Static Image Editor with a strong track record in e-commerce to enhance, refine, and transform product visuals and promotional assets. Unlike a traditional Graphic Designer who creates concepts from scratch, your focus will be technical image refinement, high-end compositing, and producing conversion-focused sales and offer-based imagery. You will blend traditional post-processing techniques with modern AI generation tools to deliver high-volume, high-converting visual assets efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

• Image Retouching & Post-Production: Clean up raw photography, perform color correction, exposure adjustment, object removal, background isolation, and surface cleanup for e-commerce product catalogs.

• Sales & Offer Visual Creation: Produce promotional visuals (e.g., promotional badges, discount callouts, bundle overlays, banner variations) designed specifically to drive conversions and sales.

• AI-Assisted Workflow Execution: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly create background variations, generate lifestyle mockups around product photography, and upscale/extend image borders.

• Batch Processing & Sizing: Format, crop, and export optimized assets across diverse platform specifications (Shopify/Amazon catalogs, Meta ads, Google Display, marketplace listings).

• Asset & Quality Consistency: Maintain strict brand visual guidelines, color accuracy, lighting consistency, and shadow realism across large volumes of images.

Key Technical Stack & Tool Requirements

• Core Post-Processing & Manipulation Tools

• Adobe Photoshop (Advanced): Advanced masking, frequency separation, camera raw processing, pen tool isolation, non-destructive editing, smart objects, and action automation.

• Adobe Lightroom: Batch processing, unified color grading, and catalog organization.

• Canva / Figma (Desirable): Fast composition setup, simple layout handling, and vector icon overlays for quick offer graphics.

• Generative AI Tools (Sales & Background Generation)

• Midjourney / DALL-E / Stable Diffusion: Prompt engineering for background generation, lifestyle settings, and contextual surface integration.

• Photoshop Generative Fill / Generative Expand: Seamless object removal, background extension, and element replacement.

• E-commerce Specific AI Platforms: Tools such as CreatorKit, Pebblely, Photoroom, or Flair AI for quick lifestyle mockup generation around static product photos.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

• E-Commerce Background: 2+ years of experience working with e-commerce brands, DTC agencies, or online marketplaces (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, etc.).

• Technical Precision over Visual Strategy: Strong technical eye for lighting direction, shadows, edge reflections, and realistic perspective alignment when merging elements.

• Direct-Response & Commercial Awareness: Understanding of what visual elements pull attention in high-converting sales graphics (clear typography hierarchy, contrasting offer badges, clean focal points).

• Efficiency & Batch Speed: Ability to handle high-volume processing without compromising edge accuracy or color fidelity.

• Portfolio Requirement: Demonstrated portfolio showcasing "Before vs. After" raw photo edits, offer/sales imagery, and AI-assisted image compositions.
