postings.title: Conceptual Art Director - Marketing Campaigns
postings.descriptionText:
Wripple's financial services client is looking for a Conceptual Art Director – Marketing Campaigns in Buenos Aires, Argentina to join their team for a 40-hour/week, 12-month contract with the potential to convert to full-time for the right fit.

This is an opportunity to own the creative idea from brief through execution for a leading global financial brand.

We’re looking for a conceptual thinker and campaign builder — not just a strong designer. The ideal candidate knows how to take a business or marketing challenge, uncover the creative opportunity within it, and develop an original campaign idea that can come to life across channels.

Working closely with a Creative Director, copywriters, designers, and marketing partners, the Conceptual Art Director will develop strategic, audience-relevant creative ideas and translate them into compelling visual concepts and campaign systems across digital, social, web, video, print, and other brand experiences.

What You'll Do
You’ll own and contribute to the creative process from initial brief through final execution:

• Start with the brief. Understand the business and marketing challenge, audience insight, objectives, and strategic opportunity behind each assignment.

• Develop the big idea. Partner closely with copywriters and other creatives to generate original campaign concepts that solve the brief — not simply execute against an existing visual direction.

• Create the visual concept. Once the campaign idea is established, define how it comes to life visually through art direction, imagery, typography, composition, motion, and other elements of the brand experience.

• Build the campaign system. Develop a cohesive visual language that can flex across channels and formats while maintaining the integrity and impact of the core idea.

• Bring the idea to life. Direct and execute creative across touchpoints including digital, social, web, video, print, presentations, and other marketing experiences.

• Present creative concepts and articulate the strategic thinking behind them to Creative Directors, marketing partners, and key stakeholders.

• Collaborate with copywriters, designers, and cross-functional partners to ensure copy and visual storytelling work together as one cohesive idea.

• Rapidly synthesize feedback, evolve concepts, and maintain the strength of the creative idea through rounds of iteration.

• Push the boundaries of the brand thoughtfully while ensuring creative solutions remain relevant to the audience and aligned with business objectives.

• Understand the company, its audiences, and global financial markets in order to turn complex marketing challenges into clear, compelling creative.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high degree of craft and attention to detail.

• Leverage AI and emerging creative tools throughout the creative process to accelerate exploration, expand possibilities, and improve efficiency.

What We're Looking For
First and foremost, your portfolio should demonstrate conceptual campaign thinking. We want to see how you have taken briefs or marketing challenges and turned them into creative ideas — and how those ideas became integrated campaigns.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

• 2–4+ years of experience in an Art Director role at a creative agency, in-house creative team, or similar environment.

• A portfolio featuring concept-led, integrated marketing campaigns , not primarily standalone design or production work.

• Experience developing creative concepts from a business/marketing brief and audience insight , ideally in partnership with copywriters.

• The ability to explain the idea behind the work — the challenge, insight, concept, visual direction, and how the idea extended across channels.

• Strong visual conceptualization skills and the ability to establish a distinctive, cohesive art direction for a campaign.

• Experience building campaign systems that translate effectively across digital, social, web, video, print, experiential, and other channels .

• A passion for storytelling and an understanding of how imagery, typography, motion, copy, and design work together to communicate a powerful idea.

• Exceptional typography, visual hierarchy, composition, and overall design craft.

• Experience presenting and selling creative ideas to internal teams, clients, and senior stakeholders.

• Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop.

• Experience using AI tools as part of creative ideation, concept development, or execution.

• The ability to work independently while thriving in a highly collaborative creative environment.

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, including the ability to confidently present creative concepts and rationale in English.

• Financial services experience is a plus, but strong conceptual campaign experience is more important.

Education
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in art direction, design, advertising, visual communications, or a related discipline, with a strong foundation in conceptual thinking, visual storytelling, and design principles.

Portfolio Requirement
A portfolio is required for consideration.
We are specifically looking for work that demonstrates idea-driven art direction and integrated campaign development. Your portfolio should show examples where you helped originate the creative concept — ideally from a brief or strategic insight — and then developed the visual direction and carried that idea across multiple marketing touchpoints.

This role is best suited for an Art Director who wants to own the idea, not just execute the assets.

ABOUT WRIPPLE:
Wripple is the first Agency Services Platform that connects clients with independent talent to create teams that thrive in an on-demand world. Our platform allows clients and talent to achieve speed, flexibility, and control of their projects and business.

Our mission is to provide clients, talent, and partners the freedom to do their very best work through a new platform that enables smart team building by matching organizations with proven on-demand digital marketing & experience talent. Wripple is continuously looking for the highest quality independent talent. Our platform provides freelancers with a complete operating system to land verified opportunities and focus on doing great work.

Let our Business Development team do the hard work to find qualified blue-chip clients that you get matched with based on your capabilities and the type of work you love to do. Take control of how you want to work through Wripple’s Talent Dashboard: set your rates and preferences for how & when you want to work; receive online project briefs to determine whether to pursue; update your profile as your situation and skills change· Outsource the back office to Wripple, including payment, tax compliance as well as data and insights that help you make decisions for your business

There is absolutely no cost to be a member of Wripple. The process is simple. If you have the background for this specific role, please send your resume through the LinkedIn application process.

If you are not a direct match for this role, you can be considered for other opportunities by applying here: https://www.wripple.com/apply-to-join . After applying, you’ll be invited to interview and if your background is a match for the type of roles we have at Wripple, you’ll be approved to join our talent marketplace.

postings.descriptionText:
Performance Video Editor | DTC E-commerce

Work Schedule: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST
Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Contract

About the Role
Our client is a fast-growing DTC e-commerce company specializing in consumer products, with a strong presence across major retail channels.
They are looking for a Performance Video Editor to join their creative team and produce high-performing video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok. This is a great opportunity for an editor who understands that performance creative is about more than making a video look good—it’s about creating content that captures attention, communicates value quickly, and drives conversions.
The team produces a high volume of advertising creatives, so we are looking for someone who is creative, efficient, proactive, and comfortable generating new ideas and testing different approaches.

What You'll Do
Video Editing & Performance Creative

• Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.

• Transform raw footage, creator content, scripts, and product footage into engaging advertising creatives.

• Build strong hooks, pacing, re-hooks, visual storytelling, and CTAs designed to improve viewer retention and conversions.

• Create multiple variations of creative concepts to support testing and optimization.

• Source and incorporate relevant B-roll, stock footage, graphics, and other visual assets.

• Adapt content for different platforms, placements, and formats.

• Continuously improve creative based on feedback and performance insights.

Creative & Design

• Create compelling visual assets that support video ads and marketing campaigns.

• Apply strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.

• Use Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar tools when needed.

• Contribute new creative concepts and ideas for advertising campaigns.

Collaboration & Workflow

• Organize and manage creative assets efficiently.

• Follow established file naming and organization standards.

• Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions.

• Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to execute a high volume of advertising content.

• Be open to feedback and continuously look for ways to improve creative quality and workflow efficiency.

Requirements

• 2+ years of professional video editing experience, ideally focused on short-form content.

• Strong experience creating direct-response / performance video ads.

• Proven experience editing Facebook/Meta Ads.

• At least 1 year of experience working with a DTC or e-commerce brand.

• Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills.

• Strong understanding of short-form advertising creative and what makes people stop scrolling.

• Experience working with product-focused advertising.

• Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar design tools.

• Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, storytelling, typography, composition, and motion graphics.

• Ability to take a script or creative concept and turn it into an engaging visual story.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality work consistently.

• Fluent English, both written and verbal.

• Strong time management and ability to meet daily and weekly deadlines.

• Proactive, creative, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Comfortable giving and receiving feedback and iterating quickly.

• Portfolio required, with relevant performance video examples.

Strongly Preferred Experience

• We will prioritize candidates who have created advertising content for DTC/e-commerce brands, especially products such as:

• Home and household products

• Cleaning products

• Pet-related products

• Consumer electronics

• Other physical consumer products

• Experience creating Meta advertising creative is especially valuable.

• Candidates whose experience is primarily in corporate video, traditional media, film, or organic social content without meaningful performance advertising experience are unlikely to be a strong fit.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is not necessarily the most senior editor in the market. We are looking for someone with strong performance instincts, creativity, and good judgment who can understand a product, identify what will grab attention, and turn that insight into effective advertising creative.

You should be someone who:

• Thinks beyond simply following a script.

• Can come up with fresh creative ideas and angles.

• Understands the difference between organic content and direct-response advertising.

• Is comfortable testing hooks, formats, pacing, and creative concepts.

• Learns quickly and applies feedback.

• Can produce a high volume of quality creative without sacrificing attention to detail.

Tech Requirements

• Computer: i7 processor or equivalent with at least 16GB RAM

• Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum.

Schedule

• Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

• Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST

Hiring Process

• Candidates who move forward should be comfortable completing the following steps:

• Skills Assessment

• Trial Project

• Hiring Manager Interview

• Final Offer

The trial project will be used to evaluate editing quality, performance instincts, creativity, and technical execution.

Benefits & Perks

• Fully Remote

• Full-Time, Long-Term Opportunity

• Paid Time Off

• Flex Days

• Professional Development – Opportunities to learn and grow with the business

• Opportunity to work directly on high-volume DTC performance advertising

Want to become a Skylinker? Let’s soar together! ✈️

Are you a paid media specialist who cares about what happens after the click? Have you built landing pages, wired forms into a CRM, and tested the whole chain before spending a dollar on traffic? Can you tell an ad problem from a page problem from a targeting problem? Then we want to hear from you!

Who are we?
At Skylink, we’ve been flying high since 1986. ✈️ Founded by Jim and Susie Anglin, we’re dedicated to giving you a “WOW” experience. When challenges pop up (and they do!), we solve them together with a smile. We support the maintenance of aircraft fleets worldwide, providing everything from tiny bolts to massive jet engines. Whether it’s for commercial flights or military missions, we keep fleets soaring!

We're a Global Team! 🌍 of 30+ Skylinkers across the US and internationally, we offer a dynamic, collaborative environment where growth and success are shared by all!

✈️ What We Do
Skylink supports aircraft maintenance worldwide. We work with large commercial, regional, and military aircraft (yes, the same ones you fly on vacation, that transport cargo globally, and that support military missions). Our mission? To simplify the delivery of nose-to-tail aircraft maintenance materials for clients across 30+ countries.

This is a high-ownership, execution-driven , part-time contract role with 10 hours a week. You will own the whole path: the ad, the landing page, the form, and the lead that lands on a salesperson’s desk in Salesforce. The goal of every paid dollar and every funnel is a form fill or a conversation with sales. Clicks, impressions, and visits don't count. You will work closely with our CEO, and our Sales team, with our Marketing Playbook and AI marketing engine behind you.

Aviation experience is not required. Our AI engine carries the industry knowledge, the proof points, and the campaign history. We are hiring funnel thinking and disciplined judgment.

🎯 What You'll Own
• The Monday ad review. One fixed morning a week: our AI marketing engine pulls the LinkedIn and Meta numbers and drafts the recommendations. You decide which ones are right and apply them the same day. Pausing ads, rotating creative, fixing targeting leaks, and killing placements that spend without converting are your call. Budget changes, new channels, and objective changes go to the CEO with your reasoning.

• The funnels. For every campaign you build the landing page, thank-you page, form, CRM wiring, UTMs, and tracking pixels, then run the end-to-end test that proves a real submission reaches a real salesperson before a dollar of traffic runs.

• The budget models. Built from measured cost per click and real conversion rates, never from a platform’s flattering forecast.

• Retargeting. Build and manage the audience pools (page visitors, visitors who didn’t convert, ad engagers, and contact lists), give each pool the right message, and keep people who already converted out of the ads.PINK

• The numbers. Read the landing page conversion rate every week and act on it. Track MQLs and cost per MQL from paid, and check them against what Sales says about lead quality.

• The discipline that defines this role: nothing changes mid-week. One review day keeps every number readable. If your instinct is to tinker daily, this isn’t your seat. If your instinct is to isolate the problem before touching anything, keep reading.

🎯 Job Functions ✈️ Paid Media Management (LinkedIn & Meta)

• Run LinkedIn prospecting campaigns against target-account lists and buying roles

• Run Meta retargeting and awareness campaigns

• Hold the weekly review rhythm: read the AI engine's draft, decide, apply the fixes the same day, and save the written recommendation note.

• Run the Thursday load-and-check: load approved creative and confirm everything is serving, with no mid-week changes

• Diagnose before changing anything: is it delivering, is the click-through healthy, is the page converting, are leads qualifying, or is it fatigue?

• Decide when to freshen an ad that wore out and when to rewrite one that never worked

✈️ Funnel Design & Build

• Build landing pages (one offer, one form) and thank-you pages at their own URLs in Squarespace

• Build forms and automations in ActiveCampaign that trigger email sequences and alert Sales

• Wire leads into Salesforce, including campaign membership and same-day follow-up tasks for reps

• Set UTMs at the ad set level, following our naming standard

• Install tracking pixels the day pages go live, before any ads run

• Test every funnel end to end with a real submission before launch

✈️ Measurement & Optimization

• Track landing page conversion rate, MQLs, and cost per MQL

• Test the offer, headline, and form placement to improve conversion

• Separate cold paid traffic from warm traffic before drawing conclusions

• Bring a clear one-line paid summary to our weekly Monday Number meeting

✈️ Collaboration

• Work with our Designer on ad creative and page builds, and keep a creative queue ready for rotation

• Partner with Sales on lead quality and disqualification patterns

• Bring the CEO budget proposals backed by data, and sometimes a respectful “not yet”

This Role Is Perfect for Team Members Who Are…
(If you don’t resonate with these traits, this may not be the right fit for you!)
🚀 Key Traits & Skills

• Self-discipline & optimism : Consistently focused and positive, even in challenges.

• Emotional intelligence & empathy : Understand and connect with others on a deeper level.

• Scrappiness : Find solutions with creativity and practical insight.

• Ability to read people & act with initiative : Anticipate needs and take proactive steps.

• Persistence & passion : Stay committed and driven towards goals.

• Great communication & engaging presence : Articulate and compelling in all interactions.

• Accountability & authenticity : Own your results and stay true to your values.

Skills & Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns in a B2B environment (LinkedIn Campaign Manager is a must; Meta Ads Manager is a strong plus)

• A track record of running an ad account on a fixed review rhythm with written notes

• Experience building landing page funnels and testing the full chain, not just the page

• Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation (Salesforce and ActiveCampaign preferred, or similar platforms such as HubSpot)

• Comfort with website builders like Squarespace, tracking pixels, and UTM structures

• Ability to build budget models from real cost-per-click and conversion data

• Advanced prompting skills and the ability to use AI as a leverage tool, not a crutch

• Comfortable pushing back with data, including to leadership

• Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a remote environment

💰 Compensation

• For the Paid Ads & Full Funnel Designer, you can expect to earn between [$15 – $25] USD hourly rate depending on your experience and background. This range reflects opportunities across junior to more experienced profiles. This position is open to both U.S. and international candidates. Compensation aligned to local market benchmarks and experience.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

• Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

• Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

• Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

• Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

• Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

• Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

• Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

• Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

• Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

• Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You Bring

• 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

• A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

• Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

• High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

• Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

• Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

• Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

• Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

• Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

• A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.descriptionText:
About Nysonian
Nysonian builds the next generation of global lifestyle brands, shaping how people travel, move, and live. We go beyond creating great products to build experiences that elevate everyday life and empower people around the world.

Our Fast-Growing Portfolio Includes:

• NOBL Travel — redefining modern travel with design, durability, and performance

• FLO Pilates — bringing Pilates into homes and wardrobes globally

With $350M+ in revenue, 400+ teammates across 8 countries, and 1M+ customers worldwide, we are shaping the brands that will define the next decade.

Core Values: Winners’ Mindset | Speed with Purpose | Thoughtful Innovation | Genuineness | No Ego, Full Ownership

Important Information
To be considered for this job, in addition to applying, you must complete the form below. Any candidate who does not complete the form will be immediately disqualified.

Complete the Candidate Form

Position Overview
We are looking for a Video Editor to create high-performing paid social video ads for Nysonian's brands. You'll work with raw footage and transform it into compelling, performance-driven ads optimized for platforms like Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. This role is focused almost entirely on editing performance marketing creative that drives purchases, improves ad performance, and helps scale spend.

This is more than a traditional editing role. Your creative work will have a direct and measurable impact on business performance, with significant opportunities for growth, ownership, and additional earnings based on the performance of the ads you create.

What You Will Do

• Edit and produce high-quality video assets across social media, paid ads, websites, and campaign initiatives.

• Craft compelling narratives with strong hooks, pacing, and platform-optimized storytelling techniques.

• Transform UGC, influencer content, and brand footage into polished, performance-driven deliverables.

• Integrate motion graphics, captions, music, and sound design to elevate overall content quality and engagement.

• Convert long-form content into high-performing short-form formats, including TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Partner with designers, copywriters, and strategists to ensure alignment with brand and campaign objectives.

• Manage multiple projects with fast turnaround times while maintaining strict adherence to brand standards and evolving platform best practices.

• Analyze creative performance and use data, testing, and learnings to continuously improve future ads.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Media, Film, Communications, or a related field (preferred).

• 2–4 years of video editing experience in fast-paced environments such as agency, DTC, or E-Commerce.

• Advanced skills in editing tools including Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent platforms.

• Exposure to AI-driven video tools such as Runway ML or similar platforms to enhance creative production and efficiency.

• Strong understanding of content formats and performance dynamics across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Meta.

• Ability to edit with a focus on storytelling and marketing outcomes, including CTR, engagement, conversion, and ROAS.

• Experience in motion graphics, basic animation, sound design, and a strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality, high-performing content.

• Skilled storyteller with a sharp eye for detail and a strong understanding of current creative trends.

• Able to thrive under tight deadlines in a high-growth environment.

• Team-oriented yet independent, with a data-driven mindset and a desire to test, optimize, and improve creative performance.

Performance-Based Bonuses & Growth
At Nysonian, high performance is rewarded.

Your bonus is tied to the objective performance of the ad creatives you produce. The better your creativity performs, the greater your opportunity to earn. Depending on your salary level and performance, editors can have the opportunity to earn 50–150%+ of their base salary in performance bonuses.

What This Means

• Performance-based bonuses tied to the measurable performance of your ad creatives.

• Potential for significant quarterly bonus payouts.

• The opportunity to earn 50–150%+ of base salary in bonuses, depending on compensation level and performance.

• Higher-salaried editors may have a lower bonus percentage while still having substantial earning potential.

• A clear opportunity for career growth, increased ownership, and greater earning potential as your creative performance improves.

• The chance to work directly on creative that influences revenue and helps scale some of the fastest-growing DTC brands.

If you consistently produce ads that win, your growth and earning potential can grow with them.

Why You'll Love Working at Nysonian

• Collaborate with high-performing teams across fast-growing global brands.

• Meaningful opportunities for growth, ownership, and impact.

• A culture built on accountability, transparency, and execution.

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness-focused perks.

• Significant performance-based earning potential through quarterly bonuses.

• Work in an environment where creative performance is measured, recognized, and rewarded.

• Opportunity to take ownership of creative initiatives and make a measurable business impact.

• Opportunity to design and own internal automation systems.

• Work alongside ambitious people who want to build brands that operate at a global scale.

Our Commitment
Nysonian is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.

Symmetry es una app de salud y fitness con más de 3 millones de usuarios: número uno de Salud y Bienestar en España, top 10 en varios mercados más, y más de 200 millones de visualizaciones al mes en nuestro contenido.

Qué vas a publicar
Carruseles y piezas verticales para TikTok. El formato principal es el carrusel: varias tarjetas con imagen y texto, pensadas para retención y para que la gente las guarde. Tú las conceptualizas y las produces de principio a fin, desde el hook hasta la última tarjeta.

Cómo es una semana

• Produces. Sacas las piezas acordadas siguiendo el sistema del equipo.

• Reportas. Dejas el trabajo registrado en las herramientas internas.

• Iteras. Recibes feedback en la revisión semanal y lo aplicas a la siguiente tanda.

Requerimientos

• Criterio para TikTok: distingues un hook que funciona de uno que no, y sabes explicar por qué.

• Manejo de formatos verticales y de las herramientas para producirlos. Con celular y computadora propios es suficiente.

• Escribir bien y corto. El copy de un carrusel es la mitad del trabajo.

• Aplicar feedback rápido y sin fricción.

• Interés real por el fitness, la salud o el bienestar.

Suma puntos

• Cuentas o piezas propias que podamos ver, aunque sean pequeñas.

• Haber producido contenido orgánico con volumen y calendario.

• Conocer la escena de creadores de fitness en Argentina.

Cómo trabajamos
Cien por ciento remoto y con horario flexible, trabajas directo con el Head of Content, con objetivos semanales y una revisión de feedback cada semana.

Compensación y formato

• Compensación competitiva según experiencia.

• Remoto desde Argentina, con horario flexible.

• Si funciona, hay camino para crecer dentro del equipo de contenido.

Tu candidatura
Mándanos trabajo que ya tengas publicado: tu TikTok, carruseles, videos, lo que sea. Si todavía no tienes nada publicado, mándanos tres cuentas de TikTok que te parezcan buenas y dinos exactamente qué hacen bien.

Senior Video Editor and AI Creative Producer
DTC Ecommerce
Full-time | Remote in LATAM | US Pacific working hours
Schedule follows Pacific Time, including PST and PDT. Professional written and spoken English required.
About Lemon Adds and the role
Lemon Adds is a performance marketing agency helping DTC and e-commerce brands grow through paid media, creative, influencer marketing, retention, and ecommerce execution. We are looking for a senior creator who combines exceptional video editing, direct-response advertising judgment, and expert AI production.
You will own projects from the brand brief through concept, script, production, and final delivery. Your work will include paid social ads, UGC edits, branded product videos, and original organic social content designed to earn attention, build interest, and drive purchases.
Proven DTC ecommerce advertising experience and an advanced AI video portfolio are essential.

What you will own

• Develop original concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, and shot lists. Research products, customer motivations, objections, competitors, and social trends, then turn those insights into clear creative ideas.

• Edit short-form ads and branded content for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Combine creator footage, product assets, and AI-generated scenes with strong pacing, persuasive storytelling, captions, and clear calls to action.

• Create realistic AI UGC-style content with believable people, expressions, gestures, product interactions, and lip sync. Direct voice delivery and sound design so dialogue, music, and visuals work together naturally.

• Produce AI product videos and motion graphics using reference images, controlled generation, compositing, animation, and kinetic typography. Preserve product shape, scale, packaging, labels, and visual consistency across shots.

• Develop organic social concepts with strong openings, humor, relevant memes, cultural references, and repeatable formats. Adapt trends to each brand and audience, with a focus on retention, sharing, and discovery.

• Build meaningful variations of hooks, angles, narratives, offers, and calls to action. Work with media buyers to use retention, hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS as context for creative improvements.

• Finish assets to a high standard: correct AI artifacts, polish color and audio, check captions and product accuracy, and export for the intended placements. Keep source files, prompts, and references organized while managing deadlines and generation costs.

What you must bring
A portfolio of finished DTC ecommerce ads used in paid campaigns, created for brands directly or through a performance marketing agency. Experience handling multiple brands is strongly preferred.
Strong direct-response instincts: you understand how a hook leads into a product benefit, demonstration, credible proof, objection handling, and a compelling reason to buy.
Expert AI production skills demonstrated in completed commercial work, including realistic UGC-style video, consistent characters and products, lip sync, voice direction, and product motion.
Advanced editing, motion graphics, compositing, and sound skills. You can identify unnatural movement, weak pacing, incorrect product details, or robotic delivery and bring the work to a professional finish.
Creative ownership and strong awareness of US social media culture. You can write natural English scripts, pitch original ideas, explain your decisions, and improve work through feedback and results.
Professional written and spoken English, reliable remote collaboration, and availability to work the agreed full-time US Pacific schedule from LATAM.
Comfortable creating content for a range of DTC brands, including sexual wellness brands.

Production tools and workflow
You should have an expert working setup across the categories below. We assess the quality and repeatability of your workflow; proficiency in every named application is not required.
Editing and motion: Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with After Effects or comparable motion graphics and compositing tools.
AI video: Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Google Veo through Flow, or comparable current platforms for controlled, realistic production.
Voice and performance: ElevenLabs, plus tools such as HeyGen, Runway Act-Two, or Higgsfield lip-sync workflows.
Image preparation: Photoshop and Firefly, Nano Banana, or equivalent tools for product references, storyboards, and generation inputs.
Stay current, test new models, and explain which tools you choose for each brief. Show how you refine generations and combine them with precise editing to deliver finished work.

What to include in your application
Email your application to careers@lemonadds.com with the subject line “Senior Video Editor and AI Creative Producer Application — [Your Full Name]” and include:

• Your résumé/CV, a brief introduction, and your location.

• Your expected monthly compensation in USD and confirmation that you can work full-time US Pacific hours (PST/PDT).

• A portfolio link with 3–5 finished videos covering three DTC paid social ads, a UGC edit, a realistic AI UGC-style ad, and an AI product video with motion graphics. Samples may satisfy multiple categories.

• For each sample, identify the product, objective, your exact contribution, and tools used. Include available performance context and one iteration informed by results. Redacted results and private portfolio links are welcome.

• One short workflow breakdown from brief and script to generation and final edit, including an initial AI output and the improvements you made.

Portfolios consisting only of podcast edits, real estate videos, generic social clips, or motion graphics without DTC advertising examples do not meet this role’s requirements.

Why join Lemon Adds
Own creative work across DTC brands, collaborate directly with performance marketers and creatives, and help shape our AI production workflows. See your ideas tested in live campaigns and use the feedback to make your next concept stronger.

postings.title: Video Editor
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview:

At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry.

Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Video Editor to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing.

Qualifications:
• At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

• Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci.

• Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos.

• A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

• Agency experience is a plus

• Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others

• BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work

• Fluency in English is required.

Key Competencies:
• Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

• Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets.

• A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation.

• Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

• Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

• A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

• You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.

Overview: As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates.

• Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

• Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued.

• Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

• Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

• Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

• Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.

Working Hours:

• This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.

Expectations:

• Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

• Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

• Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.

Tools and Software:

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.

Compensation:
The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:

• Compensation: Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

• Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.

Expectations and Growth:
This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.
We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.

To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form that is 27 questions in total. You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

Schedule follows Pacific Time, including PST and PDT. Professional written and spoken English required.
About Lemon Adds and the role
Lemon Adds is a performance marketing agency helping DTC and ecommerce brands grow through paid media, creative, influencer marketing, retention, and ecommerce execution. We are looking for a senior creator who combines exceptional video editing, direct-response advertising judgment, and expert AI production.
You will own projects from the brand brief through concept, script, production, and final delivery. Your work will include paid social ads, UGC edits, branded product videos, and original organic social content designed to earn attention, build interest, and drive purchases.
Proven DTC ecommerce advertising experience and an advanced AI video portfolio are essential.
What you will own

• Develop original concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, and shot lists. Research products, customer motivations, objections, competitors, and social trends, then turn those insights into clear creative ideas.

• Edit short-form ads and branded content for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Combine creator footage, product assets, and AI-generated scenes with strong pacing, persuasive storytelling, captions, and clear calls to action.

• Create realistic AI UGC-style content with believable people, expressions, gestures, product interactions, and lip sync. Direct voice delivery and sound design so dialogue, music, and visuals work together naturally.

• Produce AI product videos and motion graphics using reference images, controlled generation, compositing, animation, and kinetic typography. Preserve product shape, scale, packaging, labels, and visual consistency across shots.

• Develop organic social concepts with strong openings, humor, relevant memes, cultural references, and repeatable formats. Adapt trends to each brand and audience, with a focus on retention, sharing, and discovery.

• Build meaningful variations of hooks, angles, narratives, offers, and calls to action. Work with media buyers to use retention, hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS as context for creative improvements.

• Finish assets to a high standard: correct AI artifacts, polish color and audio, check captions and product accuracy, and export for the intended placements. Keep source files, prompts, and references organized while managing deadlines and generation costs.

What you must bring

• A portfolio of finished DTC ecommerce ads used in paid campaigns, created for brands directly or through a performance marketing agency. Experience handling multiple brands is strongly preferred.

• Strong direct-response instincts: you understand how a hook leads into a product benefit, demonstration, credible proof, objection handling, and a compelling reason to buy.

• Expert AI production skills demonstrated in completed commercial work, including realistic UGC-style video, consistent characters and products, lip sync, voice direction, and product motion.

• Advanced editing, motion graphics, compositing, and sound skills. You can identify unnatural movement, weak pacing, incorrect product details, or robotic delivery and bring the work to a professional finish.

• Creative ownership and strong awareness of US social media culture. You can write natural English scripts, pitch original ideas, explain your decisions, and improve work through feedback and results.

• Professional written and spoken English, reliable remote collaboration, and availability to work the agreed full-time US Pacific schedule from LATAM.

• Comfortable creating content for a range of DTC brands, including sexual wellness brands.

Production tools and workflow
You should have an expert working setup across the categories below. We assess the quality and repeatability of your workflow; proficiency in every named application is not required.

• Editing and motion: Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with After Effects or comparable motion graphics and compositing tools.

• AI video: Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Google Veo through Flow, or comparable current platforms for controlled, realistic production.

• Voice and performance: ElevenLabs, plus tools such as HeyGen, Runway Act-Two, or Higgsfield lip-sync workflows.

• Image preparation: Photoshop and Firefly, Nano Banana, or equivalent tools for product references, storyboards, and generation inputs.

Stay current, test new models, and explain which tools you choose for each brief. Show how you refine generations and combine them with precise editing to deliver finished work.
What to include in your application

• A brief introduction, your location, and confirmation of availability during US Pacific working hours.

• Three to five finished videos that collectively include three DTC paid social ads, a UGC edit, a realistic AI UGC-style ad, and an AI product video with motion graphics. A sample may satisfy more than one category.

• For each sample, identify the product, objective, your exact contribution, and the tools used. Include available performance context and one example of how results informed an iteration. Redacted results and private portfolio links are welcome.

• One short workflow breakdown showing how you moved from a brief and script to generation and final edit. Include an initial AI output and the improvements you made to it.

Portfolios consisting only of podcast edits, real estate videos, generic social clips, or motion graphics without DTC advertising examples do not meet this role’s requirements.
Why join Lemon Adds
Own creative work across DTC brands, collaborate directly with performance marketers and creatives, and help shape our AI production workflows. See your ideas tested in live campaigns and use the feedback to make your next concept stronger.

About the Role

ZIVA is supporting a mission-driven organization in its search for a Content Creator and Social Media Specialist.
Our client is committed to personal growth and positive community impact. The team is eager to connect with new audiences and deepen engagement with its existing community through compelling, authentic social media content.
This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who can take real ownership of the organization’s social media presence. You will develop and implement content strategies tailored to the strengths of each platform, then turn those strategies into consistent, high-quality content. You will create, schedule, and publish original content; engage with the online community; and use data to continually improve results.
Your work will strengthen brand awareness and affinity, grow the community, and support the organization’s marketing goals year over year.

Objectives of This Role
• Own the day-to-day development and improvement of the organization’s social media presence.

• Translate marketing priorities into clear, practical social media and content strategies.

• Increase engagement with existing audiences through high-quality social content and initiatives.

• Attract new followers by identifying and filling gaps in current content output.

• Keep the brand relevant by thoughtfully incorporating appropriate trends and platform changes.

• Improve content effectiveness through consistent, audience-relevant messaging and performance analysis.

• Identify new channels, formats, and content opportunities that support the overall marketing direction.

• Gather practical insights from social data and use them to guide future decisions.

Key Responsibilities
• Take ownership of the organization’s social media channels, including both strategic development and consistent day-to-day execution.

• Develop, maintain, and improve a social media strategy that supports the organization’s wider marketing goals.

• Create, schedule, and publish original, platform-native content across social channels, including short-form video, social posts, captions, stories, and other relevant formats.

• Build and maintain organized content calendars that connect campaign priorities, audience needs, and platform-specific opportunities.

• Develop social media campaigns in collaboration with the marketing team, from initial concept through execution, reporting, and improvement.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve content, strengthen engagement, test new approaches, or expand the organization’s reach.

• Represent the brand professionally by engaging with the existing community and welcoming new audiences through comments, messages, and other social interactions as appropriate.

• Stay current on platform changes, content formats, and emerging trends, using sound judgment to determine which opportunities align with the brand and audience.

• Track agreed key performance indicators, measure campaign effectiveness, and recommend adjustments to improve results.

• Prepare clear, practical performance updates for the team, including learnings, proposed priorities, and recommended next steps.

• Work within established brand guidelines while bringing forward thoughtful ideas and creative solutions.

• Manage projects independently, communicate progress clearly, and follow through on commitments without needing constant direction.

Required Qualifications
• High English proficiency, written and spoken, at C1 level or higher.

• Degree in Marketing, Social Media, Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Demonstrated experience creating social media content for one or more major platforms, such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, or YouTube.

• Strong visual judgment, copywriting ability, and attention to detail.

• Ability to create or confidently coordinate short-form video, graphics, and other engaging social content.

• Demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects and guide initiatives from idea to results.

• A strategic mindset, with the ability to balance creative execution with audience needs, organizational goals, and measurable outcomes.

• Ability to interpret content-performance data and turn it into practical improvements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

• Clear, confident communication and strong time-management skills.

• Comfort receiving feedback, revising work promptly, and continuously improving.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience leading or substantially contributing to a brand’s social media strategy and initiatives.

• A strong understanding of how to build, test, and improve effective social media strategies.

• Experience growing an organization’s social media presence or audience.

• Experience with social media management, scheduling, monitoring, and analytics tools.

• Familiarity with content-creation tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with email clients and project-management software.

Professional and Cultural Fit This role suits someone who works with integrity, takes pride in the quality of their work, and holds themselves accountable for results. We are looking for someone who approaches the organization’s social media presence with an owner’s mindset: they notice what needs attention, bring forward solutions, and take responsibility for following through.
The right person is committed and self-driven, keeps learning and improving, and cares about the impact their content has on people and communities. A positive, collaborative attitude, sound judgment, and a genuine enjoyment of creating are essential.

Self-Selection Check This role will be fulfilling if you enjoy turning ideas into engaging content, taking responsibility for meaningful results, learning from data, and using your creativity to support a mission you can believe in.
This role may not be fulfilling if you prefer highly rigid direction, are uncomfortable making thoughtful decisions independently, or are not interested in staying current with evolving platforms, content formats, and trends.

Position Details and What We Offer
• 100% remote.

• Full-time, 40 hours per week.

• Hourly compensation in USD.

• Opportunity to take meaningful ownership in a growing, fast-moving organization.

• Ongoing learning and professional development, with support to build skills over time.

Application Requirement
• Please submit a portfolio or links to social media accounts, campaigns, videos, graphics, written content, or other relevant work you have created. We are especially interested in examples that show your ability to create engaging, platform-appropriate content, think strategically about audience needs, and explain the thinking behind your work.

Senior Content & Communications Specialist

You will support the Tax Technology Studio at GDS Argentina by creating, refining and organizing high-quality content for internal and external audiences. The role combines content creation, content mining, editorial support, corporate communications and marketing coordination, with a strong focus on clear messaging, presentation development and brand-compliant delivery.

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Content Creator who can translate complex tax, technology and business topics into clear, engaging and audience-appropriate communications. This opportunity is well suited to someone with strong editorial judgment, excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple content workstreams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Your key responsibilities

As part of our team, you will:

• Create, adapt and organize content for internal and external communications, campaigns, proposals and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

• Mine existing materials and subject-matter input to identify reusable messages, insights and content opportunities.

• Write and edit a range of content, including presentation decks, newsletters, emails, intranet articles, web copy, social media posts and other corporate communications.

• Translate tax, technology and business-related topics into clear, concise and audience-appropriate language.

• Develop key messages, communication narratives and storytelling approaches that help strategic initiatives resonate with target audiences.

• Proofread, copy edit, fact-check and quality-assure written materials before publication or distribution.

• Build and polish high-quality PowerPoint presentations that communicate complex information clearly and consistently.

• Support the planning and organization of content calendars, editorial pipelines and related deliverables.

• Coordinate priorities, inputs, reviews and approvals across multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

• Partner with design, marketing, communications, tax and technology teams to align content with business needs and intended audiences.

• Apply EY brand and communications guidance to deliver consistent, brand-compliant materials.

• Maintain organized content repositories and support the effective reuse of approved materials.

• Identify audience needs, recommend relevant topics and propose practical improvements to content and communications.

• Participate in client and internal team calls as needed, capturing requirements and converting them into clear content actions.

• Provide light project coordination and administrative support for assigned content initiatives, while remaining primarily accountable for content and editorial delivery.

• Comply with applicable learning, continuing education, Risk Management and general policy requirements.

Skills and attributes for success

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce polished professional content. Additional languages are beneficial but not required; German or French would be particularly valuable.

• Proven experience in content creation, corporate communications, copywriting, editorial work, content marketing or a related field.

• Strong copy editing, proofreading and fact-checking skills, with close attention to detail and consistency.

• Advanced Microsoft Office skills, with strong PowerPoint proficiency and confidence working in Excel and Word.

• Ability to plan, prioritize and organize work effectively across multiple concurrent requests and deadlines applying basic project management principles where appropriate.

• Strong presentation and information-structuring skills, including the ability to turn complex input into a clear narrative.

• Sound stakeholder management, communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and service-oriented approach.

• Ability to work independently, exercise judgment and follow through on actions and approvals.

• Working knowledge of branding principles and corporate communications standards is an advantage.

• Experience in marketing and communications, corporate communications, editorial roles, customer success/customer experience, project coordination, PMO support or administrative coordination may be relevant.

What we look for

You are a thoughtful and dependable content professional who combines strong writing and editorial judgment with excellent planning and organization. You can manage competing priorities, collaborate with distributed teams and deliver accurate, brand-compliant work to deadlines. You are comfortable supporting tax and business-related communications, and you bring enough project coordination capability to keep content moving without treating the role as a dedicated project management position.

What working at EY offers:

This role offers the opportunity to deepen your content, communications and presentation skills while collaborating with experienced professionals across tax, technology, marketing and design. You will contribute to varied regional and global initiatives, strengthen your understanding of complex business topics and help shape high-quality communications for internal and external audiences.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations – Argentina, China, India, Hungary, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

postings.title: Head Editor
postings.descriptionText:
Performance Video Editor

Fast-Growing Jewellery Brand · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week
$10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About the Brand

We're hiring on behalf of one of the fastest-growing e-commerce jewellery brands in the US. The brand sells collectible charms, with new products launching soon, and its content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you decide which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's decided by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

- Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience
- Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.
- Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

- Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics
- Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats
- Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change
- Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes
- Work directly from paid performance data to decide what to cut next
- Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required
- Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

- A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)
- You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work
- Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video
- Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut
- Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice
- Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool
- Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands
- Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data
- A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

- Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die
- 1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead
- Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in
- A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

- Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content
- You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed
- You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell
- You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive
- You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

- Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD
- Location: 100% remote
- Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role
- Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.
- Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.
- Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics
- Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

About the Role:

As a Marketing Growth & Communications Intern, you will play a critical support role with responsibility for preparing and executing the campaigns behind our consumer programs — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle communications — that reach millions of shoppers. A core focus will be managing our CRM platform (Braze) across email, push, RCS/SMS, and in-app messages, building and QAing assets, managing compliance approvals, and reporting on performance. In addition to execution, you will help build content to support channel optimization, segmentation, and analytics across all channels. To achieve these goals, you will engage with varying members across the marketing department, as well as Design, Product and Compliance.

The primary aim for this role is to help create relevant, customized and personalized content for our Sezzle consumers, to maximize revenue and engagement. Beyond executing campaigns, you'll be encouraged to help shape them — proposing the audience, the timing, and the message.

Keep the operation running

Educational & Professional Experience

• Prior experience with Braze or another CRM/marketing automation platform is a plus

Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Social Media Video Editor who speaks the language of the internet and can turn raw footage into viral gold.

Why This Role Matters

The "For You Page," the scroll, and the hook are your playground. As a Junior Social Media Video Editor, you aren't just cutting video; you are translating brand messages into native social culture. You will be responsible for taking raw influencer content and studio footage and turning it into snappy, engaging, and high-converting assets for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Your work determines if a user stops scrolling or keeps moving. If you are obsessed with pacing, trends, and creating content that feels authentic to the platform, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

• Edit Native Short-Form Content

• Assemble and edit fast-paced, engaging videos specifically for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

• Master the art of the "hook"—editing the first 3 seconds to grab attention instantly using visual disruption, text overlays, and sound.

• Implement trending audio, native text styles, and platform-specific stickers to make ads feel organic.

• Remix & Iterate

• Take successful ad concepts and create fresh iterations by swapping hooks, changing music, or re-ordering footage to combat creative fatigue.

• Turn long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts) into bite-sized, viral social clips.

• Polish & Enhance

• Apply dynamic captions (Alex Hormozi style, karaoke style, etc.) that increase watch time and retention.

• Perform basic color correction and audio mixing to ensure mobile-viewing quality.

• Add basic motion graphics and transitions to keep the energy high.

• Stay Trend-Obsessed

• Monitor the TikTok Creative Center and Reels trends daily.

• Proactively pitch new editing styles, audio trends, or visual memes that we can apply to our client brands.

Who You Are

• A Social Media Native

• 1–3 years of experience editing specifically for social media (personal brand, agency, or freelance).

• You live on the FYP. You understand current memes, pacing trends, and what makes a video go viral.

• Technically Agile

• Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required).

• Familiarity with After Effects (for motion text) and CapCut (for specific trending effects) is a major plus.

• You understand aspect ratios, safe zones, and export settings for all social platforms.

• Fast & Creative

• You can turn around an edit in hours, not days. You thrive on the speed of social media.

• You have a good sense of rhythm and timing—your cuts land perfectly on the beat.

• Detail-Oriented

• You double-check spelling in captions and ensure audio levels are balanced for phone speakers.

• You are organized with your file management and project structures.

• Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You can clearly articulate why you made a creative choice and collaborate effectively with Art Directors remotely.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of major brands and grow into a Senior Editor or Creative Strategist role.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral edit at a time.
