postings.title: Creative Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
About Social Scout

Social Scout is the fastest-growing retention agency in the eCommerce industry, helping DTC brands generate more repeat purchases and increase customer lifetime value through email and SMS marketing.

We currently work with 150+ full-service retainer client accounts and are rapidly expanding into conversion rate optimization (CRO) and webpage design services.

We’re hiring a prolific, high-velocity Creative Strategist to lead our internal client acquisition pipeline. Managing over $110,000/month in internal Meta ad spend, your primary objective will be to conceptualize, script, launch, and scale high-converting B2B ad campaigns that convince eCommerce founders, CMOs, and heads of growth to hire Social Scout.

Our goal is simple: book more qualified calls, sign more clients, and accelerate our growth even further. We want to double, and eventually triple, our current ad spend as quickly as performance allows.

This role will initially focus heavily on scaling our core email and SMS marketing offer, while also helping us expand into new acquisition funnels for CRO and related services.

We’re looking for someone who can operate at high velocity, aiming for 60+ ad variations per week, while still thinking strategically about messaging, hooks, angles, creative formats, testing, and performance.

Compensation & Role Details

• Highly competitive salary.

• Full-time (40 hours per week) and fully remote.

• You must be set up and hired as a contractor.

• Fluent English required (written and spoken).

• A minimum five hour overlap between 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.

The Role

As a Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of creative concepts, rapid content production, and ad account execution. You won't just be writing briefs, you will actively write scripts, direct existing video footage (studio recordings, founder clips, B-roll, client interviews), manage UGC creator relationships, collaborate with video editors, and directly launch campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

This is a high-volume, performance-first role built for someone who understands how to use creative as the primary targeting lever in B2B and performance marketing.

What You'll Be Doing

• High-Velocity Scripting & Concepting: Develop 60 ad creative concepts/variations weekly using modular testing frameworks (swapping hooks, CTAs, angles, and visual formats) tailored for Meta.

• Content & Production Management: Utilize our existing media library (founder studio footage, client interviews, B-roll) to brief video editors. Sourcing and managing relationships with external UGC creators and B2B actors as needed.

• Meta Campaign Setup & Launch: Upload, set up, and launch ad creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager, ensuring accurate naming conventions, headlines, primary text, and campaign setups.

• Performance Analysis & Testing: Analyze front-end metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and down-funnel performance. Continually iterate on winning angles and eliminate underperforming creative assets.

• Service Ecosystem Synergy: Work closely with our email marketing and upcoming CRO/webpage design teams to ensure ad messaging seamlessly connects with landing pages and backend nurture flows.

• Platform Expansion Strategy: Lead initial efforts on Meta while laying the foundation to repurpose winning creative formats into future channels like LinkedIn and Google.

What You Bring

• 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Performance Creative Strategist focused heavily on Meta Ads.

• Proven track record writing scripts and concepts for short-form video (Reels/UGC) and static graphics that drive direct-response conversions.

• Experience in high-volume creative testing environments, capable of managing asset pipelines and briefing video editors efficiently.

postings.title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
E-commerce Manager (Shopify)

BlackboxMyCar | Remote, working Pacific hours | Full-time contractor | Senior role

About us
BlackboxMyCar is a dash cam retailer and installer based in Richmond, BC, in business for 14 years. We sell across Canada and the US through two Shopify stores, Amazon and our own install centre. We carry the leading dash cam brands alongside our own products, and we are launching a new product line this fall.

The role
You run the day to day of both our Shopify stores and everything that feeds them: product pages, pricing roll-outs, site quality, SEO and product feeds. Once the store is under control, you also take over our written website content.

We use AI to produce first drafts of pages, content and code. Your job is the part AI cannot do: knowing what is right, checking it properly, and shipping work that is correct the first time. The first 80 percent of most tasks is easy now. We are hiring for the last 20 percent: the judgment, the product knowledge and the attention to detail that decide whether something is actually done.

This is a senior generalist role. We do not expect you to know our products on day one, but we do expect you to become independent quickly and not need your work redone.

You report to our Director of Marketing and work closely with our CEO and our operations team.

What you will do

Store and site

• Handle Shopify changes and requests from our sales, operations and support teams through one queue.

• Build new product and content pages from our existing templates and theme, keeping the structure clean and consistent. No one-off layouts, no bloat.

• Check that any AI-generated code actually fits how our site is built before it goes anywhere near live.

• Test every change on phone and desktop, on both stores, before it goes live.

• Keep a clear change log: what changed, when, why, and how to undo it.

• Help simplify the site as we move pages off a page builder and remove apps we no longer need.

• Contribute to site design and brand direction, working with the Director of Marketing, who has the final say.

Products and pricing

• Keep product data accurate: specs, titles, variants, images and compatibility.

• Roll out our twice-weekly price and promotion changes across the website, Google, Meta, email and social, and confirm every channel shows the same thing.

• Build product pages and launch checklists for new products.

SEO and product feeds

• Implement SEO work: page updates, redirects, and clean-up of old, translated and retired pages. Every redirect decided case by case, with the reason written down, never as a blind batch.

• Keep Google Merchant Center and our product feeds healthy: disapprovals, missing attributes, and product URLs that affect our ads.

Reporting

• Send a short written update every Friday: what shipped, what broke and how it was fixed, feed status, and the week's numbers, with Shopify as the source of truth.

Written website content (after the first 90 days)

• Our CEO is laying the content foundation now: priorities, topics and the calendar. Once the store is under control, you take over running it.

• Keep guides, buying advice, product content and blog pages accurate, current and useful, including refreshing older pages rather than only adding new ones.

• Written website content only. Video, social posting and influencer work sit with other people on the team.

• Write for customers first and search second. No volume for its own sake and no generic AI content.

What this role is not

• Video production, social posting or influencer outreach.

• Packaging or factory communication.

• Setting prices (you roll them out; you do not decide them).

• Running or monitoring ad campaigns (our ads specialist does this).

Must have

• 3+ years hands-on running a Shopify store, including theme code (Liquid and CSS, some JavaScript), sections and metafields.

• Practical e-commerce SEO: redirects, canonicals, handling retired products and translated pages, Google Search Console.

• Google Merchant Center and product feeds.

• Comfortable working in GA4.

• Strong written English: you can write a product page or a buying guide a customer actually wants to read.

• You use AI tools every day, and you can explain where they got something wrong and how you caught it.

• You check your own work. You catch wrong specs, broken links, inconsistent formatting and claims we cannot make before anyone else sees them.

• You understand how Shopify, SEO, product feeds and site content affect each other.

• You take ownership of the final result, not just the first draft.

• At least 6 hours of overlap with Pacific business hours.

Nice to have

• Consumer electronics or automotive products (dash cams a plus).

• A good eye for site design, UX and brand.

• Content planning for an e-commerce brand.

• Shopify Admin API, scripting or automation.

• Experience moving a store off a page builder such as Shogun or PageFly.

• Klaviyo, Gorgias or Judge.me.

• Design skills (Figma, Canva).

• French.

How we hire
Step 1. Short first call.

Step 2. A paid test of 2 to 3 hours on real work:

• Fix a real product page that has planted errors, and list what you found.

• Diagnose a product feed or product exclusion problem and write the fix.

• For 20 old URLs, decide redirect (and where), keep, or retire, with a one-line reason for each.

Step 3. Final interview with the Director of Marketing and the CEO.

Step 4. Reference check.

What success looks like

• 30 days: you own routine store requests and our twice-weekly price updates, with no errors reaching customers.

• 60 days: you build product pages from templates on your own and run our SEO clean-up.

• 90 days: you can run both stores for a full week without help, and you start taking over the written content calendar.

Working with us

• Your own named logins; all accounts belong to the company.

• Changes to themes, apps, checkout, domains and bulk edits go through the Director's sign-off.

• Contractor agreement with confidentiality and ownership-of-work terms.

• First 30 days as a trial with a review at day 30.

postings.descriptionText:
Synchro Social is hiring a Short-Form Video Editor. This role combines editing skills, storytelling, speed and attention to detail.

About Synchro Social
Synchro Social is a social media agency. We work with coaches, thought leaders and business owners around the world who want to make a positive impact. We help them grow their audience, build trust as experts and turn their views into paying clients.

The Role
You will turn raw footage into short-form videos that grab attention in the first seconds, keep people watching and make our clients look and sound their best. Every video you deliver should be clean, match the client’s brand, arrive on time and be ready to post without any fixes.

What You Will Do

• Edit raw footage into short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.

• Build edits with strong openings, tight cuts and no empty pauses.

• Add accurate captions, text on screen and simple motion graphics.

• Clean up the audio, balance volume levels and choose music that fits the client.

• Follow each client’s style guide so their videos always look professional and consistent.

• Deliver your edits on time and tell the team early if something might cause a delay.

• Apply feedback from the team and clients carefully and get it right the first time.

• Notice which edits perform best and share what you learn with the team.

•

What We Are Looking For
Attention to detail is required for this role. One spelling mistake in a caption, one jump cut in the wrong place or one bad sound in the audio can ruin a great video, and our clients notice these things.
We like creativity, but here consistency, quality, finishing what you start and meeting deadlines are much more important.

AI has changed how our team works and has made our editors more productive than ever. In this role you will spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time using your own judgment to make each video better, with clearer stories and stronger hooks. AI should help you work faster and better, and it is never a reason to do low quality work.

What You Need to Have

• Experience editing short-form videos for social media, ideally in English.

• A portfolio of short-form edits that shows good pacing, captions and storytelling.

• A strong understanding of what makes videos perform on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.

• Strong skills in DaVinci Resolve, and experience using Slack and Google Workspace (G-Suite).

• The ability to edit videos with Claude. This is required for the role.

• Experience using Hypermotion and Claude to deliver multiple videos per day is strongly preferred.

• An AI-based workflow that you already use to make editing decisions faster.

• Good written English, so you can communicate clearly with the team and understand client feedback.

• The ability to stay calm under pressure, work with multiple clients at the same time and take responsibility for your work without someone checking on you all the time.

Pay and Schedule
Remote position.
$1,700 to $1,850 USD per month, depending on experience.
Working hours are 9:00am to 5:00pm Eastern Time (New York time).

Please Do Not Apply If
You want full creative freedom on every video and you do not like feedback or making changes. This role is about serving the client’s message and brand.

How to Apply
Click the Apply button on this job post.
If you pay attention to details, you are reliable and you enjoy helping people share their message with the world, we would love to hear from you. You will work with clients who are changing lives and making a positive impact on the people they serve.

postings.title: TikTok Content Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition. That’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we're constantly pushing the boundaries of creative production.

We're looking for a TikTok Content Manager who lives and breathes social media, understands what makes content go viral, and knows how to turn creative ideas into engaging videos that drive measurable results.

Why This Role Matters

TikTok moves fast, and so do we.

As our TikTok Content Manager, you'll take ownership of TikTok content strategy, planning, publishing, and performance. You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement.

We're looking for someone who understands TikTok beyond trends and viral sounds. You know how to identify content opportunities, develop repeatable formats, analyze performance, and turn insights into better creative decisions.

If you're constantly discovering new creators, experimenting with content formats, and finding ways to make every video perform better than the last, you'll thrive in this role.

What You'll Do

Develop & Execute TikTok Content Strategies

• Develop and manage TikTok content strategies aligned with brand objectives, target audiences, and growth goals.

• Create and maintain content calendars, publishing schedules, and campaign plans.

• Research trending formats, sounds, hashtags, creators, and emerging content opportunities.

• Develop creative concepts, content series, and video ideas tailored to each brand's identity.

• Identify opportunities to improve organic reach, audience engagement, and follower growth.

Manage Content Production

• Work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, Copywriters, and Creative Strategists to produce engaging TikTok videos.

• Prepare creative briefs, scripts, references, and production guidelines.

• Coordinate content production to ensure videos are delivered on schedule.

• Review videos before publishing to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines.

• Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve content quality and performance.

Oversee Publishing & Account Management

• Manage daily TikTok publishing activities across assigned brand accounts.

• Write engaging captions, select relevant hashtags, and optimize posts for discoverability.

• Ensure content is published consistently and according to the content calendar.

• Monitor comments, audience interactions, and emerging conversations to identify engagement opportunities.

• Maintain a consistent brand voice across all published content.

Analyze Content Performance

• Monitor key performance metrics, including views, watch time, retention, engagement rate, follower growth, and conversions.

• Identify top-performing content and develop strategies to replicate successful formats.

• Analyze underperforming videos and recommend improvements to hooks, pacing, storytelling, and creative execution.

• Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key insights, trends, and opportunities.

• Use performance data to continuously refine content strategies and improve results.

Stay Ahead of TikTok Trends

• Monitor TikTok trends, algorithm updates, platform features, and changes in audience behavior.

• Research competitors and successful creators to identify emerging content strategies.

• Experiment with new formats, storytelling techniques, and creative approaches.

• Identify trends early and translate them into relevant content opportunities for our brands.

Who You Are

Experienced TikTok Content Professional

• 1-3 years of experience in TikTok content management, social media management, content strategy, or digital marketing.

• Proven experience managing TikTok accounts and developing content that generates meaningful engagement and audience growth.

• Experience working with DTC, eCommerce, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands is highly preferred.

• A portfolio or examples of TikTok accounts you've managed and their performance results are required.

Strong Creative Instincts

• Deep understanding of TikTok culture, trends, algorithms, and content formats.

• Strong ability to identify engaging hooks, compelling storytelling techniques, and creative concepts.

• Comfortable developing ideas for both organic content and performance-driven advertising.

• Familiarity with TikTok Shop, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing is a plus.

Data-Driven & Results-Oriented

• Experience using TikTok Analytics and social media management platforms.

• Strong understanding of content performance metrics and how to translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Comfortable testing different creative approaches and making decisions based on performance data.

Organized & Collaborative

• Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, content calendars, and production deadlines.

• Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with creators, editors, and cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable providing creative feedback and managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Creative, Resourceful & Adaptable

• You're constantly exploring new ideas and finding opportunities to improve content performance.

• You enjoy experimenting with new formats and aren't afraid to challenge conventional creative approaches.

• You anticipate production needs, take ownership of projects, and find solutions when priorities change.

• You bring fresh ideas and energy to every project and enjoy working with a team that's always looking to raise the bar.

Perks & Benefits

Work with Leading Brands: Develop TikTok strategies and content for exciting lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, and DTC brands.

Creative Ownership: Take an active role in shaping content strategies, developing original concepts, and experimenting with new creative formats.

Career Growth: Expand your expertise in social media strategy, creative production, influencer marketing, and performance advertising, with opportunities to advance into senior content and creative leadership roles.

Collaborative Creative Environment: Work alongside talented Content Creators, Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and marketing professionals.

A Culture of Innovation: Join a team that moves quickly, embraces experimentation, and values people who bring fresh ideas and turn them into results.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe exceptional creative work comes from different perspectives, experiences, and ideas. If you're passionate about TikTok, excited by creative experimentation, and motivated by building content that delivers measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

Buscamos una persona que combine creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance : alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que piense la creatividad de principio a fin , desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

Qué harás

• Desarrollar conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación para campañas de paid ads.

• Escribir guiones y briefs creativos claros para producción y edición.

• Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.

• Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.

• Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.

• Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.

• Participar en la creación de contenido tanto short-form como long-form , siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.

• 2+ años de experiencia creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.

• Experiencia trabajando con marcas de e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo .

• Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.

• Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.

Te esperamos!

postings.title: Social Media Manager - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.
As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

THE ROLE You'll be one of the people who makes a brand's social presence happen, day in, day out. From content ideation, trend tracking and scheduling to community engagement, copy writing, and performance tracking, you'll manage the daily rhythm of social channels and ensure the brand shows up consistently and compellingly across platforms.
This is a role for someone who is organised, culturally-fluent, and genuinely enthusiastic about social media as a discipline. You understand what makes content work on TikTok versus Instagram versus YouTube, you can write copy that fits the tone of each platform, and you notice when something is trending before it peaks. We're looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a content calendar and pulling a performance report as they are drafting a reactive post or briefing a content creator on an emerging format.
Success means channels that run smoothly, content that consistently meets brand and platform standards, a community that feels listened to and engaged, and performance data that shows steady growth in reach, engagement, and brand affinity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Content Planning and Publishing
• Create and manage social content calendars across TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms, ensuring a consistent cadence of planned, campaign, and reactive content.

• Schedule and publish content across platforms, ensuring every post meets brand guidelines, platform specifications, and accessibility standards (captions, alt text, format requirements).

• Write and adapt social copy for each platform, ensuring tone of voice is consistent, compelling, and native to the channel.

• Coordinate with the creative team and content creators to ensure assets are delivered on time, correctly formatted, and ready to publish.

• Support the Senior Social Media Manager in planning always-on content, campaign activations, and seasonal or product-launch moments.

Community Management and Engagement
• Monitor social channels daily, responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, on-brand, and thoughtful manner.

• Engage proactively with audiences, fostering a sense of community and connection that reflects values of inclusivity and authenticity.

• Track trending topics, hashtags, cultural moments, and platform features, flagging relevant opportunities to the wider team and, where appropriate, drafting reactive content.

• Identify opportunities to surprise and delight audiences through creative engagement, timely responses, and community-building moments.

Performance Tracking and Reporting
• Track and report on social content performance across platforms, compiling regular reports on key metrics including reach, engagement, saves, shares, and audience growth.

• Use native platform analytics and social management tools to monitor content effectiveness, identify trends, and flag insights that can inform future content decisions.

• Support the Senior Social Media Manager and Data Analyst in building a continuous learning loop between content output and performance data.

Collaboration and Coordination
• Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to ensure social assets align with the content calendar and campaign objectives.

• Support the coordination of influencer and creator content within the publishing schedule, ensuring assets are approved, scheduled, and tracked.

• Work closely with the brand team on day-to-day social activity, keeping stakeholders informed of what's publishing, what's performing, and what's coming next.

• Support briefing processes, helping to translate client briefs and campaign objectives into clear direction for the creative team.

Platform Expertise and Trends
• Stay current with social platform updates, algorithm changes, new features, and emerging content formats, sharing relevant developments with the team.

• Contribute ideas for new content formats, series, and engagement approaches based on platform evolution and audience behaviour.

• Ensure the studio's content approach reflects the latest platform best practices for organic reach and engagement.

WHAT YOU BRING
• 3–5 years of experience in social media management for consumer brands, ideally in beauty, personal care, wellness, or FMCG.

• Strong platform fluency across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging social channels, including an understanding of content formats, algorithms, audience behaviours, and publishing best practices.

• Experience managing social content calendars and publishing workflows across multiple platforms.

• Solid copywriting skills, with the ability to write platform-native social copy that reflects a brand's tone of voice and connects with diverse audiences.

• Experience with community management, including responding to comments and messages, engaging with audiences, and maintaining a consistent, on-brand presence.

• Familiarity with social media management tools (such as Sprinklr, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or similar) and native platform analytics.

• The ability to track and report on social performance metrics, with a good understanding of what the numbers mean and how they inform content decisions.

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing deadlines, and day-to-day publishing demands without losing attention to detail.

• A genuine interest in social culture, digital trends, and the evolving beauty and personal care landscape.

• A collaborative, proactive working style, with the confidence to flag opportunities, raise issues, and contribute ideas.

• Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.

Gen AI and Agentic Thinking
• Basic proficiency with Gen AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copy.ai, Grammarly) to support copy drafting, content ideation, trend research, and reporting.

• An agentic approach to your work: ability to self-organise, manage priorities, find efficient solutions, and take initiative across a busy, multi-platform workload.

• Willingness to experiment with AI tools as part of the social workflow, understanding when they add value and when human creativity, cultural nuance, and community instinct are needed.

• Understanding of AI limitations, with an eye for outputs that feel authentic and on-brand versus generic.

Qualifications: Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning.
NICE TO HAVE
• Experience in an in-house agency, embedded studio, or social-specialist environment.

• An editorial background or experience writing long-form and short-form content for social.

• Experience working with influencer or creator content within a publishing workflow.

• Familiarity with social listening tools and basic audience research.

• Experience with accessibility in social publishing (captions, alt text, inclusive content practices).

• An interest in or experience with brand purpose, inclusivity, or social impact in a marketing context.

• Familiarity with paid social amplification and how organic and paid content work together.

Our values shape everything we do:
Be  Ambitious  to succeed 
Be  Imaginative  to push the boundaries of what’s possible 
Be  Inspirational  to do groundbreaking work 
Be  always learning and listening to understand 
Be  Results-focused  to exceed expectations 
Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations 

OLIVER, a part of the Brandtech Group, is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive working environment where all employees are encouraged to reach their full potential, and individual differences are valued and respected. All applicants shall be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodivergence, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws. 
 OLIVER has set ambitious environmental goals around sustainability, with science-based emissions reduction targets. Collectively, we work towards our mission, embedding sustainability into every department and through every stage of the project lifecycle.

postings.title: Graphic Design Production Artist
postings.descriptionText:
Description

You sweat the small stuff because you know that great design is in the details.

You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful deliverables. You would also be responsible for troubleshooting problems that may arise with a piece and coming up with creative solutions to make sure things happen the way they’re supposed to. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Production Artist role with BoldSky .

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and is proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Production Artist: You assist teams in the production of graphic material, packaging, display, and advertising projects, and more. You collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, and other Graphic Designers to format artwork, ensure print quality standards are met, and often collect, process, and organize files.

Responsibilities:

• Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces, and is proficient at adhering to brand standards.

• Report to the Discipline Lead for project assignments; collaborate with creative teams for implementation and direction.

• Layout files, make prescribed edits, and prepare print files per vendor specifications.

• Must also be capable of developing scientific figure redraws (converting raw data into vector charts and graphs) for medical communication materials using adobe illustrator.

• Work closely with account, creative, and creative services departments as part of an integrated team.

• Adhere to agency vision and uphold client style guidelines.

• Traditional studio support including mock-ups and presentation materials.

• Deliver quality work on time and within budget.

• Create production-ready files for print and digital, including edits to existing layouts.

• Prepare mechanical print files according to vendor specs and brand style guides.

• Coordinate with project managers on schedule and hours.

• Maintain server structure and guide others on file organization.

• Support onboarding for studio process and file structure.

• Manage brand assets, logos, and workflow within the brand.

• Champion BoldSky workflow and contribute to process improvements.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.

• 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.

• Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).

• Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.

• Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.

• Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.

• Experience with Sketch and/or Figma a plus.

• Experience with PowerPoint, animation, digital/video a plus.

• Experience working in DAM systems a plus.

Should also be:

• Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can translate creative objectives into effective execution and communicate workload needs clearly.

• Industry Application: Quick learner with strong functional and technical knowledge of both the client’s and agency’s businesses.

• Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Shows initiative and consistently offers new ideas, owning the brand from a visual standpoint.

• Willingness to be Flexible: Open to stepping outside the formal job description to support the team and deliver high-quality work.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Boldsky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Video Editor who is hungry to learn, fast on the keys, and ready to grow into a top-tier performance editor.

Why This Role Matters

Speed, precision, and growth are your playground. As a Junior Video Editor, you are the engine room of our post-production team. You’ll support Senior Editors by assembling footage, handling high-volume versioning, and applying the finishing touches that make our ads pop.

This isn’t just about cutting clips; it’s about mastering the art of performance marketing. You will learn the science behind "the hook," the rhythm of a winning ad, and the technical workflows of a world-class agency. If you are eager to learn from the best and accelerate your career, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

• Support High-Volume Editing

• Assist Senior Editors by assembling rough cuts, organizing raw footage, and pulling selects for high-performance ad campaigns.

• Execute fast-paced edits for social media (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), focusing on pacing, music syncing, and basic transitions.

• Handle Versioning & Resizing

• Take approved "hero" edits and adapt them for various platforms and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 16:9) ensuring no visual quality is lost.

• Create multiple variations of ads (changing hooks, swapping music, updating CTAs) to support our aggressive A/B testing strategy.

• Manage Assets & Organization

• Maintain a pristine digital workspace. ensuring all project files, assets, and exports are named and organized according to High Scale’s strict workflows.

• Perform Quality Control (QC) on your own work to ensure zero technical errors before final delivery.

• Learn & Level Up

• Absorb feedback from Art Directors and Senior Editors to refine your technical skills and storytelling ability.

• Stay current with social media trends to understand what editing styles are trending on TikTok and Instagram.

Who You Are

• A Rising Talent

• 1–3 years of experience in video editing (freelance or agency). You have a portfolio that shows potential, rhythm, and a good eye for composition.

• You are passionate about social media content and understand the language of the internet.

• Technically Proficient

• You know Adobe Premiere Pro inside and out. You are comfortable with keyboard shortcuts and efficient workflows.

• Basic knowledge of After Effects (for simple motion graphics) and color correction is a major plus.

• Fast & Detail-Oriented

• You can work quickly without sacrificing quality. You double-check your export settings and catch small mistakes before anyone else does.

• You are organized and follow instructions precisely.

• Eager to Learn

• You check your ego at the door. You view feedback as an opportunity to get better, not a criticism.

• You want to build a career in performance marketing and commercial editing.

• Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You can communicate clearly with a global remote team via Slack and Zoom.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: We promote from within. Master this role, and the path to Video Editor and Senior Editor is open to you.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one breakthrough campaign at a time.

postings.title: Community & Events Associate
postings.descriptionText:
• PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote / Telecommute

Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Industry: Community / Membership / Professional Networks

Salary Range: ~$2,000–$2,500 USD per month

Schedule: Monday–Friday, typically 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET or CT

English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English required

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing professional community and membership organization serving thousands of accomplished entrepreneurs and founders who have successfully built and exited companies.

The organization creates meaningful connections and high-quality experiences through local chapters, curated groups, forums, events, workshops, and real-time community interaction.

The team operates with a high level of ownership, moves quickly, works remotely across time zones, and integrates AI deeply into day-to-day operations.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and relationship-oriented Community & Events Associate to help shape the day-to-day experience of a large and highly engaged founder community.

This role sits at the intersection of community management, content, communications, events, and program coordination .

You will own the content calendar, help determine what communications members receive and when, coordinate events and workshops from beginning to end, stay closely connected to conversations happening across the community, and help identify the topics, people, and opportunities that matter most.

This is a writing-heavy and execution-oriented role for someone who combines excellent communication skills with attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity, and a genuine interest in people.

Why This Opportunity?

You'll have the opportunity to work closely with a community of thousands of experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders while having a meaningful impact on their member experience.

You'll also join a small, fast-moving remote team where:

• You can take meaningful ownership early

• Your ideas and observations can directly influence programs and communications

• AI is actively used to make work faster and more effective

• You can see the measurable impact of the campaigns, events, and initiatives you manage

• There is significant room to grow based on your strengths and interests

What You'll Do

Content & Communications

• Own and maintain the community content and communications calendar, determining what goes out, when, and why

• Write, edit, and refine communications sent to members while maintaining a clear, natural, and consistent brand voice

• Build, test, and send email campaigns

• Select and manage appropriate audience segments for different communications

• Review campaigns carefully before launch, including links, formatting, dates, names, and other details

• Track campaign performance and identify what content and messages resonate most strongly with members

• Share insights and recommendations based on engagement and performance data

Events & Programs

• Coordinate virtual and occasional in-person events from planning through execution

• Create and manage registration pages, reminders, logistics, and event-day support

• Promote events to the most relevant members to drive attendance

• Coordinate speakers and workshops, including scheduling, confirmations, logistics, and run-of-show preparation

• Manage program communications including applications, deadlines, participant updates, and waitlists

• Follow up with attendees and participants after events

• Track which events, speakers, and topics perform best and use those insights to improve future programming

Community Engagement

• Stay closely connected to daily conversations happening within the community

• Develop a strong understanding of what members are discussing, asking about, celebrating, and struggling with

• Identify recurring themes, community wins, concerns, and opportunities for meaningful member connections

• Welcome new voices and help encourage thoughtful participation

• Provide first-line community moderation when needed

• Escalate situations requiring additional review or decisions to the appropriate internal team member

• Proactively identify members who may benefit from meeting or connecting with one another

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

You'll focus on understanding the community, its members, communication style, tools, and existing programs.

You'll begin supporting campaigns and events with guidance from the team.

By 60 Days

You'll independently manage much of the weekly communications calendar and take greater ownership of events and program execution.

By 90 Days

You'll have a strong pulse on the community and proactively surface what members need, what topics are gaining traction, and where the organization should focus next.

How We Work

AI-Assisted by Default

AI is an important part of the team's workflow.

You'll use AI tools to help with first drafts, summaries, reporting, research, organization, and repetitive tasks so that more of your time can be spent on judgment, relationships, creativity, and execution.

You should already be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and interested in becoming even better at using them.

Attention to Detail Matters

You'll be communicating with thousands of experienced founders and business leaders.

Small details matter.

You'll be expected to catch incorrect links, formatting issues, outdated dates, inconsistent names, typos, and other mistakes before anything is published or sent.

Async and Remote

The team works remotely across multiple time zones and communicates heavily in writing.

You'll be expected to:

• Share updates proactively

• Flag blockers early

• Manage your time effectively

• Take ownership without waiting for constant direction

Measure and Improve

Your work doesn't stop when a campaign is sent or an event ends.

You'll review what happened, understand what worked, identify what didn't, and help the team improve the next iteration.

Tools You May Use

The organization currently works with tools such as:

• Customer.io or similar email marketing platforms

• Event management platforms such as Luma

• Notion

• Google Workspace

Most Important Things (MITs)

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Fabula to the next level.

What You'll Own

• Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid

• Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research

• Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives

• Full-funnel performance: Analyze and optimize the entire journey from ad advertorial/landing page offer conversion

• Research: Mine customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ads, Meta Ads Library, and other sources for new angles and opportunities

• Creative production: Brief and manage UGC creators, editors, and designers - while remaining hands-on with scripts, hooks, copy, and creative direction

• Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics

• Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend

• Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency

• AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What Success Looks Like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

• Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics

• Improving ROAS and reducing CPA

• Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity

• Finding new winning angles and audiences

• Improving conversion rates across the funnel

• Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system

• Ultimately, taking Fabula to the next level

You are

• 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)

• A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)

• Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing

• Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology

• Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change

• Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing

• Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy

• Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers

• An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale

• Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding

• AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution

• Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

• Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands

• Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels

• Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads

• Experience with Outbrain or Taboola

• Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar

• Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

Important: Who this role is NOT for

This is not a fit if:

• You've managed less than $200K/month in ad spend

• Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing

• You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying

• You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy

• You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments

• You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

• Fully remote

• Full-time

• Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)

• Direct collaboration with the founders

• Significant ownership and autonomy

• Possible equity upside for strong performance

• Testing subject lines, send times, content, and offers to continually improve engagement and revenue performance.

• Ensuring messaging and offers stay aligned with paid media campaigns for one consistent, full funnel customer experience.

• Approximately 8 to 10 years of overall marketing and advertising experience, including a minimum of 5 years of direct, hands on ecommerce experience.

• Direct, hands on experience managing a Meta Ads account with an annual budget of $1,000,000 or more, spend that you personally planned and managed, not aggregated team or agency level spend.

• Google Ads experience in addition to Meta.

• Demonstrated ownership of full funnel performance, from prospecting through conversion and retention, with a strong command of attribution, reporting, and ongoing optimization.

• Experience assessing and improving attribution accuracy, ideally including work reconciling platform reported data, attribution tools, and actual sales results.

• Direct experience with Triple Whale, Northbeam, or a similar full funnel attribution and analytics platform.

• Required, hands on experience owning email and SMS marketing in Klaviyo, including flow building, segmentation, and campaign execution. This is a required platform for the role.

• Proven experience managing full funnel marketing for an ecommerce brand, ideally one with both online and physical retail sales, and working knowledge of blending in store and online data into a single view of performance.

• Comfort using Canva to produce or direct creative assets.

• Comfort using Shopify or a comparable ecommerce platform.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to pull, interpret, and present cross platform performance data.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present results directly to client stakeholders.

• Experience with high AOV and third-party attribution tracking (e.g., Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros) is required.

• Experience with spend above 100K USD per month via paid acquisition channels, Blended, Meta, Google, is required.

• Bonus: experience in luxury, jewelry, or another high consideration retail category.

💼 What We Offer

• 💸 Competitive base compensation + significant performance-based pay.

• 🌴 15 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. national holidays.

• 💻 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.

• 📈 A high visibility, full funnel role where your strategy and execution directly shape how a growing ecommerce and retail brand spends its marketing budget.

If you are ready to own a full funnel growth engine, from paid media through lifecycle marketing, and prove your impact in real revenue, apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short two minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first opportunity to show us your thinking and what makes you the right person for this role. We can't wait to meet you!

postings.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

• Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month

• Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working

• Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people

• Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing

• Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target

• Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule

• Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery

• Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why

• Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team

• Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

You are a fit if

• You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search

• You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have

• You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it

• You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list

• You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard

• You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you

• Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too

You are not a fit if

• "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed

• You want to be told what to do this week

• You need a ticketing system to know what matters

• You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Omunix International | Argentina – 100% Remoto

Modalidad: 100% Remoto
Horario: 10:00 – 18:00 (hora de España)
Ubicación: Argentina

🚀 Sobre Omunix International
En Omunix International conectamos talento especializado con empresas y proyectos internacionales de Europa, América y otros mercados.

Buscamos incorporar un/a Junior Digital Marketing Specialist para formar parte de un entorno internacional, dinámico y orientado a resultados, trabajando con cuentas y campañas de performance.

🎯 Sobre el puesto
Buscamos un/a Junior Digital Marketing Specialist con buena formación en marketing digital, perfil analítico y ganas de desarrollarse profesionalmente en performance marketing.

La persona seleccionada participará en la gestión de campañas de Google Ads y Meta Ads, analizará datos, colaborará en la propuesta de estrategias de optimización y trabajará junto a equipos creativos y comerciales para conseguir resultados medibles.

Además, valoramos especialmente el interés por utilizar IA y herramientas de automatización para mejorar procesos, análisis y rendimiento.

💻 Tus principales responsabilidades
• Apoyar en la creación, gestión y optimización de campañas en Google Ads y Meta Ads.
• Analizar resultados y detectar oportunidades de mejora en campañas, audiencias, creatividades, funnels y conversiones.
• Monitorizar KPIs como CPC, CPA, CTR, ROAS, conversiones, leads y ventas.
• Elaborar informes y dashboards utilizando Excel, Google Sheets y Looker Studio.
• Trabajar conjuntamente con los equipos creativos y comerciales para alinear campañas, mensajes y landing pages.
• Utilizar herramientas como ChatGPT y Gemini para generación y optimización de copies, análisis de datos y automatización de tareas.
• Proponer nuevas ideas y acciones para mejorar el rendimiento de las campañas.
• Preparar informes periódicos con conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?
Buscamos un/a Junior Digital Marketing Specialist con buena formación en marketing digital, perfil analítico y ganas de desarrollarse profesionalmente en performance marketing.

Requisitos:
• Grado universitario relacionado con Marketing, ADE, Publicidad, Comunicación o similar.
• Máster o posgrado en Marketing Digital, finalizado o próximo a finalizar.
• Conocimientos de Google Ads y Meta Ads, adquiridos mediante formación, prácticas o primera experiencia profesional.
• Entre 0 y 2 años de experiencia.
• Buen manejo de Excel y Google Sheets.
• Inglés mínimo B2.
• Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
• Interés por IA, automatización y nuevas herramientas de marketing digital.
• Disponibilidad en horario laboral de España, de 10:00 a 18:00 (entre las 5:00 y las 6:00 a. m. hora de Argentina, según horario de verano/invierno en España).

✨ Se valorará especialmente
• Prácticas o experiencia previa en una agencia de marketing digital.
• Certificaciones de Google Ads, Google Analytics o Meta.
• Conocimientos de GA4, Looker Studio, SEO, CRO, afiliación o automatización.
• Idiomas adicionales.
• Buena capacidad de comunicación y facilidad para trabajar en equipo y, progresivamente, con clientes.

🌎 ¿Qué ofrecemos?
• 100% Remote.
• Horario laboral alineado con España (10:00 – 18:00).
• Entorno profesional y dinámico.
• Proyectos de performance marketing con objetivos y métricas claras.
• Posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
• Exposición a diferentes sectores, mercados y estrategias digitales.
• Trabajo con herramientas actuales de marketing, datos, IA y automatización.

📩 ¿Te interesa?
Si tienes formación en marketing digital, conocimientos de Google Ads y Meta Ads y quieres desarrollarte en un entorno internacional de performance marketing, queremos conocerte.

Envíanos tu CV y, si es posible, incluye una breve descripción de:
• Tu formación (grado, máster o posgrado).
• Prácticas o experiencia previa en marketing digital.
• Certificaciones obtenidas.
• Herramientas que manejas.
• Proyectos o campañas en los que hayas participado, si los hay.
Hay portales como LinkedIn o Computrabajo que muestran mal los emojis. Si en el tuyo se ven raros, puedes borrarlos sin que el texto pierda sentido.

postings.title: Senior PPC Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: Operations Manager · Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm CST

About us
Plumber Marketing USA is a digital marketing agency built specifically for plumbers, HVAC contractors, and electricians across the United States. We don't do generalist marketing. We go deep on home services, and our clients see it in their results. Our team is remote, high-performing, and built on a culture of ownership and excellence.

About the role
This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the paid search strategist for a portfolio of approximately 20 home services clients, each spending around $8,000 per month in ads. You report to the Operations Manager and work alongside web designers and account managers, but you own the paid media strategy.

We're not looking for someone to follow a playbook. We want someone who has their own and knows when to adjust it.

Core responsibilities

• Own Google Ads strategy for approximately 20 active clients across Search, Display, and Performance Max

• Manage and optimize Local Services Ads (LSA / Google Guaranteed) for home services clients

• Build, test, and improve landing pages in GoHighLevel, including ground-up builds using AI tools

• Manage budgets, bids, and campaign structure to consistently lower CPAs and improve ROAS

• Build and maintain negative keyword lists, audience segments, and targeting logic

• Set up and maintain conversion tracking and attribution in GA4 and Google Tag Manager

• Build performance dashboards in Looker Studio

• Handle bulk campaign changes efficiently in Google Ads Editor

• Join client calls 1 to 2 times per month to walk through strategy and results

• Spot opportunities and act on them without waiting to be asked

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads management with real strategic ownership

• Experience in home services PPC, plumbing, HVAC, or electrical strongly preferred

• Google Ads certified (Search and Display minimum)

• Solid working knowledge of GA4, Google Ads Editor, Looker Studio, and Google Sheets

• Experience building and improving landing pages (GoHighLevel a strong plus)

• Comfortable using AI tools for content, page builds, and day-to-day efficiency

• Strong spoken and written English, client calls are part of this role

• Available and focused 8am to 5pm CST, Monday through Friday

Preferred qualifications

• Bing Ads / Microsoft Advertising experience

• Meta Ads experience (Google is the priority, Meta is a bonus)

• Experience managing Local Services Ads from setup through ongoing optimization

• Familiarity with home services seasonality, call tracking, and lead generation funnels

Who will thrive here
Our best people take ownership without being told to, hold themselves to a higher standard than anyone asks of them, and treat client results like they're personally on the line. They adjust when things change, speak up before problems grow, and never confuse being busy with getting results.

If you need close supervision, a narrow workload, or you measure your day by tasks checked off rather than outcomes, this role will frustrate you, and that's okay. We'd rather be straight with you upfront.

Compensation and benefits

• $4,500 to $6,500/month USD, paid in USD, based on experience

• Paid US holidays and vacation

• Performance bonuses

• Room to grow, we promote from within

• Fully remote, work from home

•

How to apply
Send your resume and 2 to 3 campaign examples.
For each one, tell us the industry, how much you were spending per month, what your strategy was, and what the results looked like.
We read every application, but we only move forward with people who show their work.

postings.title: Senior Growth Marketer (SEO, AI Search, Lifecycle & Social)
postings.descriptionText:
INCORE is hiring a Senior Growth Marketer (SEO, AI Search, Lifecycle & Social) : a strategic, analytical marketer who also ships the work.

We're a boutique digital agency serving U.S. clients across healthcare, education, manufacturing, and more. Clients rely on us to grow their online presence through strategy, design, development, automation, and digital marketing. You'll shape INCORE's marketing direction and lead client growth across classic search, AI search, lifecycle, and social.

Initially, you'll be a one-person powerhouse: shaping frameworks, executing campaigns, building lifecycle journeys, running social, and setting up analytics. As the role grows, you'll build and lead a small team.

🧭 How this role is scoped

You own marketing and client growth end to end. You're hands-on with SEO and AI search, positioning, analytics, lifecycle in Customer.io, and social. At the start you run social yourself for INCORE and the first client accounts, using AI and scheduling tools to keep it efficient, and hand off execution as volume grows. For heavy server-side tracking builds you direct a specialist. We hire for ownership and judgment, then add hands under you.

🥸 Requirements

• 5+ years in SEO, digital marketing, or web growth strategy (agency or B2B preferred).

• Deep understanding of technical and content SEO, site architecture, and conversion optimization.

• Hands-on growth experience in lead gen and e-commerce: funnel design, lead qualification, CRM handoff, e-commerce tracking (AOV, LTV, ROAS).

• Lifecycle marketing, hands-on in Customer.io (or Klaviyo, Braze, HubSpot with fast ramp into Customer.io). Core to the role: you design the strategy (onboarding, nurture, re-engagement, win-back, post-purchase, review/referral) and build it yourself: segments, event-triggered journeys, branching, Liquid personalization, transactional messages, A/B tests, webhooks/API.

• Strong working knowledge of AI search visibility across AEO (being the extracted answer in AI Overviews, snippets, voice), GEO (being cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Copilot, Grok), and AIO (the entity, reputation, and trust signals that make AI systems recommend a brand). You can explain how each differs from classic SEO and what moves them.

• Social media, strategy and execution , across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube: platform selection by ICP, content pillars, short-form video, social search optimization, and reporting tied to business outcomes. You're comfortable running this yourself at the start (planning, producing, scheduling, posting), using AI for drafting and repurposing and a scheduling tool to keep it efficient, and handing it off as volume grows.

• Strong positioning and messaging fluency: defining ICPs, articulating differentiation, shaping messaging for website copy, landing pages, and campaigns.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end tracking pipelines: consent layer → client-side GTM → server-side GTM → GA4, ad platforms, CDPs. You specify, QA, and maintain the architecture and are hands-on in GTM/GA4; heavy server-side implementation can go to a specialist under your direction.

• Experience with CMPs (OneTrust, Usercentrics, Cookiebot) and Google Consent Mode v2 for GDPR and CCPA/CPRA compliance.

• Working knowledge of PPC principles and metrics (oversight, not daily management).

• Near-native English fluency : confident communicator comfortable pitching, presenting, and leading client meetings.

Hands-on experience with:

• SEO : SEMrush or Ahrefs (incl. AI visibility modules), Search Console, Screaming Frog / Sitebulb.

• Analytics : GA4, GTM (web + server-side), Looker Studio.

• Lifecycle : Customer.io (journeys, segments, data pipelines, transactional).

• Social : a scheduling and analytics tool.

• AI tools : Fluent daily use of Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini for research, briefs, drafting, editing, synthesizing analytics, and QAing AI output. You know where AI accelerates work, where human judgment is non-negotiable, and how to build voice guides and reusable Projects/Custom GPTs so output reflects the brand.

✨ Nice-to-Haves

• Hands-on server-side GTM implementation (Stape, self-hosted, or similar).

• Email deliverability (domain warm-up, DMARC/DKIM/SPF, list hygiene).

• Paid social or creator partnerships.

⛑️ Responsibilities

INCORE Marketing Ownership

• Lead INCORE's marketing direction: SEO, AI search, lifecycle, social, conversion, content, and reporting.

• Oversee content, landing pages, case studies, and lifecycle flows in Customer.io.

• Define and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.

• Use AI tools to accelerate content, briefs, and analysis, with voice guides and QA loops that keep output credible.

Positioning & Messaging

• Own INCORE's positioning: who we serve, what problems we solve, what makes us different.

• Translate positioning into site hierarchy, service pages, case studies, and sales decks.

• Lead positioning engagements for clients: define ICPs, surface differentiators, build messaging frameworks.

Client Strategy & Growth

• Benchmark client performance, identify growth gaps, define roadmaps for traffic, leads, and ROI.

• Tailor strategy to each business model: lead-gen funnels for service clients; product feeds, lifecycle flows, and AOV/LTV optimization for e-commerce.

• Present insights, recommendations, and growth roadmaps to clients.

Lifecycle Marketing & Customer.io

• Own lifecycle strategy for INCORE and clients: map the journey per business model, decide which moments get a message and through which channel, and bring the ideas yourself.

• Build and run it in Customer.io: event tracking and data schema, segments, journeys, campaigns, transactional messaging, personalization, testing.

• Report per-flow revenue and conversion alongside search and social, and keep improving flows.

AI Search Visibility

• Own AI search strategy across AEO, GEO, and AIO alongside classic SEO, so clients are cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Copilot, and Grok.

• Build entity and authority signals: structured data, consistent brand facts, presence on sources LLMs cite (directories, review platforms, Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, press).

• Track share of answer, citations, and sentiment monthly and report it next to rankings.

Social Media & Distribution

• Own INCORE's social strategy and calendar, LinkedIn first.

• Lead social strategy for clients: platform priorities, content pillars, short-form video, social search optimization.

• Execute hands-on at the start: plan, produce, schedule, post, and respond for INCORE and the first client accounts, using AI for drafting and repurposing and a scheduling tool to batch the work.

• Build the repeatable system (calendar templates, voice guides, approval flow) so execution can be handed to a coordinator as accounts grow.

• Treat social as an AI visibility channel and report it with business metrics.

Tracking, Analytics & Privacy

• Own tracking and conversion architecture across client sites: consent layer, tagging, server-side, reporting. Specify, QA, maintain; direct a specialist for heavy server-side builds.

• Maintain CMP and Google Consent Mode v2 configurations across jurisdictions.

Revenue Operations & Leadership

• Develop standardized scopes, pricing, and retainers for marketing services.

• Drive quarterly plans and KPIs for internal and client growth.

• Direct contractors and, as revenue grows, hire and mentor a small team.

📚 Description

• Environment : Remote-first and pragmatic. You'll work with designers, developers, and PPC specialists while owning client communication and frequently leading client calls.

• Tooling : SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, GTM (web + server-side), Looker Studio, Customer.io, a social scheduling tool, ClickUp, Google Workspace, Slack, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini).

• Schedule : Business hours are 8 AM – 5 PM Eastern Time (UTC-5/-4), with core collaboration hours 8 AM – 3 PM ET. You must be reliably available during core hours (including a daily 8 AM ET standup); outside of those, your schedule is flexible.

🏆 Success looks like:

• Client redesigns launch with strong positioning, SEO, analytics, and conversion frameworks.

• Tracking, consent, and attribution are correct across every client. No data gaps, no compliance risks.

• Every client with a lifecycle need has journeys running in Customer.io that are measured and improved.

• Clients show up in classic SERPs and AI answers alike, with measurable presence in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

• INCORE and clients have a consistent, active social presence, produced efficiently with AI, and reported alongside search.

• You transition from individual execution to managing structured marketing operations.

✨ To do well here, you:

• Thrive in both strategy and execution: you plan, build, and improve.

• Stay current with SEO, AI search, lifecycle, social, analytics, and privacy trends.

• Are proactive, accountable, and communicate simply and directly.

• Get the most out of AI tools: neither afraid of AI nor blindly reliant on it.

⛔️ Do not apply unless you meet ALL 3 criteria below:

INCORE is a fully remote team, but to apply, you must:

• Have near-native English fluency in speaking and writing ("rusty" is not acceptable).

• Be located within a 6-hour time window of the Eastern Time zone (UTC-5/-4).

• Be reliably available during core collaboration hours (8 AM – 3 PM ET), within our overall 8 AM – 5 PM ET business hours. Flexibility outside core hours is fine.
