postings.title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager - Shopify DTC
postings.descriptionText:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

• Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round

• Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day

• Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts

• Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

• Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)

• Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)

• Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped

• AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)

• No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

• Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first

• Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells

• Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners

• Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor

• Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix

• Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house

• Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

• Fully remote, full-time

• Fluent in English

• CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must

• Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up

• Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages

• Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help

• Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency

• Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule

• Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin

• No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work

• Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

• Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder

• Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

• CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next

• Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV

• Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week

• Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day

• CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house

• CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

• Application + Screening

• Test Project

• Technical Interview

• Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

postings.title: Junior Paid Social Marketing Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Junior Paid Social Marketing Specialist
Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Remote

About the Role
Our client is a US-based consumer brand operating in the retail and e-commerce space. The company sells its products through major retail and e-commerce channels, including Amazon, Walmart, Target, and large supermarket chains.

With a strong focus on performance-driven growth, the company invests heavily in digital advertising and works across multiple paid media platforms to drive customer acquisition, sales, and brand growth.

They are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Paid Social Marketing Specialist to support campaign execution, performance tracking, creative testing, and reporting across multiple advertising platforms.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing significant advertising budgets, analyzing campaign performance, and maintaining accurate campaign setups and reporting. Experience working with consumer brands and retail or e-commerce businesses is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

• Set up, launch, and manage advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and AppLovin.

• Upload and organize creative assets, ad copy, and targeting structures.

• Perform quality assurance checks to ensure campaigns are launched accurately and meet platform and brand standards.

• Translate agency-provided scripts and briefs into organized ClickUp tasks for video editors and landing page designers.

• Track creative production tasks, deadlines, completion status, and turnaround times.

• Assist with weekly performance dashboards using data from Meta Ads Manager and landing page tools.

• Maintain tracking spreadsheets for ad spend, campaign results, creative performance, and testing priorities.

• Conduct bi-weekly creative and funnel audits to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Summarize findings and flag potential optimizations across ads, landing pages, and audience segments.

• Collaborate with media buyers, copywriters, and editors to ensure timely campaign execution.

• Maintain internal documentation, update SOPs, and follow up on assigned tasks.

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in paid social advertising, particularly with Meta Ads Manager, or a related digital marketing role.

• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and paid social campaign structures.

• Proficiency in Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools.

• Experience with ClickUp or other project management platforms.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to follow checklists, SOPs, and established workflows with minimal supervision.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage repetitive operational tasks, meet tight deadlines, and prioritize effectively.

• Reliable internet connection and experience working remotely.

• Based in Latin America and available to work 8 AM–5 PM EST .

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and eager to grow in performance marketing. They enjoy working with data, creative assets, and campaign operations, and can consistently execute tasks accurately while keeping projects organized and on schedule.

Type: Full-Time

postings.title: Digital Marketing Account Manager ($1800 - $2500)
postings.descriptionText:
Application Instructions
To apply, please submit:

• Your resume

• A short video (3–4 minutes) answering the following question:

"A client says: 'My leads dropped this month and I don't think SEO is working.' Walk us through exactly how you'd diagnose it across their SEO and paid campaigns — and what you'd tell them on the call."
We ask this question because strong account managers must be able to lead a client through a real problem, not just reassure them.

Applications without the video will not be considered.

Overview

We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency focused on helping home service businesses generate leads through SEO and paid advertising.

We are looking for an Account Manager who is a strategic marketing leader — someone who is familiar with marketing strategy across SEO, Google Ads, and Facebook Ads, interpret performance, and lead the business owner toward the decisions that grow their company.

This is not a customer support or relationship-only role. You are the client's primary marketing strategist. Our clients expect their account manager to set the direction, explain the "why," diagnose problems before they do, and lead the plan forward. If you are not providing strategic leadership to the client, no one is — so the bar for marketing competence and leadership is high.

You will manage a portfolio of approximately 30 clients and direct our internal marketing and delivery teams on what each client needs to win.

What You'll Own

Own the Strategy and the Results
You are the strategic owner for your client portfolio — not just the point of contact.

• Lead monthly strategy calls (some accounts meet weekly) where you set the agenda and direct the plan

• Own each client's results across SEO, Google Ads, and Facebook Ads

• Explain performance and translate it into clear next steps for the business owner

Clients should see you as their marketing leader, not simply their contact.

Diagnose and Solve Performance Problems
When a client's leads drop, rankings slide, or cost-per-lead rises, you lead the diagnosis and prescribe the fix across every channel — not wait for someone else to.

Direct the Internal Team
Our SEO lead and project managers execute the SEO work and campaigns. You translate each client's strategy into clear priorities for them, monitor deliverables, and own the outcome.

Identify and Lead Growth
Spot when a client is ready to expand and recommend the right next move — more SEO scope, expanded advertising, or new lead-generation initiatives.

Protect Scope and Set Expectations
Ensure clients understand what is included, and push back professionally when requests fall outside the scope of work.

What We're Looking For
Experience

• 4+ years in account management, client success, or digital marketing consulting in an SEO / digital marketing environment

• A track record of leading client marketing strategy (not just managing relationships)

• Experience presenting marketing performance to, and advising, small business owners

Deep Command of Our Services — so you can LEAD strategy
You will not be doing the SEO work or building the ad campaigns — our SEO lead and project managers own execution. Your job is to be very strong on the services we offer and why we do what we do, so you can lead the client's strategy, explain our approach with conviction, and direct the delivery team.

• Local SEO: deeply understand and learn how we rank local businesses and why — Google Business Profile (primary category, services, reviews), review velocity and recency, on-page and service pages, and what actually moves the map pack (category and proximity do most of the work; velocity beats raw review count). Strong enough to lead the strategy and interpret results, not to execute it.

• Paid Media — Google & Facebook/Meta Ads: understand how each channel works and why we use it — high-intent Google Ads vs. demand-generation Facebook, and how to judge cost-per-lead against job value and lead quality — enough to set direction and evaluate performance with the client.

You lead strategy and own results; the SEO lead and project managers execute the work.

Leadership & Communication

• Leading client meetings and setting direction

• Explaining marketing concepts clearly

• Making strategic recommendations and holding them under pressure without getting defensive

• Strong communication and emotional intelligence are essential

Tools We Use

• Google Business Profile

• Google Ads

• Meta Ads Manager (Facebook/Instagram)

• Google Sheets

• GoHighLevel

Helpful but not required: ClickUp, CRM systems, marketing reporting dashboards, meeting transcription tools (such as Fireflies).

postings.title: Head of Growth
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About The Role

You build the growth machine behind Rebill's public presence: campaigns, funnel, press, distribution, and the systems that turn moments into measurable demand.

This seat sits next to our GTM Evangelist motion. They are the figure on stage and on the timeline. You are the operator who designs the programs, amplifies every event, and makes acquisition repeatable across LATAM and the United States.

You are bilingual, close to the ICP (software, AI, travel, digital services collecting across the Americas), and comfortable in payments or fintech GTM. You report to the co-founders and work tightly with sales.

Why this role exists

Rebill's product gap is smaller than its awareness gap. Evangelism alone is not enough: without campaigns, content distribution, press, and a clear funnel, moments die on the stage.

We need a senior growth lead who has run GTM in payments or fintech across the Americas—someone who can stand up the machine while we hire and scale the public face of the brand.

What You Will Own

• Growth programs. Owning acquisition and demand programs that bring mid-market and scaling companies into our funnel—channel mix, messaging tests, and conversion from first touch to sales-ready.

• Campaigns and amplification. Turning events, launches, and evangelist moments into reach: follow-up content, paid and organic distribution, partner co-marketing, and press where it moves the needle.

• Positioning ops. Keeping the one-liner and narrative consistent across site, ads, sales enablement, and social—so evangelism and performance speak the same language.

• Funnel and measurement. Instrumenting what matters: sources, CPL/CPA quality, pipeline contribution, and feedback loops with sales. Opinions without numbers do not ship.

• Ecosystem GTM. Working accelerators, communities, and partners as channels—not just logos—so intros and awareness compound.

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years in growth, GTM, or product marketing, with ownership of programs that produced pipeline—not only vanity metrics.

• Experience in payments, fintech, or B2B infrastructure selling into LATAM and/or cross-border Americas. Competitors and lookalikes (regional PSPs, open finance, billing) should feel familiar.

• Fluent English and Spanish. You write and present in both.

• Comfort with modern growth tooling: analytics, CRM attribution, ads, content distribution, and experimentation.

• A bias to ship: you would rather run a clean experiment this week than wait for a perfect deck.

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami (hybrid), able to travel for events and offsites when needed.

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience partnering with a public evangelist, DevRel, or founder-led content motion.

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at similar stage.

What We Offer

• A senior compensation package matching the seat: competitive base, meaningful equity, and room to grow with impact.

• Direct access to the founders and to sales, with no layers in between.

• Hybrid base in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami.

How We Hire

An intro conversation, a working session on a real growth problem from our funnel, and a conversation with the founders. We will tell you what is still open. We expect the same candour back.

Digital Account Manager

Chili Digital is a performance-driven digital marketing agency operating across Latin America and international markets. We specialize in SEO, Paid Media, CRO, BI, and data-driven growth strategies that maximize ROI and long-term business impact.

We believe Account Management is not a coordination role — it is a leadership role. At Chili, the Digital Account Manager is the owner of the portfolio, the leader of the squad, and the guardian of both client success and internal efficiency.

Why Join Chili Digital?

• Be the most senior decision-maker for your portfolio, with real authority and accountability.

• Lead multidisciplinary squads (SEO, Paid Media, Content, CRO, BI) and shape how work is delivered.

• Work with international clients and complex growth challenges.

• Operate in an AI-first, fast-paced environment where ownership is valued over hierarchy.

• Have direct influence over retention, growth, margins, team performance, and client satisfaction.

About The Role

We are hiring a Digital Account Manager to fully own a portfolio of clients (15 accounts).

This role goes far beyond client communication. You are responsible for everything that impacts the health of your portfolio — revenue, costs, delivery quality, team performance, client satisfaction, and growth opportunities.

You are the escalation point, the strategist, the project owner, and the people leader.

If something goes wrong in the portfolio, it is yours to identify, solve, and prevent from happening again.

This is a high-responsibility role that requires advanced English , emotional intelligence, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to perform under pressure in a fast-moving agency environment.

Core Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership & Growth (Revenue + Retention)

• Own the full performance and health of your client portfolio.

• Be responsible for retention, upsells, cross-sells, and expansion opportunities.

• Identify risks early and proactively act to prevent churn.

• Partner with Sales and Leadership on renewals, scope changes, and growth opportunities.

• Ensure the portfolio grows sustainably, not at the expense of delivery quality or margins.

Client Leadership & Escalation Management

• Act as the single point of accountability for all client communication.

• Lead monthly reviews, strategic calls, quarterly planning, and performance deep dives.

• Manage difficult conversations, expectations, feedback, and escalations confidently.

• Translate business objectives into clear strategies and execution plans.

• Represent Chili as a senior strategic partner, not a vendor.

Squad Leadership & People Management

• Lead and manage your full squad (SEO, PPC, Content, CRO, BI).

• Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, KPI tracking, and development planning.

• Ensure team members understand priorities, standards, and expectations.

• Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, certifications, and coaching plans.

• Participate in hiring decisions and performance-based team changes when needed.

• Drive accountability while maintaining a high-performance, healthy team culture.

Project Management & Delivery Excellence

• Own all timelines, milestones, and quality standards for your portfolio.

• Ensure campaigns and projects are delivered on time, on scope, and at Chili quality level.

• Use ClickUp (or equivalent) to manage workflows, dependencies, and visibility.

• Ensure SOPs are followed and improved when gaps are identified.

• Balance speed and quality in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

Performance & Data-Driven Decision Making

• Understand performance across SEO, Paid Media, CRO, and funnels at a strategic level.

• Use data to guide decisions, prioritisation, and client conversations.

• Ensure reporting is clear, honest, and tied to business outcomes.

• Work closely with BI to improve dashboards, transparency, and insights.

Requirements

• 2+ years in a senior Account Manager, Client Partner, or Client Services role (agency experience required).

• Strong understanding of SEO, Paid Media (Google, Meta), CRO, and funnel strategy.

• Proven experience managing client portfolios with revenue responsibility.

• Demonstrated people leadership experience (1:1s, performance reviews, development plans).

• Experience with project management tools (ClickUp preferred; Asana, Monday, Trello acceptable).

• Strong commercial mindset with experience in upselling, cross-selling, and value positioning.

• Advanced English (mandatory) — daily communication with international clients.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Highly organised, resilient, and able to perform under pressure.

• Comfortable multitasking and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.

What We’re Looking For

• Ownership-driven mindset — you don’t wait to be told what to fix.

• Calm under pressure and confident in difficult situations.

• Strategic thinker who can also execute operationally.

• Strong leadership presence with empathy and accountability.

• Obsessed with quality, performance, and long-term client success.

Benefits

• Competitive compensation package.

• High autonomy and visibility with leadership.

• Direct influence over team structure, tools, and portfolio strategy.

• Continuous training in leadership, performance marketing, and client services.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

We're looking for a Senior Demand Generation Manager to own demand strategy and go-to-market for Deel's emerging product lines. You'll drive full-funnel demand strategy and non-paid channels, working hand-in-hand with Sales, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Regional Teams to build a world-class, AI-powered demand machine for new products entering the market. You'll collaborate across teams to align everyone around growth targets and leverage AI to move faster and smarter.

Reporting to GM and Growth leadership, you operate with high autonomy while excelling at rallying teams around ambitious growth targets. You're accountable for demand strategy, pipeline performance, and growth velocity for your product.

What You'll Do

Build & Lead Demand Strategy

• Set quarterly demand strategy and growth targets in partnership with Sales, Product Marketing, and regional teams

• Design integrated demand architectures across owned, earned, partnership, and emerging channels using AI to forecast performance

Scale Non-Paid Channels

• Own demand generation across non-paid channels: content syndication, partnerships, affiliates, review sites, lead buys, webinars, and emerging sources

Drive Execution & Results

What You'll Bring

• 8+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated campaigns (SaaS/tech preferred)

• Advanced ability to forecast, analyze, and optimize funnel performance across channels (leads → SQOs → pipeline)

• Strong command of demand and performance metrics: CPL, cost per SQO, ROAS, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, pipeline ROI

• Creative and analytical mindset—you test, measure, optimize, and aren't afraid to kill what doesn't work

• Hands-on builder mentality: you can take an experiment from idea → build → launch → analyze → iterate, and ship fast without sacrificing quality

• Comfort with AI tools and eagerness to use them to move faster (LLMs, agents, automation for campaign creation, testing, and optimization)

• Exceptional collaboration skills—you rally teams around ambitious goals, communicate with clarity, and influence without authority

• Executive presence: able to present insights and recommendations at leadership level with confidence

• Operates as a senior individual contributor: autonomous, accountable, highly data-driven, and self-motivated

• Adaptable and thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments

• Fluency in analytics tools, reporting, and dashboard development

• Fluent in written and spoken English

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy.

postings.title: Head of Organic Growth, Kraken Pro
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.

You’re going to fix that.

The opportunity

We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.

We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.

• Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.

• Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.

• Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.

• Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.

• Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

• Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

• Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

• Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.

• Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.

• Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.

• UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.

• High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.

• Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.

• Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

• Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.

• Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.

• Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.

• Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Head of Marketing - Argentina / Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in Argentina and Uruguay - one of the biggest cattle regions in the world. You’ll be building recognition for Halter’s brand that reaches every farming community, with revenue performance to match. We're making our first moves on the ground and we need a senior leader to build the marketing foundation and be part of our core team.

This role is a key driver of full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the local marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new farmers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing farmers expanding and retained. You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth for years to come.

We want you to own marketing for this region. You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in Argentina and Uruguay - acquire, expand and retain the best farms in one of the best farming regions globally.

Who we are looking for:

• A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness

• Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on farm with cattle farmers, and you turn that firsthand understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.

• A builder and world-class operator. You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment. You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or loose) and learn from that experience

• Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.

• First-principles by instinct. You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when the local market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.

• A strong operator across both brand and demand. You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease

• Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.

• AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.

What the role looks like:

• Strategy & ownership: Own the marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.

• Organic growth & content. Build content that compounds: SEO-driven farmer resources, owned channels, and organic social that establishes Halter as the trusted voice in cattle, not just a paid acquisition function.

• Events strategy. This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and farmer gatherings actually move pipeline in AU, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.

• Case studies & proof. Build a library of farmer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new farmers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.

• Paid traffic. Work with the global Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on customer acquisition costs (CAC) and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.

• Enterprise motion. Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in AU specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator farms.

• Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture. Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to net dollar retention.

• Brand and tone of voice in-region. Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with Argentinian and Uruguayan farmers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.

• Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets. Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections AU farmers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.

Our Office First Approach:

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Analista de Adquisiciones
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Gracias por la curiosidad 👋

Nos impulsa la ambición y nos guía una visión audaz. A medida que ampliamos nuestro ecosistema de herramientas y servicios, buscamos un/a Analista de User Acquisition con espíritu emprendedor para hacer crecer nuestra red de couriers: atraer, activar y fidelizar a los mejores freelancers de la plataforma. Vas a reportar directamente al Manager de Operaciones.

Quiénes Somos

Zubale es una empresa de tecnología que empodera a los retailers para triunfar en el comercio electrónico ( e-commerce ). Atendemos a una amplia gama de clientes —desde supermercados, tiendas especializadas y farmacias hasta tiendas departamentales y marcas de moda— en México, Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Perú, Colombia y, ahora, Argentina. ¿Cómo lo hacemos? A través de dos productos clave:

• Flexifleet: Un marketplace de freelancers para realizar tareas de recolección ( picking ), empaque ( packing ) y entrega para retailers y agregadores.

• Consumer Connect: Comercio conversacional impulsado por inteligencia artificial vía WhatsApp para impulsar las ventas y mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

Nos apasiona ayudar a marcas, agregadores y retailers a optimizar sus operaciones de e-commerce , reducir costos y aumentar la rentabilidad. Respaldados por más de 70 millones de dólares en capital de riesgo ( venture capital ), hemos mantenido un crecimiento constante durante los últimos seis años y procesado más de 100 millones de pedidos a través de nuestra plataforma. Hoy atendemos a más de 100 clientes y conectamos a miles de freelancers dentro de nuestra red. Y esto es solo el comienzo. Estamos construyendo un ecosistema rentable y escalable, con la visión de convertirnos en el aliado número uno para el crecimiento del comercio electrónico de los retailers .

¿Quién sos?

Sos una persona dinámica, proactiva y orientada a resultados. Entendés que para saber qué hace que un courier se sume y se quede, primero hay que hablar con ellos: estar en los puntos de operación, escuchar qué les funciona y qué no, y llevar eso a mejores campañas y procesos. Cuando algo no convierte, no esperás instrucciones: probás, medís y ajustás. Actuás como dueño/a del crecimiento de la red.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

Adquisición y crecimiento

• Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de adquisición de couriers que acompañen el crecimiento de la operación.

• Lanzar campañas de reclutamiento multicanal (digital, referidos, alianzas, acciones en calle) y optimizar las que mejor convierten.

• Identificar nuevas fuentes de captación y testear canales de forma rápida y con bajo costo.

• Construir y comunicar una propuesta de valor clara y atractiva para los couriers.

Activación y retención

• Reducir los tiempos de activación y mejorar la conversión en cada etapa del funnel, desde el registro hasta el primer pedido.

• Estar presente en onboardings, capacitaciones y puntos de operación para entender la experiencia del courier de primera mano.

• Diseñar e implementar programas de incentivos y fidelización basados en desempeño, referidos y antigüedad.

• Asegurar que la red esté lista para los picos de demanda y fechas críticas (Hot Sale, CyberMonday, Black Friday, fiestas).

Data como herramienta

• Monitorear métricas clave (costo por adquisición, tasa de activación, retención, churn) para saber dónde intervenir.

• Medir el impacto de cada campaña e incentivo y usar esos aprendizajes para la siguiente.

Lo que este rol no es

No es un rol de marketing de escritorio. Vas a pasar parte importante de tu semana cerca de la operación y de los couriers, porque es ahí donde se entiende qué los atrae y qué los hace quedarse.

Lo que vas a aportar

Adquisición y operación

• Experiencia en adquisición de usuarios, growth, reclutamiento masivo u operaciones en plataformas o logística.

• Habilidad analítica para leer métricas y tomar decisiones basadas en datos.

• Espíritu emprendedor: autonomía, sentido de urgencia y ganas de resolver sin esperar instrucciones.

• Mentalidad de testeo y mejora continua.

Comunicación

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación, tanto con couriers como con equipos internos.

• Capacidad de influir y movilizar a otras áreas para que los cambios sucedan.

Formación y experiencia

• Carrera en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Marketing o afines.

• Experiencia en adquisición de usuarios, growth, operaciones o roles similares (deseable).

• Experiencia en startups, retail, logística o plataformas digitales (deseable).

• Buen nivel de inglés.

Lo que ofrecemos

• Modalidad híbrida: 3 días por semana en nuestra oficina de Vicente López y trabajo frecuente en campo.

• Una cultura de alto rendimiento donde los datos y la calle se complementan.

• Impacto directo en el crecimiento de nuestra red de couriers.

• Oportunidades de crecimiento en una empresa en expansión.

¿Te suena a vos? ¡Postulate y charlemos!

postings.title: B2B Marketing - LATAM Southern Cone
postings.descriptionText:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in LATAM Southern Cone. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in LATAM Southern Cone, your work will shape how Southern Cone businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

What You'll Do

• Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Southern Cone priority industries — from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

• Own field marketing for the region: plan and run self-hosted events (dinners, roundtables, workshops), represent ElevenLabs at third-party conferences and sponsorships, and bring in creative, high-touch formats (experiential activations, executive dinners, partner co-hosted sessions) that build pipeline and brand with technical buyers.

• Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound — choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

• Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Southern Cone market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

• Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

• Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

Requirements

• 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

• Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

• Deep knowledge of the Southern Cone market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

• Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

• Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

• Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

postings.descriptionText:
At Morean , we're looking for a Growth Marketing Associate to join an international team and help build scalable growth initiatives through marketing automation, AI, and data-driven campaigns .

You'll work at the intersection of Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, AI, and automation , turning defined marketing priorities into campaigns, automated workflows, and AI-powered solutions that support acquisition, activation, and retention.

You'll work autonomously, using market and funnel data to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and measure impact. You'll also collaborate with Marketing and Business Operations teams to understand market context and improve campaign execution.

What You'll Do

• Monitor market and funnel data to identify opportunities and determine the right campaign response.

• Own campaign execution end-to-end, from audience selection and channel setup to performance tracking.

• Build and optimize triggered campaigns, onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.

• Translate marketing strategies into scalable systems and automated workflows.

• Identify manual marketing processes and use AI and automation to improve speed, personalization, and efficiency.

• Build AI-powered workflows for acquisition, content, and competitive intelligence.

• Work with LLM tools and APIs to design prompts, structured outputs, and evaluation processes.

• Build and improve tools that enable faster campaign activation across different channels.

• Analyze campaign performance and communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Business Operations teams to understand market conditions and improve decision-making.

• 2–3+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Technical Marketing, or a similar role combining strategy and execution.

• 3 sabbatical weeks every 3 years at Morean

• 100% remote work

• Opportunity to work with international teams and global companies

postings.title: Manager, Programmatic
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Our Programmatic Managers are our resident experts in programmatic and direct buying. You are responsible for keeping on top of industry-wide trends and best practices, putting them to optimal use for each client’s initiatives. You will be part of a cross-functional team including Paid Search, Paid Social, Ad Operations, and Data Strategy, ensuring client needs are anticipated and met. From negotiating direct deals to building stellar full-funnel media plans, you move with precision to drive growth for our most ambitious brands.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Strategic Planning: Design and execute programmatic strategies across Display, Video, CTV, and Audio that align with client business objectives.

• Campaign Management: Manage mid-to-high level budgets, ensuring optimal allocation across tactics and inventory to maximize ROI.

• Deal Negotiation: Lead the negotiation and management of Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals with premium publishers.

• Data-Driven Optimization: Translate complex programmatic data into actionable insights for client presentations, moving beyond the "what" to the "why."

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Integrated Planning and Data Strategy teams to ensure programmatic activity is a cohesive part of the total media mix.

• Technical Oversight: Oversee the technical quality of campaigns, ensuring brand safety standards and 3rd-party verification (IAS, DV) are strictly maintained.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 2-4 years of hands-on experience in programmatic media buying, specifically within DSPs like DV360, The Trade Desk, or Amazon DSP.

• Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including identity solutions, real-time bidding, and the evolving cookie-less landscape.

• Proven ability to manage full-funnel campaigns, moving from broad awareness to performance-based conversion.

• Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools; you can find the "story" within the spreadsheet.

• Experience with ad servers (Google Campaign Manager 360) and 3rd party verification tools (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).

• Exceptional communication skills—you can explain the complexities of programmatic to clients in a clear and compelling way.

• A "better together" spirit and a relentless curiosity to test new platforms and inventory sources.

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

• You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT® , we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

postings.title: Client Account Manager II
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Great brands help make Pinners’ inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for a Client Account Manager II to help lead the way.

In this role, you will support one of Pinterest’s most strategic businesses in LATAM, partnering closely on the Mercado Libre business across Hispanic markets . You will help advertisers get the most out of Pinterest by driving strong campaign execution, performance optimization, measurement rigor, and clear client communication. You’ll collaborate closely with sales and cross-functional teams while helping bring structure, insights, and momentum to a complex regional account.

What You’ll Do

• Build and nurture strong relationships with partners by proactively communicating on campaign performance, optimizations, updates, and growth opportunities

• Partner closely with the Client Partner to support a complex regional business across multiple Hispanic LATAM markets

• Ensure partner objectives and requirements are met by coordinating effectively with internal teams including Measurement, Product Marketing, Creative Strategy, Performance Solutions, and others

• Gain a deep understanding of partner business goals and turn data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations

• Own the “how” conversation with advertisers by advising on targeting, bidding, creative, measurement, pacing, and optimization approaches

• Become an expert in Pinterest campaign best practices and performance solutions, and act as a trusted resource on performance-related opportunities

• Ensure campaign setup and execution are strong, monitor results closely, troubleshoot issues, and take action to course-correct when needed

• Interpret and communicate campaign results clearly so that partners understand impact, opportunity, and next steps

• Support QBRs, performance recaps, and other business reviews with strong analysis and clear recommendations

• Actively participate in client meetings, helping explain complex solutions in a simple, credible, and commercially relevant way

• Handle resistance, objections, and product questions thoughtfully and professionally

• Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities that can contribute to account growth and team revenue goals

• Maintain strong fluency in Pinterest ad products, performance solutions, and evolving roadmap updates

• Partner efficiently with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, answer technical questions, and support business growth

• Pitch new performance products and best practices at scale where relevant

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in digital advertising, account management, or media with responsibility for campaign performance and client communication

• Strong track record of turning data into compelling recommendations and business actions

• Experience managing complex workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with strong attention to detail

• Strong understanding of campaign optimization, performance measurement, attribution, and analytical problem-solving

• Experience with technical and performance-oriented media solutions, including areas such as tagging, measurement, analytics, shopping, search, display, paid social, or lower-funnel advertising

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, on the phone, and in writing

• Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience managing sophisticated client or agency relationships is strongly preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as math, economics, marketing, business, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.

Our Commitment To Inclusion

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.
