postings.title: Amazon Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators works with leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness, and DTC brands to accelerate growth through performance-driven creative and marketing.

We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and constantly look for better ways to grow. We’re looking for an Amazon Account Manager who understands the Amazon ecosystem, knows how to turn data into action, and takes ownership of driving measurable marketplace performance.

Why This Role Matters

Amazon is more than a sales channel. For many brands, it’s one of the most important drivers of revenue, customer acquisition, and long-term growth.

As our Amazon Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for managing and growing Amazon accounts across our portfolio. You’ll oversee marketplace performance, listings, advertising, promotions, inventory coordination, reporting, and account health while continuously identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply maintain an Amazon account. You should be constantly asking: Where can we improve conversion? What’s hurting organic ranking? Which campaigns are wasting spend? Where are we losing margin? What can we test next?

If you know Seller Central inside and out and enjoy turning marketplace data into growth opportunities, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Manage Amazon Accounts

• Own day-to-day management of assigned Amazon Seller Central accounts.

• Monitor account performance, sales, traffic, conversion rates, inventory, and account health.

• Manage product listings, variations, categories, pricing, and other catalog updates.

• Troubleshoot listing suppressions, account issues, stranded inventory, and other marketplace problems.

• Ensure accounts remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.

Optimize Product Listings

• Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images, and A+ Content.

• Conduct keyword and competitor research to improve organic visibility and conversion.

• Identify opportunities to improve product detail pages and overall customer experience.

• Coordinate with creative and copy teams to develop stronger listing assets.

• Run ongoing tests and improvements based on marketplace performance.

Manage Amazon Advertising

• Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

• Monitor budgets, bids, keywords, search terms, and campaign performance.

• Improve advertising efficiency while supporting revenue growth.

• Track metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and attributed sales.

• Identify winning campaigns and opportunities to scale while reducing inefficient spend.

Drive Revenue & Profitability

• Develop strategies to increase Amazon revenue, market share, and profitability.

• Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities across products, categories, and campaigns.

• Plan promotions, coupons, deals, and other marketplace initiatives.

• Monitor competitor pricing, positioning, reviews, and marketplace activity.

• Balance revenue growth with advertising efficiency and contribution margin.

Monitor Inventory & Forecasting

• Coordinate with operations and supply chain teams to maintain healthy inventory levels.

• Monitor sell-through rates and identify potential stockout or overstock risks.

• Support demand forecasting using historical performance, seasonality, promotions, and growth trends.

• Help ensure inventory decisions align with advertising and sales strategies.

Analyze & Report Performance

• Build regular reports covering sales, advertising, profitability, inventory, and account health.

• Translate Amazon data into clear recommendations and next steps.

• Identify performance trends, problems, and growth opportunities before they become obvious.

• Communicate results and strategic recommendations to internal teams and leadership.

• Establish and track KPIs for each account.

Who You Are

Amazon Marketplace Expert

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

• Strong understanding of Amazon marketplace operations, catalog management, account health, and listing optimization.

• Proven experience growing Amazon revenue and improving marketplace performance.

• Experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously is strongly preferred.

• Agency or multi-brand eCommerce experience is a major plus.

Strong Amazon PPC Experience

You understand how organic performance and paid advertising work together.

You’re comfortable building, analyzing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns and can explain exactly why you’re increasing spend, reducing bids, changing targeting, or restructuring a campaign.

Data-Driven

You’re comfortable working with large amounts of marketplace data and turning it into decisions.

You understand metrics such as ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR, sessions, Buy Box percentage, organic ranking, and contribution margin.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are required. Experience with Amazon analytics and third-party marketplace tools is a plus.

Commercially Minded

You understand that growing revenue alone isn’t enough.

You think about profitability, advertising efficiency, inventory, pricing, conversion, and customer behavior together when making decisions.

Highly Organized

You can manage multiple products, campaigns, deadlines, and priorities without losing attention to detail.

You document your work, communicate clearly, and keep stakeholders informed without needing to be chased for updates.

Always Looking for the Next Opportunity

You don’t wait for someone to tell you an account is underperforming.

You notice the change, investigate the cause, develop a solution, and move quickly.

You enjoy testing new strategies, solving marketplace problems, and finding opportunities others might overlook. When Amazon changes something, your first instinct is to understand it and figure out how to use it to our advantage.

Perks & Benefits

Own Meaningful Growth: Take direct responsibility for Amazon accounts and see the measurable impact of your strategies.

Work With Growing Consumer Brands: Manage products across lifestyle, beauty, wellness, fashion, and DTC categories.

Data + Creativity: Work alongside performance marketers, strategists, designers, copywriters, and creative teams to improve the entire Amazon customer journey.

Career Growth: Expand your expertise across marketplace strategy, eCommerce, performance marketing, and account leadership as High Scale continues to grow.

Real Ownership: If you identify an opportunity, we want you to bring it forward, build the case, and help make it happen.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe different perspectives, experiences, and ideas create stronger teams and better results. If you know how to turn Amazon data into action and are excited by the challenge of growing brands in one of the world’s most competitive marketplaces, we’d love to hear from you.

postings.descriptionText:
Head of Growth | B2B SaaS

Hybrid | Buenos Aires, Argentina

Influencer Hero is a profitable, bootstrapped B2B SaaS platform helping brands run and scale their influencer marketing programs. Our platform combines influencer discovery, CRM, outreach automation, affiliate tracking, campaign management, reporting, and creator workflows in one system.

We already have a strong inbound growth engine and customers across global markets. We are now entering our next stage of growth: scaling demand generation, moving further into enterprise, and building a world-class marketing function.

We’re looking for a Head of Growth to own that journey.

This is a key leadership hire with the potential to grow into a broader CMO-level role. You’ll own our marketing and growth strategy, build the team around you, and be directly accountable for generating qualified pipeline and revenue.

This is not a purely managerial role. We are looking for a hands-on operator who can set the strategy, execute quickly, analyze the results, and build the team and systems required to scale what works.

What you'll own

• Own Influencer Hero’s growth and marketing strategy with clear targets for qualified pipeline, ARR, CAC, and revenue

• Scale our existing inbound engine across SEO, GEO/AI search, content, email, paid acquisition, social, partnerships, webinars, and events

• Build new growth channels while continuously improving the performance of existing ones

• Work closely with Sales and the founders on ICP, ABM, enterprise GTM, lead quality, positioning, and pipeline generation

• Elevate our positioning, website, case studies, thought leadership, and content to the standard expected by mid-market and enterprise buyers

• Build and lead a high-performing marketing team across internal hires, freelancers, agencies, and AI-powered workflows

• Develop a rigorous experimentation culture: identify opportunities, launch quickly, measure results, and aggressively scale what works

• Own funnel analytics from traffic → lead → demo → opportunity → customer → ARR

• Track and improve CAC, conversion rates, channel ROI, pipeline contribution, and marketing efficiency

• Own the marketing budget and technology stack

• Use AI and automation extensively to increase the output and leverage of a lean marketing organization

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS growth or marketing, with meaningful ownership of growth, demand generation, or pipeline

• A track record of helping scale a SaaS company, ideally during the early-to-growth stage rather than only inside a large established organization

• Demonstrable experience generating qualified pipeline and revenue, not just traffic, impressions, followers, or MQLs

• Strong understanding of organic growth, content, SEO and modern AI/GEO-driven acquisition

• Experience marketing to US, UK, or European B2B buyers

• Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how positioning and content need to change when selling to larger and enterprise customers

• Exceptional written and spoken English

• Highly analytical and comfortable working deeply with funnel, CRM, attribution, and revenue data

• Experience building or managing high-performing marketers, freelancers, or agencies

• Comfortable being both strategic and hands-on — you should be willing to personally review messaging, analyze funnels, launch experiments, and solve problems

• High ownership, urgency, intellectual curiosity, and bias toward execution

Strong pluses

• Experience scaling a B2B SaaS company from roughly $1M–$20M+ ARR

• Experience with enterprise or mid-market SaaS

• Deep expertise in SEO, content-led growth, GEO, or demand generation

• Experience in D2C e-commerce, creator economy or martech

• Experience building an international growth engine, particularly targeting the US and Europe

• Strong understanding of AI tools and how to use them to operate a significantly more productive marketing organization

Why Influencer Hero

Influencer Hero is bootstrapped and profitable, which means we operate differently from many venture-backed SaaS companies: we care about speed, efficiency, ownership, and measurable business outcomes.

You’ll join at a stage where the foundation already exists, but there is significant room to increase the scale and sophistication of the growth engine.

You will have

• Real ownership: growth and marketing will be your function to build

• Direct access to the founders: you’ll work closely with the CEO on GTM and company strategy

• Resources to execute: we are actively investing in growth and will build the team around successful channels

• Global scope: our customers and prospects span the US, Europe, and other international markets

• High impact: your work will directly influence how quickly Influencer Hero moves through its next stage of growth

• A path to broader marketing leadership as the company scales

We value people who move quickly, think independently, challenge assumptions, and care more about creating results than protecting processes.

How to apply

Please complete the application form below, including:

• Your CV in English

• Your answers to all four mandatory questions

Both your CV and answers must be submitted through the form for your application to be considered.

postings.title: Amazon Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators works with leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness, and DTC brands to accelerate growth through performance-driven creative and marketing.

We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and constantly look for better ways to grow. We’re looking for an Amazon Account Manager who understands the Amazon ecosystem, knows how to turn data into action, and takes ownership of driving measurable marketplace performance.

Why This Role Matters

Amazon is more than a sales channel. For many brands, it’s one of the most important drivers of revenue, customer acquisition, and long-term growth.

As our Amazon Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for managing and growing Amazon accounts across our portfolio. You’ll oversee marketplace performance, listings, advertising, promotions, inventory coordination, reporting, and account health while continuously identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply maintain an Amazon account. You should be constantly asking: Where can we improve conversion? What’s hurting organic ranking? Which campaigns are wasting spend? Where are we losing margin? What can we test next?

If you know Seller Central inside and out and enjoy turning marketplace data into growth opportunities, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Manage Amazon Accounts

• Own day-to-day management of assigned Amazon Seller Central accounts.

• Monitor account performance, sales, traffic, conversion rates, inventory, and account health.

• Manage product listings, variations, categories, pricing, and other catalog updates.

• Troubleshoot listing suppressions, account issues, stranded inventory, and other marketplace problems.

• Ensure accounts remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.

Optimize Product Listings

• Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images, and A+ Content.

• Conduct keyword and competitor research to improve organic visibility and conversion.

• Identify opportunities to improve product detail pages and overall customer experience.

• Coordinate with creative and copy teams to develop stronger listing assets.

• Run ongoing tests and improvements based on marketplace performance.

Manage Amazon Advertising

• Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

• Monitor budgets, bids, keywords, search terms, and campaign performance.

• Improve advertising efficiency while supporting revenue growth.

• Track metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and attributed sales.

• Identify winning campaigns and opportunities to scale while reducing inefficient spend.

Drive Revenue & Profitability

• Develop strategies to increase Amazon revenue, market share, and profitability.

• Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities across products, categories, and campaigns.

• Plan promotions, coupons, deals, and other marketplace initiatives.

• Monitor competitor pricing, positioning, reviews, and marketplace activity.

• Balance revenue growth with advertising efficiency and contribution margin.

Monitor Inventory & Forecasting

• Coordinate with operations and supply chain teams to maintain healthy inventory levels.

• Monitor sell-through rates and identify potential stockout or overstock risks.

• Support demand forecasting using historical performance, seasonality, promotions, and growth trends.

• Help ensure inventory decisions align with advertising and sales strategies.

Analyze & Report Performance

• Build regular reports covering sales, advertising, profitability, inventory, and account health.

• Translate Amazon data into clear recommendations and next steps.

• Identify performance trends, problems, and growth opportunities before they become obvious.

• Communicate results and strategic recommendations to internal teams and leadership.

• Establish and track KPIs for each account.

Who You Are

Amazon Marketplace Expert

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

• Strong understanding of Amazon marketplace operations, catalog management, account health, and listing optimization.

• Proven experience growing Amazon revenue and improving marketplace performance.

• Experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously is strongly preferred.

• Agency or multi-brand eCommerce experience is a major plus.

Strong Amazon PPC Experience

You understand how organic performance and paid advertising work together.

You’re comfortable building, analyzing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns and can explain exactly why you’re increasing spend, reducing bids, changing targeting, or restructuring a campaign.

Data-Driven

You’re comfortable working with large amounts of marketplace data and turning it into decisions.

You understand metrics such as ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR, sessions, Buy Box percentage, organic ranking, and contribution margin.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are required. Experience with Amazon analytics and third-party marketplace tools is a plus.

Commercially Minded

You understand that growing revenue alone isn’t enough.

You think about profitability, advertising efficiency, inventory, pricing, conversion, and customer behavior together when making decisions.

Highly Organized

You can manage multiple products, campaigns, deadlines, and priorities without losing attention to detail.

You document your work, communicate clearly, and keep stakeholders informed without needing to be chased for updates.

Always Looking for the Next Opportunity

You don’t wait for someone to tell you an account is underperforming.

You notice the change, investigate the cause, develop a solution, and move quickly.

You enjoy testing new strategies, solving marketplace problems, and finding opportunities others might overlook. When Amazon changes something, your first instinct is to understand it and figure out how to use it to our advantage.

Perks & Benefits

Own Meaningful Growth: Take direct responsibility for Amazon accounts and see the measurable impact of your strategies.

Work With Growing Consumer Brands: Manage products across lifestyle, beauty, wellness, fashion, and DTC categories.

Data + Creativity: Work alongside performance marketers, strategists, designers, copywriters, and creative teams to improve the entire Amazon customer journey.

Career Growth: Expand your expertise across marketplace strategy, eCommerce, performance marketing, and account leadership as High Scale continues to grow.

Real Ownership: If you identify an opportunity, we want you to bring it forward, build the case, and help make it happen.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe different perspectives, experiences, and ideas create stronger teams and better results. If you know how to turn Amazon data into action and are excited by the challenge of growing brands in one of the world’s most competitive marketplaces, we’d love to hear from you.

postings.title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

Why this role exists

Our product is ahead of our brand.

We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.

At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.

This role owns both.

What You Will Own

• Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.

• Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.

• Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.

• Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.

• Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.

• Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

What We Are Looking For

• You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.

• You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.

• You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.

• Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.

• You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.

• You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.

Nice to have

• Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.

• You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.

• Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.

• Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.

• You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.

• A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.

By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.

By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.

What This Role Is Not

There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.

The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.

We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.

You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.

Compensation

Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

Compensation and Benefits

You’ll have success here if you value clear processes and feel qualified to do the following things:

• LinkedIn and email first. These are our two main channels. Run the company pages, create and schedule LinkedIn posts, and own email end to end: list growth, segments for clients and candidates, newsletters, nurture sequences, deliverability and reporting.

• Content and calendar. Own the content calendar from idea to distribution: LinkedIn posts, campaigns, blog and SEO articles, website updates. Ideas often come from the founder. You plan it, produce it and ship it.

• Lead magnets. Ship one lead magnet a quarter, starting with our salary analysis for the tire, automotive and industrial markets. Turn each one into posts, emails and outreach.

• Podcast. Run the podcast workflow: guest booking, production, publishing and promotion, so every episode turns into clips, posts and articles.

• Client and candidate journeys. Map and improve every digital touchpoint a client or candidate has with us (website, job posts, outreach, emails, follow-up) so it feels consistent, professional and human.

• Events. Plan our pushes around trade shows like SEMA in Las Vegas: promote Founder’s panels and talks, set up meetings ahead of time, and follow up after.

• Organic growth. Grow search traffic with SEO, backlinks and content partnerships.

• Performance. Track results weekly and report monthly in plain words: what worked, what did not, what you will change. Run a personal review every quarter and turn it into next steps.

We train our team to help them succeed, and everyone on our team helps with our success. In this role, you’ll be accountable to hit the following numbers each week:

• Qualified leads (the main one). At least 3 qualified leads a month by day 90 and 5 a month by month 6, from LinkedIn, email and content. Counted in Close by lead source. A qualified lead is a decision maker at a target company who asks about a search or books a call. You earn a small share of every deal that closes from your leads.

• Founder time. By day 90, the Founder spends 2 hours a week or less on marketing, and only to review and approve. You run the other 90%.

• On time, with quality. 100% of the calendar ships on its date, every month. That calendar is 3 LinkedIn posts a week for each active brand, 3 campaigns a month, 1 SEO article a month, 1 lead magnet a quarter, and every podcast episode on its release date with guests booked 6 weeks ahead. Zero factual errors go live: every number and claim is checked against a real source before it is published.

• Email. 1 newsletter a month to clients and 1 to candidates. Open rate of 35% or more. At least 10 new subscribers a month across both lists.

• Organic search. Clicks from Google across our sites up 50% in 6 months.

If you want to come to work, learn, and hit those numbers, you’ll be recognized and rewarded. Our company runs on EOS purely. That means as a member of this team, you will have a leader who:

• Gives clear directions

• Makes sure you have the necessary tools

• Acts with the greater good in mind

• Delegates appropriately

• Takes time to truly understand your role and how you can help the company

• Makes their expectations clear

• Communicates well

• Has effective meetings

• Meets one-on-one with you quarterly or more, if needed

• Rewards and recognizes your performance

The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client's marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers' Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients' marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers' Associates to ensure that your assigned clients' marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

• Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well

• Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing

• Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you'll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)

• Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met

• Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients

• Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly

• Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients

• Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients

• Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers' demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly

• Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue

• Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director

• Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients' satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team

• Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision

• Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers

• Participating in the Account Managers' group calls

• Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise

• Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing

• Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building

• Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner

• Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers' Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director

• Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments

• Directly reporting to the Account Managers' Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

• Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours

• An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently

• Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD

• Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement

• Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)

• Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)

• Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

• Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers' Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

• At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)

• A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients

• Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards

• Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines

• Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries

• Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism

• Any remote work experience is a major advantage

• Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department

• Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues

• Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency

• Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus

• Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)

• Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)

• Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (i.e, 140 hours per month)

• Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language

• Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

• Advanced knowledge in MS Office, including Excel (including developing pivot tables) and PowerPoint

• Experience with Tableau, Adobe web platform, Adobe analytics/web trends/Google analytics, Sprinklr/Hootsuite, Sysomos, any eMail marketing tool, Google Adwords

• Experience with digital marketing analytics including analyzing digital ad and social media performance

• Experience with event management tools such as Cvent, Marketo, Kaltura, On24, or similar platforms.

• Experience with digital event analytics including analyzing attendee engagement and event performance.

• Ability to drive an agile team; independent and showing flexibility during peak times

• Team leader with a knack to motivate the team to deliver programs within a stipulated timeframe

In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

postings.title: Analista Comercial De Marketplace
postings.descriptionText:
ANALISTA COMERCIAL DE MARKETPLACE – PORTFOLIO & RENTABILIDAD
AI-First · Argentina, México y Colombia

Ser top seller en MercadoLibre ya es difícil en un país. Nosotros lo logramos en tres: Argentina, México y Colombia. Y operamos en los principales marketplaces de la región. Somos la única empresa argentina que puede decirlo, y esto recién empieza. Ahora te estamos buscando a vos.

La forma tradicional de gestionar este canal ya fue. Murió. En Disbyte el foco del analista no está en la carga operativa: está en construir los sistemas escalables con IA que se encargan de ella. Vos diseñás la máquina, tus copilotos la hacen correr, y esa máquina escala a tres países a la vez. ¿El fin? Tomar mejores decisiones en menos tiempo, con la cabeza puesta en la estrategia y no en la planilla. Si querés ver cómo se gestiona un canal digital en 2026, es acá.

EL ROL
Vas a ser responsable de optimizar la rentabilidad de un portfolio de productos definido, usando todas las palancas disponibles: catálogo, precio, ads y stock. Que cada publicación se encuentre, se vea bien, convierta y tenga el precio justo para ganar ranking sin resignar margen. Y vas a ser la cara de Disbyte frente a los equipos comerciales de los marketplaces: construir y sostener la relación con los KAMs y Category Managers es una palanca más para maximizar la performance de tu portfolio.

La diferencia con un rol tradicional es cómo lo vas a hacer: en vez de tocar las publicaciones una por una, vas a usar sistemas con IA que te permitan hacerlo a escala. Buscamos a alguien que resuelva y ejecute, no que arme reportes y los mande por mail. Si te gusta tomar decisiones y ver el impacto en tus números, este rol es para vos.

CÓMO VAS A USAR LA IA EN EL DÍA A DÍA
Vas a trabajar sobre las palancas que mueven el negocio: optimización de listings, performance de ads y reglas de repricing, con alertas cuando la competencia mueve precio o cae la conversión de un SKU. Para eso vas a usar herramientas de desarrollo propio, que van a evolucionar con tu feedback y tu mirada de mejora continua. No hace falta que programes: sí que tengas ganas de aprender y de hacerte las preguntas correctas. La construcción del sistema es la consecuencia de eso.

LO QUE BUSCAMOS
- Experiencia en marketplace. MercadoLibre es excluyente; Amazon, deseable. Tenés 2 o más años gestionando cuentas o categorías y entendés las variables que definen quién vende y quién no: posicionamiento, reputación, conversión y precio. No te lo contaron, lo operaste.
- Hands-on con IA, y comprobable. Trabajás con Claude Desktop, Claude Code o herramientas similares, y podés mostrarnos lo que hiciste con ellas. En la entrevista te vamos a pedir que nos lo enseñes.
- Hands-on en la gestión. Cuando aparece un problema, lo resolvés. Y después pensás cómo hacer para que no vuelva a pasar. Esa segunda parte es la que más nos importa.
- Relación comercial. Te movés bien con los KAMs y Category Managers de los marketplaces: generás confianza, mantenés el contacto constante y sabés convertir esa relación en oportunidades concretas para el negocio. Si ya tenés vínculo con los equipos de MercadoLibre, mucho mejor.
- Deseable: experiencia en estimación de mercado, análisis de share y forecasting.
- Formación: preferentemente Ingeniería (Industrial, Sistemas o cualquier especialidad). También valoramos Economía, Ciencia de Datos o Comercialización. Lo que más nos importa es la base cuantitativa: que te guste la matemática y el análisis en profundidad.
- Inglés: deseable.

CÓMO SE MIDE TU IMPACTO
- Venta y rentabilidad: NMV, TSU, MC1 y MC2.
- Performance de publicaciones y ads: CVR, ASP, ACOS y ROAS.
- Precisión de planificación: FAR y WAPE.

QUÉ OFRECEMOS
🍴 Almuerzo incluído en la oficina.
🏥 Prepaga de primer nivel.
🎂 Tu día de cumpleaños libre.
🎁 Acceso a Club de Beneficios con descuentos exclusivos en primeras marcas.

This role requires a deep understanding of email marketing best practices, retention marketing principles, and analytics, along with a creative mindset to develop compelling content. If you have a passion for email marketing for enterprise-level accounts using Klaviyo , possess strong technical acumen, and excel at driving results, we would love to hear from you.
Why Work With Us
At CrucialPoint, we pride ourselves on creating exceptional results-driven retention programs for our diverse range of ecommerce clients. As an Email Marketing Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to work with amazing brands and be at the forefront of the industry. We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, where your ideas and contributions are valued. Additionally, we offer room for growth, flexible scheduling, and a competitive salary / rate.
Responsibilities:

• Develop and Execute Email Marketing Strategies:

• Create and implement comprehensive email marketing strategies using Klaviyo that align with business goals and industry best practices.

• Optimize and improve automated email marketing flows (e.g., welcome series, abandoned cart, win-back) and signup forms in Klaviyo to maximize new customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue generation.

• Develop comprehensive content calendars aligned with client objectives, ensuring consistent and engaging messaging throughout email marketing campaigns.

• Client Collaboration:

• Collaborate closely with clients and Client Success Managers to translate requirements into effective Klaviyo email marketing campaigns, ensuring their success and satisfaction.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, promptly addressing questions and concerns.

• Partner with clients and internal teams to understand business needs and translate them into actionable strategies that help drive business growth.

• Technical Optimization:

• Conduct regular audits in Klaviyo to identify and resolve technical issues related to email deliverability, responsive design, dynamic tagging, and personalization.

• Identify technical issues and work diligently to resolve them in a timely manner.

• Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to optimize performance and drive continuous improvement.

• Continuously analyze data and metrics to identify revenue opportunities for clients, providing strategic recommendations to drive growth and maximize ROI.

• Foster a positive and collaborative team environment, supporting and mentoring team members when needed.

• Stay up-to-date with Klaviyo features, updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies in retention marketing, incorporating them into our strategies to maintain a competitive edge.

Liderar la estrategia de marketing de la compañía para sus tres canales (B2C, distribuidores y corporativo), traduciendo las necesidades de cada sector en planes concretos, gestionando al equipo y a la agencia externa, y tomando decisiones basadas en datos para impulsar las ventas y construir una comunicación de marca seria, sofisticada y coherente.

• Experiencia de al menos 4 años en posiciones de liderazgo o gestión del área.

• Experiencia en e-commerce y marketplaces, con manejo de métricas y análisis de resultados.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de pauta y analítica digital (Google, Meta, etc.) y de gestión de agencias.

• Experiencia en comunicación corporativa / B2B, incluyendo LinkedIn.

• Valoramos experiencia en canales de distribución y en entornos online y offline (eventos, expos, medios).

• Persona ordenada, autónoma y con criterio propio, que sepa priorizar y delegar.

🚀 El desafío de construir y liderar el área de marketing desde sus bases.

🏢 Modalidad híbrida: 2 presenciales (CABA) y 3 home office.

💻 Notebook y celular.

postings.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Media buying has changed.

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across Meta ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and also think like a marketer .

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

Requirements

What You'll Do

• Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients across Meta and TikTok

• Build creative testing roadmaps — develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working

• Manage ad budgets ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client

• Diagnose the full funnel — spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion

• Communicate clearly with clients — present results, plans, and next steps

• Work with UGC creators — source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

You're A Great Fit If...

You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:

• You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)

• Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

You understand creative is the lever:

• You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles

• You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs

• You can work with editors to create winning ad variations

• Video editing or design skills are a plus

You're a strategist, not a robot:

• You challenge assumptions and adapt fast

• You don't blindly follow "best practices"

• You can explain what you're doing and why

You have ownership and urgency:

• You act like it's your money

• You move fast and follow through

• You don't wait to be told what to do

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

postings.title: TikTok Shop Growth Strategist
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

• Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A Day In The Life

The Social Commerce Strategist plays a pivotal role in driving revenue and optimizing affiliate and social commerce strategies through data-driven, AI-enhanced processes. This position manages affiliate and social ambassador partnerships across platforms like TikTok, Meta, and Amazon affiliate, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and maximizing partnership profitability. Daily responsibilities include overseeing affiliate production and outreach, optimizing social shops, and refining commission strategies based on GMV and engagement metrics. In this fast-paced role, the Social Commerce Strategist also serves as a key client liaison, delivering actionable insights and recommendations to sustain and strengthen client relationships. Always forward-thinking, this strategist keeps pace with industry trends, continuously integrating innovative tactics to elevate social commerce results.

Responsibilities

• TikTok Shops & Affiliate Management: Execute a TikTok Shop affiliate strategy and/or social ambassdor aligned with brand objectives, focusing on maximizing partnerships and revenue, including daily affiliate outreach through the TikTok Shop Affiliate center

• Affiliate Outreach and Onboarding: Management of affiliate messaging system and discord communities to encourage ongoing partnerships that are mutually beneficial

• Commerce Optimization: Manage social commerce initiatives across platforms like TikTok and Meta, including the setup and continuous optimization of social shops to enhance conversions and drive revenue for clients

• Data-driven Reporting and Analytics: Track and report key metrics, including GMV, response rate, and program growth; provide affiliate commission strategies and analyze overall profitability. Develop forecasts and goals for clients based on historical data.

• Client Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with clients, providing regular updates on campaign performance, insights, and recommendations for optimization to ensure client satisfaction and retention

• Continuous Learning and Innovation: Stay abreast of industry trends and platform updates, actively seeking out new opportunities and innovative strategies to enhance the performance of influencer campaigns and social commerce initiatives

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in social media (agency experience preferred)

• Industry Expertise: Proactive in staying current with the latest trends, algorithm changes, and platform updates in the social media landscape, must have examples of applying this knowledge to enhance strategies

• Proficiency in TikTok Shop Seller Center: Comfort and familiarity with navigating and utilizing the various TikTok tools within their commerce suite. Must have experience in the Affiliate management system

• Affiliate & Ambassador Program Experience: Understanding of the social ambassador ecosystem and proven experience in at least one sub-affiliate program; bonus points for Impact experience

• Client Variety: Proven track record of successfully managing social media strategies for multiple clients spanning various industries, demonstrating adaptability and versatility

• Strong Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze campaign data effectively, derive actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance and achieve client goals

• Commerce Management Experience: Previous experience managing social commerce initiatives, including setting up and optimizing social shops on platforms like TikTok and Meta, to drive revenue and conversions

• Performance Influencer Management: Demonstrated proficiency in managing influencer campaigns focused on driving specific performance metrics such as conversions, click-through rates, and ROI

• Autonomous Workflow Capability: Highly self-motivated and capable of working independently to develop, execute, and manage social media strategies while delivering exceptional results

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• REP Goal of $26,0000

• Hitting within 15% of target forecast OR having key recommendations in place to hit goals

• Below 10% Client Churn Rate

• Understands all strategies of department and can execute on 100%

• Can navigate 100%+ difficult probing questions on performance

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Client Performance and Sentiment

• Autonomous workflow management and account ownership

• Department Support

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/ . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at recruiting@powerdigital.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

postings.title: CRO Lead (Hands-On)
postings.descriptionText:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

• Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round

• Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day

• Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts

• Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

• Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)

• Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)

• Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped

• AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)

• No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

• Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first

• Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells

• Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners

• Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor

• Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix

• Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house

• Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

• Fully remote, full-time

• Fluent in English

• CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must

• Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up

• Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages

• Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help

• Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency

• Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule

• Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin

• No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work

• Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

• Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder

• Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

• CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next

• Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV

• Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week

• Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day

• CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house

• CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

• Application + Screening

• Test Project

• Technical Interview

• Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

postings.title: Manager, Programmatic
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Our Programmatic Managers are our resident experts in programmatic and direct buying. You are responsible for keeping on top of industry-wide trends and best practices, putting them to optimal use for each client’s initiatives. You will be part of a cross-functional team including Paid Search, Paid Social, Ad Operations, and Data Strategy, ensuring client needs are anticipated and met. From negotiating direct deals to building stellar full-funnel media plans, you move with precision to drive growth for our most ambitious brands.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Strategic Planning: Design and execute programmatic strategies across Display, Video, CTV, and Audio that align with client business objectives.

• Campaign Management: Manage mid-to-high level budgets, ensuring optimal allocation across tactics and inventory to maximize ROI.

• Deal Negotiation: Lead the negotiation and management of Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals with premium publishers.

• Data-Driven Optimization: Translate complex programmatic data into actionable insights for client presentations, moving beyond the "what" to the "why."

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Integrated Planning and Data Strategy teams to ensure programmatic activity is a cohesive part of the total media mix.

• Technical Oversight: Oversee the technical quality of campaigns, ensuring brand safety standards and 3rd-party verification (IAS, DV) are strictly maintained.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 2-4 years of hands-on experience in programmatic media buying, specifically within DSPs like DV360, The Trade Desk, or Amazon DSP.

• Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including identity solutions, real-time bidding, and the evolving cookie-less landscape.

• Proven ability to manage full-funnel campaigns, moving from broad awareness to performance-based conversion.

• Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools; you can find the "story" within the spreadsheet.

• Experience with ad servers (Google Campaign Manager 360) and 3rd party verification tools (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).

• Exceptional communication skills—you can explain the complexities of programmatic to clients in a clear and compelling way.

• A "better together" spirit and a relentless curiosity to test new platforms and inventory sources.

TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

• You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

postings.title: CRO Specialist - Funnels & Upsells
postings.descriptionText:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

• Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round

• Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day

• Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts

• Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

• Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)

• Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)

• Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped

• AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)

• No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

• Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first

• Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells

• Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners

• Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor

• Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix

• Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house

• Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

• Fully remote, full-time

• Fluent in English

• CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must

• Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up

• Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages

• Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help

• Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency

• Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule

• Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin

• No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work

• Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

• Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder

• Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

• CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next

• Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV

• Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week

• Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day

• CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house

• CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

• Application + Screening

• Test Project

• Technical Interview

• Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).
