postings.title: General Manager - Marketing and Ecommerce Growth
postings.descriptionText:
HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own

• Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand

• Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention

• Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands

• Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing

• Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently

Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.

• Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention

• Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability

• Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists

• Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments

• Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems

• Strong professional English and effective remote leadership

Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.

• Culture Index survey

• Criteria GAME assessment - English

Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The Company Is Founder Led, Profitable And Growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:

• Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area

• Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans

• Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers

• Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs

• Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact

• Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

• A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management

• Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions

• Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams

• Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy

• Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale

Nice-to-have skills

• Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth

• Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches

• Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio

• Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors

• Understanding of open source communities and business models

• Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

🏆Recognition rewards

🏝 Annual holiday leave

👶Parental Leave

🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme

🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Meta Media Buyer | Facebook & Instagram Ads
Remote | Part-Time to Start | Potential for Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role
Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based marketing and growth agency that helps local businesses and performance-driven brands grow through paid media, creative testing, lead generation, and full-funnel marketing strategies.

They are looking for a hands-on Meta Media Buyer who can independently manage and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising accounts, identify performance issues through data, troubleshoot tracking and funnel problems, and make strategic decisions that improve profitability.

This is not a campaign setup or reporting-only role. The ideal candidate should be comfortable getting into the numbers, diagnosing *why* performance is changing, identifying the root cause, and taking action based on data.

What You'll Do

• Own Meta Ads accounts end-to-end, from campaign setup and tracking checks through ongoing optimization, testing, scaling, and reporting.

• Monitor and analyze key performance metrics including CPA, CPL, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CPC, CVR, frequency, conversion volume, and spend.

• Diagnose performance changes and identify the underlying cause rather than relying on generic testing.

• Analyze whether performance issues are related to creative, audience, campaign structure, placements, landing pages, website experience, checkout/conversion flow, or tracking/attribution.

• Identify and troubleshoot tracking discrepancies between Meta and backend platforms such as Shopify or CRM systems.

• Develop and test creative concepts, hooks, messaging, formats, and angles based on account-level data.

• Identify creative fatigue, audience saturation, increasing frequency, declining CTR, rising CPA, and other performance patterns , and take appropriate action.

• Manage prospecting, retargeting, and full-funnel campaign strategies.

• Build efficient campaign structures and avoid unnecessary fragmentation when budgets or data do not support it.

• Make informed budget allocation and scaling decisions based on performance, profitability, historical data, and business goals.

• Test and optimize audiences, including broad targeting, lookalikes, retargeting, and Meta's Advantage+ solutions when appropriate.

• Investigate and resolve issues such as sudden drops in purchases, changes in spend, CPA spikes, tracking failures, or campaigns disproportionately consuming budget.

• Connect media performance to broader business metrics such as AOV, CAC, LTV, MER, profitability, and contribution margin when relevant.

• Collaborate with creative, strategy, and client teams to translate performance data into actionable recommendations.

• Communicate findings clearly to clients, including what changed, why it changed, what was done, and what the expected impact is.

• Stay current with Meta Ads platform changes, bidding strategies, attribution, automation, and evolving best practices.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for businesses, brands, or agencies.

• Strong, recent experience working directly inside Meta Ads Manager.

• Proven experience independently managing and optimizing multiple accounts.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret account-level data and identify root causes.

• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting tracking, attribution, funnel, and conversion issues.

• Strong understanding of creative performance, including creative fatigue, hooks, messaging, formats, and audience/creative fit.

• Strong understanding of campaign structure, audience strategy, retargeting, lookalikes, broad targeting, and Advantage+.

• Experience with both lead generation and/or e-commerce campaigns.

• Ability to make data-driven decisions around budget allocation, scaling, testing, and optimization.

• Understanding of Meta bidding strategies and when different approaches may be appropriate, including Lowest Cost, Cost Cap, and Bid Cap.

• Comfortable working with metrics beyond platform-level ROAS and understanding the relationship between advertising performance and actual business results.

• Strong troubleshooting mindset: you should be able to look at a performance problem and determine what you would check first, what you believe is causing it, and what action you would take .

• Excellent English communication skills and confidence working directly with clients.

• Ability to explain technical performance insights in a clear and practical way.

• Agency experience managing multiple accounts is highly valued.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Shopify, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Triple Whale, Hyros, Looker Studio, Northbeam, or similar tools.

• Experience working with CRM platforms and understanding the relationship between leads, qualified leads, opportunities, and revenue.

• Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest, or other paid media channels.

• Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or agencies.

• Experience with DTC/e-commerce brands and performance-driven local businesses.

• Understanding of incrementality and different attribution models.

• Experience connecting paid media performance to LTV, CAC, MER, margins, and overall profitability.

What Success Looks Like

• Meta accounts are actively monitored, optimized, and scaled based on data rather than assumptions.

• Performance problems are identified early and diagnosed at the account, funnel, creative, audience, or tracking level.

• Campaign structures remain efficient and appropriate for the available budget and data.

• Creative testing produces actionable insights and continuous performance improvements.

• Tracking and attribution issues are identified and resolved quickly.

• Budget is consistently allocated toward the highest-impact opportunities.

• Paid media decisions are connected to actual business outcomes, not just platform metrics.

• Clients receive clear, proactive recommendations and understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what we are doing about it.

postings.title: Growth Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS / Cybersecurity)
postings.descriptionText:
About CrucialLogics Inc.

We secure your business using native Microsoft technologies you already own.

We apply our Consulting with a Conscience TM approach in our security philosophy.

• Security should be simple, easy to manage and scalable

• Security does not require a large investment in various point solutions

• Security is easily achieved by properly configuring technologies you already are paying for

• Reduce your attack footprint by reducing overall infrastructure

You will never stop bad actors from targeting you. The goal in security is to put defences in place to detect the attempt before the breach.

CrucialLogics is a Microsoft-centric cyber-security firm headquartered in Toronto, Canada. We have been running for nearly ten years, with a 100% remote team of 60 people, and our team spans North America, South America, Spain, Kenya and India. We are a Microsoft CSP Direct partner, and we sell, deploy and manage Microsoft estates for clients from SMBs to Enterprise across North America.

Secure Managed Service ( securemanagedservice.com ) is our productized managed service security offer for SMBs, built entirely on Microsoft tooling. It is aimed at companies with 50 to 200 employees who have little or no internal IT team. Take a look before you apply.

The product is about a year old. It is live, it has paying clients, and it works. What it has not had yet is a proper marketing engine behind it. That is the core focus of this role.

About The Role

You will report directly to our Chief Revenue Officer and work alongside our SEO specialist. Your focus will be almost entirely on Secure Managed Service: taking a proven offer and building the demand to scale it.

• Offers and positioning. Build and test the reasons a company switches provider or buys security properly for the first time.

• Nurture and email. Own the nurture sequences, lead scoring and follow-up, from first contact to a booked call.

• Traffic and conversion. Grow qualified traffic through content, organic search and LinkedIn, and own what the site converts.

• Content and creative. Comparison pages, pricing explainers, switching guides, plus simple infographics and short-form video (with potential for paid external support).

• LinkedIn. Build the brand presence and drive traffic to our website from LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

• 3+ years in B2B marketing, with at least two of those owning a funnel rather than supporting one.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, IT services or an adjacent technical category.

• Verifiable proof of growth success. One funnel you owned and the numbers that came with it.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Hands-on with a marketing automation platform. We use HubSpot for reference.

• Comfortable working autonomously in a remote team.

Helpful but not essential: Experience marketing to companies that buy through a managed service provider, paid ads experience, outbound and direct marketing experience.

Location & Package

This is a fully remote, full-time position. We are looking for candidates in Latin America, with Argentina preferred.

Working in or close to our Toronto time zone matters, as that is where the business runs.

We offer a competitive salary, potential for a performance bonus tied to measured impact, an annual review, fifteen days paid time off plus public holidays, an equipment budget and a learning budget.

postings.title: Especialista en Venta de Membresías y Crecimiento en YouTube
postings.descriptionText:
Especialista en Venta de Membresías y Crecimiento de YouTube

Modalidad remota | Part-time (2–3 horas diarias) | USD 500 mensuales + incentivos por resultados

Buscamos una persona con experiencia demostrable en marketing de productos digitales y crecimiento de canales de YouTube, que asuma la responsabilidad de impulsar dos proyectos que ya están en funcionamiento y tienen gran potencial de crecimiento.

La posición combina estrategia, ejecución y coordinación de recursos, con objetivos medibles y oportunidades de incrementar la compensación en función de los resultados.

1. Crecimiento comercial de una comunidad digital

Contamos con una comunidad de pago especializada en marketing digital, LinkedIn y posicionamiento de marca personal. Es un producto validado, con clientes y una propuesta de valor consolidada.

El objetivo es aumentar la adquisición de nuevos miembros mediante acciones de marketing consistentes y medibles.

Responsabilidades

• Desarrollar y ejecutar un plan de adquisición de leads y nuevos miembros para la comunidad.

• Identificar y activar oportunidades de visibilidad mediante colaboraciones, podcasts, redes sociales, alianzas y otros canales relevantes.

• Proponer e implementar campañas y acciones promocionales aprovechando el contenido y los recursos existentes.

• Crear copies y materiales sencillos de marketing, coordinando con el equipo los recursos de diseño y edición necesarios.

• Hacer seguimiento de leads, conversiones y ventas, identificando oportunidades para mejorar los resultados.

2. Crecimiento del canal de YouTube

Tenemos un canal activo con contenido publicado y capacidad de generar nuevas grabaciones. Buscamos desarrollar una estrategia de crecimiento orgánico que permita ampliar su audiencia y aprovechar mejor el contenido.

Responsabilidades

• Diseñar y ejecutar una estrategia de crecimiento basada en el análisis del canal y de oportunidades de contenido.

• Planificar videos largos, Shorts, series y otros formatos que favorezcan el crecimiento y la retención de audiencia.

• Optimizar títulos, miniaturas, descripciones y otros elementos que influyen en el rendimiento del contenido.

• Coordinar grabaciones, editores y diseñadores para mantener un calendario de publicaciones consistente.

• Analizar métricas de crecimiento y rendimiento para ajustar continuamente la estrategia.

3. Forma de trabajo

Buscamos una persona autónoma, organizada y orientada a resultados, que pueda hacerse responsable de que ambos proyectos avancen de forma constante.

Se espera que la persona seleccionada

• Organice sus prioridades y ejecute acciones concretas cada día.

• Coordine con el equipo las tareas de producción que requieran apoyo especializado.

• Presente un breve seguimiento semanal de acciones realizadas, resultados y próximos pasos.

• Trabaje con KPIs mensuales definidos conjuntamente, tanto para adquisición de miembros como para crecimiento de YouTube. Se construirán en conjunto con la persona seleccionada.

No se trata de una posición exclusivamente consultiva. La persona deberá involucrarse directamente en la implementación, sin necesidad de realizar personalmente las tareas especializadas de edición audiovisual o diseño.

4. Perfil requerido

• Experiencia demostrable en adquisición de leads o ventas de productos digitales, preferiblemente comunidades de pago, membresías, cursos o programas de formación.

• Experiencia comprobable en crecimiento de canales de YouTube, con resultados medibles (se solicitarán links de los canales manejado sy explicacion de su intervencion en dicho crecimiento)

• Conocimiento de estrategias de contenido, distribución orgánica y conversión.

• Capacidad para redactar contenidos comerciales y coordinar proyectos con autonomía.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de analítica y seguimiento de resultados.

• Excelente comunicación en español y conocimiento del mercado latinoamericano.

Se valorará positivamente el dominio del inglés.

No exigimos una cantidad específica de años de experiencia. Nos interesan especialmente las personas con iniciativa, capacidad de ejecución y resultados demostrables.

5. Compensación y oportunidades de crecimiento

• Honorarios fijos iniciales de USD 500 mensuales.

• Dedicación estimada de 2 a 3 horas diarias, con flexibilidad para organizar el trabajo.

• Incentivos variables vinculados a KPIs definidos conjuntamente, con objetivos alcanzables y transparentes.

• Comisiones adicionales por ventas de membresías atribuibles a las acciones desarrolladas.

• Posibilidad de aumentar progresivamente la compensación según resultados y evolución de los proyectos.

Buscamos construir una colaboración a largo plazo en la que el crecimiento de ambos proyectos también se traduzca en mejores oportunidades económicas para la persona responsable.

6. Postulación

Para postularse, es indispensable enviar, además del CV o perfil profesional, dos ejemplos concretos de experiencia.

Caso 1 — YouTube. Un canal en cuyo crecimiento haya participado directamente, incluyendo enlace, métricas iniciales y finales, período de trabajo y acciones implementadas.

Caso 2 — Producto digital. Un proyecto en el que haya contribuido a generar leads o ventas para un producto digital, explicando las acciones desarrolladas y los resultados conseguidos.

Las candidaturas deberán incluir resultados verificables. Valoraremos especialmente la participación directa en la ejecución, no solamente en la planificación de estrategias.

• A sense of ownership: you can set the strategy, execute it yourself, and challenge assumptions with evidence.

Experience in jewelry, fashion, beauty, or another visual consumer category is a plus. Success in this role means more customers making a second purchase, stronger retention and loyalty, better automated journeys, and a clearer understanding of what drives those results.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best-in-class, with a high IQ and EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team. Our Marketing Growth team runs consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers promoting subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, RCS/SMS, in-app messages, and landing pages.

This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well-suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions are made.

Answer questions with data

postings.title: SEO/AEO Manager ($30k-$80k, remote OK)
postings.descriptionText:
About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO and answer engine optimisation (AEO) agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne).
We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by companies including Instantly, Granola, Composio and other Series A+ B2B SaaS businesses to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.
We do this through content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification, including PR, backlinks and Reddit marketing.
View recent case studies at discoveredlabs.com/case-studies.

High-level overview of our approach:

• AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution.

• Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar, and remain responsible for the work our tools help produce.

• Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes.

Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!

This role

SEO/AEO is already Discovered Labs' top pipeline driver, generating millions in recurring revenue. We're hiring an experienced SEO/AEO Manager who can work confidently with data, run our content workflows, off-page programs and personally ship website improvements (using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code) to grow the qualified opportunities it generates.

You'll report to Liam and agree commercial goals and quarterly direction with him. You'll own day-to-day prioritisation, delivery and reporting. Using and improving our existing methodology, proprietary tools and workflows, you'll diagnose performance, choose priorities and carry work through implementation and measurement.

Your primary outcome is qualified inbound pipeline: relevant buyers discovering us through search and becoming sales opportunities. Keyword positions, relevant organic traffic and AI visibility help you understand whether the work is moving in the right direction.

This is a full-time individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role is fully remote, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT.

Everyone on the Discovered Labs team is tech savvy and data-driven, even if they didn’t start that way. If you have curiosity and the willingness to learn, you’ll thrive here.

What you'll do

You'll run our SEO/AEO programme to generate qualified inbound pipeline, with new content, refreshes and off-page campaigns tied to our pillar and cluster strategy.

• Develop our pillar and cluster strategy: Maintain our money-keyword universe, group queries by search intent and map priority clusters to target pages, using semantic clustering where useful.

• Close topic gaps with new content: Run the weekly content loop through our proprietary tools, keeping at least two weeks of approved assignments scheduled against editorial capacity and resolving SEO issues in briefs and drafts. Editors handle QA and publishing.

• Manage content refreshes: Diagnose content decay, underperformance and cannibalisation. Prepare blog refresh briefs covering keyword targeting, topic coverage and internal linking, then verify the changes and measure results.

• Build and optimise landing pages: Personally create and improve pages using coding agents and our GitHub repository. Submit tested pull requests and verify live changes.

• Fix technical SEO issues: Diagnose and fix issues with crawlability, indexation, internal linking, metadata and structured data. Test changes, verify live results and escalate complex engineering work.

• Own our off-page strategy: Define how targeted link building, Reddit and YouTube support our priority topics and objectives. Brief the specialists who produce the deliverables, review their work and use results to refine the strategy.

• Close AI visibility and citation gaps: Use embeddings and entity analysis where useful to investigate how AI answers represent and cite Discovered Labs. Test changes against the gaps you find.

• Build tools that improve delivery: Create and validate scripts, automations and AI workflows for recurring research, analysis and measurement.

• Connect every action to an objective: Tie each tactic to an overarching strategy and a clear objective: improving performance on commercial keywords, earning AI Overview placements, strengthening brand positioning or generating qualified pipeline. Measure progress against those objectives and use results to decide what to prioritise next.

The ideal person for this role

• You make commercial SEO decisions. You can choose whether to create, refresh or consolidate content by weighing search intent, existing performance and relevance to the buyers we want to reach.

• You investigate before concluding. When performance changes, you check competing explanations across content, technical and off-page factors, and distinguish evidence from a plausible story.

• You turn investigation into implementation. You can take an SEO problem through analysis, a tested website change or a completed content workflow, and measurement of the result. You know which work needs editorial QA or engineering support and arrive with the work ready for that handoff.

• You enjoy the technical detail. You're curious about embeddings, entities and how content relates semantically. You explore the data, build small tools to test ideas and judge the work by whether it improves a useful decision or outcome.

Requirements

• Demonstrated SEO execution, with examples of work you personally diagnosed, prioritised and implemented, the results and how you measured them.

• Experience independently translating business goals into search strategy and a practical delivery plan.

• Working fluency in Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or an equivalent research tool, and a crawler such as Screaming Frog. You use them to investigate performance and check figures at source.

• Practical ability to build and improve website pages and make technical SEO changes using coding agents and GitHub, demonstrated through previous work or an exercise.

• An AI-assisted tool, script or workflow you've built or materially adapted to solve a real problem. Explain the decisions you made, what AI contributed, how you verified the code, data or output, and what improved.

• Evidence of rigorous SEO analysis that led to an implemented change: explain the data you used, the competing explanations you checked, your decision and how you measured the result.

• Reliable delivery tracking in a project management tool such as ClickUp, with clear actions, complete handoffs and documentation others can use.

• Excellent verbal and written English.

•

Nice-to-haves (not required)

• Familiarity with B2B or B2B SaaS. Strong candidates from other SEO backgrounds are welcome.

• Agency experience or experience coordinating editors and specialist contributors.

• Deeper Python, SQL, statistics or applied machine-learning skills.

• Experience measuring AI visibility, analysing citations or running link-building and Reddit programmes.

•

This role is not for you if…
• Your work ends with an audit or plan. We need someone who implements changes, resolves blockers and checks what happened afterwards.

• You treat traffic or citation counts as the final result. We expect you to connect search performance to relevant buyers and qualified opportunities.

• You ship AI output you cannot explain or verify. You remain responsible for the analysis, recommendations and code you use.

•

Culture fitYou'll thrive here if:
• You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy.

• You're curious about how search is changing and willing to test ideas against evidence.

• You communicate risks early and welcome a clear challenge to your recommendation.

You won't thrive here if:
• You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions before acting.

• You protect a perfect plan instead of delivering, learning and improving.

• You need a large team around you before you can produce useful work.

What's in it for you
• Compensation: $30K - $80K USD (or GBP/EUR equivalent), depending on relevant skills and experience.

• Fully remote: Work from where you do your best work, ideally within ±4 hours of GMT.

• Real autonomy: Make daily prioritisation and execution decisions, with direct access to Liam for strategic direction.

• Our in-house tools and methodology: Learn the proprietary SEO/AEO systems built by our engineers, apply them to our own growth and help improve them. We'll teach you our systems.

• Depth and visible impact: Build expertise across organic growth, technical SEO and applied analysis through sustained ownership of a programme whose results you can follow over time.

• Paid leave holidays

Interview process
• Async assessment (15 minutes)

• 30 minute call with founder

• 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work

• 3 hour paid assessment

• Reference checks with former peers and managers.

To apply Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail.

Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles.

TikTok moves fast, and so do we.

As our TikTok Content Manager, you'll take ownership of TikTok content strategy, planning, publishing, and performance. You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement.

Manage Content Production

postings.title: Content & Community Lead
postings.descriptionText:
CONTENT & COMMUNITY LEAD @ FANZ
Remoto con presencialidad en eventos · AMBA · Full-time · Reportás directo al CEO.

VAS A SER LA VOZ DE FANZ. Y VAS A AYUDAR A ARMAR EL EQUIPO QUE LA AMPLIFIQUE.

La mayoría de los puestos de contenido son esto: entrás a un equipo de marketing ya armado, te dan un calendario, un brief y una lista de aprobadores, y tu trabajo es llenar casilleros. Nadie te pregunta qué comunicar ni por qué. Y cuando la empresa crece, vos seguís siendo la persona que hace los reels.

Acá es distinto por tres razones:

• Hoy no hay equipo de marketing. Lo estamos armando, y vos sos la primera pieza. Vas a tener voz y voto sobre quién se suma después, y vas a estructurar las bases del área desde cero: cómo se produce, qué se cuenta, con qué criterio. Lo que armes ahora es lo que va a escalar después.

• Sos la voz de la empresa y de sus founders. Producto, clientes, equipo, cultura, lanzamientos, nuevos roles, testimonials. Toda la comunicación de Fanz pasa por vos, y la de los founders también. No hay agencia ni intermediarios: la estrategia y la ejecución son tuyas.

• Trabajás palo a palo con el CEO. Daily con los dos founders, 1:1 semanal con el CEO y acceso directo al CTO cuando sale una feature. No te enterás de las cosas cuando ya pasaron: estás adentro cuando se deciden.

Si tenés cabeza para pensar la comunicación de una empresa entera, y manos para producirla vos, seguí leyendo.

QUIÉNES SOMOS Y CÓMO TRABAJAMOS

Fanz es el sistema operativo para organizadores de eventos: ticketing, marca, sitio web, marketing, soporte, automatizaciones, pagos y datos en una sola plataforma. Hoy tenemos el mejor software de la industria por lejos, y trabajamos con los organizadores más grandes de Argentina mientras abrimos Uruguay, México, Chile, Colombia y Perú.

Triplicamos revenue en 12 meses con 15 personas, y apuntamos a ser 50 en los próximos 12. Somos pocos a propósito: construimos todas nuestras herramientas in-house, con agentes de IA en cada proceso.

Para vos, eso significa que la materia prima ya está: cientos de eventos por semana, cientos de features, clientes grandes con casos reales, un equipo que vale la pena mostrar y un brandbook profesional. Lo que no está es la comunicación. Quedó en pausa, y eso hoy nos cuesta en tres frentes: los clientes que no nos conocen, el talento que no sabe que existimos y los inversores que no nos ven. La persona que prenda ese motor destraba las tres cosas a la vez.

Tres cosas que vas a notar rápido:

Impacto directo . Cada pieza que sale mueve algo concreto: una demo agendada, una postulación, un mensaje de un inversor. Vas a ver el efecto de tu trabajo en el negocio, no en un dashboard de likes.

Transparente . Daily report en Slack con los founders. Sabés qué funciona y qué no en tiempo real, y decidís en base a eso.

Full ownership . Autonomía pura, cero micromanagement. Vos definís qué se comunica, cómo y cuándo. Y lo producís: grabás, te ponés en cámara, editás y publicás. Cada persona se gana su lugar todos los días.

QUÉ VAS A HACER

Tus tres responsabilidades, en orden de importancia:

• Ser la voz de Fanz y de sus founders. Estrategia, calendario y ejecución en todas las redes de la empresa. Ghostwriting de los founders en LinkedIn y X, y guiones para su contenido hablado. Comunicación de cada lanzamiento de producto, cada nuevo rol, cada hito.

• Producir el contenido que muestra lo que somos. Ponerte en cámara explicando features. Ir a los eventos de nuestros clientes mientras suceden y contar lo que pasó con números reales. Sentarte con dueños de venues y grabar sus testimonials. Mostrar al equipo y cómo se trabaja acá.

• Armar las bases del equipo de marketing. Definir cómo se produce, con qué criterio y qué falta. Participar en la decisión de quién se suma al área y en cómo se estructura a medida que crece.

Lo que no vas a hacer: vender, dar soporte, implementar clientes ni esperar que alguien te diga qué publicar.

A QUIÉN BUSCAMOS

• Pensás contenido todo el tiempo. Ves una feature, un evento, una contratación, y ya sabés cómo contarlo.

• Tenés criterio para representar a una empresa y a sus fundadores. Lo que sale con tu firma tiene nivel profesional, siempre.

• Producís vos: grabás, te ponés delante de la cámara, editás y publicás. De la idea al post sin intermediarios.

• Querés armar un área, no ocupar un puesto. Te motiva que hoy haya una hoja en blanco.

• Vivís en AMBA y te copa estar en eventos, incluso de noche.

• Usás IA en tu trabajo diario. Acá todos lo hacemos.

• Suma: contenido para B2B, SaaS o marcas de eventos, gastronomía, entretenimiento o deportes.

Además:

• Remoto con grabaciones presenciales en venues y eventos. Viáticos cubiertos.

• Camarógrafo de apoyo en los venues principales.

• Cuentas de Claude/ChatGPT y brandbook completo desde el día uno.

• Trial de 3 meses con objetivos claros. Los cumplís, te quedás.

• Un evento presencial por mes en Buenos Aires y uno online.

CÓMO APLICAR

Aplicá directo acá en LinkedIn. En el mensaje de tu postulación mandanos el link a un video en el que aparezcas vos explicando algo, y contanos en 3 líneas qué es lo primero que comunicarías de Fanz si arrancaras mañana.

postings.title: SEO Specialist: AI Search
postings.descriptionText:
About Dialpad

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic .

Your role

As an SEO Specialist: AI Search, you'll work closely with the Sr. Manager, SEO, to implement tactics that increase Dialpad's visibility in AI search, also known as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) or AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). You'll implement tactics directly on our website and partner with cross-functional teams to increase visibility on external sites, with the goal of getting Dialpad mentioned and cited in AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. You'll grow your skills in SEO and GEO/AEO, gaining hands-on experience with an exciting marketing discipline as people change how they search from Google to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and other LLMs.

This position reports to our Sr. Manager, SEO, and has the opportunity to be based in our Buenos Aires office.

What You’ll Do

• Implement GEO/AEO/SEO tactics as assigned to accelerate Dialpad’s AI search results and visibility, and increase leads and pipeline from organic search and LLMs.

• Using AI tools, generate and edit content for GEO/AEO, then publish it to our website.

• Work with design to update existing images and create new visuals for content.

• Implement GEO tests, and may support CRO testing.

• Support efforts to grow external visibility on the Web, including outreach/backlinking, and partnering with PR and Social teams, including engagement on channels like Reddit.

• Use AI tools and platforms (e.g. LLMs, Ahrefs, AI visibility tools) to support the work mentioned above, which could include keyword/prompt research, competitive analysis of SERPs/prompt responses, and monitoring of rankings/mentions/citations.

• Stay current on GEO/AEO best practices and tools as the discipline evolves.

Skills You’ll Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Psychology, or a related field.

• 2+ years of SEO experience or marketing communications experience.

• Experience writing, editing, and publishing website content.

• Skilled in using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.).

• Experience working with a B2B SaaS company is desirable.

Why Join Dialpad

• Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications

• Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate

• Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact

• Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

postings.descriptionText:
The Role

We're looking for an experienced Email Campaign Manager to own and execute email marketing campaigns for a high-volume Kitchen & Bath remodeling company.

Your primary responsibility will be managing our email campaigns and customer lists from end to end — including audience segmentation, campaign strategy, email design, automation, deployment, tracking, reporting, and optimization.

You'll work primarily in GoHighLevel (GHL) and will be responsible for making sure the right message reaches the right audience at the right time.

This is an execution-focused, data-driven marketing role . We're looking for someone who understands that successful email marketing isn't just about making emails look good — it's about generating engagement, leads, appointments, and revenue.

Compensation & Growth

Months 1–3: Email Campaign Coordinator — $6/hour

Month 3 onward: Email Campaign Manager — $8/hour

The first 3 months are designed to help you learn our brand, audience, systems, and campaign processes while managing campaigns hands-on.

Upon successfully meeting expectations, you'll transition into the Email Campaign Manager role with greater ownership over campaign strategy, performance, and optimization.

What You'll Own

Email Campaign Management

• Plan, build, schedule, and launch email campaigns from start to finish

• Manage newsletters, promotional campaigns, nurture campaigns, re-engagement campaigns, and customer communications

• Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and deadlines

• Ensure campaigns are properly tested before deployment

Audience Segmentation & List Management

• Build and maintain targeted audience segments based on customer data, behavior, engagement, lead status, and other criteria

• Manage email lists and ensure proper organization and data hygiene

• Identify opportunities to improve targeting and personalization

• Monitor list health, engagement, unsubscribes, and other important metrics

Automation & Workflows

• Build and maintain automated email sequences and workflows in GoHighLevel

• Create triggers, conditions, wait steps, and actions based on customer behavior and campaign objectives

• Troubleshoot workflow and automation issues

• Continuously improve existing automations based on performance data

Email Design & Content

• Build professional, conversion-focused emails within GHL

• Follow brand guidelines while creating clean and effective email layouts

• Work with existing copy and use AI tools when appropriate to improve or scale content production

• Optimize subject lines, calls-to-action, messaging, and email structure for engagement

Tracking, Reporting & Optimization

• Monitor campaign performance and maintain accurate reporting

• Track key metrics including open rate, click-through rate (CTR), conversions, leads, appointments, unsubscribes, and campaign ROI where applicable

• Identify what is working, what isn't, and what needs to change

• Use performance data to continuously improve future campaigns

• Provide clear, actionable campaign reports to management

You'll Be a Strong Fit If You

• Have hands-on experience managing email marketing campaigns and customer lists

• Are highly experienced with GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM/email marketing platform

• Understand audience segmentation, email automation, workflows, and list management

• Can independently build and launch email campaigns from start to finish

• Understand email marketing metrics and can explain what the numbers mean

• Are comfortable working with data and using it to make campaign decisions

• Have an eye for clean, professional email design

• Have a strong understanding of B2C marketing and lead generation

• Can manage multiple campaigns without losing attention to detail

• Have a problem-solving and optimization mindset

• Are comfortable using AI tools to improve campaign production, analysis, and reporting

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in email marketing, campaign management, CRM marketing, or B2C lead generation

• Strong hands-on experience with email campaign platforms and automation

• Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is highly preferred

• Proven experience with audience segmentation and email list management

• Experience building and managing automated email workflows

• Strong understanding of email marketing KPIs and reporting

• Experience with A/B testing and campaign optimization is a plus

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously

• Experience in home services, remodeling, or high-volume B2C marketing is a plus

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

The right audience → receives the right message → at the right time → through the right automation → and the results are measured and improved.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply send emails. You should be able to look at campaign data, identify opportunities, and make changes that improve performance.

About Us

We're a family-owned kitchen, bath, and flooring remodeling company based in Southern California. We've been in business for over 40 years and continue to grow.

Our mission is simple: improve people's lives by transforming their spaces and making the remodeling experience fun and hassle-free.

Why You'll Want to Stay

• Weekly pay

• Paid vacation

• National holiday bonus

• Year-end bonus

• Referral bonus

• Contests and spiffs

• Real opportunities for growth

• Continued education and training

Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio.

AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions.

Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences.

We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success.

We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next.

Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology.

We are building that future today.

postings.title: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:

• Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.

• Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.

• Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.

Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact

• Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.

• Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.

• Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.

• Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.

What We’re Looking For

• The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.

• The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.

• The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.

• The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.

What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

• Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Parental Leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Go-to-market Content Development Manager - Assistant Director - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
The GTM Content Development Manager is an embedded content and sales enablement role supporting the USLI CCaSS team. The role will be responsible for identifying priority go-to-market and sales-content needs, translating complex propositions into clear business narratives, and developing or tailoring high-quality assets for internal education and client conversations. The role will own an insight-led content plan and delivery cadence that equips client-facing teams with consistent, relevant and easy-to-use materials, supports campaign and event activation. The person will use stakeholder feedback and available performance data to continuously improve content effectiveness. The role will work closely with CCaSS and GTM leaders, subject-matter resources, client-facing teams, Business Development, BMC, Insights and other relevant teams to plan and deliver on these GTM and sales content development priorities.

Your key responsibilities

Research

• Engage USLI CCaSS stakeholders to clarify business objectives, GTM / sales priorities, buyer needs, differentiators, intended use cases and required outcomes before content planning and development begins.

• Collaborate with other teams to find and/or conduct focused research on priority CCaSS themes, client issues, market developments, competitor positioning and relevant campaigns to inform content direction.

• Identify, assess and reuse existing Global, regional and cross-SL assets where appropriate, avoiding duplication and highlighting content gaps that require new development.

• Work with CCaSS subject-matter resources to understand complex offerings and validate the accuracy, relevance and recency of messages, evidence and supporting materials.

• Maintain awareness of emerging topics, content practices and formats and appropriate technology, including AI-enabled tools, that can improve content quality and speed of delivery.

Develop or tailor GTM and sales content

• Develop, co-develop, tailor and localize client and sales content for priority topics, adapting messages for the relevant audience, market, formats, channel and stage of the client conversation. Asset formats could be (but not limited to) client discussion decks, session decks, strategy and account decks, placemats, talk tracks, solution briefs, sales toolkits, client emailers, newsletters, thought leadership, event materials and self-serve guidance.

• Translate complex technical and solution information into concise, business-centric narratives, compelling value propositions and practical conversation guides for client-facing teams.

• Build content for campaigns and events, including materials that educate client-facing teams, create awareness and help teams conduct effective needs-based client conversations.

• Prepare modular, updated self-service packs of sales assets, templates, tools and guidance, and ensure clear version control and ease of use.

Project and operations management

• Create and maintain a prioritized GTM content calendar and execution plan aligned with CCaSS priorities, campaigns, events and client-facing / account team needs.

• Own and monitor end-to-end content development projects, including scoping, kick-off, workplans, timelines, dependencies, review cycles, approvals, risks and next steps.

• Manage the content demand pipeline, prioritize requests with stakeholders and balance planned activity with time-sensitive business needs.

• Coordinate multi-stakeholder working sessions and reviews; clarify objectives, document decisions and drive actions through to completion.

• Apply quality-control checks for accuracy, coherence, brand and SCORE alignment, accessibility and readiness before publication or distribution.

• Manage content libraries and distribution channels so that current, approved assets are easy to find across relevant portals and collaboration sites (Discover, SharePoint sites, TEAMs).

Relationship and influencing

• Build and maintain trusted working relationships across the USLI CCaSS stakeholder ecosystem.

• Act as a trusted content adviser to stakeholders, providing clear recommendations, constructively challenging requests where appropriate, and influencing decisions through evidence-based storytelling.

• Facilitate discussions to align priorities, messages, audience needs, ownership and review responsibilities across a working group.

• Connect with Global and other Region content and demand generation communities to share assets, adopt relevant practices and reduce duplication.

• Work effectively across geographies and time zones, maintaining responsive, clear and professional communication.

Impact measurement

• Define practical success measures for content initiatives, such as adoption, usage, stakeholder feedback, client-facing team readiness and contribution to campaign or sales activity, using available data and within agreed attribution and/or influence boundaries.

• Gather structured feedback from client-facing teams and stakeholders to understand asset relevance, usability and gaps.

• Use available dashboards, distribution data and qualitative insights to track effectiveness and relevance of assets across their lifecycle.

• Present clear observations and recommendations to leadership and maintain a continuous-improvement backlog for priority content.

Skills and attributes for success

• Strong understanding of B2B GTM and demand generation, with demonstrated experience developing and tailoring content for different audiences, channels and stages of the client conversation.

• Excellent business writing, editing, storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics.

• Strong research, synthesis and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to distinguish useful evidence from noise and identify content gaps.

• Strong stakeholder, project and matrix-management capabilities, with the ability to influence senior audiences and coordinate delivery across multiple teams and geographies.

• Working knowledge of professional services and CCaSS or Sustainability-related topics is an advantage.

• Collaborative and self-directed professional with strong curiosity, sound judgement, cultural awareness and the ability to balance creativity, accuracy, stakeholder needs and delivery discipline.

Academics and experience

• University degree required; MBA or master’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field is desirable but not required

• Approximately 8-10 years of relevant business experience for an Assistant Director role, including substantial experience in GTM content, sales enablement, marketing, business development, or related work.

• Experience working in a large, global and multi-stakeholder organization; professional services experience is preferred.

• Portfolio or demonstrated examples of high-quality B2B narrative and sales-content development are desirable.

Technologies and tools

• Advanced capability in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word, with strong working knowledge of Excel and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint.

• Working knowledge of Co-pilot and other GenAI-enabled productivity tools, data visualization or reporting tools, and marketing or content-management platforms is desirable.

• Ability to apply technology responsibly to improve research, drafting, quality control, reuse and content operations.

Note: This job description reflects the principal purpose and responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may vary based on business priorities, location and management requirements.

Hey there!

postings.descriptionText:
En Humand ayudamos a las empresas a digitalizar sus procesos de comunicación interna, cultura y recursos humanos en un solo lugar.

¿Querés ser parte del cambio hacia la búsqueda con IA? 🚀

Humand está en busca de un SEO Specialist: AI Search para liderar la visibilidad de la marca tanto en buscadores tradicionales como en herramientas de IA como ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini y Google AI Overviews. Desempeñarás un rol clave en el crecimiento de leads y pipeline desde orgánico y LLMs, con foco en LATAM y prioridad en Argentina y México.

🎯 Tu rol

Como SEO Specialist: AI Search, vas a trabajar codo a codo con el Gerente de Web para implementar tácticas que aumenten la visibilidad de Humand tanto en búsqueda tradicional como en búsqueda con IA (lo que se conoce como GEO — Generative Engine Optimization — o AEO — Answer Engine Optimization).

Vas a implementar tácticas directamente en nuestro sitio y también vas a trabajar de forma transversal con otros equipos para aumentar la visibilidad en sitios externos, con el objetivo de que Humand aparezca mencionado y citado en herramientas de IA como ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini y Google AI Overviews.

Vas a crecer tus skills en SEO y en GEO/AEO, ganando experiencia hands-on en una disciplina de marketing que está en pleno auge a medida que la gente cambia la forma en la que busca información: de Google a ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini y otros LLMs.

🔑 Responsabilidades clave

• Implementar tácticas de GEO/AEO/SEO para acelerar los resultados y la visibilidad de Humand en búsqueda con IA y tradicional, e incrementar leads y pipeline desde orgánico y LLMs.

• Usando IA, generar y editar contenido para GEO/AEO (estructura, keywords, entidades, formato pregunta-respuesta), y publicarlo en el sitio, con el apoyo del equipo de Content para revisión y corrección.

• Mantenerte al día con las mejores prácticas y herramientas de GEO/AEO, dado que la disciplina evoluciona constantemente.

• Detalle

• Auditar y mejorar la salud técnica del sitio (indexación, autoridad de dominio, velocidad, estructura) usando herramientas como Semrush, Ahrefs y Screaming Frog.

• Analizar por qué Humand no aparece en búsquedas clave del sector HR en Argentina y México, y ejecutar un plan para revertirlo (incluye posicionar la keyword de marca "Humand").

• Trabajar junto a Producto/IT para priorizar e implementar mejoras técnicas que requieran desarrollo, priorizando iniciativas según esfuerzo e impacto esperado.

• Aplicar principios de autoridad temática (topical authority), SEO por entidades y E-E-A-T en la estrategia de contenido del sitio.

• Identificar y mitigar riesgos de SEO que puedan afectar la reputación de marca o la performance del dominio.

• Optimizar contenido existente del sitio (no solo crear contenido nuevo) para mejorar rankings, CTR, tráfico y conversiones.

• Analizar tráfico orgánico, embudos de conversión y atribución mediante GA4, y elaborar reportes/dashboards de KPIs para la dirección.

• Gestionar agencias o freelancers externos (backlinks, contenido), asegurando ROI y calidad de entregables.

• Conocimiento de AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) y GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), incluyendo herramientas de tracking de visibilidad/citaciones en IA, o fuerte interés y capacidad de aprendizaje dado que es un área emergente.

postings.title: Partner Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Partner Marketing Manager at Canonical

Canonical is looking for a channel marketing manager who will be responsible for developing our strategic relationships with a set of global partners . Canonical partners with the leading companies in technology across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle…), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx…), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). As our business increasingly depends on partners, the scope of our partnership grows every year (GSI, software vendors, IoT…). We are thus looking for an individual, who will not only drive successful marketing activities with our partners but also shape our partner programs.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Marketing.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

What your day will look like

• Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, from messaging to pipeline generation

• Create and deliver integrated campaigns, product launches, webinar series, industry announcements and core content in collaboration with partners.

• Package all of Canonical's product offerings and educational material creatively, from bare metal, AI, Kubernetes...

• Continue to grow Canonical's partner ecosystem by delivering partner value

• Continue to develop Canonical's partner activities to scale our partner programs

What we are looking for in you

• Experience in B2B marketing and experience working with strategic corporate partners to develop co-marketing initiatives.

• Strong customer/partner relationship management skills.

• Proven analytical skills, able to assess opportunities and make decisions on ROI/advantages of programs & investments.

• Willingness to roll up their sleeves.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

Nice-to-have Skills

• Experience in enterprise software, SaaS or silicon preferred

• Track record of delivering strong results and innovation.

• Ability to work and thrive in a self-starter, fast-paced and changing environment

• Love for diverse work assignments and the opportunity to try new approaches

• Growth mindset - someone who is not afraid to think big and take on risk.

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
