postings.title: AI-Native Executive Assistant
postings.descriptionText:
We're hiring an AI-Native Executive Assistant for a fast-growing, retention-first e-commerce marketing agency for Shopify DTC brands — one of the Klaviyo Elite Partners worldwide, and also a Shopify Plus Partner. The founder also runs a venture-backed startup building an AI operating system for retention agencies and the brands they serve.
This role exists because the founder is running two companies and currently doing his own executive support inside AI tools. You will take that over, and then do something most assistants never get to do: build the systems that make your own job smaller every quarter. This is not a calendar job with a chatbot bolted on. Half of your week is world-class executive support. The other half is engineering that support out of existence.

The Job
• Calendar and inbox as a system: full control of scheduling across two companies, triage on email and Slack, and a defensible answer at all times to "what actually needs him today."

• Meeting exhaust to closed loops: every call runs through Granola or Fireflies. You turn transcripts into action items, owners, and Asana tasks the same day, then chase them to done instead of filing them.

• Pre-call briefing: no external meeting starts cold. Partner calls, client escalations, investor conversations, and candidate interviews each get a short brief with attendee background, account history, and the three things that need to come out of the room.

• Cross-tool status retrieval: pulling a real answer out of HubSpot, Gmail, Slack, and Fireflies at once. "Where does this deal stand" should take you ten minutes and produce something forwardable.

• Correspondence in his voice: follow-ups, nudges, partner updates, close-out notes, and referral intros. You draft, he edits, and over time he edits less.

• Travel and events: conference logistics for the team. You will build a standing preferences brief in your first month so no booking decision ever gets researched from scratch twice.

• Deliverable production: one-pagers, briefing docs, case studies, and partner assets built on the brand system and produced fast enough to be useful.

• Automation build: this is the half that makes the job different. You will build Claude skills, n8n workflows, and MCP-connected pipelines that absorb recurring work: meeting notes into Asana, invoice reconciliation, notification triage, reporting pulls, onboarding sequences.

• An automation ledger: you track what you built, what it replaced, and how many hours per month it reclaimed. This is how your performance gets measured alongside the executive support itself.

• Venture-side administration: entity filings, investor and advisor correspondence, document management, and vendor coordination for the founder's startup, handled with the discretion that implies.

You're a Fit If
• You have supported a founder or senior executive for at least two years, and you have handled the unglamorous end of it: expense reports, visa paperwork, canceled flights, awkward reschedules.

• You have already built something with AI that another human being still uses. A workflow, an agent, a script, a custom GPT, an n8n automation. You can show it and explain why you built it that way.

• You work with Claude or an equivalent tool every day, not occasionally.

• You write English at a native or near-native level. Much of your output goes to clients, partners, and investors under his name.

• You work United States Eastern business hours.

• You are fluent in Asana, HubSpot, Slack, and Google Workspace, and you can teach yourself n8n and Supabase without a training plan.

• You handle compensation data, cap table documents, client contracts, and candidate feedback without anyone reminding you to.

• When you are unclear, you ask once, precisely, and then move. You do not stall and you do not guess.

Not a Fit If
• You need a task list handed to you. Most of what you will own, you will find yourself.

• You think "AI-native" means you use ChatGPT to polish emails. We mean you build things.

• Open-ended research tasks tend to expand to fill whatever time is available. A hotel booking is a thirty-minute task, and if it takes three hours we have a problem.

• You need consensus and a long runway before you act.

• You want the same job a year from now. Every task you master, you should be trying to delete.

• Automating away part of your own work feels like a threat to your job security rather than the point of it.

• You are more comfortable taking care of the team than protecting the founder's time. Both matter, but this role is unambiguously the second one.

What You Get
• Direct, high-trust partnership with a founder running two companies at once.

• Real authority over automation — you build the workflows, own the ledger, and get the credit for hours reclaimed.

• Fully remote, on a team distributed across Latin America, running on EOS.

• A front-row seat inside a top e-commerce retention agency serving DTC brands doing $2M+ in annual revenue.

Our Operating Principles
• Accountability: see it, own it, solve it, do it

• Proactivity: don't wait for direction, act

• Ownership: ask "what else can I do," not "is this my job"

• Communication: clear, direct, and frequent

• Curiosity: stay hungry, embrace change, build better

• Gratitude: notice the win and say so

• Care: for clients, teammates, and yourself

postings.descriptionText:
Anyone AI is recruiting experienced Application Security Engineers and Vulnerability Researchers for a specialized project focused on reviewing real-world software vulnerabilities, CVE reproductions, remediation approaches, and exploit verification environments.

We’re looking for security professionals with hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability research, or application security who can determine whether vulnerabilities are reproduced accurately, fixes address the actual root cause, and security tests reliably demonstrate that an exploit has been mitigated.

What You’ll Work On

You’ll review technical security tasks involving:

• CVE vulnerability reproduction

• Exploit proof-of-concepts

• Vulnerability remediation and secure coding

• Application security testing

• Docker-based vulnerability labs

• Exploit verification scripts

• Security regression testing

• CVSS, CWE, and vulnerability classification

• Environment and configuration analysis

• Edge cases and alternative attack paths

A key part of the role is determining whether a vulnerability environment accurately recreates the original attack conditions and whether a proposed fix genuinely eliminates the vulnerability without breaking legitimate functionality.

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing, or vulnerability research

• Strong understanding of CVE, CVSS, CWE, and common vulnerability classes

• Experience identifying and remediating vulnerabilities such as:

• SQL injection

• Command injection

• SSRF

• Deserialization vulnerabilities

• Buffer overflows

• Privilege escalation

• Access control issues

• Security misconfigurations

• Strong understanding of secure coding and vulnerability remediation

• Experience reviewing or developing exploit proof-of-concepts

• Experience validating whether security fixes address the root cause rather than only the immediate exploit

• Proficiency with Docker and Docker Compose

• Ability to provide clear, technically rigorous written feedback

What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Reviewing CVE reproduction environments for technical accuracy

• Determining whether vulnerabilities faithfully reproduce the original attack vector and impact

• Evaluating proposed security fixes and remediation strategies

• Reviewing test suites that verify both:

• Normal application functionality remains intact

• The original exploit no longer succeeds

• Identifying incomplete fixes and alternative exploitation paths

• Reviewing Docker environments for correct software versions, services, networking, and configuration

• Detecting potential regressions or new vulnerabilities introduced by a fix

• Providing recommendations for improving vulnerability reproductions, fixes, and verification logic

Nice to Have

• Experience maintaining exploit proof-of-concept code

• Experience writing automated security tests using tools such as:

• Python

• pwntools

• Custom exploit harnesses

• DevSecOps experience

Engagement

Work Type: Remote

Engagement: Part-time, project-based consulting

Focus: Application security, vulnerability research, CVE reproduction, and remediation

This role is ideal for security engineers who enjoy understanding how vulnerabilities actually work, reproducing exploits in controlled environments, evaluating security fixes, and identifying subtle gaps that traditional testing may miss.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

postings.title: Assistant Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Haven

Full-time | Remote

Department: Operations

Schedule: Enough daily overlap with US working hours to close loops the same day

Reports to: Account Manager

Compensation: USD $2,000 / month

About The Brand

Haven manages cabins and mountain homes in the Great Smoky Mountains and around Knoxville, Tennessee. Steep driveways, hot tubs, wood stoves, and a season that swings from quiet weeks to a full house every weekend. It is a market where property care is guest experience: a cold hot tub is a ruined anniversary.

The role

You are the person who makes sure the thing that was agreed actually happens. You work alongside our Account Managers and keep the owner side of the business moving: reading every review and turning it into a response and a next step, keeping listings accurate and live on every platform, getting owner approvals in front of owners and back again, and making sure every issue raised in Slack or Trellis ends with someone doing something about it.

When an Airbnb listing is at risk, you are the one who builds the appeal. When a property leaves us, you close it out cleanly across every tool. It is a role for someone who is happier with a closed loop than a busy inbox, and who will chase a vendor a third time without being asked.

Where you sit

You sit in Operations and work every day with our Account Managers, Dispatch, and the guest experience and field operations teams, and regularly with Finance, Revenue, vendors and local realtors. This is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone.

This role is remote and open to people anywhere in the Americas. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.

What You'll Own

• Read every review, draft responses and appeal the unfair ones when the case is there.

• Keep listing information and photos accurate across Airbnb, Guesty, Breezeway, SuiteOp and our own tools.

• Catch suspended or at-risk Airbnb listings early and build the appeal when needed.

• Get owner approvals out through Trellis, email or message, and follow up until they come back.

• Book owner stays and send owners their check-in instructions.

• Turn every tag in Slack and Trellis into a clear next step, following up with Dispatch and vendors until it is done.

• Schedule STRU fire inspections, coordinate realtor showings and close out offboardings across every tool.

• Support Finance, Revenue and the AMs on owner statements, invoice checks, pricing adjustments and damage claims.

How You'll Live Our Core Values

Five values run this company, and we hire and promote against them.

• See Something Do Something: if you spot it, it is yours. Nobody here is allowed to walk past a problem because it belongs to another team.

• Do What You Say: a commitment with a date on it is a promise. If it slips, you say so before it is late, not after.

• Own the Miss: we get things wrong. What matters is that you name it first, fix it, and make sure it cannot happen the same way twice. Nobody is punished for a miss they owned.

• Say the Hard Thing: kindly, directly and early. Silence in a meeting followed by a private complaint is the one behaviour we will not carry.

• Make It Better: leave the process, the property or the shift in better shape than you found it. Small improvements, constantly, beat big ones occasionally.

What You Bring

• Enough daily overlap with US working hours to close loops the same day.

• Written English clear enough for owner, vendor and platform correspondence, including a review response or an appeal that gets read and acted on.

• Experience with scheduling, coordination, operations or admin where you owned the follow-through.

• Comfort with everyday tools: Google Workspace, Slack, a PMS and spreadsheets.

• Familiarity with Airbnb's host side, Trellis or short-term rental operations is a plus.

• Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

What To Expect

This is a long-term team role on a strong, established global team, with structured onboarding and ongoing support.

How To Apply

Apply here — it takes about four minutes on a phone. You will answer a handful of questions written to find out what you can actually do, upload a résumé, and record a short voice note so we can hear how you sound with a guest. There is no cover letter and there is no portal account to create.

Every single applicant hears back from us, including a no. If we are not moving forward we will tell you, and we will tell you why. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, email careers@stayd.co — asking never counts against you.

By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.

Convoy Finance is a small finance and accounting firm working with tech startups, crypto-native companies, and established Canadian businesses .

We're a team of around nine people. Most of the team is in Toronto, with a few people working remotely from different parts of the world.

We're a fast-paced, client-focused team . Our clients are growing companies, so things move quickly and priorities can change. We're small, which means there isn't much bureaucracy and you'll work directly with the people making decisions.

The Role

We're hiring an Executive Assistant / Operations person to work closely with two of our partners and help keep things moving.

You'll manage calendars and inboxes, follow up on action items, coordinate meetings, help with client onboarding and invoicing, and keep documents and other admin work organized.

You'll also get involved in whatever needs to be done to support our clients and the team. Some days will be straightforward, while other days will require you to figure something out quickly and get it done .

This is not a role where you'll be given a checklist every morning. We're looking for someone who can take ownership, move quickly and stay on top of multiple priorities .

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a few years of experience in an Executive Assistant, Operations, Administrative or similar role . You're comfortable working in English and communicating with senior people and clients.

You're organized, reliable and proactive . You follow things through, pay attention to details and don't wait to be asked about every next step.

Experience working with founders or executives would be great. Startup or professional services experience is also a plus. Experience with client onboarding, invoicing, Asana, DocuSign or similar tools is helpful, but we can teach you our systems.

We're remote-friendly, but we're not a work-in-a-silo kind of company . You'll work closely with a team that's mostly based in Toronto, so communication, responsiveness and reliability are important.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want a role where you can keep learning, take real ownership and grow beyond traditional accounting , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

USD 1,300-1,800 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time independent contractor position .

How To Apply

Send us your resume and a brief overview of your experience.

We'd love to hear from you.

About The Company

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.

The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Founder Support

• Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions

• Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients

• Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments

• Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making

• Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion

Vendor Relationship Management

• Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations

• Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits

• Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary

• Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records

• Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership

Operational Systems & Technology

• Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms

• Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding

• Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology

• Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable

Process Design & Operational Improvement

• Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes

• Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation

• Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards

• Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth

Financial & Administrative Management

• Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances

• Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits

• Maintain organized financial and administrative records

• Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning

Business Development & Revenue Support

• Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control

• Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities

• Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing

• Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team

• Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials

• Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships

• Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination

• Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process

Qualifications

Required

• 3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support

• Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision

• Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination

• Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary

• Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms

• Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency

• A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth

• Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment

• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace

• Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours

Preferred

• Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment

• Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities

• Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion

• Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social commerce operations

• Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch

• Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation

• Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies

What Success Looks Like

• Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled

• Executive calendars, communications, and administrative responsibilities run smoothly with minimal supervision

• Vendor relationships are professionally managed, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs

• Operational systems and workflows become increasingly efficient through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement

• The business development team receives meaningful support through prospect research, outreach, pipeline management, and sales preparation

• You consistently identify opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and contribute to the company's growth without waiting for instructions

Who We're Looking For

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

postings.title: Sales & Marketing Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Builder Lead Converter

Sales & Marketing Manager

Remote | Full-Time | Monday-Friday

Salary: $2,800-$3,500 per month, with eligibility for quarterly performance bonuses, profit sharing opportunities , paid time off, and floating holidays

About Builder Lead Converter

Builder Lead Converter helps home builders improve lead generation, Sales follow-up, customer engagement, and business growth through proven Marketing systems, technology, and training.

We are growing quickly and looking for a Sales & Marketing Manager who can bring structure, accountability, and consistent execution to our Sales and Marketing efforts.

This is not a role for someone who wants to personally handle every Marketing task or focus only on closing Sales. We need a strong manager who can turn ideas into clear plans, coordinate people and priorities, track results, and keep important initiatives moving forward.

This role oversees both Builder Lead Converter's internal sales and marketing execution and the delivery of client-facing marketing services. The manager will ensure internal growth initiatives and client campaigns have clear priorities, owners, timelines, handoffs, performance visibility, and accountability.

The Visionary will continue to own market direction, strategic partnerships, webinars, major opportunities, and high-level sales vision. Marketing specialists will continue to own technical and channel execution. This role will own the planning, coordination, management, accountability, and execution system connecting those areas.

The right person will be proactive, organized, resourceful, and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial company where everyone takes ownership and contributes to growth.

This position reports to the Integrator and works closely with the Visionary, Leadership Team, Account Management, Client Operations, and Marketing specialists.

What You Will Do

• Lead and manage our remote Marketing team.

• Turn company goals into clear quarterly Sales and Marketing priorities.

• Build and maintain a rolling 90-day calendar for campaigns, webinars, content, partnerships, offers, and launches.

• Assign responsibilities, deadlines, and priorities across the team.

• Run weekly meetings, one-on-one check-ins, and accountability follow-ups.

• Coordinate campaign launches and make sure all messaging, creative assets, landing pages, follow-up, and tracking are ready.

• Oversee the operating cadence and delivery visibility for client-facing marketing services.

• Ensure client campaigns have clear priorities, owners, deadlines, dependencies, tracking, and follow-through.

• Work with Account Management to identify client risks, missed commitments, capacity issues, performance concerns, and delivery blockers.

• Improve consistency, accountability, quality, and communication across internal and client-facing marketing work.

• Maintain visibility into Marketing team capacity and ensure internal initiatives and client deliverables are prioritized appropriately.

• Connect Marketing activity to leads, lead sources, MQLs, SQLs, first appointments, opportunities, conversion rates, and revenue. Maintain visibility into the sales pipeline, lead follow-up, appointments, opportunities, conversion performance, and revenue forecast.

• Ensure Sales has the messaging, assets, offers, landing pages, nurture, follow-up processes, and reporting needed to convert demand.

• Initially coordinate sales follow-up and accountability, and help establish the operating structure for future Sales hires.

• Maintain simple scorecards and reports that show what is working and where improvement is needed.

• Coordinate with leadership, Account Managers, Client Operations, Marketing specialists, future Sales hires, and other delivery teams to ensure both BLC initiatives and client-facing marketing work are executed consistently.

• Identify roadblocks early and help the team solve them.

• Improve workflows, documentation, communication, and follow-through.

• Bring recommendations and solutions, not just problems.

• Make sure projects are completed accurately, on time, and at a high standard.

• Partner with Client Operations to ensure client-facing marketing work is properly scoped, prioritized, assigned, tracked, and delivered. As the Client Operations function develops, this role will retain ownership of marketing team execution, capacity, quality, and performance, while Client Operations supports the broader client-delivery workflow and cross-functional coordination.

Success in This Role

• The Sales and Marketing teams have clear quarterly priorities, owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

• BLC campaigns, webinars, offers, partnerships, and launches are planned and executed consistently.

• Client-facing Marketing work has clear ownership, capacity visibility, deadlines, and accountability.

• Leadership has reliable visibility into Marketing performance, the sales funnel, client-delivery risks, and revenue opportunities.

• Sales and Marketing operate as one connected commercial system.

• Weekly meetings, scorecards, and accountability follow-ups result in clear decisions and completed actions.

• Marketing specialists have clear direction without unnecessary micromanagement.

• Problems, risks, and missed commitments are identified early and resolved or escalated appropriately.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience managing a Marketing, Sales and Marketing, growth, demand generation, or similar commercial team.

• Direct experience leading remote employees, contractors, or specialists.

• Strong understanding of the Sales and Marketing funnel.

• Ability to connect Marketing activity to measurable business results.

• Experience building calendars, workflows, scorecards, project plans, or accountability systems.

• Strong organization, communication, prioritization, and follow-through.

• Ability to manage specialists without needing to perform every technical task yourself.

• Confidence holding team members accountable and addressing missed commitments.

• Experience working with founders, executives, or entrepreneurial leadership teams.

• Experience coordinating Marketing delivery across Account Management, Client Operations, Sales, and specialist teams.

• Ability to balance internal growth priorities with client-facing delivery commitments and team capacity.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• A practical, hands-on leadership style.

• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership without waiting for complete instructions.

• Comfort working in a fast-moving company where priorities may change as the business grows.

Helpful Experience

• Experience with a Marketing agency, professional services company, technology-enabled business, or homebuilding industry.

• Familiarity with High Level CRM software (or similar), Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, CRM systems, and Jira project management tools.

• Working knowledge of SEO, paid advertising, social media, email Marketing, content, landing pages, and Marketing automation.

• Experience supporting webinars, partnerships, Sales enablement, lead follow-up, or service launches.

• Familiarity with EOS, including the relationship between a Visionary and Integrator.

• Experience overseeing client-facing Marketing delivery in an agency, professional services company, or recurring-service business.

• Experience managing team capacity, delivery risks, client commitments, and cross-functional handoffs.

• Experience working with Account Management or Client Operations teams.

• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Trello, Ninety, or similar project and accountability systems.

You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in every Marketing channel. We care more about your ability to lead people, organize execution, understand the funnel, and turn plans into measurable results.

You will not be expected to personally execute every campaign, manage every client conversation, or close every Sales opportunity. You will be accountable for ensuring the right people have clear priorities, resources, ownership, visibility, and follow-through.

You May Be a Great Fit If You

• Enjoy building structure in a growing company.

• Take initiative and move work forward.

• Are comfortable wearing more than one hat.

• Prefer practical action over unnecessary complexity.

• Hold yourself and others accountable.

• Communicate openly and follow through consistently.

• See problems as opportunities to improve the system.

• Want to help build something rather than simply maintain it.

What We Offer

• Salary of $2,800-$3,500 per month, based on experience.

• Quarterly performance bonus opportunities.

• Profit-sharing opportunities.

• Paid time off and floating holidays.

• Full-time remote work.

• Monday-Friday schedule, generally 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time, with possible flexibility based on location.

• Professional growth and leadership development opportunities.

• A collaborative team and direct access to company leadership.

• The opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing company.

Our Hiring Process

Qualified candidates may be invited to complete interviews, assessments, practical exercises, work samples, and professional reference checks.

Please be prepared to discuss the remote teams you have managed, how you organize quarterly priorities, how you track the Sales and Marketing funnel, how you oversee client-facing delivery, and how you keep cross-functional projects moving when priorities, capacity, and deadlines compete. .

Join Builder Lead Converter and help us build a focused, accountable, and high-performing Sales and Marketing operation.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Media & PR Specialist – LATAM to strengthen our media presence, public relations, local communications and online reputation across Spanish-speaking Latin America.
This is a senior individual contributor role with regional ownership , ideal for someone who is highly hands-on, well-connected, an excellent communicator and confident representing a global brand externally.
You will be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with journalists and media outlets, identifying PR opportunities, developing high-quality Spanish-language PR content, managing our Spanish-language online reputation, and representing the company at selected local events and industry activities.
As a key local marketing representative, you will also support the localisation of global English marketing communications into Spanish and contribute to a wide range of regional marketing initiatives, campaigns, partnerships, events and brand activities when required.
This role requires someone who can move comfortably between relationship building, content creation, localisation and hands-on marketing execution — from meeting journalists and attending industry events to writing press releases, adapting global campaigns for Spanish-speaking audiences and supporting local marketing initiatives.
Experience within Forex / CFD trading, fintech or financial services is a strong advantage, but not mandatory.

What You’ll Do
Media Relations & PR

• Build and maintain strong relationships with relevant financial, business, technology and mainstream media across Spanish-speaking LATAM.

• Develop a strong network of journalists, editors, publishers, media partners and other relevant industry contacts.

• Proactively identify media and PR opportunities that increase brand awareness, credibility and visibility.

• Pitch company stories, market insights, product developments, partnerships, sponsorships and corporate initiatives to relevant media.

• Coordinate interviews, media briefings, executive commentary and other PR opportunities.

• Maintain and continuously expand a regional media database and relationship network.

• Work with external PR agencies and media partners where appropriate while maintaining direct ownership of key media relationships.

PR Content & Storytelling

• Write and edit high-quality press releases, media articles, contributed articles, executive commentary, interview materials, talking points and other PR content in Spanish.

• Transform company developments and global campaigns into compelling stories relevant to LATAM audiences.

• Identify strong local angles and narratives that can generate organic media interest.

• Work with internal subject-matter experts to translate complex financial, product or business information into clear and engaging communications.

• Ensure external communications are accurate, professional and aligned with brand positioning.

Spanish Localisation & Marketing Copy

• Support the translation and localisation of English marketing content into Spanish across regional marketing touchpoints.

• Adapt global marketing copy into natural, locally relevant and culturally appropriate Spanish , rather than relying on direct word-for-word translation.

• Support localisation across campaigns, websites, landing pages, App content, social media, advertising materials, EDMs, event materials, promotions and other customer-facing communications.

• Maintain consistency in Spanish terminology, tone of voice and brand messaging across different channels.

• Review Spanish-language marketing materials produced by internal teams, agencies or external partners to ensure language quality and local relevance.

• Work closely with global Content, Social, Product, Design and Marketing teams to ensure global messages are effectively adapted for Spanish-speaking LATAM audiences.

• Provide local language and cultural insights when developing new campaigns and marketing concepts.

Online Reputation Management

• Take ownership of the company's Spanish-language online reputation across LATAM.

• Monitor brand mentions, reviews, media coverage, search results and relevant online conversations.

• Track brand sentiment and identify recurring reputation issues or emerging risks.

• Develop appropriate communication approaches for negative reviews, misinformation and reputation-related concerns.

• Work closely with Social Media, Customer Support, Compliance and other teams to ensure reputation issues are handled consistently and effectively.

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lidermos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're looking for a Knowledge Management Specialist to organize, maintain, and optimize our support knowledge assets. You'll develop strategies that make critical information accessible, create content that helps people solve problems, and ensure everything we publish is accurate, searchable, and ready for AI-powered systems. This role is all about turning institutional knowledge into practical, usable resources that support our global customers and teams.

More Specifically, You Will

• Develop and implement knowledge management strategies that align with organizational goals and improve how we capture and share information.

• Create, organize, and maintain support content across multiple channels, including knowledge bases, documentation, FAQs, and training materials.

• Ensure all content is accurate, up-to-date, and optimized for AI systems, search engines, and user accessibility.

• Use analytics to track how knowledge assets perform and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct regular content audits to maintain consistency, quality, and relevance across all materials.

• Collaborate with subject matter experts to capture and document institutional knowledge effectively.

• Leverage AI tools to improve document generation, maintenance workflows, and content discoverability.

• Identify knowledge gaps within the organization and develop solutions to address them.

What You Bring to Sovos

• Experience in knowledge management, technical writing, or content management — whether through a degree in Information Science, Technical Communication, or hands-on work.

• You know how to structure information for clarity and findability, whether you've done it in knowledge management, technical writing, or content management roles., and you understand how to structure information for clarity and findability.

• Strong writing and editing skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex information into clear, concise content.

• Experience with knowledge management systems, content management tools, and information architecture principles.

• Familiarity with AI content optimization, natural language processing, and comfort with AI-assisted workflows.

• Basic understanding of data analytics for measuring content performance and informing content strategy.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams and extract knowledge from subject matter experts.

• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

• Global Mentoring Programs

postings.title: Senior Content Creator & Video Producer
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Argentina (remote, with strong overlap with US business hours)
Engagement: Full-time contract (approximately 40 hours/week)
Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month
Languages: Fluent professional English required

ABOUT THE ROLE

GrowthMasters is hiring a dedicated, hands-on content creator and video producer for a fast-growing AI company serving the US home-care industry. You will turn customer stories, interviews, podcasts, product footage, founder ideas, and industry moments into video people genuinely want to watch.
This is not a role for someone who only builds content calendars, manages agencies, or hands briefs to an editor. You will personally shape stories and produce polished work: short-form videos and reels, customer case studies, UGC, YouTube content, product and founder videos, and fast-turn campaign or announcement assets.
The goal is to build a repeatable video engine across platforms—especially YouTube—without sacrificing quality, credibility, or judgment. We want a high volume of strong work, not AI slop.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Partner directly with company leadership to turn a long idea backlog into an organized, prioritized production pipeline.
• Create high volumes of short-form video for YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and paid-social reuse.
• Produce compelling customer case-study and testimonial videos focused on measurable results, memorable operational stories, trust, and why customers chose the company.
• Turn interviews, podcasts, customer conversations, demos, and event footage into platform-specific clips with strong hooks and clear narratives.
• Develop authentic UGC concepts for agency owners, operators, schedulers, caregivers, patients, and families.
• Create founder-led, product-demo, partnership-announcement, campaign, and event content on short timelines.
• Own editing from raw footage to publish-ready asset: structure, pacing, captions, graphics, music, sound, color correction, lighting improvements, B-roll, and mobile readability.
• Make sound editorial and privacy decisions about what can be shown publicly.
• Maintain the content calendar, asset library, production backlog, and review process.
• Use performance feedback to improve hooks, formats, topics, and distribution—not just report vanity metrics.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• A strong portfolio of video content you personally created—not only work your team or agency delivered.
• Proven ability to produce effective short-form content at meaningful volume while keeping the quality bar high.
• Excellent storytelling instincts: you can find the hook, cut the filler, make proof memorable, and build trust without overhyping.
• Strong hands-on editing skills, including color correction, lighting remediation, captions, audio cleanup, B-roll selection, pacing, and mobile-first design.
• Experience turning imperfect raw footage into polished, useful assets without making the result feel artificial.
• Experience with customer case studies, testimonials, UGC, podcast clips, founder content, or B2B/vertical-SaaS video.
• Strong judgment around confidential, sensitive, or not-yet-public information.
• Comfort working directly with a founder or senior leader and turning many ideas into an executable system.
• High ownership: you request missing inputs, push projects forward, manage revisions, and deliver without waiting for a perfect brief.
• Fluent professional English and strong overlap with US business hours.
• AI-native working habits. You use AI to accelerate research, ideation, scripting, transcription, repurposing, and production—but never as a substitute for taste, accuracy, or human judgment.

ESPECIALLY VALUABLE

• Experience with B2B SaaS, healthcare, home care, vertical software, or operationally complex industries.
• YouTube channel development: Shorts, standard videos, playlists, packaging, and retention-oriented editing.
• UGC production and creator/vendor coordination.
• Experience creating assets for both organic and paid-media teams.
• On-camera interviewing, directing, or filming ability.
• AEO/content-discovery knowledge.

THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

• Your strength is content strategy, but you do not personally create and edit.
• You need a large production team or pristine footage before you can ship.
• Your portfolio is mostly generic corporate video without strong hooks or platform-native execution.
• You optimize for volume by publishing low-quality, inaccurate, or visibly automated content.
• You prefer detailed instructions instead of turning ideas and raw material into a plan.
• You want an internship-style learning role. This seat needs someone ready to own the work.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 30 days, you will understand the audience, audit the available footage and ideas, organize the production backlog, establish templates and review workflows, and begin shipping strong work from existing assets.
By 60 days, the company should have a reliable short-form cadence, an active YouTube content system, and a repeatable process for turning each interview, podcast, event, or founder recording into multiple useful assets.
By 90 days, the content engine should be predictable: stronger stories, faster turnaround, fewer production bottlenecks, a growing library of customer proof, and clear performance feedback guiding what gets made next.

HOW TO APPLY

Please include three examples you personally created:
1. One short-form reel or YouTube Short.
2. One customer story, testimonial, or case study.
3. One example where you improved imperfect footage or turned a long source into multiple strong assets.
For each example, explain your exact role, tools, turnaround time, and result. Also include a short note on how you would turn a 45-minute customer interview into a two-week cross-platform content package, plus your availability and CV or LinkedIn profile.
Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical exercise using a realistic but controlled brief.

postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. The people who use it are demanding, opinionated, and allergic to marketing.

We want someone who belongs in that room. Not a brand account with a person behind it, but a trader's trader who happens to be very good at building community.

Come here to build and grow this Community for us.

The opportunity

• Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.

• Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.

• Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.

• Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.

• Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.

• Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.

• Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.

What You’ll Bring

• You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.

• 3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.

• You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.

• You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.

• You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.

• You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.

• You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. Full-time

• Contractor

• Remote

• Monthly salary: $4,000 to $4,500 USD Worldwide, with partial overlap with Pacific Time required

About The Role

You lead events, marketing initiatives and client relationships inside the Production team, as a counterpart to the Production Lead. You own work from kickoff to launch, keep clients, partners and internal teams aligned, and step into the execution when it needs hands. Strategy, priorities and final decisions stay with the Production Lead.

You report to the Project Manager and the Production Lead, and work closely with the Junior Project Manager and the Marketing Coordinator.

About Moj And Trolley

Moj Mahdara is an entrepreneur and investor. She is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Kinship Ventures, the venture platform she launched alongside Gwyneth Paltrow, the founder of Trolley, and Co-CEO of goop, the lifestyle brand Gwyneth started in 2008. Before Kinship, Moj was CEO of Beautycon Media, the global festival and media company built at the intersection of beauty and pop culture.

Trolley is a fast-growing creative operations company delivering high-impact digital and marketing solutions. We work with high-profile clients and founder-led brands to strategize, produce and optimize content that drives engagement, brand visibility and business growth. Our team combines strategy, design, production and performance analysis, and we work AI-first. We are a fast-moving, collaborative remote team that values respect, teamwork and open communication.

What You Will Own

• Events, podcasts, fellowships and community programs, from vendors, speakers and contracts to post-event follow-up.

• Marketing and content initiatives, working with the Marketing Coordinator on campaigns, newsletters, launches and promotions.

• Projects and partnerships that move from plan to launch without constant oversight, each with clear owners, timelines and success metrics.

• Client, partner and vendor relationships: you lead the meetings and status updates and keep scope and expectations clear.

• Alignment across production, creative, operations and community, with risks and blockers raised early.

• Trackers, dashboards, reports and accurate CRM records that give the team and leadership a clear view of every project.

• AI-enabled workflows that cut manual work in reporting, research and planning, and a lighter project load for the Production Lead.

Who You Are

• Experience leading several projects at once and managing clients or external partners, ideally in events, marketing, production, agency or media work.

• Hands-on execution: you draft the update, build the tracker and prepare the report yourself when needed.

• Clear written and spoken communication, and confidence representing the company in client and partner meetings.

• Sound judgment: you make day-to-day decisions, escalate strategic ones and flag risks early.

• AI is already part of how you work.

Nice to have

• Experience with sponsors, speakers or talent partnerships.

• Hands-on use of a CRM and project tools such as Notion or ClickUp.

This role is not

Not a sales, customer success, executive assistant or creative lead role.

How We Hire

The stages depend on the case, and usually include:

• A 15-minute interview

• A skills test

• A 30-minute interview with the manager

• A final interview with Moj, our CEO

Equal opportunity

Trolley is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or any other protected status. We are not considering applications from agencies or recruiters at this time.

We use AI tools to help organize and shortlist applications. A person reviews every application before any rejection and makes every final decision.

Buscamos a alguien con mirada estratégica y foco en ejecución que sea práctico, flexible y orientado a la acción, que se sienta cómodo trabajando con múltiples prioridades, y transformando necesidades del negocio en soluciones concretas.

Responsabilidades

P&L y estrategia del canal

• Ser responsable del P&L completo del canal ventas, margen bruto, costos logísticos y de pasarela, inversión comercial y contribución.

• Definir objetivos, plan anual y forecast del canal, y hacer el seguimiento del real contra el plan.

• Identificar y priorizar las palancas de crecimiento precio, surtido, conversión, ticket promedio, recompra y nuevos clientes.

Pricing y promociones

• Definir la estrategia de precios del canal y gestionarla en el día a día.

• Diseñar promociones, bundles y mecánicas comerciales cuidando el balance entre crecimiento y rentabilidad.

• Planificar y ejecutar las fechas comerciales clave del calendario.

• Medir el resultado de cada acción y documentar los aprendizajes.

Surtido y alocación de stock

• Definir el surtido del canal y la priorización de SKUs (foco, lanzamientos, liquidación).

• Trabajar con Planeamiento y Operaciones en la alocación de inventario al canal, anticipando quiebres y sobrestock.

• Proponer acciones comerciales para corregir desvíos de inventario.

Propuesta de envíos y financiación

• Diseñar la propuesta logística para el cliente costos, umbrales de envío gratis, tiempos y cobertura.

• Definir la estrategia de financiación y medios de pago (cuotas, promociones bancarias, pasarelas) y evaluar su costo contra su impacto en la conversión.

Gestión cross-funcional

• Trabajar con los equipos comerciales locales, Operaciones, Paid Media, Branding y CX para cumplir los objetivos del canal.

• Darle a Paid Media prioridades comerciales claras (productos foco, promociones, stock disponible) y alinear el calendario.

• Trabajar con Branding en el posicionamiento de la marca, el merchandising del sitio y la comunicación comercial.

Inteligencia competitiva y cliente

• Monitorear precios, promociones, propuesta de envíos y financiación de los competidores directos.

• Analizar el comportamiento del cliente (conversión, ticket, recompra) y el feedback de reviews y CX para detectar oportunidades.

Requisitos Experiencia

• 1 a 3 años en e-commerce, idealmente en un canal D2C o en roles de Channel Manager, Category Manager o Commercial Manager.

• Experiencia siendo responsable de resultados comerciales.

• Deseable experiencia en marcas propias, productos físicos (hogar, muebles, fitness, electrónica)

Formación

• Título universitario en Administración, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing, Finanzas o una carrera afín.

Conocimientos técnicos

• Excel o Google Sheets avanzado.

• Métricas de e-commerce y funnel de conversión.

• Deseable Shopify, GA4, herramientas de BI y SQL básico.

• Uso fluido de herramientas de IA en el trabajo diario.

Competencias que valoramos

• Ownership sentir el canal como propio y responder por sus números.

• Comercial y analítica conectar datos con decisiones de precio, surtido y propuesta de valor.

• Visión de negocio pensar en el crecimiento y en la rentabilidad, no en uno solo de los dos.

• Influencia sin autoridad mover equipos que no te reportan para lograr un objetivo común.

• Hands-on involucrarse en el detalle cuando hace falta.

• Comunicación clara saber presentar resultados, alertas y propuestas a distintos niveles.

Nuestro ADN Cultural

En Elevva operamos bajo cinco principios

Nos movemos rápido

Priorizamos, decidimos y ejecutamos con sentido de urgencia.

Buscamos ser los mejores

Elevamos el estándar constantemente.

Decidimos con datos (y criterio)

Usamos información para tomar decisiones inteligentes.

Ganamos en equipo

Construimos juntos, sin silos.

Damos el máximo por impacto real

Nos enfocamos en resultados, no en excusas.

Beneficios

• Cobertura médica premium

• Modalidad híbrida

• Vacaciones + días Elevva

• Beneficios corporativos

• Espacio para crecer profesionalmente en una plataforma regional en expansión

¡Sumate a Elevva y liderá el futuro del e-commerce en Argentina!

En Elevva transformamos el e-commerce en América Latina. Nuestro modelo combina creatividad, tecnología de punta y un enfoque basado en datos para adquirir y desarrollar marcas que lideren el mercado. Innovamos, perseguimos la excelencia y marcamos tendencia en el mercado.

¿Qué nos hace diferentes?

Nos mueve el desafío de construir algo extraordinario. Elevva es más que una empresa de e-commerce somos un equipo ágil, colaborativo y con una visión clara de cómo queremos transformar la experiencia del consumidor en la región. Aquí, tus ideas cobran vida y tienen un impacto real.

Que harás

Sólidas habilidades de negociación, comunicación e influencia.

Solutions 2GO Inc.

Solutions 2 GO INC. es un distribuidor global líder de productos de videojuegos, con operaciones en 19 países de Norteamérica, Centroamérica y Sudamérica, y alianzas estratégicas que amplían nuestro alcance a Europa, África, Australia y Asia. Si te identificas con esta forma de trabajar y quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento, queremos conocerte!

Trade Marketing Analyst.

Resumen De La Posición

El/la Trade Marketing Analyst de Nintendo es responsable de desarrollar, implementar y hacer seguimiento de las estrategias de trade marketing de Nintendo, Roku y los publishers (EA, Take-Two, Capcom) en Argentina, asegurando una ejecución efectiva en el punto de venta, fuerte visibilidad de marca y alineación con los objetivos comerciales.

Es el nexo entre Marketing y Ventas para maximizar el impacto en los 8 recursos de campo asignados a la marca, asumiendo además la gestión directa de ese equipo de field force. Sin esta posición, Nintendo y sus marcas asociadas quedan sin la misma profundidad de cobertura que PlayStation.

Principales Responsabilidades

Planificación y Ejecución de Trade Marketing

• Planificar y ejecutar acciones de trade marketing por canal y cliente.

• Coordinar lanzamientos de producto, promociones y campañas de visibilidad en el punto de venta (POS).

• Desarrollar y supervisar la producción de materiales POP, asegurando su correcta implementación.

Análisis y Seguimiento

• Analizar la performance de las campañas y proponer mejoras continuas.

• Hacer seguimiento de KPIs de ejecución y medir el ROI de las iniciativas de trade.

Coordinación Interna y con Proveedores

• Coordinar con agencias de merchandising y proveedores.

• Colaborar con los equipos de ventas, marketing y comercial para alinear estrategias.

• Dar soporte a acciones digitales vinculadas a la actividad en el punto de venta.

• Supervisar el mantenimiento de displays, señalética de vidriera y demás activos en el punto de venta.

Gestión de Field Force

• Definir la rutina semanal de objetivos, ruteo y cobertura de los 8 recursos de promotoría de Nintendo/Roku/Publishers.

• Capacitar al equipo de campo y controlar la carga de evidencias y ejecución vía app.

• Monitorear quiebres, distribución física y pricing en el punto de venta.

Requisitos y Competencias

• Estudiante o graduado/a reciente en Marketing, Administración de Empresas o Comercialización.

• Idealmente con inglés avanzado.

• Residencia en CABA o zona norte del GBA.

• Movilidad propia.

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro del país.

• Mínimo 3-4 años de experiencia en roles similares.

• Sólido conocimiento de trade marketing y canales retail.

• Mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados.

• Perfil proactivo, autónomo y con excelente gestión del tiempo.

• Manejo sólido de Excel y PowerPoint.

• Experiencia en tecnología / electrónica de consumo, un plus.

La persona seleccionada recibirá una oferta de empleo condicional, sujeta a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes realizada por un proveedor externo contratado por la compañía. Los requisitos específicos de verificación podrán variar según la posición y pueden incluir uno o más de los siguientes: verificación de antecedentes penales, verificación crediticia, validación de experiencia laboral, verificación de estudios académicos y revisión del historial de conducción.

Si tienes alguna pregunta durante el proceso, no dudes en consultarnos.

We are looking for a results-driven Key Account Manager to lead and expand the KitchenAid business across strategic retail, wholesale, and hospitality (HORECA) channels. • Contribute to the regional sales forecasting process by providing accurate demand estimates for each account.

• Analyze distributor performance and competitor activity to identify market trends and new business development opportunities.

Preferred skills and experiences

• Proven track record of managing high-priority retail accounts in the Argentinian and Southern Cone markets.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data, market trends, and financial statements (Profit & Loss).

• Availability to travel within Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Bolivia as required.

postings.title: Retail Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Anker Innovations
Anker Innovations is a global leader in consumer electronics and smart devices, with a portfolio of beloved brands including Anker (charging), Soundcore (audio), eufy (smart home), and Nebula (projection). With products sold in 100+ countries and annual revenue exceeding $2.5 billion USD, we are the #1 selling charging brand on Amazon globally and a top player in smart home and audio categories worldwide.
We are building our retail presence from the ground up in Argentina and seeking a hands-on Retail Manager to lead our brick-and-mortar expansion — from store openings and channel partnerships to in-store brand experience and retail operations.

Role Overview
As the Retail Manager, Argentina , you will be responsible for building Anker's offline retail footprint in the Argentine market. This is a 0-to-1 role : you will lead store openings, negotiate entry into major retail chains, set operational standards for branded spaces and shop-in-shops, and manage a growing team of in-store brand ambassadors (BAs).
You will work closely with the Country Sales Manager and the LATAM marketing team to bring the Anker brand to life in Argentine retail — delivering a premium consumer experience that stands out in a market dominated by Samsung, JBL, and Xiaomi.

Key Responsibilities
Retail Expansion & Store Openings

• Lead end-to-end new store openings in Argentina: site selection, lease negotiation, store design & fit-out coordination, staffing, and grand opening execution

• Evaluate and prioritize high-potential retail locations (shopping malls, high-street, electronics retail clusters) across Buenos Aires and key secondary cities (Córdoba, Rosario, Mendoza)

• Build business cases for each location — footfall analysis, rent-to-revenue modeling, competitor proximity mapping, and payback period estimation

• Manage relationships with commercial real estate agents, mall operators, and landlords

• Coordinate with China HQ on retail-related requirements such as store openings.

Channel Partner Retail Operations

• Negotiate and secure branded shop-in-shops, gondolas, and premium display spaces in major Argentine consumer electronics chains (Musimundo, Megatone, Frávega, etc)

• Develop and enforce visual merchandising (VM) standards — planograms, POS materials, product demo units — ensuring consistent brand execution across all retail touchpoints

• Manage the operational relationship with key retail partners: quarterly business reviews, assortment planning, promotional calendars, and sell-out data sharing

In-Store Brand Experience

• Design and implement the Argentine retail experience playbook — from store layout and product demonstration to customer journey and after-sales service

• Train and certify in-store Brand Ambassadors (BAs) on product knowledge, brand storytelling, and sales techniques

• Drive Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvement through mystery shopper programs, customer feedback loops, and continuous operational refinement

• Plan and execute in-store activation events — product launches, demo days, seasonal promotions

Retail Operations & Performance Management

• Set and manage KPIs per store and per channel partner: revenue per sqm, conversion rate, average transaction value (ATV), BA productivity, and inventory turn

• Build a systematic retail reporting cadence — daily sales flash, weekly sell-out analysis, monthly business reviews

• Manage the retail P&L: store operating costs, BA compensation, VM and POS material budgets

• Partner with supply chain and distributor teams to ensure optimal in-stock levels at retail points of sale

Team Building & Leadership

• Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of Brand Ambassadors (BAs) and retail supervisors as the footprint scales

• Foster a high-performance, customer-obsessed retail culture

• Conduct regular store visits and field coaching sessions

Qualifications & Requirements
Must-Have

• 3+ years of retail management experience with proven store opening track record in Argentina — you have personally led at least 2 new store openings from site selection to first month of operations

• Deep knowledge of Argentine retail real estate — you know the key malls (Alto Palermo, Unicenter, DOT Baires, Abasto), high-street corridors, and electronics retail clusters; you have existing relationships with landlords, brokers, or mall operators

• Fluent English (written and spoken) — you will communicate daily with LATAM regional leadership and Shenzhen HQ in English

• Native Spanish — for on-the-ground execution with local partners, contractors, and BAs

• Visual merchandising and in-store execution experience — you have built planograms, designed store layouts, or managed shop-in-shop fit-outs

• Willingness to travel domestically up to 30-40% for store visits and new location scouting

Nice-to-Have

• Experience with a global consumer brand (consumer electronics, mobile accessories, lifestyle, or premium retail) launching or scaling in Argentina

• Multi-brand or multi-category retail experience — managing distinct brand identities within a shared retail space

• Experience implementing retail POS / inventory management systems and using sell-out data for decision-making

• Familiarity with Argentine labor regulations for retail staff and experience managing shift-based workforces

• Experience running in-store financing/promotional programs in partnership with Argentine consumer credit providers (e.g., Ahora 12, Ahora 18)

Who You Are

• Builder, not maintainer — you thrive in the ambiguity of a 0-to-1 buildout and get energy from turning an empty space into a functioning store

• On-the-ground operator — you spend more time in stores than at a desk; you believe retail problems are solved on the floor, not in spreadsheets

• Brand-obsessed — you notice when a price tag is crooked, a demo unit is not working, or a BA is not telling the brand story correctly

• Commercially sharp — you understand that great retail experience and strong commercial performance are two sides of the same coin

• Cross-cultural communicator — you can negotiate a lease in Spanish in the morning and present a business review in English in the afternoon

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation — base salary (12 months) + performance-based annual bonus, aligned with Anker's global banding structure

• 0-to-1 build opportunity — rare chance to build a retail network from scratch for a global brand in Argentina

• Global brand platform — represent a portfolio of #1-selling brands (Anker, Soundcore, eufy, Nebula) with real consumer recognition

• Career growth — Anker is scaling aggressively in Latin America; as the retail footprint grows, so will your scope and leadership responsibility

• Autonomy — you will define the retail playbook for Argentina, not execute someone else's

• Comprehensive benefits — in line with Argentine labor law (Ley 20.744) and market practice
