postings.title: Community Associate
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

Community Associate | Community

About The Opportunity

As a Community Associate, you'll be the primary point of contact for the Community and act as the “face” of WeWork! You will report to your building each day to support the Community Management team.

Duties

Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:

• Build a welcoming and collaborative community environment amongst our members through events and building relationships between members!

• Ensure that your building is fully operational and processes are running efficiently.

• Drive growth and promotion of WeWork-provided service offerings.

• Take direction from the Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary.

• All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission.

Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas:

Front Desk Management

• Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact, easily located on the member floor or at Community Bar.

• Greet members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor.

• Ensure all visiting guests are in accordance with WeWork's guest policy by ensuring all guests properly sign-in via Welkio tablet.

• Learn the names of members and guests with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community WeWork is known for.

• Anticipate member and guest needs before they arise using relevant information collected about members to enhance and personalize their experience.

• Ensure building Specific forms are up to date including pet forms, filming requests, bike room requests, etc.

• Keep the front desk clean and organized.

• Notify members of any food deliveries and couriers.

• Answer any questions from members and guests related to the building including way-finding, policies and procedures, community etiquette, etc.

Events And Membership Engagement

• Provide feedback on programming types (based on member makeup) and evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact on the appropriate event team.

• Consistently celebrate members’ successes and milestones through gifts and notes.

• Distribute all necessary info to promote the event including creation and posting of weekly events poster and individual event posters.

• Ensure building-specific operational requirements are met for each event (elevators, HVAC, etc).

• Input notes into Kube or equivalent system about Members.

• Identify and execute opportunities to connect members with each other.

• Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc.

• Be active on the WeWork member network to engage members.

• Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures and communicate, inform, and update members on building issues.

• Ensure music levels and activations are appropriate to the daypart and occasion.

• Write and send broadcasts relating to building updates.

Building Operations And Management

• Receive, process, sort, and organize all mail.

• Locate and issue posts via the regional system to members upon request.

• Keep the mailroom organized and clean.

• “Return to Sender" for unidentified mail and former member mail after 30 days of no-pick up.

• Ensure courier parcels have all the correct details for scheduled pick-ups.

• Investigate, escalate, and resolve 'lost' packages.

• Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom.

• Track, audit, and organize keys collected and distributed.

• Manage keycard stock and request new inventory as needed.

• Collect keys and key cards upon move-out.

• Review location and how to use each piece of Emergency Equipment.

• Provide support for an automated coffee machine for guests and members.

About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:

• Bachelors Degree in Tourism, Hospitality or related.

• Proficient in English

• Available to work onsite: WeWork Butty.

• 1+ years of hospitality experience

• Customer service and/or sales experience a plus

• Must have strong verbal and written communication skills

• Outstanding interpersonal and multitasking skills

• Demonstrate integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion

• Passion for entrepreneurial communities

• Passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values

• Proficient in basic computer skills

Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

postings.title: Experience Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Experience Manager
Buenos Aires | Experience | Full-Time | In-Office

About Belong
We didn't build a better property management company. We replaced the need for one.
Belong is the operating system for rental homeownership. One system that runs rent, maintenance, finances, residents, and visibility end to end. Not a person juggling disconnected tools. A system that gets smarter every single day, with every home we add.
We've survived Covid, the tech crash, and the toughest capital markets cycle in a generation. We are growing fast, we are AI-first, and we are building something that has never existed before.
Our 200+ Belongers are strong, curious, and unreasonably ambitious. If you want a passive role at a company that's okay with average, this is not it.

The Role
You lead the teams responsible for the experience homeowners and residents receive after they join Belong.
You oversee Concierge, Member Support, and Home Occupancy. These teams sit at the intersection of service, operations, and trust. They influence whether residents renew, whether homeowners stay with Belong, and whether operational issues are resolved quickly and correctly.
This role exists because great experiences do not happen by accident. They come from strong operators who build clear standards, coach teams consistently, and create systems that scale.
This is not a role focused on strategy presentations or reporting from a distance. You spend time in the operation. You review conversations, coach managers, handle escalations, improve processes, and raise performance standards.
Success is measured through member satisfaction, renewals, occupancy performance, operational efficiency, escalation quality, and the strength of the teams you build.
As Belong grows, your ability to scale service quality without scaling complexity becomes increasingly important.

What You'll Own
Concierge
You own the function responsible for maintaining the relationship between Belong, homeowners, and residents throughout occupancy.
You establish the standards that define how members experience Belong day to day. You ensure the team is proactive, accountable, and capable of building trust through consistent execution.
The quality of this function directly influences retention, member satisfaction, and long-term homeowner confidence.

Member Support
You own the operation that responds when members need help.
You ensure members receive timely, accurate, and complete resolutions across every communication channel. You determine how escalations are handled, how service quality is measured, and how recurring issues are identified and addressed.
You transform member feedback into operational improvements that reduce friction and strengthen the overall experience.

Home Occupancy
You own the operational lifecycle of occupied homes.
This includes renewals, move-outs, turnover execution, occupancy transitions, and the operational processes that support homeowners and residents throughout their relationship with Belong.
Your decisions influence occupancy rates, homeowner returns, resident retention, and the efficiency of one of the most important economic engines inside the company.

Team Performance
You lead managers, leads, and individual contributors across multiple member-facing functions.
You create clarity around expectations, performance, accountability, and development.
You build leaders who can make decisions, coach effectively, and maintain high standards without constant oversight.

Operational Scale
You continuously improve how the operation runs.
You identify bottlenecks, eliminate unnecessary work, and create systems that allow teams to deliver better outcomes as Belong grows.
You leverage AI, automation, and operational tooling to improve productivity, increase consistency, and expand the impact of every team member.

What We're Looking For
On Experience

• You have at least 5 years of experience leading hospitality, customer experience, service delivery, or member-facing operations.

• You have at least 2 years of direct people management experience, including managing managers, supervisors, or team leads.

• You have led teams where service quality, responsiveness, and operational execution directly affected customer retention and satisfaction.

• You are comfortable using operational metrics, performance dashboards, and service data to make decisions and improve outcomes.

• You are fluent in English and Spanish and can operate effectively with teams and stakeholders across multiple locations.

• Experience in hospitality, residential services, home operations, or other high-touch service environments is strongly preferred.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled workflows, support automation, or operational systems is a plus.

On Mindset

• You think in systems rather than individual incidents.

• You naturally balance empathy with accountability.

• You are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations and taking ownership of outcomes.

• You look for root causes instead of treating symptoms.

• You coach directly and address performance issues early.

• You believe exceptional service is built through standards, training, discipline, and operational excellence.

• You are energized by building teams and improving systems rather than maintaining the status quo.

Why This Role Matters
Belong only works when homeowners trust us with one of their most valuable assets and residents trust us with the place they call home.
The teams you lead are responsible for maintaining that trust every day.
Your decisions influence renewals, occupancy, member satisfaction, homeowner retention, and operational efficiency. They directly affect revenue, reduce operational risk, and determine how effectively Belong can scale.
As the company grows, the systems, leaders, and standards you build become a competitive advantage that is difficult to replicate.

Why Belong
Most companies in this industry are built around managing properties. We are building the operating system for rental homeownership.
At Belong, you work on problems that sit at the intersection of technology, operations, and one of the largest asset classes in the world.
You will have meaningful ownership, direct exposure to senior leadership, and the opportunity to shape systems that impact thousands of homeowners and residents.
We are AI-first, ambitious about what we are building, and committed to giving exceptional operators the autonomy and responsibility to create outsized impact.

Onboarding → Activation → Adoption → Retention → Expansion

Permanente

» Interactuar con equipos multidisciplinarios para la correcta implementación de nuevas soluciones y procesos.

» Dar seguimiento diario a la evolución de las actividades, apoyando en el monitoreo de los SLAs y KPIs de productividad por parte de los socios.

» Apoyar en el correcto almacenamiento y organización de los assets en nuestras plataformas oficiales de DAM (Digital Asset Management). » Facilitar el onboarding y capacitación de nuevos colaboradores y socios, enseñando las rutinas, demandas del área y uso de herramientas.

» Experiencia en gestión de proyectos y procesos con foco en ganar eficiencia operativa.

» Visión global de las diversas disciplinas de comunicación y pensamiento digital-first.

» Alta capacidad de aprendizaje tecnológico (herramientas en general).

» Organizada.

» Comunicativa.

» Con habilidades técnicas y numéricas.

» Resiliente y colaborativa.

» Con pensamiento crítico y orientado a datos.

» Con capacidad de influencia y articulación.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

¿Conoces a alguien en Natura?

postings.title: Customer Success - Team Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.

We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.

Location: These opportunities are available in the APAC and AMER regions and are remote positions.

The role entails:

• Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.

• Customer interactions and support to your team: resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.

• Team management: passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth.

• Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.

• Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What We Are Looking For In You

• Excellent academic results at school and university

• Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject

• Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries

• Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results

• Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific

• Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration

• Experience growing and developing a CSM team

• Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have Skills

• Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.

What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Programme

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others

• Priority Pass for travel

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: BDR / Sales Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

BDR / Sales Operations Specialist

Location: Remote – Latin America

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Industry: LegalTech / Technology / Professional Services

Compensation: $2,200 USD/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday | U.S. Eastern Time (ET) Business Hours

English Proficiency: Strong Professional English

About The Company

Our client is an innovative U.S.-based LegalTech company helping individuals and couples navigate important legal and financial decisions through technology and access to qualified professionals.

By combining AI-powered solutions, personalized guidance, and a network of legal and financial experts, the company makes traditionally complex services more accessible and efficient.

As the business continues to grow, it is expanding its network of qualified attorneys and strengthening its business development and sales operations capabilities.

About The Role

We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy BDR / Sales Operations Specialist who combines hands-on outbound prospecting, CRM management, and sales automation.

This is not a traditional BDR position. You will take ownership of the attorney acquisition pipeline, from identifying and engaging prospective attorneys to scheduling qualified meetings, managing follow-ups, and improving sales workflows.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable communicating with prospects, analyzing pipeline performance, and using AI and automation tools to improve efficiency and conversion rates.

Why This Opportunity?

• Own a key part of a growing LegalTech company's attorney acquisition strategy

• Combine business development, sales operations, CRM management, and AI automation

• Work directly with a U.S.-based commercial team

• Build and optimize processes with measurable business impact

What You'll Do

Business Development & Attorney Acquisition

• Execute outbound prospecting through Indeed, PosseList, cold email, LinkedIn, referrals, and existing lead databases

• Engage prospective attorneys, manage follow-ups, and re-engage unresponsive leads

• Schedule qualified meetings for the Account Executive

• Reschedule missed meetings and ensure prospects advance through the acquisition funnel

• Coordinate attorney screening, vetting, and onboarding activities

• Support ongoing attorney relationship management as needed

Sales Operations & CRM Management

• Manage and maintain the CRM pipeline using GoHighLevel (GHL), HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms

• Ensure every lead has an accurate status, assigned owner, and clearly defined next action

• Monitor lead volume, outreach activity, booking conversions, and meeting show rates

• Identify stalled opportunities, missed follow-ups, and sales funnel bottlenecks

• Maintain accurate reporting and clear pipeline visibility for the commercial team

Automation & Process Improvement

• Build and optimize sales workflows using CRM automation and AI tools

• Leverage AI for prospect research, outreach, lead management, and follow-up

• Work with tools such as Instantly, Clay, n8n, GHL, or comparable platforms

• Reduce repetitive manual tasks and improve response, booking, and show rates

• Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and scalability of the acquisition process

Qualifications

postings.title: Account Director, Performance Marketing
postings.descriptionText:
About the Role
Adlantica is a Dallas-based performance advertising agency helping service businesses and ecommerce brands generate measurable growth. We manage Meta and Google Ads alongside the research, messaging, creative, landing pages, and measurement systems behind effective campaigns. We work closely with founders and leadership teams, using customer insight, direct-response principles, and disciplined testing to guide our work.

We are hiring a senior, client-facing leader who can own campaign delivery, daily account decisions, performance accountability, and client relationships. You will guide a media buyer, graphic designer, video editor, and web developer; translate strategic direction into coordinated execution; challenge weak analysis and creative; and represent Adlantica confidently with clients. The founder will remain involved in high-stakes positioning and major strategic decisions, but routine work should not wait for the founder’s review. This is neither a project coordinator nor an individual-contributor media buying role.

Responsibilities

• Own delivery across a portfolio of client accounts, from approved strategy through campaign launch, optimization, reporting, and follow-through. Make sound day-to-day decisions without waiting for the founder to direct every step.

• Take business objectives, customer research, and creative strategy and turn them into actionable briefs. Coordinate copy, design, video, landing pages, audiences, budgets, URLs, campaign structure, and deadlines so every specialist knows what success requires.

• Lead performance reviews across Meta and Google Ads. Examine account metrics, question the media buyer about what happened and why, and critically evaluate their analysis, assumptions, comparisons, testing approach, and recommended optimizations to ensure decisions are grounded in data and aligned with business outcomes.

• Investigate gaps between advertising results and sales outcomes, including lead quality, booked appointments, CRM attribution, form submissions, phone calls, conversion tracking, and landing-page performance. Bring the right specialists together to resolve them.

• Review ad copy, scripts, creative concepts, and landing pages for customer relevance, clarity, persuasion, differentiation, evidence, and alignment with the offer. Give specific, strategic feedback rather than subjective preferences or purely cosmetic edits.

• Lead and coordinate the work of the media buyer, designer, editor, and developer. Prioritize work, remove blockers, manage revisions, and ensure deadlines and quality standards are met without routing routine questions back to the founder.

• Own repeatable pre-launch quality assurance: correct assets and placements, messaging, destination URLs, mobile experience, forms, thank-you pages, tracking events, CRM handoffs, and final checks.

• Own the preparation and follow-through for client meetings, including setting agendas, preparing performance reports, presenting completed work, and managing action items. Lead discussions around campaign performance and recommendations, and respond confidently to client questions. The founder will participate in all client meetings to guide overall strategy and direction.

• Manage day-to-day client email and Slack communication. Stay close to client priorities, anticipate concerns, and keep the founder informed through concise updates on material changes, risks, and opportunities.

Requirements

• 6+ years in performance marketing or digital advertising agencies, including meaningful experience leading multiple client accounts and supervising cross-functional delivery.

• Proven ownership of client outcomes, not merely task coordination. You can describe decisions you made independently, teams you directed, problems you solved, and the commercial impact.

• Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads for lead generation and ecommerce businesses.

• Advanced analytical judgment: able to diagnose underperformance, spot weak comparisons, distinguish correlation from causation, evaluate lead quality, and challenge recommendations constructively.

• Practical fluency with landing pages, GA4/GTM, pixels, conversion events, UTMs, CRM workflows, and attribution. You need to direct technical investigations, not personally code every fix.

• Excellent creative and messaging judgment, grounded in audience research and direct-response principles. Able to identify why copy or creative is weak and explain precisely how to improve it.

• Experience managing specialists and reviewing their work against clear standards; strong prioritization, ownership, and follow-through across several simultaneous client engagements.

• Exceptional spoken and written English. Comfortable advising U.S. business owners, presenting complex findings, handling disagreement, and communicating uncertainty without losing trust.

• Independent, curious, decisive, and willing to push back thoughtfully. You know when to act, when to investigate, and when an issue genuinely merits escalation.

• Full-time remote availability with substantial overlap with U.S. Central Time. Prior client-facing experience with U.S. companies or agencies is strongly preferred.

At MetLife, we strive to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and communities. As part of the Investments Finance team, you will play a key role in supporting US Net Investment Income and Asset Planning, including projections, analysis, and attribution of results. This position offers regular exposure to senior leadership, including the Chief Investment Officer and Chief Financial Officer. It involves close collaboration with Portfolio Managers, Asset Sector Specialists, and teams across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and deliver reports to support investment asset and net investment income analysis.

• Partner with Portfolio Managers and Asset Specialists to gather inputs for monthly projections.

• Analyze data and workflows to enhance forecasting and modelling accuracy.

• Develop a solid understanding of asset classes & projection outputs and provide clear, well-structured attribution of results to management.

• Collaborate with teams across the organization to ensure proper support for investment processes.

• Handle ad-hoc requests and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and proficiency in MS Office tools.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to communicate with all levels of management; work effectively independently as well as with teammates

Preferred Qualifications

Acerca de MetLife

Reconocida por Fortune entre las compañías más admiradas del mundo y los mejores lugares para trabajar, MetLife es una de las compañías líderes de servicios financieros a nivel global. A través de nuestras subsidiarias y afiliadas, ofrecemos seguros, anualidades, beneficios para empleados y soluciones de gestión de activos a clientes individuales e institucionales. Nuestro propósito es simple: ayudar a nuestros colaboradores, clientes, comunidades y a la sociedad en general a construir un futuro más seguro y confiable. postings.title: Financial Planning Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
FP&A Analyst

About Gain
Gain is an innovator in the legal finance and revenue cycle management markets, financing healthcare and living expenses for people injured in accidents by funding, servicing, and recovering receivables tied to personal injury claims.
Our mission is to make sure that every person injured through no fault of their own gets access to the quality medical care they deserve and can navigate the economic uncertainty caused by the injury.
Founded in 2011 in Atlanta as Cherokee Funding and consolidated under the Gain brand in 2023, Gain has built connective infrastructure for a personal injury market that historically lacked a unified platform. We advance capital against medical receivables for healthcare providers, connect law firms to a network of healthcare practices, and give injured families access to care with no upfront cost.
Gain is a privately held, founder-led, technology-driven organization operating in a complex and rapidly growing financial services environment.

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly analytical and hands-on FP&A Analyst to strengthen Gain's financial planning, forecasting, modeling, and strategic decision-making capabilities.
This role will be responsible for developing and maintaining sophisticated financial models, leading budgeting and forecasting processes, analyzing company performance, and providing actionable financial insights to senior leadership.
A critical requirement for this position is demonstrated experience building and maintaining fully integrated three-statement financial models incorporating the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement, including forward-looking projections and scenario analysis.
The ideal candidate will have developed strong financial modeling and analytical skills through experience in FP&A, M&A, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or a similarly rigorous financial environment.
Benefits: Salary paid in USD, quarterly performance bonus.

Key ResponsibilitiesFinancial Modeling & Three-Statement Forecasting
· Build, maintain, and continuously improve integrated three-statement financial models , including the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement.
· Develop detailed financial projections incorporating revenue, operating expenses, working capital, financing activity, capital deployment, and cash flow.
· Ensure financial statements and projections are fully integrated and dynamically linked.
· Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to evaluate different operating, financing, investment, and growth assumptions.
· Develop short- and long-term financial forecasts to support strategic planning and capital allocation decisions.
· Analyze historical financial performance and use trends and business drivers to develop forward-looking projections.
· Stress-test financial assumptions and identify potential risks, liquidity requirements, and opportunities.
Budgeting, Forecasting & Planning
· Lead and support the Company's annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes.
· Partner with department leaders to develop operating budgets, headcount plans, and expense forecasts.
· Maintain rolling forecasts and update projections based on actual performance and changing business conditions.
· Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies that connect operational activity with financial outcomes.
· Evaluate forecast accuracy and continuously improve assumptions and methodologies.
· Support long-range financial planning and strategic growth initiatives.
Financial Performance & Variance Analysis
· Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
· Identify and explain key financial and operational variances.
· Develop monthly and quarterly management reporting packages for senior leadership.
· Analyze profitability, margins, operating expenses, cash generation, and other key financial metrics.
· Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities and communicate their potential financial impact.
· Develop KPIs and financial dashboards that provide leadership with clear visibility into business performance.
Strategic Finance & Decision Support
· Partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership to support strategic and financial decision-making.
· Develop financial analyses and business cases for new initiatives, investments, products, partnerships, and growth opportunities.
· Evaluate the financial impact and expected returns of strategic initiatives.
· Perform scenario analysis around pricing, growth, funding, operating costs, and capital allocation.
· Translate complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for executive leadership.
· Support Board and investor reporting and other executive-level financial presentations as needed.
M&A, Investment & Corporate Finance Analysis
· Support the evaluation of potential acquisitions, investments, partnerships, and other strategic transactions.
· Build transaction and valuation models, including scenario and return analyses where appropriate.
· Assist with financial due diligence and analysis of potential acquisition targets.
· Evaluate transaction economics and potential impact on Gain's financial statements and cash position.
· Support post-transaction financial planning and integration analysis when applicable.
Cash Flow & Liquidity Planning
· Develop and maintain detailed cash flow and liquidity forecasts.
· Analyze working capital requirements and cash conversion trends.
· Partner with Treasury and Finance leadership to forecast funding needs and capital requirements.
· Evaluate the impact of business growth, collections, investments, and financing decisions on liquidity.
· Provide forward-looking visibility into cash requirements under multiple business scenarios.
Business Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
· Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Operations, Risk, Sales, and other business functions to ensure financial forecasts accurately reflect business activity.
· Work closely with Accounting to understand actual results and ensure consistency between historical financial reporting and forward-looking projections.
· Partner with business leaders to understand the operational drivers behind financial results.
· Provide financial guidance to department leaders during budgeting and forecasting.
· Serve as a trusted financial partner capable of challenging assumptions constructively and providing data-driven recommendations.
Reporting, Data & Process Improvement
· Develop scalable FP&A processes, models, reporting tools, and financial dashboards.
· Improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of financial reporting and forecasting.
· Identify opportunities to automate recurring financial analysis and reporting.
· Ensure financial models and reports are accurate, well documented, auditable, and easy to maintain.
· Work with financial and operational systems to improve data integrity and accessibility.

Requirements
· 5+ years of experience in FP&A, M&A, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory, or another analytically rigorous finance role.
· Demonstrated experience building integrated three-statement financial models from the ground up, including Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement projections.
· Advanced financial modeling skills, including forecasting, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, and financial statement analysis.
· Strong understanding of accounting principles and the relationships between the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement.
· Experience developing budgets, forecasts, and long-range financial plans.

postings.descriptionText:
Launch Your Next Successful Chapter with Veta Virtual! 🚀

💸 Competitive Salary in USD | 🌍 100% Remote | 📈 Performance Incentives | 🏦 Global Treasury & Finance Role

Veta Virtual is hiring a Treasury Analyst for one of our high growth clients in the fintech and cryptocurrency industry. This is not a basic reporting role. This is a high responsibility treasury position for someone who can manage global banking relationships, liquidity, and risk with precision, and who is comfortable working directly with a treasury manager or corporate treasurer to keep every account accurate and every forecast reliable.

🔑 Your Role

As a Treasury Analyst , you will report directly to the Treasury Manager and support the full scope of global treasury operations for a fintech and cryptocurrency platform with thousands of kiosks operating across multiple countries. You will be responsible for daily cash positioning, bank reconciliation, liquidity management, cash forecasting, and ensuring full compliance with international accounting standards. Your day-to-day will involve:

• Preparing daily cash positioning within the treasury management system to support global liquidity management.

• Monitoring and reconciling cash related accounts, including bank accounts, cash in kiosks, and cash in transit, and analyzing this data for KPI reporting.

• Reconciling all bank accounts to make sure banking transactions are accurate and consistent with the books, and eliminating variances.

• Providing reconciliation reports to the accounting team to support the month close process

• Overseeing the sourcing, management, and administration of bank relationships and bank accounts for domestic and international operations, and liaising with banks for statements, reports, and updates on cash position.

• Monitoring fund disbursements to make sure all income and expenditure is recorded in line with internal procedures and international accounting standards.

• Keeping accurate financial and treasury records for every transaction.

• Preparing ad hoc management reports on budget utilization and variances, explaining deviations, and proposing preliminary recommendations for management review.

• Overseeing administrative matters related to the code of conduct for financial activities, and reporting and investigating any unusual activity or transactions.

• Supporting management in the financial decision making process.

• Coordinating and maintaining daily, thirteen week, and twenty six week cash forecasting to make sure adequate funds are available to meet program needs.

• Reviewing budget proposals from other functions for technical errors or issues.

• Providing analysis, detail, and explanations on the status of the company's accounts.

✅ What You'll Need

• A bachelor's degree in business administration with an emphasis on accounting and finance.

• An MBA is preferred.

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role.

• A CPA or Certified Management Accountant credential is preferable.

• Experience developing financial models.

• Familiarity with Access or another database software application.

• Technical awareness of accounting and treasury management systems and other business software.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to stay self motivated.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks at once without losing focus.

• A proactive approach, with the ability to meet and beat project deadlines.

• Comfort and proficiency using AI tools to support forecasting, reporting, and daily productivity is a strong plus.

• Excellent Excel skills, including advanced formulas such as VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and INDEX MATCH, pivot tables for reporting and variance analysis, and the ability to build and maintain rolling cash forecasts, reconciliation trackers, and financial models from scratch, ideally with some comfort in macros or Power Query for repeatable reporting.

• Bonus: basic knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain.

• To be considered for this role, you must currently be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

💼 What We Offer

• 💸 Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently every month, no matter where you are.

• 🌴 15 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.

• 💻 100% remote, work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.

• 📈 A fast paced, high growth environment at the forefront of the global fintech and cryptocurrency industry, where your forecasting and analysis directly support major financial decisions.

• 🤝 A collaborative, high trust culture through Veta Virtual and our client, where your expertise and judgment are valued from day one.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to own global treasury operations and help guide real financial decisions, apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short 2-minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first opportunity to show us your expertise, your analytical mindset, and what makes you the right person for this role. We can't wait to meet you!

Esta posición actúa como el controlador financiero del área logística, siendo responsable de auditar gastos de flete y almacenamiento (Freight & Warehousing - F&W), gestionar el cierre contable mensual del área, garantizar el cumplimiento aduanero e impulsar proyectos de optimización de costos y mejora continua.

Funciones y Responsabilidades Clave:
Control Presupuestario y Financiero Logístico:

• Validar, liquidar y conciliar facturas de proveedores logísticos de flete, almacenamiento y servicios aduaneros.

• Controlar y auditar la ejecución de gastos logísticos frente al presupuesto operativo anual (Profit Plan) de la región.

• Liderar el cierre contable de gastos logísticos y elaborar los reportes de provisiones de fin de mes (accruals).

• Garantizar la correcta asignación de costos logísticos a los centros de costo y áreas correspondientes.

• Elaborar notas de débito/crédito, cuentas de cobro y conciliación de cuentas por pagar con proveedores.

Comercio Exterior y Normativa Aduanera:

• Coordinar y monitorear la operativa de comercio exterior y trámites aduaneros bajo la legislación local vigente de Argentina.

• Auditar los contratos y Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) comerciales firmados con operadores logísticos (3PL).

Analítica, KPIs y Margen de Contribución:

• Desarrollar y mantener tableros de control (Scorecards) e indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) para medir la eficiencia operacional de la logística.

• Generar el reporte de asignación de costos por SKU para el análisis del margen de contribución directa (DCM).

• Monitorear los costos diarios de la operación y el nivel semanal de capacidad y ocupación de almacenamiento tercerizado (3PL).

• Realizar el seguimiento de la proyección semanal de ventas (sales outlook) en relación con el plan financiero corporativo.

Gobernanza de Sistemas y Mejora Continua:

• Gestionar el registro de órdenes de compra (PO), facturas, solicitudes de pedido y remisiones en el sistema ERP (SAP).

• Liderar e implementar proyectos de mejora continua (Lean / Continuous Improvement) enfocados en ahorro de costos y eficiencias presupuestarias (Productivity / Cost-Out).

• Mantener relaciones comerciales estratégicas con proveedores de insumos y servicios logísticos.

Requisitos:

• Educación: Profesional graduado en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Comercio Exterior, Comercio Internacional o carreras afines.

• Experiencia: Mínimo tres (3) años de experiencia comprobable desempeñándose como Controller de COMEX y Proyectos (Supply & Logistics), preferiblemente en empresas multinacionales.

• Conocimientos Técnicos: Experiencia sólida en procesos aduaneros y normativa de comercio exterior en Argentina. Dominio avanzado de Excel avanzado y Google Workspace. Deseable conocimiento de módulos logísticos y financieros en SAP u otro ERP. Sólidos conocimientos en contabilidad analítica, finanzas corporativas y gestión presupuestaria.

• Idiomas: Dominio fluido del idioma inglés y español (oral y escrito).

Habilidades:

• Alta capacidad de análisis financiero-operativo y mentalidad enfocada en la mejora continua de procesos.

• Fuerte liderazgo y habilidad para trabajar colaborativamente con equipos multidisciplinarios (Finanzas, Ventas, Operaciones).

• Excelente comunicación interpersonal, capacidad de negociación y r esolución efectiva de conflictos.

• Proactividad para detectar oportunidades de eficiencia que contribuyan a la rentabilidad del negocio.

• Obtener y analizar las justificaciones correspondientes a los desvíos detectados, realizando su seguimiento.

• Generar información y análisis que contribuyan a identificar oportunidades de mejora y optimización de costos.

• Capacidad analítica y orientación al detalle.

• Orientación a resultados y mejora continua.

En Coface, hacemos que el comercio suceda todos los días.

• Elaborar informes de análisis de deudores integrando evaluación cualitativa y cuantitativa basada en fuentes públicas y privadas, entrevistas con el management y revisiones financieras, proporcionando recomendaciones de crédito claras, sólidas y fundamentadas.

• Monitorear de forma continua sectores sensibles y de alto riesgo, identificando tendencias emergentes y emitiendo alertas tempranas cuando se detecten cambios significativos que puedan afectar la solvencia de los compradores.

• Supervisar la identificación, escalamiento y seguimiento de información adversa y alertas de riesgo provenientes de proveedores de información, terceras fuentes o asegurados, garantizando una investigación y resolución oportuna.

postings.title: ITAD Operations Associate (finance-focused)
postings.descriptionText:
About AppDirect
Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
About Firstbase, an AppDirect Subsidiary
Firstbase helps companies equip their teams with everything they need to do great work—from computers and furniture to company swag and perks. We give businesses the ability to instantly support employees with the right physical goods, and give employees the flexibility to choose what works for their unique needs. Firstbase is part of AppDirect, a subscription commerce platform that powers millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations selling any product, through any channel, on any device—as a service.
About You
The ITAD Operations Associate will own the financial side of our IT Asset Disposition program, a small, fast-moving team responsible for what happens to hardware at the end of its life, and for the money that comes back when it's resold or recycled. You'll own the final word on whether a settlement is right. Half of that is investigative: a deposit that doesn't match any invoice, a partner file that's quietly missing a hundred devices, revenue a vendor earned months ago that never reached our books. You find it, you prove it, you close it. Increasingly, you won't do that hunting alone. We're building AI agents that work these queues inside ITAD OS, our internal operations platform, pulling partner files apart, matching deposits against revenue, flagging the rows that look wrong, and we're putting the best AI tooling available into this team's hands as fast as it ships. That moves the job up, not away: the agent proposes, you decide. Your value becomes knowing what the right answer should look like, catching the case the agent got confidently wrong, and turning a workflow you've been running by hand into one that runs itself with you supervising it. If you'd rather be the person who automates their own job than the one it gets automated around, this is that seat.
This posting is for the finance-focused seat on the team. Alongside your primary ownership, you'll be trained across the rest of our ITAD operations —data destruction documentation, vendor management, shipping and logistics — so the team can cover for one another. Everyone here rotates.
The position offers a flexible hybrid schedule: you will work one day per week onsite and four days remote. Compensation includes 15 paid working days (PTO) plus local holidays, comprehensive medical coverage (OSDE Plan 310) for you and your dependents, reimbursement for eligible wellness activities, English lessons, global and local events participation, and much more!
What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Ingest settlement and revenue reports from our resale and recycling partners. Every partner sends a different format, and a real part of the craft is turning messy vendor data into clean, trustworthy records without introducing errors.

• Reconcile device-level and order-level ITAD revenue against actual bank deposits, and allocate deposits to settlements.

• Investigate unmatched records, ambiguous serials and variances.

• Own the end-to-end credit issuance workflow in partnership with Finance.

• Raise and resolve discrepancies directly with our vendor partners.

• Own financial reporting for the ITAD program, including revenue and margin, and produce executive-ready summaries that go straight to leadership.

• Review and ingest Certificates of Destruction and data destruction reports from partners, matching them to the devices they cover.

• Monitor ITAD action queues, ensuring steps are followed per SOPs and that we're hitting our service level objectives.

• Support shipment and recycling order workflows with our warehouses and partner facilities: pick lists, ship and receipt dates, and resolving receipt exceptions.

• Maintain and enrich our internal database of fair market value estimates per device, drawing on secondary market platforms, trade-in partners and historical resale data.

• Act as a primary point of contact between Operations, Finance, Customer Success and Warehouse teams for ITAD financial workflows.

What we’re looking for

• 2–5 years in reconciliation, cash applications, billing, audit, accounts payable/receivable, or financial operations. This is a hands-on execution role.

• Demonstrated experience finding and resolving discrepancies, not just processing transactions. We'll ask you about a number that didn't tie and what you did about it.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, text-to-columns, deduplication, and genuine comfort cleaning up badly formatted exports.

• Strong spoken and written English. You'll speak and write directly to partners in the US and UK, and to colleagues over Slack. Expect this to be assessed.

• The judgment to know when something is wrong, and the confidence to escalate rather than force a match.

• High attention to detail, and the ability to run several parallel workflows without losing track of any of them.

• Comfortable with structured SOPs, but restless about improving them.

(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.
About AppDirect:
AppDirect is the only end-to-end commerce platform for selling, distributing, and managing cloud-based products and services to succeed in the digital economy. The AppDirect ecosystem connects channels, developers, and customers through its platform to simplify the digital supply chain by enabling the onboarding and sale of products with third-party services, for any channel, on any device, with support. Powering millions of cloud subscriptions worldwide, AppDirect helps organizations, including Jaguar Land Rover, Comcast, ADP, and Deutsche Telekom connect their customers to the solutions they need to reach their full potential in the digital economy.
We believe that the unique contributions of all AppDirectors is the driver of our success. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.
At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice: link: https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice

Descripción del puesto

El puesto lidera el proceso de Settlement de los eventos de la compañía, desde el análisis previo de las condiciones económicas del negocio hasta la conciliación y el cierre definitivo de cada show. Entiende el evento como una unidad de negocio analiza su rentabilidad, identifica desvíos y anticipa riesgos. Además, sostiene los resultados frente a áreas internas, auditores, contadores de artistas, promotores y socios.

Reporta al Gerente de Settlement y tiene a cargo un equipo de 3 analistas.

Responsabilidades

• Liderazgo, coordinación y desarrollo del equipo de Analistas de Settlement, con definición de prioridades, estándares de trabajo y seguimiento de entregables.

• Supervisión del proceso completo de Settlement, desde la preparación previa al show hasta el cierre definitivo del negocio.

• Revisión de las condiciones económicas, fiscales y contractuales de cada proyecto.

• Comparación entre offer, forecast y resultado final, con identificación y explicación de los desvíos.

• Análisis de rentabilidad de los eventos y elaboración de reportes ejecutivos para la toma de decisiones.

• Supervisión de conciliaciones de ticketing, ingresos, costos, anticipos, pagos y facturación.

• Control de conceptos propios del negocio escaladores, bonos, rebates, retenciones, gross-up, seguros, costos compartidos y tipos de cambio contractuales.

• Revisión y aprobación de los Settlements antes de su presentación a terceros.

• Presentación y negociación de resultados con auditores, representantes y contadores de artistas, promotores, socios y Live Nation.

• Participación presencial en los shows cuando se requiera, brindando información al staff financiero del artista.

• Trabajo transversal con Finanzas, Contabilidad, Impuestos, Tesorería, Ticketing, Producción, Booking, Legales y Operaciones.

• Impulso de mejoras, automatizaciones y estandarización de procesos y reportes.

Requisitos

Requisitos

• Graduado/a universitario/a en Administración, Negocios, Economía, Finanzas, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines. No es excluyente la formación contable.

• Experiencia en controlling, análisis de negocios, planeamiento comercial, finanzas o planning. Se valora el origen en consumo masivo u otras industrias dinámicas y de alta complejidad.

Job Purpose

The FP&A Staff Consultant supports the delivery of financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis activities, focusing on accurate execution, data integrity, and timely support of FP&A deliverables.

The role is primarily execution‑focused, performing foundational FP&A tasks under guidance while building core analytical, financial, and digital skills. The Staff Consultant contributes to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities and supports the adoption of standardized and digitally enabled FP&A ways of working.

This role serves as a developmental foundation within the future‑ready FP&A model, preparing individuals for progression into more advanced FP&A analytical and consulting roles.

Job Goals

• Deliver accurate FP&A execution

•

• Perform assigned planning, forecasting, and reporting tasks accurately and on time.

• Ensure completeness and correctness of data used in FP&A outputs.

• Support performance visibility

•

• Assist in preparing variance analysis, reports, and KPI summaries.

• Help maintain transparent and reliable performance information.

• Build foundational analytical capability

•

• Develop understanding financial drivers, KPIs, and business performance metrics.

• Apply structured thinking to routine analysis and reconciliations.

• Adopt digital and standardized ways of working

•

• Use templates, automation tools, and dashboards to improve efficiency.

• Reduce manual effort and errors by following standard FP&A processes.

• Develop FP&A technical and professional skills

•

• Build proficiency in Excel, financial models, and analytics tools.

• Develop communication, organization, and ownership skills.

Key Responsibilities

• Support execution of FP&A activities, including:

•

• Budgeting, Forecasting, and Planning

• Financial Modeling and Variance Analysis

• Performance Reporting and KPI Analysis

• Cost and Profitability Analysis

• Cash Flow Analysis

• Collect, validate, and prepare input data for forecasts, budgets, and reports.

• Update templates, reports, trackers, and planning models.

• Perform basic variance analysis and highlight deviations for review.

• Ensure adherence to defined FP&A standards, calendars, and processes.

Digital & Analytical Enablement Support

• Prepare reports and dashboards using Excel and BI tools (e.g., Power BI).

• Support automation of recurring reports and data preparation tasks.

• Perform basic data checks, reconciliations, and validations.

• Participate in testing, documentation, and adoption of new FP&A tools.

Stakeholder & Team Support

• Provide timely support to Senior Consultants and Managers during planning and reporting cycles.

• Respond to basic data and reporting requests with guidance.

• Prepare materials for internal reviews and discussions.

• Escalate issues, data gaps, or delays promptly.

Learning, Development & Collaboration

• Actively learn FP&A processes, tools, and business drivers.

• Follow established methodologies, SOPs, and documentation standards.

• Participate in training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong professionalism, reliability, and willingness to learn.

Performance & Quality Support

• Support tracking of basic FP&A KPIs (timeliness, accuracy).

• Help maintain data consistency between forecasts, plans, and reports.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through observations and suggestions.

Functional & Technical Skills

• Foundational understanding of FP&A concepts, including:

•

• Budgeting, Forecasting, and Planning

• Financial Modeling and Variance Analysis

• Performance and KPI Reporting

• Cost and Profitability Concepts

• Cash Flow Fundamentals

• Strong Excel skills and basic financial modeling capability.

• Exposure to analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) preferred.

• Familiarity with planning and EPM tools is a plus.

• Attention to detail and strong data accuracy mindset.

Future-Ready & Behavioral Competencies

• Analytical Foundation: Demonstrates logical thinking and numerical accuracy.

• Learning Agility: Quickly learns new tools, processes, and concepts.

• Digital Awareness: Comfortable using analytics tools and automation‑enabled workflows.

• Collaboration: Works effectively within FP&A and broader finance teams.

• Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned tasks and timelines.

• Professional Discipline: Follows standards, controls, and documentation requirements.

Performance Metrics / KPIs

• Accuracy and completeness of assigned FP&A tasks

• Timeliness of deliverables

• Data quality and adherence to standards

• Responsiveness during planning and reporting cycles

• Skill development and capability progression

Qualifications & Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

• Experience: 0–2 years of relevant finance, accounting, or analytical experience (internships included).

• Exposure to FP&A, reporting, analytics, or finance operations is preferred.

• Strong interest in financial analysis, planning, and business insight development.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Commercial Finance Manager para liderar la agenda financiera de una operación regional con presencia en múltiples países de Latinoamérica.
Buscamos un perfil con fuerte orientación al negocio, capaz de actuar como socio estratégico de líderes comerciales y funcionales, aportando visión financiera para impulsar el crecimiento rentable, la toma de decisiones y la ejecución de la estrategia.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar los procesos de planeación financiera, forecasting, presupuesto y análisis de desempeño.

• Actuar como Business Partner de líderes comerciales y funcionales, brindando recomendaciones basadas en análisis financiero.

• Evaluar rentabilidad por cliente, canal, categoría y portafolio.

• Participar en la definición de estrategias de crecimiento, pricing e inversiones comerciales.

• Garantizar la calidad y consistencia de los análisis financieros para la toma de decisiones.

• Gestionar la identificación y seguimiento de riesgos y oportunidades del negocio.

• Liderar y desarrollar a un miembro del equipo de Finanzas.

• Trabajar de forma cercana con stakeholders regionales y equipos multifuncionales.

Perfil requerido

• Licenciatura en Finanzas, Contabilidad, Economía, Administración, Ingeniería o afín.

• Experiencia sólida en Commercial Finance, FP&A, Business Controlling o Finance Business Partnering .

• Experiencia apoyando la toma de decisiones de negocio a nivel gerencial o directivo.

• Conocimiento de forecasting, budgeting, análisis financiero, P&L y performance management.

• Experiencia trabajando en entornos matriciales y con múltiples stakeholders.

• Experiencia liderando equipos o proyectos con responsabilidad de liderazgo.

• Inglés avanzado.

Valoraremos especialmente

• Experiencia en empresas de consumo masivo (FMCG), retail o industrias orientadas al consumidor.

• Experiencia regional y/o multi-país.

• Conocimientos de rentabilidad por cliente, canal, pricing, trade investments y estrategias comerciales.

• Manejo de herramientas de planeación y análisis financiero (Anaplan, HFM, Power BI, Excel avanzado).

Buscamos una persona que destaque por

• Visión estratégica de negocio.

• Capacidad de influencia y manejo de stakeholders.

• Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados.

• Habilidad para desafiar constructivamente y generar consenso.

• Adaptabilidad para desenvolverse en estructuras ágiles y dinámicas.

Si te motiva desempeñar un rol con alta exposición al negocio, impacto regional y participación activa en la toma de decisiones estratégicas, nos encantaría conocerte.

La posición tendrá interacción con bancos locales e internacionales, organismos multilaterales, inversores institucionales, agencias de rating y mercados de capitales , participando de operaciones de financiamiento y liability management.

Responsabilidades

• Liderar la estructuración y ejecución de financiamientos corporativos y de proyectos.

• Evaluar alternativas de financiamiento bancario, mercado de capitales y organismos multilaterales.

• Coordinar operaciones de préstamos sindicados, financiamientos bilaterales, project finance, emisiones de deuda y liability management.

• Desarrollar y mantener modelos financieros para análisis crediticio, evaluación de estructuras de financiamiento y proyección de escenarios.

• Preparar presentaciones y materiales para bancos, inversores, agencias de rating, organismos multilaterales y alta dirección.

• Coordinar procesos de due diligence junto con asesores financieros, legales y técnicos.

• Analizar documentación financiera y contractual asociada a las distintas operaciones.

• Monitorear covenants, obligaciones financieras, vencimientos e indicadores de endeudamiento.

Requisitos

Requisitos

• Graduados/as de Economía, Administración de Empresas, Finanzas, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Más de 8 años de experiencia en Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, Project Finance, Financiamiento Estructurado, Debt Capital Markets, Crédito Corporativo, Debt Advisory o áreas relacionadas.

• Sólidos conocimientos de análisis y modelización financiera y evaluación crediticia.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel y PowerPoint.

• Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito. - Excluyente -

En MSU combinamos más de 160 años de trayectoria en el agro con más de una década de experiencia en generación eléctrica. Esta base nos permitió construir un portafolio energético sólido, respaldado por altos estándares de gestión y tecnología que impulsan nuestro crecimiento.

Desde 2016, invertimos más de USD 1.000 millones en infraestructura energética, contribuyendo a mejorar la calidad del suministro y generando impacto en industrias y comunidades.

A través de MSU Energy , desarrollamos y operamos 7 centrales térmicas , consolidando nuestra experiencia en generación convencional. En paralelo, con MSU Green Energy , impulsamos la transición hacia una matriz más sustentable actualmente operamos 5 parques solares y avanzamos con 2 proyectos adicionales en desarrollo .

Somos una compañía en constante expansión, donde el crecimiento , la innovación y el desarrollo de las personas son parte central de nuestro camino. Buscamos quienes quieran sumarse a un entorno dinámico, con desafíos reales y la oportunidad de generar impacto.

postings.title: People Financial Planning Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Estamos revolucionando las finanzas en América Latina 🚀

Fundada en 2017, Ualá nació con la misión de llevar los servicios financieros en América Latina al Siglo XXI. Hoy, ya somos el neobanco de más de 11 millones de usuarios y seguimos creciendo para transformar la industria en la región con soluciones fáciles y accesibles.

Con presencia en Argentina, México y Colombia, seguimos expandiendo nuestro ecosistema con productos innovadores en Medios de Pago, Crédito, Inversiones y soluciones para comercios con Ualá Bis. Además, logramos la ronda de inversión más grande de la región en los últimos años y seguimos sumando talento para hacer realidad nuestra visión.

Si querés ser parte de un equipo de +1000 personas que desafía lo establecido, trabaja con la mejor tecnología y siempre pone a las personas en el centro, ¡sumate a Ualá!

#LoMejorEstáPorVenir

En esta oportunidad, nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a People Financial Planning Manager cuyo principal objetivo será liderar la planificación, proyección y seguimiento presupuestario de People, garantizando la optimización de los recursos financieros y asegurando la alineación estratégica entre las metas del negocio y la propuesta de compensaciones de la organización.

Tendrás El Desafío De

• Diseñar, construir y gestionar el presupuesto anual de personal (headcount, salarios, cargas sociales, beneficios) y el OPEX del área de People para las distintas geografías.

• Liderar el proceso de forecast y análisis de desvíos (actual vs. budget) en partnership directo con Finanzas y Senior Management, anticipando riesgos y proponiendo planes de acción correctivos.

• Modelar escenarios financieros para revisiones salariales, esquemas de comisiones, bonos y programas de incentivos de corto y largo plazo (LTI/ESOP).

• Evaluar la estructura de costos de compensaciones y beneficios a nivel regional, identificando oportunidades de eficiencia y competitividad salarial alineadas con la propuesta de valor y políticas de la organización.

• Definir, monitorear y consolidar KPIs y reportes financieros clave de capital humano (costo por FTE, ratio de compensación variable, eficiencia de headcount) para C-Level y el Directorio.

• Asesorar a los líderes de People y business partners en la asignación eficiente de recursos para atracción, desarrollo y retención de talento.

• Dar soporte financiero en procesos de M&A (due diligence de estructura de costos laborales, integración de nómina) y en la construcción de business cases para nuevas iniciativas de People.

Qué buscamos para este rol

• 5+ años de experiencia en planificación financiera (FP&A) aplicada a Recursos Humanos, control de gestión o finanzas corporativas.

• Liderazgo en gestión de costos y elaboración de reportes o tableros para audiencias ejecutivas y C-Level.

• Experiencia en diseño, análisis y administración de estructuras de compensaciones y beneficios.

• Experiencia desarrollada en empresas financieras, fintechs, tecnología o entornos regionales de alto crecimiento

• Título universitario en las carreras de Economía, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Contabilidad, Recursos Humanos o afines.

• Perfil analítico, con fuerte orientación al detalle y capacidad de modelado financiero avanzado (Excel avanzado; valorable Google Sheets, SQL o herramientas de BI).

• Capacidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios (Finanzas, People, Legal, Business Partners) y comunicarse de manera clara y sintética con la alta dirección.

• Mirada estratégica y capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos.

• Liderazgo por influencia.

• Inglés: Upper.intermediate - avanzado

¿Por qué trabajar en Ualá?

Queremos compartir con vos...

• Ambiente laboral flexible, en crecimiento y con un enorme potencial de desarrollo profesional.

• Acceso a formación en instituciones educativas de primer nivel con descuentos en capacitaciones, cursos y carreras.

• Valoramos el equilibrio entre la vida profesional y personal, por eso contamos con tres semanas de vacaciones, licencias extendidas, día libre en tu cumpleaños, políticas de trabajo flexible y más.

• También brindamos cobertura de medicina prepaga para grupo familiar, descuento en gimnasios, cashback del 70% en tus compras con la tarjeta de Ualá con tope de reintegro, bono por referidos y otros beneficios que te acompañan dentro y fuera del trabajo.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de la diversidad de miradas y experiencias, por eso, creamos un espacio seguro y colaborativo, en el que todas las voces cuentan.En Ualá contamos con representantes de 11 nacionalidades, de diversos orígenes y experiencias. El 46% del equipo son mujeres, un hito en una empresa tecnológico-financiera. Si lo comparamos con América Latina, menos del 30% del personal que trabaja en empresas fintech son mujeres. Esa diversidad nos fortalece y es la única manera de desarrollar un producto inclusivo para competir con las mejores empresas de la región y el mundo.Si te motiva transformar la industria y hacer las cosas de otra manera, te estamos buscando. Porque desde el primer día construímos el equipo con una máxima: sólo el mejor equipo puede hacer el mejor producto. Por eso contratar, retener, y apostar al talento es lo más importante que hacemos.#Sumate
