postings.title: Sr. Accounting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About The Team

You’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative Accounting & Finance team that truly partners with Operations and Supply Chain. We value curiosity, ownership, and teamwork, and we believe the best results come from people who aren’t afraid to ask questions, dig deeper, and help each other out. As we continue to grow, the team plays a key role in building scalable processes while staying close to the day-to-day realities of the business.

The Role

We’re looking for a Sr. Accounting Analyst to own prepaid expense reconciliations, lease accounting, and expense analysis across software, insurance, utilities, and general operating expenses.

This role plays a key part in the monthly close, ensuring accurate accounting records, complete supporting documentation, and clear explanations of account variances. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge with curiosity, attention to detail, is adept at balance sheet account reconciliations and the ability to independently manage assigned processes.

The position reports directly to the Sr. Accounting Manager and is a full-time role.

Responsibilities

• Own the monthly close for assigned accounts, preparing journal entries, accruals, and adjustments within established deadlines.

• Prepares and maintains clear and well documented account reconciliations for their area of responsibility.

• Maintain lease accounting under ASC 842, including lease schedules, monthly entries, and reconciliations of right-of-use assets and lease liabilities using 3rd part lease accounting software.

• Review lease agreements, amendments, renewals, and terminations, identifying accounting implications and coordinating the appropriate treatment with the Accounting Manager.

• Ensure proper classification and recording of rent, utilities, and other occupancy-related expenses based on contract terms and applicable accounting policies.

• Own prepaid expense reconciliations and amortization schedules, ensuring expenses are recognized in the appropriate periods.

• Perform monthly variance analysis for software, insurance, utilities, rent, and general operating expenses, investigating movements and providing clear, supported explanations.

• Review invoices, contracts, and account activity to identify missing accruals, coding errors, and timing differences.

• Reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and proactively resolve outstanding items.

• Collaborate with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders to obtain timely information and ensure accurate expense recognition.

• Maintain process documentation and support internal controls across assigned areas.

• Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for external audits.

• Contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives, reviewing outputs critically to ensure accuracy.

• Support ad hoc accounting projects as needed.

Qualifications

• 3–4 years of relevant experience in accounting or audit roles.

• Advanced English skills, with the ability to communicate accounting matters clearly in writing and verbally.

• Experience with month-end close, journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Experience preparing prepaid expense reconciliations and amortization schedules.

• Degree in Accounting or a related field.

• Strong understanding of expense recognition and the distinction between rent, utilities, and other occupancy-related charges.

• Experience performing account variance analysis and explaining the underlying business drivers.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound accounting judgment.

• Ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities, meet deadlines, and proactively communicate issues or roadblocks.

• Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with LeaseQuery.

• US GAAP knowledge, including ASC 842 lease accounting.

• Experience with NetSuite.

• Experience with multi-currency entities.

• Experience improving accounting processes through automation or AI tools, including validating the accuracy of their outputs.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

💸 Get paid in USD

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: access to a benefits platform you can use for wellness, learning, food, and more

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.title: Reconciliation Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Drive Financial Integrity & Payment Analytics for Global E-Commerce

About The Company

Marbill is a fast-growing brand within the Luna Group, a global leader redefining the future of e-commerce. Marbill empowers merchants worldwide and focuses on delivering cutting-edge, AI-driven solutions.

We are an ambitious, agile team comprised of professionals from over 30 countries. We thrive on challenges, move quickly, and value solution-oriented thinking. We equip our team with the tools and support they need to succeed, fostering both professional and personal growth in a fully remote environment.

What We Offer

💻 Fully Remote Position: Work from anywhere in the world.

⏰ Flexible Working Hours: Work when you're most productive.

🎁 Referral Bonuses: Get rewarded for bringing great talent on board.

💰 Competitive Salary: Based on your experience, with regular reviews.

About The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Reconciliation Specialist to join our Commercial Strategy team. In this role, you will own end-to-end financial reconciliation, monitor processing metrics, and manage risk across our global merchant portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of complex payment data modeling, business analytics, and executive decision support.

If you're looking to boost your career, now is the perfect opportunity!

What You'll Do

• Own end-to-end reconciliation across our portfolio of merchant entities in the US, EU and LATAM, matching invoices, acquirer/PSP settlements, payouts and bank movements at merchant and MID level.

• Reconcile chargeback-related costs and credits (dispute fees, RDR, VAMP fees, rolling reserves and reserve releases) against what acquirers and partners actually charged or credited.

• Track payment plans and installment schedules with partners, flagging overdue, overpaid and in-transit amounts with a clear status per merchant.

• Run the monthly reconciliation close: exception logs, aging of open items, documentation and sign-off.

• Act as business controller for the payments side: monitor processing costs, refunds and chargebacks by entity and geography, analyze variances against budget and forecast, and flag margin risks early.

• Produce clear, concise reporting for leadership on financial exposure, recoveries and open issues.

What You’ll Bring

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

• +5 years of experience in reconciliation, financial control or business controlling, ideally in payments, fintech, e-commerce or subscription businesses.

• Solid understanding of the card payments ecosystem: acquirers, MIDs, settlement cycles, scheme fees, chargebacks and reserves.

• Experience working across multiple entities and currencies (USD/EUR) and different jurisdictions.

• Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort handling large, messy datasets.

• A rigorous, detail-oriented mindset: you don't stop at "there's a gap," you find out why.

• Strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously, prioritize and keep many open items moving at once.

• Clear communication skills in English, able to explain complex financial issues simply to non-finance stakeholders.

Bonus Skills

• Proven experience automating, matching and building repeatable reconciliation processes.

• Familiarity with Visa/Mastercard dispute and monitoring programs (VAMP, RDR, Ethoca, Verifi).

• Experience with BI tools (Power BI)

• Experience building or scaling a reconciliation or controlling function from scratch.

• Background managing high-risk or subscription merchant portfolios.

• Professional working proficiency in Spanish.

Role Details & How To Apply

• Location: Fully Remote

• Type: Full-time (~40 hours/week)

• Contract: Independent Contractor / Long-term engagement

Why Marbill & Luna Group?

We believe in empowering our people. Here, your ideas matter, and your growth is a priority. If you are looking for a challenging role where you can work with the latest technologies and build impactful solutions, this is the perfect opportunity.

Apply now and let’s make an impact together!

Data Protection Notice: By submitting your application, you agree that your personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by Marbill / Luna Group solely for recruitment and candidacy assessment purposes.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

postings.title: Financial Controller, Argentina & Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

We're building a regional finance and operations hub in Buenos Aires, and this role owns the finance engine for Argentina and Uruguay. Reporting to the Director Finance & Operations, South America, you'll be accountable for the close, tax, statutory compliance and controls across both entities, and you'll lead a Financial Accountant and a Billing Admin from day one.

This is a build role in the literal sense. Some processes exist when you arrive; most don't. You'll design them, run them, and make them hold as volume grows fast. You'll work closely with the Director on planning and strategy, and with Halter's global finance team in New Zealand on consolidation, reporting and group requirements.

If you want to be the person who knows exactly why every number in two countries is right, and who built the process that makes it so, this is it.

What You'll Own

• The monthly close for Argentina and Uruguay: accurate, on time, and reconciled to group reporting.

• Tax compliance across both countries (ARCA, formerly AFIP, and provincial Ingresos Brutos in Argentina; DGI and BPS in Uruguay), with advisors managed rather than relied on.

• Statutory reporting and audits, including inflation-adjusted local reporting and the bridge to group IFRS.

• Controls and source-of-truth discipline: coding, approvals, documentation and audit-readiness across both entities.

• Treasury operations: cash positions, FX execution within the policy the Director sets, and import and supplier payment compliance.

• Leading and developing the Financial Accountant and Billing Admin, and deciding what gets automated rather than resourced.

What You'll Bring

Must-haves

• 6 to 10 years in accounting, controllership or audit, with hands-on Argentine tax and statutory experience.

• You've owned a close end-to-end, not just contributed to one.

• Working knowledge of inflation-adjusted reporting and IFRS, and the ability to reconcile the two.

• Fluency in Spanish and English. You'll work daily with the team in New Zealand.

• Experience managing or mentoring others.

• Accuracy and a builder's instinct. You're comfortable creating process where none exists.

Nice-to-haves

• Uruguayan tax and compliance exposure.

• Big 4 background, or experience in a multinational subsidiary reporting to an offshore parent.

• Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP.

• A track record of automating finance processes or using AI to create leverage.

How We'll Know You're Winning

• Close runs on time every month and reconciles to group without back-and-forth.

• Tax filings and statutory audits in both countries are clean and on time, with no surprises.

• The Director spends their time on strategy, partnering and operations, not reviewing your work.

• Your team is growing and taking on more each quarter.

Culture line

This role is Absolute Ownership of the numbers across two countries: if it's wrong, it's yours to find and fix. It rewards someone who works From First Principles to build processes that scale rather than copying familiar ones, and who brings the discipline of Here to Win to a close that doesn't slip.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Position Overview

We are looking for approximately three Senior SAP Cost Center Planning Consultants to support the Accounting team during a 3–4 month project as part of the transition to SAP Cost Center Planning.
The consultant will serve as a Controlling Champion, working closely with Plant Controllers to ensure the accuracy and completeness of actual postings, validate cost center structures, support cost categorization and allocation activities, and execute the end-to-end cost center planning process.
This role requires strong hands-on experience in SAP Controlling (CO), a solid understanding of manufacturing plant operations, and the ability to work directly with business and plant finance teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with Plant Controllers to review and validate actual postings, identifying incorrect allocations and posting errors.

• Analyze transactional SAP data, identify posting issues, and collaborate with business stakeholders on appropriate correction methodologies.

• Validate cost center structures, ownership, groupings, and expense categorization.

• Support all cost center planning activities, including SAP transactions such as KP06, KP26, KSU7, KSS4, KSPI, and related planning processes.

• Guide Plant Controllers on planning templates, activity rate calculations, allocation methodologies, and reconciliation activities.

• Support the definition and validation of assessment and distribution cycles, including allocation logic.

• Analyze under-absorption and over-absorption of production orders and help the business understand their root causes.

• Ensure compliance with cost center planning governance, ownership assignments, and planning calendar requirements.

• Evaluate absorption logic, including the treatment of non-absorbing cost centers.

• Support CO-PA integration preparation and assess the impact of cost center planning on product costing and profitability analysis.

• Provide expertise in Product Costing and support the understanding of Material Ledger impacts related to cost center planning.

• Develop user manuals, step-by-step guides, and plant-specific process documentation.

• Deliver training and knowledge transfer sessions for Plant Controllers and other business users.

• Document allocation logic, cost center grouping rules, and procedures for cleansing actual postings.

• Support reconciliations and ensure consistency of planning and transactional data across related processes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• 8–10 years of relevant SAP experience with deep expertise in SAP Controlling (CO) and Cost Center Planning.

• Strong hands-on experience with SAP cost center planning processes.

• Proven experience analyzing SAP transactions and actual postings, identifying posting errors, and recommending corrective actions.

• Strong knowledge of:

• Cost Center Accounting (CCA)

• Cost Center Planning

• Activity Type and Activity Rate Planning

• Assessment and Distribution Cycles

• Cost Allocation Methodologies

• Product Costing

• CO-PA Integration and Planning

• Absorption logic and production order under-/over-absorption

• Material Ledger impacts

• Solid understanding of manufacturing plant operations and the relationship between operational activities, cost centers, activity rates, and product costing.

• Experience working directly with Plant Controllers and business stakeholders.

• Strong analytical, data reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience creating training materials, user documentation, and process guides.

• Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).

Key Competencies

• SAP CO / Cost Center Planning expertise

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Hands-on approach to transactional and data analysis

• Business and manufacturing operations understanding

• Stakeholder management and communication skills

• Ability to work independently with Plant Controllers and Finance teams

• Documentation and training capabilities

• Knowledge of planning governance and process controls

Project Details

• Resources Required: 3 consultants

• Business Area: Accounting / Controlling

postings.title: Responsable Contable
postings.descriptionText:
MÉDICOS SIN FRONTERAS – SECCIÓN MSF LAT busca para su oficina en Buenos Aires

RESPONSABLE CONTABLE

CONTEXTO GENERAL
Médicos Sin Fronteras (MSF) es una organización médico-humanitaria de carácter internacional e independiente, que ofrece asistencia a las poblaciones que sufren, a las víctimas de catástrofes naturales o provocadas por el hombre y a las víctimas de conflictos armados, sin discriminación e independientemente de su raza, religión, creencia o afiliación política (Carta Magna de MSF).
El movimiento internacional de MSF está organizado alrededor de cinco centros operacionales (OCs) apoyados por 23 secciones, 25 asociaciones y 17 oficinas en todo el mundo como la recientemente aprobada MSF LAT. Desde enero 2021 MSF Lat es una sección plena que congrega los países de América del Sur de habla hispana. Actualmente con oficinas en Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia y Chile.
Los proyectos humanitarios son implementados por los equipos de terreno en las misiones bajo la dirección de células operacionales (regulares o de emergencia) a cargo de cada OC. Desde MSF LAT contribuimos a dichas operaciones a través del reclutamiento, selección y acompañamiento de recursos humanos para el pool internacional, recaudación de fondos, comunicaciones regionales y advocacy.

PROPÓSITO PRINCIPAL
Liderar el equipo de Contabilidad de MSF LAT (Argentina y Chile) y garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas financiero-contables y los procesos necesarios para guiar la gestión contable-administrativa de la sección de MSF LAT, en cada una de sus dependencias regionales.

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DEL PUESTO
• El área de Finanzas, Administración y Servicios de Soportes (FASS), es responsable de gestionar y proteger los recursos y activos de la organización, asegurando la disponibilidad de recursos financieros y estructurales al resto de los departamentos, para que puedan llevar a cabo sus actividades, cumpliendo con los principios de transparencia y rendición de cuentas de MSF.
• El Responsable Contable:
o Lidera el área Contabilidad, la cual forma parte del departamento de Finanzas, Administración y Servicios de Soporte.
o Consolida las cifras de MSF LAT en las oficinas de Argentina y Chile.
o Lleva adelante la gestión contable-administrativa de acuerdo al marco financiero de la organización, las legislaciones locales, las directrices que define MSF Internacional, y las recomendaciones de los auditores, asegurando la fiabilidad de la información contable generada para asegurar el principio de rendición de cuentas, la toma de decisiones, así como para prevenir, identificar o minimizar los riesgos de fraude financiero y económico, y facilitando la adaptación de la estructura financiero-contable a la evolución constante de la organización.

RESPONSABILIDADES
• Definir, coordinar y supervisar los procesos contables-administrativos, cumpliendo las normativas contables y fiscales locales, controles internos, estándares de transparencia y rendición de cuentas exigidos por la organización.
• Liderar, supervisar y asegurar el proceso de cierre contables mensuales y cierre anual, estableciendo y coordinando el cronograma de trabajo.• Elaborar periódicamente reportes contables-financieros internos con el fin de que las áreas cuenten con información confiable para la toma de decisiones y llevar adelante el reporte internacional Combined Accounts de MSF LAT.
• Gestionar el equipo contable a su cargo (jerárquica y funcionalmente), asegurando el back-up de las tareas y el cumplimiento de las responsabilidades de integrantes del equipo durante períodos de ausencia.
• Asegurar la disponibilidad de la información necesaria para los ejercicios presupuestarios, dentro de los plazos previstos, con la calidad y detalle requeridos.
• Ser el punto focal de los consultores contables-impositivos y auditores externos, para asegurar el cumplimiento de las normativas locales de cada dependencia y la elaboración de los Balances Contables Anuales en tiempo y forma.

ELEMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS DEL ROL
• Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las normas, políticas y procedimientos en materia contable, tributaria, fiscal, prevención de lavado de activos, evaluando su impacto en la organización e implementando los cambios en los procesos para asegurar su cumplimiento.
• Participar en proyectos internacionales con otras secciones del movimiento, con el fin de compartir buenas prácticas y políticas, en la búsqueda de mejorar la gestión contable y financiera, estableciendo criterios contables comunes que ayuden a una mejor gestión en la consolidación internacional.
• Colaborar y proponer mejoras en el diseño e implementación del sistema de información contable y financiero, utilizando para el registro de información, y en el desarrollo e implementación de herramientas de planificación y gestión.

REQUISITOS

Formación
• Titulación universitaria en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, o afín. - Esencial.
• Conocimiento de gestión Contable-Administrativa (contabilidad, administración, bancos, impuestos). - Esencial.
• Conocimiento de gestión de Finanzas (tesorería, control financiero, gestión de caja. - Deseable.

Experiencia
• Experiencia de trabajo en organizaciones con estructuras internacionales complejas. - Deseable.
• Experiencia en Asociaciones Civiles, Fundaciones. - Deseable.
• Experiencia liderando equipos (mínimo 2 años) - Deseable.

Idioma
• Español e inglés. - Esencial.

Conocimientos
• Conocimiento elevado de entorno Windows (Excel nivel avanzado - Esencial. | Power BI - Deseable).

postings.title: Senior Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
Client Accounting & Advisory Services

Location: Argentina

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor

Compensation: USD 2,300-3,000/month

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm EST

About Convoy Finance

We like working with people who move fast, think for themselves, and care about doing great work. That's pretty much how we run Convoy.

We're a small finance and accounting firm working with technology, SaaS, fintech and Web3 companies across Canada and internationally. Our clients are ambitious businesses, and we work directly with the founders and finance teams building them.

That means we're not just looking at numbers all day. We get to see what's happening inside growing companies and help the people running them make better decisions. One week you might be deep in a month-end close, and the next you could be helping a client solve a reporting issue, clean up their books or work through something completely new.

We're a small team, too. Most of us are based in Toronto, with a few people working remotely around the world. There's very little bureaucracy, decisions happen quickly, and good ideas can actually turn into action.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Accountant who wants to be close to the action.

You'll own accounting work across a portfolio of growing companies and work directly with international clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals .

You'll be responsible for getting the accounting right, but that's only part of it. We want you to understand the business behind the numbers, notice when something doesn't add up and be confident enough to ask questions.

The clients we work with move quickly, and so do we. There will be deadlines, new problems to solve and plenty of opportunities to learn. You'll have the support of an experienced team, but you'll also be trusted to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.

As you grow into the role, you'll have the opportunity to take on more complex accounting, finance and advisory work.

What You'll Do

You'll take ownership of:

• Full-cycle accounting and bookkeeping, including reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR and month-end close

• Preparing and reviewing financial statements and management reporting

• Supporting year-end compilations, audits, reviews and tax-related work

• Working directly with clients to resolve accounting questions and issues

• Keeping client deliverables moving and communicating when something needs attention

• Finding ways to improve processes, systems and the way we work

• Supporting financial analysis and other client projects as they come up

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field and 4+ years of relevant accounting experience .

You're comfortable owning full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting, and managing multiple clients and deadlines at the same time.

You're confident communicating in English with clients and senior finance people . You can explain what the numbers mean, not just what the numbers are. This role would be a 100% in English.

And you're someone who likes to figure things out . If something looks wrong, you investigate it. If you don't know the answer, you find it. If there's a better way to do something, you speak up.

Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Taxprep or CaseWare is a plus, as is experience in public accounting, audit, tax, SaaS, technology, fintech or Web3.

CPA designation or active CPA pursuit is also a plus.

Big Four experience is a must for this role.

Benefits

Why Convoy?

You'll work with interesting companies, smart people and problems that don't always come with an instruction manual.

You'll have direct exposure to founders and senior finance leaders and get to see how growing companies actually operate. Because we're small, your work is visible and your ideas can have an impact.

We're remote-friendly, with team members working from Toronto and different parts of the world. We also make time for team lunches, happy hours and, when the numbers are good, the occasional team trip.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want a role where you can keep learning, take real ownership and grow beyond traditional accounting , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

USD 2,300-3,000 per month , depending on experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time independent contractor position .

How To Apply

Send us your resume and a brief overview of your experience.

We'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Data & Billing Specialist-Part-Time
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote (US Eastern Time Zone Required)

Type: Part-Time (4 hours per day)

The Role in Context

Acadia is looking for a Data & Billing Specialist to serve as a critical backup and support pillar for our finance leadership. In this role, you will work closely with our Assistant Controller to master our billing engine (Ordway) and provide high-level data support to our Head of Finance and Controller.

We are a lean, high-output team. We don’t need a "task-taker"—we need a partner who is curious, proactive, and committed to data cleanliness and accuracy above all else.

The "Acadia Mindset": Ask, Don’t Guess

We have a simple philosophy: We value questions over assumptions. If a data point doesn't look right, or if you aren't 100% sure how a contract should be structured in Ordway, we want you to pause and ask. We believe that a well-timed question—backed by your own hypothesis—prevents the issues that result from guessing. You are encouraged to challenge our processes and bring new ideas to the table; we are always open to feedback on how to do things better.

What You’ll Do

• Ordway Ownership: Learn to translate SOW contract terms into subscription models within Ordway. Eventually, you will take the lead on daily Ordway management, with the Assistant Controller providing oversight.

• QBO Integration: Ensure the seamless sync between Ordway and QuickBooks Online (QBO), keeping our general ledger pristine.

• Leadership Support: Assist the Head of Finance and Controller with ad-hoc data requests, financial reporting, and audit preparation.

• Data Hygiene: Proactively manage and audit data cleanliness across all financial systems to ensure reporting is 100% reliable.

• Data Integrity: Use tools like Coupler and SaasAnt to manipulate and import data with laser-sharp attention to detail.

• Process Improvement: Actively look for ways to streamline our tech stack (Ramp, Cube, Claude AI) and propose more efficient workflows.

Qualifications

Technical Qualifications

• Must-Have: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and Google Sheets/Excel. You should be comfortable with complex data manipulation.

• Process Innovation: Knowledge of and experience in automating manual processes to increase team efficiency.

• The "Plus" List: Experience with Ordway is a massive advantage. Knowledge of Ramp, Cube, Coupler, or SaasAnt will move you to the top of the list.

• Accounting Foundation: Understanding of international accounting nuances (like transfer pricing) is a plus.

• AI Savvy: Comfort using AI tools (like Claude) to enhance your productivity and data analysis.

Schedule & Coordination

• Commitment: 4 hours per day.

• Time Zone: You must be based in (or work during) US Eastern Standard Time (EST).

• The Overlap: You will spend your mornings (EST) training with our Assistant Controller (based in Kyiv) and your other availability supporting our Atlanta-based leadership team.

postings.title: Head of Finance and Accounting
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Head of Finance & Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Argentina.

This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.

You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

• The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.

• The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.

• Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.

• Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.

postings.title: Controller
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Controller to own the accounting function of a high-growth US company, working remotely from LATAM.

This is the senior accounting seat in the business. You will be accountable for the integrity of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of the company for its audit. Where the company has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a control environment that exists in principle rather than in practice, an intercompany process that produces a different answer each quarter — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

You will work directly with the CEO, the finance leadership, and the department heads whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask.

Because you will be the most senior accounting person in the company and located outside the United States, the role calls for someone who operates well with autonomy, communicates proactively rather than on request, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture without a layer above them to catch what falls through.

What You'll Own

The Close and the Financial Statements

The close. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.

The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of leadership, auditors, and the board.
Final review. Hold final review authority over general ledger activity, journal entries, account reconciliations, and fixed assets.

Technical accounting. Research, document, and conclude on technical positions — revenue recognition, leases, equity, accruals, and capitalisation — and maintain the memoranda that support them.

Multi-entity accounting. Own consolidation across the group structure, including intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to the company's stage, and enforce them once established.

Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and SOPs that allow the function to operate without depending on any single individual.

Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.

Tax coordination. Coordinate US federal, state, and local tax compliance with external CPA firms, and own the accounting inputs those firms depend on.

Accounting Operations

The transactional cycle. Own AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.

Balance sheet integrity. Ensure reconciling items are resolved rather than carried forward, and that every balance has support a reviewer can follow.

Cash reporting. Maintain accurate cash reporting and reconciliation, and provide leadership with a reliable view of position and movement.

Business partnership. Provide FP&A and department leaders with the reporting packages, KPIs, variance analysis, and root-cause explanation that budgeting and forecasting depend on.

Team and Systems

The accounting team. Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team, and manage external accounting and bookkeeping partners against agreed standards and deadlines.

Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.

Process design. Build accounting processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and cycle time as the company grows, rather than processes that break at the next stage.

What We're Looking For

• 8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of an accounting team

• Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's

• Strong command of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842); familiarity with stock-based compensation (ASC 718) is an advantage

• Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination

• A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them

• Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings

• Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks Online, or Xero, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, Gusto, or FloQast

• Comfort operating within a lean team, with the seniority to own the function and the willingness to prepare the entry yourself when circumstances require it

• Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires

• Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Preferred

• CPA, Contador Público, CRC-registered Contador, CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred

• Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience

• Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C

• Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded

• SaaS, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR

• Board, lender, and management reporting experience

• Exposure to US multi-state tax, international entities, or transfer pricing is welcome

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own a function outright rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you, and you are equally credible in a room with a CEO, an auditor, and a junior accountant.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

The Drive the Future Program is designed to provide university students with their first professional experience while completing their studies.

During journey in our program, you'll collaborate with our expert professionals to influence and shape decisions and initiatives that support our businesses across the firm. You'll have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions while developing your professional expertise in a dynamic team environment.

In Argentina, DTF Opportunities are open to students from all universities in Buenos Aires. If you are looking to gain professional experience while pursuing your degree, this could be the beginning of something great. Take in consideration that participants are hired for an initial 6-month period, with the possibility of extension up to 12 months based on participant performance, feedback, and business needs. This role requires part-time, availability in Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires.

These opportunities are intended for advanced university students of Finance/Economics/Business Administration who have approximately one year to one and a half years remaining until graduation in:

• Advanced university students of Accountancy/Industrial Engineering/Finance/Economics/Business Administration

• Intermediate to Advanced English proficiency

• Availability to work 19 hours per week

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized and disciplined, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently

• Proactive and dynamic, with the ability to perform well under pressure

• Strong analytical skills and commercial acumen

postings.title: Accounting Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Client Accounting & Advisory Services

Location: Argentina

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Convoy Finance

We like working with people who move fast, think for themselves, and care about doing great work. That's pretty much how we run Convoy.

We're a small finance and accounting firm working with technology, SaaS, fintech and Web3 companies across Canada and internationally. Our clients are ambitious businesses, and we work directly with the founders and finance teams building them.

That means we're not just looking at numbers all day. We get to see what's happening inside growing companies and help the people running them make better decisions. One week you might be leading a month-end close, and the next you could be helping a client work through a reporting issue, improve their financial processes or solve something completely new.

We're a small team, too. Most of us are based in Toronto, with a few people working remotely around the world. There's very little bureaucracy, decisions happen quickly, and good ideas can actually turn into action.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Accounting Manager who can take ownership, think beyond the books and be a trusted partner to our clients.

You'll oversee accounting work across a portfolio of growing companies and work directly with international clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals .

You'll be responsible for making sure the accounting is accurate, the work gets done well and client deliverables stay on track. But we also expect you to look beyond the numbers: understand what's happening in the business, identify issues before they become problems and bring ideas to the table.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll still be close to the accounting, while also reviewing work, guiding team members, managing priorities and helping clients navigate more complex accounting and finance questions.

Our clients move quickly, and so do we. There will be deadlines, competing priorities and new problems to solve.

As an Accounting Manager, you'll have significant ownership over your client relationships and the opportunity to grow into broader advisory, financial management and leadership responsibilities .

What You'll Do

You'll take ownership of:

• Managing a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of accounting and reporting work

• Leading and overseeing full-cycle accounting and month-end close, including reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR and financial statement preparation

• Reviewing accounting work and ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency across client deliverables

• Preparing and reviewing financial statements, management reports and financial analysis

• Working directly with founders, CFOs and senior finance teams to answer questions, resolve issues and provide accounting guidance

• Managing client deadlines, priorities and deliverables, and proactively communicating when something needs attention

• Supporting year-end compilations, audits, reviews and tax-related work

• Identifying opportunities to improve accounting processes, systems and controls

• Coaching and supporting more junior members of the accounting team

• Taking ownership of more complex accounting issues and helping the team determine the right approach

• Supporting advisory and finance projects as they come up

• Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and becoming a trusted point of contact for their accounting needs

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field and 5+ years of relevant accounting experience , including significant experience in full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , with significant experience in a client-facing accounting, public accounting, audit or advisory environment.

Big Four experience is required for this role. We're looking for someone who has been exposed to high standards of quality, complex accounting work and demanding client environments, and who is ready to take that experience into a more hands-on, ownership-driven role.

You're confident owning full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , while also reviewing work, managing priorities and ensuring that client deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.

You're comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals . You communicate clearly in English and can explain what the numbers mean — not just what the numbers are. This role is 100% in English , both internally and with clients.

You have experience reviewing or mentoring other accountants and are comfortable providing guidance, giving feedback and taking responsibility for the quality of the work delivered by your team.

You're able to work with at least partial overlap with Eastern Time business hours. Availability from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time is a plus.

Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Taxprep or CaseWare is a plus, as is experience working with SaaS, technology, fintech or Web3 companies .

A CPA designation or active CPA pursuit is also a plus.

Benefits

Why Convoy?

You'll work with interesting companies, smart people and problems that don't always come with an instruction manual.

You'll have direct exposure to founders and senior finance leaders and get to see how growing companies actually operate. Because we're small, your work is visible and your ideas can have an impact.

We're remote-friendly, with team members working from Toronto and different parts of the world.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want a role where you can keep learning, take real ownership and grow beyond traditional accounting , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

We offer USD 24,000-48,000 per year , depending on experience and qualifications.

postings.title: EY Parthenon - Strategy - Manager - EY Global Delivery Service
postings.descriptionText:
The opportunity

EY-Parthenon is establishing a Strategy Realized Global Delivery Team in Argentina to provide near-shore support to the US teams. The Argentina based team(s) are expected to be involved on client engagements across the Strategy Realized service line, including but not limited to strategic assessments, growth strategy, new market or product entry, venture building, go-to-market, commercial diligence and operational transformation.

This role is designed for a strong people manager and problem solver who can lead ‘case cracking’ with the global team, while also managing project timelines, work products and workload. The successful candidate will combine consulting discipline, analytical rigor, strong business judgment, an AI-first mindset with excellent people and project management skills to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, client-service environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Project leadership: Serve as the day-to-day project lead and primary point of contact for assigned workstreams or engagements, coordinating across Argentina, US and broader global delivery teams

• Work planning and coordination: Translate engagement objectives into clear workplans, milestones, team responsibilities and review cadences; manage timelines, dependencies, stakeholder inputs and issue escalation

• Structured problem solving: Lead and/or support junior team members with framing ambiguous strategic questions, developing issue trees, formulating hypotheses and aligning the team on the analytical path required to answer the client question

• Analytics leadership: Guide quantitative and qualitative analyses, including selection of data sources, methodology design, model logic, quality checks, interpretation of results and articulation of limitations

• Recommendations design: Drive the team from findings to implications, pressure test options, identify risks and trade-offs, and shape practical recommendations for clients

• Deliverable development: Own the quality of client-ready deliverables, including Excel models, PowerPoint slides, dashboards, executive summaries and other outputs in accordance with EYP guidelines

• Quality reviews: Review work product for analytical logic, accuracy, synthesis, storyline, slide polish and source support before sharing with US teams or senior leadership

• Team coaching: Coach Senior Associates, Consultants and junior team members by setting clear expectations, reviewing work, building problem-solving skills and providing actionable feedback

• Collaboration and communication: Collaborate proactively and frequently with local and global teams, communicate risks early, and ensure the team remains aligned on priorities and next steps

• Practice development: Contribute to team-building efforts, reusable assets, playbooks, AI-enabled delivery approaches and knowledge management as the near-shore team scales

Qualifications And Experience

• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred

• Approximately 5 to 8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, corporate development, business development, transformation or an adjacent strategic project environment

• Demonstrated experience leading workstreams or small project teams from problem structuring and analysis through final deliverable creation

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with ability to review executive-level analyses and develop client-ready presentations

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including ability to synthesize complex topics into structured narratives for senior stakeholders

• Demonstrated aptitude for both quantitative and qualitative analysis, including comfort working with imperfect and/or large data sets and multiple information sources

• Experience managing junior team members, including assigning work, reviewing outputs and providing feedback

• Ability to work effectively across time zones in a near-shore delivery model and collaborate with geographically distributed teams

Preferred Experience

• Experience performing market landscape assessments, customer and competitor research, market sizing, revenue growth analysis, synergy assessment, operational transformation, value creation planning, diligence or transformation roadmap development

• Experience identifying risks and opportunities across markets, customers, competitors, financial performance, operations and organizational capabilities

• Familiarity with data tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, R or advanced Excel

• Demonstrated aptitude to learn, use and keep pace with AI tools and solutions coming to market, and to drive adoption in ways that enhance work product quality and delivery speed

Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a SAP Project Manager para liderar proyectos y equipos internacionales, con un fuerte enfoque en la gestión de personas, liderazgo de proyectos y relación con el cliente .

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia en liderazgo de equipos, gestión de proyectos y coordinación de equipos internacionales , capaz de desenvolverse con autonomía en entornos complejos y de mantener una visión global del proyecto. Contar con conocimientos del entorno SAP y del área de Finanzas será también importante para comprender las necesidades del negocio y facilitar la interlocución con los diferentes equipos y stakeholders.

🚀 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

• Liderar y gestionar equipos internacionales ubicados en diferentes países y husos horarios.

• Coordinar y supervisar el trabajo de los diferentes equipos, asegurando una correcta organización y cumplimiento de objetivos.

• Liderar proyectos relacionados con el entorno SAP, garantizando el cumplimiento de plazos, alcance y objetivos establecidos.

• Ser un interlocutor clave con el cliente, manteniendo una comunicación cercana, profesional y orientada a generar relaciones de confianza.

• Gestionar las expectativas del cliente, identificando necesidades y anticipando posibles riesgos.

• Realizar el seguimiento del estado de los proyectos y de los principales indicadores de gestión.

• Coordinar equipos técnicos, funcionales y de negocio, facilitando una comunicación fluida entre todos los participantes.

• Gestionar prioridades, incidencias y posibles escalados, asegurando una respuesta ágil y adecuada.

• Motivar, acompañar y desarrollar a los miembros del equipo, fomentando un entorno de colaboración y crecimiento.

• Asegurar una comunicación efectiva entre equipos distribuidos geográficamente.

• Participar en la planificación y toma de decisiones relacionadas con los proyectos y equipos bajo su responsabilidad.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia demostrable en gestión y liderazgo de equipos , especialmente en entornos internacionales o distribuidos geográficamente.

• Experiencia en liderazgo y gestión de proyectos , preferiblemente en el entorno SAP.

• Conocimientos del entorno SAP y comprensión de procesos de negocio.

• Conocimientos y experiencia en el área de Finanzas .

• Experiencia en la gestión y relación directa con clientes .

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para establecer relaciones de confianza con diferentes interlocutores.

• Capacidad para gestionar equipos ubicados en diferentes países y husos horarios.

• Capacidad de organización, planificación y priorización.

• Orientación a resultados y capacidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos y multiculturales.

• Capacidad de liderazgo, negociación y resolución de conflictos.

• Requisito imprescindible: Residir en Buenos Aires. Será necesario contar con disponibilidad para asistir a las oficinas del cliente cuando el proyecto lo requiera. Las oficinas están ubicadas en la zona centro de Buenos Aires (a escasos metros de Plaza de Mayo)

⭐ ¿Qué valoramos especialmente?
Buscamos una persona con un marcado perfil de liderazgo y gestión , capaz de coordinar equipos internacionales, generar confianza en el cliente y garantizar que los proyectos avancen de forma ordenada y eficiente.
Será especialmente valorada la capacidad para:

• Liderar, motivar y desarrollar equipos.

• Gestionar diferentes interlocutores y situaciones de forma eficaz.

• Mantener una relación sólida y profesional con el cliente.

• Anticiparse a problemas y gestionar conflictos o situaciones de escalado.

• Tomar decisiones y asumir responsabilidades.

• Adaptarse a diferentes culturas, equipos y husos horarios.

postings.title: Accounting Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Client Accounting & Advisory Services

Location: Argentina

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Convoy Finance

We like working with people who move fast, think for themselves, and care about doing great work. That's pretty much how we run Convoy.

We're a small finance and accounting firm working with technology, SaaS, fintech and Web3 companies across Canada and internationally. Our clients are ambitious businesses, and we work directly with the founders and finance teams building them.

That means we're not just looking at numbers all day. We get to see what's happening inside growing companies and help the people running them make better decisions. One week you might be leading a month-end close, and the next you could be helping a client work through a reporting issue, improve their financial processes or solve something completely new.

We're a small team, too. Most of us are based in Toronto, with a few people working remotely around the world. There's very little bureaucracy, decisions happen quickly, and good ideas can actually turn into action.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Accounting Manager who can take ownership, think beyond the books and be a trusted partner to our clients.

You'll oversee accounting work across a portfolio of growing companies and work directly with international clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals .

You'll be responsible for making sure the accounting is accurate, the work gets done well and client deliverables stay on track. But we also expect you to look beyond the numbers: understand what's happening in the business, identify issues before they become problems and bring ideas to the table.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll still be close to the accounting, while also reviewing work, guiding team members, managing priorities and helping clients navigate more complex accounting and finance questions.

Our clients move quickly, and so do we. There will be deadlines, competing priorities and new problems to solve.

As an Accounting Manager, you'll have significant ownership over your client relationships and the opportunity to grow into broader advisory, financial management and leadership responsibilities .

What You'll Do

You'll take ownership of:

• Managing a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of accounting and reporting work

• Leading and overseeing full-cycle accounting and month-end close, including reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR and financial statement preparation

• Reviewing accounting work and ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency across client deliverables

• Preparing and reviewing financial statements, management reports and financial analysis

• Working directly with founders, CFOs and senior finance teams to answer questions, resolve issues and provide accounting guidance

• Managing client deadlines, priorities and deliverables, and proactively communicating when something needs attention

• Supporting year-end compilations, audits, reviews and tax-related work

• Identifying opportunities to improve accounting processes, systems and controls

• Coaching and supporting more junior members of the accounting team

• Taking ownership of more complex accounting issues and helping the team determine the right approach

• Supporting advisory and finance projects as they come up

• Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and becoming a trusted point of contact for their accounting needs

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field and 5+ years of relevant accounting experience , including significant experience in full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , with significant experience in a client-facing accounting, public accounting, audit or advisory environment.

Big Four experience is required for this role. We're looking for someone who has been exposed to high standards of quality, complex accounting work and demanding client environments, and who is ready to take that experience into a more hands-on, ownership-driven role.

You're confident owning full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , while also reviewing work, managing priorities and ensuring that client deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.

You're comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals . You communicate clearly in English and can explain what the numbers mean — not just what the numbers are. This role is 100% in English , both internally and with clients.

You have experience reviewing or mentoring other accountants and are comfortable providing guidance, giving feedback and taking responsibility for the quality of the work delivered by your team.

You're able to work with at least partial overlap with Eastern Time business hours. Availability from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time is a plus.

Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Taxprep or CaseWare is a plus, as is experience working with SaaS, technology, fintech or Web3 companies .

A CPA designation or active CPA pursuit is also a plus.

Benefits

Why Convoy?

You'll work with interesting companies, smart people and problems that don't always come with an instruction manual.

You'll have direct exposure to founders and senior finance leaders and get to see how growing companies actually operate. Because we're small, your work is visible and your ideas can have an impact.

We're remote-friendly, with team members working from Toronto and different parts of the world.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want a role where you can keep learning, take real ownership and grow beyond traditional accounting , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

We offer USD 24,000-48,000 per year , depending on experience and qualifications.

Our team supports the fastest-growing and most exciting startups in the U.S. and around the world. We manage our clients’ financial operations, allowing them to focus on growing their product and business.

This Senior Accountant role supports our Accounting Manager and Controller-level team with day-to-day accounting needs. This position involves supporting the accounting department, managing 15 mid- to large-sized clients, handling client engagements with C-level executives, providing technical support, reviewing monthly closes, and closing the books for a portion of our client base.
This is a fast-paced and dynamic position that involves a high level of cross-functional interaction with our entire team. You would work closely with our accounting, payroll, accounts receivable, and accounts payable team members.

Primary responsibilities include:

• Define and implement rigorous accounting processes and controls

• Perform all general ledger functions: revenue recognition, accounting for prepaid expenses, short and long-term investments, accrued liabilities, inventory tracking, depreciation and amortization, equity, and interest income and expense

• Review of monthly client closes

• Manage all accounting functions, including A/R, A/P, cash flow management and financial reporting

• Develop revenue recognition and other accounting policies, processes, and internal controls, consistent with GAAP

• Ensure accurate and timely development of financial statements, offer insights on technical accounting areas, including footnotes, disclosures, and audit responses as needed

• Identify inefficiencies and cost-saving opportunities

• Ensure accurate and timely tax filings and payments to Federal, State, and Local tax agencies

Qualifications:

• Current CPA designation or equivalent experience

• Four plus years of experience

• In-depth knowledge of GAAP, including preparation of audited GAAP financial statements (IFRS is also a plus)

• Good written and verbal communication skills are a must, with an emphasis on clear and sensitive responses to client inquiries and escalations

• Entrepreneurial spirit with a resourceful nature, team-first attitude, and problem-solving nature

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects while simultaneously meeting company goals and deadlines

• In-depth knowledge and direct experience working with accounting systems (any one or more of: QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, optionally Sage Intacct)

• In-depth knowledge and direct experience working with payroll processing systems is a plus (any one or more of: Gusto, ADP, Paychex, Rippling, QBO, Intuit)

• Intermediate/advanced in Google Docs, Google Spreadsheets, and Microsoft Excel

• Strong desire to tackle new challenges and projects with enthusiasm

Why work at Finvisor?

En Cencosud Argentina, buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Jefe/a de Facturación , quien tendrá la misión de liderar el proceso integral de facturación dentro de nuestro Centro de Servicios Compartidos, con alcance regional.

Si te motiva liderar equipos, resolver con rigor analítico y llevar adelante procesos de mejora continua y automatización en un entorno multirregional, este desafío es para vos.

🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Liderar el equipo de facturación asegurando la ejecución, el control y la mejora de los procesos, garantizando la emisión correcta, oportuna y completa de la facturación, el cumplimiento de condiciones comerciales y normativas fiscales, y contribuyendo a la cobranza efectiva y al cierre financiero de la compañía.

🔍 ¿Qué harás?

• Liderar el proceso integral de facturación.

• Supervisar la correcta emisión de documentos fiscales y electrónicos.

• Analizar y resolver errores de facturación, rechazos e inconsistencias de datos maestros.

• Coordinar con Comercial, Contratos, Operaciones, Impuestos, Contabilidad, Cobranzas y Sistemas la resolución de casos complejos.

• Controlar calendarios de cierre, cortes de facturación, re-procesos, anulaciones y pendientes críticos.

• Ejecutar y supervisar conciliaciones entre contratos, órdenes de servicio, facturación emitida y registros contables.

• Monitorear KPIs del proceso: volumen facturado, SLA, backlog, errores, rechazos y productividad.

• Diseñar e implementar controles internos y acciones de mejora continua.

• Liderar iniciativas de automatización y digitalización del proceso de facturación.

👀 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Comercio Internacional, Comercio Exterior, Ingeniería Industrial, Contador Público o carreras afines.

• 2 a 4 años liderando equipos de facturación en un Centro de Servicios Compartidos (CSC) o entorno multirregional.

• Experiencia comprobable en mejora de procesos y automatización.

• Dominio de SAP, Oracle o sistemas ERP similares.

• Excel avanzado y herramientas de análisis de datos (Power BI, Tableau).

• Inglés bilingüe; Portugués avanzado.
