postings.title: Contador/a – Río Grande, Tierra del Fuego
postings.descriptionText:
📢 Búsqueda laboral | Contador/a Auditor/a – Río Grande, Tierra del Fuego

Río Grande, Tierra del Fuego | Modalidad freelance / profesional independiente

Buscamos incorporar un/a Contador/a Público/a con experiencia en contabilidad, auditoría, regularización tributaria y trámites societarios , para asistir en la regularización integral de una S.R.L. y su situación ante los organismos correspondientes.
La posición requiere un perfil autónomo, resolutivo y con experiencia práctica en trámites ante ARCA y organismos societarios.

🔹 Principales responsabilidades Contabilidad, auditoría y ARCA

• Preparar balances contables y realizar su correspondiente certificación profesional para presentación ante ARCA.

• Preparar y presentar declaraciones juradas de impuestos correspondientes a períodos retroactivos no prescriptos .

• Analizar la situación fiscal de la sociedad y realizar las presentaciones, rectificaciones y trámites pendientes ante ARCA .

• Preparar la documentación contable necesaria para la regularización fiscal y operativa de la sociedad .

• Elaborar informes de auditoría , certificaciones y demás documentación profesional requerida.

• Realizar las certificaciones correspondientes ante el Consejo Profesional de Ciencias Económicas de Tierra del Fuego para su posterior presentación ante ARCA.

Importante: al tratarse de una S.R.L. , la documentación contable será certificada profesionalmente ante el Consejo de Tierra del Fuego para su presentación ante ARCA, sin presentación de balances ante IGJ , según corresponda al tipo societario.
🔹 Regularización de deudas y medidas cautelares
• Preparar y gestionar presentaciones relacionadas con el levantamiento de embargos .

• Analizar, documentar y gestionar prescripciones de deudas tributarias .

• Trabajar conjuntamente con el abogado de la empresa en la estrategia y documentación necesaria para cada caso.

• Realizar seguimiento de los trámites y requerimientos hasta su resolución.

•

🔹 Trámites societarios – IGJ Río Grande Gestionar, preparar y presentar la documentación necesaria para:

• Cambio de denominación social.

• Cambio de domicilio social.

• Modificación de socios.

• Designación de nuevo gerente.

• Seguimiento de las observaciones y requerimientos que eventualmente formule el organismo.

•

🔹 Trámites ante ARCA Realizar las gestiones necesarias para actualizar la situación registral de la sociedad ante ARCA, incluyendo:

• Cambio de denominación/nombre .

• Cambio de domicilio fiscal .

• Actualización de socios .

• Registración/habilitación del nuevo gerente .

• Tramitación de CDI para socio extranjero .

• Actualización de los registros y datos societarios correspondientes.

•

🔹 Requisitos excluyentes
• Título de Contador/a Público/a.

• Matrícula profesional vigente en Tierra del Fuego.

• Estar habilitado/a ante el Consejo Profesional de Ciencias Económicas de Tierra del Fuego .

• Experiencia comprobable en ARCA y trámites tributarios.

• Experiencia en balances, auditorías y certificaciones profesionales .

• Conocimiento práctico de trámites societarios y registrales.

• Capacidad para trabajar coordinadamente con profesionales del área legal.

📌 Al momento de la contratación se solicitará copia del título profesional y constancia de matrícula vigente.

⭐ Será especialmente valorado
• Contar además con matrícula profesional vigente en Ciudad de Buenos Aires (Capital Federal)

• Experiencia previa en regularización integral de sociedades .

• Experiencia con sociedades que presentan deudas tributarias, embargos, incumplimientos de presentaciones o situaciones registrales pendientes .

• Experiencia en trámites relacionados con socios extranjeros y CDI .

• Conocimiento de procedimientos ante IGJ y ARCA.

• Experiencia trabajando conjuntamente con abogados en prescripciones y estrategias de regularización de deuda fiscal .

🧑‍💼 Perfil que buscamos Más que un profesional dedicado exclusivamente a la liquidación impositiva, buscamos una persona capaz de tomar el caso, relevar la situación actual de la sociedad, identificar las obligaciones y trámites pendientes, preparar la documentación necesaria y llevar adelante la regularización hasta su conclusión , coordinando las cuestiones contables con el abogado responsable de los aspectos jurídicos.

📍 Ubicación Río Grande, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina
Modalidad: prestación de servicios profesionales / freelance.
📩 Postulación
Enviar CV indicando:

• Experiencia en ARCA .

• Experiencia en balances y certificaciones .

• Experiencia en trámites societarios .

• Experiencia en embargos y prescripción de deudas .

• Matrícula profesional vigente.

• Consejos profesionales donde se encuentra matriculado/a.

• Disponibilidad para realizar gestiones presenciales en Río Grande cuando resulte necesario.

postings.title: Senior Technology Business Manager
postings.descriptionText:
The Sr. Technology Business Manager will support the Technology Business Management function by leading IDS governance activities and overseeing end-to-end labor reporting. This role will partner closely with Technology, Finance, Accounting, Audit, Product, and HHS stakeholders to ensure labor allocations, capitalization activities, compliance controls, and reporting deliverables are accurate, timely, well-controlled, and audit-ready.
This position is responsible for managing the full labor reporting lifecycle, including intake, validation, allocation tracking, monthly and quarterly reporting, issue resolution, leadership insights, and continuous process improvement across Jira, Airtable, Allstacks, Apptio, and related data sources.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

• Organization and Planning: Demonstrated ability to manage recurring data collection cycles, tailor reporting to stakeholder needs, and translate data-driven analysis into actionable business insights

• Process Management: Proven ability to design, document, and execute repeatable processes that improve consistency, accountability, and operational effectiveness

• Labor Reporting: Strong ownership of end-to-end labor reporting processes, including data intake, validation, allocation accuracy, variance review, stakeholder follow-up, and recurring leadership reporting

• Governance and Controls: Ability to establish and maintain effective controls for IDS, labor allocation, capitalization, and software governance while supporting audit and compliance requirements

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to cross-functional and leadership audiences

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead IDS (Internally Developed Software) SOX business process controls for RTE certification, ensuring compliance with SOX, GAAP, and ASC standards while coordinating audit deliverables and mitigating control risks across Finance, Accounting, Audit, Technology, Product, and HHS teams

• Validate monthly and quarterly IDS and labor allocations to ensure submissions are complete, accurate, aligned to established guidelines, and delivered timely to Finance and Accounting stakeholders

• Own the end-to-end labor reporting process, including resource intake, cost center coding, allocation validation, capitalization support, variance analysis, stakeholder follow-up, reporting distribution, and process documentation

• Manage Airtable operations, including automation development, user permissions, field and base updates, vendor coordination, and contract and usage oversight

• Develop and automate reports and dashboards in Power BI to track delivery metrics, identify trends, and recommend data-driven actions

• Monitor and report on labor trends, allocation risks, reporting gaps, and process health, providing actionable insights to Technology and Finance leaders

• Manage budget tracking and resource alignment against approved spend, while providing regular and transparent financial reporting to stakeholders

• Lead requirements gathering and process alignment activities to ensure operational practices remain consistent with current business strategies and governance expectations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT, Finance, Technology Business Management, or related business operations roles

• Excellent organizational, planning, and prioritization skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience partnering with Finance teams on labor allocation, reporting, reconciliation, or capitalization processes; advanced Excel and Airtable experience preferred

• Experience developing leadership reporting materials and presenting insights through PowerPoint and Power BI

• Strong English written and verbal communication skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience creating management reporting decks for operational, financial, or technology leadership audiences

• Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI

• Experience with Jira or similar work management platforms

postings.title: Cash Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Launch Your Next Successful Chapter with Veta Virtual! 🚀

💸 Competitive Pay in USD | 🌍 100% Remote | 💵 Cash and Reconciliation Ownership

Veta Virtual is hiring a Cash Operations Specialist for one of our high growth clients in the fintech and cryptocurrency industry. This is not a routine data entry role. This is a detail driven finance position for someone who can own daily cash positions, bank reconciliations, and liquidity with precision, and who is comfortable working closely with accounting, treasury, and payroll teams to keep every number accurate and every deadline met.

🔑 Your Role

As a Cash Operations Specialist , you will be responsible for managing, reconciling, and optimizing daily cash positions, bank transactions, and liquidity for a fintech and cryptocurrency platform operating thousands of kiosks across multiple international markets. You will work closely with Accounting, Treasury, and Accounts Payable teams to ensure financial completeness, accuracy, and timely month-end close delivery. Your day-to-day will involve:

• Allocating and recording cash payments accurately across accounts, ensuring every transaction is captured completely and in line with internal accounting standards and procedures.

• Owning the accounting completeness and reconciliation of transactions and related accounts.

• Creating and parking general ledger journals tied to bank statement transactions.

• Managing relationships and accounting transactions related to the company's banking activity.

• Handling any other financial accounting and cash operations work needed to deliver month end close on schedule.

• Preparing monthly bank reconciliations with appropriate supporting documentation.

• Owning balance sheet general ledger accounts and their monthly reconciliation.

• Resolving historic queries related to cash.

• Reporting on performance and process KPIs for the department.

• Managing audit and tax queries, providing clear accounting explanations and documentation when required.

✅ What You'll Need

• 1 to 3 years of experience in treasury operations, accounting, or banking.

• Hands on experience with bank reconciliations.

• Solid knowledge of accounting principles and business concepts.

• A working appreciation of core financial accounting standards, policies, processes, and systems.

• Strong numeracy and analytical skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.

• Strong work ethic and the ability to work independently in a fast paced environment.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholder demands while meeting deadlines.

• Comfort and proficiency using AI tools to support reconciliation, reporting, and daily productivity is a strong plus.

• Bonus: basic knowledge of cryptocurrency and blockchain.

• To be considered for this role, you must currently be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

💼 What We Offer

• 💸 Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently every month, no matter where you are.

• 🌴 15 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.

• 💻 100% remote, work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.

• 📈 A fast paced, high growth environment at the forefront of the global fintech and cryptocurrency industry, where your accuracy and ownership keep the business running smoothly.

• 🤝 A collaborative, high trust culture through Veta Virtual and our client, where your precision and reliability are valued from day one.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to own cash operations with precision and be the reliable link between finance teams, apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual.

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short two minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first chance to show us your communication style and what makes you the right fit. We can't wait to meet you!

postings.descriptionText:
HLB Argentina ofrece una nueva oportunidad como Auditor Interno Corporativo .

Propósito del Rol

- Brindar aseguramiento independiente y objetivo sobre la efectividad de los procesos de control interno, gestión de riesgos y gobierno corporativo, contribuyendo a la mejora continua y al cumplimiento de normativas internas y externas.

Responsabilidades Principales
- Ejecutar auditorías internas (operativas, financieras, regulatorias y de sistemas) de acuerdo con el plan anual de auditoría.
- Evaluar la efectividad del sistema de control interno y la gestión de riesgos en las distintas áreas de la compañía.
- Identificar desvíos, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora, proponiendo recomendaciones accionables.
- Documentar hallazgos y elaborar informes claros y ejecutivos para la alta dirección.
- Realizar seguimiento de planes de acción comprometidos por las áreas auditadas.
- Colaborar en la elaboración del plan anual de auditoría basado en riesgos.
- Participar en auditorías especiales o investigaciones internas cuando sea requerido.
- Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, normativas locales e internacionales y mejores prácticas (por ejemplo, COSO, IIA).
- Coordinar con auditores externos y entes reguladores cuando corresponda.
- Promover la cultura de control interno y ética dentro de la organización.

Requisitos
- Graduado/a en Contador Público, Administración de Empresas, Economía o carreras afines.
- Se valorarán certificaciones como CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, o similares.
- 2 a 5 años de experiencia en auditoría interna, externa o consultoría.
Experiencia en empresas de telecomunicaciones o industrias reguladas (deseable).

Conocimientos Técnicos:

- Normas de auditoría interna (IIA).
- Marcos de control interno (COSO).
- Análisis de riesgos y controles.
- Manejo avanzado de Excel y herramientas de análisis de datos.
- Conocimiento de SAP u otros ERP (deseable).
- Inglés intermedio/avanzado (deseable).

Competencias Clave
* Pensamiento analítico y orientación al detalle.
* Capacidad de comunicación efectiva (oral y escrita).
* Autonomía y proactividad.
* Ética e integridad profesional.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y relacionamiento con múltiples áreas.
* Gestión del tiempo y cumplimiento de plazos.
* Indicadores de Desempeño (KPIs)
* Cumplimiento del plan anual de auditoría.
* Calidad y relevancia de los hallazgos identificados.
* Nivel de implementación de recomendaciones.
* Tiempo de cierre de auditorías y seguimiento de acciones.
* Satisfacción de stakeholders internos.

Sobre las Condiciones de Contratación

• Posición híbrida siendo 3 dias presencial en zona Parque Patricios y/o Palermo.

• Contratación temporal hasta diciembre inclusive con posibilidad de extenderse.

• Modalidad de contratación: Locación de Servicios.

postings.title: Tax Manager
postings.descriptionText:
We are hiring a full-time Tax Manager for a CPA-led outsourced finance firm that provides bookkeeping, tax, and advisory services to restoration and trades businesses. This is a hands-on role with a clear path into department leadership. Initially, you’ll prepare and review returns yourself while building the standards, processes, and capacity model for the tax department. As the firm grows, you’ll hire and develop preparers underneath you and transition toward owning the tax function.
The ideal candidate is already reviewing other people’s U.S. tax returns and is ready to take the next step into leadership. You do not need previous people-management experience, but you should have strong technical tax experience and genuinely want to build and lead a department. The CEO is a CPA and currently oversees this function, so you’ll have hands-on support during the transition and continued guidance on particularly complex technical issues.
Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.

Hours: 9 am to 5 pm - CST
Salary: $2,800/mo

Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare and review U.S. tax returns across partnerships, S-corps, C-corps, and individual 1040s

• Own the tax filing calendar across all clients and entity types

• Build and maintain clear review standards and workpaper processes for the tax department

• Manage year-round tax work, including quarterly estimates, tax planning, S-corp reasonable compensation, and year-end tax positions

• Own TaxDome as the tax system of record and ensure tax workflows are followed correctly

• Review returns prepared by others, identify errors or missing information, and provide clear feedback

• Work directly with clients on tax questions, planning opportunities, and technical recommendations

• Partner with the bookkeeping team to improve the bookkeeping-to-tax handoff and resolve issues before they impact tax preparation

• Build the department’s capacity plan ahead of tax season and identify staffing needs before they become bottlenecks

• Hire and develop tax preparers as the department grows

• Train and provide technical guidance to junior preparers

• Monitor workload and raise capacity or technical issues early

• Help build a year-round tax offering that goes beyond filing returns and provides ongoing value to clients

Key Qualifications:

• 4–7 years of experience working in U.S. tax

• At least 1 year of meaningful tax return review experience

• Strong experience reviewing other preparers’ work, identifying errors, and sending returns back with clear technical feedback

• Strong knowledge of U.S. small business taxation, including partnerships, S-corps, C-corps, and individual returns

• Strong understanding of basis, distributions, reasonable compensation, and multi-state tax considerations

• Active U.S. PTIN or willingness to obtain one upon accepting the role

• Comfortable preparing returns directly while the department is being built

• Able to explain complex tax issues clearly to clients, including situations where the recommendation may not be what the client wants to hear

• Self-directed and comfortable taking ownership in a fully remote environment

• Proactive about identifying technical, process, and capacity issues before they become larger problems

• Interested in building a tax department rather than simply inheriting and maintaining an existing system

• Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet

• Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING

Nice to Have:

• U.S. Enrolled Agent or CPA designation

• Experience training or mentoring junior tax preparers

• Experience working with construction, restoration, trades, or job-costing businesses

• Multi-state tax filing experience

• Experience with ProConnect, TaxDome, Intuit Tax Advisor, or QuickBooks Online

• Familiarity with AI-assisted tax tools such as TaxGPT

postings.title: Jefe/a de Créditos y Cobranzas
postings.descriptionText:
En Sinteplast buscamos un Jefe de Créditos y Cobranzas para liderar la estrategia integral de administración del crédito y gestión de cobranzas de nuestra cartera de clientes, con base en nuestras oficinas administrativas de Planta Ezeiza (C. Spegazzini).

Su principal desafío será l iderar la gestión integral de Créditos y Cobranzas , asegurando una adecuada administración del riesgo crediticio, la optimización de los plazos de cobro y la generación de flujo de fondos, contribuyendo al crecimiento sustentable del negocio.

Buscamos profesionales con visión de negocio y fuerte orientación a resultados, capaces de c onstruir relaciones cercanas con clientes y equipos comerciales. Tendrá un rol clave en la gestión de cuentas corrientes, la mitigación de riesgos crediticios, la reducción de días de cobranza, la liberación estratégica de pedidos y el soporte permanente a la fuerza de ventas para acompañar las oportunidades comerciales de nuestros segmentos de Pinturerías, Corralones, Distribuidores y Empresas.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se encuentran

• Reportar a la Gerencia de Finanzas.

• Asegurar el análisis y control de las cobranzas ingresadas y las cuentas corrientes de los clientes de la compañía.

• Elaborar informes de gestión.

• Gestionar las cuentas corrientes, el análisis de riesgo crediticio y la liberación de pedidos.

• Minimizar contingencias crediticias y optimizar el ingreso de cobranzas por las ventas efectuadas.

• Gestionar, coordinar y realizar visitas a clientes.

• Supervisar, controlar y dar soporte al personal a cargo.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de DSO definidos por la compañía.

Requisitos

• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes para visita a clientes.

• Orientamos la búsqueda a profesionales graduados en las carreras Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Contador Público o carreras afines y que cuenten con sólida experiencia en empresas industriales o productivas con clientes en puntos de venta.

• Buscamos personas con marcado perfil de liderazgo, buena predisposición, capacidad resolutiva y habilidades de negociación y comunicación. Orientación a resultados.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel y Power BI.

• Manejo de MS Project y SAP.

• Manejo de Ingles (nivel intermedio) – Deseable Portugués.

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Créditos y Cobranzas liderando equipos.

Beneficios

Se ofrecen muy buenas condiciones de contratación en relación de dependencia y beneficios propios de una empresa de primera línea como es el Grupo Sinteplast, en un excelente clima laboral.

Somos una Compañía argentina líder en el mercado de nuestro país con 68 años de trayectoria. Fabricamos y comercializamos pinturas decorativas, indistriales, aerosoles, para repintado automotor y también incursionamos en los productos cementicios.

Contamos con Plantas en Carlos Spegazzini (Pcia. de Buenos Aires), San Luis y Córdoba y con más de 7000 artículos que se distribuyen a lo largo de todo el país.

En la región tenemos Plantas productivas en Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay y Brasil. Somos, en total, más de 1500 personas las que trabajamos a diario.

La búsqueda constante de crecimiento, y la innovación son nuestras cartas de presentación

postings.title: Lead Accountant

Location Virtual

The Lead Accountant role will play a vital role within the Consolidations team. Duties and responsibilities will include, but not limited to, preparation and reconciliation of capital movements between entities, assisting with accounting for equity changes and equity pickups and eliminations, tracking intercompany loans, and reconciling intercompany transactions for select entities. The role will also assist with preparation of various journal entries, account reconciliations and analytical duties related to these responsibilities on a monthly and quarterly basis, as well as assist in process improvement efforts and automation of tasks where applicable.

Core Responsibilities

• Equity:

postings.title: Senior Accountant (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
✨ One Platform, a Whole World Of Opportunity

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're Proof That a High-performing Culture Doesn't Need An Office. Distributed Across 60+ Countries Since 2020, We've Built Something The Industry Keeps Noticing

• Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies

• Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 by Newsweek

• A G2 Spring 2026 Leader across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

• The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within -3 / - 8 UTC.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Accountant to own day-to-day accounting, monthly reporting, and ERP activities for Oyster entities around the world, with a focus on LATAM coverage. You will combine rigorous accounting judgment with proactive stakeholder management, lead close and audit activities, investigate complex discrepancies, and improve the systems and processes that keep a distributed finance function accurate and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage full-cycle accounting and intercompany transactions for global subsidiaries.

• Prepare and review financial statements and balance-sheet reconciliations across multiple entities.

• Lead month-end and year-end close activities, maintaining clear checklists and documentation.

• Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual local statutory filings and provide complete support packages.

• Oversee local statutory audits and resolve auditor questions and adjustments.

• Reconcile local statutory records to the ERP

• Conduct financial analysis, identify trends or discrepancies, and present decision-useful insights.

• Own assigned ERP activities and improve accounting standards, controls, documentation, and automation.

• Proactively coordinate dependencies across Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and external partners.

• Execute ad hoc financial projects and support junior teammates with practical guidance.

Core Requirements

• At least 5 years of accounting experience, including at least 1 year operating at senior-accountant scope.

• CPA (or part-qualified) or an equivalent professional accounting qualification.

• Strong knowledge of multi-entity accounting, intercompany transactions, financial reporting, reconciliations, close, and audit support.

• Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and manipulation of large datasets.

• Meticulous attention to detail and a logical, evidence-based approach to problem solving.

• Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and maintain quality across several entities.

• Strong written and spoken English, with effective stakeholder management in an asynchronous environment.

• Proactive follow-through, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement and automation mindset.

Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience

• NetSuite or a comparable ERP.

• Payroll accounting or SaaS experience.

• High-growth startup or rapidly changing international environment.

• Accounting across EMEA jurisdictions, including local statutory reporting and local-to-group reconciliation.

This might not be right for you if...

• You prefer a narrowly scoped, single-entity role with limited stakeholder contact.

• You are uncomfortable investigating ambiguous discrepancies or making evidence-based accounting recommendations.

• You need close supervision to manage deadlines, follow up with stakeholders, or keep work documented.

• You prefer manual routines and have little interest in improving controls, systems, or automation.

You'll also need

• A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.

How We Work Together At Oyster

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ so other global teams can learn from us.

How YOU Work

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

• Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

• Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

• Mental health support: Access Plumm, our mental well-being service.

• Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

• Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

• WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @ oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline.

postings.title: Accounting Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Client Accounting & Advisory Services

Location: Argentina

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Convoy Finance

We like working with people who move fast, think for themselves, and care about doing great work. That's pretty much how we run Convoy.

We're a small finance and accounting firm working with technology, SaaS, fintech and Web3 companies across Canada and internationally. Our clients are ambitious businesses, and we work directly with the founders and finance teams building them.

That means we're not just looking at numbers all day. We get to see what's happening inside growing companies and help the people running them make better decisions. One week you might be leading a month-end close, and the next you could be helping a client work through a reporting issue, improve their financial processes or solve something completely new.

We're a small team, too. Most of us are based in Toronto, with a few people working remotely around the world. There's very little bureaucracy, decisions happen quickly, and good ideas can actually turn into action.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Accounting Manager who can take ownership, think beyond the books and be a trusted partner to our clients.

You'll oversee accounting work across a portfolio of growing companies and work directly with international clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals .

You'll be responsible for making sure the accounting is accurate, the work gets done well and client deliverables stay on track. But we also expect you to look beyond the numbers: understand what's happening in the business, identify issues before they become problems and bring ideas to the table.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll still be close to the accounting, while also reviewing work, guiding team members, managing priorities and helping clients navigate more complex accounting and finance questions.

Our clients move quickly, and so do we. There will be deadlines, competing priorities and new problems to solve.

As an Accounting Manager, you'll have significant ownership over your client relationships and the opportunity to grow into broader advisory, financial management and leadership responsibilities .

What You'll Do

You'll take ownership of:

• Managing a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of accounting and reporting work

• Leading and overseeing full-cycle accounting and month-end close, including reconciliations, journal entries, AP/AR and financial statement preparation

• Reviewing accounting work and ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency across client deliverables

• Preparing and reviewing financial statements, management reports and financial analysis

• Working directly with founders, CFOs and senior finance teams to answer questions, resolve issues and provide accounting guidance

• Managing client deadlines, priorities and deliverables, and proactively communicating when something needs attention

• Supporting year-end compilations, audits, reviews and tax-related work

• Identifying opportunities to improve accounting processes, systems and controls

• Coaching and supporting more junior members of the accounting team

• Taking ownership of more complex accounting issues and helping the team determine the right approach

• Supporting advisory and finance projects as they come up

• Building strong, long-term relationships with clients and becoming a trusted point of contact for their accounting needs

Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field and 5+ years of relevant accounting experience , including significant experience in full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , with significant experience in a client-facing accounting, public accounting, audit or advisory environment.

Big Four experience is required for this role. We're looking for someone who has been exposed to high standards of quality, complex accounting work and demanding client environments, and who is ready to take that experience into a more hands-on, ownership-driven role.

You're confident owning full-cycle accounting, month-end close and financial reporting , while also reviewing work, managing priorities and ensuring that client deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.

You're comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CFOs and senior finance professionals . You communicate clearly in English and can explain what the numbers mean — not just what the numbers are. This role is 100% in English , both internally and with clients.

You have experience reviewing or mentoring other accountants and are comfortable providing guidance, giving feedback and taking responsibility for the quality of the work delivered by your team.

You're able to work with at least partial overlap with Eastern Time business hours. Availability from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time is a plus.

Experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Taxprep or CaseWare is a plus, as is experience working with SaaS, technology, fintech or Web3 companies .

A CPA designation or active CPA pursuit is also a plus.

Benefits

Why Convoy?

You'll work with interesting companies, smart people and problems that don't always come with an instruction manual.

You'll have direct exposure to founders and senior finance leaders and get to see how growing companies actually operate. Because we're small, your work is visible and your ideas can have an impact.

We're remote-friendly, with team members working from Toronto and different parts of the world.

It's fast-paced. It's challenging. And it's definitely not boring.

If you want a role where you can keep learning, take real ownership and grow beyond traditional accounting , we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

We offer USD 24,000-48,000 per year , depending on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

As a Senior Associate in the CIB Regulation W Controllers team (first line of defense) in Argentina, you will help design, execute and continuously improve the control framework that supports compliance with Sections 23A and 23B of the Federal Reserve Act and the JPMorganChase Regulation W Policy. You will partner across products, functions and geographies to identify covered transactions by evaluating product offerings, transaction structures and legal-entity relationships, and you will oversee lifecycle activities spanning monitoring, reporting (including FR Y-8), governance, issue management, and communications to senior management, audit and regulators.

Job Responsibilities

• Regulatory reporting & delivery — You will own FR Y-8 subject matter coverage for insured depository institutions' inter-affiliate activity, including covered-transaction exposures, collateral requirements, and fair value/notional/collateral reporting for inter-affiliate derivatives.

• Schedule integrity & controls — You will drive end-to-end CIB schedule integrity and compliance with reporting requirements, delivering complete and materially accurate submissions.

• Process, validation & remediation — You will develop, maintain and enhance report production, validation and control processes, including issue/incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis, and timely remediation.

• Control environment & gap management — You will identify control gaps, strengthen the control environment, and address specific regulatory concerns with scalable solutions.

• Policy interpretation & guidance — You will interpret and implement the Regulation W Policy across Business, Finance and Operations, providing clear guidance on in-scope activities.

• Governance, attestations & exceptions — You will facilitate supervisory controls, attestations and exception-management processes, escalating issues to line-of-business and firmwide operating committees as appropriate.

• Stakeholder management — You will partner with senior stakeholders across Front Office, Operations, Legal, Finance, Compliance and Risk, including coordination with the Inter-affiliate Group and the Firmwide Regulation W team on key deliverables and priorities.

• Approvals & senior forums — You will oversee new Regulation W transaction approvals from inquiry through approval and reporting, and you will develop executive-ready materials, metrics and updates for senior-management forums, audit, Compliance and regulatory reviews.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills.

• Experience in controls, business management, finance, risk, operations, or a similar business-facing role.

postings.title: Analista de Gobierno Corporativo
postings.descriptionText:
Estamos buscando un Analista de Gobierno Corporativo para incorporarse a nuestro equipo.

Como Analista de Gobierno Corporativo, te encargarás de realizar actividades de auditoría interna, evaluando procesos, controles y riesgos para mejorar la efectividad operativa y garantizar la integridad de la información financiera y operativa de la empresa . Además, serás responsable de analizar y evaluar políticas, procedimientos y prácticas relacionadas con el sistema de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento para fortalecer el control interno, garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos y contribuir a la eficiencia de las operaciones.

Algunas de tus responsabilidades serán

• Evaluar el diseño de los procesos de la compañía mediante entrevistas con responsables, relevamiento de información, identificación de controles clave y análisis de brechas y oportunidades de mejora, para contribuir al fortalecimiento del sistema de control interno y la eficiencia operativa.

• Evaluar la eficacia de los procesos y controles internos mediante la revisión de documentación, el análisis de universos de información y la identificación de excepciones, para verificar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de control establecidos por la compañía.

• Realizar el seguimiento de hallazgos y contramedidas derivadas de auditorías mediante la planificación de reuniones, la recopilación de evidencia y la elaboración de reportes de avance, para contribuir a la implementación efectiva de acciones correctivas y de mejora.

• Realizar revisiones especiales a solicitud de la administración mediante el relevamiento de funciones, actividades y controles de las áreas asignadas, para evaluar la efectividad de los procesos y apoyar la toma de decisiones.

• Velar por el cumplimiento del Código de Ética, políticas corporativas, normas y procedimientos internos mediante actividades de comunicación, asesoramiento y seguimiento, para fortalecer la cultura de integridad, transparencia y cumplimiento dentro de la organización.

• Brindar orientación y capacitación sobre gestión de riesgos, control interno, ética, transparencia, cumplimiento y Gobierno Corporativo, utilizando matrices de entrenamiento y documentación corporativa, para promover el conocimiento y la aplicación de los lineamientos definidos por la compañía.

• Administrar y mantener actualizadas las políticas, normas y procedimientos corporativos, asegurando su adecuada comunicación y disponibilidad para los asociados, para contribuir a la correcta aplicación de los estándares internos de gobierno y cumplimiento.

• Analizar y dar seguimiento a los controles de acceso en SAP, segregación de funciones y herramientas de monitoreo de fuga de información, Auditorías en procesos de ITGC, para contribuir al fortalecimiento de los controles internos y la mitigación de riesgos operativos.

• Recopilar información, mantener registros y elaborar reportes relacionados con auditorías, controles internos, cumplimiento y seguimiento de acciones correctivas, para proporcionar información confiable para la toma de decisiones y el monitoreo de riesgos.

• Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua relacionadas con procesos, controles y gobierno corporativo, identificando oportunidades de optimización y fortalecimiento del sistema de control interno de la compañía.

Si buscas un desafío en un entorno dinámico, donde la excelencia y la innovación son parte fundamental de nuestra cultura, ¡No dudes en aplicar para esta posición de Analista de Gobierno Corporativo en Honda Motor de Argentina!

postings.title: Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
SoFi Tech Solutions (formerly Galileo Financial Technologies), offers a best-in-class financial technology platform that supports issuing payment cards, mobile push provisioning, and differentiated financial products across industries and geographies.

Who We Are

Employees say we are welcoming, collaborative and offer an opportunity to make an impact. SoFi Tech Solutions enables fintechs, financial institutions, and emerging and established brands to build differentiated financial solutions that deliver exceptional, customer-centric experiences. Through modern, open APIs, SoFi Tech Solutions’ flexible, secure, scalable and fully integrated platform drives innovation across payments and financial services. Trusted by digital banking heavyweights, early-stage innovators and enterprise clients alike, SoFi Tech Solutions supports issuing physical and virtual payment cards, mobile push provisioning, tailored and differentiated financial products and more, across industries and geographies.

Learn more about us and why we work here at https://tech.sofi.com/careers/

About The Role

This role is responsible for leading key financial close activities, ensuring accurate and compliant accounting processes under US GAAP and Argentina GAAP. The position partners cross-functionally to manage complex accounting matters, support audits and SEC/SOX compliance, and drive process improvements through automation. Success in this role requires strong technical accounting expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to independently own critical accounting processes.

What You’ll Do

• Contribute to the company's financial integrity by participating in month-end, quarter-end, and annual close processes to support accurate financial reporting.

• Prepare standard and recurring journal entries, perform routine account analyses, and complete monthly reconciliations of general ledger accounts under US GAAP and Argentina GAAP.

• Collaborate with team members accounting staff with day-to-day routines, account reconciliations, and basic operational queries.

• Execute assigned accounting workflows and routine operations, escalating non-standard issues or complex variances when necessary.

• Research, analyze, and apply appropriate accounting treatments to corporate accounting matters, vendor contracts, new transactions, and other relevant areas.

• Support quarterly and annual SEC filings and actively maintain compliance with SOX requirements.

• Assist in external and internal audits by preparing complex schedules, providing necessary documentation, and responding to auditor and SOX compliance requests effectively.

• Identify opportunities for automation and implement process improvements to streamline accounting workflows and enhance overall efficiency.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support business decision-making through accurate data preparation and insightful analysis, fostering teamwork and transparency.

What You’ll Need

• Bachelor’s degree in Public Accounting (graduated or expected to graduate within the next year).

• 2+ years of relevant accounting experience in similar roles.

• Demonstrated ability to manage daily accounting functions and complete close schedules reliably.

• Big 4 accounting experience preferred.

• Advanced English proficiency is required.

• Proficiency in MS Excel and excellent written communication skills.

• Good understanding of US GAAP and Argentine accounting standards, with foundational knowledge of financial close routines.

• Must demonstrate strong attention to detail, analytical abilities, and consistent follow-through, including strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Strong collaboration skills with experience working cross-functionally with teams in finance, operations, legal, and HR.

Nice To Have

• Experience in financial services and/or technology industries.

• Ability to automate and simplify large datasets.

• Experience with ETL tools and other data transformation tools (Alteryx, Tableau, Snowflake, etc.).

• Experience with Accounting ERPs (Specifically Workday Financial).

• Ability to think critically and work independently, while also collaborating effectively within a broader team environment.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• We offer a proven, leading-edge digital banking platform.

• We value our talent.

• We are growing.

• We lead by example.

• We have fun.

• We offer a highly collaborative working environment.

• We practice and incentivize continuous improvement.

Our Benefits Include, But Are Not Limited To

• A selection of competitive health insurance plans.

• Flexible paid time-off (PTO).

• English and Portuguese lessons, if desired.

You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁

You will work directly with clients and their accounting teams across the region to guide them through end-to-end accounting configuration — from chart of accounts mapping and tax setup to ERP integrations and country-specific e-invoicing compliance — ensuring every property is set up correctly and running smoothly from day one. This is a customer-facing role requiring equal parts hospitality accounting expertise, technical curiosity, and a genuine passion for helping people succeed. We move fast, collaborate closely with Engineering, Support, and Sales, and take genuine pride in helping customers connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds. If you love solving problems that actually matter to the people you are helping, you will feel right at home here.

• Troubleshoot accounting discrepancies, integration sync issues, and configuration questions with a hands-on, solutions-oriented approach

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀

• 5+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience specifically within the hotel or hospitality industry — required

• Proven experience configuring or supporting integrations between a hotel PMS and accounting or ERP software (QuickBooks, NetSuite, M3, or comparable) — not theoretical; you have done this

• Deep knowledge of at least one Latin American country's fiscal and e-invoicing requirements with working familiarity across the broader region

• Strong customer-facing communication skills — you are comfortable and confident engaging directly with hotel clients and their accounting teams via phone and video daily

• Fluent in both Spanish and English — this is a firm requirement for this role; Portuguese is a strong additional plus

• Comfort navigating SaaS platforms and adopting new tools quickly with minimal hand-holding

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to trace data flows, identify mapping issues, and troubleshoot integration problems methodically

𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁

• Prior hands-on experience in hotel operations — front office, night audit, or revenue management

• Knowledge of fiscal compliance requirements across multiple Latin American countries beyond your home market

• Active personal use of AI tools or workflow automation — we are building a team that embraces technology and learns continuously

𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

Job Description

Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expertise to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.

As a Governance Associate in Risk Management & Compliance, you support governance activities that help ensure effective oversight of risk management processes and initiatives. You will contribute to the governance framework for new products and services while supporting legal entity risk governance activities across North America. Working with stakeholders across the organization, you will help drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in a dynamic environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Support governance of Commercial & Investment Bank Risk's operating model for engagement in the New Product Assessment program.

• Maintain governance documentation and provide training to stakeholders as needed.

• Support engagement with firmwide and Commercial & Investment Bank New Product Assessment teams and governance forums.

• Manage New Product Assessment reporting, including identifying opportunities to automate reporting processes.

• Provide administrative support for selected New Product Assessments and partner with business managers to track timely completion.

• Contribute to prioritization and implementation of enhancement initiatives related to the New Product Assessment program.

• Support North America legal entity risk governance activities.

• Assist in preparing information and responses to regulatory requests.

• Prepare materials for legal entity governance meetings, including risk forums and legal entity board meetings.

• Participate in, and where appropriate lead, projects that impact legal entity risk management in North America.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• +4 years of experience in financial services or a related field, with exposure to risk management, compliance, internal audit, external audit, or another control function.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex topics to senior stakeholders.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with familiarity with artificial intelligence and large language model capabilities.

• Demonstrated organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities from initiation through completion.

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

• Bachelor's degree required.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Ability to assess processes holistically and recommend improvements.

• Knowledge of risk management concepts, including liquidity risk, country risk, market risk, and credit risk.

• Experience building and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships.

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Treasury (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

About The Team

The Treasury team builds and operates the core infrastructure that moves money across our platform. We’re responsible for handling incoming and outgoing flows—fiat and stablecoins, internal transfers, withdrawals, and payouts. Our systems need to be reliable, observable, and audit-ready by default. We work closely with teams across the company to design systems that meet real-world operational, regulatory, and business needs.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build global, asset-agnostic money movement systems that work seamlessly across regions, currencies, and financial partners. You’ll build flows that handle both fiat and stablecoins in production. You will partner with engineering, product, customer success, and finance teams to build systems with both internal and user-facing impact.

Responsibilities

• Design and operate scalable systems that move and reconcile funds across jurisdictions, channels, and asset types

• Build observability into every layer; lead incident response and drive long-term reliability improvements

• Stay current with fintech, tech, and compliance trends, and evolve our systems accordingly

What we’re looking for

We encourage everyone to apply even if you just meet the minimum requirements. Preferred qualifications are a bonus.

Minimum Requirements

• Experience: Minimum of 6 years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning and operating business-critical systems (candidates with fewer years of experience may also be considered as Software Engineer).

• Problem solving: You care deeply about correctness, edge cases, and failure modes. You approach problems methodically, debug with rigor, and prioritize clear, robust solutions over quick fixes.

• Backend focus: You have experience working on backend systems and enjoy building APIs, services, and infrastructure that power real-world applications.

• Data modeling and access: You’re comfortable working with relational databases like Postgres and MySQL, and have a solid understanding of transactions, data integrity, and performance tradeoffs. You’ve used ORMs like TypeORM or the equivalent in your stack, but know when to go beyond them.

• Technical judgment: You balance technical depth with product understanding, and apply sound judgment when making tradeoffs. You build systems that are elegant under the hood, but practical and adaptable in real-world use.

• Peer collaboration: You hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and peer review, and value working closely with others who do the same. You communicate clearly, challenge ideas respectfully, and help raise the quality of the whole team.

• Versatility: You’re comfortable learning new domains, working across the stack, and adapting quickly as priorities shift. You thrive in fast-moving environments and aren’t afraid to dive deep into unfamiliar systems.

• Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, and AWS, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over any specific toolset.

Preferred Qualifications

• Domain knowledge: Experience in financial domains—such as payments, disbursements, custody, or cards—is a strong plus, but not required.

• Technical proficiency: You design systems that are stateless by default, built for scale, and resilient to failure. You’re comfortable with async workflows, distributed services, and cloud infrastructure.

• AI fluency: You embrace using AI tools to accelerate development and explore ideas, but you apply them with discernment, not as a replacement. You know when to trust outputs and when to go deeper.

• Full-stack experience: Experience across the stack (backend, frontend, infrastructure, data) is a bonus.

• High-growth environments: Experience working in high-growth teams is a bonus.

postings.title: Capital Market & Derivatives Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

Bridgenext is seeking an experienced Derivatives Developer to join the Derivatives Technology team and design, develop, test, maintain, customize, integrate, and support solutions on a leading derivatives trading and risk platform such as ION Findur (OpenLink Endur), Calypso, Murex, or an equivalent system. The platform serves as a core system of record for derivative transactions, valuations, risk metrics, and accounting.

The role requires deep hands-on platform expertise, strong full-stack and integration development capabilities, and a solid understanding of OTC derivatives across the complete trade lifecycle. The developer will build reliable, secure, and scalable solutions that support front-, middle-, and back-office trade-servicing functions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, operations analysts, Business Analysts, Product Owners, technology, security, vendor teams, and cross-functional delivery squads to translate requirements and deliver high-quality, production-ready software solutions.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

• Design, develop, configure, and unit test platform customizations in accordance with approved functional and technical standards

• Enhance and support derivative trade-servicing capabilities across trading, treasury, and investment management functions

• Implement and maintain platform workflows for trade booking, confirmations, valuations, risk calculations, collateral events, accounting, reporting, and settlement

• Build and maintain custom scripts, modules, interfaces, and supporting applications within and around the derivatives platform

• Develop and support integrations with upstream and downstream platforms, including trade capture, market data, confirmation, settlement, accounting, risk, and reconciliation systems

• Work with enterprise and vendor platforms such as Bloomberg EMSX, FX Connect, MarkitServ, AcadiaSoft, TriOptima, and DTCC, as well as internal trade, risk, and reference-data systems

• Develop and support FpML file generation, validation, transmission, and processing

• Support platform databases and reporting queries using strong SQL and data-analysis practices

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, source-control practices, code recompilation, release management, and deployment automation aligned with a DevSecOps delivery model

• Participate in platform upgrades, including version-impact assessment, code recompilation, version testing, regression testing, and deployment validation

• Participate in sprint planning, story refinement, estimation, and Program Increment (PI) planning ceremonies

• Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Owners to clarify business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions

• Support cloud resilience and disaster-recovery capabilities, including derivatives workloads hosted on cloud infrastructure (e.g., Azure AKS) where applicable

• Apply least-privilege access, security-group controls, access reviews, encryption, audit logging, and other enterprise security standards

• Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit testing, technical documentation, and adherence to approved engineering standards; participate in technology evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives

• Provide production support, including troubleshooting, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and system optimization

Must Have Skills

• Platform & Derivatives Domain

• Deep hands-on knowledge of a leading derivatives platform such as ION Findur (OpenLink Endur), Calypso, or Murex, including scripting, configuration, administration, trade booking, valuations, risk modules, and accounting modules

• Experience developing and maintaining platform customizations, scripts, modules, interfaces, and integrations across upstream and downstream trade, market-data, confirmation, settlement, accounting, risk, and reconciliation systems

• Strong derivatives domain knowledge of OTC products such as swaps, options, futures, and forwards

• End-to-end understanding of the derivatives lifecycle — booking, confirmation, valuation, collateral, settlement, accounting, and reconciliation — including lifecycle events such as partial buyouts, corporate actions, and qualified purchases

• Practical understanding of valuation, pricing, and risk management, including market data, Greek sensitivities, and volatility surfaces

• Knowledge of collateral management processes, including cleared swaps, futures margining, and Uncleared Margin Rules (UMR) reconciliation

• Knowledge of Fixed Income products and markets

• Technical & Development

• Full-stack software development expertise, including Java, Spring Boot, and Python

• Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, SQL Server, and Databricks

• Strong database and SQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting, reporting, and support of the platform's underlying data stores

• Experience building and supporting enterprise CI/CD pipelines

• Experience integrating AI/ML or Generative AI solutions into enterprise applications, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, or enterprise copilot development

• Market Systems & Production Support

• Experience with market, trading, and portfolio platforms such as Bloomberg, Reuters, and Aladdin

• Experience supporting production systems, including incident diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and performance optimization

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Bloomberg EMSX, FX Connect, MarkitServ, AcadiaSoft, TriOptima, DTCC, or similar market and vendor platform integrations

• Knowledge of FpML standards and derivative trade-message processing

• Experience with repository management, code compilation, CI/CD pipeline automation, and DevSecOps practices

• Exposure to cloud infrastructure (e.g., Microsoft Azure), Kubernetes/AKS, cloud resilience, disaster recovery, and related controls

• Understanding of security and access management, including least-privilege provisioning, security groups, access reviews, cryptographic standards, and audit logging

• Knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, or NAIC accounting standards, including hedge accounting, journal entries, and regulatory reporting

• Awareness of regulatory and operational-resilience expectations (e.g., OSFI B-10, DORA, or equivalent requirements)

Professional Skills

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

• Collaborative team player who can also work independently with limited supervision.

• High standards of professionalism, ownership, and quality, with composure during production or delivery-critical situations.

• Analytical problem solver who can translate complex derivative-processing requirements into reliable technical solutions.

• Flexible and open-minded, with a continuous-improvement approach and willingness to propose creative solutions.

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

postings.title: Financial Accountant
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

We're building a regional finance and operations hub in Buenos Aires, and this is one of the first roles in it. Reporting to the Financial Controller, Argentina & Uruguay, you'll own the accounting that sits underneath everything else: payables, reconciliations, the general ledger, and the preparation that makes our close and tax filings run cleanly.

The team is small, so you'll get real responsibility early and exposure to work well beyond a typical accountant role. Processes are being built as you join, and you'll be expected to improve them, not just follow them.

This suits someone early in their career who wants range, likes getting the detail right, and would rather fix a broken process than work around it.

What You'll Own

• Accounts payable: supplier onboarding, invoice processing and payment runs across both entities.

• Bank, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations, completed on time as part of the monthly close.

• General ledger accuracy: journals, accruals and coding that the Controller doesn't need to recheck.

• Inventory and fixed asset records for collar stock and equipment held in-country.

• Tax filing preparation and documentation for the Controller and external advisors.

• Expense and payroll inputs, working with our People team and local providers.

What You'll Bring

Must-haves

• A minimum of 3 years in accounting, audit or finance operations

• Working knowledge of Argentine accounting, tax and payment processes.

• Strong Excel skills and close attention to detail.

• Fluency in Spanish and good working English.

• Comfort with unfinished processes and being asked to help build them.

Nice-to-haves

• Exposure to Uruguayan compliance.

• Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP.

• Inventory accounting experience in a product or hardware business.

• Interest in automation, SQL or AI tooling.

How We'll Know You're Winning

• Suppliers are paid correctly and on time.

• Reconciliations are done on time and don't need rechecking.

• At least one process you inherited runs faster or with less manual work because of you.

• You're being trusted with more complex close and tax work by the end of the year.

Culture line

This role rewards Absolute Ownership at the level where it matters most: the transactions everything else is built on. It suits someone who believes in We Work Hard and Here to Win, where effort shows up as accuracy and follow-through, and who can Embrace Discomfort as the function grows around them.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

• Alta atención al detalle para la asignación de splits por headcount y el control de tarjetas.

🌟 Nuestro propósito: llevar felicidad al mundo del trabajo.

postings.title: Billing & Refunds Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Remote, only for candidates in LATAM

At Ryz Labs we are looking for a Billing & Refunds Coordinator to join our team. This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of finance operations, customer experience, and cross-functional process optimization.

The Billing & Refunds Coordinator will own the daily execution of key transactional workflows—from managing collections and processing high-volume refunds to bookkeeping journal entries and directly supporting our most valued sellers and customers.

This role requires someone who possesses financial precision and strong interpersonal skills. You are just as comfortable diving into Excel sheets, Stripe data, and ERP systems as you are translating complex payment or invoicing issues into clear, empathetic communication for our users. The right person has an analytical mindset, deep attention to detail, and a track record of thriving in fast-paced, digital marketplace or e-commerce environments.

What You Will Do

• Address Customer Experience support tickets related to payments, invoicing, and refunds

• Monitor customer accounts and assist with the application of cash receipts, incoming Wire and ACH payments, and reconciliation of discrepancies

• Preparing daily/monthly journal entries in the ERP system for Cash and A/R transactions

• Processing Sales Team Requests, Refunds, Credits, Rate adjustments, and other one-off payment issues in Admin, Stripe and Avalara

• Identify opportunities to streamline and enhance automation across key accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows, contributing to process efficiency and scalability, creating and updating accounting policy memos and process flowcharts

• Sales Tax Exemption maintenance and refund processing in Avalara

• Serve as a point of contact for key sellers, delivering proactive updates on sales proceeds and payout schedules

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree or progress toward a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Customer Service or a related field preferred

• 4-6 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Bookkeeping, Customer Support or related finance support roles

• Familiarity with basic accounting principles and ERP systems (Stripe or Oracle Fusion experience preferred)

• Strong Excel skills and attention to detail in data entry and transaction processing

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

• Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer

• Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated

• Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility

• Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone that interacts with RYZ with respect

• Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less

• Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way

• Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, our expectations. Status quo is not good enough and never should be
