You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

• Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options

• Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love

• Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as the Public Private Solutions Sales Specialist (West) at Capital Group.”

The Public Private Solutions (PPS) Sales Specialist is a client facing specialist role focused on business development efforts for Capital Group’s public private suite of products across Wealth Management (WM) channels. This position requires team collaboration across WM Sales and Capital Group product teams and will be responsible for delivering point of sale expertise in representing Capital Group PPS in the West to financial advisors and portfolio solution strategists.

While responsibilities are varied, it is expected that the PPS Specialist will focus efforts in the following areas:

• Ability to represent PPS in market with product education, capital markets updates across private markets, guidance on interval funds, and portfolio construction guidance.

• Partner with WM Sales to identify, prioritize and schedule territory travel; gain an understanding of and prioritize the highest opportunity zones and coverage frequency within their geographic territory.

• Actively participate as a PPS sales and investment resource for sales force members in their territories; the expectation is that the position will require a minimum of 2-3 days of weekly territory travel to support 1:1 engagements, regional meetings and national events.

• Synthesize information from across Capital Group teams and external partners to create timely capital market, competitor, and portfolio construction updates targeted to the needs of the sales force members in territory.

• Lead stakeholder management as partner and resource for product across Sales leadership teams including Regional Sales and Marketing to ensure our message is relevant to the market; participate in regular product leadership meetings.

• Coordinate delivery of relevant information and data on Private Market trends and fund-specific competitive landscape; some writing and collaboration with PPS marketing required; business intelligence across divisions and SFM.

• Work closely with the PPS Product team and WM Sales Leadership on the creation and/or deployment of the PPS Sales and Marketing plan.

• Help build, deliver and maintain all training to external sales force members in Wealth Management.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

• You have at least 5+ years of professional experience in Sales or Specialist positions engaging with Financial advisors and business development professionals.

• You have experience across private markets, an understanding of private market fund structures including interval funds, and experience marketing across Wealth Management channels.

• You have experience in building sales narratives centered around portfolio construction guidance.

• You have strong analytical skills and the ability to analyze opportunities/issues and to recommend business solutions.

• You have strong organizational, relationship, communication and presentation skills.

• You have a focus on achievements/outcomes and a drive to take initiative while demonstrating sound business judgment.

• You have the ability to develop, prioritize and implement best practices.

• You have a leadership style that is open, approachable, and informing.

• You wholly embrace American Funds and Capital Group's investment philosophy. You share in the commitment to increasing sales within a framework of long-term relationship building, teamwork, and the highest professional integrity.

• You have the ability to adapt and thrive in a startup opportunity within a large world class asset management firm.

• You have a Bachelor’s Degree; Master; CFA or CAIA is a plus.

Base Range

$180,000 - $282,500

In addition to a highly competitive base salary, you will receive two annual bonuses and a generous retirement contribution.

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.”

You’ve reviewed this job posting and you’re ready to start the candidate journey with us. Apply now to move to the next step in our recruiting process. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, check out our other opportunities and join our talent community.

“I Can Learn More About Capital Group.”

postings.descriptionText:
Role Title: GDS Microsoft Commercial Solution Area Investment Specialist – Azure

Alliance: Microsoft

Competency: Co-Investments

Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Skill Level: High

Rank: Assistant Director

Sub Function: GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

Reports to: GDS Microsoft Operations Lead

The Opportunity

The Microsoft Alliance Commercial Solution Area Investment Specialist is responsible for working with the Global Alliance Commercial and Functional Alliance Directors for one of EY’s largest and most strategic alliances to grow the investment year over year that we receive from our alliance partner. The Investment Specialist for Microsoft’s Azure solution portfolio will help manage the alliance relationship commercial activity including evaluating the alliance programs, contribute to enabling EY’s participation in the program across Member Firm locations. The specialist will develop a deep understanding of Microsoft’s investment programs, Microsoft’s partner performance measurement and serve as a subject matter resource to increase the velocity of contracting while reducing systemic risk.

This role is part of the Global Alliance and Ecosystem Relationship Program which has responsibility for:

• Increasing Global sales and revenue, by leveraging EY’s alliance relationships to drive sales and delivery assisted and influenced by alliances across joint solutions, campaigns and active engagement in the field

• Increasing pipeline of EY opportunities through collaboration with alliance partner.

• Increasing win rates and reducing delivery risk through collaboration with alliances

Your Key Responsibilities

• Interact with the alliance partner and alliance commercial leadership and functional alliance directors to interpret new programs, develop plan for how EY will leverage and optimize programs, and coordinate across teams to define processes to execute upon the repeatable aspects of the program

• Develop a deep understanding of Microsoft’s partner investments programs for user-based business services: Microsoft 365, Dynamics365 and Copilot portfolio and EY commercial applicability.

• Drive enablement and execution of alliance investment programs across regions ensuring alignment with global strategy

• Engage with regional stakeholders including EY service line leaders, alliance partner teams, and market enablement leads to ensure alignment, localization, and execution of investment programs.

• Collaborate across teams that manage on-going execution of programs and connected alliance partner processes.

• Provide solution area subject matter resource expertise and escalation support to sales and delivery teams across Sector and Regions

• Success will be measured by increased program adoption, reduction in systemic risk, increased partner performance and growth in alliance-attributed pipeline and revenue across the targeted regions.

Drive investment reporting, insights and performance management

• Collaborate with Global Commercial and Alliance Relationship Directors for executive reporting on investment program performance

• Develop and maintain investment dashboards, trackers and executive summaries that provide clear visibility into solution area/geo investment health, performance and highlights.

• Analyze trends across solution area investments and provide practical recommendations to improve processes , governance and go-to-market impact.

• Use data and stakeholder input to tell a clear story on where investment programs s are progressing well, where support is required and where leadership decisions are needed.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• A proficient understanding of how Microsoft’s Azure partner programs are executed

• Experience working for a global system integrator (GSI) and/or Big Four firm with exposure to complex partner programs, incentives, and investment programs from top tier software companies.

• Proven ability to contribute to teams to operationalize complex partner program requirements, processes, reporting, compliance, and portal management.

• Ability to leverage knowledge of programs to advise senior business leaders on how to maximize partner program benefits and minimize risks.

• Ability to work and influence multiple stakeholders in matrixed structures of large global partners.

• Strong English speaking at negotiation level, strong influencing, and communication skills

• High attention to detail, strong follow-through and a continuous improvement mindset.

Supervision Responsibilities:

• Must be able to operate primarily independently to drive activation and engagement, direct activities of those in other practice areas or functions who do not report to the Alliance Commercial Specialist and be comfortable working with and providing guidance to resources senior to the Alliance Commercial Specialist.

To qualify for the role, you must have

• Bachelor’s Degree preferably Business, Technology, Finance,

• Postgraduate preferably MBA (Business, Finance)

• 12+ years of experience working in relevant technology and professional services environments.

• Proven experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders (both internal and external) in a virtual environment, across geographies.

• Location: Buenos Aries, Argentina

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting USLI market priorities or comparable regional business priorities.

• Exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI Platforms, Security or related solution areas.

• Experience in alliance management, co-sell motions, co-investment programs, solution area funding, marketplace offerings or technology partner ecosystems.

• Experience in a Big Four, global system integrator (GSI), professional services, consulting or technology-led environment.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Shape the future with confidence

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

postings.title: Senior Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization , built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.

We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concert or a large-scale multi-city activation , we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey from initial sales and strategy to global execution working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

The Role

We are looking for a tenured Sr. Account Executive to help build and scale our emerging Fever for Business unit across LATAM, bringing the full power of Fever to corporate and institutional clients in a fast-growing market. In this role, you will take ownership of a targeted book of business within the Strategic & Enterprise segments, while also shaping our local go-to-market approach - defining strategy, advising prospects on their needs within the culture and live entertainment space and driving net new revenue. Your expertise in consultative selling, combined with strong deal execution and cross-functional alignment, will be critical to accelerating our expansion and establishing a high-impact B2B presence in the region.

What You'll Do

• Own the relationship with Fever’s Enterprise and Strategic prospects and clients in your territory

• Consistently meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

• Take ownership in pipeline creation and deal cycle management, applying MEDDIC-style Sales methodologies

• Drive New Logo growth and a land & expand motion for our top tier customers

• Leverage Fever’s ecosystem and your own network to identify and engage ideal prospects

• Identify, map, and multi-thread key stakeholders in your territory

• Craft and execute creative outreach strategies to drive pipeline quality

• Build lasting client relationships that generate recurring revenue

• Collaborate cross-functionally (Marketing, Partners, Operations) to ensure alignment

• Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends and competitors

• Thrive on change while remaining highly organized, adaptable, optimistic, and coachable

• Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy, and high customer service standards

Who You Are

• 5+ years in B2B sales (SaaS, Media, Entertainment, MICE or similar a plus)

• Proven track record of achieving Sales targets

• Experience with MEDDIC/SPIN or similar methodologies is preferred

• Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills; confident with senior stakeholders

• Entrepreneurial self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change

• Excellent written & verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Growth mindset: coachable, data-driven, organized, optimistic

• Fluency in English and Spanish.

Why You'll Love It Here

• Attractive compensation package with room to grow.

• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.

• 20 days of paid annual leave to support your well-being and personal time outside of work.

• Private health & dental insurance: OSDE 410 plan fully covered by Fever.

• Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.

• Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.

• Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Buenos Aires office location.

• Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

postings.title: Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Account Executive, full sales cycle
More and more people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Claude which business they should go to. Those assistants answer from facts, not from ads, and the businesses they name are the ones whose facts are complete, consistent and easy to find. GEO Booster is the platform that manages those facts: it collects them from every source, flags what is missing or contradicts itself, and publishes them in the format the assistants read, automatically, every day.

More than 200 businesses already run on it, across hotels, vacation rentals, tours and charters, real estate and local services, and we are expanding into new markets and new verticals. The category is three years old. Most of the market does not know it exists yet. That is the opportunity.

The role
We are looking for a full sales cycle Account Executive with a hunter mentality. You find your own opportunities and you close them. Our SDR team adds meetings on top of that, but nobody here waits for leads to arrive. You eat what you kill.
You will be selling something people have not bought before, which means the first half of every conversation is teaching and the second half is closing. Short cycle, high volume, business owners and general managers on the other side of the call.

What you will do
Build your own pipeline. Research your market, find the businesses that fit, and get to the person who decides. Close what you built, and take the meetings our SDRs add on top.
Run the meetings as a consultant, not as a product tour. Understand what the business actually needs, show what AI assistants can and cannot say about it today, and connect that to the value the platform adds to their business.

Close. Handle the objections, agree on the terms, get the agreement signed, and the first invoice collected.

Keep your admin in order. Every call logged, every deal in the right stage, every next step dated. If it is not documented there, it does not exist. Feed back what you hear. You will be closer to the market than anyone, and the product and the pitch both improve from what you bring back.

What we are looking for

• At least three years running a full sales cycle in SaaS or tech, prospecting and closing. Not an SDR who was promoted, and not a closer who has never prospected.

• Numbers you can back up. How many opportunities you worked a month, how many you closed, what you generated yourself.

• Fully bilingual. C1 or C2 English, or native. Spanish at the same level.

• Critical thinking. The questions in this market have answers, and very few people are equipped to give them. You will be one of the people who can, which means thinking on your feet instead of reaching for a script.

• Adaptability. The product, the market and the playbook are all still moving.

• Mental toughness. Rejection is part of the job here. A no is either something to learn from or an objection worth digging into, and you treat it that way.

• Proactive and performance driven. You measure yourself before anyone else does.

• Comfortable in a CRM. Pipedrive and Aircall knowledge is a plus.

• A plus, not a requirement: knowledge of GEO, AEO or AI search , or experience selling to hospitality, marketing, tourism or local businesses.

What we offer

• Base salary plus uncapped commission, with accelerators that raise the rate on every deal you closed that month once you pass target.

• Fully remote

• A category so new that almost nobody is competing in it yet. Reaching out about this is still a conversation people want to have, not one more vendor email.

• Direct access to the people who decide. Small team, no layers between you and the product.

The practical details
Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 United States Eastern time. Fully remote. We accept applications from across Latin America.

How to apply
Send your CV in English and answer the application questions. We read every answer, and the answers matter more than the CV.

GEO Booster is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to target and close net new accounts, as well as re-engage dormant accounts. Success in this role comes from your skills in researching potential customers, strategically engaging them, aligning Toptal’s value with their needs, and consistently closing new business. This is a full sales cycle role, which means you will be responsible for setting your own meetings through your prospecting and outreach.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Prospect, educate, qualify, and close leads and opportunities by engaging dormant accounts and performing lead-generation activities into new targeted accounts. Additionally, manage inbound leads, as required.

• Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to convey Toptal’s vision, identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.

• Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.

• As you become more comfortable in the role, you’ll help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.

• Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.

• Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.

• Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.

• Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.

• Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).

• Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.

• Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

• While exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.

• Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.

• Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.

• Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.

• Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.

• Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.

• Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

• Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

• Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

• Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.

• Establish a career path for advancement.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

• The ideal candidate will bring at least 1 year of closing experience.

• You are persistent. Being rejected by prospective clients can be a common occurrence in this role. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Being enthusiastic, ambitious, and having a positive mindset will play a key role in your success.

• You are naturally curious. You have a strong desire to understand people, their problems, companies, and industries. If/when you come across a complex issue, you can understand and explain them to clients.

• You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business. To succeed at Toptal, you need to be a world-class individual contributor. Part of this includes being able to take ownership of your accounts, successes, and failures.

• You are a go-getter. We are looking for self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts and think about target accounts as their own business. You aren’t afraid to do the work required to reach your goals by following a process and being creative.

• You don’t take yourself too seriously; you have a sense of humor and are comfortable with sarcasm. This position does sit on our Sales teams, after all.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

For Toptal Use Only: #northamerica #centralamerica #southamerica

Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We are an untraditional SaaS revenue organization, built to support a rapidly scaling technology start-up driven by product-led-growth and sales (PLG / PLS). We need to expand our footprint in the region, working closely with partners to expand relationships and drive growth.

Specific responsibilities for Account Executives include nurturing larger named accounts and enterprise customers across Latin America – who are looking for a better way to connect with their customers, adopt AI, and find product-market fit.

You will work closely with customers end-to-end throughout their lifecycle – from concept to technical requirements, implementation, adoption, expansion, and paid. This is truly an expansive sales responsibility that spans selling, success, and support.

Activities Related To This Role Will, For Example, Include

• Expand outreach to your existing network and new opportunities across LATAM, working closely with BDRs to build and qualify pipeline.

• Develop and sell through channel and ecosystem partners (resellers, SIs, and technology partners) to extend reach and accelerate deals across the region.

• Work with our Growth team to increase product awareness across the region.

• Guide customers through implementation plans to further adoption and drive paid conversion.

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

Deel IT exists to equip the world's talent with the means to do their best work. Through one slick platform customers can procure, deploy, repair & recover entire fleets of devices and home office equipment for their employees in over 120 countries.

Your Responsibilities

• Hungry for success: You’re passionate and driven, and you’re willing to take risks, be creative, and always resilient.

• Seasoned sales professional: You have experience selling to MM (From 200 to 2,000 employees) sized customers, ideally a software-led product, and having strong success as a net new logo hunter.

• Ownership and execution: You take ownership of the complete sales cycle from start to finish, navigating complex commercial deals by building strong relationships and negotiating to a close.

• Strong Communicator: You are an excellent communicator with great presentation skills. You can effectively articulate and leverage the Deel IT value proposition to win the trust of customers and close deals.

• Owner mindset: You're passionate about Deel IT's product and mission and positively display this at every interaction within the sales cycle and beyond.

Key Requirements

• 2+ years of sales quota carrying experience - ideally in IT SaaS (MDM, IAM, device lifecycle, SaaS procurement, or adjacent categories).

• Seen great success: You have been an integral part of at least one great business success story, and know what it takes to deliver outlier results.

• Closing: A strong background in getting B2B software-led product sales across the line. You are an expert individual contributor with an excellent track record.

• Builder: You're willing and able to build out strong pipelines, whilst fluidly partnering with a BDR.

• Accurate and accountable: You can accurately forecast your sales results, you see the gaps in your pipeline and you are ahead of the curve, you strive to always go above and beyond.

• Teamwork: You have experience collaborating with teams across a growing company and building strong relationships.

• Thrive in a global remote team environment

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

• Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

• Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

• We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy.

The Senior Account Executive, Leap is responsible for driving complex, multi‑solution commercial execution across strategic and high‑impact accounts, representing Broadcom as a trusted executive partner to customers and the channel ecosystem. This role owns long‑term account strategy, executive‑level relationships, and transformational growth initiatives, including large renewals, enterprise expansion, and new solution adoption under the Leap motion. The role operates with greater autonomy and strategic accountability than Account Executive, Aggregator, and serves as a deal and account leader for the most complex opportunities in the country or sub‑region.

• Lead complex commercial transactions, including multi‑year renewals, large expansions, cross‑portfolio deals, and non‑standard commercial structures, within regional and corporate guidelines.

• Drive net‑new revenue and transformational growth, including win‑backs, competitive displacements, and adoption of new Leap offerings across the installed base.

• Orchestrate internal and external resources (pre‑sales, marketing, operations, partners, distributors) to deliver differentiated value and ensure flawless execution.

• Serve as a commercial escalation point for strategic deals, resolving contractual, pricing, or operational challenges that exceed standard sales motions.

• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline governance, and executive‑level reporting, contributing to regional planning and business reviews.

• Act as a role model and informal mentor to less‑senior Account Executives, sharing best practices on deal strategy, negotiation, and account management (without direct people management).

• Contribute to country and regional go‑to‑market strategy, including feedback on Leap program effectiveness, partner performance, and market dynamics.

• Manages largest, most complex, or most strategic accounts in the country or sub‑region.

• Direct impact on revenue growth, renewal rates, and multi‑year customer retention.

• Exercises high commercial judgment and pricing discretion within defined authority levels.

• Influences strategy beyond individual accounts, shaping broader Leap execution.

Knowledge, Skills And Experience

• >8 to 10 Years of relevant work experience

• Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and multi‑stakeholder deals.

• Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and executive communication capabilities.

• Deep understanding of channel‑led sales models and partner ecosystems.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills.

• High degree of autonomy, integrity, and accountability.

• Knowledge of the local market and key players/end-users.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Customer-centric and consultative mindset.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

• Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish according to country; English required.

• Team player with strong collaboration skills.

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability.

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or related field required.

• Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.

• Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.

Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.

At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

postings.title: Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

What This Role Is All About

As an Account Executive, you will drive new business growth by selling Infobip’s solutions to Tier 1 clients within your assigned territory. You will identify new opportunities across existing and prospective customers, manage complex sales cycles, and build long-term client relationships focused on growth and account health. This is a highly consultative role that combines strategic prospecting, solution selling, negotiation, and customer ownership during the first 12 months of the client lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

• Manage and grow a target account list within your assigned territory

• Sell Infobip solutions directly or through partners to Tier 1 customers

• Identify new business opportunities and proactively recommend tailored solutions

• Build solution proposals and value propositions aligned with customer needs

• Manage sales activities including forecasting, account planning, and resource coordination

• Negotiate pricing and contractual agreements to close new business

• Support end-to-end client relationships during the first 12 months, including retention, cross-sell, upsell, and expansion activities

• Build trusted relationships with customers and maintain strong account health

• Keep CRM data accurate and up to date throughout the sales cycle

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to secure new business and customer growth

• Provide guidance and mentoring to other team members when needed

What Makes You a Strong Fit

• 5+ years of experience in sales or account management roles

• Experience in software, SaaS, or technology sales environments

• Strong commercial and negotiation skills with experience managing complex sales cycles

• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Strategic and consultative sales approach with strong customer focus

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment

• Strong organizational skills and CRM discipline

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel and PowerPoint

• Fluent English, spoken and written

Why you'll love it here

• Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.

• Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.

• ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.

• Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.

• Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. 

• Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.

• International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

Experiencia

En COSENTINO nuestro propósito es inspirar a las Personas a través de espacios innovadores y sostenibles. Somos el productor líder mundial de superficies arquitectónicas y decorativas. Nuestros productos están diseñados para brindar soluciones innovadoras y funcionales tanto para el hogar como para espacios comerciales, como encimeras de cocina y baño, espacios abiertos al aire libre, fachadas, etc. Innovación, sostenibilidad, funcionalidad y belleza describen nuestra propuesta de valor para los diferentes actores del mercado y cliente final www.cosentino.com

PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

¿Querés ser parte de un equipo que impulsa el crecimiento de las marcas más importantes de Latam?

En PedidosYa transformamos la manera en que millones de personas acceden a sus comidas y productos favoritos. Y detrás de cada experiencia, hay un equipo comercial que lo hace posible.

Estamos buscando Account Executive con perfil estratégico, foco en resultados y pasión por construir relaciones sólidas con partners clave. Una persona con mentalidad emprendedora, capacidad analítica y visión comercial, que quiera dejar su huella en un negocio que no para de crecer.

Si te entusiasma liderar negociaciones, desarrollar oportunidades de negocio y trabajar en un entorno dinámico, ¡este desafío es para vos!

Conoce algunos de los desafíos que te esperan:

• Mantener y consolidar las relaciones con las distintas marcas.

• Realizar análisis de marca para identificar las fortalezas, oportunidades, debilidades y amenazas de cada Partner.

• Desarrollar planes de acción y expansión para rentabilizar el negocio, e incrementar el volumen de órdenes con las marcas.

• Asistir a reuniones presenciales.

• Seguimiento de las distintas negociaciones.

• Realizar gestiones operativas varias relacionadas a los Partners.

• Venta de espacios publicitarios In-App.

Requisitos

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

• Experiencia de al menos 1 año en manejo de cuentas ideal en rubro gastronómico.

• Conocimiento en Excel.

• Capacidades analíticas y creativas.

• Habilidades para la venta de servicios.

• Conocimiento básico de marketing y marketing digital.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. postings.title: Senior Sales Executive - Google
postings.descriptionText:
Maplink es una empresa líder en Latinoamérica especializada en tecnología de geolocalización, soluciones en la nube y servicios profesionales. Como socio estratégico de nuestros clientes, ayudamos a empresas de toda la región a optimizar sus operaciones, mejorar la experiencia del cliente y tomar decisiones más inteligentes gracias al poder de los datos de ubicación y la innovación en la nube.

Operamos como uno de los principales socios de Google en Latinoamérica, comercializando e implementando soluciones de Google Maps Platform, Google Cloud y Google Workspace. Además, desarrollamos nuestra propia plataforma, Maplink Platform, diseñada para optimizar la inteligencia logística, el enrutamiento y la visibilidad operativa en entornos complejos. En Maplink, creemos que la tecnología es más poderosa cuando trabaja con las personas. Nuestro equipo está formado por profesionales apasionados que se esfuerzan por resolver desafíos reales y ofrecer resultados tangibles.

Acerca del puesto

¿Te apasiona la tecnología, el impacto en el cliente y la generación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio? Buscamos un Ejecutivo de Ventas Senior listo para asumir un rol híbrido que combine innovación y crecimiento estratégico. Esta es tu oportunidad de liderar conversaciones con clientes de alto potencial, ayudarlos a aprovechar el poder de Google Maps Platform (GMP) y Google Cloud Platform (GCP) y marcar una diferencia tangible en sus operaciones. Si te desenvuelves bien en ventas consultivas, disfrutas gestionando relaciones empresariales complejas y quieres formar parte de un equipo con visión de futuro, este puesto es para ti.

Buscamos un Ejecutivo de Ventas Sénior con experiencia demostrada en ventas de tecnología B2B, enfocado en el desarrollo de cuentas existentes y la generación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Este puesto se centra en productos de alto impacto como Google Maps Platform (GMP) y Google Cloud Platform (GCP), y requiere una mentalidad consultiva, un enfoque centrado en el cliente, aptitud técnica y experiencia en la gestión de relaciones complejas.

Ejecutivo/a Senior de Ventas

Ubicación: Híbrido – Palermo, Buenos Aires, Argentina

Departamento: Ventas Latinoamérica

Reporta a: Gerente Regional de Ventas Latinoamérica

Responsabilidades:

Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas existentes, identificando oportunidades de upselling y crossselling.

Identificar, prospectar y cerrar nuevos negocios en el mercado local.

Comprender los desafíos comerciales y técnicos para proponer soluciones de alto valor utilizando GMP y GCP.

Colaborar con los equipos de preventa y customer success del cliente para garantizar una experiencia de cliente de primer nivel.

Liderar reuniones de descubrimiento, la preparación de propuestas comerciales y presentaciones ejecutivas.

Mantener actualizados los datos de oportunidades y pipeline en el CRM.

Cumplir con los objetivos mensuales/trimestrales de consumo y nuevos contratos.

Requisitos :

5 a 7 años de experiencia en ventas B2B de soluciones tecnológicas, idealmente en el ecosistema de Google o empresas SaaS.

Experiencia demostrada en la gestión de cuentas medianas y grandes, incluyendo interacción directa con los responsables de TI y de la toma de decisiones empresariales.

Enfoque consultivo con capacidad para interpretar necesidades complejas y traducirlas en soluciones tangibles.

Conocimiento funcional de arquitecturas en la nube, API y casos de uso de geolocalización (no se requieren conocimientos técnicos profundos).

Experiencia trabajando estrechamente con equipos de preventa y posventa.

Sólidas habilidades de planificación, priorización y ejecución con una mentalidad orientada a resultados.

Inglés intermedio (escrito y hablado) Valorable

Certificaciones en Google Cloud o Google Maps Platform.

Experiencia en Google, AWS, Azure u otros ecosistemas de socios en la nube.

Lo que ofrecemos

Paquete de compensación competitivo con un componente variable basado en objetivos de farmers y hunters.

Una cultura colaborativa y orientada al crecimiento con un fuerte enfoque en la adopción de tecnología.

Oportunidad de crecer dentro de un equipo de alto rendimiento con experiencia regional.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido con sede en Buenos Aires.

postings.title: Business Development Manager B2B – Argentina | Territory Manager Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Achilles busca un profesional de venta enterprise con mentalidad hunter, con empuje y dinamismo, para sumarse a nuestro equipo de alto rendimiento. En este rol clave vas a liderar la adquisición de nuevo negocio e impulsar el crecimiento de ingresos, enfocándote en cuentas de alto valor en los sectores estratégicos de Argentina.
Serás responsable de promover las soluciones de gestión de riesgo de proveedores de Achilles, construir y mantener un pipeline sólido y cerrar acuerdos complejos de alto valor con grandes empresas.

Responsabilidades principales

- Nuevo negocio: identificar, abordar y conseguir nuevos clientes enterprise (new logos) en los sectores clave del mercado argentino, con foco en energía, oil & gas y minería.
- Venta de soluciones: promover la plataforma de gestión de riesgo de proveedores de Achilles, comunicando su valor y retorno de inversión (ROI) a interlocutores de todos los niveles de la organización. Liderar el ciclo completo de venta: identificar prospectos, entender necesidades, presentar soluciones, manejar objeciones y negociar condiciones.
- Gestión de pipeline: desarrollar y gestionar un pipeline saludable de oportunidades de ciclo medio y largo mediante prospección proactiva y generación de leads. Mantenerse al día con las tendencias del mercado, recopilar inteligencia comercial e identificar cuentas de alto potencial alineadas a las estrategias sectoriales de Achilles.
- Relación con decisores: vincularse directamente con los tomadores de decisión clave (alta dirección, compras, riesgo y compliance) para entender las necesidades del negocio y alinear las soluciones de Achilles.

- Crecimiento de ingresos: cumplir o superar de forma consistente las metas trimestrales de venta y contribuir a los objetivos de ingresos de largo plazo de la organización.
- Visión estratégica: colaborar con los equipos de marketing, account management y producto para alinear la estrategia comercial con la demanda de los clientes.

Lo que buscamos

- Estar o haber estado recientemente en un rol de venta de nuevo negocio, con 5 años o más de éxito comprobado en venta enterprise de SaaS o soluciones intangibles a nuevos clientes. Es una ventaja la experiencia en gestión de riesgo de proveedores, compliance, gestión de riesgos o tecnología para supply chain.
- Trayectoria y experiencia cerrando acuerdos de alto valor con grandes empresas.
- Enfoque de venta consultiva sólido, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y presentación.
- Autonomía y trayectoria comprobada generando su propio pipeline y gestionando ciclos de venta largos y complejos de forma independiente. Alta motivación, resiliencia y una actitud positiva de embajador de la marca.
- Es un fuerte plus contar con experiencia vendiendo a sectores como energía, oil & gas, minería, industria o construcción.
- Inglés avanzado.
- Residencia en Buenos Aires y disponibilidad para viajar por Argentina y LATAM.
- Este no es un rol para Team Leaders ni Account Managers.

¿Por qué sumarte a Achilles?

- Formar parte de una marca global líder en su mercado, en la que confían algunas de las organizaciones más grandes del mundo.
- Trabajar en un rol de alto impacto.
- Integrarte a un equipo colaborativo, con visión de futuro y comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia. tina #Achilles.

Sobre Achilles

Durante más de 30 años, Achilles ha protegido los intereses comerciales y la reputación de las organizaciones al proporcionar niveles inigualables de transparencia en la cadena de suministro, reducción de carbono y gestión. Somos el socio de referencia en gestión ESG y de carbono para las principales marcas globales.

Trabajamos con organizaciones líderes de los sectores financiero, industrial, comercial y gubernamental, y con operaciones en 22 ubicaciones alrededor del mundo, estamos a la vanguardia en la lucha contra el cambio climático, la justicia social, los derechos humanos, la salud, la seguridad y la gestión de riesgos.

postings.title: Sales Executive - LATAM (ARG123-SL)
postings.descriptionText:
OKTO PAYMENTS' continuous growth demands high-caliber candidates who embody professionalism, passion, and creativity. For those who join us, we offer significant career advancement, stimulating challenges, and a clear runway for growth.

OKTO PAYMENTS is the next-generation Payment Service Provider - AI-native, precision-engineered, and relentlessly merchant-obsessed. Built for merchants operating in the most complex and demanding eCommerce sectors, our platform goes far beyond transaction processing. We solve for scale, compliance, and performance with one unshakable focus: delivering outcomes that power merchant growth.

From payments and banking to treasury and settlement, we engineer the financial infrastructure that gives our partners a competitive edge. The result? Faster onboarding, smarter operations, and resilient, real-time performance.

At OKTO PAYMENTS, we enable merchants to Play Differently, transforming payments from routine transactions into true differentiators that deliver personalized, frictionless experiences.

Our AI-native innovation harnesses data and insight to power every decision, while our proprietary in-house engineering ensures precision and control. Combined with deep, trust-based relationships worldwide, we're redefining what it means to build, scale, and win in complex digital commerce.

Role Summary

The Sales Executive - LATAM (excluding Brazil) is an individual contributor responsible for identifying, prospecting and closing new merchant relationships across the entire Spanish-speaking region, primarily in iGaming and adjacent high-risk e-commerce verticals. The role builds local pipeline that complements OKTO's cross-border Business Development function, instead focusing on merchants already operating in or entering LATAM who need local payment methods, strong acceptance rates and compliant settlement. This is a revenue-generating role.

Reports to: Managing Director LATAM.

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina. Client-facing role; on-site/hybrid presence with frequent travelling to to other LATAM regions expected to support relationship-building with local merchants, partners and industry events.

Key Responsibilities

• New business origination - Proactively identify, prospect,qualify and close new merchant opportunities across the entire Spanish-speaking region , primarily iGaming operators and platforms

• Full sales cycle ownership - Own the deal from lead generation through needs analysis, solution positioning (local card acquiring, bank transfers, cash-based methods, settlement), commercial proposal and negotiation to signed contract, coordinating with Legal on contract drafting

• Pipeline management & forecasting - Maintain accurate, current pipeline in Salesforce; deliver reliable weekly/monthly forecasts to the MD Latam and Sales Operations

• Cross-functional handoff - Work with Compliance on KYB/AML/CTF clearance before contracting; hand off signed merchants cleanly to Merchant Delivery & Operations and the Account Director for onboarding and ongoing account management

• Market & competitive intelligence - Track the LATAM payments and iGaming regulatory and competitive landscape and feed insights to Product,the General Manager North Pod LATAM and the General Manager South POD LATAM

• Relationship & partnership development - Build relationships with local industry associations, integrators and channel partners who can introduce merchant opportunities; represent OKTO at relevant LATAM industry events

• Quota delivery - Consistently meet or exceed assigned new-business revenue and merchant-count targets

Requirements

Must-have

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in payments, fintech, PSP/acquiring, or iGaming in LATAM, with a demonstrable track record of closing new business

• Strong understanding of the LATAM regional payments ecosystem. The ideal candidate must be familiar with alternative payment methods (APMs), local acquiring, and regulatory contexts across key markets like Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru

• Fluent Spanish (native/business fluency) and strong working English (internal reporting, cross-regional collaboration); Portuguese is a plus

• Disciplined CRM user (Salesforce preferred) with strong pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy

• Consultative, solution-based sales style, comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, technical and compliance contacts

• Based in Buenos Aires

• Willing to travel frequently within Spanish-speaking LATAM region

Nice-to-have

• Existing relationships with iGaming operators, payment aggregators or high-risk e-commerce merchants active in LATAM

• Experience selling into regulated or high-risk verticals

• Familiarity with KYB/AML onboarding processes typical of PSPs

Please submit your CV in English

Benefits

• 💰 Competitive Compensation

• 💻 Modern Equipment

• 📈 Career Growth

• 🎓 Continuous Learning

• 🌱 Inclusive Environment

• 🏠 Work-from-home

• 🎂 Birthday leave

postings.title: Sponsorship Sales Manager
postings.descriptionText:
BRESH es una marca de entretenimiento latina que no para de crecer en el mundo, y cada vez más marcas quieren ser parte. Estamos buscando un/a Sponsorships Sales Manager para sumarse a nuestro equipo de Sponsorships LATAM en Buenos Aires y convertir ese momentum en partnerships.

Es la oportunidad de vender algo único. En BRESH no vendemos espacios publicitarios: construimos alianzas entre marcas y una de las comunidades de Gen Z y jóvenes millennials más comprometidos que existen. Cada partnership puede combinar presencia y activaciones en nuestros eventos con acciones digitales, y tiene que generar resultados de negocio reales para la marca.

Vas a sumarte a un equipo chico dentro de una marca en crecimiento, donde tu trabajo se ve desde el primer día y tiene impacto directo en el negocio. Hay espacio para aportar tus ideas, darle forma a cómo vendemos y crecer junto con la compañía.

Es un rol 100% comercial, con foco en new business. Vas a abrir puertas, construir tu propio pipeline y liderar cada oportunidad de punta a punta, desde el primer contacto hasta la firma del contrato. Una vez cerrado el deal, nuestro equipo de fulfillment toma la ejecución y desde tu lugar acompañarás el proceso para que lo vendido se haga realidad.

Buscamos a alguien con verdadero drive comercial, que disfrute el pitch y la negociación, y que entienda cómo se toman las decisiones de inversión del lado de las marcas y las agencias.

Ubicación: Buenos Aires, Argentina
Reporta a: Sponsorships Strategy Lead - Latam

QUÉ HARÁS
• Prospección y new business. Identificar marcas y agencias con potencial en toda la región, abrir nuevas puertas y construir un pipeline propio, sólido y sostenido.

• Pitch y propuestas comerciales. Presentar BRESH como la plataforma para conectar con la Gen Z, entender los objetivos de cada marca y, junto al equipo, armar propuestas a medida que combinen activaciones en eventos, presencia de marca y acciones digitales.

• Negociación y cierre. Liderar las negociaciones de punta a punta (alcance, inversión, condiciones y contrato) y cerrar deals que impulsen los objetivos de revenue del equipo.

• Relación con marcas y agencias. Construir y sostener una red de contactos con marcas directas y con agencias de medios, creativas y de experiencias, como canales clave de new business.

• Crecimiento de cuentas. Detectar oportunidades de renovación y upselling con los sponsors actuales, para que cada partnership siga creciendo en el tiempo.

• Handoff y seguimiento de la ejecución. Asegurar un traspaso claro de cada deal cerrado (lo acordado, las expectativas del cliente y los entregables) y acompañar al equipo de fulfillment para que la ejecución esté a la altura de lo vendido.

• Gestión comercial y forecast. Mantener Salesforce actualizado, proyectar el pipeline y reportar avances, cierres y aprendizajes.

• Lectura de mercado. Seguir tendencias, presupuestos y movimientos de las marcas en la región para anticipar oportunidades y proponer nuevos formatos de partnership.

QUÉ BUSCAMOS
• Más de 6 años de experiencia comprobable en venta de patrocinios, partnerships, alianzas de marca o gestión de cuentas, idealmente en entretenimiento, música, eventos, deportes o medios.

• Track record de cierres con marcas y agencias, y experiencia trabajando con objetivos de revenue.

• Red de contactos activa en marcas y agencias de la región.

• Perfil Hunter: proactividad para generar oportunidades propias, persistencia en el seguimiento y comodidad para escuchar un "no".

• Excelentes habilidades de pitch, presentación y negociación .

• Capacidad para entender el negocio del cliente y traducir sus objetivos en propuestas de valor concretas.

• Capacidad para acompañar la ejecución de los proyectos comerciales, entendiendo cómo una venta se traduce en entregables concretos para una marca, desde el kick-off hasta su correcta implementación, con alto nivel de atención al detalle.

• Experiencia con CRM, idealmente Salesforce .

• Inglés fluido , oral y escrito.

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la región y asistir a eventos con clientes.

postings.title: Business Development Lead, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About The Role

You will open the Argentine market for Caliza, land our first anchor customers, and then extend into the rest of the Southern Cone. You will own the regional revenue target and shape how Caliza grows in a market where USD access and fast payouts matter most. You will report to the Director of Business Development, work closely with the CEO, and partner with Compliance, Product, Legal, and Operations to get customers live quickly and safely.

What you'll do

• Own the Southern Cone territory. Core market: Argentina. Expansion markets: Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay. Key corridors: Southern Cone-US, Southern Cone-China and Southern Cone-Brazil

• Prioritise these target customers in each market:

• Argentina: software and service exporters, freelancer and payroll platforms, fintechs, crypto exchanges and investment platforms that need USD access and fast ARS payouts

• Chile: fintechs, PSPs and exporters (mining services, agriculture) with cross-border payables and receivables

• Uruguay: fintechs, regional headquarters and free-zone companies serving the wider region

• Paraguay: trading companies and importers paying suppliers in China and the US

• Sell USD accounts, stablecoin rails, FX and fast local-currency payouts, positioning Caliza against local FX controls, liquidity constraints and informal alternatives

• Build pipeline from scratch in Argentina, then in Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay

• Feed market insight into Product and Partnerships to shape the ARS corridor roadmap, including collections

• Use your network to source, qualify, and close new revenue-generating customers, and run full sales cycles from discovery through pricing, contract, onboarding, and first live transactions

• Negotiate commercial terms, including bps pricing, FX spreads, and volume tiers, and present with confidence using existing templates

• Keep pipeline, activity, and forecasts accurate in HubSpot, and track metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rate, time to first transaction, and monthly volume

• Work with Customer Success, Operations, and Compliance to ensure smooth handoffs, and share prospect feedback to help refine the sales process

What you'll bring

• 10+ years in sales or business development at a fintech, payments company, crypto business, or bank, ideally in Argentina or the Southern Cone

• Experience selling to software and service exporters, freelancer and payroll platforms, fintechs, crypto exchanges and importers, with a track record of hitting quota across the full sales cycle

• An existing relationship base with senior professionals in Argentine and Southern Cone fintech, payments or crypto

• A clear understanding of the value stablecoins and blockchain bring to cross-border payments

• A data-driven approach, strong negotiation and presentation skills, and excellent follow-through that never lets an opportunity slip

• Comfort working in a fast-paced, resource-constrained startup and adapting your approach to local business cultures

• Professional working fluency in Spanish and English

• Based in, or within two hours of, Buenos Aires, with the ability to overlap a few hours a day with US Eastern and Brazil time zones

Nice to have

• Prior startup experience

• Deep understanding of the Argentine fintech and crypto landscape and relevant regulations (e.g., BCRA FX rules, CNV) as they relate to closing prospects

• Proficient in Portuguese

• Experience with HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and modern AI tools (e.g. Claude)

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

Recruitment fraud. Caliza will never ask candidates for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency during the hiring process. Official communications come only from Caliza email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, please report it to our team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Account Executive, Business Development, Customer Service, Inside Sales, Sales

EST Hours Required

Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Inbound Sales Consultants to speak with property owners who are interested in professional property management services. This role is for someone who can confidently answer inbound inquiries, understand the owner’s needs, explain our services, run professional demo calls on camera, handle objections, and close qualified property owners.

You will be speaking with warm inbound leads - property owners who have already shown interest. Your job is to build trust quickly, explain the value clearly, guide the owner through the next steps, and help them move forward with Royal York Property Management.

After sign-up, you will help ensure the client experience stays organized and professional until the file is ready for the next stage.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns, you’ll receive a link to a short pre-recorded video interview shortly after applying.

What You’ll Do

• Answer inbound inquiries from property owners interested in property management services

• Qualify the owner’s needs, property details, timeline, and level of urgency

• Explain Royal York Property Management’s services clearly and professionally

• Run on-camera demo calls with prospective clients

• Present yourself professionally on video calls with property owners

• Build trust with owners and help them understand the value of professional property management

• Handle objections related to pricing, service, timing, process, and trust

• Close qualified property owners and guide them through the next steps

• Follow up consistently with owners who have not yet moved forward

• Maintain clean CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, and lead status updates

• Manage multiple active leads and client conversations at the same time
