• Coordinate internally to support a smooth client experience

• Escalate issues early when needed and protect the client experience through strong judgment

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; required for candidates without strong equivalent sales experience

• 3–5+ years of full-time experience in inbound sales, consultative sales, inside sales, account executive, client acquisition, or high-ticket service sales

• Proven ability to close warm inbound leads over the phone or through video/demo calls

• Comfortable being on camera while running professional demo calls with clients

• Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

• Experience working full-time in a professional remote environment

• Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with homeowners, property owners, business owners, or high-value prospects

• Experience running demos, presentations, consultations, or structured sales calls

• Strong objection-handling ability and confidence asking for the close

• Ability to explain services clearly and make the client feel comfortable moving forward

• High follow-up discipline and comfort working inside a structured CRM workflow

• Strong organization, task management, and documentation habits

• Ability to manage multiple leads and active conversations at the same time

• Calm, professional, and persuasive under pressure

Nice-to-Have

• SaaS, software sales, insurance sales, mortgage/lending, home services, financial services, B2B services, or high-ticket call center sales experience

• Experience selling services to homeowners, property owners, investors, landlords, or business owners

• Experience managing a client from first conversation through onboarding or handoff

• Experience in high-volume, SLA-driven, operations-heavy, or service-based environments

• Comfort using AI/tools to improve notes, follow-ups, summaries, and internal efficiency

Remote Tech Requirements

• Dual monitor setup

• Computer with 16GB RAM minimum

• 100+ Mbps reliable internet speed

• Professional, quiet remote workspace suitable for on-camera demo calls

Compensation

• Full compensation details will be shared during the interview process.

postings.title: Account Executive, Ad-Sales (Chile) - GBS
postings.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the role:
TikTok is seeking an Account Executive (what we call Brand Partnerships Manager) to support full-funnel clients in Chile. You will be based out of the Buenos Aires, Argentina office. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in cross-network performance solutions selling and a proven ability to reach and influence executive level customers to drive new business. The candidate will have operational knowledge of clients and experience dealing with executive stakeholders across Social, Video, Mobile, Digital teams. A proven track record in scaling client investment is a must.
Above all, the candidate will have an established track record of building strong relationships across key stakeholders. The role will involve working cross-functionally with members of the TikTok sales organization with the intent of onboarding priority accounts across the market. You’ll bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to building and growing long term business partnerships across Advertising Technology partners.

Responsibilities:
- Identify, prioritize, and secure business opportunities
- Drive revenue for TikTok by seeking partnerships across the territory;
- Use a consultative approach by offering strategic media solutions with all clients;
- Create compelling sales propositions utilizing internal and external data for respective regions;
- Liaise with cross-functional teams on structuring and executing operational and strategic initiatives;
- Develop and implement best practices for client interaction, sales, and services;
- Create persuasive sales presentations using market trends and case studies;
- Ensure that our advertising partners receive the highest level of sales and operational customer service;
- Educate partners on TikTok products and best practices.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 5+ years of (performance) marketing, brand advertising, media sales, and/or online advertising experience.
- Experience working with key stakeholders across the 3SA market (Spanish-Speaking-South-America)
- Proficient in Spanish and English with writing, communication and interpersonal skills
- Must be willing to work in Buenos Aires, Argentina

Preferred Qualifications:
- Expert knowledge of social media, mobile apps, and digital and mobile marketing.
- Knowledge of the self-serve platform, auction, and biddable form of digital advertising buying.
- Proven performance winning the support of key stakeholders.
- Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals.
- Ability to perform well in a highly dynamic, rapidly changing environment.
- Creative, outside-the-box thinker and strategist.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- A team player and collaborator.
- Passion for TikTok marketing, and up for the challenge of building something from the bottom up.

*In-Office Policy* - We're currently working in the office 4x a week and moving to 5x a week starting September 2026. Our office is located in Vicente Lopez and we provide flexible working hours.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

• Integridad : que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.

Principales responsabilidades

• Prospectar nuevos clientes mediante acciones comerciales outbound y contacto digital.

• Detectar oportunidades de negocio en territorio y desarrollar nuevos mercados.

• Gestionar leads y bases de potenciales clientes.

• Realizar visitas presenciales y relevamientos de las necesidades del cliente.

• Brindar asesoramiento comercial de manera consultiva.

• Elaborar y presentar propuestas comerciales.

• Gestionar negociaciones, objeciones y cierre de operaciones.

• Mantener actualizado el CRM y realizar seguimiento del pipeline comercial.

• Desarrollar y fidelizar la cartera de clientes.

• Realizar seguimiento postventa.

• Detectar oportunidades de venta cruzada y actualización de servicios.

• Cumplir con los objetivos comerciales definidos.

Requisitos

• Secundario completo (excluyente).

• Experiencia mínima de 2/3 años en posiciones comerciales, preferentemente en venta consultiva.

• Experiencia en comercialización de productos o servicios de alto valor percibido.

• Se valorará experiencia en servicios intangibles, tecnología, seguridad electrónica, telecomunicaciones, seguros, servicios financieros o inmobiliarios.

• Movilidad propia y registro de conducir vigente (excluyente).

• Manejo de herramientas CRM.

• Buen manejo de herramientas digitales y capacidad de aprendizaje de productos tecnológicos.

• Disponibilidad para realizar tareas de prospección y visitas presenciales.

Competencias

Buscamos una persona con marcado perfil comercial, iniciativa y autonomía, orientada al cumplimiento de objetivos y con capacidad para generar relaciones de confianza con los clientes.

Será importante contar con buenas habilidades de comunicación, negociación, organización, planificación, orientación al cliente y trabajo en equipo , además de tolerancia a la frustración y capacidad para desarrollar actividad comercial en calle.

Zona de trabajo Zona Norte / Oeste / CABA.

Jornada laboral lunes a viernes de 9 a 18 h, con flexibilidad de acuerdo con la agenda de clientes, y dos sábados al mes de 8 a 13 h.

Modalidad de contratación relación de dependencia.

Empresa de servicios de seguridad electrónica, líder en Zona Norte.

Ofrecemos todos los tipos de seguridad, alarmas, cercos, cámaras, controles de acceso, barrios privados. En todos los casos con opción de monitoreo.

Nos caracterizamos por la cercanía con el cliente, la calidad y calidez en la atención.

postings.title: Field Sales Representative, Public Sector, Google Cloud (English)
postings.descriptionText:
Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language. Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in quota-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a business-to-business (B2B) software company.

• Experience managing the full sales cycle (e.g., pipeline management, forecasting, reporting) and managing commercial negotiations and agreements.

• Experience building relationships with internal teams and customer stakeholders.

• Experience in a consulting sales role to the public sector, presenting proposals, and building multi-year account strategies.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently to support clients in region.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience qualifying leads and presenting the value proposition against customers’ business opportunities.

• Experience showcasing current technology trends and Google Cloud differentiators.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and partners in project implementation and negotiation.

• Experience expanding existing accounts, securing new customers, and accelerating consumption business growth. Experience working with, and leading, cross-functional teams and partners to co-sell and win together.

• Experience with agreement structuring, negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements, and supporting multi-year engagements.

• Excellent business and financial acumen, including P&L management and accurate forecasting.

About The Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Field Sales Representative (FSR) for Public Sector, you will serve as a partner to Public Sector accounts related to different public entities. You will manage account growth strategies, engaging customers with consultative value selling methodology. You will drive long-term business growth by gaining an understanding of critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions. You will lead the sales process, from initiating customer conversations to orchestrating internal and external teams to deliver business growth commitments and increased consumption. You will advocate the power of our products and solutions to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

• Develop and implement sales strategies to surpass business goals and build trusted, consultative relationships with customers.

• Leverage emerging technology trends, market analysis, and knowledge of cloud solutions to showcase how Google Cloud can transform customers' business.

• Manage and track the sales pipeline, from lead to close, ensuring health and accurate forecasting for clear visibility into expected outcomes.

• Manage complex, multi-year agreements and formulate persuasive proposals that illustrate clear return on investment through customer business cases and comprehensive deployment plans.

• Mobilize internal experts (Customer Engineering, Partner, Post-Sales) and external partners at the right time to drive consumption and deliver a seamless customer experience.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

postings.title: Account Executive Sr
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

¡Sumate a nuestro equipo en PedidosYa Argentina!

Tenemos una oportunidad para vos, estamos buscando Account Executive Sr para nuestro Equipo Comercial de Food con base en Rosario.

• Responsabilidad por la gestión comercial de postventa, mantenimiento y fidelización de las cuentas a cargo, generando relaciones a largo plazo.

• Negociacion de condiciones comerciales y facturación.

• Gestión de la inversión en promociones y publicidad de la cartera a cargo

• Análisis y seguimiento de la performance de los partners.

• Asegurar el correcto funcionamiento operativo y el entrenamiento de nuestros partners en las herramientas disponibles en la app, teniendo en cuenta el impacto en la experiencia del usuario.

Requisitos

• Residir en Rosario

• Experiencia comercial en generación y gestión de carteras de clientes y cuentas.

• Perfil analítico, con buen entendimiento del negocio, experiencia en seguimiento de indicadores y orientación a la toma de decisiones basada en datos.

• Capacidad de planificación, organización, autonomía y orientación a resultados.

• Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de trabajo en equipo.

• Deseable conocimientos en Marketing y manejo de indicadores de Marketing Digital (CPO, CPA, CPC, ratios de conversión).

• Dominio de G-suit y MS Office.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

postings.title: Representante técnico de ventas
postings.descriptionText:
¡Hola! Estamos contentos con tu interés en nuestras oportunidades.
En ArcelorMittal creemos que la elección de carrera va más allá del puesto, se trata de formar parte de un entorno que valora a las personas, promueve el desarrollo continuo y, sobre todo, sitúa la Seguridad como un valor innegociable en todas las decisiones.
A continuación, encontrarás más detalles sobre ArcelorMittal, la oportunidad, lo que ofrecemos y qué buscamos en las personas que quieren construir este camino con nosotros.

Quiénes somos

Somos ArcelorMittal, el mayor productor de acero, una empresa global que opera con el propósito de producir aceros más inteligentes para las personas y el planeta.
Somos una organización que evoluciona continuamente, impulsada por las personas, la innovación y la búsqueda constante de soluciones más eficientes y sostenibles. ArcelorMittal es una de las principales empresas integradas de acero y minería del mundo, con operaciones en 60 países. Con más de 125.000 empleados en todo el mundo, atendemos a clientes de diversos sectores, como la industria automotriz, la construcción, la energía y la ingeniería.
Nuestros productos forman parte de la vida cotidiana, teniendo un impacto positivo en las personas, las comunidades y la sociedad.
En nuestra cultura, las personas están en el centro de todo lo que hacemos ,por eso la Seguridad, es nuestro valor fundamental, guía nuestras acciones, decisiones y la forma en que trabajamos cada día.

Formar parte de ArcelorMittal es formar parte de un entorno en constante transformación, donde:

• La seguridad y el cuidado de las personas siempre van primero

• La innovación y la tecnología se aplican para generar valor de forma responsable

• El aprendizaje es continuo, con retos reales y oportunidades de crecimiento

• La diversidad de perspectivas fortalece nuestras decisiones y resultados

Buscamos personas que quieran evolucionar junto con la empresa, contribuyendo de manera responsable, colaborativa y comprometida hacia resultados sostenibles.

• Serás responsable de:

• Gestionar y desarrollar una cartera de clientes B2B, potenciando nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Liderar negociaciones comerciales, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, rentabilidad y cobranzas.

• Analizar información comercial, tendencias de mercado e indicadores para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y mejorar la rentabilidad.

• Trabajar de manera articulada con diferentes áreas internas para garantizar un servicio de excelencia y una gestión comercial integral.

• Brindar asesoramiento técnico-comercial, agregando valor en cada interacción con el cliente.

• Representar a la compañía en reuniones, visitas comerciales y eventos del sector.

Asegúrate de que las actividades en tu zona estén alineadas con los requisitos de Salud y Seguridad.
Conoce y cumple con las reglas de oro y requisitos de los FPS

Requisitos mínimos:

Más de 5 años de experiencia en posiciones comerciales B2B, preferentemente en empresas vinculadas a la construcción, industria, materiales, o rubros afines.
• Experiencia en desarrollo de negocios, negociación comercial y gestión de cuentas estratégicas.
• Capacidad analítica para interpretar información comercial, definir estrategias de precios y contribuir a la toma de decisiones.
• Perfil autónomo, proactivo, con iniciativa, resiliencia y fuerte orientación a resultados.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y relacionamiento interpersonal.
• Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Arquitectura, Administración o carreras afines (deseable).
• Movilidad propia y disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes ( excluyente)
Beneficios

En ArcelorMittal, cuidamos de las personas de forma integral, promoviendo la salud, el bienestar, la seguridad y la calidad de vida para ti y tu familia.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre
🩺 Cobertura médica premium para vos y tu familia
🏖 Vacaciones adicionales
🚐 Transporte a planta
🍽 Comedor subsidiado
📚 Formación continua + becas para hijos/as
🍼 Licencias parentales extendidas y apoyo por guardería
🎁 Beneficios corporativos y descuentos exclusivos

¿Cómo funciona nuestro proceso de selección?
Nuestro proceso de selección se lleva a cabo de manera estructurada, transparente y respetuosa, teniendo en cuenta tanto los aspectos técnicos como la adhesión a nuestra cultura.
A lo largo del camino, buscamos conocer no solo tus experiencias, sino también cómo conectas con entornos que valoran:

• Seguridad

• Cuidado colectivo

• Responsabilidad en las decisiones

Este es el primer paso del proceso. A medida que avanza, los otros pasos incluyen entrevistas con el equipo de Personas y la dirección, así como evaluaciones complementarias.

Estamos muy contentos con tu interés en unirte a nuestro #Equipo y esperamos recibir tu solicitud. Para saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestras redes sociales.
¡Nos vemos pronto!
#ArcelorMittal

postings.title: Vendedor de Servicios - Recapturas
postings.descriptionText:
Date Posted:

2026-10-09

Country:

Argentina

Location:

ARG02 : Chiclana 3345, CABA, BUENOS AIRES

Generalidades del puesto

En OTIS , buscamos un Vendedor de Servicios - Recapturas que impulse el crecimiento de nuestro portafolio de mantenimiento mediante la recuperación de contratos actualmente gestionados por la competencia. Esta posición tiene un rol clave en la generación de nuevos negocios, el desarrollo de relaciones comerciales estratégicas y la expansión de nuestra presencia en el mercado.

Buscamos profesionales con un fuerte perfil comercial, orientación a resultados y experiencia en prospección y desarrollo de clientes.

Ubicación de labores: CABA, Argentina

En un día normal tendrás que:

• Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en edificios, condominios, constructoras y empresas administradoras.

• Realizar prospección activa mediante llamadas, visitas presenciales y contactos estratégicos.

• Construir y fortalecer relaciones con clientes potenciales y actuales.

• Elaborar y presentar propuestas comerciales adaptadas a las necesidades de cada cliente.

• Liderar negociaciones y acompañar el proceso comercial hasta el cierre de contrato.

• Gestionar y actualizar oportunidades en CRM, asegurando el seguimiento adecuado del pipeline.

• Coordinar con equipos internos para garantizar una implementación exitosa de los contratos recuperados.

Lo que necesitas para tener éxito:

• Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Administración, Marketing, Economía o carreras afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en ventas consultivas, desarrollo de negocios o roles comerciales similares.

• Experiencia en prospección activa, generación de clientes y apertura de mercado.

• Habilidades de negociación, comunicación y manejo de relaciones comerciales.

• Orientación a resultados y capacidad para gestionar múltiples oportunidades de negocio.

• Manejo de herramientas CRM será valorado.

Será un plus si cuentas con:

• Experiencia en ventas técnicas o industriales.

• Experiencia en servicios financieros, seguros o soluciones complejas B2B.

• Conocimiento del sector de mantenimiento, construcción, infraestructura o servicios.

#BuildWhatsNext

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge. 

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do. If you would like to learn more about environmental, social and governance (ESG) at Otis click here.

Become a part of the Otis team and help us #Buildwhatsnext!

Otis is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other protected class according to applicable law. To request an accommodation in completing an employment application due to a special need or a disability, please contact us at careers@otis.com.

postings.title: Direct Sales Manager (UHNWI)
postings.descriptionText:
The Direct Sales Executive will acquire and develop ultra-high-net-worth individual (UHNWI) relationships through a high-trust, high-touch commercial approach. The role is responsible for building a qualified pipeline, converting prospects through a premium consultative process, and coordinating a personalized onboarding experience in close partnership with internal onboarding and compliance teams. Success requires deep product and objection handling training, disciplined pipeline execution and immediate qualification and closing skills (prospects are often a one-shot opportunity).

Benefits of working at Insignia
You will operate in a dynamic, premium environment at the pinnacle of luxury banking and concierge experience worldwide, backed by more than 30 years of expertise. The role offers unique access to ultra-high-net-worth networks, including exclusive events and venues where relationships are built at the highest level. At Insignia, ambition is matched by execution—our mindset is captured in a simple promise we live by every day: “Yes to impossible.”

Key responsibilities

• Develop and execute a pipeline plan with clear weekly activity and conversion targets.

• Source qualified prospects through trusted networks, introducers, strategic partners, and high-calibre events.

• Enable premium discovery meetings to diagnose needs (privacy, service expectations, lifestyle, and financial preferences) and qualify fit.

• Present Insignia’s value proposition credibly and consistently, tailored to the client’s context, without discounting premium positioning.

• Manage objections with composure (fees, privacy, onboarding requirements, ‘why Insignia’ comparisons) and progress deals to decision.

• Coordinate onboarding with internal stakeholders, ensuring a seamless, compliant client experience.

• Maintain excellent CRM hygiene: accurate updates, follow-ups, and reporting cadence.

• Protect brand integrity through disciplined qualification, ethical conduct, and confidentiality at all times.

Qualifications and experience

• Proven sales track record in premium, relationship-led environments (e.g., private banking, luxury services, UHNW advisory, premium membership models). Experience within the luxury sector and exposure to HNW/UHNW clients are preferred, with relevant backgrounds including luxury fashion, automotive, hospitality, food and beverage, and luxury real estate. Profiles from football, gaming, and crypto/digital assets are also highly relevant.

• Demonstrated ability to source leads through trusted networks and introducers; comfort operating in an invitation-led context. Strong ability to use an established network to build high-value relationships and generate new business opportunities across LATAM is essential.

• Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to create tailored proposals and deliver polished presentations.

• Comfort working with structured processes (CRM, pipeline stages, reporting cadence) in a target-driven environment.

• High integrity, discretion, and professionalism; able to operate confidently with senior stakeholders and demanding clients.

• Fluent Spanish is essential. Portuguese is highly desirable, particularly for the Brazilian market. A good working level of English is sufficient;

• Candidates may be based in Spain, LATAM or elsewhere, provided they are able to travel to Spain when required.

• Strong connections to the new generation of wealth in LATAM are particularly desirable, including entrepreneurs, business owners, athletes, and individuals from the digital, gaming and crypto ecosystems, with access to self-made HNW/UHNW individuals and emerging wealth.

Working style and mindset

• Client-first, service-oriented approach with premium standards.

• Calm under pressure; resilient and tactful with strong personalities.

• Collaborative and proactive across functions (sales, compliance, ops, concierge, leadership).

• Disciplined follow-through: closes loops, meets commitments, and communicates clearly.

postings.title: Programmatic Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Aleph is seeking a strategic, high-energy Programmatic Specialist to represent Spotify across the LATAM region. You don't need to be a hands-on trafficker or optimizer, but you do need to speak the language of DSPs, SSPs, and Ad Exchanges fluently enough to sell with real credibility, handle objections, and guide agencies through the offering.

What You'll Do

• Own revenue targets and pipeline growth for Spotify's programmatic solutions (self-serve, PMPs, always-on activations) across LATAM markets.

• Proactively prospect and identify new opportunities, and unblock stalled ones within agencies and brands — finding the right internal contact, the right angle, and the right moment to move a deal forward.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with agency programmatic desks, buying, strategy, and digital teams across multiple markets — know how agencies are structured internally and how to navigate them.

• Evangelize Spotify's programmatic offering to agencies and clients, driving upsell and always-on activations, and supporting partners with any questions along the way.

• Translate campaign performance data into insights and business narratives that resonate with clients at a strategic level.

• Train and mentor sales team members on programmatic positioning and talking points.

• Stay current on programmatic trends, self-serve platform dynamics, and industry best practices to keep pitches sharp and relevant.

• Represent Spotify/Aleph at industry events, building market presence across the region.

• Work with third-party vendors and partners to strengthen the offering, and coordinate with internal specialist/operations teams to ensure smooth execution once a deal is won.

What You Need For This Role

• 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, business development, or account management within programmatic/digital advertising.

• Solid working knowledge of programmatic fundamentals: DSPs, SSPs, Ad Exchanges, and self-serve platforms — enough to sell and defend the offering with authority, even if you're not the one operating it day to day.

• Proven track record building agency/client relationships and driving revenue growth across LATAM markets (regional exposure strongly preferred).

• Strong understanding of agency internal structures and dynamics — you know who to talk to and how to get in the door.

• Comfort with data at a consumption level: able to read dashboards and performance reports and turn them into a compelling client story (Salesforce, Sheets/Slides, Excel).

• A genuinely commercial mindset — you love prospecting, relationship-building, and closing; programmatic is your specialty, not just a technical checkbox.

• Exceptional storytelling, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable holding a room at C-suite level.

• Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English.

What Will Make Us Really Love You

• Commercial Drive — You love the chase: prospecting, unblocking, closing.

• Enough Data Fluency to Sell — You can read a dashboard and turn it into a story, even if you're not the one building it.

• Adaptability — Comfortable moving between a strategic C-suite pitch and a technical programmatic conversation in the same day.

• AI-Curious by Default — When a new tool shows up, you test it and fold it into how you sell — briefs, pipeline signals, prospecting — rather than just tolerating it.

• Passion for music, audio culture, or the creator economy — You get why audio matters to brands and to people, and that shows up in how you pitch.

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. BeOne Medicines is seeking a proactive, self-managed and solution-oriented Sales Representative / Key Account Manager to join its Oncology and Hematology team in Argentina, at a time of strong company growth and portfolio expansion.

This is a dual role that combines medical promotion to healthcare professionals with key account management (wholesalers and payers). Medical promotion will be the main day-to-day focus.

The position covers Buenos Aires City (CABA) and Greater Buenos Aires (GBA), including field trips to other provinces of Argentina.

Essential Function

• Promote the company’s products to healthcare professionals, with in-depth knowledge of the products and associated diseases, within the applicable regulatory framework and BeOne compliance policies.

• Manage and develop relationships with key accounts, including wholesalers and payers.

• Segment physicians and payers, and implement effective negotiation strategies.

• Identify and analyze market needs to adapt quickly to changes in the healthcare environment.

• Collaborate closely with the commercial and medical teams to develop effective and sustainable sales strategies.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the company CRM.

• Self-manage the agenda and field trips, including travel arrangements (flights and accommodation) and the administrative tasks associated with the role, without dedicated administrative support.

Minimum Requirements – Education And Experience

Valid Medical Sales Representative license (Matrícula de Agente de Propaganda Médica – APM), required.

University degree in Health Sciences, Business or a related field, preferred.

Minimum of 3 years of related experience in Oncology & Hematology

postings.descriptionText:
Enterprise selling has always been part science, part art. The data told you where to look, but closing still came down to instinct honed over years. AI changes that.

You've already made AI your unfair advantage. It's shortened your cycles, sharpened your pitch, and put deals on the board your peers are still chasing. At IgniteTech, our sellers win because they've rewired how they sell around AI; how they research an account, qualify it, handle objections in-flight, shape a proposal, and negotiate the close.

This is the role where you get to run that playbook at full speed on a warm book across our portfolio of enterprise products and set the bar for what an AI-driven closer looks like industry-wide.

What you will be doing

• AI-Driven Selling: Walk into every call with an edge most reps still dream about: instant read on the customer, tailored angles, live objection handling, next-best action already in your head before they ask. This is what selling looks like when AI does the prep and you do the winning.

• Deal Intelligence That Actually Moves Deals: Prioritize your book the way top closers wish they could; scoring every opportunity in real time on size, momentum, and strategic fit, so your calendar always points at the deals that move.

• See the Market Before It Turns: Read where demand, competitors, and buyer behavior are heading and get in front of it, turning market shifts into pipeline while other sellers are still reacting to them.

• Set the Bar: Prove what an AI-driven closer looks like at the top of the profession, as part of an AI-first organization.

What you will NOT be doing

• Running sales the old-fashioned way — gut-feel prioritization, static spreadsheets, and no predictive support.

• Grinding through cold lists or chasing prospects who were never going to buy. Every opportunity you touch is warm.

• Handing pipeline off the moment it gets interesting. You own the commercial close, not just the intro.

• Waiting on ops, marketing, or enablement for the brief, the battlecard, or the first draft of the proposal.

Responsibilities

• Deliver quota. Consistently close new, expansion, and cross-sell bookings across the IgniteTech portfolio, quarter after quarter.

• Compress the cycle. Shorten time-from-qualified-to-signed by running an AI-driven selling motion the rest of the industry hasn't caught up to yet.

• Sell the whole portfolio, not a corner of it. Grow deal size and product breadth on the accounts you touch.

• Translate complex AI capabilities into decisions non-technical sales stakeholders can act on.

Requirements

• At least 3 years of experience in B2B enterprise software sales, with a track record of managing and closing complex deals.

• Hands-on professional experience applying GenAI/LLM tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) to real business problems, not just familiarity with them.

• Strong grasp of sales strategy, customer journey mapping, and market dynamics.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to explain AI concepts and persuade non-technical stakeholders.

What you will learn

• You'll deepen your hands-on expertise applying generative AI to live, high-stakes sales environments — not lab experiments.

• You'll sharpen an edge you've already built. Close across every major software vertical at a volume most enterprise sellers never see. Push your AI-driven selling system further alongside peers doing the same, and walk away setting the ceiling for what an AI-first closer looks like."

About the Company

We are a team of over 200 professionals dedicated to creating innovative tech solutions for businesses. Responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and advance opportunities across the company's three product lines (policy administration, claims management, and compliance monitoring) through the full commercial pipeline.
Generate demand through outbound prospecting (email, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and active participation in industry conferences.
Own the RFI/RFP response process: coordinate internal contributors, gather required documentation, and deliver the final package on time.
Lead discovery calls and product demos tailored to each prospect's use case.
Build quotes, negotiate commercial terms, and manage deal closing.
Support the handoff to the implementation team, ensuring continuity between the sale and onboarding.
Serve as the commercial point of contact for closed accounts, identifying growth and renewal opportunities.
Represent the company at industry conferences in the U.S. (booth coverage, scheduled meetings, networking).
Keep the CRM up to date on deal status and report pipeline health in regular sales cadences.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Marketing to keep the sales process moving.

Requirements:

Must-haves

Professional business English (all client interactions, demos, and RFPs are conducted in English, with owner/CEO/management-level counterparts in the U.S.)
Long-cycle B2B sales experience, able to sustain multi-month processes with multiple decision-makers.
Knowledge of the insurance market: workers' compensation, claims management, policy administration, and the role of TPAs, self-insurance funds, and captives.
Ability to sell into two distinct buyer markets, each with its own pitch and sales cycle.
Autonomy to work without daily supervision, coordinating with clients in a different country and time zone.
CRM discipline and comfort managing a high volume of contacts and opportunities.
Willingness to travel (4–6 U.S. conferences per year, including booth duty).

Nice-to-haves

Prior experience selling software to the insurance industry.
Familiarity with vendor/subcontractor certificate of insurance (COI) compliance processes.
Experience coordinating RFI/RFP responses with technical teams.
Comfort delivering product demos to full client teams.
An existing network of contacts in the industry conference circuit.

What We Offer
Join a company with over 20 years of experience, offering a competitive salary in USD and the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in the world. We provide ongoing training, professional development, and a collaborative work environment. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, international projects. Additionally, we offer flexible PTO, extended parental leave, and an attractive hiring bonus.

Description

You’re organised, customer-focused and technically curious.

This position supports the day-to-day coordination of assigned projects for digital products used in clinical trials and related healthcare and medical communications initiatives, including our proprietary clinical SaaS solution, Virtual Interactive Protocol (VIPro). The account executive works with guidance from an account lead and supports project delivery, customer communications, financial administration, and organic growth activities. The account executive works closely with sponsors, study teams, and cross-functional clinical, operational, product, and technology stakeholders to support successful implementation, adoption, and study delivery.

Client Management

• Support customer communications, meetings and follow-up for assigned projects, including work with sponsors and study teams.

• Prepare for and participate in client touchpoints, communicate project status, document next steps and complete agreed follow-up.

• Escalate project risks, issues and client concerns to the account lead as appropriate.

Project Management

• Coordinate assigned project activities and deliver work reliably with guidance from an account lead.

• Develop and maintain project timelines, action plans and meeting materials; track risks, issues, actions and deliverables, escalating concerns to the account lead when appropriate.

• Support demonstrations, solution reviews and implementation planning for internal and external customers.

Financial Management

• Support project administration and financial tracking with guidance from the account lead.

• Support project estimates, statements of work, budget tracking and related project communications.

• Review project utilization information and flag potential scope or budget changes to the account lead.

Business Development

• Support proposal development, new business presentations, demonstrations and other customer-facing materials for existing and prospective clients.

• Identify and share opportunities to improve or expand digital products and related service offerings.

Business and Product Knowledge

• Develop knowledge of medical communications, clinical research operations, clinical trial workflows and the needs of sponsors, study teams and healthcare communications stakeholders.

• Develop an understanding of regulated environments and the importance of following client requirements, technical specifications, quality standards and internal processes.

• Build working knowledge of the organization’s digital product capabilities, service offerings, assigned studies, protocols and implementation requirements.

Qualifications And Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, communications, business or technology, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• At least two years’ professional experience within a service industry, ideally involving project coordination, account support, customer service, healthcare, technology or another relevant environment.

• Clinical trial experience and familiarity with how studies are planned, initiated, conducted, monitored or supported are helpful but not required.

• Experience coordinating activities across teams in a service, healthcare, technology or regulated environment.

• Interest in digital products and technology, with an aptitude for developing knowledge of product-development processes.

• Familiarity with AI tools and their use in content, operational or delivery workflows is preferred.

• Working knowledge of project management and collaboration platforms, such as Wrike, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Salesforce or comparable business systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

• Ability to organize and prioritize assigned work across multiple projects and timelines, work independently and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and attention to detail.

At Cadent, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Cadent is a US Medical Communications company with employees located across the US. The home office is in New York City. Cadent specializes in high science, high touch peer to peer medical communications. The company excels in translating complex science into compelling messages that deliver value and action. Cadent builds relationships and collaboration between the biopharmaceutical industry and healthcare professionals.

postings.descriptionText:
Account Executive, Business Development, Customer Service, Inside Sales, Sales

EST Hours Required

Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Inbound Sales Consultants to speak with property owners who are interested in professional property management services. This role is for someone who can confidently answer inbound inquiries, understand the owner’s needs, explain our services, run professional demo calls on camera, handle objections, and close qualified property owners.

You will be speaking with warm inbound leads - property owners who have already shown interest. Your job is to build trust quickly, explain the value clearly, guide the owner through the next steps, and help them move forward with Royal York Property Management.

After sign-up, you will help ensure the client experience stays organized and professional until the file is ready for the next stage.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns, you’ll receive a link to a short pre-recorded video interview shortly after applying.

What You’ll Do

• Answer inbound inquiries from property owners interested in property management services

• Qualify the owner’s needs, property details, timeline, and level of urgency

• Explain Royal York Property Management’s services clearly and professionally

• Run on-camera demo calls with prospective clients

• Present yourself professionally on video calls with property owners

• Build trust with owners and help them understand the value of professional property management

• Handle objections related to pricing, service, timing, process, and trust

• Close qualified property owners and guide them through the next steps

• Follow up consistently with owners who have not yet moved forward

• Maintain clean CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, and lead status updates

• Manage multiple active leads and client conversations at the same time

• Identify stalled opportunities, missed follow-ups, owner concerns, and delays

• Coordinate internally to support a smooth client experience

• Escalate issues early when needed and protect the client experience through strong judgment

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; required for candidates without strong equivalent sales experience

• 3–5+ years of full-time experience in inbound sales, consultative sales, inside sales, account executive, client acquisition, or high-ticket service sales

• Proven ability to close warm inbound leads over the phone or through video/demo calls

• Comfortable being on camera while running professional demo calls with clients

• Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written

• Experience working full-time in a professional remote environment

• Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with homeowners, property owners, business owners, or high-value prospects

• Experience running demos, presentations, consultations, or structured sales calls

• Strong objection-handling ability and confidence asking for the close

• Ability to explain services clearly and make the client feel comfortable moving forward

• High follow-up discipline and comfort working inside a structured CRM workflow

• Strong organization, task management, and documentation habits

• Ability to manage multiple leads and active conversations at the same time

• Calm, professional, and persuasive under pressure

Nice-to-Have

• SaaS, software sales, insurance sales, mortgage/lending, home services, financial services, B2B services, or high-ticket call center sales experience

• Real estate, leasing, property management, or housing-related experience

• Experience selling services to homeowners, property owners, investors, landlords, or business owners

• Experience managing a client from first conversation through onboarding or handoff

• Experience in high-volume, SLA-driven, operations-heavy, or service-based environments

• Comfort using AI/tools to improve notes, follow-ups, summaries, and internal efficiency

Remote Tech Requirements

• Dual monitor setup

• Computer with 16GB RAM minimum

• 100+ Mbps reliable internet speed

• Webcam

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Professional, quiet remote workspace suitable for on-camera demo calls

Compensation

• This role offers base pay plus commissions.

• Full compensation details will be shared during the interview process.

postings.title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD) - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.

We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates

• Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions

• Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs

• Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets

• Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system

• Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction

• Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners

Key Requirements

• Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage

• Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

• Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines

• Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage

• Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities

• Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals

• Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses

• Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies

• Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment

• Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies

• Flexible working arrangement

If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

postings.title: Business Development Representative Sr
postings.descriptionText:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We Are Proud Of

• The work we do and the innovation we drive

• Our values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Business Development Representative Sr , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 5+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

• A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo

• A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing

• Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data

• Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

• Responsible for developing accounts in large customers, recognizing business needs and designing the solution, generating benefits for the customer's business and for Valtech.

• Will collaborate with the Growth and Strategy team, so that the company's OKRs are achieved and exceeded.

• Use Valtech's services to build and present solutions tailored to the client's needs, through critical thinking, research and analysis.

• Lead and collaborate with the development of go to market strategy.

• Deeply understand customers to intimately articulate (through primary and secondary research) the customer's business goals and key performance indicators.

• Lead and conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis to produce value models and revenue-generating insights that positively impact and drive the client's business.

• Will need to have a up-to-date portfolio of clients and prospects.

• Identifying opportunities and routing them to specialized teams.

• Scheduling meetings and presenting services.

• Build solutions and proposals focused on results for the client, using web and data analytics to measure results and ROI (must).

• Tracking Client NPS and Crisis Management.

• Understanding customer needs and developing solutions using AI.

• Write and present experience debriefs, gap analysis, competitive assessments, customer journeys to provide solutions to support key marketing initiatives.

• Work on approaches and produce solutions supported by research and trends.

• Identify the trends and technologies that shape the future of consumer behavior and be able to understand how these trends may influence future consumer behavior.

Must Have Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

• More than 5 years of experience in digital agency or digital marketing and technology consulting.

• Autonomy in developing technical and commercial proposals.

• Proven track record for conducting senior level interviews and facilitating group discussions/work sessions.

• Excellent interpersonal skills are required, with the ability to write briefly while being engaging.

• Experience using AI in everyday tasks (Claude and Copilot minimun).

• Use of tools (Salesforce, Sales Navigator).

• PowerPoint presentations. Domain of the business structure.

• Advanced Spanish skills.

• Advanced English skills.

• Problem solving and analytical thinking.

• Interpersonal and managerial skills.

• Facilitation and observation skills.

• Analytical and investigative skills.

• Ability to understand (and break down) the big picture of a problem.

• Good command of spoken and written communication.

• Organization skills.

• Availability to travel.

Nice To Have Qualifications

• Solid knowledge of data and process modeling (plus).

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The Benefits

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

postings.title: BDR - Enterprise Strategic Accounts
postings.descriptionText:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Development Representative to our Sales Development team in Buenos Aires !

The Business Development Representative II drives pipeline growth and new business generation within an assigned prospecting territory with a high level of autonomy. This role manages the end-to-end outbound and inbound cycle, running deep qualifying and discovery-level conversations to uncover strategic corporate pain points, map decision-makers, and communicate complex value propositions compellingly. Beyond consistently achieving monthly qualified-meeting quotas and maintaining rigorous CRM, the Representative analyzes personal performance data to inform short-term territory planning and to propose optimization strategies for the broader team's outreach cadences.

YOUR IMPACT

• Own a prospecting territory within the ICP universe: build account lists owned by SOPs, prioritize by strategic fit, and run high-quality outbound sequences independently.

• Qualify accounts at depth: validate company HR challenges, decision-maker map, timing, and budget potential before booking the AE meeting.

• Conduct discovery-level conversations to surface corporate wellness pain points and position Wellhub's value proposition compellingly.

• Maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce: accurate contact records, opportunity stage, and activity logs at all times.

• Consistently achieve monthly qualified-meeting quota and contribute to team pipeline goal. Identify and propose improvements to outbound cadences or ICP targeting based on personal prospecting data; share winning approaches with the team.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Who You Are

• 3+ years of experience in outbound prospecting, business development, or sales for large/complex Strategic accounts.

• Previous experience with CRM & sales-engagement tools (Salesforce, Salesloft/Outreach); comfort directing AI-assisted outreach; LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Experience with the Argentinian and Latam Market.

• Fluent English — you’ll interact with global teams and resources.

• A true team player who loves collaborating to reach ambitious goals.

• Organized and self-motivated — you can handle multiple priorities in a fast-growing organization.

• Coachable, curious, and always seeking to learn and improve.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore whether you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in outbound prospecting and with sales tech stack like CRM, AI, and Sales Navigator are mandatory requirements .

What We Offer You

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our Benefits Include

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office equipment reimbursement and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days off per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!

This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

You are genuinely excited about continuous learning and are looking for long-term commitment and stability. Job Description:
A Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities through proactive outreach and strategic prospecting efforts. This role focuses on expanding the company’s client base by building relationships with decision-makers and qualifying opportunities for the sales team. The ideal candidate is results-driven, organized, and comfortable managing structured outreach initiatives in a remote environment. While your duties will depend on the specific needs of your client, they will include, but not be limited to:

• Identify target industries, companies, and decision-makers aligned with the company’s growth strategy and ideal customer profile.

• Execute outbound outreach campaigns through phone calls, email sequences, LinkedIn engagement, and other approved prospecting channels

• Qualify prospects by understanding their business challenges, needs, budget, and decisionmaking process

• Build and nurture relationships with potential clients through consistent follow-up and value-driven communication.

• Schedule qualified discovery meetings and transfer opportunities to Account Executives with proper documentation and context

• Maintain accurate and detailed records of prospect interactions, pipeline status, and followup actions within CRM systems

• Track outreach performance metrics including connection rates, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline contribution

• Collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine targeting strategies and improve campaign effectiveness

Requirements:

• 2+ years of experience in business development, outbound sales, or prospecting roles.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

• Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools.

• Ability to meet outreach and pipeline generation targets consistently

Technical Requirements

• Processor: Intel 11th Gen (or equivalent AMD Ryzen 5000 series) for Windows users and M2 for Macs

• RAM: 16 GB minimum

• 25 - 50 Mbps Internet Speed (Min)

Please note that devices such as MacBook Neos and Chromebooks are not fit for our roles .

Benefits
Compensation & Growth
At WorkBetterNow, we believe in rewarding commitment and supporting long-term success. Our pay structure ensures your compensation evolves with your experience and tenure. Note: The figures below reflect our 2026 ranges; each tenure milestone will increase each year.

• 0-3 months: $1,200 USD/month

• After 3 months: You’ll receive a $50 monthly Wellness Bonus to support a healthy and balanced work life (total: $1,250/month).

• After 1 year: Salary increases to $1,340 USD/month

• After 2 years: Salary increases to $1,480 USD/month

• After 3 years: Salary increases to $1,540 USD/month

• After 4 years: Salary increases to $1,600 USD/month

• Two Annual Adjustments: Every year, you benefit from two salary increases: one on your work anniversary, recognizing your continued tenure with WorkBetterNow, and one at the start of each calendar year, when all salary ranges are updated company-wide.

Benefits & Perks

• 100% remote work — enjoy the comfort and flexibility of working from home

• 18 paid vacation days + U.S. federal holidays

P&L y estrategia comercial

Desarrollo de negocios y alianzas

• Trabajar con el equipo de Alianzas Estratégicas para identificar potenciales clientes y socios por país, y posteriormente colaborar de manera directa con los equipos de BizDev y Sales.
