postings.title: Business Development Representative
postings.descriptionText:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

What This Role Is All About

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will focus on outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across assigned regions and industries. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Business Development Lead and a key entry point into Infobip’s commercial organization, designed to prepare you for future growth into Mid-Market or Tier 1 customer-facing roles.

What You’ll Do

• Execute outbound prospecting across target accounts, industries, and regions

• Engage prospects via email, phone, LinkedIn, and digital outreach channels

• Research accounts, stakeholders, and buying personas to identify opportunities

• Generate qualified meetings and sales opportunities for Account Executives

• Collaborate with Regional Sales and Customer Facing teams on pipeline initiatives

• Maintain and execute outreach sequences using approved tools and methodologies

• Use prospecting and research tools to enrich and validate account data

• Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce and outreach platforms

• Follow qualification standards and outreach best practices to ensure pipeline quality

• Leverage AI tools and automation to improve research, outreach, and productivity

• Continuously learn Infobip products, solutions, and customer use cases

What Makes You a Strong Fit

• Interest in sales, business development, or B2B tech environments

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Comfortable with targets, structured processes, and outbound activity

• Curious, coachable, and motivated to grow within a commercial career path

• Organized, data-driven, and detail-oriented

• Fluent English, spoken and written

Why you'll love it here

• Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.

• Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.

• ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.

• Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.

• Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. 

• Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.

• International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

postings.title: Sales Director Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales to lead and grow our commercial strategy at Futbol Sites .

This is a leadership position for a senior professional with a strong network and proven track record in digital media advertising . The ideal candidate combines deep market knowledge with strong commercial expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to build long-term relationships with advertisers, agencies, brands, and strategic partners.

Based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for leading your team to drive revenue growth across the market, developing new business opportunities, strengthening key client relationships, and leading a high-performing sales team. You will play a key role in positioning Futbol Sites as a leading sports media partner and identifying new opportunities across the evolving digital advertising ecosystem.

What You'll Do Commercial Leadership & Strategy

• Instill a partnership-first mindset across the team, coaching reps to prioritize long-term relationship depth and strategic account growth over transactional, campaign-by-campaign selling.

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the market, aligned with Futbol Sites' regional and global objectives.

• Identify new revenue opportunities across digital media, sports, football, branded content, programmatic, sponsorships, and other relevant commercial solutions.

• Develop and maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics, advertiser needs, agency structures, competitors, and emerging digital media trends.

• Contribute to the evolution of Futbol Sites' commercial offering and go-to-market strategy.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop the commercial team, setting clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.

• Build a high-performing, collaborative, and results-oriented sales culture.

• Support team members in developing strategic accounts, closing complex opportunities, and expanding existing business.

• Monitor team performance, pipeline development, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities, processes, and commercial best practices across the team.

Business Development & Sales

• Lead the identification and acquisition of new clients, advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and the sports ecosystem.

• Personally manage and develop strategic and high-value accounts.

• Lead major commercial pitches, negotiations, and partnership discussions.

• Develop innovative and customized commercial proposals that combine Futbol Sites' digital media assets, audience, content, and sports expertise.

• Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and business growth targets.

Market & Industry Leadership

• Maintain a strong network and active presence within the digital media, advertising, sports, and fútbol industries .

• Represent Futbol Sites at relevant industry events, meetings, conferences, and client activities.

• Stay ahead of changes in digital advertising, media consumption, audience behavior, sports marketing, and competitive offerings.

• Bring market intelligence and new commercial ideas into the organization.

• Identify opportunities to position Futbol Sites at the forefront of the digital sports media ecosystem.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Marketing, Content, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Programmatic, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of commercial initiatives.

• Partner with regional and global stakeholders to share market insights and identify opportunities across Argentina

• Ensure that client expectations and commercial commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered.

What We're Looking For

• Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and developing commercial or sales teams, preferably within digital media, advertising, sports, or technology companies.

• Industry Expertise: Strong background in the digital media and advertising industry , with a solid understanding of the sports and/or fútbol ecosystem.

• Commercial Track Record: Demonstrated success in developing new business, managing strategic accounts, negotiating complex deals, and consistently achieving revenue targets.

• Industry Network: Established relationships with advertisers, brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and/or key players within the sports ecosystem.

• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of digital advertising, media sales, branded content, sponsorships, audience monetization, and current industry trends.

• Leadership Skills: Strong ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams while maintaining a high-performance culture.

• Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate market opportunities into actionable commercial strategies and measurable business results.

• Communication & Negotiation: Excellent presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

• Analytical & Business Acumen: Strong understanding of sales pipelines, forecasting, commercial KPIs, revenue performance, and business planning.

• Tools: Strong proficiency in PowerPoint/Keynote, Excel, CRM platforms, and other commercial tools.

• Education: University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field is preferred.

• Languages: Advanced English is preferred.

• Location: Based in Buenos Aires with full-time availability.

What Success Looks Like

• Consistent growth in commercial revenue and market share.

• A strong and well-developed sales pipeline.

• Successful acquisition and retention of strategic clients and partners.

• A high-performing and engaged commercial team.

• Strong positioning and visibility for Futbol Sites within the digital media and sports industry.

• Continuous identification of new business opportunities and innovative ways to monetize our audiences and content.

• Lead a commercial team that thinks and sells like partnership builders and generates strategic value of the relationships they own.

postings.descriptionText:
Consultor(a) Comercial de Franquias – Mercado Brasileiro | Buenos Aires⁣
⁣
Na Franquicias Que Crecen, somos uma organização especializada em consultoria e comercialização de franquias, com mais de 25 anos de experiência acompanhando o crescimento de marcas, empreendedores e investidores.⁣
⁣
Mais de 100 marcas confiam em nosso trabalho e recebemos mais de 5.000 consultas por mês de pessoas interessadas em investir em franquias.⁣
⁣
Atualmente, buscamos incorporar um(a) Consultor(a) Comercial para o mercado brasileiro, residente em Buenos Aires e com excelente domínio da língua portuguesa, para assessorar e acompanhar empreendedores e investidores do Brasil interessados em adquirir e desenvolver franquias.⁣
⁣
A função exige a realização de conversas, reuniões, apresentações e negociações comerciais integralmente em português. Por isso, será especialmente valorizado o domínio do idioma em nível nativo ou equivalente, além de um profundo conhecimento do mercado e da cultura de negócios brasileira.⁣
⁣
Torne-se consultor(a) da Franquicias Que Crecen e faça parte do nosso crescimento no Brasil.⁣
⁣
📆 Responsabilidades⁣
⁣
- Entrar em contato, assessorar e acompanhar empreendedores e investidores interessados em adquirir franquias para o mercado brasileiro.⁣
- Entender as necessidades de cada potencial cliente e acompanhá-lo durante todo o processo comercial.⁣
- Apresentar oportunidades de investimento e conduzir reuniões comerciais integralmente em português.⁣
- Acompanhar o investidor durante seu processo de análise e tomada de decisão.⁣
- Gerenciar contatos, oportunidades comerciais e follow-ups por meio de CRM.⁣
- Participar de reuniões, treinamentos e encontros de acompanhamento comercial.⁣
- Trabalhar em conjunto com nossa equipe para concretizar novas operações e desenvolver o mercado brasileiro.⁣
⁣
🤝 Por que fazer parte da nossa equipe?⁣
⁣
- Mais de 50 contatos mensais de potenciais interessados.⁣
- Sistema de comissões em dólares por resultados, entre USD 1.000 e USD 4.000 por operação, de acordo com as características de cada venda.⁣
- Acompanhamento da nossa equipe durante reuniões e processos comerciais.⁣
- Flexibilidade de horários dentro de uma modalidade de trabalho presencial.⁣
- Capacitação comercial contínua, com encontros semanais.⁣
- Estrutura comercial consolidada e uma equipe com ampla experiência no mercado de franquias.⁣
- Escritórios preparados para reuniões e desenvolvimento comercial.⁣
- Benefício especial para cursar a Diplomatura em Franquias com certificação da UTN.⁣
- Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional dentro de uma organização com presença nacional e internacional.⁣
⁣
👔 Qual perfil estamos buscando?⁣
⁣
- Domínio avançado/bilíngue de português.⁣
- Será especialmente valorizado um nível de português nativo ou equivalente.⁣
- Capacidade para conduzir conversas, apresentações e negociações comerciais integralmente em português.⁣
- Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro e da sua cultura de negócios.⁣
- Será especialmente valorizada experiência profissional ou comercial no Brasil ou trabalhando com clientes brasileiros.⁣
- Residência atual em Buenos Aires.⁣
- Experiência comercial mínima de 2 anos.⁣
- Disponibilidade full time para trabalho presencial, com flexibilidade de horários.⁣
- Formação ou interesse nas áreas de negócios, vendas, relações comerciais ou áreas relacionadas.⁣
- Excelente comunicação, capacidade de negociação e orientação para resultados.⁣
- Interesse e motivação pela área de vendas e pelo desenvolvimento de relações comerciais.⁣
- Autodisciplina, comprometimento e abertura para aprender.⁣
- Ter notebook próprio.⁣
- Conhecimento e experiência com ferramentas de CRM, Google Workspace e Excel.⁣
- Capacidade de relacionamento, trabalho em equipe e autonomia.⁣
- Mentalidade empreendedora e ambição de crescimento profissional.⁣
⁣
Uma posição pensada especificamente para o mercado brasileiro⁣
⁣
Buscamos uma pessoa capaz de compreender como o investidor brasileiro pensa, se comunica e toma decisões, além de desenvolver relacionamentos comerciais de longo prazo com clientes desse mercado.⁣
⁣
Devido às características da posição, o português será o principal idioma de trabalho com os potenciais clientes e parte do processo seletivo também poderá ser realizada em português.⁣
⁣
Se você tem experiência comercial, domina o português e conhece o mercado brasileiro, queremos conhecer você.⁣

postings.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Hellotext
Hellotext es un sistema de inteligencia autónoma para eCommerce. Interpreta las señales de cada tienda y, a través de Misiones inteligentes, activa conversaciones personalizadas en WhatsApp y otros canales para recuperar carritos, impulsar ventas y recompra, recomendar productos y resolver consultas. La IA y los equipos humanos trabajan juntos en un único Inbox.

Buscamos un BDR con base en Argentina para generar oportunidades comerciales en Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Perú, con apoyo al mercado chileno.

Tu misión
Investigar marcas de eCommerce y retail, identificar oportunidades de negocio, abrir conversaciones relevantes y convertirlas en demos calificadas para la Account Executive de la región.

Queremos que cada oportunidad que generes tenga una razón clara para avanzar: una empresa que corresponda con nuestro perfil de cliente ideal, una necesidad identificada y un interlocutor interesado en explorar cómo Hellotext puede ayudar.

Lo que vas a hacer

• Identificar y priorizar cuentas dentro de nuestro perfil de cliente ideal —ICP—.

• Investigar marcas, sus tiendas y sus canales para detectar señales comerciales y posibles oportunidades de mejora.

• Convertir esa investigación en mensajes breves, específicos y relevantes para cada cuenta.

• Ejecutar prospección outbound por email, LinkedIn, teléfono y encuentros de la industria.

• Abrir conversaciones con responsables de eCommerce, Marketing, CRM, Growth y Digital.

• Preparar observaciones o pequeñas auditorías que aporten valor y ayuden a iniciar una conversación.

• Conducir un primer discovery para entender el negocio, validar necesidades, identificar prioridades y evaluar si existe una oportunidad.

• Agendar demos calificadas con la Account Executive y coordinar el seguimiento previo para favorecer la asistencia.

• Entregar cada oportunidad con contexto, notas del discovery y próximos pasos registrados en el CRM.

• Descalificar o dejar en seguimiento las cuentas que todavía no estén listas para avanzar.

• Trabajar con la Account Executive para mejorar los mensajes, los segmentos y los criterios de calificación.

• Usar herramientas de IA para investigar y preparar el trabajo, verificando la información antes de utilizarla.

Cómo vas a trabajar con el equipo
Tu foco estará en la prospección, el discovery inicial y la generación de demos calificadas.

La Account Executive se encargará de las demos de producto, las propuestas, la negociación y el cierre. Customer Experience llevará adelante los pilotos y el onboarding.

Vas a trabajar en contacto directo con la Account Executive de la región, con revisiones frecuentes de las oportunidades y feedback para mejorar la prospección.

Lo que buscamos

• Experiencia en prospección outbound B2B, idealmente entre 1 y 3 años como BDR, SDR o en desarrollo comercial.

• Capacidad para investigar una empresa y formular hipótesis comerciales basadas en información concreta.

• Excelente comunicación oral y escrita en español: clara, breve y natural.

• Curiosidad para entender cómo funciona un eCommerce y dónde puede mejorar sus resultados.

• Capacidad para escuchar, hacer buenas preguntas y profundizar antes de proponer una solución.

• Criterio para priorizar cuentas y reconocer cuándo una oportunidad no tiene suficiente encaje.

• Organización para dar seguimiento y mantener un CRM completo y actualizado.

• Resiliencia frente al rechazo, apertura al feedback y disposición para probar nuevos enfoques.

• Autonomía y responsabilidad para trabajar en un equipo remoto.

• Residencia en Argentina.

Diferenciales

• Experiencia en SaaS, MarTech, eCommerce, retail o soluciones digitales.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de eCommerce argentino y de otros mercados de la región.

• Familiaridad con conversión, recuperación de carritos, recompra, retención y automatización de marketing.

• Experiencia conversando con responsables de Marketing, eCommerce, CRM o Digital.

• Manejo de herramientas de CRM, prospección y enriquecimiento de datos.

• Inglés intermedio o avanzado.

• Disponibilidad para participar ocasionalmente en eventos de la industria.

Cómo mediremos el éxito
Después del período inicial de aprendizaje y adaptación:

• Objetivo mensual: 18 demos calificadas, realizadas y aceptadas por la Account Executive.

• Meta destacada: 24 demos calificadas, realizadas y aceptadas.

• Tasa de asistencia y aceptación de las oportunidades.

• Calidad de la información entregada y del registro en CRM.

• Progresión posterior de las oportunidades como indicador de la calidad de la prospección.

Una demo cuenta cuando el prospecto asiste, la empresa corresponde con nuestro ICP, el discovery identifica una necesidad u oportunidad y la Account Executive valida que corresponde avanzar.

Nuestra forma de prospectar
Valoramos la investigación, la relevancia y el respeto por el tiempo del prospecto. Buscamos personas capaces de explicar por qué están contactando a esa empresa y aportar algo útil desde la primera conversación.

La IA nos ayuda a preparar mejor el trabajo. El criterio comercial, la verificación de información y la calidad del contacto quedan en manos de la persona.

¿Por qué Hellotext?

• Un producto enfocado en el comercio electrónico latinoamericano.

• Impacto directo y medible en nuestra expansión regional.

• Responsabilidades y territorios definidos.

• Trabajo cercano con el equipo comercial y feedback continuo.

• Espacio para experimentar y construir nuestro proceso de prospección regional.

• Cultura de autonomía, transparencia, aprendizaje y responsabilidad.

• Trabajo remoto desde Argentina.

postings.title: Territory Manager - Buenos Aires - Centro
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Centro region of Buenos Aires, including Bolívar, Olavarria, Azul, Saladillo, Las Flores, La Plata, Zárate or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Centro region of Buenos Aires, including Bolívar, Olavarria, Azul, Saladillo, Las Flores, La Plata, Zárate or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Territory Manager - Buenos Aires - Este
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Este region of Buenos Aires, including Chascomús, Dolores, Ayacucho, Tandil, Balcarce, Mar del Plata or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Centro region of Buenos Aires, including Bolívar, Olavarria, Azul, Saladillo, Las Flores, La Plata, Zárate or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Por eso trabajamos codo a codo con operaciones mineras de todo el mundo para mover menos roca, utilizar menos energía, gestionar el agua de forma responsable y generar menos residuos. Juntos impulsamos una minería más inteligente, eficiente y sostenible.

postings.title: Sales Coordinator

Job Description

Sales Coordinator

What if your next role changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our team in CABA, Argentina . This is your chance to grow your career in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and help young people take the leap toward a life-changing experience abroad.

You'll be at the heart of our sales operation: managing your own pipeline, building real relationships with prospective students, and guiding them through one of the most exciting decisions of their lives. No scripts, no cold calling - just meaningful conversations, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one

Student Recruitment

Your main responsibilities are:

• Own your sales pipeline from end to end - from the first contact to the signed enrollment.

• Conduct consultations and virtual office meetings, guiding prospective students through their options with confidence and empathy.

• Host and participate in Information Meetings to present our programs to potential students.

• Make welcome home calls to nurture relationships after initial contact.

• Develop customized nurturing strategies via email and social media to keep prospects engaged throughout the funnel.

Beyond Sales - A Little Bit of Everything

As part of a dynamic team, you'll occasionally get involved in representing EF at fairs and events, supporting marketing campaigns and content creation, building ambassadors and referral networks, helping localize global materials for the local market, and supporting operational tasks such as airport duty, rebooking, payment follow-ups, document collection, and visa processes.

Requirements

• Education: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated with a bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Tourism, or related fields.

• Work Experience: Any professional experience, internship, or summer job is valued. Up to 1 Year of full-time experience is ideal.

• Language Level: Upper-intermediate English proficiency. Additional languages are a plus.

• International Experience: Having lived, studied, or worked abroad is a nice-to-have.

• Sales Drive: Strong motivation to hit targets and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

• People Skills: Passion for building genuine relationships and delivering outstanding service.

• Adaptability: Comfortable in dynamic environments, under pressure, and occasionally on weekends.

• Team Player: Collaborative, open-minded, and culturally aware.

• Tech-Savvy: Familiar with CRM tools to manage leads, follow-ups, and KPIs.

Why you will love working with us

More than just a job, we offer a career - and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy

• Benefits by law

• Corporate benefits discounts

• Staff referral bonus (500 USD)

• EF Hello App

• Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation"

As a Sales Executive, You Also Unlock

• Global Mobile Office

• National KO recognition

• EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad

• Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA

As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:

• Intercontinental Famtrip nominations

• Free language courses and international training nominations

• Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities

• Leadership development programs and international kickoffs

Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

postings.title: Inside Partner Manager (US Market)
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About The Role

As part of the Global Partner Sales organization at DevRev, we are growing our team and hiring talented, ambitious, and AI-native Inside Partner Managers in the United States.

As an Inside Partner Manager at DevRev, you will operate at the intersection of partnerships, AI, and go-to-market execution. Your mission will be to expand and activate DevRev's partner ecosystem, generate qualified partner-sourced pipeline, and help shape our channel go-to-market strategy. Rather than relying solely on traditional partner-development methods, you will leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to identify partner opportunities, personalize engagement, and build meaningful relationships with prospective and existing partners at scale.

In this role, you'll work closely with Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to refine messaging, uncover ecosystem insights, and continuously improve how we recruit, onboard, and engage with partners.

What You'll Do

• Expand our partner pipeline by identifying and engaging high-quality prospective partners across target ecosystems and market segments (SIs, resellers, ISVs, and technology alliances).

• Research partners, principals, and co-sell signals using AI-powered tools and modern partner-development techniques.

• Build personalized outreach campaigns across email, phone, text, social, and emerging channels.

• Set up introductory meetings with target partner leaders and key decision-makers.

• Qualify partners by understanding their business model, practice areas, priorities, and go-to-market goals.

• Partner with Account Executives and Partner Solutions Engineers to develop co-sell strategies and create high-quality partner-sourced pipeline.

• Onboard newly signed partners and drive them into the deal-registration and co-sell motion quickly.

• Leverage AI-assisted workflows to increase productivity while maintaining thoughtful, high-quality engagement.

• Develop, test, and optimize messaging, prompts, and partner-recruitment playbooks to improve conversion rates.

• Analyze partner interactions, engagement data, and ecosystem trends to continuously improve targeting and outreach effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate pipeline data, partner records, and deal registrations within DevRev's CRM.

• Act as the voice of the ecosystem by sharing partner insights, objections, and feedback with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Revenue teams.

• Stay current on emerging AI technologies, partner/channel methodologies, and industry trends to continuously evolve your partner-development approach.

What We're Looking For

• BA/BS degree or equivalent educational or professional experience.

• Prior experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), Partner/Channel Development Representative, Account Executive (AE), or similar customer- or partner-facing role.

• Experience selling or partnering around SaaS, technology, or IT-related products.

• Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Outplay, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar technologies to support research, personalization, and workflow optimization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to combine AI-generated insights with human judgment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.

• A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to experiment and learn quickly.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly collaborative environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Genuine ability to build trust and connect deeply with people.

• Bonus: exposure to channel/partner ecosystems, deal registration, or co-sell motions.

What Makes Someone Successful In This Role

• You embrace AI as a force multiplier and continuously look for ways to work smarter and create more value.

• You are highly coachable and eager to learn.

• You enjoy experimenting, measuring results, and iterating quickly.

• You are resilient, resourceful, and energized by building something from the ground up.

• You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how partners build their business.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

• Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)

• Strong inter-personal skills

• Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions

• Excellent critical and strategic thinking

• Excellent project management and negotiation skills

• Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm

• Must have communications and proposal writing experience

• Experience in managing end to end managed services deals

Certification Requirements:

Technologies and Tools

Excellent MS Office Skills, Specifically PowerPoint Are Required

postings.title: Account Manager - Brazil
postings.descriptionText:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customization to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments.

You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale.

In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in Brazil

• Fluent in Portuguese and English

• Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

• Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

• Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities

• Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

• Strong understanding of the LATAM market landscape and cultural nuances

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Análisis de Métricas y Rentabilidad: Evaluar constantemente indicadores clave de negocio, lectura de reportes de performance en la plataforma y análisis de costos/márgenes para detectar brechas y oportunidades de mejora en el repago de los clientes.

And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.

Your Career

The Major Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

• As a Major Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer

• Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers

• Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions

• Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan

• Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account

• Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services

• Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings

Qualifications

Your Experience

• Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry

• Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques

• Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems

• Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions

• Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers

• Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process

• Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes

• Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

postings.title: Tribe Lead (Remote Based)
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

Arionkoder is a fast-scaling AI consulting firm with a simple but ambitious mission: to create better futures for humanity, one customer, one engagement at a time — with extreme customer centricity.

We solve real business problems through AI-driven solutions, and we measure our success by our clients' success. We push the possible, we're thorough to the last detail, and we earn trust by showing up as genuine partners - not just vendors.

Our customers range from start-ups to global brands, and we're proud of the relationships we build as much as the work we deliver.

You’ll join our growing Growth team at Arionkoder. As an ambitious group, we're on a mission to continue the rapid growth we've seen over the last three years, with clear revenue and satisfaction targets. You'll be part of a dynamic environment where your contributions matter and your ideas are valued.

The Role

A Tribe Lead at Arionkoder is not only an account manager. You are a client advocate inside AK - your job is to help clients succeed in their career, their goals, and their businesses, while making our business grow alongside theirs.

You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for taking them through AK's relationship system, designed to turn great individual client relationships into a company-owned competitive advantage. From building deep Customer Intelligence Profiles to activating referrals and leading joint business reviews, you will be the person who makes farming permanent and predictable.

This is one of the most strategically important roles in the company. The right candidate thinks like an owner, acts like a partner, and earns trust from clients and internal teams alike. You have client empathy, technical context, and a growth mindset. You thrive with autonomy, move with urgency, and take full accountability for the health and growth of your portfolio.

Responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of strategic Arionkoder accounts and drive their sustained growth, retention, and expansion

• Build and continuously update a Customer Intelligence Profile (CIP) for each account, capturing the intelligence needed to anticipate needs, surface expansion signals, and activate referrals

• Move accounts through our phases: from early relationship stabilization through to full co-ownership - with intentionality and discipline

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, grounded in genuine partnership and long-term thinking

• Act as the voice of the customer internally - surface their feedback, advocate for their needs, and influence how AK evolves its offerings and delivery

• Work in close alignment with the Account Delivery Manager, who owns delivery - you own the relationship, together you own the outcome

• Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic planning sessions that reflect real knowledge of the client's business, not just contract status

• Identify and activate referral opportunities from within your portfolio.

• Monitor account health proactively and address risks before they surface as issues

• Use and maintain HubSpot for portfolio management, CIP tracking, and reporting

Who Are You

• You have experience with B2B account management, customer success, or strategic partnerships in technology, AI services, digital product development, or enterprise solutions.

• The three non-negotiables: client empathy, technical context, and a growth mindset

• Technical Knowledge: Intermediate technical knowledge, with the ability to understand and differentiate between technical profiles and the tools and libraries each one typically works with. Up to date with AI trends and able to leverage AI tools to explore and improve processes.

• Experience managing complex client accounts with $2M+ annual spend

• Proven track record of growing accounts organically through trust, consistent value delivery, and strategic thinking

• Comfortable building relationships with executives and technical stakeholders across diverse industries

• You can be autonomous while working on a team - you manage your own portfolio with structure, discipline, and initiative

• Excellent communicator in English

• Analytical and data-driven: you use metrics to prioritize effort, spot expansion signals, and demonstrate impact

• Deeply collaborative - you work hand in hand with the Growth team, ADM and the innovation teams to maximize outcomes for every client

• Resilient, accountable, and energized by owning a portfolio end-to-end

Travel is expected, less than 10% of the time, primarily to the United States, where our customers are based.

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.
