postings.title: Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Account Manager with a strong background in Revenue Management to join our growing short-term rental team. This role is responsible for managing client relationships while developing and executing revenue strategies that maximize occupancy, ADR, and overall portfolio performance. If you have experience in both client management and revenue optimization, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with property owners and stakeholders.

• Develop and implement revenue strategies to maximize occupancy and profitability.

• Monitor market trends, competitor pricing, and demand patterns to optimize property performance.

• Manage pricing, availability, and restrictions across multiple booking channels.

• Utilize revenue management tools such as PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond Pricing, or similar platforms.

• Prepare and present performance reports, including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and revenue insights.

• Collaborate with operations, guest communications, and marketing teams to improve overall portfolio performance.

• Identify opportunities for process improvements and revenue growth.

• Ensure client satisfaction by providing proactive communication and strategic recommendations.

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in Account Management, Revenue Management, or Short-Term Rental Operations.

• Proven experience managing revenue strategies for vacation rentals, hospitality, or property management portfolios.Hands-on experience with revenue management tools such as PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond Pricing, or similar software.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and performance metrics.

• Excellent communication and relationship management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, and other OTA platforms.

• Familiarity with property management systems such as Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, Lodgify, or OwnerRez.

• Background in hospitality, vacation rentals, or real estate.

• Experience working with U.S.-based property management companies.

• Knowledge of forecasting, budgeting, and financial reporting.

Work Details

• Remote position.

• Full-time role aligned with U.S. business hours.

• Long-term opportunity with a growing short-term rental company.

• Collaborative and performance-driven work environment.

• Opportunity to directly influence client success and portfolio revenue growth.

If you have a strong background in account management and revenue optimization and are passionate about helping clients maximize their property's performance, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Key Account Manager, SKYWAVE - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Join Us as Key Account Manager, LATAM – SKYWAVE!
ORBCOMM is seeking a results-driven Key Account Manager to grow our SKYWAVE satellite IoT terminal business across Latin America (LATAM). In this role, you will sell the SKYWAVE ST 9100, ST 6100, and ST 2100 terminals and connectivity services into industrial IoT markets, including agriculture, water, oil and gas, commercial fishing, ocean monitoring, trucking, and equipment rental, winning new accounts and expanding the customer and partner relationships you already hold.

Why You’ll Love Working Here
As Key Account Manager, LATAM – SKYWAVE, you will own the industrial IoT territory for LATAM and play a critical role in achieving ORBCOMM’s growth objectives. You will carry an annual new-growth target of approximately USD $2 million and be rewarded with a competitive base salary, uncapped commission, and a guaranteed 80% of target commission for your first three months while you build your pipeline.

You will sell proven satellite terminals that keep remote assets connected beyond the reach of cellular networks, working closely with solution providers, value-added resellers, system integrators, distributors, and end customers, with the full support of ORBCOMM’s product, technical support, and operations teams.

Location: Remote – Mexico or Argentina

What You’ll Do
Revenue Growth & Business Performance

• Deliver approximately USD $2 million in new growth annually across LATAM, achieving or exceeding revenue, bookings, and gross margin objectives.

• Sell SKYWAVE ST 9100, ST 6100, and ST 2100 satellite IoT terminals and the connectivity services that go with them to new and existing accounts.

• Maintain forecast accuracy and provide reliable business visibility through disciplined territory and account planning.

Strategic Growth & Market Expansion

• Win net-new key accounts in industrial IoT markets, including agriculture and irrigation, water and wastewater, oil and gas, commercial fishing, ocean buoys and environmental monitoring, trucking and trailer tracking, and rental equipment.

• Pursue priority opportunities across Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Peru, Colombia, and Central America, including fishing vessel monitoring, oil and gas, agriculture, mining, water, truck and cargo fleets, and equipment rental.

• Build and execute territory and account plans to achieve pipeline growth, customer acquisition, and total contract value (TCV) objectives.

Sales Excellence & Pipeline Management

• Run a disciplined sales cadence focused on opportunity management, forecasting, and CRM excellence.

• Build and maintain the pipeline coverage and conversion rates needed to deliver your annual target.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification and field trials through to contract and volume deployment.

Customer & Partner Development

• Take ownership of established customer and partner relationships in the region and grow them through retention, expansion, and long-term value creation.

• Build executive-level relationships with the solution providers, value-added resellers (VARs), system integrators, and distributors that take SKYWAVE terminals to market.

• Recruit and enable new partners in each priority industry.

Collaboration & Market Insight

• Partner with product, technical support, and operations teams to scope solutions, support customer trials, and deliver on customer requirements.

• Represent SKYWAVE at regional industry events, trade shows, and customer forums.

• Bring customer, competitor, and market insight back into the business to help shape product and go-to-market priorities.

Who You Are
You are a proven hunter who sells satellite IoT or industrial remote monitoring hardware and connectivity. You know the buyers and partners in agriculture, water, oil and gas, fishing, ocean monitoring, trucking, or equipment rental in your region, you are at ease in technical conversations about remote assets and telemetry, and you are motivated by exceeding your targets.
If you have:

• Proven success selling satellite IoT terminals, satellite connectivity, tracking devices, or industrial IoT (IIoT) remote monitoring solutions.

• An established book of business and active customer and partner relationships across LATAM that you can build on from day one.

• Experience selling into one or more of the following: commercial fishing and vessel monitoring (VMS), oil and gas, agriculture, mining, water and environmental monitoring, truck and cargo telematics, or rental equipment connectivity.

• A consistent record of meeting or exceeding annual new-business targets of USD $2 million or more.

• Experience selling hardware and recurring connectivity services through solution providers, VARs, system integrators, and distributors.

• Working knowledge of remote monitoring applications such as SCADA, telemetry, asset tracking, and vessel monitoring.

• Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline.

• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

• Fluency in Spanish and English; Portuguese is a strong asset.

• Willingness to travel regularly across LATAM.

• Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.

• Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

The Benefits of Working Here
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

How We Hire
ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

About Us
At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

Ready to Join Us?
We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

• Demonstrate deep understanding of the southern cone market, industry trends, customer business drivers and competitive landscape

Job Description

Buscamos un Gerente de Cuentas Clave apasionado y con experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo en Thomson Reuters. En este rol, será responsable de desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con nuestros clientes más importantes, identificando sus necesidades y ofreciendo soluciones que generen valor.

Key Responsibilities

En esta oportunidad como Key Account Manager , serás responsable de:

• Crear y gestionar un pipeline de oportunidades de negocio, identificando y calificando nuevos clientes potenciales. Desarrollar y fortalecer relaciones estratégicas con clientes clave, actuando como un asesor de confianza.

• Liderar el desarrollo de sociedades que generen crecimiento mutuo.

• Realizar evaluaciones exhaustivas de las necesidades del cliente para comprender sus desafíos y objetivos.

• Influir en las decisiones de compra de los clientes a través de presentaciones profesionales y propuestas de valor convincentes.

• Colaborar con los equipos de marketing para desarrollar estrategias que impulsen el compromiso del cliente. Gestionar el proceso de ventas de principio a fin, asegurando un flujo de trabajo eficiente y exitoso.

• Comprender y optimizar los procesos empresariales del cliente para integrar nuestras soluciones de manera efectiva. Presentar y negociar propuestas de productos y servicios que aborden las necesidades específicas del cliente. Utilizar tecnología de ventas y tecnología web para optimizar la gestión de cuentas y el seguimiento del rendimiento. Demostrar y comunicar el valor de entrega de nuestras soluciones a los clientes.

• Implementar un enfoque de venta consultiva para identificar y resolver los problemas de los clientes

Required Qualifications

Eres el candidato ideal para el puesto de Key Account Manager si tu experiencia incluye:

• Experiencia comprobada en creación de oportunidades y desarrollo de relaciones con clientes clave.

• Habilidad para el desarrollo de sociedades estratégicas.

• Fuertes habilidades en evaluaciones de las necesidades del cliente.

• Capacidad demostrada de influencia en las decisiones de compra.

• Conocimiento en estrategias de marketing.

• Motivación por los new challenges y la mejora continua.

• Excelentes habilidades de presentación profesional y comunicación.

• Sólida comprensión del proceso de ventas y los procesos empresariales.

• Experiencia en la creación y presentación de propuestas de productos.

• Familiaridad con la tecnología de ventas y la tecnología web.

• Capacidad para demostrar y comunicar el valor de entrega.

• Experiencia en venta consultiva.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experiencia trabajando en entornos colaborativos y con equipos multifuncionales.

• Capacidad para adaptarse a nuevas herramientas, procesos y necesidades del negocio.

• Orientación al cliente y capacidad para construir relaciones profesionales a largo plazo.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.

• Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.

• Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.

• Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.

• Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.

postings.title: Senior Account Manager, AI-DNA, $200k/year USD
postings.descriptionText:
You've built your career closing seven-figure enterprise deals, navigating complex renewals, and turning at-risk accounts into expansion opportunities — and now you want to do it inside a system that actually rewards disciplined execution over heroics. If you're the kind of sales leader who finds satisfaction in running a tight forecast, coaching a team through a tough negotiation, and walking out of an executive escalation call with the customer more committed than before, this is the role you've been looking for.

What you will be doing

• Owning the revenue line for enterprise renewals and expansions — driving pipeline discipline, forecast accuracy, and margin-safe deal execution across Fortune-level accounts.

• Leading executive account reviews and escalation management — stepping into high-stakes customer situations, diagnosing root causes, and converting risk into renewed trust and commercial opportunity.

• Structuring and approving commercial proposals and contracts — negotiating multi-year terms, SOWs, SLAs, and pricing structures that protect margin while enabling long-term customer value.

• Coaching your team on commercial excellence — sharpening how your people think about pricing, deal structure, and negotiation so they close better deals independently.

• Leveraging GenAI tools to enhance commercial operations, accelerate data analysis, and improve communication workflows across your account portfolio.

What you will NOT be doing

• Firefighting without a playbook — you'll operate inside structured, high-performance systems with clear processes, not ad-hoc chaos.

• Chasing net-new logos cold — this role is about deepening and expanding existing enterprise relationships, not outbound prospecting or cold pipeline generation.

• Working in a metrics-optional culture — there are no "vibes-based" forecasts here; you'll have real accountability, but also real support and tooling to hit your numbers.

• Operating as a lone wolf — you'll have cross-functional partnerships with delivery, legal, finance, and customer success built into your weekly rhythm.

• Waiting months for feedback — performance visibility is continuous, not annual; you'll know where you stand every week.

Responsibilities

• Own and execute the enterprise renewal and expansion pipeline, ensuring forecast accuracy and on-time deal closure

• Lead executive-level account reviews (QBRs) and manage escalations with composure, strategic clarity, and follow-through

• Structure, negotiate, and secure approval for commercial proposals and contracts (multi-year agreements, SOWs, SLAs, pricing)

• Coach and develop team members on commercial judgment — pricing strategy, deal structuring, and negotiation tactics

• Maintain CRM hygiene and pipeline integrity; drive continuous improvement in sales operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes

• Identify trends and patterns across accounts and translate insights into scalable commercial playbook improvements

• Collaborate cross-functionally with delivery, finance, legal, and customer success to ensure seamless post-signature execution

Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales experience with direct quota ownership for renewals and/or expansions

• Direct responsibility for enterprise accounts with $1M+ annual contract value

• Demonstrated expertise negotiating complex contracts, including multi-year terms, SOWs, SLAs, and pricing structures

• Strong business acumen — fluency with P&L, revenue recognition, forecasting, and customer lifetime value

• Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce or equivalent) and familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes

• Executive presence — ability to command trust and authority in high-stakes customer conversations and escalations

• Comfort being held accountable to strict metrics, forecast accuracy, and process discipline on a weekly cadence

• Solid GenAI skills — experience using AI tools to enhance commercial operations, data analysis, or communication workflows

Nice to Have

• Experience in AI, data, or analytics-related software/SaaS businesses

• Track record coaching or mentoring sales teams on commercial excellence

• Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes and legal/compliance requirements for large-scale contracts

• Experience with sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, Challenger, or Command of the Message

• Background working with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 accounts

What you will learn

• AI-native commercial operations — how to integrate GenAI tools into every stage of the sales cycle, from pipeline analysis to proposal generation, giving you a skillset that will define the next decade of enterprise sales leadership.

• Structured high-performance sales systems — you'll internalize frameworks for forecast precision, deal review, and escalation management that most organizations only aspire to.

• Pattern recognition at scale — by working across a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts, you'll develop strategic instincts for identifying commercial trends and building repeatable playbooks.

• Cross-functional leadership — deep collaboration with delivery, finance, and customer success will sharpen your ability to lead beyond the sales function.

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

• Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

• Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

• Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

At Gorgias, we are revolutionizing customer service for ecommerce businesses. Our Customer Success team ensures clients realize measurable value from our platform by driving product adoption, automation maturity, and long-term operational impact.

We partner with leading ecommerce brands to optimize their support operations, implement AI-powered workflows, and unlock scalable growth.

As a Commercial AI Solutions Manager , you will serve as a strategic partner to a portfolio of ecommerce merchants. You will guide customers through product adoption, optimization, and long-term success by helping them implement AI-powered workflows, automate support operations, and align Gorgias with their business goals.

You will work closely with customers to uncover opportunities, deepen relationships across stakeholders, and ensure merchants are maximizing the value of the platform.

Your working hours would be 11am - 8pm.

What You’ll Do

As a Commercial AI Solutions Manager, you will:

Customer Partnership & Account Strategy

• Manage a large portfolio of commercial ecommerce customers (high-volume book of business)

• Maintain a strong pulse on your accounts through a mix of proactive and reactive engagement

• Run regular check-ins and support higher-value customers with more structured conversations

• Understand customer workflows, goals, and common blockers

• Support customers in improving how they use Gorgias in their day-to-day operations

Product Adoption & Optimization

• Drive adoption of Gorgias features including automation, AI, and integrations

• Analyze support workflows and recommend improvements for common use cases

• Help customers implement automation and AI workflows to improve efficiency

• Troubleshoot product issues and support customers in resolving blockers

Customer Health & Risk Management

• Identify risk signals and take action to prevent churn

• Focus on improving adoption and setup quality as key drivers of retention

• Support renewal conversations for lower-risk or flat renewals when needed

Operational Excellence & AI Enablement

• Maintain accurate customer data and engagement tracking in internal systems

• Manage your book of business in a structured and organized way

• Prioritize accounts based on impact and risk

• Use AI and internal tools to improve efficiency in your day-to-day work

• Contribute insights and patterns to improve team processes over time

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Sales, Product, and Support teams to resolve issues and improve outcomes

• Escalate when needed and ensure context is clearly communicated

• Share recurring customer challenges and insights with internal teams

Who You Are

• 2+ years in Customer Success, Support, Account Management, or a customer-facing SaaS role

• Comfortable managing a high-volume portfolio of accounts

• Strong communicator who can guide customers through practical, solution-oriented conversations

• Support-oriented and hands-on - you enjoy helping customers solve real problems

AI at Gorgias

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. The Media team supports the global distribution and commercial development of media rights across CONMEBOL Libertadores, Sudamericana and Recopa, helping connect South American club football with audiences around the world.

IMG’s team works across key markets in Latin America and internationally, collaborating closely with CONMEBOL, broadcasters, streaming platforms and other media partners to support the continued growth and distribution of CONMEBOL Club Competitions.

• Support IMG’s leadership in Buenos Aires on all Media-related matters and contribute to broader Media team projects and day-to-day activities as required.

Knowledge And Experience

• Previous experience in the Sports, Media and/or Broadcasting industry.

• Experience in media rights sales, distribution and/or account management.

• Strong commercial mindset, organizational skills, relationship management and customer service skills.\

• Good understanding of the sports media landscape in Latin America and international media markets.

• Fluent in Spanish and English; professional proficiency in Portuguese.

• Previous experience with sports media rights, broadcasters, streaming platforms, audience measurement and/or TV/digital viewership data.

• Availability to travel internationally, particularly within Latin America.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies that apply to all employees:

• Business Acumen – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

• Operational Excellence – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

• Innovation Mindset – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

• Leadership & Collaboration – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

Working Conditions

postings.title: Territory Manager, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Mar y Sierras + Sudoeste region, including Tandil, Bahía Blanca, Coronel Suárez, or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Channel Partners Senior Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Channel Partner Senior Manager to our Indirect Sales team, based in Argentina, with regional scope covering Argentina and Chile.

This is a key individual contributor role within Wellhub’s SSLatam indirect sales strategy. You will be responsible for building and scaling a reseller and alliance ecosystem across two high-potential markets, combining hunting for new channel partners with the development and management of existing ones. You will operate with high autonomy, executing go-to-market strategies through brokers, HR consultancies, benefits companies, banks, and fintechs to drive B2B revenue through indirect channels. This role requires a commercially sharp, resourceful professional who understands the indirect channel business, can open doors with senior stakeholders, and knows how to create value both for partners and for Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

• Build and grow the channel partner ecosystem across Argentina and Chile, identifying, onboarding, and developing strategic alliances with benefits brokers, HR consultancies, voucher/benefits companies, banks, and fintechs.

• Drive indirect revenue through a mix of hunting new reseller partners and farming existing alliances, ensuring consistent pipeline generation and deal conversion through the channel.

• Own end-to-end partner relationships — from commercial negotiation and contract structuring to joint go-to-market execution, co-marketing initiatives, and ongoing performance management.

• Design and execute joint go-to-market strategies with partners, coordinating internally with Marketing, Sales Team, and Operations to ensure aligned initiatives that maximize channel revenue.

• Prospect and engage senior decision-makers (commercial directors, HR leaders, C-suite) at potential partner organizations, building a qualified pipeline of new alliance opportunities.

• Monitor and report channel performance with accuracy, maintaining forecast discipline and proactively managing risks in the indirect pipeline.

• Ensure commercial sustainability by managing partner margins, MAP clauses, and deal structures that protect Wellhub’s margin while remaining competitive in the market.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves.

Who You Are

• An experienced channel and alliances professional with 5–7 years of experience in indirect sales, reseller partnerships, or B2B alliance management, ideally in multi-stakeholder commercial environments.

• A hunter-farmer hybrid — you’re equally comfortable opening new partner relationships from scratch and deepening existing ones to unlock long-term revenue.

• A commercially-driven operator with solid understanding of partner economics, margin management, deal structuring, and reseller go-to-market models.

• An autonomous and resourceful professional capable of navigating ambiguity, managing complex negotiations, and driving results without a direct team to lean on.

• A skilled communicator and influencer with the ability to engage and persuade senior stakeholders both externally (partners) and internally (cross-functional teams).

• Familiar with the Argentina and Chilean business landscape, including local dynamics in HR, benefits, and corporate services markets.

• Experienced in or exposed to SaaS, wellness, or HR technology environments — a strong plus but not a hard requirement.

• Fluent in Spanish and English (advanced/fluent), with professional proficiency required to operate in our global environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Indirect Sales / Channel Partnerships and B2B Alliance Management are mandatory requirements.

What We Offer You

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our Benefits Include

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office equipment reimbursement and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days off per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!

This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

Equitable job search. The employer may only request information strictly necessary for the performance of the job offered (Law 6471).

postings.title: Account Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

uhoh.com is a managed services provider that is scaling fast. Growing companies hand us their technology, from systems and security to integrations and the automation that keeps them moving, so they can get on with their own work. We don't do egos, and we don't do fluff.

The Role

This role combines client relationship ownership with level 1 support. You'll be the main point of contact for clients and one of the people actually fixing things.

Most IT providers make you pick between a friendly account manager who "totally gets your business" but can't reset a password, and a tech who fixes everything but communicates exclusively in ticket numbers. Tradeoffs aren't our thing, so this role is different.

What You'll Do

This is a high-ownership role where you will:

• Manage multiple accounts (around 10)

• Turn vague requests like "our tools are a mess" into a clear plan with actual next steps

• Be the first human a client talks to when something breaks

• Handle the everyday Level 1 stuff fast: password resets, 2FA lockouts, access problems, and connectivity issues before a call

• Get to know each client's business well enough to know what "urgent" actually means to them

• Run regular check-ins with clients to review what's been fixed, what's in progress, and what's coming next

• Keep clients in the loop without making them chase you for updates

• Handle frustrated clients calmly, even when the problem is on fire and it's 8:59 a.m.

• Troubleshoot hardware and software issues across Windows and macOS, and know when to loop in the right internal people when something's beyond Level 1, and own the follow-through until it's resolved

• Keep tickets and project work moving side by side without dropping either one

What You Bring

• Technical Versatility : Proven experience in level 1 IT support or systems administration within a high-growth, fast-paced environment

• Problem-Solving DNA : You find root causes instead of just fixing surface issues

• Proactivity : Always thinking about the needs of a client before they are

• Strong Communication : You ensure clarity with internal teams and clients

• Professional level of English (written and spoken)

• Great Attitude : Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team

• Detail-Oriented, Organized, and Resourceful : You find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly

• Confidence : You're comfortable leading a client call and owning the answer, even when the answer is "I'll find out."

• Excellent Time Management : You act quickly and effectively and have the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously

• Experience with AI : You're comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better

You'll Fit Right in if You

• Have at least Level 1 IT support experience (password resets, access issues, and device setup should all feel familiar)

• Genuinely enjoy troubleshooting, the weirder the problem the better

• Think in systems rather than isolated fixes

• Can explain tech to a founder without making them feel dumb

The Vibe

• No Ego: We care about the best solution, not who came up with it

• High Velocity: We are growing rapidly, so you should be comfortable with change and ready to build systems that scale with the client base

• Direct Communication: We value clarity and brevity

postings.title: Manager, Customer Success
postings.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Customer Success

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

As a Regional Customer Success Manager for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:

Cultivate a strong customer partnership through a deep understanding of their business and managing customer health and value realization during network product launch and post-sale

Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products

Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them

Growing The Business:

Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products

Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings

Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data

Technical & Program Readiness:

Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition

Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products

All About You:

Skilled at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage

Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus

Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability

Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Proficient experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth

Successful track record of identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties

Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges

Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level

Advanced experience working with both large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners

English, Spanish

postings.title: Territory Manager, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Mar y Sierras + Sudoeste region, including Tandil, Bahía Blanca, Coronel Suárez, or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Este region of Buenos Aires, including Chascomús, Dolores, Ayacucho, Tandil, Balcarce, Mar del Plata or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Centro region of Buenos Aires, including Bolívar, Olavarria, Azul, Saladillo, Las Flores, La Plata, Zárate or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

postings.title: Vendedor de Servicios - Mantenimiento
postings.descriptionText:
En Otis, buscamos un Vendedor de Servicios - Mantenimiento que gestione, retenga y desarrolle nuestra cartera de clientes de Servicio.

Esta posición será responsable de mantener relaciones comerciales de largo plazo, identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y asegurar el seguimiento de los procesos comerciales, administrativos y operativos asociados a cada cuenta.

Buscamos una persona con un perfil administrativo-comercial , orientación al cliente y capacidad para gestionar múltiples oportunidades de manera organizada y proactiva.

Ubicación de labores: CABA, Argentina

En un día normal tendrás que:

• Gestionar integralmente la cartera de clientes asignada, brindando seguimiento comercial, administrativo, operativo y de cobranza.

• Identificar las necesidades de los clientes y ofrecer los productos, servicios o soluciones más apropiados.

• Elaborar cotizaciones, propuestas comerciales y presentaciones para desarrollar nuevas oportunidades dentro de las cuentas.

• Dar seguimiento a oportunidades, contratos y solicitudes de servicio mediante el CRM.

• Coordinar renovaciones, licitaciones, altas de proveedores y otros procesos relacionados con la administración de contratos.

• Mantener una relación cercana con los clientes y coordinar con equipos internos para asegurar la continuidad y calidad del servicio.

Lo que necesitas para tener éxito:

• Formación universitaria en carreras económico-administrativas, Ingeniería o áreas afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 1 a 2 años en ventas, administración de cuentas o posiciones similares.

• Experiencia gestionando y desarrollando relaciones comerciales con clientes.

• Habilidades de organización, negociación, análisis y manejo de múltiples iniciativas.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel para el análisis de información y seguimiento de indicadores.

• Comunicación clara, orientación al cliente y enfoque en resultados.

Será un plus si cuentas con:

• Experiencia utilizando Microsoft Dynamics u otras herramientas CRM.

• Experiencia en gestión de contratos, procesos de licitación o seguimiento de cobranza.

Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

As the first Territory Manager in Argentina at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

Location: This role can be based anywhere within the Noroeste region of Buenos Aires, including Pehuajó, Trenque Lauquen, 9 de Julio, Lincoln, Chivilcoy, Junin, Pergamino or surrounding areas. Frequent travel throughout the region is a core part of this role.

Who Are We Looking For

• Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

• Beef Industry Experience: You know the ropes of beef operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. If you don’t, you will be deeply passionate about it, and willing to dive deep into the operations of a farm to learn rapidly.

• Attitude: You naturally play for the front of the jersey. Make those around you better. Thrive under pressure and own your results. You bring authentic energy and passion to every interaction.

• Territory Management: Able to use critical thinking to manage a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, making the appropriate trade-offs.

• Problem Solving & Collaboration: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

• Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Prospecting & Expansion: Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals, industry events, and other channels, as well as responding to inbound queries. You’ll manage the full sales pipeline from lead generation through to close.

• Hitting Sales Targets: Manage your pipeline and meet high-growth sales targets by screening, qualifying, demonstrating the product, and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

• Customer Account Management: After the sale, maintain close relationships with customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

• Territory Ownership: A high level of ownership in your territory working with regional agricultural groups to foster deep relationships across the beef industry.

• Customer Onboarding: Assist in owning the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

• Field Learnings & Feedback: Serve as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory. Work closely with Support, Product, and R&D teams to share insights from the field that can drive product improvements and innovations.

• Collaborating with Support Teams: Partner with the Support Team to resolve any issues your customers encounter quickly. You’ll escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"
