postings.descriptionText:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We're changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!).

If you've banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API's, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent - even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We've started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Pod Lead at Tyk, you're a strategic and technical leader within our Customer Success team. This isn't just about reacting to tickets - you'll help build a proactive function that spots risk early, strengthens customer trust, and makes sure customers get real value from Tyk.

You'll lead complex, high-priority customer engagements, mentor Customer Success Engineers, and partner with Engineering, Product, and Account Management to turn customer feedback into real improvements.

You'll also shape how the team works day to day - building processes that scale, and championing AI adoption to speed up debugging, share knowledge, and cut out repetitive work.

When things get complicated - technical, customer-facing, or cross-functional - you're who people turn to. You'll play a key role in defining what modern Customer Success looks like at Tyk.

Key Responsibilities

• Leadership & escalations. You own the health of the Zendesk queue and are the first point of call for critical, high-impact escalations - stepping in before issues reach Product, and taking part in the 24/7 on-call rotation (weekends included)

• Coaching & team development. You coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers, raising the bar for technical quality and ownership across the pod, and helping close capability gaps through training, hiring, and documentation

• Technical depth & innovation. You lead the toughest technical investigations - debugging, source code analysis, root cause analysis - and drive the process improvements, automation, and AI adoption that make the whole team faster

• Customer relationships. You build trusted, senior-level relationships with key Enterprise customers, partnering with Account Management to catch risk early and championing improvements to the customer journey

• Driving continuous improvement. You turn support data into action - feeding it to Product and Engineering, evolving support policies as Tyk scales, and representing Customer Success Engineering in company-wide initiatives

Requirements

What we're looking for:

• Extensive experience in Technical Support, Customer Success Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, with a track record leading complex escalations and driving systemic improvements

• A strong, hands-on engineering mindset - comfortable reproducing issues, digging through logs and config, reading source code, and diagnosing problems across distributed systems

• Strong Docker and Kubernetes knowledge is essential. A large share of our customer environments are containerized, and many investigations involve debugging Kubernetes deployments, networking, and scaling

• Experience deploying and troubleshooting on-premise environments and a solid background with large Enterprise customers, ideally including API/API Management (gateways, authentication, networking, distributed architectures)

• Comfortable getting hands-on with unfamiliar technologies - Redis, MongoDB, SQL databases, load balancers, proxies, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, and Identity Providers

• Sharp debugging instincts and excellent communication - you can move from symptom to root cause and explain it clearly to both customers and internal teams

• Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, and a growth mindset: curious, humble, and always looking to improve yourself and the people around you

• Comfortable working with customers across regions, with willingness to take part in rotational on-call (including weekends), and to contribute code and documentation changes directly

Why Customer Success @ Tyk?

Tyk is on a mission to simplify API and service management for everyone. As a CSE Pod Lead, you'll help shape the future of technical support - not just as a service, but as a strategic advantage. You'll be empowered to lead initiatives, make a real impact, and work with passionate people around the globe.

Benefits

Here's why you should join us:

• Everyone has unlimited paid holidays.

• We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all

• Employee share scheme

• Generous maternity and paternity leave

• Volunteering Days

• Company retreats

• Employee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk - here's how:

• It's ok to screw up!

We've found that it's often the ‘stupid' or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

• The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It's in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we'd do it again!

• Trust starts with you - make it count!

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

• Assume best intent!

We have each other's back - we're all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

• Make things better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What's it like to work here?! Check it out: https://tyk.io/worklife/

Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

👉 You can see more about us here https://tyk.io

Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

• Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role

A Day In The Life

The primary responsibility of the Data Access Manager is to provide best-in-class support for prospective clients during Power Digital's sales cycle, guiding them through our Access & Integration process to ensure all necessary data sources are connected to our internal systems. This role is the connective tissue between our Revenue and Analyst teams during new business vetting—ensuring our Analysts have the platform access they need to deliver a complete and accurate marketing assessment.

The Data Access Manager builds trust quickly with prospective clients through clear communication, high emotional intelligence, and a consistently positive experience. They are an effective English speaker who can calmly and confidently guide clients through technical access requirements, maintaining a professional and solutions-oriented attitude throughout. Platform-specific expertise can be learned on the job—the ability to build rapport, problem-solve access challenges, and represent the Power Digital brand well is what matters most.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective clients during the data access and integration phase of the sales cycle

• Partner closely with the Revenue and Analyst teams to coordinate platform access ahead of and during marketing audits

• Manage prospective client onboarding environments

• Maintain and evolve the library of Access & Integration materials

• Regularly update internal documentation as platform access processes change over time

• Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize Access & Integration processes

• Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

• Training and Onboarding Expertise: Experience guiding clients or customers through onboarding processes and conducting effective training sessions

• Problem-Solving Experience: Background in addressing and resolving customer issues, ideally in a technical or software-related context

• Analytical and Reporting Skills: Familiarity with using analytics tools for customer data analysis and reporting

• Experience using Google Sheets for administrative tasks

• Familiarity with the access protocol for the following platforms a plus:

• Google Analytics

• Google Ads

• Meta Ads

• TikTok Ads

• Pinterest Ads

• HubSpot, Salesforce, and similar CRMs

• Klaviyo & similar ESPs

• Shopify & similar CDPs

• Familiarity with marketing and financial KPIs is a plus

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Access Request Velocity: Decrease avg. days to complete access requests (OKR = 7 days or less)

• First-Touch Completeness Rate: % of appraisals where no follow-up access requests were needed after the initial outreach.

• Integration Completion Rate: % of available integrations completed once access is granted (OKR = 100%)

Most Important Things (MITs)

• Access Request Velocity

• Completed Integrations

• Access & Integration Success

All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking a Senior Client Success Manager to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Our benefits ✨

About The Project

Nortal's Client Services team in the Americas is hiring a Senior Client Success Manager to own a portfolio of strategic accounts. These are complex engagements and clients, the kind where the account plan & strategy matters as much as the relationship. You will set account strategy, own forecasting and revenue targets, identify and close growth opportunities, and be the person our clients and internal teams both trusts. You’ll also be responsible for building and expanding executive-level relationships, opening doors to C-level stakeholders, and creating the access and influence needed to strengthen partnerships and unlock new opportunities. You’ll work closely with Delivery, technical, legal, and finance teams to make sure every commitment we make is one we can sustain and grow.

Who You Are

• Detail-oriented and organized, you don't let a number, a date, or a follow-up slip, and your account plans and forecasts hold up under scrutiny.

• Comfortable with accounting and forecasting, you build a reliable pipeline view and can defend every number in it.

• A natural bridge builder, you connect client stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.

• Genuinely invested in relationships, client success, and to you, is not a quota; it's a relationship you protect over the years.

• Not afraid of a hard conversation, internally or with the client, when something needs to be said.

• Proactive by default, you raise the risk before someone else finds it, and you follow through without being chased, and know when to escalate.

• Comfortable navigating complex environments.

• Highly autonomous, you don't need strong handholding to know what the account needs next.

• Commercially fluent, you understand contract structures, negotiation dynamics, and how to protect margins and relationships simultaneously.

What You’ll Do

Client retention and growth

• Build long-lasting, profitable relationships with assigned accounts/portfolios

• Define and implement long-term strategy and objectives for each account.

• Proactively identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Deliver high retention and measurable account growth.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• 10+ years in Client Success, Account Management, or a comparable client-facing commercial role, including direct experience on Tier-1 or enterprise-scale accounts.

• A demonstrated track record of owning revenue targets, forecasting, and upselling/cross-selling on complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.

• Full professional English (C1+), you will be the primary point of contact for US enterprise stakeholders, both written and verbal.

• Experience in technology services, digital platforms, or enterprise software environments.

• Hands-on experience negotiating and administering multiple contract types (T&M, fixed price, retainer, SOWs, MSAs).

• Disciplined CRM hygiene and comfort producing revenue, forecast, and account-health reporting for internal and client audiences.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

postings.descriptionText:
BCM Argentina seleccionará

Delivery Manager - Plataforma de video IA - Videovigilancia - Híbrido en CABA

Para cliente que desarrolla tecnología inteligente de videovigilancia y seguridad, con sedes en Buenos Aires, Ciudad de

México, Madrid y Miami cuyas líneas de producto abarcan analítica de video, control de acceso, telemetría y

seguimiento vehicular (AVL).

Requisitos

Delivery Manager — Plataforma de Video IA - Videovigilancia

REPORTA A

CTO (Director de Tecnología)

UBICACIÓN

Buenos Aires (Híbrido) | LATAM, España y EE. UU.

EQUIPO

Ingenieros de implementación, coordinadores y soporte

VIAJES

Ocasionales a clientes y oficinas (aprox. 15%)

IDIOMAS

Español e Inglés (Nivel avanzado)

Punto único de responsabilidad en la entrega La persona seleccionada gestiona la implementación técnica de

clientes, coordina lanzamientos internos con ingeniería y producto, mantiene el alcance y margen comercial, y lidera el

rendimiento de soporte y SLA tras la puesta en marcha.

La plataforma de video con IA es la línea más reciente modelos de visión por computadora y lenguaje-visión

que ejecutan inferencia en el borde (edge) sobre hardware NVIDIA Jetson, integrándose con las cámaras y VMS del

cliente, combinados con una capa cloud para configuración, eventos y tableros de control.

La ejecución de entregas es el principal factor de crecimiento de esta línea. Cada despliegue combina hardware en

el borde, ajuste de modelos por sitio, integración con VMS y red, y la adopción por parte del equipo operativo del

cliente.

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE

• Entrega e Implementación con Clientes

Gestionar cada despliegue desde la firma del contrato hasta la aceptación final.

Llevar a cabo el relevamiento técnico y auditorías de sitio (cámaras, ancho de banda, energía, VMS y control de

acceso).

Dimensionar el hardware en el borde (modelos Jetson, almacenamiento y red) a partir del conteo de cámaras y

analíticas requeridas, generando la lista de materiales (BOM).

Traducir la propuesta comercial en un plan de entrega con alcance, hitos y criterios de aceptación claros.

Coordinar el aprovisionamiento, armado y montaje de hardware con equipos internos y socios integradores.

Desplegar y configurar analíticas en sitio zonas de detección, reglas, horarios, umbrales y escalamiento de alertas.

Liderar ciclos de ajuste fino con ingeniería para reducir falsos positivos según las metas acordadas.

Garantizar integraciones sólidas con VMS, control de acceso y sistemas ERP/WMS del cliente.

Supervisar pruebas de aceptación, capacitación de operadores y la entrega formal de documentación.

• Entrega de Versiones y Hoja de Ruta (Roadmap)

Nexo principal entre las necesidades del cliente en campo y los desarrollos del equipo de ingeniería.

Mantener una vista unificada de fechas comprometidas e identificar tempranamente posibles cuellos de botella.

Participar en la planificación de sprints representativo de las restricciones del cliente y riesgos de entrega.

Asegurar la preparación del lanzamiento notas de versión, rutas de actualización en el borde y planes de contingencia.

Canalizar la retroalimentación de los despliegues hacia la hoja de ruta del producto para impulsar la estandarización.

• Gestión de Proyectos y PMO

Gestionar las entregas como un portafolio estructurado, con asignación eficiente de recursos.

Control estricto de alcances y cambios todo trabajo adicional requiere una orden de cambio aprobada en costo y

tiempo.

Mantener un registro de riesgos e incidencias con responsables y fechas de mitigación.

Monitorear presupuestos, horas dedicadas y margen de entrega frente a lo vendido.

Crear el manual de ejecución (playbook) plantillas de relevamiento, listas de verificación y criterios de aceptación.

• Posventa, Soporte y Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLA)

Definir y garantizar el cumplimiento de SLAs contractuales (tiempos de respuesta, disponibilidad y calidad de alertas).

Liderar la gestión de incidentes graves y revisiones post-incidente en caso de incumplimientos de SLA.

Gestionar la salud proactiva de la flota instalada (conectividad, estado de cámaras y deriva del modelo).

Acompañar renovaciones y expansiones identificando nuevos casos de uso junto al equipo comercial.

REQUISITOS DEL PERFIL

Experiencia Más de 7 años liderando proyectos B2B tecnológicos, con al menos 2 años gestionando equipos de

entrega, implementación o servicios profesionales.

Despliegues Complejos Experiencia comprobable en proyectos end-to-end que involucren hardware instalado en

planta (no únicamente software SaaS).

Fundamentos de PM Dominio de planificación, estimación, control de cambios, riesgos y márgenes.

Solidez Técnica Capacidad para dialogar y evaluar decisiones de arquitectura en redes (IP, VLAN, VPN), Linux,

contenedores, APIs y video IP (RTSP, ONVIF, códecs).

Visión por Computadora Entendimiento práctico del comportamiento de modelos de IA en entornos reales (falsos

positivos, condiciones de luz y variaciones por sitio).

Gestión de SLAs Habilidad para manejar incidentes críticos y mantener interlocución con clientes exigentes.

Idiomas Dominio fluido del español e inglés (oral y escrito).

Residencia Área Metropolitana de Buenos Aires o disponibilidad de reubicación, con disponibilidad para viajar.

MEDICIÓN DEL ÉXITO Y OBJETIVOS

Primeros 90 días

Día 30 Diagnóstico y lista de riesgos de todos los despliegues activos.

Día 60 Primera versión del playbook de entrega aplicada en un proyecto real.

Día 90 Plan estándar de implementación y modelo de estimación operativo para los 2 casos de uso principales.

Métrica de Desempeño Objetivo Propuesto

Despliegues entregados en la fecha comprometida 90%

Margen de entrega vs. margen vendido Dentro del 10% de variación

Tiempo de contrato a puesta en marcha (alcance estándar) Reducción del 30% en 12 meses

Cumplimiento de SLA en cuentas activas 98%

Satisfacción del cliente al handover (CSAT) 4.5 / 5.0

MODELO DE TRABAJO E INTERACC IÓN

Contraparte Internal / External Propósito de la Relación

CTO Reporte directo. Escalamientos, capacidad vs. pipeline y estándares.

Ingeniería y Producto Planificación de versiones, ajustes de modelos y feedback del roadmap.

Ventas y Pre-venta Validación de alcance previo a la firma, órdenes de cambio y expansiones.

Sponsors del Cliente Seguimiento de hitos, aceptación del servicio y revisiones periódicas.

Deseable

• Experiencia práctica con hardware de edge AI, especialmente NVIDIA Jetson y en el despliegue de modelos en dispositivos con recursos restringidos.

• Experiencia/Conocimientos en seguridad física o en la industria de la videovigilancia plataformas de VMS como Milestone, Genetec o Digifort, control de acceso, integradores e instaladores.

• Experiencia en entornos logísticos, industriales o de retail centros de distribución, almacenes y plantas operativas.

• Familiaridad con prácticas de MLOps versionado de modelos, monitoreo y bucles/ciclos de reentrenamiento con datos del cliente.

• Experiencia gestionando entregas o proyectos (delivery) en múltiples países y contextos regulatorios, incluidas las normativas de protección de datos para video (GDPR en España, regulaciones locales en LATAM y EE. UU.).

Cuando una idea aparece, nacen la motivación y el deseo de concretarla. Esa motivación es la que mueve a nuestro equipo. Desde que comenzamos a dar nuestros primeros pasos solo hemos tenido una idea en mente, la tecnología es siempre el camino.

postings.title: Senior Director, Customer Success – LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Senior Director, Customer Success for Latin America to own the retention and growth strategy for our LATAM customer base — from SMB at scale to larger, strategic accounts.

This is a hands-on regional leadership role within a global Customer Success organization. You will own regional outcomes, define and launch LATAM-specific retention and growth initiatives, and adapt the global Customer Success model to what works best for the market. You will be expected to bring fresh, data-informed ideas, turn them into measurable programs, and drive execution with speed and rigor.

You will also act as the voice of LATAM within the global organization , influencing global teams and senior stakeholders to secure the priorities, resources, and decisions the region needs to succeed.

This role is ideal for a results-driven, entrepreneurial CS leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution — someone who can identify opportunities, build the strategy, remove blockers, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you'll do

• Own the LATAM retention and growth strategy — define the regional agenda and identify new opportunities to improve retention, adoption, and expansion across the customer base.

• Design, launch, and iterate region-specific programs — develop lifecycle motions, retention plays, and growth initiatives tailored to LATAM segments; test, measure, and continuously improve based on results.

• Adapt and elevate the global Customer Success model for LATAM — leverage global frameworks, playbooks, and KPIs where they work, while reshaping them where local market dynamics require a different approach.

• Drive the full customer lifecycle — own onboarding, adoption, engagement, expansion, and renewals, balancing scalable SMB motions with a more sophisticated approach for larger and strategic accounts.

• Execute with pace and quality — translate strategy into action, maintain high execution standards, and ensure regional priorities consistently move forward.

• Unblock issues, escalations, and cross-functional initiatives — act as a regional problem-solver, rapidly removing obstacles and driving complex issues and projects to resolution.

• Influence global teams on behalf of LATAM — partner with global Customer Success, Product, Risk, Operations, Sales, and Support teams to advocate for regional priorities and secure the resources and decisions needed to deliver results.

• Own regional performance and KPIs — maintain accountability for retention, NRR/GRR, product adoption, churn, segmentation health, and other key Customer Success metrics.

• Establish a disciplined operating cadence — lead dashboards, QBRs, success scorecards, forecasting, and executive reporting for the LATAM business.

• Build, coach, and scale the regional CS organization — hire, develop, and retain high-performing talent while establishing a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and customer obsession.

• Strengthen regional cross-functional alignment — work closely with Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, and Support to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

• Be the voice of the LATAM customer — consolidate regional insights and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations for global teams.

• Build executive customer relationships — engage directly with key and strategic accounts, particularly in high-value, complex, or escalated situations.

Who you are

Professional background

• 10–15+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Post-Sales, or a related customer-facing function, including senior leadership experience.

• 5+ years leading regional or country-level Customer Success teams, with direct accountability for execution, customer outcomes, and business results.

• A proven track record of hands-on execution and delivering results in fast-paced, complex environments.

• Demonstrated experience originating and launching retention and growth strategies, not simply executing existing programs.

• Strong experience operating Customer Success models at scale, including segmentation, lifecycle design, playbooks, KPI frameworks, and operating cadences.

• Proven ability to influence across a matrix organization, including senior and global stakeholders, without relying on direct authority.

• Experience in fintech or payments is a significant advantage.

• Experience managing SMB customers at scale is a strong advantage.

• Experience evolving Customer Success toward more strategic and upmarket customer engagement is a strong advantage.

• Deep knowledge of the LATAM market and professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, plus business-level English.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

postings.title: Operations Manager | LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Why this role?

Enterprise customers expect flawless execution at scale. As an Operations Manager you'll own the operational outcome of some of Deel's most strategic customers, ensuring they launch successfully and continue to operate efficiently as they grow.

This role is designed for exceptional early-career operators who thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and want to accelerate their careers through ownership and continuous learning.

You'll gain deep exposure across onboarding, customer operations, payroll, product, and process improvement while helping build the operating model that supports Deel's largest customers.

What You'll Do

• Own the onboarding and operational delivery for a portfolio of enterprise customers.

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Payroll, Legal, and Support to resolve operational challenges.

• Drive operational excellence by identifying bottlenecks, improving processes, and implementing scalable solutions.

• Build trusted relationships with customers while ensuring a high-quality operational experience.

• Analyze operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

• Take ownership of increasingly complex customer environments as your expertise grows.

• Contribute to building new operational playbooks that improve efficiency across the Operations organization.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for people who can wear multiple hats, move fast, and get promoted quickly—not people who want deep specialization in one function. You must have an exceptional analytical ability and a demonstrated track record of learning quickly.

You May Be a Great Fit If You

• Have approximately 1–3 years of professional experience.

• You don't want a career in investment banking or consulting, you want an accelerated career trajectory in tech.

• You’re attracted by high ownership, steep learning curves, and the chance to make an outsized impact early in your careers.

• Hold a strong technical or analytical degree, ideally in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, or a related discipline.

• Enjoy solving difficult problems and bringing structure to ambiguity.

• Have outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Are highly organized, execution-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Learn quickly, embrace ownership, and consistently seek opportunities to improve how things work.

We'd especially love to hear from you if you

• Graduated from a leading university with a strong technical or quantitative background.

• Considered careers in consulting, investment banking, engineering, or technology before deciding you wanted to build and operate within a high-growth company.

• Are motivated by steep learning curves rather than narrowly defined responsibilities.

• Want to become a future operational leader inside one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the world.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll:

• Deliver exceptional operational outcomes for enterprise customers.

• Build deep expertise across Deel's products and operational workflows.

• Continuously improve internal processes through automation and operational excellence.

• Take on increasingly complex customer portfolios as your experience grows.

• Develop into a trusted operational leader capable of owning large-scale enterprise operations.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

• Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.

• Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.

• Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.

• We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

Some things you'll enjoy

• Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

• Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

• Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page .

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy.

• For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT

postings.title: GPC Service Delivery Manager
postings.descriptionText:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the GPC Service Delivery Manager based in Buenos Aires, Argentina , you will join the Global Patient Care (GPC) organization—a first-level customer and patient support network of 500+ internal and external collaborative team members across North America, EMEA/LATAM, and APAC. Reporting within Henrique’s team, you will act as a critical global bridge between GPC operations, Global Customer Support (GCS), Post-Market Quality (PMQ), and regional affiliate stakeholders (including LATAM). You will own the operational handover post-Hypercare for new service implementations, lead global feedback loops, monitor standardized KPIs, and drive continuous service improvement initiatives across diabetes care and near-patient care portfolios.

The Opportunity

• Post-Hypercare Service Ownership & Handover: Manage the end-to-end transition and operational delivery following the Hypercare phase of new GPC service implementations for global affiliates, ensuring strict alignment with global guidelines and KPI standards

• Global Stakeholder Partnership & Governance: Act as the primary GPC point of contact for GCS, PMQ, Global IT, Quality & Regulatory, and Marketing/Sales. Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across LATAM and global hubs to align service delivery strategies

• KPI Monitoring & Operational Feedback Loop: Monitor global operational metrics, gather affiliate/customer feedback, and establish structured feedback loops to drive process enhancements and a consistent global customer experience

• Service Improvement Plans (SIP): Identify operational bottlenecks, design vision-driven Service Improvement Plans (SIPs), and execute change management strategies that optimize service delivery efficiency and patient/customer satisfaction

• Service Operations & Change Management: Lead cross-functional global squads and service teams, overseeing change control, service transition timelines, resource allocations, and risk mitigation strategies in an agile environment

• Cross-Hub Collaboration: Work in close partnership with regional team members across North America, EMEA, and APAC to standardize global customer care workflows and promote a "right first time" operational mindset

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Communications, or a related field

• 5+ years of progressive experience in Service Delivery Management, Client Services, Customer Care Operations, or BPO / Contact Center Environments (healthcare industry experience is a plus, but BPO/Service Operations expertise is primary)

• Proven track record in Service Implementation, Service Improvement Plans (SIPs), SLA governance, and Post-Hypercare transitions in multi-hub or regional/global environments

• Strong background in operational KPI tracking, feedback loop implementation, SLA management, and structured process optimization

• Exceptional stakeholder management, active listening, and change management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a matrix environment

• Fluency in English (advanced/fluent, written and spoken) is required to engage daily with global leadership and cross-region hubs

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

postings.title: Senior Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking a talented Senior Project Manager to join our growing Customer Experience Engineering (CXE) team. The right candidate is someone who can lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of cloud-based contact center solutions for our clients. You will guide cross-functional teams — including solutions architects, engineers, and QA — through the full lifecycle of Amazon Connect deployments, ensuring successful implementation and adoption. This role is technical light: strong project management fundamentals, organization, and the ability to communicate confidently about cloud and contact center concepts matter far more than hands-on AWS technical depth.

Your Assignment

Project Management & Client Engagement

• Lead end-to-end project management for Amazon Connect implementations from initial discovery to successful client handoff

• Develop comprehensive project plans with clear milestones, deliverables, and resource allocations aligned with Caylent's delivery methodology

• Build strong client relationships as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation project

• Facilitate effective communication among stakeholders, Caylent technical teams, and client stakeholders

• Conduct regular status meetings and provide clear, concise updates to both Caylent leadership and client teams

• Manage and regularly report on project scope, schedule, and budget while maintaining Caylent's high standards for quality

• Manage detailed resource plans, including team allocations and forecasted budget

• Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and dependencies proactively

• Collaborate closely with internal partner teams (e.g., BSAs, QA, and Product)

Technical Coordination

• Coordinate the technical implementation of Amazon Connect and integrated AWS services, partnering closely with solutions architects and engineers who own the technical design

• Translate client requirements into clear specifications for the technical team designing contact flows, queues, and routing strategies

• Coordinate the integration of Amazon Connect with client CRM systems, knowledge bases, and other enterprise applications

• Track and coordinate delivery of AI/ML-powered features (e.g., Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly) built by the technical team

• Partner with technical leads to confirm implementations follow AWS best practices for security, reliability, and operational excellence

• Confirm technical solutions meet client requirements and performance expectations, escalating gaps to the technical team

• Coordinate testing efforts across functional, performance, and user acceptance testing phases

Solution Delivery Oversight

• Collaborate with Caylent solutions architects on the delivery plan for custom CX solutions that leverage the AWS ecosystem

• Manage the team's development of custom components, extensions, and integrations for client-specific needs, tracking scope and timeline

• Coordinate delivery of analytics and reporting solutions (e.g., Amazon Kinesis, Amazon S3, Amazon QuickSight) built by the technical team

• Coordinate delivery of CI/CD pipelines for Amazon Connect solution deployment and updates

• Confirm with technical leads that solutions are built with scalability, resilience, and future extensibility in mind

• Coordinate knowledge transfer to client teams and Caylent managed services teams

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

• Develop reusable implementation assets, templates, and best practices to enhance Caylent's delivery capabilities

• Document lessons learned and contribute to the organization's implementation methodology

• Stay current on Amazon Connect feature releases and AWS service enhancements at a working-knowledge level

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency and quality

• Contribute to Caylent thought leadership in the Amazon Connect and CX space

• Participate in client-facing presentations and demonstrations of Caylent solutions

• Mentor junior team members on project delivery best practices and client engagement approaches

Your Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of experience in project management, ideally within technology or professional services delivery

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional implementations

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences

• Strong client relationship management capabilities

• Working knowledge of JIRA, Smartsheet, Confluence, and other project and resource management tools

• Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or equivalent) or equivalent hands-on experience

• Experience with Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with contact center technologies and customer experience solutions

• Exposure to AWS cloud technologies

• AWS Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, or Solutions Architect Professional certification

• Experience implementing or working with Amazon Connect

• Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Kinesis, and CloudFormation

• Familiarity with IVR systems, CTI integrations, and telephony technologies

• Familiarity with AI/ML technologies such as natural language understanding and speech recognition

• Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, Dynamics, ServiceNow, etc.)

• Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Node.js) and infrastructure as code tools

postings.title: Client Lead
postings.descriptionText:
💸 Up to USD 80,000 per year, on a full time, contractor contract
🌎 Fully remote working!
✨ Opportunity to work close to major basketball and sports clients, including the live rhythms of the season, playoffs, Finals, Draft, offseason, and tentpole content moments.
💻 Modern tooling environment where we expect thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, repeatability, and team performance

Working Hours: this role must align closely with US Eastern Time across weekdays (regardless of your location).

ABOUT US

Storyteller is a high growth B2B SaaS platform which allows companies to integrate Stories into their owned and operated platforms. Popularized by Instagram and Snapchat, Stories are perfectly suited for boosting user engagement, audience retention, and driving advertising revenue. For customers, building their own stories experience can take years and a lot of investment however Storyteller has solved this by allowing companies to integrate in days, not years all for one monthly cost.

Our end‑to‑end platform gives companies a best‑in‑class Stories experience in days with native iOS, Android, and Web SDKs, publishing tools, analytics, and ad support.

The Role

This role leads the team and operating system behind one of our largest and most important client relationships: a globally recognised organisation in major US sport.
The work is high-volume and unusually broad. It spans content and publishing operations, design delivery, analytics and analysis, client projects, product and engineering coordination, releases, integrations, live-event readiness and a growing set of AI-enabled services.

We need one strong operational generalist who can see that whole picture, lead the people doing the work and make sure priorities become completed outcomes. You will give the team clarity, pace and high standards; help specialists do their best work; and stop important work from depending on senior leaders chasing it.

This is an operational and people-leadership role. It is not primarily a product-management, sales or account-director position.

Sports Context

The client is in major US sport, where a playoff run, Draft, trade, injury, live-game issue or major campaign can change the shape of the week immediately. Basketball knowledge is useful because it helps you anticipate those moments, understand their importance and organise the team accordingly.

You do not need to be a basketball analyst. You do need to be interested enough to understand the season, the audience and why timing matters.

What You Will Own

• Lead and develop the multidisciplinary team delivering work for the account.

• Maintain one clear operating picture across priorities, owners, deadlines, dependencies, risks and decisions.

• Set the team's workload and standards, inspect delivery and intervene early when quality, pace or performance slips.

• Run a high volume of work across content, publishing, design, analytics, client projects, releases, integrations and AI-enabled services.

• Turn unclear requests into a practical plan: the outcome, scope, owner, next action, dependency, deadline and decision required.

• Use operating, audience and delivery data to diagnose problems and make decisions, not simply report activity.

• Work closely with design, content, product, engineering, support and client leaders without pretending to replace their specialist judgement.

• Help functional leaders manage priorities and handoffs, provide operational cover when they are unavailable and prevent one account from consuming all of their capacity.

• Lead large, ambiguous operational projects, including audits and migrations, while keeping live delivery moving.

• Improve the operating system itself. This includes simplifying fragmented tracking, moving appropriate work from Airtable into Linear and building useful review rhythms, automations and controls.

• Recognise when a growing area needs clearer ownership, a different process or a specialist hire; define the need, help hire the right person and make the resulting capability work.

• Prepare concise, accurate client updates and lead day-to-day delivery conversations, including incidents and difficult news.

• Make sensible day-to-day decisions independently and escalate only the decisions that genuinely need senior or specialist input.

What Good Looks Like

• The team knows what matters, what they own, when it is due and what good looks like.

• Material work has a current owner, status, next action and decision path.

• Missed commitments and quality problems trigger early intervention rather than late surprises.

• Content and design work has active capacity, priority and handoff management.

• Large projects are broken into workable phases with clear leadership and follow-through.

• Client updates are timely, candid and connected to real delivery state.

• Repeated operational pain becomes a better process, tool, automation or ownership model.

• AI is used to improve speed, analysis, quality and repeatability, with important outputs checked and owned by the team.

• Senior leaders can set direction and inspect outcomes without running the account's daily work.

What We Are Looking For

• High agency: you create forward motion without waiting for perfect instructions.

• Strong judgement: you can decide what matters now, what stops, what waits, what needs more evidence and what needs escalation.

• Direct people leadership: you have set standards, allocated work, coached people, handled performance problems and remained accountable for the team's output.

• Operational grip: you can run several different workstreams at once without losing the detail or drowning the team in process.

• Numeracy and analytical ability: you can interrogate imperfect data, find the signal and turn it into a decision.

• Clear communication: you can explain complex work simply to team members, specialists and senior client stakeholders.

• Cross-functional range: you are comfortable working across content, design, analytics, projects, product, engineering and service delivery.

• Systems thinking: you improve the mechanism behind the work rather than relying on repeated manual effort or individual heroics.

• Practical AI fluency: you use AI and agents to improve real operating loops, validate the output and drive adoption.

• Pace and resilience: you can stay calm, make decisions and reorganise the work when priorities change quickly.

• Attention to detail: you notice the small errors, weak handoffs and missing ownership that become larger problems later.

• Genuine interest in basketball and sport: you understand how live games, tentpoles, player news and the shape of a season change operational priorities.

Helpful Experience

Relevant experience may come from client operations, delivery leadership, content or publishing operations, programme management, product operations, support operations, media, sport or another high-volume environment.

We care more about what you have actually led, decided and improved than a particular job title. Strong candidates will be able to show:

• Responsibility for direct reports and difficult people decisions;

• Ownership of several simultaneous workstreams across different disciplines;

• A consequential decision made from incomplete evidence;

• A process, system or operating model they materially improved;

• An example of helping specialists or functional leaders deliver better;

• A capability gap they closed through clearer ownership, process change or hiring; and

• Practical AI use that improved a measurable outcome.

What This Role Is Not

• A product manager responsible for designing the client's app or owning its roadmap.

• A conventional account director focused mainly on relationships, renewals and expansion.

• A creative director replacing the design lead.

• A project coordinator who records actions but does not own outcomes.

• A specialist expected to personally perform every kind of work on the account.

Recruitment Process

• An initial conversation about the role and your relevant evidence.

• A time-boxed practical operational exercise. Sensible AI use is allowed and expected.

• A live discussion of your work, including a changed constraint that requires you to adapt the plan.

The process is designed to test how you organise complexity, lead people, use evidence, communicate and make decisions in practice.

What's In It For You

We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:

• Rewards: Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

Get in touch

Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.

• Margin and cost awareness: has tracked estimated vs. actual cost and acted early on deviations

• Strong risk management: identifies, logs, assigns, and mitigates risks before they become escalations

Contract and engagement setup

Once the deal is signed, turn the contract into an integrated delivery plan with the PMO, coordinate with Casting & Recruiting on team readiness, and map internal and external stakeholders, responsibilities, and processes.

Kickoff and ways of working

Agree with the client on communication channels, delivery workflow, validation, and sign-off. Onboard them to our engagement model so we share language and expectations. Support PMs in presenting delivery structure, escalation paths, customer responsibilities, milestone roadmap, and KPIs, and make sure they have the templates, dashboards, and tooling to act as one front.

Strategic client management

Run monthly or quarterly progress, risk, and status reviews. Monitor client satisfaction across all projects. Delivery health and margin

Coordinate delivery across multiple projects and teams. Make sure change requests are properly estimated and risk-reviewed. Protect delivery margin by keeping costs close to estimates. Ensure training, documentation, and handoff plans match client expectations.

Continuous improvement

Run post-mortems and capture lessons learned. Propose and implement improvements to the delivery process, and drive standardization and best practices across projects through the vertical leads.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:
As an Onboarding Project Manager, you will lead complex onboarding projects for Cloudbeds' mid-market customers, guiding them from contract signature through adoption and successful transition to Account Management at the time onboarding is completed. Acting as the strategic lead throughout the onboarding journey, you will partner cross-functionally with Onboarding, Account Management, Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services teams to deliver a seamless implementation experience that drives customer confidence, platform adoption, and measurable business outcomes.
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers realize value quickly by managing timelines, aligning stakeholders, mitigating risks, and maintaining a high-touch customer experience. This role combines project management, customer partnership and relationship management, operational excellence, and hospitality expertise in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:
Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping hoteliers succeed with Cloudbeds from day one. We build together, review opportunities together, and embrace a test-and-learn mindset that encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Every team member is valued and empowered to share feedback, ideas, and insights so we can learn, grow, and improve both as individuals and as a team. Team members who thrive here are proactive communicators, collaborative problem-solvers, and true customer advocates who enjoy navigating complexity while working closely with others to drive successful outcomes.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

• Own and manage the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle for mid-market customers, from sales handoff through go-live, adoption, and transition to Account Management

• Define project scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful and timely implementations

• Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding mid-market customers, driving clear communication and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle

• Lead customer meetings, including pre-kickoff, kickoff, project check-ins, and go-live milestones, while documenting action items and next steps

• Proactively identify and manage risks, dependencies, and escalation points to maintain project momentum and customer satisfaction

• Coordinate cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Onboarding, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management teams

• Monitor onboarding success metrics, customer adoption, training completion, and utilization milestones to support long-term customer success

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀:

• Fluency in English and Spanish at a business-professional level, both written and spoken

• Minimum 4 years of experience in hotel operations or hotel management

• At least 1 year of project management experience within a SaaS or customer-facing environment

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and organization

• Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving projects through completion in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication, relationship management, and customer-facing presentation skills

• Ability to proactively solve problems, manage ambiguity, and adapt quickly to changing customer and business needs

𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁 (𝗢𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹):

• At least 1 year of project management experience within a hospitality SaaS environment

• Previous experience with customer implementation & onboarding at a hospitality SAAS company

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, or other customer operations tools

• Fluency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

postings.title: Manager, Implementation
postings.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Implementation

Overview

• In a customer-facing environment, lead a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from both MasterCard and our customer

• Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.

• Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?

• Have you good knowledge about electronic payment and related processes such as authorization, clearing and settlement?

• Are you able to cope with a fast changing and ambiguous environment?

Role

• Act as central point of contact for customers and/ or MasterCard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.

• Assess and document customer needs and according to implementation impacts on customers’ and MasterCard’s core and non-core processing systems and platforms.

• Define scope, plan and drive customer processing implementation projects of new electronic payments processing business activities following the global project coordination methodology.

• Act as processing implementation advisor, to customers’ processing support staff. Provide guidance to execute all necessary processing implementation activities

• Execute extensive and comprehensive initial end-to-end processing system impact analyses for multiple key customer processing implementation projects in parallel.

• Provide internal and customer training.

All About You

• Relevant experience in “Information Technology” system knowledge, with strong understanding of network technology, applications, and project management.

• Strong payment transaction processing and industry business principles knowledge.

• Strong understanding of MasterCard’s payment processing systems, formats and associated customer host interface testing services and principles.

• Ability to interact well with the customer, Sr. and Executive management

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to leverage these skills in a teaching environment

• Strong project management skills

• Ability to drive change in a technical work environment

• Ability to lead matrix organizations and cross functional teams

• Self-Starter with ability to work independently

• High English proficiency is required

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

postings.title: Customer Support Manager - AgTech / Tecnología Agrícola
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the LATAM support team

• Hire your team: Hire, onboard, and develop Halter's first Support Specialists in South America, in line with growth plans.

• Drive performance: Set clear expectations and drive performance through team routines, coaching, and accountability.

• Set the culture: Build a high-performance culture from day one - one that reflects Halter's standards and serves the region well.

Stay close to customers and the field teams

• Get on ranch: Spend time on ranch with producers to deeply understand their workflows, challenges, and how Support can lift the end-to-end experience.

• Partner with the field team: Spend time with the field team to understand their customers' experiences with support, and use those insights to keep improving.

• Step in when it counts: Step in on complex or high-impact customer issues, and use those moments to coach the team.

• Champion the region: Carry the voice of the South American producer and their animals into every internal conversation - you're the region's advocate.

Own performance and operations

• Run daily operations: Execute the global support strategy across LATAM, turning strategy into clear, repeatable daily operations.

• Own the numbers: Own regional KPIs including CSAT, response times, quality, and cost to serve.

• Use data: Use data daily to understand trends, prioritise work, improve the customer experience, identify risks, and lift team performance.

• Build reporting: Build and maintain reporting that highlights trends, risks, and opportunities for smarter ways of working.

• Stay aligned with the field: Work closely with Territory Managers and Account Managers to stay aligned on customer health and act fast when things need attention.

• Drive proactive support: Lead proactive support initiatives including education content, risk identification, and customer outreach.

• Raise the bar: Continuously lift the standard of support through clarity, coaching, and operational improvements.

Partner with the global Customer team to build for the region

• Lean on global: Partner with global Customer leaders who have built support operations in New Zealand, Australia, and the US - and feed your learnings back into the global playbook.

• Feed back to Product: Provide feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in regional context, trends, and escalation patterns - a key part of how we make Halter work for South America.

• Represent the region: Represent the voice of the South American customer in global planning, forecasting, and improvement work.

• Improve the AI: Work with the AI team to improve automation quality and ensure seamless transitions from AI to human support and optimisation of daily workflows for both customers and the support team.

Who Are We Looking For

• 3+ years experience leading and developing teams in a customer-facing environment - support, operations, hospitality, or anywhere people and quality outcomes matter.

• Full professional fluency in Spanish and English - you're equally comfortable switching between both.

• A builder's mentality: comfortable with ambiguity and energised by standing things up from zero.

• A track record of owning outcomes, not just executing tasks.

• An understanding of the ranching or livestock industry - ideally with familiarity across the South American beef or dairy sector in Argentina, Uruguay, or Brazil.

• Strong judgment and comfort making decisions when priorities shift.

• A high bar for quality and customer experience.

• The ability to move between hands-on problem-solving and leadership in the same day.

• Clear, calm communication that builds trust quickly.

• Curiosity and an improvement mindset - you're always looking for ways to raise the standard.

• Confidence operating independently while staying aligned with a global organisation.

English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you.

NICE TO HAVES

• Experience launching or scaling a new market, region, or 0-to-1 motion.

• Startup or high-growth environment experience.

• Familiarity with tools like Intercom, Salesforce, or similar systems.

• Experience working in ag-tech.

• Experience working with hardware products or field-deployed technology.

• Portuguese language skills.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"
