postings.title: Renewals Sales Manager, Americas
postings.descriptionText:
Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a regional sales renewal team manager in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

• Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

• High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

• Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

• Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

• Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual team bookings quota within their territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagements or, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness in managing their team. They will need to coach, mentor and lead by example. Their sales representatives are expected to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region.

What your day will look like

• Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting

• Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team

• Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account-based marketing and prospecting

• Ensure that sales representatives have high quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects

• Monitor new pipeline development by your team, through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events

• Support contract closure to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets

• Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives

• Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities

• Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce

• Represent the company, its solutions and software

What we are looking for in you

• Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science

• Leadership and management skill

• Experience of open source technology and solutions

• Detail oriented with effective planning, organisation and reporting skill

• Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution

• Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins

• Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team

• Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market

• Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

• Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech

• Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team meetings in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Employee Assistance Program

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Sr. Industry Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. postings.title: Concierge Manager Position - Latin America (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

• Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,

• Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders

• Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception

• Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

• Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities

• Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client

• Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need

• Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

• Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up

• Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment

• Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations

• Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

• Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team

• Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively

• Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation

• Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

• Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale

• Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations

• Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

• 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset

• 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines

• Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work

• A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards

• Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership

• Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

• Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs

• Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms

• A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs

• Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones

• Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

• Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove

• Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them

• Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client

• Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium

• Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

• We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers

• Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback

• A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you

• A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

• Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance

• Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late

• A global team with talented colleagues across continents

• Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

• Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry

• How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making

• Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations

• Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

• Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win

• Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours

• Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust

• Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it

• Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?

If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

• Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?

• Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?

• Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?

• Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

• Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders

• Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership

• Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow

• Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices

• Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, And Benefits

Ascend is a remote-first, global team. This role is structured as a direct independent contractor engagement, with compensation being stated in USD and be paid in your local currency

As this is an independent contractor engagement, the compensation will not follow a traditional local payroll structure or salary breakup. This means statutory deductions or components or other local payroll-linked benefits are not applicable unless specifically required under the terms of engagement or communicated in writing by Ascend. Contractors are responsible for managing any applicable taxes, filings, and compliance requirements in their own location.

This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends, or public holidays depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.

The consolidated monthly compensation is designed to account for the nature of the role, including rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime, or additional hours are not applicable unless specifically communicated otherwise for a particular role.

At this stage, Ascend does not provide medical insurance, mediclaim, or similar statutory benefits for this role. Further details on leaves, schedules, contractor terms, and applicable policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.

Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About The Role

As part of the Revenue organization at DevRev, we are growing our team and hiring talented, ambitious, and AI-native Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

As an SDR at DevRev, you will operate at the intersection of sales, AI, and customer intelligence. Your mission will be to expand DevRev's customer base, generate qualified pipeline, and help shape our go-to-market strategy. Rather than relying solely on traditional prospecting methods, you will leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to identify opportunities, personalize engagement, and build meaningful relationships with prospective customers at scale.

In this role, you'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to refine messaging, uncover market insights, and continuously improve how we engage with customers.

What You'll Do

• Expand our pipeline by identifying and engaging high-quality prospects across target accounts and market segments.

• Research accounts, stakeholders, and buying signals using AI-powered tools and modern prospecting techniques.

• Build personalized outreach campaigns across email, phone, text, social, and emerging channels.

• Set up introductory meetings with target influencers and key decision-makers.

• Qualify prospects by understanding their business challenges, priorities, and goals.

• Partner with Account Executives to develop account strategies and create high-quality pipeline opportunities.

• Leverage AI-assisted workflows to increase productivity while maintaining thoughtful, high-quality engagement.

• Develop, test, and optimize messaging, prompts, and prospecting playbooks to improve conversion rates.

• Analyze prospect interactions, engagement data, and market trends to continuously improve targeting and outreach effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate pipeline data and account information within DevRev's CRM.

• Act as the voice of the market by sharing customer insights, objections, and feedback with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Revenue teams.

• Stay current on emerging AI technologies, sales methodologies, and industry trends to continuously evolve your prospecting approach.

What We're Looking For

• BA/BS degree or equivalent educational or professional experience.

• Prior experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), Account Executive (AE), or similar customer-facing role.

• Experience selling SaaS, technology, or IT-related products.

• Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Outplay, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar technologies to support research, personalization, and workflow optimization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to combine AI-generated insights with human judgment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.

• A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to experiment and learn quickly.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly collaborative environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Genuine ability to build trust and connect deeply with people.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

• You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how businesses operate.

• You embrace AI as a force multiplier and continuously look for ways to work smarter and create more value.

• You are highly coachable and eager to learn.

• You enjoy experimenting, measuring results, and iterating quickly.

• You are resilient, resourceful, and energized by building something from the ground up.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

postings.title: Research Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
This Research Analyst position is a highly influential and critical component of our organization's business development strategy. You will serve as the primary intelligence provider, driving the effectiveness and momentum of our entire sales pipeline. Your research directly informs and empowers the Lead Generation, Business Development, and Marketing Teams.
If you are an analytical thinker with impeccable attention to detail who can translate complex data into clear, actionable insights, this is the role for you. This is where the sales process begins, and your work ensures its success.

Key Responsibilities
You will conduct comprehensive, high-quality research and analysis daily, focusing on:
1. Market & Client Intelligence (The Core Research)

• Vertical Mapping: Research and interpret trends across verticals, sectors, and industries.

• Company Profiles: Deep-dive analysis of prospective clients, including:

• Financial Health: Finances, stock market data, strength, and growth opportunities.

• Strategy & Structure: Business practices, strategies, products/services, competition, and executive leadership hierarchy.

• Strategic Alliances: Identify and research potential business partners and strategic alliances.

2. Pipeline and Lead Generation

• Qualified Leads: Generate and provide highly qualified leads based on Vertical and Marketing Plan criteria.

• Marketing Insight: Deliver key details about our target audience to support and refine Marketing strategies.

• Documentation: Create clear, concise, factual, and accurate documentation of all findings for immediate team use.

3. Event and Data Management

• Event Research: Compile detailed information on relevant events (virtual, local, regional, national), including attendee lists, speakers, itinerary, and associated costs.

• Data Analysis: Conduct comprehensive analysis of documents, statistics, and data, ensuring quality and accuracy.

Skills and Attributes Required
We are looking for a candidate who is highly organized, self-driven, and results-focused.
Analytical & Technical

• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Exceptional ability to interpret data, solve problems, and provide a comprehensive outlook on research.

• Time Management: Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage time efficiently, and achieve deadlines with quality work.

• Software Proficiency: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, etc.) and information documentation processes.

Professional & Collaborative

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills —clarity and conciseness are mandatory.

• Ethics: Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.

• Attitude: Self-motivated, adaptable, results-focused, and willing to collaborate and learn new concepts.

Qualifications

• Education: High School or equivalent diploma required . A 4-year degree or a related College Diploma is preferred .

• Experience:

• Direct work experience in research is preferred .

• Direct work experience in a sales or telesales role is beneficial.

• A minimum of 1 year of BPO or call center experience is preferred.

• Candidates must be from Argentina

La empresa procedente de Nueva Zelanda lleva varios años comercializando sistemas que mejora la producción en ganadería pastoril en varias regiones ganaderas del país, con productores muy conformes por la eficiencia productiva de sus rodeos y el consecuente incremento de rentabilidad de su negocio gracias a estos sistemas implementados.

Recibirá las capacitaciones necesarias para conocer en profundidad el producto y servicio a ofrecer – los beneficios productivas, económicas y financieras - y su proceso de ventas, que es básicamente una venta consultiva, que se podrá extender en el tiempo por más de 30 o 60 días. Para sus primeros meses de trabajo, recibirá el soporte y el acompañamiento en las visitas a clientes potenciales y oportunidades abiertas en la zona descripta.

Orientamos nuestra búsqueda a una persona con verdadera pasión por la ganadería, activa y dinámica, con buen conocimiento y/o experiencia práctica en producción pastoril, experiencia que le permita entender y transmitir con total convicción, las bondades del sistema a ofrecer, que le permita al productor mejorar su eficiencia productiva y la rentabilidad de su negocio ganadero. Es ideal que la formación académica sea de Médico Veterinario, Ingeniero Zootecnista, Ing. Agrónomo o Técnico Agropecuario, que cuente con un marcado perfil relacional y que, en su trayectoria laboral, haya tenido experiencia en ventas a productores directos, es decir, que haya desarrollado su perfil comercial, por lo menos por 2 a 3 años.

Deberá estar dispuesto a realizar frecuentes viajes por la zona mencionada.

Reportará directamente al Coordinador de Ventas de la empresa y deberá interactuar con el área de Planificación de proyectos y con Finanzas.

La empresa le proveerá de movilidad para su trabajo, pc, pago de viáticos y Obra Social prepaga y ofrece un atractivo paquete remunerativo con comisiones por negocios concretados.

Residencia La ubicación ideal es Río Cuarto, Córdoba. No obstante, se considerarán candidatos residentes en La Carlota, Laboulaye, General Pico, Realicó, General Villegas y otras localidades de la zona Sur de Córdoba y Norte La Pampa.

Sauce is a premier restaurant technology platform that helps businesses grow with our Commission-Free Delivery & Pickup structure and proprietary delivery optimization technology.

We are serving a 105 billion dollar US local restaurant business. Headquartered in NYC and Tel-Aviv, Sauce wants restaurants to fulfill their highest potential, this means giving local establishments everything they need to connect directly with their customers.

The Sauce team pools together decades of restaurant tech experience, along with seasoned tech, sales, marketing, product and operations executives who produce an industry-changing delivery system for successful local restaurants and chains.

We're looking for a People & Recruitment Specialist to join People Ops. This is a dual role: you will own full-cycle recruitment across the entire organization, and carry a substantial part of a growing People Operations function. Both halves are core — this is not a recruiting seat with occasional HR tasks attached.

The role is hands-on and autonomous: you run your own searches start to finish and partner directly with executive stakeholders in the US and Israel. You'll report to the Head of People. Monday through Friday, US Eastern time.

What You'll Do:
Recruiting
Full-Cycle Ownership: Every requisition is yours from the first intake call to the signed offer — intake and scorecard definition, sourcing, screening, stakeholder coordination, offer construction and close. Nothing is handed off mid-search. This spans every function at Sauce, from entry-level sales through executive search.

Sourcing: Sourcing is the core of this desk. You build and run your own pipelines rather than working with just inbound applications - utilize outbound InMail campaigns, niche boards, referrals, talent mapping and market research. You are expected to generate qualified candidates across the US (primarily NYC and Miami), LATAM, Europe, Israel and Asia.

AI-Augmented Workflow: Use AI tooling as a core part of everyday work— resume screening, interview transcription and analysis, and drafting of ATS notes and candidate communications. We expect you to build workflows, not just use tools out of the box.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner directly with department heads and the executive team across time zones. Where external search partners are used, you brief, calibrate and hold them accountable.

Candidate Experience: Run a transparent, well-communicated process, including scheduling across US, Israeli and international calendars and clear communication on rejections and pauses.

Pipeline & Reporting: Maintain clean ATS data, build and share funnel metrics, and bring insight — not just numbers — to weekly hiring syncs.

Offers & Contracting: Prepare offers for US employees and international contractors, coordinate multi-signer signature workflows, and work with Finance on compensation structures across geographies.

People Operations
Employee Lifecycle Administration: Own the full lifecycle — onboarding, internal moves and promotions, contract and role changes, and offboarding — including communications, system access, documentation and records across every stage.

Employee Experience & Welfare: Own the practical side of employee experience: equipment provisioning and logistics, swag and gifting programs, perks and welfare initiatives, and the day-to-day requests that come with supporting a distributed team.

Culture & Engagement: Organize physical activities across our office locations and online activities for the remote population, team events, holiday and milestone celebrations, engagement surveys and internal communications.

HRIS & Systems Administration: Keep employee data accurate across HR and recruiting systems, own the ATS and HRIS as systems rather than repositories, and support recurring workforce reporting.

Employment Structures: Support hiring and ongoing administration across US employment, EOR and international contractor models, coordinating with the relevant platforms and internal stakeholders.

Policy & Compliance Support: Support policy rollout and stay current with local employment considerations across the markets we hire in.

What You Bring:

• Based in South America or Mexico

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, in-house or agency, with demonstrated ownership of searches from intake to close

• Proven sourcing ability — you can point to hires you generated yourself through outbound, not inbound applications.

• Meaningful People Operations or HR generalist experience — employee lifecycle administration, HR systems, employment administration, and hands-on employee experience work such as equipment, swag and culture activities

• Experience hiring across multiple functions and seniority levels, and internationally across time zones, including distributed or contractor-based teams

• Hands-on AI tool usage in your actual workflow, with specific examples of what you've built or automated

• Strong ATS fluency — Lever preferred; Greenhouse, Workday or similar acceptable

• HRIS familiarity — Deel preferred; Remote, Rippling, Workday or similar acceptable

• Impeccable written and spoken English — you'll be drafting candidate, stakeholder and agency communications daily and representing Sauce to senior candidates

• Comfort operating with minimal structure and managing senior stakeholders, including executives

• Strong judgment — able to make a clear recommendation on a candidate rather than presenting options without a point of view

What We Offer:

• Strong & Competitive Compensation Package

• Flexible Work Environment

• Paid Time Off Policy

• Friendly environment where you can reach your full potential and grow your career

• Challenging tasks to help you evolve as a professional

• Open minded teams for innovation and self growth

• Work from home for better work/life balance

Sauce is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability (physical or mental), gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, immigration status, or any other classification, category or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We understand the importance of creating a more diverse and inclusive workplace and celebrate our employees for their differences.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

As a key member of the Talent leadership team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering Halter’s global recruitment strategy as we scale rapidly across new and existing markets.

Reporting into the Head of Talent, you’ll lead a growing team, providing direction, coaching, and support to ensure we consistently hire exceptional people who raise the bar and align deeply with our mission and values. You’ll balance hands on recruitment delivery with team leadership, strategic planning, and continuous improvement of our recruitment engine.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating at a systems and leadership level, thrives in high-growth environments, and wants to have a meaningful influence on how a company scales, through thoughtful strategy, strong teams, and disciplined execution.

What Your Day Will Look Like

• Lead and develop a team of Recruiters across our Customer and Go To Market portfolio across South America, you’ll set clear expectations, coach for performance, and support career growth.

• Own recruitment delivery across different portfolios and functions, while ensuring the wider team delivers consistently high-quality hiring outcomes.

• Partner closely with the Head of Talent on recruitment strategy, workforce planning, and capacity modelling to support near and long term growth.

• Act as a senior partner to hiring leaders, helping them anticipate talent needs, define success profiles, and make strong, data informed hiring decisions.

• Design and evolve scalable recruitment processes, tools, and ways of working that support increasing volume without sacrificing quality.

• Upskill and enable hiring managers through structured coaching, training sessions, and real-time feedback to lift interview quality and assessment rigour.

• Help shape and refine Halter’s Employee Value Proposition, ensuring our external talent story reflects the real employee experience.

• Embed inclusive hiring practices across the team, supporting diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives in both process and outcomes.

• Represent Halter externally as a talent ambassador, at events, industry forums, and universities - strengthening our employer brand.

• Track, analyse, and share key recruitment metrics to continuously improve performance.

• Support internal mobility and long-term talent planning initiatives as the business matures.

• As a fast-moving growth company, you’ll also jump into new challenges and projects as they arise - helping shape how we scale.

Who are we looking for?

• 8+ years of experience in talent acquisition, ideally within high growth or global tech environments.

• Proven experience leading and developing a team, including setting standards, managing performance, and scaling team capability.

• Strong track record recruiting across multiple disciplines and regions (experience with software, hardware, or deeply technical roles is highly valued).

• A strategic business partner who can operate at multiple levels, from executive discussions and planning through to hands-on hiring execution.

• Demonstrated success delivering high-volume hiring without compromising on quality or candidate experience.

• Deep expertise in proactive sourcing strategies and global talent markets.

• Strong data and reporting capability; comfortable using metrics to guide decisions and improve outcomes.

• High emotional intelligence, excellent communication skills, and a calm, solutions-focused approach in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

• A natural owner, someone who takes accountability, builds trust quickly, and genuinely cares about doing recruitment exceptionally well.

Our Office First Approach

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.

Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Recruiting & Onboarding Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Recruiting & Onboarding Specialist – Stay'd

Full-time | Remote (Latin America)

Reports to : HR Director

Compensation : USD $1,400–$1,800 / month

About Stayd

Stay'd is a consortium of best-in-class short-term rental management companies building one unified brand across multiple US markets. As we grow, the team grows — and that's where you come in. You'll help find, hire, and onboard the people who power every brand in the portfolio, and make sure every hire is set up right and by the book. This is a fast, hungry culture where we move quickly and win as a team.

The Role

You'll work at the holdco level alongside our Talent & People Operations Specialist, sharing the recruiting load while taking the lead on onboarding and new-hire compliance across every company in the Stayd collective. Your time splits roughly 60% recruiting, 30% onboarding, and the rest on HR compliance and admin. On recruiting, you partner closely with the Talent & People Operations Specialist to keep pipelines full and candidates moving — this is a collaborative effort, not a solo one. Where you own the outcome is after the offer: welcoming new hires, running a smooth onboarding, getting their paperwork right, and making sure every member company stays compliant and audit-ready. You wear multiple hats, you figure things out, and you make sure no candidate, no start date, and no document slips through the cracks.

What You'll Do

Recruiting (in partnership with the Talent & People Operations Specialist)

• Partner on full-cycle recruiting — sourcing, screening, scheduling, and coordinating interviews across multiple roles, brands, and markets.

• Keep pipelines full and candidates warm and moving; divide and conquer the hiring load with the Talent & People Operations Specialist.

• Respond to applicants fast. A great candidate experience starts with speed.

• Help write and keep job descriptions and postings current.

• Keep the ATS clean and current — every candidate, every stage, every note.

Onboarding (you lead)

• Run onboarding end to end so every new hire is welcomed, informed, and productive from day one.

• Coordinate start dates, accounts, tools, and first-week setup across the relevant member company.

• Be the new hire's go-to contact through their first weeks, and hand off cleanly to their manager.

• Continuously improve the onboarding experience and documentation as we scale.

Compliance & HR Admin (you own)

• Own new-hire compliance across all Stayd member companies — collect, verify, and track I-9 documentation and ensure every form is completed correctly and on time.

• Keep employee records, offer paperwork, and onboarding documentation accurate, organized, and audit-ready.

• Stay on top of required forms and deadlines for each company, and flag gaps before they become problems.

• Support the HR Director on ad-hoc projects and process improvements as priorities shift.

What We're Tracking

• Contribution to roles filled per month and time-to-fill

• Pipeline health and candidate response time

• Onboarding completion — every new hire fully set up by day one

• Quality of hire (new hires who stick through onboarding and ramp)

• I-9 and new-hire compliance — 100% of documents completed on time and audit-ready

Who You Are

• 1–3 years in recruiting, HR, or a related field, with hands-on experience supporting hiring.

• Experience with (or a fast learner on) US new-hire compliance and paperwork — I-9s and onboarding documentation. You take compliance seriously.

• Experience hiring or onboarding for US-based teams is a plus.

• Organized and detail-obsessed — you keep trackers, records, and deadlines airtight.

• A strong collaborator who works well alongside others and shares ownership cleanly.

• AI-native or AI-curious. You use AI tools daily and reach for automation before manual work.

• Comfortable wearing multiple hats and taking on tasks outside a strict job description. Bias toward action.

• ATS-fluent and comfortable staying organized during high-volume, cross-brand hiring.

• Available to work US business hours (Eastern Time overlap) to stay in sync with the team and hiring managers.

• Excellent written and verbal English.

• Self-directed and dependable in a remote setup — reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.

Nice to Have

• Experience with HR compliance, I-9/E-Verify, or contractor documentation across multiple entities.

• Experience building or improving onboarding programs from scratch.

• Familiarity with ATS and HRIS tools, and with hiring across multiple LATAM markets.

What We Offer

• Fully remote work with a team that values autonomy and ownership.

• Direct mentorship from and close collaboration with the HR Director and the Talent & People Operations team.

• A high-impact role where your work directly shapes who joins the company and how they start.

• Room to grow as Stayd grows.

Compensation : USD $1,400–$1,800 / month

Reports To : HR Director, Stayd

By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.

postings.title: Recruiting Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

Great hiring depends on thoughtful coordination, reliable systems, and clear processes. As a Recruiting Operations Specialist , you'll own the day-to-day workflows that keep hiring moving at CookUnity, from interview scheduling and reference-check coordination to recruiting systems, data, and reporting.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition, you'll partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations across regions. You'll balance hands-on execution with practical improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen data quality, and create a smooth experience for candidates and hiring teams. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys both getting the details right and finding better ways to work.

Responsibilities

• Own interview scheduling and logistics across departments and time zones, including executive interviews, case presentations, rescheduling, preparation materials, and timely candidate communication.

• Manage the reference-check workflow, from collecting contact details and coordinating outreach, calls, and forms to tracking completion and documenting feedback in partnership with recruiters.

• Manage recruiting administration, including requisition setup, job postings, approval tracking, offer documentation, and handoffs to People Operations.

• Own day-to-day administration of Greenhouse ATS and support related recruiting tools, maintaining interview plans, scorecards, templates, and permissions, and troubleshooting issues.

• Keep recruiting data accurate and consistent through regular audits, clear standards, and timely resolution of data-quality issues.

• Maintain recurring pipeline and CRM reports, surface bottlenecks and missing feedback, and turn findings into practical recommendations.

• Improve workflows and handoffs, and use automation and AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work, testing changes and reviewing outputs carefully.

• Create clear documentation and training materials, help hiring teams adopt consistent processes, and partner on cross-functional operational improvements.

• Handle sensitive candidate and employee information with discretion and in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements.

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in recruiting operations or coordination, with demonstrated ownership of workflows and process improvements in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience supporting multiple recruiters and managing complex interview schedules across teams and time zones.

• Strong hands-on ATS experience, including workflow configuration, data management, and reporting; Greenhouse experience is strongly preferred.

• Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills, with the ability to spot inconsistencies, identify patterns, and explain what the data means.

• A track record of improving processes, documenting workflows, and helping stakeholders adopt new ways of working.

• Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the judgment to prioritize competing requests and resolve issues independently.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish, and a thoughtful approach to candidate and stakeholder relationships.

• Comfort with hands-on administrative work, curiosity about automation and AI, and discretion when handling confidential information.

Nice To Have

• Experience with Gem or recruiting CRM workflows, LinkedIn Recruiter, Canditech, or scheduling platforms.

• Experience building dashboards or recurring reports in Google Sheets or business-intelligence tools.

• Practical experience with no-code automation, system integrations, or AI-assisted workflows.

• Experience in a startup or scaleup with a lean, global Talent Acquisition team.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentine holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use with your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family Leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefits platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

Demand is completely solved through our paid advertising and in-house sales team, meaning you will never have to find a client. Your job is to run and grow the machine that delivers for them.

This is a senior seat reporting directly to the founder. You will have true ownership of the delivery side of the business and share in the financial upside as we scale.

What You Will Own

• Time-to-fill: Managing the timeline from signed client to placed candidate.
• The Bench: Maintaining a pipeline of fully screened, interview-ready candidates for our highest-volume roles.
• Team Performance: Leading an operations coordinator, recruiters/screeners, and sourcing support while establishing productivity standards and scorecards.
• Quality Control: Ensuring placement quality and 90-day retention (replacements come directly out of our margin).
• Process Optimization: Managing our ATS pipeline (JazzHR), sourcing channels, and overall candidate experience.

Your First 90 Days
• Audit the current pipeline, bench, and screening processes to identify what is working and what isn't.
• Set the fill-speed and quality standards the team will be held to, putting scorecards in place to track them.
• Rebuild the candidate bench so a signed client is never waiting on sourcing.
• Establish a daily and weekly operating rhythm that keeps every open search moving.

Who You Are
• 5–10+ years in recruitment with real leadership experience (ran an agency, branch, or perm desk with P&L or billings responsibility).
• Experienced in managing recruiters and holding a firm quality bar under speed pressure.
• Highly data-driven: you know your placements per month, fill times, and fall-off rates cold.
• Calm, structured, decisive, and ruthless with prioritization—you don't drop balls.
• Comfortable working US-aligned hours remotely.
• Proficient in leveraging AI tools to screen, source, and move faster.
• A builer at heart: comfortable rewriting broken processes or scaling a half-built function.
• Experience placing into US, UK, or Australian clients is strongly preferred.

Why You Should Join Us
• No Red Tape: Work directly with the founder. Decisions get made in a conversation, giving you a direct line to strategy and hiring.
• Zero Client Acquisition: Inherit a paid-ads and sales engine that already produces signed clients so you can focus entirely on delivery.
• Massive Upside: Beyond base and performance bonuses, this role is on a path to a profit-share incentive. Build the machine and share in what it produces.
• Premium Positioning: We charge top-of-market fees, allowing us to hire well, pay well, and maintain elite standards.
• Global & Remote: Join a 100+ person team across South Africa, the Philippines, and Latin America with no commute and US-dollar earnings.
• Room to Build: Shape how our role expansion happens rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

How to Apply
Along with your CV, provide a video introduction telling us:

1. How many placements per month your desk or team made.

2. Your average time-to-fill.

3. The biggest operational problem you fixed in a recruitment business.

Note: Candidates who know their numbers cold will move fastest through our process.

postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Strategic Sourcing Lead, you’ll lead a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields.

This is a strategic, hands-on role within Fulfillment. You’ll define how the hub operates, develop the team, and partner with Recruitment and Delivery to build sourcing strategies ranging from complex searches to high-volume scaling. The team will work in a data-informed and AI-enabled environment, using technology to enhance research, outreach, analysis, and sourcing efficiency.

Your Impact

• Design and execute creative sourcing strategies for specialized, hard-to-reach, and high-volume needs.

• Partner with Recruitment and Delivery to assess requirements, sourcing feasibility, and project needs.

• Build relationships with production stakeholders and communicate risks, timelines, and expectations.

• Use sourcing and conversion data to identify bottlenecks, test approaches, and improve funnel performance.

• Embed AI and automation into sourcing workflows to improve research, outreach, analysis, efficiency, and scalability.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in sourcing, recruitment, talent acquisition, or a related field.

• Experience leading or mentoring sourcing teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across teams.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide sourcing decisions.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to Haves

• Experience sourcing for AI, data, or crowdsourcing projects.

• Experience sourcing linguists, translators, or other language profiles across markets.

• Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

• Flexibility to work regular U.S. hours or provide U.S. overlap when working in a different time zone.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Business Solutions Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a Toptal Business Solutions Specialist, you will be working directly with Toptal’s clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with Management Consultants from our talent network, and provide support during the matching process, throughout the engagement, and beyond.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Gather requirements and consult with clients to ensure needs are understood.

• Define job descriptions, talent responsibilities, and requirements.

• Search talent profiles, shortlist candidates, and send availability requests.

• Confirm talent availability, screen job applications, and select candidates.

• Introduce candidates to clients, communicating technical and cultural fit.

• Customize talent rates, adjust commitment types, and schedule engagement dates.

• Obtain feedback on talent and maintain detailed platform documentation.

• Provide advice and guidance to Management Consultants in the network.

• Investigate disputes and collaborate cross-functionally in the resolution process.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.

• Familiarize yourself with the team’s tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.

• Shadow matching calls and learn about the matching process with your TopPal.

In the first month, expect to:

• Take on your first clients and manage their engagements with Toptal.

• Learn about supporting teams and how they contribute to the company’s success.

• Work closely with individual Management Consultants and our talent network.

• Become proficient with Toptal’s platform.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Matching, Sales, and Talent Operations.

• Build a mature client portfolio.

• Establish direct connections with top talents in our network.

• Resolve any client-talent disputes which may arise in your client portfolio.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Become eligible to take on Toptal’s major accounts, including top-tier brands and clients.

• Understand best practices and share effective strategies with the team.

In the first year, expect to:

• Act as a subject matter expert on management consulting matching.

• Continue to promote an environment of teamwork and collaboration.

• Offer insights and ways to improve the success of a Matching lifecycle based on feedback, experience, and data insights.

• Have started taking on initiatives to improve operations, establishing the needed infrastructure for scale.

• Participate in onboarding newcomers and helping them learn about best practices.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s Degree is required.

• Full-time availability during EST or PST working hours.

• 5+ years in Management Consulting (top-tier, or reputable boutique firm), or equivalent strategic advisory experience.

• Hands-on experience across multiple consulting practices — e.g., strategy, finance, operations, marketing, people/HR, and technology — or a strong generalist track record spanning several of these areas.

• Strong adaptability to learn and execute in new areas of expertise — e.g., Product Management, Project Management, Design, Digital Marketing.

• Ability to understand ambiguous business needs and translate them to a consultant’s responsibilities and skills.

• Excellent communication, relationship development and emotional intelligence skills to qualify a consulting project, and to assess fit with the best consultant or team of consultants.

• Understanding of business strategy and management consulting concepts, playbooks and frameworks (MBA is an advantage but not required).

• Ability to quickly adopt new processes and technologies.

• Ability to adhere to tight deadlines and thrive under pressure.

• Strong strategic thinking skills.

• Self-starter who can execute with limited guidance.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

For Toptal Use Only: #southamerica #centralamerica

Coordinar y ejecutar la gestión integral de recursos humanos de la organización, con foco en la administración de personal y el cumplimiento de la normativa laboral, vigente en Argentina. El rol asegura la correcta ejecución de los procesos de altas, bajas, novedades y liquidación de haberes, y lidera el proceso de reclutamiento y selección, brindando soporte a empleados y a las distintas áreas del Hotel.

• Responsabilidades principales

2.1 Administración de personal

Altas de personal

• Gestionar el proceso completo de ingreso: recolección y validación de documentación (DNI, CUIL, domicilio, estudios, datos de familiares a cargo, CBU, etc.).

• Gestionar la Alta Temprana con el Estudio Contable en tiempo y forma, previo al inicio de la relación laboral.

• Coordinar exámenes preocupacionales y la entrega de elementos de protección personal y documentación de ingreso.

• Confeccionar contratos de trabajo y su documentación asociada, y armar y mantener actualizado el legajo del empleado.

• Encuadrar correctamente a cada trabajador (categoría, convenio colectivo aplicable, jornada, antigüedad).

Bajas de personal

• Gestionar los distintos tipos de egreso: renuncia, despido con y sin causa, mutuo acuerdo, vencimiento de contrato, jubilación y fallecimiento.

• Tramitar a través del Estudio Contable la Baja ante ARCA.

• Controlar la liquidación final: días trabajados, SAC proporcional, vacaciones no gozadas e indemnizaciones (preaviso, integración del mes de despido, antigüedad, etc.), según corresponda.

postings.title: Talent Partner
postings.descriptionText:
The Role

We're looking for a Talent Partner who brings operator-level credibility to technical recruiting. You'll be the strategic force behind search execution for PCT's clients — companies ranging from pre-seed to pre-IPO — partnering directly with founders and technical leaders to hire exceptional engineering and technical talent.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives with autonomy, has a high bar for quality of hire, and is energized by building repeatable yet flexible recruiting processes across different company stages and hiring contexts.

Note: This role is fully remote, but will require on average 4-5 hours of overlap a day within the 9-6pm PT timezone due to client, team, and candidate overlap.

What You'll Own

• End-to-End Search Execution: Lead full-cycle technical searches across Engineering and adjacent functions (Product, Design, Data, Security, QA) for PCT clients

• Stakeholder Partnership: Partner directly with founders and VP-level leaders to qualify roles, align on hiring criteria, and move searches forward with urgency

• Process Architecture: Build and coach clients through structured, high-signal interview processes — especially when working with first-time hiring managers

• Market Intelligence: Conduct deep talent mapping and competitive analysis to identify where the best candidates are and how to reach them

• Pipeline Development: Create innovative sourcing strategies that go beyond inbound and referrals to build diverse, high-quality candidate pipelines

• Candidate Assessment: Screen and evaluate senior+ technical talent with the judgment to know what separates good from great

• Data & Reporting: Track pipeline health, pass-through rates, and search progress — using data to optimize your approach and communicate clearly with clients

• Collaboration: Work closely with PCT's Technical Sourcers to align on targeting strategy and move searches efficiently

What You'll Bring

• Experience: You've spent the majority of your career in technical recruiting inside product-led or SaaS companies. You've owned senior and staff+ searches end-to-end and have the credibility to walk into a room with a CTO and immediately earn their trust

• Scope: You've hired across Engineering and at least a few adjacent technical functions — Product, Design, Data, Security, or QA. You're not a generalist, but you're not one-dimensional either

• Autonomy: You don't need someone to tell you how to prioritize your day. You're used to managing multiple searches simultaneously and making judgment calls without hand-holding

• High Bar: You've worked somewhere with a genuinely high talent bar and can articulate — concisely — what separates a strong candidate from an exceptional one

• Sourcing Chops: Boolean search, talent mapping, and high-volume outreach are native to your workflow, not tasks you outsource

• Communication: Strong written communication skills. You can synthesize a search update, write a compelling candidate message, or brief a founder — all with clarity and efficiency

• Tools: Comfortable in an ATS (Ashby experience a plus, but not required) and curious about how AI and new tooling can sharpen your workflow

This Role Probably Isn't for You If:

• You only know how to source on LinkedIn Recruiter. We don't use legacy tools- we are building our own and testing the newest ones on the market that drive towards outcomes

• If you haven't been using AI tools daily and are only familiar with ChatGPT

• You're a hiring generalist who hasn't gone deep on technical recruiting

• You need significant ramp time before operating independently with senior stakeholders

• The majority of your experience is in high-volume or early-career hiring

• You're coming in with a fixed playbook and aren't excited to think from first principles

• You want heavy structure and frequent direction — we give you ownership, not a checklist

Contract Terms

This is a contract-to-hire position with strong potential for permanent conversion based on performance and business needs. PCT believes in growing with talented people who are committed to building exceptional teams. Competitive compensation provided with placement-based bonuses.
