postings.title: Head of Human Resources
postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition. That’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re scaling rapidly, and we need a Head of HR who can build the people, processes, and performance systems to support our next stage of growth.

We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and believe exceptional teams are built by people who take ownership and continuously raise the bar. We're looking for a leader who brings that same energy to building an organization where talented people can do their best work.

Why This Role Matters

Great companies aren't built by hiring great people alone. They're built by creating an environment where those people can thrive, perform, and grow.

As our Head of HR, you'll be responsible for building the people infrastructure that enables High Scale to scale efficiently while maintaining a high-performance culture.

This isn't a traditional HR role focused solely on policies and administrative processes. We're looking for a strategic, hands-on leader who understands how to connect people operations with business performance.

You'll work directly with executive leadership to strengthen our organizational structure, develop performance management systems, improve employee engagement, and establish scalable HR processes across the company.

From implementing KPI frameworks and building leadership development programs to improving employee retention and optimizing our recruitment strategy, you'll play a critical role in shaping how High Scale operates.

If you're energized by building systems, developing people, solving complex organizational challenges, and creating measurable business impact, this is an opportunity to help shape the future of a rapidly growing company.

What You'll Do

Build a Scalable HR Infrastructure

• Evaluate existing HR operations and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

• Develop and implement comprehensive HR policies, SOPs, and standardized workflows across the employee lifecycle.

• Establish structured processes for onboarding, employee development, performance reviews, promotions, compensation reviews, and offboarding.

• Implement HR systems and automation tools that reduce administrative work and improve operational efficiency.

• Ensure HR practices support organizational growth while maintaining compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations.

Develop a High-Performance Culture

• Design and implement company-wide performance management frameworks that connect individual contributions to organizational objectives.

• Partner with department leaders to establish clear KPIs, measurable expectations, and accountability systems.

• Build structured performance review processes, including regular evaluations, feedback mechanisms, and performance improvement plans.

• Establish recognition and development programs that reward meaningful contributions and encourage continuous improvement.

• Create an environment where employees understand what success looks like and have the tools and support to achieve it.

Lead Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

• Develop recruitment strategies that support the company's current and future hiring needs.

• Partner with leadership to identify critical roles, workforce requirements, and organizational gaps.

• Oversee the recruitment team to ensure efficient hiring processes, strong candidate pipelines, and an exceptional candidate experience.

• Establish recruiting KPIs, including time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, offer acceptance rates, and employee retention.

• Strengthen employer branding initiatives to attract professionals who align with High Scale's culture and business objectives.

Strengthen Employee Engagement & Retention

• Develop initiatives that improve employee satisfaction, engagement, and long-term retention.

• Implement structured feedback systems, employee surveys, and engagement assessments.

• Analyze turnover trends, identify underlying organizational challenges, and develop actionable retention strategies.

• Establish clear career progression frameworks and professional development opportunities.

• Build strong relationships across departments and create an environment where employees feel supported, challenged, and motivated to succeed.

Develop Leaders & Strengthen Organizational Effectiveness

• Partner with executive leadership to design organizational structures that support business growth.

• Coach managers on effective leadership, performance management, employee development, and conflict resolution.

• Identify leadership development opportunities and implement programs that strengthen management capabilities.

• Establish succession planning frameworks for critical positions.

• Support organizational change initiatives while maintaining clear communication and employee alignment.

Drive Data-Driven HR Decisions

• Develop HR dashboards and reporting systems that provide leadership with visibility into workforce performance.

• Track key people metrics, including employee turnover, retention, recruitment efficiency, absenteeism, and engagement.

• Analyze workforce data to identify trends, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Establish regular reporting and review processes with executive leadership.

• Translate HR insights into actionable strategies that improve organizational performance.

Who You Are

Experienced HR Leader

You have 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HR leadership or management position.

You've successfully led HR operations, developed people strategies, and implemented systems that support organizational growth.

Experience in BPO, shared services, professional services, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

You have a strong understanding of talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, organizational development, and HR compliance.

Strategic Thinker & Hands-On Builder

You understand that HR is a strategic business function, not simply an administrative department.

You're equally comfortable developing a long-term people strategy and rolling up your sleeves to solve an immediate operational challenge.

You enjoy building processes from the ground up and transforming fragmented workflows into structured, scalable systems.

You recognize opportunities for improvement and know how to turn ideas into measurable results.

Performance & Systems Driven

You have hands-on experience designing and implementing KPI frameworks, employee performance management systems, and HR operational processes.

You're comfortable using workforce analytics and business metrics to guide decision-making.

Experience with HRIS platforms, applicant tracking systems, performance management software, and workflow automation tools is highly valued.

Knowledge of organizational development, continuous improvement, and change management methodologies is a strong advantage.

Influential People Leader

You communicate confidently with executives, department heads, managers, and employees at every level.

You know how to navigate challenging conversations, resolve conflicts, and build trust while maintaining accountability.

You can balance employee advocacy with business priorities and make thoughtful decisions that support both.

You lead by example, develop the people around you, and understand how to build a team that consistently delivers results.

Thrives in High-Growth Environments

You see organizational challenges as opportunities to create something better.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and making decisions in an environment where things move quickly.

You don't wait for problems to escalate before addressing them. You anticipate organizational needs, bring solutions to the table, and take ownership of moving initiatives forward.

You bring energy and enthusiasm to your work and inspire others to embrace change, take on new challenges, and continuously improve.

Strong Business Acumen

You understand how people decisions affect productivity, operational efficiency, profitability, and long-term business growth.

You can translate business objectives into practical HR initiatives and communicate their value to executive leadership.

You know how to balance ambitious organizational goals with the realities of building and maintaining a healthy, sustainable workforce.

Perks & Benefits

Shape the Future of High Scale

Build the people strategy, organizational structure, and HR systems that will support the company's next stage of growth.

Direct Executive Partnership

Work closely with executive leadership to influence company-wide decisions, develop organizational strategies, and drive meaningful business improvements.

Build a High-Performance Organization

Create performance management systems, leadership development programs, and employee experiences that help talented people reach their full potential.

Real Ownership & Autonomy

Take ownership of the HR function with the opportunity to introduce new ideas, challenge existing processes, and implement meaningful organizational improvements.

Leadership & Career Growth

Play a central role in scaling an international organization, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the business grows.

A Culture That Embraces Innovation

Join an ambitious, collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, creative problem-solving, and the willingness to take on challenges that drive the company forward.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe that exceptional organizations are built by people with different experiences, perspectives, and ideas. If you're passionate about developing people, building scalable systems, and creating a high-performance culture that drives meaningful business results, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Chief - Human Resources
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Human Resources Chief , you’re not just leading the hotel’s HR function – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities & Position Objective: Responsible for leading and managing the hotel’s Human Resources operations, ensuring the effective administration of recruitment, development, training, compensation, employee relations, internal communications, and organizational culture processes. This role promotes a positive work environment aligned with Hilton’s standards and programs, contributing to Team Member satisfaction, compliance with applicable labor laws, and the achievement of the hotel’s business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Recruitment and Selection

• Lead end-to-end recruitment and selection processes across all organizational levels.

• Coordinate interviews, assessments, and onboarding processes.

• Build relationships with universities, educational institutions, job boards, and recruitment agencies.

• Ensure vacancies are filled promptly while maintaining high selection standards.

• Personnel Administration and Payroll

• Coordinate and oversee payroll processing by preparing, validating, and submitting payroll updates to the external payroll provider or responsible department.

• Manage personnel files, employment documentation, and mandatory records.

• Monitor hires, terminations, contractual amendments, and other personnel changes.

• Ensure compliance with current labor legislation and the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement.

• Employee and Labor Relations

• Serve as the main point of contact for resolving individual and collective labor issues.

• Advise leaders on disciplinary matters and people management.

• Coordinate disciplinary procedures, ensuring compliance with corporate policies and applicable legislation.

• Maintain professional and constructive relationships with union representatives and relevant authorities.

• Training and Development

• Develop and implement the Annual Training Plan.

• Identify training needs in collaboration with each department’s leaders.

• Coordinate Hilton corporate training programs, as well as internal and external training activities.

• Measure the effectiveness of the training programs implemented.

• Maintain up-to-date Team Member training records.

• Performance and Talent Management

• Coordinate the annual Performance Review process.

• Ensure compliance with corporate performance review timelines.

• Advise leaders on setting objectives and developing individual development plans.

• Participate in succession planning and talent development processes.

• Develop and monitor the hotel’s annual People Plan.

• Hilton Programs and Culture

• Lead the implementation and monitoring of Hilton’s corporate programs.

• Coordinate Team Member recognition, well-being, and engagement initiatives.

• Promote Hilton’s culture and values, as well as diversity and inclusion initiatives.

• Manage Team Member engagement activities and corporate celebrations.

• Organizational Climate and Internal Communications

• Design and implement initiatives aimed at strengthening the workplace environment.

• Coordinate monthly meetings with Team Members.

• Analyze engagement and satisfaction indicators.

• Promote effective communication channels across all levels of the organization.

• Lead initiatives that foster a positive and collaborative work environment.

• Budgeting and Management Control

• Prepare the annual budget for Human Resources expenses.

• Develop the payroll budget in collaboration with the Finance department.

• Prepare periodic forecasts and monitor budget performance.

• Manage and optimize expenses related to training, benefits, events, uniforms, and other HR-related items.

• Analyze Human Resources management indicators and prepare reports for senior management.

• Benefits and Vendor Management

• Manage relationships with Human Resources vendors.

• Administer Team Member benefits, including health insurance, other insurance coverage, and corporate programs.

• Negotiate and oversee contracts and services related to the department.

• Monitor vendors’ compliance with service-level agreements.

• Confidentiality and Compliance

• Manage and safeguard confidential information related to Team Members, compensation, performance reviews, and legal matters.

• Ensure compliance with privacy and data-protection policies.

• Ensure compliance with Hilton’s corporate policies, internal audit requirements, and applicable legal obligations.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

Specific Knowledge, Skills And/or Abilities

• Knowledge of various methods used to conduct and manage needs assessments.

• Knowledge of adult learning theories and the essential elements of training.

• Knowledge of training program development methods.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Written English proficiency for preparing reports and training materials, as well as the ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English with employees and management at all levels.

• Ability to observe Team Members in the workplace, analyze operations, and identify issues related to departmental practices, Team Member performance, training needs, and compliance with policies.

Qualifications And Skills Standards

Education

• University degree or studies in a related field, such as Educational Psychology, Psychology, Labor Relations, or Education.

Experience

• At least two years of experience in training and development positions within service-oriented companies, preferably in the hospitality industry.

• Previous experience leading a Training and Development department will be considered an asset.

Licenses or Certifications

• None required.

Personal Appearance

• All Team Members must maintain a neat, clean, and professional appearance in accordance with established grooming standards.

Other Requirements

• Bilingual English proficiency preferred.

• Leadership skills.

• Excellent interpersonal skills.

• Creativity.

• Planning and organizational skills.

• Strong negotiation skills.

• Teamwork.

• Effective communication skills.

• Business acumen.

Note

The hospitality industry requires operations 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Additionally, as this is a service-oriented business, a hospitable and service-focused attitude must be demonstrated at all times.

All Team Members must fully comply with Hilton’s policies and regulations to ensure the efficient operation of the hotel’s facilities. Team Members who violate these policies and regulations may be subject to disciplinary action.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

postings.title: Gerente de Recursos Humanos
postings.descriptionText:
🎯 Misión del Puesto

Liderar integralmente la estrategia y gestión de Recursos Humanos de Reino Homecenter, asegurando que las políticas, procesos y prácticas de personas acompañen los objetivos del negocio, el crecimiento de la compañía y el desarrollo de una cultura orientada a resultados. Actuar como socio estratégico de la Dirección y de los líderes, garantizando una gestión profesional, cercana, medible y alineada con los valores de Reino y el concepto “Ser Protagonistas”.

📊 Estrategia y Gestión de Recursos Humanos

• Diseñar y ejecutar el Plan Anual de Recursos Humanos alineado con los objetivos estratégicos y el presupuesto de la compañía.

• Asesorar al CEO, Dirección y Gerencias en decisiones de estructura, dotación, desempeño, compensaciones, desarrollo y relaciones laborales.

• Analizar la estructura organizacional y proponer mejoras en puestos, responsabilidades, líneas de reporte y dimensionamiento de equipos.

• Definir y monitorear indicadores de gestión de RRHH, presentando información ejecutiva y planes de acción.

📋 Administración de Personal y Relaciones Laborales

• Garantizar la correcta administración de altas, bajas, novedades, liquidaciones, licencias, vacaciones, ausentismo y documentación laboral.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de la legislación laboral, convenios colectivos, políticas internas y procedimientos de la compañía.

• Gestionar sanciones, desvinculaciones, conflictos y contingencias laborales, articulando con asesores legales cuando corresponda.

• Identificar riesgos laborales y establecer acciones preventivas y correctivas.

👥 Selección, Dotación y Estructura

• Definir junto con las áreas las necesidades de dotación y prioridades de incorporación.

• Liderar la estrategia de Reclutamiento y Selección para posiciones operativas, administrativas, profesionales, jefaturas y gerenciales.

• Validar perfiles, descripciones de puesto, propuestas económicas e incorporaciones.

• Supervisar inducciones y evaluaciones de período de prueba, asegurando seguimiento y calidad de ingreso.

💰 Compensaciones y Beneficios

• Diseñar y administrar políticas de compensaciones y beneficios, procurando equidad interna, competitividad externa y sustentabilidad económica.

• Participar en revisiones salariales, promociones, ajustes y propuestas económicas.

• Analizar costos laborales y el impacto de las decisiones de dotación y beneficios.

🎓 Capacitación, Desarrollo y Desempeño

• Diseñar y liderar el Plan Anual de Capacitación y Desarrollo y la Escuela de Formación.

• Impulsar programas de liderazgo, competencias técnicas, cultura y habilidades de gestión.

• Implementar herramientas de evaluación de desempeño, feedback, planes de mejora y desarrollo de talento.

• Promover planes de sucesión y desarrollo para posiciones críticas.

💬 Cultura, Comunicación y Clima

• Promover la cultura y los valores de Reino Homecenter, fortaleciendo “Ser Protagonistas” y la responsabilidad individual.

• Diseñar acciones de comunicación interna, integración, reconocimiento y experiencia del colaborador.

• Medir el clima organizacional y coordinar planes de acción con los líderes.

🦺 Seguridad e Higiene

• Asegurar, junto con los responsables técnicos y operativos, el cumplimiento de políticas y procedimientos de Seguridad e Higiene.

• Monitorear indicadores de accidentabilidad, capacitación y acciones preventivas, especialmente en Tiendas, CD y Transporte.

⭐ Gestión del Equipo de RRHH

• Liderar, organizar y desarrollar al equipo de Recursos Humanos, definiendo objetivos, prioridades, responsables y plazos.

• Asegurar el seguimiento de compromisos, la calidad de servicio interno y la mejora continua de los procesos del área.

• Promover autonomía, criterio, confidencialidad, cercanía con el negocio y orientación a resultados.

📈 Indicadores de Gestión (KPIs)

• Rotación total y rotación en período de prueba.

• Ausentismo y principales causas.

• Tiempo promedio de cobertura y vacantes cubiertas dentro del plazo objetivo.

• Dotación real vs. dotación autorizada / presupuestada.

• Costo laboral real vs. presupuesto y evolución de horas extras.

• Cumplimiento del Plan Anual de Capacitación y capacitaciones obligatorias.

• Cumplimiento de evaluaciones de desempeño y período de prueba.

• Promociones y cobertura interna de posiciones.

• Resultados de clima y cumplimiento de planes de acción.

• Accidentabilidad y cumplimiento de acciones preventivas de Seguridad e Higiene.

• Contingencias laborales y cumplimiento documental.

• Ejecución presupuestaria del área de RRHH.

Requisitos

🧠 ¿Qué perfil buscamos?

• Experiencia mínima de 7 años en posiciones de Recursos Humanos, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos o en posiciones gerenciales / de responsabilidad equivalente.

• Se valorará experiencia en empresas de Retail, Logística, Centros de Distribución o compañías con múltiples locaciones y dotaciones operativas.

Estudios requeridos

• Graduado/a de Lic. en Recursos Humanos, Relaciones Laborales, Administración, Psicología o carreras afines.

Conocimientos requeridos

• Legislación laboral argentina y relaciones laborales.

• Administración de Personal y Payroll.

• Compensaciones y Beneficios.

• Reclutamiento y Selección.

• Capacitación, Desarrollo y Gestión del Desempeño.

• Indicadores de RRHH, presupuesto y costos laborales.

• Seguridad e Higiene.

• Excel avanzado y herramientas de gestión; se valorará experiencia con ERP y plataformas de RRHH.

Competencias Clave

• Liderazgo y visión estratégica.

• Orientación a resultados y capacidad de ejecución.

• Capacidad analítica y toma de decisiones.

• Negociación y manejo de conflictos.

• Comunicación clara, escucha activa e influencia.

• Organización, seguimiento y mejora continua.

• Criterio, confidencialidad y cercanía con el negocio.

• Flexibilidad y adaptación.

🌟 Valor Agregado del Rol

• Socio estratégico del negocio con capacidad para anticipar riesgos y transformar necesidades en acciones concretas.

• Impulsor de una gestión de líderes responsables por sus equipos, acompañados por RRHH sin reemplazar su rol.

• Constructor de una cultura de desempeño, desarrollo, servicio y protagonismo.

• Gestión basada en datos, indicadores y seguimiento de resultados.

✨ Valoramos

• Alta capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico.

• Orientación a resultados y visión de negocio.

• Atención al detalle y rigurosidad con la información.

• Capacidad para detectar inconsistencias y analizar causa raíz.

• Capacidad para transformar datos complejos en información simple y accionable.

• Autonomía, organización y proactividad.

• Curiosidad y mentalidad de mejora continua.

• Comunicación efectiva y capacidad de trabajo transversal.

• Orientación al cliente interno.

Beneficios

🎁 Beneficios

• Crecimiento Reales posibilidades de desarrollo profesional en una estructura dinámica y en constante expansión.

• Salud Medicina prepaga de primer nivel para vos

• Equipamiento Computadora portátil corporativa provista por la empresa para tus tareas diarias.

• Comodidad Estacionamiento propio libre y gratuito en nuestras oficinas de Nordelta.

• Propósito Sumarte y ser protagonista de un proyecto tecnológico y de logística en pleno proceso de transformación digital.

📢En Reino Homecenter creemos que el crecimiento se construye con personas apasionadas, comprometidas y con ganas de ir siempre por más.

Hoy nos encontramos en una etapa de expansión y transformación, consolidando un proyecto que comenzó hace 11 años y que ya cuenta con mas de 20 sucursales en GBA y CABA.

Queremos seguir profesionalizando nuestras áreas, fortaleciendo nuestros equipos y desarrollando nuevas capacidades para afrontar los desafíos que vienen.

Por eso buscamos personas que quieran crecer junto a nosotros, aportar valor y ser protagonistas de esta historia. 🚀

postings.title: Head of Human Resources
postings.descriptionText:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition. That’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re scaling rapidly, and we need a Head of HR who can build the people, processes, and performance systems to support our next stage of growth.

We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and believe exceptional teams are built by people who take ownership and continuously raise the bar. We're looking for a leader who brings that same energy to building an organization where talented people can do their best work.

Why This Role Matters

Great companies aren't built by hiring great people alone. They're built by creating an environment where those people can thrive, perform, and grow.

As our Head of HR, you'll be responsible for building the people infrastructure that enables High Scale to scale efficiently while maintaining a high-performance culture.

This isn't a traditional HR role focused solely on policies and administrative processes. We're looking for a strategic, hands-on leader who understands how to connect people operations with business performance.

You'll work directly with executive leadership to strengthen our organizational structure, develop performance management systems, improve employee engagement, and establish scalable HR processes across the company.

From implementing KPI frameworks and building leadership development programs to improving employee retention and optimizing our recruitment strategy, you'll play a critical role in shaping how High Scale operates.

If you're energized by building systems, developing people, solving complex organizational challenges, and creating measurable business impact, this is an opportunity to help shape the future of a rapidly growing company.

What You'll Do

Build a Scalable HR Infrastructure

• Evaluate existing HR operations and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

• Develop and implement comprehensive HR policies, SOPs, and standardized workflows across the employee lifecycle.

• Establish structured processes for onboarding, employee development, performance reviews, promotions, compensation reviews, and offboarding.

• Implement HR systems and automation tools that reduce administrative work and improve operational efficiency.

• Ensure HR practices support organizational growth while maintaining compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations.

Develop a High-Performance Culture

• Design and implement company-wide performance management frameworks that connect individual contributions to organizational objectives.

• Partner with department leaders to establish clear KPIs, measurable expectations, and accountability systems.

• Build structured performance review processes, including regular evaluations, feedback mechanisms, and performance improvement plans.

• Establish recognition and development programs that reward meaningful contributions and encourage continuous improvement.

• Create an environment where employees understand what success looks like and have the tools and support to achieve it.

Lead Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

• Develop recruitment strategies that support the company's current and future hiring needs.

• Partner with leadership to identify critical roles, workforce requirements, and organizational gaps.

• Oversee the recruitment team to ensure efficient hiring processes, strong candidate pipelines, and an exceptional candidate experience.

• Establish recruiting KPIs, including time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, offer acceptance rates, and employee retention.

• Strengthen employer branding initiatives to attract professionals who align with High Scale's culture and business objectives.

Strengthen Employee Engagement & Retention

• Develop initiatives that improve employee satisfaction, engagement, and long-term retention.

• Implement structured feedback systems, employee surveys, and engagement assessments.

• Analyze turnover trends, identify underlying organizational challenges, and develop actionable retention strategies.

• Establish clear career progression frameworks and professional development opportunities.

• Build strong relationships across departments and create an environment where employees feel supported, challenged, and motivated to succeed.

Develop Leaders & Strengthen Organizational Effectiveness

• Partner with executive leadership to design organizational structures that support business growth.

• Coach managers on effective leadership, performance management, employee development, and conflict resolution.

• Identify leadership development opportunities and implement programs that strengthen management capabilities.

• Establish succession planning frameworks for critical positions.

• Support organizational change initiatives while maintaining clear communication and employee alignment.

Drive Data-Driven HR Decisions

• Develop HR dashboards and reporting systems that provide leadership with visibility into workforce performance.

• Track key people metrics, including employee turnover, retention, recruitment efficiency, absenteeism, and engagement.

• Analyze workforce data to identify trends, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Establish regular reporting and review processes with executive leadership.

• Translate HR insights into actionable strategies that improve organizational performance.

Who You Are

Experienced HR Leader

You have 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HR leadership or management position.

You've successfully led HR operations, developed people strategies, and implemented systems that support organizational growth.

Experience in BPO, shared services, professional services, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

You have a strong understanding of talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, organizational development, and HR compliance.

Strategic Thinker & Hands-On Builder

You understand that HR is a strategic business function, not simply an administrative department.

You're equally comfortable developing a long-term people strategy and rolling up your sleeves to solve an immediate operational challenge.

You enjoy building processes from the ground up and transforming fragmented workflows into structured, scalable systems.

You recognize opportunities for improvement and know how to turn ideas into measurable results.

Performance & Systems Driven

You have hands-on experience designing and implementing KPI frameworks, employee performance management systems, and HR operational processes.

You're comfortable using workforce analytics and business metrics to guide decision-making.

Experience with HRIS platforms, applicant tracking systems, performance management software, and workflow automation tools is highly valued.

Knowledge of organizational development, continuous improvement, and change management methodologies is a strong advantage.

Influential People Leader

You communicate confidently with executives, department heads, managers, and employees at every level.

You know how to navigate challenging conversations, resolve conflicts, and build trust while maintaining accountability.

You can balance employee advocacy with business priorities and make thoughtful decisions that support both.

You lead by example, develop the people around you, and understand how to build a team that consistently delivers results.

Thrives in High-Growth Environments

You see organizational challenges as opportunities to create something better.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and making decisions in an environment where things move quickly.

You don't wait for problems to escalate before addressing them. You anticipate organizational needs, bring solutions to the table, and take ownership of moving initiatives forward.

You bring energy and enthusiasm to your work and inspire others to embrace change, take on new challenges, and continuously improve.

Strong Business Acumen

You understand how people decisions affect productivity, operational efficiency, profitability, and long-term business growth.

You can translate business objectives into practical HR initiatives and communicate their value to executive leadership.

You know how to balance ambitious organizational goals with the realities of building and maintaining a healthy, sustainable workforce.

Perks & Benefits

Shape the Future of High Scale

Build the people strategy, organizational structure, and HR systems that will support the company's next stage of growth.

Direct Executive Partnership

Work closely with executive leadership to influence company-wide decisions, develop organizational strategies, and drive meaningful business improvements.

Build a High-Performance Organization

Create performance management systems, leadership development programs, and employee experiences that help talented people reach their full potential.

Real Ownership & Autonomy

Take ownership of the HR function with the opportunity to introduce new ideas, challenge existing processes, and implement meaningful organizational improvements.

Leadership & Career Growth

Play a central role in scaling an international organization, with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the business grows.

A Culture That Embraces Innovation

Join an ambitious, collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, creative problem-solving, and the willingness to take on challenges that drive the company forward.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe that exceptional organizations are built by people with different experiences, perspectives, and ideas. If you're passionate about developing people, building scalable systems, and creating a high-performance culture that drives meaningful business results, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Graduate HR Generalist - Americas
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Graduate HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will demonstrate a high work ethic and the personal confidence to set and defend high expectations of colleagues, counterparts and processes. You must be able to work independently, take a hands-on approach, and interface effectively with professionals at all levels. You'll need excellent communication, professional and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to function in a proactive, innovative environment. We look to HR both to support our colleagues in their personal needs and development, and also to maintain consistently high standards across multiple teams, managers and directors.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region

The role entails the individual to:

• Provide HR support by answering team members’ questions and responding to requests regarding their employment and contracts, escalating when necessary. Requests may include information about the new starter process and onboarding, questions regarding global benefits, employment verifications, and other general inquiries.

• Maintain our HRIS, ensuring a high degree of accuracy and timeliness in processing all team member changes and new joiners.

• Owning global projects (e.g. engagement, training or culture initiatives)

• Partnering with the managers and employees - supporting HR processes and driving the people strategy for your areas of responsibility

• Working as a truly global partner to colleagues, especially leads, managers and executives

• Process new hires, including country-specific on-boarding documentation, creation of files, systems set-up, and coordination of introductory reviews.

• Provide support to employees for the enrollment and processing of benefits and the payroll process, ensuring monthly data is provided on time and is accurate.

• Liaise with payroll to guarantee smooth salary payments.

• Create purchase orders for internal departments.

• Provide administrative support to employees for the enrollment and processing of benefits.

• Conduct regular audits of employment files and systems to ensure they are up-to-date, accurate, and GDPR compliant.

• Continually work to better our processes, spotting areas we can improve to drive our function forward.

What we are looking for in you

• Track record of exceptional achievement from high school and graduate studies.

• Internship experience working in an HR/People team is beneficial, preferably in the Technology industry.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Able to prioritize complex workloads, manage time effectively and work well under pressure.

• Self-motivated and results-orientated with a clear focus on accuracy.

• High level of honesty, integrity, and ability to handle confidential data.

• Flexible attitude and easily adaptable to change.

• Willing to take the initiative and provide suggestions and ideas to contribute to the success of the role/team.

• Ambitious to grow your career within HR.

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

• Fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese a plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Annual compensation review.

• Recognition rewards.

• Annual holiday leave.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Junior HRBP Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?

At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

We are looking for an Associate Analyst, HRBP to join the Human Resources team in LATAM. This is a junior position that plays a key operational role supporting our Regional HRBP, ensuring our people processes run smoothly across 18+ countries and 18+ business units.

You will work closely with the Regional HRBP, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Service Delivery, and business leaders across the region, contributing to a seamless employee experience and helping turn people priorities into action. You will support key HR processes, provide insights and follow-up, and help ensure that our people practices are consistently and effectively delivered across the region in line with global guidelines.

This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is energized by problem-solving, not paralyzed by it.

Key Responsibilities

• Hiring & Selection

• Support the Regional HRBP on submitting the hiring requests to TA through Workday

• Share regular updates with the Regional HRBP on hiring status and flag any potential hiring risks or challenges

• Onboarding & Offboarding

• Coordinate and facilitate welcome meetings/induction for new hires

• Ensure hiring managers take an active role in a standardised onboarding/induction template, and contribute to the onboarding process where necessary

• Conduct the scheduled check-in meetings with new employees and their managers; document key findings and flag risks to the Regional HRBP

• Track onboarding and offboarding processes: documentation, system updates, coordination with legal providers, and final payment follow-up

• Conduct the exit interview for voluntary resignations and analyse exit surveys to flag risks or challenges to the Regional HRBP

• Ensure all people movement events are processed accurately and on time in Workday

• HR Employee Support

• Act as a point of contact for complex HR queries related to employee relations, policies and procedures, performance and compensation from employees and managers across LATAM

• Collaborate with PSD on complex employee queries related to other HR topics such as time off requests and balances, Workday challenges, etc.

• Liaise with PSD on open Jira tickets and ensure timely resolution and follow-up

• Actively contribute to the FAQ/knowledge base for recurring questions to reduce query volume over time, in partnership with the broader HR team

• Engagement Plan Execution Support

• Support the execution of the LATAM Engagement Plan (Career Path Program, Recognition Program, AI & Automation initiatives)

• Coordinate logistics for engagement activities: communications, scheduling, materials, and tracking

• Assist in collecting and organizing data for engagement surveys and post-program follow-ups

• HR Systems & Data Integrity

• Own the accuracy of Workday organizational structures: positions, attributes, reporting lines, and job profiles

• Perform regular audits to ensure all people movements (new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations) are correctly reflected in the system

• Cross-check open positions in Workday against workforce planning data and flag discrepancies to the Regional HRBP

• Coordinate with different HR teams globally to resolve data inconsistencies

• Prepare HR reports on demand: headcount, open positions, engagement metrics, and data sanity checks

• Support the Regional HRBP with data preparation for leadership presentations and business reviews

• Maintain data hygiene across HR tracking tools (spreadsheets, Workday exports, dashboards)

What You Need For This Role

Background

• Degree in Human Resources, Labour Relations, Organizational Psychology, or related field

Experience

• 1 to 3 years of HR experience in dynamic, fast-moving environments

• Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday experience is a strong plus, not a requirement)

• Exposure to multi-country HR operations is valued but not mandatory

Skills

• Advanced English — written and spoken; most team communication is in English

• G Suite (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides) — advanced level required

• AI tools literacy (familiarity with Claude or similar tools is a plus)

• Analytical mindset — comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and building clean reports

Bonus Track — What Sets Great Candidates Apart

• High tolerance for ambiguity — you don't need everything to be defined to take action

• Dynamism — you shift context quickly and don't lose quality when the pace picks up

• Comfort with uncertainty — you see change as the norm, not the exception

• Proactive communication — you flag issues before they become problems

• Discretion — you handle sensitive information with maturity and judgment

Why Join Us?

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

#ALEPH

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at [email protected] .

Principales responsabilidades

• Coordinar la recopilación y validación de novedades de nómina, así como el seguimiento de incidencias, ajustes y consultas con el proveedor.

• Asegurar la correcta gestión y confidencialidad de la información de los colaboradores.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos administrativos de Recursos Humanos.

2. Administración y servicios generales

• Coordinar las actividades de servicios generales y las necesidades operativas de la oficina.

• Gestionar compras menores, abastecimiento de insumos y seguimiento de proveedores.

• Colaborar en la carga y el seguimiento de gastos, alquileres, rendiciones y otros procesos administrativos mediante el ERP corporativo.

• Coordinar con Finanzas y otras áreas el seguimiento de documentación, aprobaciones y pagos relacionados con la operación.

3. Cultura y desarrollo de personas

• Colaborar con la Gerencia de Recursos Humanos en la planificación y ejecución de iniciativas de cultura organizacional, clima y desarrollo de personas.

• Participar en la coordinación de actividades internas y proyectos orientados a fortalecer la experiencia de los colaboradores.

• Apoyar la implementación y el seguimiento de iniciativas de desarrollo, comunicación interna y mejora de procesos de Recursos Humanos.

4. Evolución hacia HR Business Partner

• Desarrollar progresivamente una comprensión integral del negocio, su estructura organizacional y las necesidades de sus equipos.

• Participar en iniciativas de Recursos Humanos alineadas con los objetivos y prioridades de la organización.

• Colaborar en la identificación de oportunidades de mejora en la gestión de personas y en la implementación de soluciones.

• Ampliar gradualmente su participación en temas de desarrollo organizacional, acompañamiento a líderes y gestión del talento, de acuerdo con su evolución en el rol.

Requisitos del perfil

• Formación universitaria en Recursos Humanos, Administración de Empresas, Relaciones Laborales o carreras afines.

• Experiencia mínima de 5 años en posiciones generalistas de Recursos Humanos, HR Operations o roles similares.

• Experiencia supervisando procesos de nómina tercerizados.

• Conocimientos de administración de personal, procesos administrativos y gestión de proveedores.

• Experiencia o interés en participar en iniciativas de cultura, desarrollo de personas y gestión del talento.

• Manejo de ERP y herramientas de gestión administrativa; se valorará el manejo de Excel.

• Inglés intermedio.

¿Querés liderar el cambio hacia un sistema de transporte mas sustentable?

¡Sumarte a Scania Argentina ! 🚛 🚍🔧

Scania es proveedor líder mundial de soluciones de transporte. Junto con nuestros socios y clientes, estamos impulsando el cambio hacia un sistema de transporte sustentable. En 2023, entregamos 91.652 camiones, 5.075 buses, así como 13.871 motores industriales y marinos. Las ventas netas ascendieron a más de 204.000 millones de coronas suecas, de las cuales más del 20% estaban relacionadas con servicios. La producción tiene lugar en Europa y América Latina, con centros regionales de producción en África, Asia y Eurasia. Scania forma parte del GRUPO TRATON. En Argentina, Scania es miembro firmante del Pacto Global de Naciones Unidas, adhiriendo a sus 17 ODS y a la Agenda 2030 por la lucha contra el cambio climático. Está presente desde 1976 en el país, y cuenta con 1.264 colaboradores y una red de concesionarios con 28 puntos de servicio. En Scania valoramos la diversidad y por eso adherimos a la Ley 6471 de Búsqueda Laboral Equitativa. Por ello, solo podremos solicitarte la información estrictamente necesaria para el desempeño en el trabajo que se ofrece.

En SMS Buenos Aires , Firma internacional de Auditoría, Asesoramiento Fiscal y Outsourcing, nos encontramos en la búsqueda de Un/a Analista de Desarrollo y Talento para nuestra área de Capital Humano .

• Nivel de intermedio de inglés (excluyente).

Beneficios

En SMS cuidamos de vos y tu desarrollo, por eso ofrecemos

🚀 Carrera profesional con grandes oportunidades de desarrollo y un excelente clima de trabajo.

📚 Capacitación permanente para que sigas creciendo en tu carrera.

💊 Cobertura médica de primer nivel.

👶 Licencias especiales, por nacimiento/adopción y soft landing para madres recientes.

🎉 Medio día por tu cumpleaños y un día off para lo que necesites.

💳 Tarjeta de descuentos para que ahorres en tus compras.

👨‍💻 Modalidad de trabajo híbrida para mayor flexibilidad.

🎟 Acceso a miSMS+, plataforma de descuentos y beneficios para la comunidad de SMS

🎁 Regalos corporativos en eventos especiales

Tu próximo desafío profesional empieza acá. ¡Te esperamos en SMS!

Somos SMS Buenos Aires , una firma especializada en servicios de auditoría, consultoría, impuestos y outsourcing para empresas. Fundada en 1987, nuestro equipo de profesionales está comprometido con brindar la más alta calidad de servicios.

Asistimos a quienes buscan un crecimiento sostenible y de impacto, tanto en Latinoamérica como en otras regiones del mundo. Somos una Firma Miembro de SMS Latinoamérica , una organización internacional de firmas profesionales independientes con cobertura en toda la región y a nivel global.

Respaldamos nuestros procesos y metodología de trabajo con una revisión continua ante los más altos estándares, asegurando la óptima calidad de nuestros servicios. Por ello, estamos calificados internacionalmente como auditores por organismos multilaterales. Conocimiento, Confianza y Esfuerzo son valores que nos distinguen, siendo SMS una organización en donde podrás desarrollarte profesionalmente y llevar adelante una carrera internacional.

Estamos comprometidos con la sostenibilidad, entendiendo que significa crear valor a través de nuestra actividad profesional para el desarrollo de la sociedad de manera justa, equitativa y respetuosa con el medio ambiente. También estamos comprometidos con la diversidad. Nuestra visión es crear un entorno inclusivo donde cada persona sea valorada, respetada y tenga la oportunidad de alcanzar su máximo potencial.

Ofrecemos un sólido plan de desarrollo profesional que incluye formación continua a través de nuestra Escuela de Negocios . Además, podrás participar en nuestro Programa de Intercambio Internacional , una oportunidad única para enriquecer tu carrera y expandir tus horizontes.

postings.descriptionText:
Importante compañía multinacional líder en su sector, con operación en Mar del Plata, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un/a Generalista de Recursos Humanos para incorporarse a su equipo.

Nos orientamos a profesionales con experiencia en procesos generalistas de RR.HH., administración de personal y relaciones laborales, que se destaquen por sus habilidades interpersonales, capacidad de negociación y vocación de servicio. Buscamos una persona con visión de mejora continua, orientada a la optimización y automatización de procesos, capaz de impulsar nuevas prácticas que contribuyan a una gestión más eficiente y moderna del área.

Principales responsabilidades

• Gestionar integralmente la administración de personal y el ciclo de vida de los colaboradores.

• Coordinar y controlar procesos de nómina, novedades y documentación laboral.

• Brindar asesoramiento a líderes y colaboradores sobre políticas, procedimientos y normativa laboral vigente.

• Participar activamente en procesos de onboarding, offboarding, capacitación, desempeño, clima organizacional y comunicación interna.

• Actuar como referente en relaciones laborales, manteniendo vínculo con sindicatos y acompañando la gestión de situaciones gremiales.

• Coordinar la relación con proveedores externos vinculados a procesos de Recursos Humanos.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de la legislación laboral, convenios colectivos y obligaciones de seguridad social.

• Elaborar indicadores, reportes y métricas para la toma de decisiones.

• Identificar e implementar oportunidades de mejora, digitalización y automatización de procesos, promoviendo una experiencia ágil y de calidad para clientes internos.

Requisitos

• Graduados/as universitarios.

• Experiencia previa mayor a 2 años en posiciones similares.

• Inglés intermedio.

• Experiencia en proyectos de mejora continua, implementación de procesos y transformación digital

• Conocimientos sólidos de administración de personal, liquidación de haberes y legislación laboral argentina.

• Experiencia en gestión de relaciones sindicales y negociaciones laborales.

• Manejo de indicadores de gestión y herramientas de Recursos Humanos.

Competencias valoradas

• Excelentes relaciones interpersonales.

• Habilidad para desenvolverse con distintos interlocutores, incluyendo líderes, colaboradores, proveedores y representantes gremiales.

• Iniciativa y orientación a la innovación.

• Capacidad analítica y de planificación.

• Orientación al cliente interno.

• Proactividad, flexibilidad y trabajo en equipo.

Ubicación: Mar del Plata, Provincia de Buenos Aires.
Modalidad: Híbrida

Al postularte o avanzar en este proceso, aceptás el tratamiento de tus datos personales conforme a nuestra Política de Privacidad, en cumplimiento de la Ley 25.326. ManpowerGroup Argentina tratará tu información exclusivamente con fines de evaluación y contacto en relación con oportunidades laborales. Podés ejercer tus derechos de acceso, rectificación o supresión cuando lo desees.

En ManpowerGroup promovemos una cultura inclusiva y diversa basada en el respeto y en la igualdad de oportunidades.

postings.title: Project Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Descripción del puesto

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the recruitment, onboarding, coordination, and ongoing management of freelance interpreters to support the effective delivery of interpretation services. This role manages client requests and interpreter assignments while working closely with internal teams, interpreters, and clients to ensure services are properly staffed, scheduled, and completed accurately, efficiently, and on time.

The Coordinator is responsible for the tracking of the assignments through their full lifecycle, maintaining accurate records, and communicating updates, changes, or issues as they arise.

In addition to prescheduled services, the position will provide support for on‑demand interpretation operations and assists with interpreter recruitment and onboarding when needed.

This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and effective communication to manage multiple requests while upholding service quality and client satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Assist with the recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing management of interpreters.

• Maintain and expand the client’s network of qualified and vetted interpreters.

• Receive, enter, and manage client interpretation requests within the scheduling system.

• Ensure assignment details are accurate, complete, and contain all information necessary for successful coordination, service delivery, and billing.

• Coordinate and assign interpreters to prescheduled appointments and source additional interpreters as needed to ensure coverage.

• Communicate assignment confirmations, updates, changes, and cancellations with clients and interpreters in a timely and professional manner.

• Monitor active assignments to ensure appropriate coverage, service quality, and timely completion.

• Address and resolve client and interpreter issues promptly, professionally, and in accordance with company procedures.

• Obtain, review, and process post-assignment documentation to ensure accurate job closure and billing support.

• Support on-demand interpretation services, including interpreter coordination and basic operational troubleshooting.

• Assist the Operations Manager with additional operational, administrative, and human resources-related projects as needed.

Requisitos

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred

• 2+ years of experience in project coordination, scheduling, customer service, or a related role

• Ability to learn and work with scheduling or database software

• Strong organizational, communication, and problem‑solving skills

• Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast‑paced environment

• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

postings.title: People Partner
postings.descriptionText:
The People Partner provides human resources support to managers and employees in designated segments in one or more Assurant Lines of businesses (LOB) Focusing on the employee experience, enabling business outcomes, and using data to help make solid business decisions.

The People Partner, in partnership with the People Business Partner, provides comprehensive and consistent coaching and counseling services to employees and managers on performance and conduct/behavioral related challenges; answering questions and listening to concerns about the workplace and jobs. The Partner will also work with the Business Partner to assist the LOB in identifying people and talent needs in the organization through the application of talent program and processes.

The People Partner may be involved in requests to investigate situations that may require investigation or have a sense of urgency to resolve. Those requests may come from employees, managers, Legal, the People Experience Center etc. In addition, the People Partner will proactively work with People Business Partners, managers & leaders in the People Experience center, providing insights and trends that impact the achievement of business results.

The feedback and coaching provided by the People Partner will model and reinforce the learnings of Success in Leading Employees to enable managers to leverage their discretion in judgment to determine the most appropriate course of action while continuing to focus on the employee experience. To this end he or she will promote The Assurant Way in their approach to policies, procedures, and practices to minimize risk to the company.

Creating and maintaining strong relationships will be critical to success as the People Partner will serve as a key resource to managers and People Business partners. In this capacity the People Partner may provide training to managers on topics that will enhance engagement or provide greater insights into management of people resources to support business objectives. Relationships with the other COE’s in the People Organization such as Talent Acquisition and the People Experience Center, will be vital to the success of this role

This role espouses the vision of the People Organization by:

• Putting people first

• Helping our employees realize their potential

• Empowering our employees to do their best work

• Embedding Diversity Equity and Inclusion in all that we do

Primary Job Responsibilities

• The People Partner, focusing on the employee experience, provides proactive and reactive coaching and consultative human resources advice and services to all employees of Assurant in their designated business unit from intake to resolution. This coaching and advice is centered around and leverages the core learnings of Success in Leading Employees (i.e. StAR/StAR-AR, GROW) as they counsel on Performance Development and Performance Improvement situations. They will build and maintain strong working relationships with Managers and with the People Business Partners for their client group.

• Provides hiring & staffing assistance such as interviewing, assessing and selection to managers as needed. Including effective compensation management and development of job descriptions for needed positions.

• Works with managers in client group in their efforts around Employee Engagement that could include action planning, team meetings and follow-up to ensure closure on plans.

• Provides performance coaching and advice which may include participation in meetings with employees and managers.

• Provides advice on policy interpretation with the focus on advising managers to always use their judgment and discretion. The Partner will leverage the Success in Leading Employees information in their interactions with managers and promote the use of this information to the Managers.

• Provides education and training to managers as needed in areas such as FMLA, Union Avoidance, Wage and Hour, Accommodations etc. Collaboratively makes decisions about training needed by consulting with managers, Legal and/or People Business Partner.

• Performs consultation responsibilities to assist managers & leaders in the termination process whether a reduction in force or a voluntary or involuntary termination including participating in any termination meeting with employees.

• Facilitates the end-to-end process of the reduction in force in consultation with the People Business Partner and Business leadership. This will include the assessment of talent, notification to impacted associates and continued support to those employees after notification.

• Performs more routine inquiries, research or investigation into issues raised by employees, managers, or other sources.

• Participates in additional projects as identified by the People Organization leadership.

• The People Partner leverages NeoCase/ ERIN, to document and manage the types of situations that come to them from managers and employees. The Partner will use multiple tools (Workday, Peakon, ERIN, etc.) to mine data for their client groups and use the analytics to drive performance in the organization. In addition, the Partner will recommend updates and suggestions to the content in the KnowledgeBase and in the analytics that will improve the content available to them and to the managers.

The People Partner will develop and maintain relationships with members of the People Experience Center team to expedite and ensure that employee and manager concerns or requestswhich have been escalatedare responded to in a timely, consistent, and accurate manner as well as documented appropriately

Required Experience, Skills, And Knowledge

• Bachelor’s degree in a related area with 1 yrs. experience in an HR professional role or a minimum of 4 years’ experience in an HR professional role or managing people. Experience must include coaching and advising all levels of employees in areas such as performance, organizational change, employee engagement, working relationships.

• Knowledge of employment law at the federal and state level (FMLA, ADA, FLSA, Title VII, EEO and other applicable employment related laws)

Preferred Experience, Skills, And Knowledge

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills desired.

• Certification as PHR, SPHR or SHRM CP or SCP preferred

• Experience in handling employee related investigations and writing report summaries

• Minimum of 1 year HR support for a workforce of a minimum of 250 employees.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

The HRBP Manager serves as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to designated business functions, driving people strategies that enable business performance while ensuring an exceptional employee experience.

postings.title: Attorney Development Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Location: 100 % remote

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor  

Posting Jurisdictions: To support US Eastern Time working hours    

Our Firm:

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economics as well as the legal aspects of our matters.

Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

Learn more at: www.sterlingtonlaw.com/

The Opportunity

As the firm scales, our associates need people management, feedback that helps them grow, and a real sense of belonging.

You'll own attorney development from the ground up. You'll build the feedback cadence, development programs, and sense of community that turns associates into long-term, fully utilized members of the firm.

Success at six months looks like associates who feel part of something bigger, are receiving real and consistent feedback, and are growing, reflected in stronger utilization. From there, the ambition grows: measurably better associate engagement and the launch of programs to enhance our attorneys’ experience at Sterlington.

You'll join the People Team and work closely with firm leadership.

What You'll Do:

• Build a feedback cadence. Built around our firm-wide culture of feedback, support team members in receiving the feedback they need to propel their growth, not just an annual review.

• Manage stakeholder relationships. Work closely with partners and firm leadership, tailoring your approach to each; this isn't a one-size-fits-all function.

• Create a sense of community. Develop the programs and touchpoints that make associates feel like they belong to the firm, not just assigned to it.

• Own learning & development. Design and manage L&D programs end-to-end, course design grounded in adult learning theory, that build associates' skills and support their career progression.

• Coach and mentor. Work directly with associates as a people manager: coach individuals, resolve performance concerns, and help them navigate their development.

• Use data to drive decisions. Analyze utilization and performance data to identify where associates are under- or mis-utilized and turn that into action.

• Bring a point of view on talent. Contribute to talent acquisition efforts, including future programs that grow our attorney team, and apply a working knowledge of US employment law where it touches development and performance.

• Speak with authority. Represent attorney development as a real function within the firm: confidently, directly, and with the credibility to influence how the firm thinks about its people.

What We're Looking For :

• A legal or attorney-development background. Ideally, you've done this work inside a law firm or legal tech environment. You understand what makes attorneys tick, and what "development" actually means in that context.

• This role calls for judgment rather than years served. You'll need to step into ambiguous situations, identify what's missing, prioritize it, and work the room to make it happen.

• Strong L&D program design skills. You know how to build training grounded in adult learning theory to achieve your objectives, not just schedule sessions.

• Real coaching and mentoring experience. Ideally, you've been a people manager before. This role is about developing people directly, not just administering a program.

• Working knowledge of US employment law. Not a legal expert, but comfortable enough to know when something needs a closer look.

• A data-driven streak. Comfortable pulling together utilization and performance data to spot problems and make the case for action.

• Excellent English communication. Written and verbal. You'll be coaching attorneys and influencing leadership, so this needs to be a strength, not a gap.

• Americas time zone, ideally ET. You'll need real overlap with the team and the attorneys you're supporting.

• The right temperament. People who thrive here don't wait to be told what to do. They're resilient, direct, transparent, and genuinely want to be part of a team. Comfort with ambiguity is table stakes, and being AI-forward and tech-savvy is essential.

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Una persona con formación terciaria o universitaria en Administración, Recursos Humanos, Gestión de Servicios de Salud o carreras afines, que cuente con:

HR Operations Specialist

Location: Remote – Latin America
