Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations supporting U.S. employees

About The Company

Our client is a U.S.-based business operating multiple locations and managing both full-time and part-time employees.

The company is looking to strengthen its HR operations by implementing and maintaining reliable systems for employee administration, payroll, benefits, time tracking, and HR policy management.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced HR Operations Specialist with strong, hands-on expertise in Rippling to lead its setup and support ongoing HR administration for a U.S.-based, multi-location business.

This is a hands-on operational role that combines HR administration, HRIS implementation, payroll and benefits coordination, multi-state policy configuration, and employee support.

The ideal candidate has already implemented and managed Rippling, understands U.S. HR operations, and can independently coordinate with employees, managers, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate and efficient HR processes.

Why This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of HR operations, contribute directly to the implementation and optimization of Rippling, and support a growing, multi-location U.S. business.

You will play a central role in establishing efficient HR workflows, maintaining accurate employee information, and helping managers navigate everyday administrative challenges.

What You'll Do

Rippling Implementation & HRIS Management

• Lead the setup and ongoing administration of Rippling

• Configure new entities and locations, employee data imports, job codes, and onboarding processes

• Support the setup and maintenance of payroll, benefits, and state employer/tax IDs

• Maintain accurate employee records and update compensation and job levels as needed

• Identify opportunities to improve HR workflows and system efficiency

HR Operations & Employee Administration

• Manage onboarding and offboarding for full-time and part-time U.S. employees

• Prepare offer letters and employment agreements

• Maintain employee records and ensure information is accurate and up to date

• Support employees and managers with HR-related administrative requests

• Follow up independently to ensure outstanding tasks and requests are completed

Multi-State Policies & Compliance Administration

• Set up and maintain HR policies across multiple U.S. states, including PTO, sick leave, overtime, and breaks

• Configure policies and employee acknowledgments in Rippling

• Support consistent implementation of company policies across locations

• Coordinate updates to employee information and HR documentation

Time Tracking & Payroll Coordination

• Implement and manage clock-in/clock-out and time-tracking processes in Rippling

• Configure timecard approval workflows and follow up on missing timecards

• Support the integration of time tracking with payroll

• Train employees and managers on time-tracking procedures

• Assist with payroll-related questions and administrative issues

General Operations Support

• Assist with vendor and bill transfers

• Respond to employees' HR and payroll questions

• Help location managers resolve administrative issues

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to maintain efficient day-to-day operations

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of HR Operations experience supporting U.S. employees

• Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing Rippling

• Experience configuring new entities, locations, employee records, payroll, benefits, job codes, and onboarding workflows in Rippling

• Experience administering HR processes for both full-time and part-time U.S. employees

• Experience preparing offer letters and employment agreements and maintaining employee records

• Experience setting up multi-state HR policies, including PTO, sick leave, overtime, and breaks

• Experience implementing and managing time tracking, timecard approvals, and payroll integration in Rippling

• Ability to train managers and employees on HR processes and systems

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and ability to manage responsibilities independently

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting multi-location U.S. businesses

• Experience coordinating HR administration with location managers

• Experience supporting vendor administration and other general operational processes

• Experience improving or streamlining HR workflows

How Success Is Measured

• Rippling is configured accurately and supports the company's entities, locations, employees, and HR processes

• Employee records, payroll-related information, benefits, and job codes are properly maintained

• Onboarding and offboarding are completed accurately and efficiently

• Multi-state policies and employee acknowledgments are correctly configured

• Time-tracking and timecard approval processes operate reliably

• Employees and managers receive timely support with HR and payroll questions

• Administrative tasks are completed independently, with consistent follow-through and attention to detail

Why Join Us?

• Competitive compensation of $2,000–$3,000 USD/month

• Fully remote opportunity from Latin America

• Ownership of Rippling implementation and ongoing HR operations

• Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based, multi-location business

• A hands-on role with responsibility across HR systems, employee administration, payroll coordination, and operational improvement

Important Notes

This position requires actual hands-on Rippling implementation and administration experience, not simply familiarity with the platform as an employee.

Candidates must have experience supporting U.S. employees and be comfortable managing multi-state HR policies, payroll-related workflows, and time tracking.

Strong integrity, professional judgment, attention to detail, and independent execution are essential.

postings.title: Compensation Analyst II
postings.descriptionText:
Job Role:

The Compensation Analyst II will analyze Astreya’s pay structures. The hire will be responsible for analyzing employees’ experience and responsibilities, by doing comparative analysis by region and industry, and by taking the company's financial performance into consideration. The Compensation Analyst will establish compensation packages for new hires and position changes, as well as new roles created, as well as requesting creation of new roles in the company's job architecture.

Scope:

• Applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues

• Works on problems of moderate scope

• Receives general instructions on routine work and detailed instructions on new projects

Your Roles and Responsibilities:

• Effectively partner with managers, business leaders, HR, and Finance to consult, propose, and resolve compensation issues.

• Support development, implementation, and administration of compensation policies and programs

• Analyze results and competitiveness of compensation programs through deep analysis and modeling of projections and program results

• Audit jobs for content and prepare job descriptions reflecting job responsibilities and requirements

• Manage job matching and participate in compensation surveys to collect and analyze competitive salary information to determine company's competitive position

• Track, file (online), and ensure accuracy of plan documents, employee data, and processing of data

• Develop custom reports, quarterly analytics, and workforce planning reporting to meet the requirements of HR, Finance, and business leaders

• Effectively manage and maintain internal tools, systems, database files and tables

• Review, interpret and recommend policy, process or program improvements

• Manage special projects

• Other duties as required. This list is not meant to be a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position

postings.title: HR Operations Specialist – Rippling
postings.descriptionText:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

HR Operations Specialist – Rippling

Location: Remote – Latin America

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Industry: Human Resources / HR Operations

Compensation: $2,000–$3,000 USD/month

English Proficiency: Fluent written and spoken English

Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations supporting U.S. employees

About The Company

Our client is a U.S.-based business operating multiple locations and managing both full-time and part-time employees.

The company is looking to strengthen its HR operations by implementing and maintaining reliable systems for employee administration, payroll, benefits, time tracking, and HR policy management.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced HR Operations Specialist with strong, hands-on expertise in Rippling to lead its setup and support ongoing HR administration for a U.S.-based, multi-location business.

This is a hands-on operational role that combines HR administration, HRIS implementation, payroll and benefits coordination, multi-state policy configuration, and employee support.

The ideal candidate has already implemented and managed Rippling, understands U.S. HR operations, and can independently coordinate with employees, managers, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate and efficient HR processes.

Why This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of HR operations, contribute directly to the implementation and optimization of Rippling, and support a growing, multi-location U.S. business.

You will play a central role in establishing efficient HR workflows, maintaining accurate employee information, and helping managers navigate everyday administrative challenges.

What You'll Do

Rippling Implementation & HRIS Management

• Lead the setup and ongoing administration of Rippling

• Configure new entities and locations, employee data imports, job codes, and onboarding processes

• Support the setup and maintenance of payroll, benefits, and state employer/tax IDs

• Maintain accurate employee records and update compensation and job levels as needed

• Identify opportunities to improve HR workflows and system efficiency

HR Operations & Employee Administration

• Manage onboarding and offboarding for full-time and part-time U.S. employees

• Prepare offer letters and employment agreements

• Maintain employee records and ensure information is accurate and up to date

• Support employees and managers with HR-related administrative requests

• Follow up independently to ensure outstanding tasks and requests are completed

Multi-State Policies & Compliance Administration

• Set up and maintain HR policies across multiple U.S. states, including PTO, sick leave, overtime, and breaks

• Configure policies and employee acknowledgments in Rippling

• Support consistent implementation of company policies across locations

• Coordinate updates to employee information and HR documentation

Time Tracking & Payroll Coordination

• Implement and manage clock-in/clock-out and time-tracking processes in Rippling

• Configure timecard approval workflows and follow up on missing timecards

• Support the integration of time tracking with payroll

• Train employees and managers on time-tracking procedures

• Assist with payroll-related questions and administrative issues

General Operations Support

• Assist with vendor and bill transfers

• Respond to employees' HR and payroll questions

• Help location managers resolve administrative issues

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to maintain efficient day-to-day operations

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of HR Operations experience supporting U.S. employees

• Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing Rippling

• Experience configuring new entities, locations, employee records, payroll, benefits, job codes, and onboarding workflows in Rippling

• Experience administering HR processes for both full-time and part-time U.S. employees

• Experience preparing offer letters and employment agreements and maintaining employee records

• Experience setting up multi-state HR policies, including PTO, sick leave, overtime, and breaks

• Experience implementing and managing time tracking, timecard approvals, and payroll integration in Rippling

• Ability to train managers and employees on HR processes and systems

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and ability to manage responsibilities independently

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting multi-location U.S. businesses

• Experience coordinating HR administration with location managers

• Experience supporting vendor administration and other general operational processes

• Experience improving or streamlining HR workflows

How Success Is Measured

• Rippling is configured accurately and supports the company's entities, locations, employees, and HR processes

• Employee records, payroll-related information, benefits, and job codes are properly maintained

• Onboarding and offboarding are completed accurately and efficiently

• Multi-state policies and employee acknowledgments are correctly configured

• Time-tracking and timecard approval processes operate reliably

• Employees and managers receive timely support with HR and payroll questions

• Administrative tasks are completed independently, with consistent follow-through and attention to detail

Why Join Us?

• Competitive compensation of $2,000–$3,000 USD/month

• Fully remote opportunity from Latin America

• Ownership of Rippling implementation and ongoing HR operations

• Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based, multi-location business

• A hands-on role with responsibility across HR systems, employee administration, payroll coordination, and operational improvement

Important Notes

This position requires actual hands-on Rippling implementation and administration experience, not simply familiarity with the platform as an employee.

Candidates must have experience supporting U.S. employees and be comfortable managing multi-state HR policies, payroll-related workflows, and time tracking.

Strong integrity, professional judgment, attention to detail, and independent execution are essential.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

postings.title: Sr Compensation Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Position Summary

The Senior Compensation Analyst will support Assurant's Global Compensation team by delivering data-driven insights and compensation solutions that help attract, retain, and reward talent across the organization. This role partners with HR and business leaders to provide market-informed recommendations, support compensation programs, and contribute to key initiatives that drive equitable and competitive pay practices. The position offers the opportunity to influence strategic compensation decisions while contributing to the evolution of Assurant's Total Rewards programs.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct compensation analyses and develop recommendations to support talent and business decisions.

• Perform job evaluations, market pricing, and benchmarking activities to maintain competitive compensation practices.

• Support annual compensation programs, including salary planning processes and related reporting.

• Partner with HR and business stakeholders to provide compensation guidance and consultation.

• Prepare analyses, presentations, and reports for leadership and executive audiences.

• Contribute to compensation transformation initiatives and process improvement efforts.

• Support pay equity and pay transparency programs through analysis and project participation.

Location & Work Arrangement

• This position is based in Argentina and follows a hybrid work model.

• The role primarily aligns with Argentina business hours.

• Occasional early morning or evening meetings may be required during compensation cycles and annual processes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, or a related field.

• Experience conducting compensation analysis, job evaluation, and market benchmarking.

• Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.

• Experience translating data into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting regional or multinational compensation programs.

• Knowledge of pay equity, pay transparency, salary structures, and incentive programs.

• Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.

• Experience participating in transformation, change, or process improvement initiatives.

• Exposure to AI-enabled tools or technology-driven work environments.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

As an Executive Talent Attraction Recruiter, Assistant Director, you’ll own executive recruiting responsibilities aligned to a various service lines and sectors, serving the US market. You’ll partner with an Executive Recruiter to manage the talent pipeline by identifying top talent and converting prospects into active candidates. As part of a high performing team, you’ll serve as a trusted business advisor to our leaders, Talent team and hiring managers by overseeing all external candidate engagement and driving talent to EY. You’ll ensure an exceptional candidate experience for every candidate, so our reputation for quality and innovation will be in your hands. In return, you’ll have the support of a network of highly knowledgeable colleagues and the opportunity to make a significant impact to your team and EY.

Your key responsibilities include

• Developing recruiting strategies to attract executive hires and serve as a key contact to client groups and external candidates

• Assessing business leadership resource needs against the talent market to build a compelling pipeline through various channels

• Ensuring all appropriate sourcing strategies are utilized, including inclusiveness initiatives and other creative sourcing techniques

• Integrating EY's brand strategy into all recruitment activity at all levels across all platforms

• Acting as a change agent for new technology, tools and processes that are rolled out to the broader recruiting community

• Staying informed of talent and labor market insights

• Conducting training and performance related feedback for teammates

• Innovating and leveraging Ai in your everyday work environment to further efficiencies and impact sourcing strategies and execution

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Demonstrating knowledge and prior experience in attracting and engaging executive hires and leveraging a variety of recruitment resources

• Ability to function in a lead recruiter role providing coaching and counseling to other recruiters and team members

• Providing operational and process excellence to ensure a quality candidate experience

• Strategic-thinking skills and ability to collaborate with team members on best practices

• Consultative approach with clients, serving as a talent advisor on the external pipeline of prospective candidates

• Ability to be agile and embrace new technology and tools which are designed to improve the recruitment process

To qualify for the role, you must have

• Extensive experience in the executive level search and recruitment process

• Ability to develop an effective sourcing strategy

• Ability to identify and solve complex recruitment issues

• Ability to develop and foster relationships

• Ability to provide training and performance related feedback to team

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

• 8-10+ years of experienced hire recruitment experience, including executive recruitment

• Experience recruiting talent in the US market

• Knowledge and experience in creative sourcing techniques of experienced hires

• Deep understanding of current recruitment/hiring laws and practices

• Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Copilot and PowerPoint) and experience working with applicant tracking software. Avature experience a plus

• Advanced English and can communicate confidently in professional settings, lead discussions, handle complex topics, and write professional communications with minimal errors

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Experience in a professional services environment

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with numerous projects happening simultaneously

• Strong reporting and data analytic skills

• Executive recruiting experience

What We Look For

We’re interested in knowledgeable professionals ready to take ownership for attracting and engaging external candidates for EY. You’ll need to be naturally curious, ready to learn and have a genuine passion for finding the right people for the right roles. If you’re aiming to influence change within a world class recruiting organization, all while developing your own career, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off with additional time based on your level and years of service plus 12 observed holidays, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

postings.title: HR Generalist
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an HR Generalist to support our growing team

With 1,200+ colleagues across 75 countries, we require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for an HR Generalist who will report into our Regional HR Manager who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will demonstrate a high work ethic and the personal confidence to set and defend high expectations of colleagues, counterparts and processes. You must be able to work independently, take a hands-on approach, and interface effectively with professionals at all levels. You'll need excellent communication, professional and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to function in a proactive, innovative environment. We look to HR both to support our colleagues in their personal needs and development, and also to maintain consistently high standards across multiple teams, managers and directors.

The role entails the individual to:

• Provide HR guidance to team members and managers, setting high expectations of behaviour and performance.

• Partner with line managers to provide employee relations advice on global policies and procedures.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness in processing employee changes, joiners and leavers.

• Manage and drive benefit programs spanning either our EMEA (UK, Ireland, France, Germany and Spain) or AMER (US, Canada and Brazil) locations

• Liaise with our finance team on monthly payroll, projects and enquiries.

• Support the full life-cycle of HR including onboarding, benefit administration, and departure.

• Apply critical thinking to automate and reduce administrative tasks.

• Take a lead role in the management, continued development, and integration of our HR system.

• Act as a system expert and advocate for the global HR team.

• Produce data driven reports to inform and influence HR initiatives.

• Lead and participate in projects where you’ll see the impact of your work.

• Support internal resource groups to drive initiatives such as diversity and inclusion.

• Create, update and maintain corporate policies that have a global lens with local application.

• Ensure consistency of application of our HR policies and procedures.

What we are looking for in you:

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Relevant professional qualification and certifications.

• Excellent practical insights into either EMEA or AMER HR practices and employment laws.

• Self-directed, organised problem solver with the ability to prioritise and meet goals and deadlines.

• Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, sound judgement, tact and diplomacy in all communications.

• Fearless and principled approach to professional interactions at every level of the business with commitment to confidentiality of sensitive information.

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events, with at least one trip of two full working weeks.

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.

• Annual compensation review.

• Recognition rewards.

• Annual holiday leave.

• Maternity and paternity leave.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.

• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

postings.title: Attorney Development Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Location: 100 % remote

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor  

Posting Jurisdictions: To support US Eastern Time working hours    

Our Firm:

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economics as well as the legal aspects of our matters.

Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

Learn more at: www.sterlingtonlaw.com/

The Opportunity

As the firm scales, our associates need people management, feedback that helps them grow, and a real sense of belonging.

You'll own attorney development from the ground up. You'll build the feedback cadence, development programs, and sense of community that turns associates into long-term, fully utilized members of the firm.

Success at six months looks like associates who feel part of something bigger, are receiving real and consistent feedback, and are growing, reflected in stronger utilization. From there, the ambition grows: measurably better associate engagement and the launch of programs to enhance our attorneys’ experience at Sterlington.

You'll join the People Team and work closely with firm leadership.

What You'll Do:

• Build a feedback cadence. Built around our firm-wide culture of feedback, support team members in receiving the feedback they need to propel their growth, not just an annual review.

• Manage stakeholder relationships. Work closely with partners and firm leadership, tailoring your approach to each; this isn't a one-size-fits-all function.

• Create a sense of community. Develop the programs and touchpoints that make associates feel like they belong to the firm, not just assigned to it.

• Own learning & development. Design and manage L&D programs end-to-end, course design grounded in adult learning theory, that build associates' skills and support their career progression.

• Coach and mentor. Work directly with associates as a people manager: coach individuals, resolve performance concerns, and help them navigate their development.

• Use data to drive decisions. Analyze utilization and performance data to identify where associates are under- or mis-utilized and turn that into action.

• Bring a point of view on talent. Contribute to talent acquisition efforts, including future programs that grow our attorney team, and apply a working knowledge of US employment law where it touches development and performance.

• Speak with authority. Represent attorney development as a real function within the firm: confidently, directly, and with the credibility to influence how the firm thinks about its people.

What We're Looking For :

• A legal or attorney-development background. Ideally, you've done this work inside a law firm or legal tech environment. You understand what makes attorneys tick, and what "development" actually means in that context.

• This role calls for judgment rather than years served. You'll need to step into ambiguous situations, identify what's missing, prioritize it, and work the room to make it happen.

• Strong L&D program design skills. You know how to build training grounded in adult learning theory to achieve your objectives, not just schedule sessions.

• Real coaching and mentoring experience. Ideally, you've been a people manager before. This role is about developing people directly, not just administering a program.

• Working knowledge of US employment law. Not a legal expert, but comfortable enough to know when something needs a closer look.

• A data-driven streak. Comfortable pulling together utilization and performance data to spot problems and make the case for action.

• Excellent English communication. Written and verbal. You'll be coaching attorneys and influencing leadership, so this needs to be a strength, not a gap.

• Americas time zone, ideally ET. You'll need real overlap with the team and the attorneys you're supporting.

• The right temperament. People who thrive here don't wait to be told what to do. They're resilient, direct, transparent, and genuinely want to be part of a team. Comfort with ambiguity is table stakes, and being AI-forward and tech-savvy is essential.

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

postings.title: Workforce Strategy Senior Associate - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Associate to support the Workforce Strategy and Design team in advancing the firm’s workforce evolution agenda. This individual will contribute to the development of strategic workforce initiatives, organization and role design efforts, and cross-functional analyses that help the firm better define, structure, and deploy talent in line with changing business needs.

This role will work across both strategic priorities to help shape future workforce models, support organizational design activities, synthesize data and insights, and coordinate deliverables that inform leadership decisions. The successful candidate will collaborate with team members across talent, business, and transformation functions to support a more integrated and future-focused approach to workforce planning and design.

What You’ll Do

Support team strategy priorities

• Contribute to the development of materials, analyses, and recommendations that support enterprise workforce priorities

• Support role design, organization structure analysis, career architecture, and related design activities that help define how work and talent should be organized

• Act as a thought partner to the Workforce Strategy and Design Assistant Director to challenge assumptions, surface risks, and enable innovative thinking

• Build relationships across the Digital Talent and Transformation Office to enable effective coordination across all Office efforts

Drive analysis and deliverables

• Gather and analyze qualitative and quantitative inputs to identify trends, inform hypotheses, and support recommendations for leadership and project teams

• Create clear, structured materials including presentations, summaries, trackers, and working documents to support team priorities and stakeholder discussions

• Maintain a strong eye for detail to deliver high-quality materials and build trust with stakeholders

Project management

• Help manage workstream actions, follow-ups, and milestones across multiple stakeholders to keep initiatives moving forward effectively

• Prepare content and inputs for meetings, reviews, and decision-making forums by distilling complex information into actionable takeaways

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

• 3–5 years of experience in workforce strategy, organization design, talent transformation, consulting, or a related field

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills

• Experience developing presentations, summaries, and project materials for diverse stakeholders

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment

• Comfort working across ambiguity and contributing to evolving strategic priorities

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Interest in the future of work, workforce transformation, and evolving talent models

Key Skills

• Proactive and dependable, with strong attention to detail

• Collaborative and eager to learn from cross-functional partners

• Structured thinker who can translate complexity into clarity

• Adaptable and comfortable supporting evolving priorities

• Highly organized and detail oriented

Success in This Role

Within your first 12–24 months, you will:

• Effectively support the Strategy and Design team through accurate and insightful analyses and materials

• Help the Strategy and Design pillar meet tight deadlines through strong project management and organizational skills

• Coordinate and build relationships across different Talent functions

• Develop actionable insights that support innovative thinking and delivery

postings.descriptionText:
Position Summary:

The Delivery Associate role works within the delivery workstream of Learning and Development Deployment to coordinate all logistics associated with virtual and in-person learning including identifying appropriate facilities and/ or production support for delivering learning.

The role includes the review of registration records and credit award amounts for supported classes and coordination of Learning Support Liaison activities for in-person classes.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Under limited direction, analyze course logistical requirements. This includes determining appropriate facilities to support in-person learning

Collaborate with other delivery team members on delivery plan

Coordinate and oversee the activities needed (e.g. confirm space is secured, materials and logistics have been finalized) from the Learning Support Liaisons to support in-person classes

Confirm set up of classroom both virtual and in person with onsite resource (producer or LSL)

Review and reconcile class rosters provided by delivery specialist against final attendance for physical and virtual classrooms to ensure accurate awarding of credit

Counsel facilitators on the process for awarding credit through Calculo attestation, stressing the importance of integrity when awarding due to a highly regulated environment

Act as point of contact for the facilitators and participants

Ensure credit is awarded and provide evaluation results as required

Initiate process for set up and publication of classes in Learning Management System

Work with Delivery leadership to identify opportunities for improvement and implement procedural enhancements as directed.

Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

Prioritize daily work while managing multiple projects simultaneously, sometimes for differing stakeholders

Identify challenges and potential issues early, consider various possible courses of action and weigh their consequences before actioning or escalating (eg solve technology issues during a class)

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Ability to demonstrate a high level of attention to detail

Ability to establish trusted relationships in a virtual environment

Ability to effectively work within a geographically dispersed team

Ability to work with all ranks and levels of the organization

Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Proficient MS Office Skills with competency in the use of Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s etc) and Teams.

Knowledge of virtual collaboration tools (e.g. Zoom, MS Teams).

Working knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors or equivalent Learning Management Systems

A foundational knowledge of EY learning opportunities.

Supervision Responsibilities:

Oversees the activities of the Learning Support Liaison

Other Requirements:

Working hours, flexible work arrangements and time off may be limited during specific times due to business demands. All overtime must be approved in advance.

Job Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree Or Equivalent Work Experience Required.

Experience:

1-3 years of learning, meeting and event services, or hospitality experience.

Experience in a professional services or corporate environment.

Note:

This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the job. However, it is not an all-inclusive listing of the required job functions and functions may vary depending on the particular geographic location of the job and/or the manager. Further, the job description is subject to change at the discretion of management.

postings.title: Workforce Strategy Consultant - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic leader to help shape the future of the firm's workforce. As the Workforce Strategy Consultant, you'll identify and translate business priorities and emerging workforce trends into practical strategies that evolve the shape, size, and skills of the workforce.

Reporting to the Workforce Strategy and Design Leader, you'll lead a workstream to drive complex strategy work while partnering across various stakeholders to connect strategic direction with evolution and execution.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of workforce strategy, analytics, and enterprise transformation.

What You’ll Do

Shape Workforce Strategy and Models

• Identify and frame strategic workforce questions, synthesize internal and external perspectives, and develop recommendations aligned with firm ambitions

• Help translate shifts in business models, technology, AI, and service delivery into implications for future roles, skills, capacity, and talent models

• Support the development of future workforce models through aligning business needs to future role definitions, career pathways and skills frameworks

• Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to clarify trade-offs and prepare concise, executive-ready recommendations

Enable Enterprise Alignment

• Maintain consistent contact with Service Line Integration Leaders to understand the strategic priorities of each Service Line to ensure perspectives across the business are captured throughout the strategy development process

• Influence senior stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization while incorporating diverse perspectives into the work

Connect Strategy to Execution

• Partner with Talent Evolution, Workforce Operations, analytics, technology, and data teams to help translate strategy into sequenced initiatives and measurable outcomes

• Identify practical implementation requirements, roadmaps, governance approaches and potential risks to help push strategic priorities forward

Drive Delivery

• Set objectives, manage scope, priorities, risks, and timelines, and coach team members to deliver high-quality outputs

• Build reusable frameworks, methodologies, and knowledge assets that strengthen the consistency and impact of workforce strategy work

• Identify responsible opportunities to use approved AI tools to improve analysis, decision-making, quality, and productivity

What We're Looking For

Qualifications

• Experience in workforce strategy, corporate strategy, talent transformation, organization design, workforce planning, or professional services transformation

• Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate complex analysis into practical recommendations

• Experience leading complex projects or workstreams across multiple senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization

• Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including the ability to synthesize data, research, and stakeholder input

• Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences

• Understanding of professional services workforce dynamics and the impact of AI, automation, and emerging technologies on talent models

• Experience managing priorities, risks, deliverables, and team contributions while maintaining quality and objectivity

Key Skills

• Strategic Workforce Planning & Future Workforce Design

• Enterprise Strategy & Transformation

• Executive Insights & Decision Support

• Stakeholder Alignment & Facilitation

• Quantitative & Qualitative Analysis

• Project Leadership & Team Development

• AI-Enabled Strategy & Continuous Improvement

Success in This Role

Within your first 12–24 months, you will:

• Develop clear, actionable workforce strategies connected to firm and business priorities

• Build senior stakeholder alignment on future workforce assumptions, choices, and strategic direction

• Deliver high-quality executive recommendations within agreed timelines

• Translate strategy into prioritized initiatives, roadmaps, and implementation requirements

• Increase the use of data, scenarios, and AI-enabled insights in workforce decisions

• Strengthen the team’s workforce strategy methods, knowledge assets, and delivery capability

The Opportunity

We're looking for a highly organized and proactive project manager to help drive execution across the Digital Talent & Transformation Office (DiTTO) portfolio. As a Project Manager, you'll support the planning, coordination, and delivery of strategic workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned, on track, and positioned to achieve intended outcomes.

Reporting to the Portfolio & Process Lead, you'll partner with leaders across Workforce Strategy & Design, Talent Evolution, Analytics, Skills Intelligence & Operations, Enterprise Technology, and Talent stakeholders to manage project plans, facilitate governance processes, coordinate cross-functional teams, and maintain visibility into key priorities, risks, and dependencies.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys bringing structure to complexity, and excels at turning strategy into execution.

What You'll Do

Drive Strategic Execution

• Support the planning and execution of strategic DiTTO priorities, ensuring activities are completed on time and aligned to established objectives

• Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, timelines, and deliverables across multiple workstreams

• Monitor progress against commitments and proactively identify and address risks, issues, and dependencies

Enable Portfolio Governance

• Coordinate governance processes, including status reporting, steering committee preparation, decision tracking, and action item management

• Maintain portfolio-level visibility into project health, milestones, resource needs, and key outcomes

• Support leadership presentations, project reviews, and program reporting activities

Coordinate Stakeholders and Teams

• Schedule and lead working sessions, project meetings, and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment and execution where needed

• Ensure clear communication of priorities, decisions, timelines, and responsibilities across project participants

Improve Processes and Ways of Working

• Identify opportunities to streamline project management practices, governance processes, and team operations

• Develop templates, tools, and reporting mechanisms that improve consistency and efficiency

• Support continuous improvement efforts across the DiTTO portfolio management function

Manage Communications and Change Activities

• Assist in the development of project communications, change management plans, stakeholder updates, and implementation materials

• Track adoption activities and support readiness efforts for key transformation initiatives

• Ensure stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and aligned throughout project lifecycles

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

• Experience in project management, program management, business operations, transformation, consulting, or related disciplines

• Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail

• Experience developing project plans, status reporting, governance materials, and executive-ready communications

• Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams

• Demonstrated ability to identify risks, solve problems, and drive execution in complex environments

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Key Skills

• Project & Program Management

• Portfolio Governance & Reporting

• Stakeholder Coordination & Communication

• Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

• Executive Presentation Development

• Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Change Management & Delivery Support

Success in This Role

Within your first 12–24 months, you will:

• Establish consistent project management practices across DiTTO initiatives

• Improve visibility into portfolio milestones, risks, and dependencies

• Enable effective governance and decision-making processes across the portfolio

• Deliver accurate and actionable reporting for DiTTO leadership

• Enhance coordination across workforce transformation workstreams and stakeholder groups

• Help accelerate the successful delivery of strategic DiTTO priorities

postings.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.

You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.

In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Ensure high quality deliverables are produced for the project by exhaustive internal reviews and obtain excellent feedback from the client and global project counterparts

• Work to drive effective client communication, cadence and build relations with client and project team counterparts across global locations

• Support development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, methodologies to enhance organisation change management and broader capability offering within the practice

• Support leadership in developing the practice through collaboration with EY global offices and demand generation for change management projects

• Support to build capability in change management pillar in collaboration with various parts of the GDS organisation and other EY member firms

Skills And Attributes For Success

• 6 months/1 year of experience in HR/Admin or Project Management related tasks.

• Working knowledge in the implementation of some or all of the following organizational change management elements i.e. change strategy and visioning, communication strategy, change impact assessment, business readiness assessment and engagement, training design and delivery, change network implementation, and organization alignment

• Understanding of basic content development techniques

• Experience working in corporate environments and building relationships with stakeholders

<< What we look for>>

• High integrity and commitment to work in a new and challenging environment

• Ability to manage ambiguity and be proactive

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity

• High energy, agility and adaptability

• Detail Oriented.

• Learning mindset.

• Hands On profile – Solutions oriented.

• Open to travel for projects that are approved per EY and country specific travel advisories

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our Commitment : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Professional Development : From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

People and Culture : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Benefits : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

How to Apply : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Compensation Analyst | Assurant-GCC

Position Summary

The Senior Compensation Analyst will support Assurant's Global Compensation team by delivering data-driven insights and compensation solutions that help attract, retain, and reward talent across the organization. This role partners with HR and business leaders to provide market-informed recommendations, support compensation programs, and contribute to key initiatives that drive equitable and competitive pay practices. The position offers the opportunity to influence strategic compensation decisions while contributing to the evolution of Assurant's Total Rewards programs.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct compensation analyses and develop recommendations to support talent and business decisions.

• Perform job evaluations, market pricing, and benchmarking activities to maintain competitive compensation practices.

• Support annual compensation programs, including salary planning processes and related reporting.

• Partner with HR and business stakeholders to provide compensation guidance and consultation.

• Prepare analyses, presentations, and reports for leadership and executive audiences.

• Contribute to compensation transformation initiatives and process improvement efforts.

• Support pay equity and pay transparency programs through analysis and project participation.

Location & Work Arrangement

• This position is based in Argentina and follows a hybrid work model.

• The role primarily aligns with Argentina business hours.

• Occasional early morning or evening meetings may be required during compensation cycles and annual processes.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, or a related field.

• Experience conducting compensation analysis, job evaluation, and market benchmarking.

• Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.

• Experience translating data into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting regional or multinational compensation programs.

• Knowledge of pay equity, pay transparency, salary structures, and incentive programs.

• Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.

• Experience participating in transformation, change, or process improvement initiatives.

• Exposure to AI-enabled tools or technology-driven work environments.

Why Join Us?

Join a highly collaborative Global Compensation team where you'll gain exposure to complex compensation challenges, partner with experienced leaders, and contribute to programs that impact employees across multiple business functions and geographies. This role offers meaningful opportunities to develop expertise, influence strategic decisions, and help shape the future of compensation at Assurant through transformation, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI dashboards, and other analytical tools.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have:

• Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experience, and a strong enthusiasm for adapting and learning in a fast-paced environment.

• Professionals eager to work in an environment of continuous professional development, willing to take on new responsibilities and projects, and collaborate with clients across various geographies.

What Working at EY Offers:

You will engage in inspiring and meaningful projects, with a focus on education and coaching alongside practical experience to support your personal development. We value our employees and empower you to take control of your growth with an individual progression plan. You will quickly assume a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Additionally, we offer:

• Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.

• The freedom and flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you best.

About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and advisory services, we leverage our finance products, expertise, and systems to build a better working world. This begins with a culture that prioritizes training, opportunities, and creative freedom. Regardless of when you join or how long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. With a commitment to hiring and developing passionate individuals, we aim to be the best employer.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us.

Join us in building a better working world.

Senior Portfolio Management Advisor - Assistant Director - EY Global Delivery Services

Job Summary:

The Talent Innovation & Analytics (TIAT) Team is seeking an experienced portfolio and project management professional with strong business consulting, strategic planning, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. This role oversees portfolio management, intake and prioritization, resource and capacity planning, governance, and delivery oversight for strategic Talent initiatives across the United States.

The successful candidate will serve as a senior advisor to Talent stakeholders and TIAT team members, translating business demand into a prioritized, actionable portfolio. The role will provide visibility into priorities, capacity, risks, and dependencies; support informed investment and resource decisions; and establish consistent processes and operating rhythms that enable effective execution.

This position requires strong business acumen, portfolio and project management expertise, problem-solving, executive communication, relationship management, and technical fluency. The role will collaborate across U.S. and international teams to strengthen portfolio transparency and accountability while enabling initiatives that drive innovation, efficiency, transformation, and measurable business value.

Key Functions And Responsibilities

I. Portfolio Strategy & Governance

• Manage the TIAT portfolio to ensure initiatives remain aligned with organizational priorities, available capacity, and expected business value.

• Establish and facilitate portfolio governance, prioritization reviews, and operating rhythms that enable transparency, consistency, accountability, and timely decision-making.

• Develop and maintain portfolio roadmaps, capacity plans, prioritization frameworks, and executive reporting that provide visibility into project health, resources, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

• Balance strategic value, innovation, operational needs, capacity, risk, and delivery feasibility when informing portfolio recommendations and trade-offs.

II. Intake & Demand Management

• Manage the end-to-end intake and demand process for analytics, automation, AI, technology, and process transformation requests.

• Facilitate discovery with stakeholders to understand business problems, desired outcomes, requirements, risks, and opportunities.

• Evaluate and prioritize requests based on strategic alignment, expected value, feasibility, complexity, resource requirements, risk, and delivery capacity.

• Translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clearly defined opportunities, requirements, roadmaps, and delivery plans.

III. Project Delivery & Capacity Management

• Oversee multiple concurrent projects and workstreams, monitoring timelines, milestones, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations to support successful delivery.

• Coordinate workload planning, prioritization, and capacity management across project management and ringfenced technical resources, balancing business priorities with delivery commitments.

• Establish and maintain consistent project management standards, governance practices, reporting expectations, and delivery methodologies across the portfolio.

• Proactively address risks, issues, dependencies, and capacity constraints while continuously improving delivery processes to strengthen quality, efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder experience.

IV. Business Consulting & Technology Enablement

• Serve as a strategic advisor to Talent stakeholders, helping identify opportunities for innovation, process improvement, analytics, automation, AI, and technology-enabled transformation.

• Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and stakeholder discussions to challenge assumptions, clarify business needs, evaluate options, and shape practical recommendations.

• Partner with business and technical teams to translate requirements into functional solution designs and scalable delivery approaches that meet quality, security, governance, adoption, and operational requirements.

• Develop business cases, recommendations, project charters, implementation roadmaps, process documentation, governance standards, adoption plans, and executive-ready communications supporting successful decision-making and implementation.

V. Stakeholder Partnership & Continuous Improvement

• Build and maintain trusted relationships across Talent, the Talent Enablement Center, Virtual Talent Hub, reporting and analytics teams, project resources, technical delivery teams, and other key stakeholders.

• Synthesize complex portfolio and project information into clear, decision-oriented insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.

• Promote effective collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across project and delivery teams.

• Continuously assess and enhance portfolio, project, and delivery practices to increase efficiency, strengthen execution, improve stakeholder experience, and maximize business value.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

• Advanced knowledge of portfolio, program, and project management, including intake, prioritization, governance, demand management, capacity planning, risk management, and resource planning.

• Ability to partner across business and technical teams to connect strategic priorities with delivery capacity, translating business needs into solutions across analytics, automation, AI, technology, and process transformation.

• Strong business consulting and analysis capabilities, including requirements gathering, stakeholder discovery, process analysis, documentation, solution evaluation, and roadmap development.

• Demonstrated ability to connect organizational priorities to portfolio decisions, resource allocation, sequencing, and investment recommendations.

• Experience establishing and maintaining portfolio governance, project management standards, reporting practices, and delivery methodologies.

• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to synthesize complex project, portfolio, capacity, and business information into actionable insights and recommendations.

• Strong understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, including project planning, testing, deployment, change management, and adoption.

• Ability to understand complex business and technical needs and partner with technical resources to shape practical, scalable solutions.

• Strong executive presence, written and verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities, risks, dependencies, and workstreams while maintaining organizational alignment.

• Strong relationship management skills with experience working across cross-functional, global, and distributed teams.

• Knowledge of Talent and HR processes, workforce strategy, people analytics, and HR technology preferred.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, judgment, and ability to operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments.

Other Technical Requirements:

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate Online, Power Pages), with the ability to evaluate potential applications and collaborate effectively with technical teams.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI-enabled productivity tools, agentic AI concepts, or similar technologies.

• Experience with HR technologies such as Workday, SuccessFactors, PeopleSoft, Taleo, or similar systems preferred.

• Experience with business intelligence, workflow automation, reporting, collaboration platforms, and data visualization tools.

Job Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Management, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related field required.

• PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred.

Experience:

• 8+ years of progressive project, program, or portfolio management experience.

• 5+ years leading project teams and managing complex portfolios.

• Experience managing both business and technical initiatives.

• Experience operating within PMO and governance structures.

• Experience leading global or distributed teams.

• Experience supporting technology, analytics, automation, AI, or transformation programs.

What Success Looks Like in Year One:

• Improved portfolio visibility, governance, and executive reporting.

• Implemented effective capacity planning across project management and Ringfence resources.

• Increased project throughput while strengthening delivery quality and predictability.

• Established consistent portfolio and project management practices that strengthen accountability and execution.

• Enabled scalable delivery of Innovation & Analytics services across TEC and U.S. Talent.

• Developed a sustainable operating model that effectively balances strategic demand, technical capacity, risk, and business value.

Customer Enablement

• Support customer teams by sharing knowledge, best practices, and product expertise.

• Contribute to customer adoption and successful use of Smart Product Suite capabilities.

• Collaborate with colleagues to continuously improve service delivery and customer outcomes.

Product Improvement & Innovation

• Contribute to the ongoing development of Kainos Smart Testing and Audit products.

• Share ideas for product enhancements and improvements based on customer needs and market insights.

• Work with product and development teams to validate new features, fixes, and functionality.

Collaboration & Team Contribution

• Work as part of a global team, collaborating with experienced consultants and product specialists.

• Support colleagues and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative working environment.

• Participate in continuous learning and development, building both technical and consulting skills.

Essential Requirements

We're looking for people who are customer-focused, analytical, and eager to learn.

You Should Have

• Experience working in a customer-facing environment.

• A strong customer-first mindset and a genuine interest in helping customers achieve successful outcomes.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• The ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities and customer needs.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Good commercial awareness and an understanding of business and project dynamics.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.

• The ability to collaborate effectively within remote and globally distributed teams.

Desirable Experience

It Would Be Advantageous If You Have

• A degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• An understanding of manual and automated testing practices.

• Experience within software development, business analysis, quality assurance, or testing environments.

• Exposure to cloud-based or enterprise business applications such as ERP, CRM, HCM, Financial Management, or Business Intelligence solutions.

• Experience working with the Workday platform.

• Previous experience supporting customers within a SaaS or cloud technology environment.

Why Kainos?

At Kainos, You'll Join a Well-established Global Organization Known For Delivering Innovative Technology Solutions And Exceptional Customer Outcomes. You'll Have The Opportunity To

• Work with customers and colleagues across international markets.

• Gain experience in cloud technologies, enterprise software, and Workday ecosystems.

• Learn from experienced product, consulting, and technology professionals.

• Develop your career through structured learning, mentorship, and growth opportunities.

• Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where people are encouraged to grow, contribute, and make an impact.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.
