Parexel FSP is looking to hire multiple Global Study Managers in Argentina, Brazil or Mexico!

Job Summary

The Global Study Manager II (GSM II) provides operational leadership throughout the study lifecycle, with accountability for oversight and execution of study management, site management, preferred Contract Research Organization (pCRO), and vendor deliverables for all study management deliverables in a study.

The Global Study Manager has exceptional knowledge within the organization for Study Management processes and deliverables. Additionally, the Global Study Manager will maintain expertise within their assigned Therapeutic Area and study in order to set the appropriate strategy, identify risks and to drive operational deliverables. The Global Study Manager will have good knowledge in understanding the responsibilities beyond their function in order to ensure goals are met for the study.

Key Accountabilities

Study Management Oversight

• Leads and coordinates the execution of a clinical trial globally from sourcing strategy and study specification development for requests for proposals to fully outsourced studies and ancillary vendors, study start up through database release and inspection readiness to ensure timely delivery of quality study data. May also provide input to and support compilation of sections to clinical study reports (CSRs) as needed

• May, on occasion, take on the role and responsibilities of a SOM

Study Team Interface

Subject Matter Expertise

• Champions the implementation and use of harmonized, consistent processes, and excellence in study management deliverables related to cost and effective, timely, and high quality clinical trial data according to agreed global goals

Compliance with Parexel standards

Knowledge And Experience

Su rol es clave: ordenar prioridades, asignar pendientes a los responsables y brindar a la dirección una visión clara y actualizada del estado de cada iniciativa.

Nos orientamos a un perfil con las siguientes características:

- 3 o más años de experiencia en coordinación de proyectos, PMO o roles similares, idealmente en fintech, banca o servicios financieros
-Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito (excluyente)
- Conocimientos del negocio fintech y de medios de pago
-Manejo de herramientas de gestión de proyectos (Notion, Jira, Asana, Monday o similares) y Excel / Google Sheets
-Excelente organización, comunicación y capacidad para manejar múltiples frentes simultáneamente
-Perfil proactivo y con firmeza para hacer seguimiento con distintos equipos

Algunas de sus funciones serán:

- Llevar el seguimiento integral de los proyectos de las distintas empresas del grupo, incluido el próximo registro como PSAV
- Identificar los temas que requieren avance y trasladarlos a cada responsable (legales, compliance, operaciones, tecnología, proveedores)
- Hacer seguimiento de tareas, plazos e hitos hasta su cierre
- Organizar y coordinar reuniones internas y con terceros, incluyendo reuniones del CEO con bancos de EE. UU. para sponsoreo bancario
- Preparar agendas, minutas y próximos pasos de cada reunión
- Monitorear KPIs comerciales y operativos y elaborar reportes periódicos para la dirección

La empresa ofrece:

- Incorporación inmediata
- Excelente clima laboral
- Remuneración acorde a la experiencia y mercado

postings.title: Senior Language & Culture Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

In the agency world, this role is usually called Senior Transcreation or Localization Manager – but let’s not limit ourselves: we think it’s so much more than that.

If you are looking for a high-ownership, rewarding challenge in a client-facing role, and are ready to share your localisation enthusiasm, embrace innovation, and play an active part within our highly collaborative Language & Culture team, this might be just the role for you.

Curious? Read on!

This position will own Transcreation and Voiceover workstreams for a complex, multi-brand client, requiring high levels of organization, self-driven initiative, the ability to run multiple projects across brands simultaneously, proactive quality ownership, creative and critical thinking and confident communication.

You possess client-facing management experience and in-depth knowledge of project lifecycle from brief to delivery (including but not limited to quoting, briefing vendors, assigning tasks, performing quality checks/delivering/actioning feedback and amends requests/issuing POs, reporting project information and financials), with additional understanding of cross-functional collaboration and production elements that take part in the adaptation process.

You will be ensuring seamless delivery of locally relevant, on-brand copy in multiple languages, for brands with vastly different preferences and requirements, while also helping us build team-wide solutions.

You are familiar and experienced with language industry best-practices regarding translation management systems, translation memories, terminology management, vendor management and have a particular interest in AI and automation.

Ultimately, the role requires strong client and project management skills, creativity, initiative, confident ownership, and commitment to deliver quality at scale in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Owning account health and day-to-day work for transcreation and VO projects, coordinating and managing delivery of multiple projects for different markets

• Receiving and actioning briefs, defining costs, timings, and allocating tasks accordingly

• Accountable for project budget, status, and reporting on these as required

• Accountable for relationship management with central and local clients, developing and maintaining a positive, trust- and collaboration-based relationship

• Proactively supporting and participating in our L&C roadmap for future-looking solutions

• Admin-related tasks such as updating trackers / managing POs and invoices from linguists

Essential

• +5 years of experience in client-facing Translation//VO Management

• Hands-on knowledge of language services workflows and best practice

• Experience with localisation of marketing campaigns for multiple countries, media and channels

• Sharp, precise communication skills

• Well organised, ability to multitask, attention to detail

DESIRED

• Up to date / interest on recent AI developments in the fields of translation / VO

• TMS tools / Project management software

• Knowledge of additional languages

• Working awareness of digital production processes

Sounds like you? Join Monks!

At Monks, you'll join a successful and super-fast-moving company creative people would kill to work for. You’ll have the chance to be part of a truly global company working as one office across teams and time zones with 1,000 Monks and counting. If you’re looking to do great work with great people, apply to join in the fun. In return for your dedication and attention to detail, you’ll get an independent position in an exciting work environment filled with some of the nicest people in the industry.

Monks stands for equal-opportunity employment and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds. Please be attentive to the requirements and accompany your application with a personal cover letter showing why you’re the right Monk for the role.

#ID12093

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

postings.title: Flash Charging Operations Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Who we are
BYD Group is a leading high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operating across four core industries; electronics, automobile, renewable energy and rail transit. As of today, BYD employs nearly one million people worldwide. At BYD, we are redefining the future of mobility. As part of the world’s leading New Energy Vehicle company, we are committed to building a sustainable, zero-emission future where technology and nature coexist in harmony.

Role Summary
The Charging Deployment and Operations Specialist supports the execution and expansion of BYD's charging network in Argentina and Uruguay. Working closely with the Head of Charging, internal teams, contractors and local partners, the role focuses on following site delivery, enabling the local deployment of digital services, and supporting network planning for a rapidly growing pipeline. The position also helps ensure that completed sites are commissioned, handed over and operated in line with BYD standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Follow the end-to-end execution of charging sites in Argentina and Uruguay, coordinating with contractors, suppliers, utilities, site hosts and internal teams to track design, permitting, procurement, construction, grid connection, commissioning and handover.

• Maintain clear visibility of project status, risks, dependencies, costs and deadlines; escalate issues promptly and drive the follow-up required to keep each site on track.

• Coordinate the local adaptation, integration and testing of digital charging services, ensuring they connect effectively with local user journeys, customer interfaces, operational partners and service providers.

• Support network planning for the expanding charging pipeline, including market and demand analysis, geographic coverage, corridor planning, site prioritization and preliminary technical and commercial feasibility.

• Support site readiness and commissioning through testing, documentation, issue resolution and structured handover to routine operations.

• Monitor the initial operational performance and customer experience of deployed sites, coordinating maintenance, corrective actions and improvements with technical teams and service providers.

• Maintain accurate project and operational documentation, including site trackers, technical records, commissioning documents, incident logs and configuration data.

• Provide execution insights and local market input to the Head of Charging and collaborate with regional and global teams to support consistent standards and future network development.

Requirements

• Education: Degree in Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Electrical/Energy, Industrial Engineering or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in infrastructure deployment, construction follow-up, project execution, energy, EV charging or similar technical and field-based roles; experience in automotive or mobility is a strong plus.

• Understanding of project delivery and electrical infrastructure; familiarity with EV charging, high-power DC systems or energy projects is preferred.

• Experience coordinating contractors and multiple stakeholders, using project trackers and operational data to drive execution and resolve issues.

• Fluency in Spanish and English. Knowledge of Chinese is highly valued.

• Availability to travel within Argentina and Uruguay.

Skills and Competencies

• Strong execution mindset, with the ability to prioritize, follow up and close actions across multiple sites and workstreams.

• Analytical and planning skills to assess locations, interpret technical and operational information, identify risks and propose pragmatic solutions.

• Clear communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with contractors, utilities, service providers, site hosts and internal stakeholders.

• High attention to safety, quality, documentation and compliance when dealing with electrical infrastructure and public-facing installations.

• Proactive, hands-on attitude and willingness to visit sites, understand real-world conditions and translate them into timely action.

postings.descriptionText:
About the client:

Our client is a US-based, fully remote team specializing in WordPress and Shopify website development, e-commerce, applications, integrations, hosting, and ongoing digital services. They partner with businesses, agencies, and organizations to create high-quality digital experiences and provide long-term support.

Their culture emphasizes treating people well, maintaining strong communication, continuously improving processes, and delivering thoughtful, high-quality work. As the company continues to grow, it is building stronger systems and leadership structures to support excellent delivery at scale.

About the role:

Our client is seeking a detail-oriented Web Project Coordinator to support website development projects, improve delivery processes, and ensure seamless collaboration between internal teams and external partners.

This role is ideal for someone with strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a proactive mindset toward improving execution.

The Delivery Coordinator will report directly to the Head of Delivery and will primarily support delivery leadership by maintaining visibility, follow-through, communication, and process consistency. This role is not responsible for independently managing the entire delivery function. Instead, it helps ensure that projects, tasks, and commitments remain organized and moving forward.

What you’ll be doing:

• Track project timelines, milestones, task completion, and delivery commitments to keep projects on schedule

• Maintain and update project boards using Asana and Kanban methodologies

• Coordinate daily task assignments, follow-ups, and deliverables across internal teams and external partners

• Keep project statuses, owners, priorities, and next steps accurate and up to date

• Identify blockers, missing information, technical dependencies, and potential delivery risks early

• Coordinate communication between clients, leadership, developers, designers, QA, and other stakeholders

• Translate client requests and project requirements into clear, actionable tasks for developers and specialists

• Assist with collecting client content, approvals, access, and other information required for project completion

• Handle straightforward WordPress or Shopify content and administrative updates where appropriate

• Support QA, SOP documentation, process improvements, and adherence to defined workflows and standards.

Who are we looking for?

• 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, customer success, or a similar role

• Experience supporting digital projects, websites, software, or agency environments is preferred

• Strong experience with Asana, Kanban, Jira, ClickUp, Monday, or similar project management tools

• Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities

• Proactive and accountable, with strong ownership of follow-through and deadlines

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating cross-functional teams

• Comfortable identifying blockers, missing information, dependencies, and potential project risks

• Working knowledge of WordPress, Shopify, or basic software development concepts is preferred

• Able to work independently and effectively within a fully remote team.

Position: Delivery Coordinator

Remote Status: Fully Remote

Preferred Location: Global

Working Hours: 40 hours a week during standard US Mountain Time working hours, with some flexibility

Holidays: 11 paid holidays and 10 days of paid time off annually

Salary: USD 1,800 - USD 2,500 per month

Internal Job ID: 1489

postings.title: EY Parthenon Deal Technology Manager - EY GDS Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
EY-Parthenon – Strategy and Execution - Deal Technology – Manager

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in IT who are serial transaction advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of operations, functions, and people.

Your key responsibilities

As a Director in EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Deal Technology practice, you will be a vital member of the team, managing and executing IT focused projects across sectors. You will support the development and execution of strategies that enable transactions. Part of your role will also involve developing experience in different types of engagements, including pre-deal (e.g., operational and carve-out planning) and post-deal (e.g., integration planning, tracking). A commercial mindset and a focus on delivery are key to this role.

Skills and attributes for success

• Build Trusted Relationships - ability to manage senior client relationships and influence client perspectives.

• Strong Problem Solving and Storytelling - be a lead for solving problems from beginning to end (problem identification, hypothesis development, synthesis, and recommendation with a compelling narrative).

• Outcomes-driven - understand and translate client needs into approach and outcomes for project delivery.

• Effective through Collaboration work effectively amongst be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the EY-Parthenon sub-service lines.

• Business and Commercially Driven - working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.

• Talent Development - coach junior colleagues to become high-performing.

• Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.

To qualify for the role, you must have

• A completed undergraduate degree (Bachelor's, Licenciatura, or equivalent) [JS1.1]with a minimum of five years of professional work experience.

• Significant management consulting experience.

• Demonstrated success in leading, mentoring, and motivating teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.

• Excellent analytical skills and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.

• Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Experience leading and managing in complex business environments.

• The ability to synthesize approaches to complex integration/divestiture conflicts.

• Strong executive presence, with demonstrated success in communicating complex topics clearly and concisely to senior leadership.

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and client teams to support successful engagement delivery.

• Expertise in a minimum of 4 of the following IT skillsets:

• IT strategy

• Enterprise architecture

• Infrastructure and cloud architecture

• Cyber and IAM architecture

• Digital Technology Strategy

• Digital IT operating model transformation

• IT cost reduction

• IT security / cyber

• IT shared services

• IT organization transformation

• ERP implementation

• Digital business enablement using digital technology enablers (i.e., advanced analytics, robotic process automation, virtual reality)

• Cloud SaaS or PaaS (including Collaboration) strategy and delivery

• Cloud IaaS or Data Center migration planning and execution

• Identity and Access Management (IAM) / Active Directory services strategy

• IT service management

• Operations Center (e.g., NOC, SOC) or Managed Service Provider

• IT TSA development

• IT finance management

• IT infrastructure management

• IT outsourcing / offshoring

• IT contract management

• IT or Cyber Diligence

• IT synergy identification

• Data governance, separation, and transition

• Integration and Separation Planning

• You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

• The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

• Strong written and verbal English proficiency, given the role's collaboration with global teams.

Ideally, you will have

• A proven record of excellence in an IT transactions role.

• Experience gained within another large professional services organization.

• A completed graduate degree (Master’s, Maestría, or equivalent) in business, IT, analytics, finance, engineering, computer science, or another relevant field.[JS2.1]

• Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

• Hands-on experience delivering IT transaction engagements within a relevant industry.

• Certifications in Agile, ITIL, PMP, Six Sigma, CISSP or CISA are beneficial.

What we look for

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

postings.title: Architect Jr
postings.descriptionText:
Somos SOUTHBAY, apasionados distribuidores oficiales de la marca NIKE en Argentina y en Uruguay.

Formamos parte del Grupo Regency, líder en la distribución de marcas de indumentaria, accesorios, calzado y otros productos en 13 países de Centroamérica y América del Sur

Con 20 tiendas entre Argentina y Uruguay, junto con los e-commerce de ambos países y más de 700 colaboradores, representamos la marca deportiva más valiosa del mundo.

MISION :

Como agente de cambio en Southbay, JR. ARCHITECT contribuye a la transformación y el crecimiento del negocio, velando por los resultados comerciales y los objetivos estratégicos de la empresa. En un entorno de constante movimiento y expansión, este rol desempeña una función clave, colaborando la construcción de las tiendas físicas, desde el diseño hasta la ejecución y seguimiento de los KPI´s claves del área. La pasión por el deporte y la innovación se reflejan en cada proyecto, asegurando que cada iniciativa esté alineada con nuestra visión de dominar el juego y tomar la delantera en el mercado, haciendo que cada jugador cuente y jugando limpio en cada paso del proceso.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Supervisión de obras .

Consiste en supervisar cada etapa de la construcción. Esto incluye coordinar y controlar a proveedores, asegurar la calidad de la ejecución y cumplir con los plazos y presupuestos establecidos.

• Presupuestos y licitaciones.

Implica realizar y evaluar los cómputos, presupuestos y licitaciones para optimizar los recursos. El objetivo es elaborar las herramientas necesarias para que se puedan tomar decisiones informadas que aseguren la rentabilidad de cada proyecto. Esto incluye definir propuestas, analizando sus ofertas y negociando los términos para optimizar los recursos.

• Coordinación Cross Functional.

Colaborar de manera efectiva con las diferentes áreas para alinear el diseño y la construcción de las tiendas según objetivos operativos y comerciales de la empresa, asegurando que el cronograma y los tiempos acordados se cumplan.

• Control de gastos.

Consiste en contraponer Capex vs. gastos de obra reales creando mapeo de los gastos realizados para cada obra. Esta información es fundamental a fin de dar seguimiento, control y generar KPI´s de medición.

• Revisión de Layouts y Documentación.

Asegurando que se ajuste a las necesidades del negocio.

COMPETENCIAS:

• Capacidad para planificar, ejecutar y supervisar proyectos de principio a fin, incluyendo el manejo de cronogramas y presupuestos.

• Habilidad para interactuar con proveedores y equipos internos, resolviendo conflictos y asegurando que las necesidades del proyecto se cumplan.

• Dominio de herramientas como AutoCAD, Monday y Excel, además de una comprensión sólida de los procesos constructivos y la normativa de obras.

• Enfocarse en alcanzar los objetivos del negocio, finalizando las obras de las tiendas a tiempo y dentro del presupuesto.

REQUERIMENTOS:

• Profesional recibido en Arquitectura, Ingeniería Civil o carreras afines.

• Dominio de AutoCAD y del paquete Office.

• Se requiere un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia previa en roles similares, específicamente en Retail.

• Es necesario contar con disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional para la supervisión de obras y relevamiento de sitios.

• Dominio de inglés.

-- Modalidad de trabajo híbrida --

﻿📍 Oficinas en Olivos, Buenos Aires.

postings.title: Analista de Proyectos
postings.descriptionText:
🚀 En Adhoc potenciamos organizaciones a través de personas felices

¿Te entusiasma encontrar oportunidades de mejora y convertirlas en proyectos que generen impacto real? En Adhoc buscamos una persona curiosa, analítica y con ganas de trabajar con equipos diversos, tecnología e inteligencia artificial para transformar nuestra forma de trabajar 🚀

🎯 ¿Cuál es la misión del rol?

Como Analista de Proyectos serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de mejora, convertirlas en proyectos concretos y coordinar su implementación hasta lograr resultados sostenibles. Trabajarás sobre cuellos de botella y procesos internos, articulando con equipos diversos, promoviendo la mejora continua y asegurando el seguimiento, la iteración y la adopción de las soluciones implementadas.

💼 Responsabilidades

• Relevar procesos junto con los equipos involucrados para comprender su funcionamiento, detectar problemas y encontrar oportunidades de mejora.

• Convertir los problemas o cuellos de botella identificados en proyectos concretos, definiendo objetivos, alcance, prioridades y próximos pasos.

• Diseñar y proponer mejoras de procesos que contribuyan a aumentar la productividad y la calidad de los resultados.

• Coordinar la implementación de las mejoras con equipos diversos, promoviendo la alineación y la participación de las personas involucradas.

• Organizar el trabajo y hacer seguimiento de los proyectos, adaptando el plan frente a cambios de contexto, nuevas necesidades o desvíos.

• Recopilar feedback, analizar indicadores y evaluar el impacto de las soluciones implementadas para realizar los ajustes necesarios.

• Documentar procesos, decisiones, aprendizajes y resultados para facilitar la reutilización y escalabilidad de las mejoras.

• Transformar conocimiento existente en materiales claros y reutilizables, como guiones, contenidos, videos, guías, tutoriales y documentación.

• Diseñar la estructura y el contenido necesarios para materiales de capacitación y herramientas de adopción.

• Participar en iniciativas de uso inteligente de inteligencia artificial para mejorar procesos internos y multiplicar el conocimiento.

• Detectar oportunidades para estandarizar soluciones y asegurar que las iniciativas implementadas generen resultados concretos y sostenibles.

🎓 Lo que buscamos en vos

• Formación en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas, Negocios Digitales o carreras afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 1.5 o 2 años en proyectos, mejora continua, análisis de procesos u operaciones.

• Perfil analítico y resolutivo, con capacidad para transformar problemas en propuestas concretas.

• Organización y autonomía para llevar iniciativas desde la idea hasta su implementación y seguimiento.

• Habilidades de comunicación, escucha y coordinación con distintos equipos, incluso sin autoridad directa.

• Adaptabilidad, curiosidad y apertura para trabajar en contextos dinámicos y de cambio constante.

• Manejo de herramientas de gestión de proyectos, documentación, análisis e inteligencia artificial.

🌟 Sumás puntos si además venís con...

• Experiencia gestionando proyectos de mejora continua o transformación de procesos.

• Experiencia relevando procesos con equipos de distintas áreas.

• Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles, gestión del cambio o mejora de operaciones.

postings.title: Project Manager - Senior - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
Transformation Design & Execution @ EY provides a rewarding career targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology, and infrastructure transformations. If you have a passion for rallying together with a team to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic TD&E team!

The opportunity

Join EY GDS’s TD&E team to help US clients connect strategy to execution—acting as their bridge from ambition to results—across functional domains such as Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and ERP. You will set up the right governance, including Transformation Management Offices (TMO), Enterprise PMOs (EPMO), or PMOs. As a Senior, you will work as part of a team to enable one or more of these capabilities: demand intake and prioritization, budgeting, portfolio scenario planning, program/portfolio/transformation execution, schedule management, risk & issue management, resource management, value planning & realization, KPI definition, performance reporting, and data‑driven dashboards. You will also provide guidance to team members, deliver high‑quality client service on complex topics, and help spot ways EY can bring more value to clients.

Your Key Responsibilities

A successful Transformation Design and Execution Senior will work with our clients to establish a TMO, PMO or EPMO infrastructure to mobilize and manage programs by applying a proven EY framework and methodology based on industry-recognized global standards. For these projects, you will lead a team and partner with engagement leadership to design, establish, and deliver project and program Operating Models and governance structures, track performance, complete status reporting and value realization across workstreams. You will support a knowledgeable team with experience in planning, controlling, and executing complex functional programs (Cyber/Finance/Risk/ERP), Program Management Offices and Transformation Offices . In your role, you will gain key insights and drive strategic conversations with our clients.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Enablement (Functional): Partner with US teams and functional leaders to align strategy, controls, and outcomes across Cyber, Finance, Risk, and ERP initiatives.

• Operating model & governance: Define functional operating models and governance for TMO/PMO/EPMO.

• Portfolio & delivery: Drive portfolio intake, prioritization, planning, execution, and benefits tracking with clear RAID.

• Tooling & data enablement: Configure PPM (Planview/Clarity), integrate Jira/Azure DevOps/MS Project, and enforce data quality.

• Agile enablement: Facilitate Scrum/SAFe/Kanban ceremonies and continuous improvement across functional workstreams.

• Reporting & KPIs: Build executive-ready reporting and dashboards; set KPIs and control-health metrics.

• Risk & compliance: Embed SOX, SOC, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR/CCPA; support testing and audit readiness.

• Change & adoption: Lead communications, training, hypercare, and adoption metrics.

• Client growth & deliverables: Support pursuits/eminence and produce SteerCo packs, TOMs, roadmaps, and playbooks.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Consulting mindset: Think critically, structure ambiguity, and design solutions that address client challenges while creating measurable outcomes.

• Architect outcomes: Link strategy to execution, ensuring design is fit‑for‑purpose.

• Orchestrator of delivery: Coordinate and partner with cross‑functional teams to deliver excellence.

• Executor with precision: Drive disciplined execution, embedding agile practices and ensuring quality at every stage.

• AI‑enabled practitioner: Activate pragmatic AI/automation use cases and CoEs (e.g., dashboard copilot, testing accelerators, risk insights) to future‑proof client transformations.

• Storytelling & influence: Simplify complex information into clear, engaging narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders.

• Analytical rigor: Apply structured problem solving, data‑driven insights, and creative thinking to deliver innovative solutions.

• Adaptability & resilience: Thrive in dynamic environments, flexing to client needs and embracing change with a solution‑oriented approach.

• Collaboration & inclusivity: Operate effectively across cultures and time zones, fostering a respectful and team‑oriented environment.

• Leadership presence: Demonstrate sound judgment in risk management and escalation; show confidence and credibility in client‑facing interactions.

• Professional excellence: Stay current on industry trends, PMO practices, and functional capabilities; demonstrate strong technical and professional knowledge.

To qualify for the role:

Must Haves

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Systems, Engineering, Economics, Social/Organizational Science, or a related field. A Master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.

• Experience: 4-7 years of relevant experience delivering large-scale, complex programs in consulting or industry, with hands-on exposure to one or more functional domains (Cyber, Finance, Risk & Compliance, ERP). Experience in several of the following is required:

• PMO/EPMO/TMO design, setup, and operations

• Program road-mapping, resource/capacity management, and execution governance

• PMO maturity assessment and capability uplift

• Transformation Office/benefits realization and value tracking

• End-to-end portfolio management (intake, prioritization, financial management)

• End-to-end ERP implementation lifecycle (Fit/Gap → Build → Test → Cutover → Hypercare)

• Cyber/Risk initiatives (control remediation, IAM, vulnerability mgmt, policy & compliance)

• Consulting experience: At least 1 year of external client-facing consulting experience, including managing client relationships in a business or technology context.

• Tooling: Working knowledge of Planview/Clarity (or equivalent SPM/PPM), Jira or Azure DevOps, and MS Project/Primavera; ability to build in Power BI/Tableau and advanced Excel. Exposure to ServiceNow GRC/ITSM, Archer/OneTrust, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP, Anaplan is a plus.

• Time flexibility: Ability to flex working hours to support US-based collaboration.

Good to have

• MBA or relevant Master’s; Certifications such as PMP, CSM/Scrum, SAFe, Six Sigma; plus CRISC, CISM/CISSP, or ERP certifications (SAP, Oracle, Workday) are a plus.

• Sector experience in Advanced Manufacturing & Mobility, Automotive, Consumer, Media & Entertainment, Life Sciences, Banking/Financial Services, and Technology.

What We Look For

We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to do it. We look for people with an entrepreneurial spirit: innovative by nature, always creating new approaches, products, services, and technologies. Helping clients solve tough problems and implement solutions requires strong intellectual abilities and rigor as well as a practical sense of what works and what does not. We seek people who strive to lead themselves, their teams, and their communities, and who can foster effective teamwork to drive results. Is this you?

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.

Plus, we offer:

• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

• Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and consulting, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Build your legacy with us. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.  

Apply now

EY, an equal employment opportunity employer (Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Disabled), values the diversity of our workforce and the knowledge of our people.

postings.title: Assoc. Project Manager (Vendor management)
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview

Associate Project Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, liaising with clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Associate Project Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for project delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with SOPs, policies and practices. Clinical Project Management is focused on project delivery, productivity and quality resulting in strong financial performance and customer satisfaction. The Associate Project Lead support the efforts of CPM to drive operational excellence and strategic leadership with our customers. Associate Project Leads may run their own studies, as part of their development.

Essential Functions

• Provide input in to the development of integrated study management plans with the core project team and/or sub-team.

• Will be assigned as the primary contact for vendors leading project vendor management and vendor management related activities as per project requirements.

• Accountable for assigned portion of clinical studies as per the contract while optimizing speed, quality and cost of delivery and ensuring consistent use of study tools and training materials and compliance with standard processes, policies and procedures.

• Set objectives of project sub-team(s), according to agreed upon contract, strategy and approach, effectively communicate and assess performance.

• Collaborate with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.

• Monitor progress against contract and prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to internal stakeholders. Support the project leader to prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to external stakeholders.

• Identify risk (positive and negative) and contingencies and partner with project leader in problem solving and resolution efforts.

• Achieve project quality by identifying quality risks and issues, responding to issues raised by project sub-team members and partner with project leader planning/implementing appropriate corrective and preventative action plans.

• May serve as primary (for small projects) or back-up project contact with customer.

• Lead the efforts of a project sub-team, responsible for managing cross-collaboration of the sub-team to support milestone achievement and to manage issues and obstacles.

• Support the project leader in ensuring the financial success of the project.

• Forecast and identify opportunities to accelerate activities to bring revenue forward in partnership with the senior project leader.

• Identify changes in scope and partner with project leader to manage change control process as necessary.

• Identify lessons learned and implement best practices.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree In life sciences or related field required.

• +4-5 years of clinical research experience, being the majority of those years in a project management capacity in a CRO or pharma company.

• Strong vendor management experience is mandatory.

• Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. Strong presentation skills.

• Problem solving - Strong problem solving skills.

• Organisation - Planning, time management and prioritization skills. Ability to organize resources needed to accomplish tasks, set objectives and provide clear direction to others, experience planning activities in advance and taking account of possible changing circumstances.

• Cross-collaboration - Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.

• Finances - Good understanding of project financials.

Please, make sure to submit your CV in English. It will be assessed by a global team.

We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Job Overview

Clinical Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, working alongside clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Clinical Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for the clinical delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies and practices. Clinical Leads ensure clinical delivery to customers, lead clinical teams and partner with Project Leaders and other functional teams ensuring projects meet delivery requirements at all times.

This is a local trial management support position, responsible for clinical delivery in Argentina .

Essential Functions

• Ensure clinical delivery of assigned projects in compliance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonization (ICH)-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), customer requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), project plans).

• Accountable for meeting projects’ recruitment targets and ensuring appropriate recruitment strategies are in place.

• Contribute to the development of the project risk mitigation plan and manage clinical risks through the project’s lifecycle.

• Ensure clinical quality delivery by identifying quality standards/requirements, planning how compliance will be measured, monitoring and overseeing management of clinical quality issues.

• Manage clinical aspects of Project Finances including Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and create plans to deliver. Monitor and manage changes against baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify additional service opportunities or out of scope work.

• Identify clinical stakeholder landscape for the project and manage both internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and resolution management.

• Collaborate with the clinical team to support milestone achievements. Report to internal and external stakeholders as per project scope requirements.

• Resourcing and Talent Planning of the clinical team. Manage the clinical team at project level to successfully deliver the project through the establishment of high-quality operational plans and guidance and project related trainings.

• Conduct regular team meetings and communicate appropriately to achieve objectives.

• Support professional development by providing feedback to clinical team line managers on performance relative to project tasks.

• May contribute to the development of the clinical delivery strategy for proposals. Participate in bid defense preparations and meetings. Develop and present Clinical Operation plan in partnership with Business Development and Project Leadership.

• May mentor and coach new peers as they assimilate into this role.

• May work as a primary Clinical Lead alongside other Clinical Leads to deliver large, global trials.

• May attend site visits as applicable in support of project delivery.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in health care or other scientific discipline required (graduated, mandatory).

• Requires 5 years clinical research/monitoring experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience (mandatory).

• Fluency in the local country language (spoken and written) and advanced English is required, tested during the interview process.

• Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.

• Problem solving - Problem solving skills.

• Organization - Planning, time management and prioritization skills.

• Prioritization - Ability to handle conflicting priorities.

• Quality - Attention to detail and accuracy in work. Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output.

• Leadership - Good influencing and negotiation skills. Good judgment and decision-making skills. Effective mentoring and training skills, fostering learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.

• IT skills - Good software and computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Collaboration - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.

• Cross-collaboration - Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.

• Effective communication - Ability to influence without authority.

• IQVIA Core Competencies - Ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).

• Familiarity with AI, automation, and workflow enablement concepts preferred.

• Ability to identify, assess, and communicate program risks, issues, dependencies, and trade-offs, and to escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.

• Highly effective written and verbal communication, presentation, analytical, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

• Above average attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. In this role you will work closely with the Launch and Customer Success teams developing meaningful relationships with our pool of contractors and coordinating with them to support the installation process of Halter. As a Launch Modelling Specialist you will also be modelling farms and identifying the optimal locations for tower placement and working directly with farmers through requested iterations of their deployment plan.

to enable seamless deployment

• Exceptional communication skills, you will be coordinating with team members and

contractors in various regions

• High attention to detail, you will need to ensure work carried out by contractors and

casual employees is to a high standard and completed in a timely manner

• If you have any experience in the geospatial/mapping industry with an understanding of

and experience with Linux, Python or Photoshop, that would be a HUGE plus but not a

must-have.

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. You'll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into clear requirements, and drive tooling and automation initiatives from idea to implementation.

Tooling Ownership & Support

• Own and manage the go-to-market tool stack, serving as a first point of contact for tooling-related questions and issues.

• Scope and drive tooling initiatives end-to-end, defining requirements, milestones, and expected business outcomes.

• Evaluate new tools and AI-powered workflows and assess their potential value for the organization.

• Build business cases and recommendations for tools and systems worth adopting.

• Create documentation and self-service resources to improve tool adoption and reduce recurring support needs.

Automation & Workflow Design

• Identify manual and repetitive processes across Sales and Customer Success and build automations to improve efficiency.

• Build workflows using tools such as Clay, Zapier, and similar automation platforms.

• Work with tables, enrichment workflows, API and webhook connections, and AI-powered automation features.

• Connect automation workflows with CRM, enrichment sources, and other tools across the GTM stack.

• Own the testing, maintenance, and continuous improvement of workflows as tools and processes evolve.

CRM & Systems

• Partner with CRM stakeholders to translate go-to-market needs into clear requirements and actionable specifications.

• Gather requirements from cross-functional teams and help prioritize system improvements based on business impact.

• Support CRM-related initiatives and contribute to maintaining reliable and useful data.

postings.descriptionText:
About EY

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

The Opportunity

The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.

The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.

This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.

Success in this model depends on agility—the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.

The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Operations

• Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.

• Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.

• Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.

• Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.

• Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.

• Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.

• Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.

Operational Excellence

• Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.

• Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.

• Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.

• Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.

• Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.

• Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.

• Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.

Skills & Attributes for Success

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.

• Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.

• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.

• A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.

• Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.

• Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society, and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI, and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network, and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Requisitos

• Especialidad Ingeniero industrial, mecánico o carrera afín.

• Estudiante universitario parcial, en curso o completo.

Conocimientos especiales deseables

• Herramientas de calidad, mejora continua y procesos.

• Auditor interno ISO 9001-14001-45001.

En Central Puerto somos la empresa líder en la producción de energía eléctrica a nivel nacional. Nuestro objetivo es producir energía en forma eficiente, sustentable y en armonía con el medio ambiente, contribuyendo al abastecimiento de la demanda eléctrica con calidad y generando valor tanto para la compañía como para la sociedad en su conjunto.

Actualmente, contamos con un portafolio energético diversificado compuesto por 16 centrales distribuidas en todo el país, que abarcan distintas tecnologías de generación térmica, hidroeléctrica, eólica y solar. Nuestros activos representan una potencia instalada de 6.933 MW , con una generación anual aproximada de 18.603 GWh , lo que equivale a una participación de mercado del 15,9% , posicionándonos como el principal grupo privado de generación eléctrica a nivel nacional.

A su vez, somos el mayor accionista privado de la sociedad Central Vuelta de Obligado S.A. y contamos con participación en Termoeléctrica José de San Martín S.A. y Termoeléctrica Manuel Belgrano S.A.

En línea con nuestra estrategia de crecimiento, continuamos ampliando nuestra capacidad instalada tanto en generación térmica como renovable, a través de nuevas inversiones, respaldados por una sólida posición financiera. Como parte de esta estrategia de diversificación, en 2026 ingresamos al negocio de Oil & Gas a través de la adquisición de los bloques Aguada del Chivato y Aguada de Bocarey, en Neuquén, con potencial de hidrocarburos no convencionales en la formación Vaca Muerta. También estamos desarrollando 2 proyectos de almacenamiento de energía mediante baterías (BESS), por un total de 205 MW , en nuestras centrales Puerto y Costanera.

En paralelo, somos uno de los principales grupos inversores del sector forestal en la Argentina. A través de nuestra subsidiaria Forestal Argentina, poseemos y operamos más de 160.000 hectáreas de plantaciones forestales ubicadas en distintos puntos del país.

Central Puerto también participa en proyectos de minería bajo el formato de Corporate Venture Capital, impulsando el desarrollo de iniciativas estratégicas vinculadas a nuevas cadenas de valor energético.

postings.title: Sales Operations Analyst Sr. (Regional)
postings.descriptionText:
📢 ¡Buscamos Sales Operations Analyst Sr !

💻 Modalidad híbrida.

📍 Ubicación Almagro, CABA. Contamos con unas hermosas y cómodas oficinas en Almagro - CABA como espacio de coworking 🤜🤛

🕘 Jornada Full time, de 9hs a 18hs

🎯 ¿Cuál será tu propósito principal?

Ser responsable del seguimiento y control integral del ciclo comercial, asegurando que cada operación avance desde el cierre de la venta hasta su implementación, facturación y cobranza.

Tendrás un rol clave en el diseño, la mejora y la documentación de procesos comerciales, garantizando la trazabilidad de las operaciones, la calidad de la información y la conversión efectiva de las ventas en ingresos.

Buscamos una persona autónoma, proactiva y resolutiva, con capacidad para tomar ownership de los procesos, detectar desvíos, impulsar soluciones y coordinar con distintas áreas para hacer que las cosas sucedan.

⚠️ Importante esta NO es una posición de Back Office administrativo, atención al cliente ni gestión de reclamos. Buscamos experiencia en la gestión del ciclo comercial end to end y en la construcción o mejora de procesos, no solamente en la ejecución de procedimientos previamente definidos.

👩‍💻 ¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

• Gestionar y controlar el ciclo comercial end-to-end, desde el cierre de la venta hasta la implementación, facturación y cobranza.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los hitos de cada operación, detectando y resolviendo desvíos que puedan generar demoras o ingresos pendientes de facturación o cobro.

• Coordinar con Comercial, Operaciones, Administración, Finanzas y Legales para garantizar el avance de las operaciones.

• Asegurar la calidad, integridad y trazabilidad de la información comercial en CRM y otros sistemas.

• Elaborar reportes, realizar cruces y analizar datos para dar visibilidad sobre el pipeline instalado, facturable, facturado y cobrado.

• Diseñar, rediseñar, documentar y estandarizar procesos comerciales y administrativos, promoviendo la mejora continua.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora, implementar controles y desarrollar soluciones que permitan prevenir errores y hacer más eficiente la operación.

• Actuar como referente funcional de Back Office a nivel regional, coordinando criterios y dando seguimiento a los procesos y acuerdos de servicio internos.

• Contribuir a la escalabilidad de la operación regional, acompañando el crecimiento del negocio y la expansión a nuevos mercados.

Requisitos 🔍 ¿Qué esperamos de vos?

Requisitos excluyentes

• Estudios universitarios o terciarios completos o en curso en Administración, Ingeniería, Sistemas, Comercialización o carreras afines, o experiencia equivalente demostrable.

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en Sales Operations, Back Office Comercial, Administración de Ventas o gestión de operaciones comerciales.

• Experiencia en el seguimiento del ciclo comercial B2B (end to end), con responsabilidad sobre procesos de facturación y cobranza.

• Experiencia concreta en el diseño o rediseño de procesos haber identificado problemas, propuesto cambios e implementado mejoras, más allá de ejecutar procedimientos definidos por otras personas.

• Experiencia utilizando un CRM como sistema de registro y seguimiento del ciclo comercial, incluyendo oportunidades, contratos y/o hitos de facturación. No alcanza con haberlo utilizado exclusivamente para gestionar tickets, reclamos o casos de atención.

• Manejo avanzado de Excel, incluyendo tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, cruces de bases de datos y elaboración de reportes.

• Autonomía, proactividad y capacidad resolutiva para gestionar procesos, organizar prioridades y destrabar situaciones.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para coordinar con distintas áreas e interlocutores.

📌 Aclaración sobre la experiencia buscamos una persona con experiencia en la gestión integral del ciclo comercial end to end y en el (re)diseño o la mejora de procesos . Si bien la experiencia en tareas administrativas es valiosa, para esta posición necesitamos excluyentemente que puedas tomar decisiones sobre el proceso e impulsar mejoras de manera autónoma.

💜 Valoraremos las siguientes competencias

• Experiencia en empresas tecnológicas, SaaS B2B o servicios tecnológicos.

• Experiencia en operaciones regionales y coordinación con equipos de distintos países de Latinoamérica.

• Conocimiento de procesos comerciales complejos, contratos, licitaciones y proyectos a medida.

• Manejo de ERP, como SAP, Tango, Soho u otros.

• Conocimientos de herramientas de BI y reporting, como Power BI o Looker Studio.

• Experiencia coordinando equipos o actuando como referente funcional, aunque no hayas tenido personas formalmente a cargo.

• Inglés y/o portugués.

• Formación complementaria en Sales Operations, gestión de procesos, análisis de datos o administración financiera.

• Interés en desarrollarte hacia futuros desafíos de liderazgo y coordinación regional.

Beneficios ⭐ Ofrecemos los siguientes beneficios

✔️ Prepaga médica de excelente nivel 🩺

✔️ 20 días de estudio anuales 📚

✔️ Wellhub (ex Gympass) para acceder a una amplia red de gimnasios y diferentes actividades a bajo costo 🏋️‍♀️

✔️ Día off de cumpleaños + box de regalo 🎂

✔️ Programa de referidos con compensación económica 👥

✔️ Regalos en momentos especiales y sorteos durante el año 🎁

¡Sumate a Urbetrack! 🚀

Somos una empresa argentina de tecnología que combina desarrollo de producto y servicios, impulsando soluciones innovadoras para la gestión de activos.

Nuestro principal producto es Urbetrack , una plataforma integral que permite a nuestros clientes monitorear y gestionar sus activos —principalmente flotas vehiculares— en tiempo real. A través de esta solución, pueden visualizar métricas, generar reportes, optimizar recorridos, estimar consumos y tomar decisiones más eficientes para reducir costos y mejorar sus operaciones 📊.

La plataforma se potencia con tecnología IoT nuestros equipos de Operaciones instalan y configuran dispositivos (GPS, antenas, sensores, cámaras con IA) en los activos que recolectan información clave y la envían al sistema, permitiendo un seguimiento preciso y actualizado.

Además, contamos con un equipo de Software Factory 💻 especializado en el desarrollo de soluciones a medida, y brindamos servicios de Consultoría Tecnológica para acompañar a nuestros clientes en sus procesos de transformación digital.

Trabajamos principalmente con empresas de Oil & Gas, Minería y, especialmente, Higiene Urbana 🚛 —donde somos referentes—, colaborando también con organizaciones del ámbito público en iniciativas vinculadas a Smart Cities, sustentabilidad y economía circular ♻️.

Hoy estamos presentes en distintos países de Latinoamérica, como Colombia, México, Chile, Honduras y España 🌎, y seguimos creciendo con el objetivo de consolidarnos como líderes en telemetría y geolocalización de activos.

En Urbetrack creemos en el talento como motor de crecimiento 💜.

Fomentamos un entorno colaborativo, donde se valoran las ideas, la iniciativa y las ganas de generar impacto. Cada persona tiene la oportunidad de desarrollarse, asumir desafíos y ser protagonista del crecimiento de la compañía ✨.

Si te motivan los desafíos, la tecnología y el crecimiento profesional, este es tu lugar 🤩

postings.title: Customer Ops & Master Data Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Company Description

Syngenta is a global leader in agricultural innovation with a presence in more than 90 countries. Syngenta is focused on developing technologies and farming practices that empower farmers, so they can make the transformation required to feed the world’s population while preserving our planet. Its bold scientific discoveries deliver better benefits for farmers and society on a bigger scale than ever before. Guided by its Sustainability Priorities, Syngenta is developing new technologies and solutions that support farmers to grow healthier plants in healthier soil with a higher yield. Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland; Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Read our stories and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram & X.

Job Description

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Customer Ops Manager Sur is seeking a Customer Operations & Master Data Specialist in Vicente López, Buenos Aires. This role will support with own and deliver reliable customer operations execution and customer master data management across LATAM South. The role ensures that customer orders, customer records and operational information are processed accurately, on time and in line with applicable policies, controls and service-level agreements. Acting as a bridge between Commercial, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, IT and customers, the role improves service delivery, strengthens data governance and turns operational data into actionable insights.

Accountabilities

• Create, maintain and update customer master records in SAP, Salesforce and other approved systems, including legal entity details, billing and shipping addresses, tax identification, payment terms and relevant commercial attributes.

• Validate incoming requests for completeness, accuracy, consistency, required documentation and approvals before execution, in accordance with local requirements and global data standards.

• Manage customer orders end-to-end in SAP, ensuring accurate processing, timely delivery, invoicing support and SLA compliance.

• Monitor backlog, availability and deliveries, proactively coordinating solutions with Commercial, Planning and Logistics.

• Resolve operational issues, discrepancies, returns, complaints and escalations through effective stakeholder communication.

• Contribute to operational reviews, issue resolution and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.

Qualifications

Required

• Advanced student or graduate in Business Administration, Agribusiness, Economics, Information Systems, Supply Chain or a related discipline.

• Experience in customer operations, customer service, order management, master data administration or a comparable operational role.

• Strong attention to detail, analytical judgement and ability to manage multiple requests and changing priorities.

• Clear written and verbal communication in Spanish and English; ability to work effectively across a multicultural, cross-functional environment.

• Customer-first mindset, personal ownership, sound problem solving and confidence to challenge poor-quality inputs constructively.

Desired

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.

• Experience in master data governance, customer onboarding or order-to-cash processes across multiple countries.

• Lean, Six Sigma, process excellence or project-management training.

• Knowledge of tax, invoicing or customer data requirements in Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.

• Portuguese language capability

Additional Information

What We Offer

• A culture that celebrates diversity & inclusion, promotes professional development, and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.

• Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day.

• Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Education Assistance, Wellness Programs, Corporate Discounts, among other benefits.

Important

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Beyond just believing in the power of diversity, Syngenta Group promotes an inclusive culture that includes differences in all its forms. We believe that the feeling of belonging allows people to become their best version, building an increasingly welcoming and productive environment.

All qualified candidates will be considered for our positions, without distinction of race, gender, age, nationality or disability

• This position will not provide relocation support.

• This position will require immediate availability.

Breakthroughs for farmers in every field

postings.title: Ingeniero de Control de Procesos
postings.descriptionText:
Eramine Sudamérica SA es una subsidiaria de Eramet, un grupo minero y metalúrgico global francés. Está ubicada en el Salar Centenario Ratones, a 3.800 metros sobre el nivel del mar, en el departamento de Los Andes, en la provincia de Salta, Argentina.

Las actividades de exploración tuvieron inicio hace 12 años y a fines de 2019 comenzó a operar nuestra planta piloto que proporciona una demostración de la calidad del producto final de carbonato de litio, con más de un 90% de eficiencia de extracción directa.

INGENIERO/A DE CONTROL DE PROCESOS

Descripción

El puesto tiene como propósito asegurar la disponibilidad, confiabilidad y correcto funcionamiento de los sistemas de control de procesos, así como monitorear, analizar y optimizar el desempeño de los procesos productivos y sus estrategias de control, identificando desviaciones e implementando mejoras. Asimismo, integra el equipo de Asistencia a la Producción, que brinda cobertura continua 24/7, aportando durante su jornada soporte técnico especializado para contribuir a la continuidad operativa de la planta, la seguridad de los procesos, la calidad del producto y el cumplimiento de los objetivos de producción.

Reporta a: Gerente Asistente de Producción de Planta

Ubicación: Salar Centenario - Ratones. Provincia de Salta, Argentina.

Responsabilidades

• Asegurar la disponibilidad, confiabilidad y correcto funcionamiento de las aplicaciones y sistemas de control de procesos.

• Monitorear y analizar el desempeño de los procesos productivos para identificar desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora en eficiencia, estabilidad, calidad y productividad.

• Definir, implementar y optimizar estrategias de control de procesos, respetando las filosofías de control, condiciones de diseño y procedimientos vigentes.

• Realizar diagnósticos y análisis de causa raíz, participando en la definición y seguimiento de acciones correctivas y preventivas.

• Brindar soporte técnico a Operaciones y Mantenimiento para la resolución de incidentes y problemas relacionados con el proceso y los sistemas de control.

• Configurar, mantener y optimizar las aplicaciones de control PLC y SCADA/HMI, coordinando con otros integrantes de IT/OT la disponibilidad y el mantenimiento de la infraestructura tecnológica asociada.

• Participar en modificaciones de lógica de control, secuencias, interlocks, parámetros operativos, configuración y racionalización de alarmas y mejoras de automatización.

• Analizar información proveniente de SCADA, historiadores de proceso, PI, LIMS y otras plataformas industriales aplicables.

• Participar en los procesos de Gestión del Cambio (MOC), evaluando los impactos operacionales, tecnológicos y de seguridad de las modificaciones propuestas.

• Participar como referente técnico en proyectos de expansión, modificaciones de planta, precomisionamiento, comisionamiento, puesta en marcha y optimización de instalaciones.

Su Perfil

• Título universitario en Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Eléctrica/Electrónica, Ingeniería en Automatización o carreras afines.

• Certificaciones / especializaciones adicionales en sistemas de control, redes industriales automatización industrial, ciencia de datos o mejora continua son ventajosas.

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en un rol de Control de Procesos o Automatización.

• Idioma: Ingñes Nivel Avanzado (C1 +) escrito y oral.

• Conocimientos avanzados en programación, configuración y diagnóstico de PLC, sistemas SCADA/HMI e historiadores de datos.

• Conocimientos avanzados de redes y comunicaciones industriales, incluyendo LAN, VLAN, Spanning Tree y protocolos industriales.

• Conocimientos de instrumentación, sistemas de adquisición de datos y dispositivos de automatización industrial, tales como variadores de frecuencia, relés inteligentes de gestión de motores TeSys T o equivalentes.

• Manejo de herramientas de análisis de tendencias, elaboración de indicadores, reportes y visualización de datos de procesos.

• Experiencia en el diagnóstico y resolución de problemas en sistemas de control de procesos, dentro de entornos de operación continua.

• Capacidad para interpretar diagramas de proceso, narrativas y filosofías de control, matrices de causa y efecto, lógicas de control, enclavamientos (interlocks) y documentación técnica.

• Capacidad para configurar, probar y validar funcionalmente modificaciones en PLC, SCADA/HMI y otras aplicaciones de control.

• Experiencia en configuración, diagnóstico y puesta en servicio de equipos de automatización y comunicaciones OT.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en modalidad roster 14x14.

Presente en los cinco continentes y con empleados de más de 70 nacionalidades, Eramet es por naturaleza un grupo inherentemente diverso.

Convencidos de que la diversidad es una ventaja, nos comprometemos a acoger a todos los talentos, independientemente de su género, discapacidad, edad, origen social o cultural, orientación sexual y creencias.

Nos comprometemos a ofrecer a todos los empleados el apoyo y las oportunidades de desarrollo que necesitan a lo largo de su carrera profesional.
