Elaborará la ingeniería de etapas tempranas (visualizaciones) y revisará la ingeniería elaborada por terceros para etapas de conceptualización, definición y ejecución. Se desempeñará en el área que ejecuta ingeniería de proyectos de instalaciones de superficie en yacimientos convencionales y no convencionales.

¿Cuál será su desafío?
Visualizar necesidades y diseñar las facilidades de producción para el desarrollo de los bloques de la propiedad. Elaborar y/o ejecutar revisiones, estudios y análisis técnicos, aplicando los criterios de diseño establecidos, en los proyectos en los que participa, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto y velando por el diseño de procesos optimizado, seguro y eficiente.

¿Cuáles serán sus principales tareas?

• Asistir técnicamente a las distintas áreas del Upstream recomendando soluciones técnicas apropiadas.

• Participar en el desarrollo de alternativas de producción del no convencional, integrando las necesidades de las IISS existentes.

• Participar en etapas de visualización y re-visualización de bloques de la propiedad, aportando soluciones y definiciones técnicas para la producción eficiente del mismo.

• Ejecutar la revisión de los documentos claves propios de su especialidad y aquellos que requieren de su intervención en la revisión interdisciplinaria en proyectos de definición, ejecución e implantación. Garantizar la calidad de los documentos técnicos y la aplicación de las especificaciones técnicas de diseño, normativas aplicables, leyes, reglamentaciones y las buenas prácticas en su área de especialidad asegurando el plazo y costo establecido.

• Analizar e informar los desvíos a las Especificaciones de Diseño de su especialidad que aplican al proyecto efectuando recomendaciones. Participar en la actualización de las Especificaciones que se le asignen facilitando la aplicación de normas y estándares nacionales e internacionales de la industria. Iniciar el trámite del no cumplimiento de una especificación de diseño, su justificación y alcance, contribuyendo así a la gestión del conocimiento.

• Participar en el desarrollo y actualización de la IB/IBE de estándares de equipos e instalaciones.

• Colaborar en las descripciones de alcances técnicos para contratación de ingenierías, estudios especiales y obras. Contribuir en la definición del alcance y establecer los requerimientos técnicos aplicables y establecidos en las Bases de Diseño.

• Participar en el análisis técnico de desvíos ofertas por servicios de ingeniería, estudios especiales, obras y provisión de materiales y equipos en su especialidad. Contribuir en la homologación técnica de ofertas y asegurar el alcance requerido.

• Elaborar los documentos requeridos en las ingenierías que se realizan con recursos propios, asegurar la revisión interdisciplinaria de los documentos de su especialidad y realizar la revisión de los de otras especialidades, asegurando el cumplimiento del alcance de acuerdo con las especificaciones técnicas de diseño, normativas aplicables, leyes, reglamentaciones y las buenas prácticas en su área de especialidad contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto.

• Ejecutar el estudio técnico comparativo para seleccionar Tecnologías de Procesos. Asegurar la selección de la tecnología óptima que permita alcanzar las especificaciones técnicas del proyecto en el marco del cumplimiento de los objetivos.

postings.title: INGENIERO DE PROCESOS DE CORROSION
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.
En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos personas que se caractericen por una fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad técnica y aprendizaje continuo, interés por comprender integralmente los procesos industriales, capacidad para resolver problemas complejos y orientación al trabajo en equipo para desempeñarse como INGENIERO DE PROCESOS en la VP MISTREAM Y DOWNSTREAM.

¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos con nosotros?

Seras responsable de realizar las acciones derivadas de la estrategia de estandarización, seguimiento, control y optimización de los procesos de los CCII y Logística de Downstream, a fin de contribuir a la eficiencia de la operación, asegurando el cumplimiento de la normativa vigente y las directrices fijadas por la Compañía y su línea de mando.

¿Cuáles serán tus tareas?

1. Coordinar el seguimiento de las variables de operación, los parámetros económicos y las variables críticas de integridad de las unidades de procesos con reacción, utilizando herramientas de monitoreo en línea e historiadores de proceso, a fin de contribuir a la optimización de los beneficios e identificar desviaciones, tendencias y potenciales impactos sobre la seguridad, confiabilidad y mecanismos de daño de los equipos.

2. Analizar las variables de operación, los balances, los parámetros económicos, los catalizadores y las condiciones reales de proceso de estas unidades, considerando su integración e interacción, con el objeto de optimizar sus beneficios e identificar desvíos respecto del diseño, arrastre de contaminantes, excursiones operativas y condiciones capaces de activar o acelerar mecanismos de daño.

3. Proponer, estudiar y evaluar los beneficios asociados a las modificaciones de los parámetros operativos o de las instalaciones, nuevos catalizadores o reutilización de los existentes en otros procesos operativos, participando en los estudios especiales y grupos de mejora a fin de contribuir a la optimización de los procesos productivos, cuidando la seguridad de las personas y las instalaciones, así como el Medio Ambiente y calidad de los productos y servicios.

4. Participar en la ingeniería conceptual, básica y de detalle de modificaciones y proyectos relevantes que afecten directamente a los procesos con reacción y a sus equipos específicos, manteniendo actualizados los diagramas de flujo de proceso (PFD), balances de materia y energía, P&ID y documentación técnica asociada, y evaluando el impacto de los cambios sobre la integridad mecánica, los sistemas de control, protección y seguridad de procesos.

5. Modelizar y simular los procesos de reacción, especialmente en boca de reactor, a fin de contribuir a la detección de cuellos de botella, proponiendo mejoras que permitan la optimización de estos.

6. Participar en el comisionado y la puesta en marcha en unidades nuevas o modificaciones de existentes, así como en test de plantas o equipos; liderar la carga y descarga de catalizadores, guardas y otros, con el objetivo de garantizar la efectividad de las mejoras introducidas en los procesos.

7. Decidir los ensayos físico-químicos a realizar en las materias primas, productos y, en especial, catalizadores, aditivos, guardas de metales y demás insumos de las unidades de procesos con reacción.

8. Colaborar, liderar y/o participar en estudios en Centros Tecnológicos, de Investigación o desarrollos propios relacionados con la mejora de los procesos de producción, nuevas tecnologías de catalizadores, aditivos y/o insumos, nuevos productos en planta, optimización de canastas de procesamiento y adecuación o vinculación de las unidades dentro de los esquemas de refino existentes, con el fin de optimizar y modernizar los procesos productivos, cuidar el Medio Ambiente y mejorar la seguridad y calidad de los productos obtenidos.

9. Participar en la elaboración de informes comparativos (benchmarking) con otras compañías del sector y estudios especiales de unidades, catalizadores, aditivos, guardas de metales y otros, con el objetivo de conocer el posicionamiento y tomar acciones para contribuir a la mejora continua, aplicando las mejores prácticas.

10. Analizar y validar los resultados de las reclamaciones de clientes y recomendar acciones correctivas, a fin de contribuir a la calidad y la mejora continua.

11. Liderar los test run de unidades de procesos y las evaluaciones de catalizadores y productos, con el fin de detectar cuellos de botella y potenciales beneficios en la operación. Realizar la validación, homologación y/o prueba en las Unidades Piloto de su área de incumbencia.

12. Gestionar los recursos humanos a su cargo, consolidando las evaluaciones de desempeño y supervisando el proceso de formación y desarrollo, para asegurar el crecimiento del equipo y consolidar la gestión del conocimiento.

13. Realizar seguimientos con los tecnólogos de catalizadores y aditivos con el fin de lograr la mejor performance operativa de las unidades involucradas.

14. Analizar P&ID, filosofía operativa, sistemas de control, alarmas e históricos de proceso para comprender el comportamiento real de las unidades, identificar variables críticas de proceso e integridad y establecer relaciones causa-efecto entre la operación y la degradación de los activos.

15. Participar en la definición, actualización y seguimiento de Ventanas Operativas de Integridad (IOW), identificando las variables que gobiernan mecanismos de daño, los límites normales de operación, los límites de alerta y las excursiones críticas que requieren acciones de mitigación.

16. Realizar estudios de tendencias mediante PI Vision, PI DataLink u otras herramientas equivalentes de visualización e historiado de datos, identificando comportamientos anormales, variabilidad operativa, pérdida de performance, contaminación cruzada y condiciones precursoras de daño.

17. Participar en revisiones HAZOP, LOPA, análisis de riesgo y evaluaciones de lógicas de control y Sistemas Instrumentados de Seguridad (SIS), identificando escenarios operativos capaces de generar condiciones favorables para mecanismos de daño, pérdida de contención o degradación acelerada de activos.

18. Diferenciar los límites normales del proceso, los límites de diseño, las restricciones inherentes a la operación y las variables que no pueden desviarse sin comprometer la seguridad, la calidad, la continuidad operativa o la integridad mecánica.

19. Analizar las diferencias entre el proceso ideal y el proceso real, considerando variabilidad operacional, arrastre o acumulación de contaminantes, cambios de composición, ineficiencias de separación, desbalances y otras condiciones con impacto potencial en corrosión y mecanismos de daño.

20. Participar en la selección, desarrollo y optimización de estrategias de monitoreo, mitigación y control de corrosión, evaluando el uso de inhibidores, neutralizantes, secuestrantes, dispersantes, lavado con agua, modificaciones de proceso y otras medidas de mitigación, en función de los mecanismos de daño identificados y de las condiciones operativas de las unidades.

21. Monitorear y evaluar la performance de inhibidores, neutralizantes, secuestrantes, dispersantes y otros aditivos utilizados para preservar la integridad de los activos, mediante el análisis de dosificación, variables operativas, indicadores de corrosión, resultados de laboratorio, inspecciones y datos históricos de proceso.

22. Establecer la causa raíz de las variaciones de contaminantes, impurezas y especies precursoras de corrosión presentes en las corrientes de proceso, identificando sus fuentes de ingreso, generación, arrastre, concentración o acumulación, y definiendo acciones correctivas orientadas a reducir su impacto sobre la integridad.

23. Identificar relaciones causa-efecto entre cambios en la calidad de carga, condiciones operativas, desempeño de equipos, eficiencia de separación, sistemas de tratamiento, recirculaciones e ingreso de contaminantes, evaluando su influencia sobre la corrosión y los mecanismos de daño.

¿Qué Valoramos?

Formación académica : Graduados de Ingeniería Química.
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años en unidades similares. Se valorará experiencia demostrable en análisis de históricos mediante PI Vision, actualización de documentación de procesos, participación en HAZOP y desarrollo o seguimiento de IOW.
Conocimientos Específicos: Conocimientos de procesos con reacción, cinética química y catalizadores. Capacidad para interpretar PFD y P&ID; analizar el comportamiento real del proceso; diferenciar límites normales de operación, límites de diseño y restricciones inherentes; identificar variables y desviaciones capaces de activar mecanismos de daño; seleccionar y evaluar estrategias de control de corrosión y tratamientos químicos; y establecer la causa raíz de variaciones de contaminantes con impacto en integridad.
Conocimientos Informáticos : Manejo de simuladores específicos para procesos con reacción, HYSYS y Pro II; PI Vision, PI DataLink e historiadores de proceso; herramientas de análisis de datos y estadística; Office, MS Project, MS Visio, visores de archivos AutoCAD, Acrobat y SAP.
Idioma: Inglés Intermedio.

Información del puesto

Lugar de trabajo: REF. LA PLATA

postings.title: Project Coordinator I
postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview

The mission of the Project Management Academy (PM Academy) is to identify and develop potential clinical project management leaders of the future. Within a face-to-face, continuous learning environment, Project Coordinators (PC) are the right-hand support to the Project Lead. The Project Coordinator-I performs the essential duties with a large degree of guidance and support from the Fortrea web of support that includes, but is not limited to, the Project Lead(s), Line Manager, mentor, and subject matter experts. As s/he progresses along the learning curve, the Project Coordinator I may mentor other PM Academy PCs in some areas of expertise.

Summary Of Responsibilities

• Operational Delivery:

• TIME: Work with project team to set up and maintain project schedule. Update timelines within MS Project, CTMS, project governance tool, and other trackers. Escalate when timelines are at risk.

• COST: Work with Project Lead to assist with TAQ/TAR (timesheet vs budget) reviews; vendor financial tracking and reconciliation; sponsor contract financial tracking and reconciliation; and final project financial reconciliation.

• SCOPE: Work with Project Lead to conduct Contract vs Study Plan Review. Maintain tracker of out of scope (OOS) work performed. Assist the Project Lead to create Change Order Forms. Provide vendor management, escalating OOS activities to Project Lead.

• RISK: Update Xcellerate Risk Identification and Issue Resolution (RIIM) tool; and follow outstanding action items to resolution. Ensure Xcellerate Risk Assessment Categorization Tool (RACT) is complete, using Xcellerate Risk library. Work with Study Team to ensure Protocol Deviations are updated in Xcellerate RIIM.

• QUALITY: Update Project Governance Tool monthly. Support the study team to identify, prevent and close quality compliance gaps. Support the Project Lead to prepare for audits and/or investigations, including creation of story boards to document issues that may occur during the study. Support study team to ensure timely closure of audit/inspection CAPAs.

• TEAM COMMUNICATION: Facilitate study team communication and collaboration by attending and setting up team meetings; updating the ADI log; updating the Task Order Matrix; maintaining the Project Directory; setting up distribution lists, SP sites, mailboxes, and other collaboration tools; and set up / maintain project-specific trackers.

• TEAM COLLABORATION: Collaborate with other support functions to facilitate timely TMF uploading, TMF reviews, TMF issue resolution, systems access, project specific training curriculum, and other delegated tasks. Monitor for, escalate, and help to enforce redaction of subject sensitive information and identifiers in any study documentation.

• LESSONS LEARNED: Work with Study Team to maintain Lessons Learned tracker.

• OTHER: And all other duties as needed or assigned

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

• University/college degree (life science preferred), or certification in a related allied health profession (i.e. nursing, medical or laboratory technology) from appropriately accredited institution.

• In lieu of the above requirement, candidates with three (3) or more years of relevant clinical research experience in pharmaceutical, CRO industries or experience in a health care setting will be considered.

• Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements

Experience (Minimum Required)

• 0-2 years of relevant industry experience

• Knowledge of ICH Guidelines and GCP including international regulatory requirements for the conduct of clinical development programs preferred.

• Computer competency with various programs (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Project, Access and Power Point)

• Ability to develop accurate study related documents with minimal supervision.

• Ability to communicate verbally and in writing.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

• Standard Office.

• Must be able to work at a computer keyboard 6-8 hours per day.

• Must be flexible to accept changes in work assignments, as business needs require

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

postings.descriptionText:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society. Every day we help our major Pharmaceutical clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects worldwide.

Are you interested in working for the world’s leading pharma corporations, delivering their world class, large scale complex projects?

Job Description

Spanish:

En Turner & Townsend buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Especialista en Control de Proyectos para incorporarse a un importante proyecto de logística portuaria, con base en Buenos Aires. La posición tendrá un rol clave en la planificación, el seguimiento y el control integral del proyecto, trabajando en coordinación con el cliente, los equipos técnicos y los principales stakeholders.

English:

Turner & Townsend is looking for a Project Controls Engineer to join a major port logistics project based in Buenos Aires. The successful candidate will play a key role in the overall planning, monitoring and control of the project, working closely with the client, technical teams and key stakeholders.

Qualifications

Spanish:

Principales responsabilidades

• Desarrollar, actualizar y controlar el cronograma maestro del proyecto.

• Realizar el seguimiento del avance físico, los costos, los recursos y los principales hitos.

• Analizar desvíos respecto del plan aprobado e identificar tendencias que puedan afectar los objetivos del proyecto.

• Preparar reportes periódicos, dashboards, curvas de avance e indicadores de desempeño.

• Participar en la elaboración y actualización de proyecciones de costos y plazos.

• Identificar y monitorear riesgos, oportunidades y acciones de mitigación.

• Evaluar el impacto de cambios de alcance sobre el cronograma y el presupuesto.

• Integrar información proveniente de ingeniería, procurement, construcción y demás áreas del proyecto.

• Coordinar con contratistas, consultores y equipos internos para asegurar información precisa y oportuna.

• Contribuir a la mejora de procesos, herramientas y estándares de Project Controls.

Principales requisitos:

• Ingeniero/a Civil, Industrial o de una especialidad afín.

• Mínimo 10 años de experiencia sólida en planificación y Control de Proyectos.

• Conocimiento de gestión de cronogramas, costos, riesgos, cambios y reporting.

• Manejo avanzado de herramientas de planificación, preferentemente Primavera P6 y/o Microsoft Project.

• Buen dominio de Excel; se valorará experiencia con Power BI u otras herramientas de visualización.

• Capacidad analítica, organización y orientación a resultados.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y coordinación con equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Inglés fluido, tanto oral como escrito, excluyente.

Se valorará experiencia en proyectos portuarios, logísticos, industriales, de infraestructura o de gran escala.

English:

Key responsibilities

• Develop, update and maintain the project master schedule.

• Monitor physical progress, costs, resources and key project milestones.

• Analyse variances against the approved baseline and identify trends that could affect project objectives.

• Prepare periodic reports, dashboards, progress curves and performance indicators.

• Support the preparation and regular update of cost and schedule forecasts.

• Identify and monitor risks, opportunities and mitigation actions.

• Assess the cost and schedule impact of scope changes.

• Consolidate information from engineering, procurement, construction and other project areas.

• Coordinate with contractors, consultants and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely project information.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Project Controls processes, tools and standards.

Requirements

• Degree in Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

• Solid experience in project planning and Project Controls.

• Strong understanding of schedule, cost, risk, change and performance management.

• Advanced knowledge of planning tools, preferably Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project.

• Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other data visualisation tools will be valued.

• Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication skills and experience working with multidisciplinary teams.

• Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory.

• Experience in port, logistics, industrial, infrastructure or other large-scale projects will be highly valued.

Additional Information

postings.title: Localization Project Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina (remote)

Department: Customer Success

Reports to: PM Program Manager

Working Hours: 1 pm to 9 pm GMT-3

Who We Are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

YOUR NEXT ROLE

As a Localization Project Coordinator, you'll play a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of localization projects and Programs across a diverse range of clients, content types, and markets. Working under the guidance of Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, and Program Managers, you'll help coordinate workflows, maintain accurate project data, support communication across stakeholders, and ensure that every project progresses smoothly through the localization lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in localization and Customer Success. You'll develop a strong understanding of project delivery, client requirements, localization technology, and operational best practices while contributing directly to the quality, efficiency, and success of Acclaro's services.

What You'll Do

• Project and Program support: Support Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, and Program Managers with the coordination of project and Program activities across multiple clients and workstreams.

• Workflow coordination: Assist with project setup, task creation, workflow configuration, scheduling, handoffs, and milestone tracking to ensure projects move efficiently through the delivery process.

• Data and system maintenance: Maintain accurate project information, client records, forecasts, trackers, dashboards, and operational data across all required systems.

• Instruction preparation: Prepare, verify, and distribute project instructions, reference materials, glossaries, style guides, and supporting documentation to internal and external stakeholders.

• Vendor and linguist coordination: Support communication with linguists, vendors, publishers, and other contributors, ensuring requests, questions, and deliverables are managed promptly and accurately.

• Monitoring and tracking: Monitor project progress, deadlines, and outstanding actions, escalating concerns or potential delays to the appropriate Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

• Administrative support: Complete project administration activities including purchase order processing, invoicing support, file management, status updates, reporting inputs, and documentation management.

• Quality support: Assist with quality-control activities, file verification, project checks, and process compliance reviews to help ensure delivery standards are met.

• Technology utilization: Use translation management systems, workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions as directed to support efficient project delivery.

• Issue triage: Respond to routine operational questions, route issues to the appropriate stakeholder, and ensure inquiries are addressed within expected timelines.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Project Management, Vendor Management, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and other internal teams to support delivery requirements.

• Client support: Assist with client communications, meeting preparation, documentation, reporting, follow-up actions, and routine requests as directed by project leadership.

• Process adherence: Follow established workflows, client requirements, security practices, and operational procedures consistently and accurately.

• Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and strengthen operational processes, sharing suggestions with project leadership.

• Independent ownership of defined tasks: Take responsibility for completing assigned activities accurately, professionally, and on time, seeking guidance when required and escalating concerns appropriately.

• Development and learning: Build expertise in localization processes, project management, customer service, and Acclaro technologies to support future career progression.

• Project ownership (where appropriate): Depending on experience, manage lower-complexity projects under defined guidelines and with appropriate oversight.

THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU

• Communicate clearly, confidently & professionally in written and spoken English

• Have 1+ years of experience in project coordination, administration, operations, customer service, localization, or a similar environment.

• Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent professional

• Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.

• Are highly organized and can manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

• Communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues, partners, and clients.

• Are comfortable following established processes while adapting to changing priorities and business needs.

• Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.

• Can identify issues, ask thoughtful questions, and seek guidance when needed.

• Enjoy supporting others and contributing to the success of a team.

• Are comfortable working with technology, systems, spreadsheets, and operational tools.

• Can work effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones.

• Are eager to learn and develop new skills in localization, customer success, and project delivery.

YOU'LL STAND OUT IF YOU

• Have experience in localization, translation, content operations, project support, or customer service environments.

• Have experience using translation management systems, workflow platforms, or project management tools.

• Have strong Excel, reporting, or data-management skills.

postings.title: Data Governance Lead
postings.descriptionText:
Somos MODO, la fintech de los bancos argentinos que está revolucionando la manera de pagar y ahorrar con promociones en la Argentina. Estamos en el centro del ecosistema de pagos, desarrollando experiencias de pago novedosas en QR, NFC y online con todos los medios de pago, y creando el mejor lugar para hacer y disfrutar promociones. Además, creamos el primer hub de open banking de la Argentina para hacer más simple el manejo de tu plata.
En MODO confluyen los principales bancos, procesadores de pagos, comercios y mucho más. Somos líderes en el cambio de una industria que está atravesando su mayor transformación en la historia, y nuestros productos y tecnologías están en la frontera de la práctica a nivel mundial.
Tenemos el propósito de "Conectar tu dinero y tu mundo para simplificar lo cotidiano" y los moders cuentan con todo lo que necesitan para hacerlo realidad.

Nuestro equipo está siempre en transformación, y hoy necesitamos sumar a un/a Data Governance Lead para poder seguir creciendo.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

• Definir e implementar la estrategia y el programa de gobierno de datos de MODO: política rectora, estándares, procesos y roadmap con objetivos e indicadores por trimestre.

• Establecer el modelo de stewardship: mapa de dominios, inventario de activos y fuentes autoritativas, y designación de Data Owners y Data Stewards con roles y responsabilidades formalizados.

• Articular con líderes de negocio y de tecnología la adopción del modelo, y actuar como punto de escalamiento ante conflictos de definiciones, criticidad o accesos entre dominios.

• Diseñar el framework de calidad de datos: métricas, reglas de validación, umbrales, monitoreo continuo y planes de remediación, con dueño asignado por regla y controles automatizados.

• Liderar la construcción del catálogo de datos, el glosario de negocio y el linaje, asegurando que la metadata se mantenga actualizada, versionada y accesible.

• Definir y reportar las métricas del programa (madurez, calidad, cobertura y cumplimiento) a leadership y al comité de gobierno.

• Impulsar los programas de Data Literacy: capacitación de stewards, comunicación y foros de trabajo.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Experiencia liderando programas de gobierno de datos de punta a punta, incluyendo su definición inicial y su implementación en la organización.

• Experiencia trabajando con stakeholders senior de negocio, tecnología, seguridad, legales y riesgos, con capacidad de influencia y negociación sin autoridad jerárquica directa.

• Conocimiento de marcos de gobierno y madurez de datos (DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM o similares) y de normativa de datos personales (Ley 25.326, GDPR).

• Experiencia en modelos descentralizados de gobierno, Data Mesh y domain ownership.

• Experiencia en frameworks de calidad de datos y en herramientas de catálogo, glosario y linaje (Snowflake, Atlan, DataHub, Select Star, Alation o similares).

• Capacidad técnica para escribir queries, scripts y automatizaciones de forma autónoma; experiencia con Snowflake u otro data warehouse cloud, dbt y orquestadores similares.

• Experiencia liderando equipos técnicos y en programas de capacitación y cultura de datos.

Será deseable que cuentes con...

• Certificaciones en gobierno de datos, plataformas cloud o IA responsable, y familiaridad con estándares internacionales de gobernanza de datos e inteligencia artificial.

• Experiencia en industrias reguladas (fintech, bancos, seguros), con exposición a BCRA, AAIP, PCI DSS o auditorías externas, y al modelo de tres líneas de defensa.

• Gobierno de IA y MLOps: métricas de drift, performance, fairness y explainability, auditoría de I/O; seguridad aplicada a IA como threat modeling, data leakage, prompt injection y validación de vendors.

• Experiencia hands-on con plataformas de agentes (Claude Tools/MCP, Amazon Bedrock Agents, Vertex AI Agents, OpenAI Assistants o similares), evaluación de sistemas RAG y exposición de metadata para consumo agéntico.

• Experiencia definiendo data contracts y SLAs de datos entre productores y consumidores.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• 10 días hábiles de vacaciones + 5 días MODO.

• Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar.

• Reintegro en app MODO para almuerzos y traslado.

• Membresía en Wellhub y descuento en Sport Club para actividad física.

• Licencias extendidas (por matrimonio, maternidad, paternidad y otras).

• Día de cumpleaños libre y medio día por cumpleaños de hijos/as.

• Actividades de team building.

• Posibilidad de desarrollarte en un ambiente flexible, dinámico y en pleno crecimiento.

-La vacante es con modalidad híbrida requerida, en CABA, Argentina.

Si te interesa trabajar en un equipo ágil y autónomo dentro de una compañía desde su concepción, donde el margen de acción de cada rol es gigante, ¡te esperamos!

Información Adicional
En MODO creemos que la diversidad de miradas potencia la forma en la que construimos soluciones y tomamos decisiones. Trabajamos en equipo para simplificar lo cotidiano, y eso solo es posible cuando integramos perspectivas distintas en cada desafío.
Promovemos equipos diversos e inclusivos, donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar desde su experiencia. Nuestras oportunidades están abiertas a todas las personas, sin distinción de identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen, religión, edad, discapacidad u otras características individuales.
Si necesitás algún ajuste o accesibilidad para participar del proceso, podés indicarlo en tu postulación.
#MejorEnMODO

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un analista de ciberseguridad para productos digitales

Integrarse a las torres y células de producto/plataformas digitales como referente/embajador de ciberseguridad, coordinando la incorporación oportuna de
controles y actividades de seguridad durante todo el ciclo de vida del producto. Su desafío será actuar como facilitador entre los equipos de negocio y tecnología y las especialidades de ciberseguridad, promoviendo una colaboración efectiva, dando visibilidad a los riesgos y compromisos, y contribuyendo a que los productos evolucionen de manera segura, ágil y sostenible

¿Cuáles serán tus principales tareas?

Desempeñarse como facilitador de ciberseguridad en el desarrollo, implementación y operación de soluciones aplicativas en la Vicepresidencia de Tecnología, siendo referente para el resto de las áreas de la VP.
· Coordinar la ejecución de las actividades necesarias de las áreas de la Dirección de Ciberseguridad, planificar las actividades, realizar el seguimiento de la ejecución en base a las prioridades acordadas y con una visión transversal en la implementación de los requerimientos respecto a ciberseguridad.
· Relevar, organizar y mantener actualizado el backlog de iniciativas, requerimientos y controles de ciberseguridad asociados a cada producto digital.
· Coordinar con Product Owners, líderes técnicos, arquitectura, desarrollo, operaciones y especialistas de ciberseguridad la definición de alcance, responsables, prioridades, dependencias y fechas objetivo.

Acompañar las etapas de ideación, diseño, construcción, pruebas, despliegue y operación, verificando que los requerimientos de seguridad sean considerados desde el inicio y cuenten con evidencias de cumplimiento.

Conocimiento de enfoques de desarrollo seguro y gestión de controles a lo largo del ciclo de vida de productos digitales.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

Test Consultant

Management Level: Consultant

Capability: Product Services

Join Kainos

Kainos is a trusted technology partner to organisations around the world, delivering innovative digital services and software solutions that help customers solve complex business challenges.

As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our Smart Product Suite capability in Argentina. This is an exciting opportunity to join an established global team supporting customers across North America and Europe through the delivery of intelligent testing and automation solutions.

As a Test Consultant, you will lead customer engagements, provide expert guidance on Kainos Smart™, and help organisations maximise the value of their Workday testing strategy. You will combine customer consulting, business process expertise, testing knowledge, and product understanding to deliver high-quality outcomes for our customers.

You will also play an important role in supporting the growth of our Product Services capability in Argentina by mentoring colleagues, sharing expertise, and helping develop the next generation of consultants within the team.

What You'll Do

Lead Customer Engagements

• Lead the delivery of Smart™ testing solutions for customers implementing or maintaining Workday.

• Build trusted customer relationships and act as a key point of contact throughout project delivery.

• Ensure solutions are aligned to customer objectives, business requirements, and testing strategies.

• Balance customer needs, technical considerations, and commercial objectives to deliver successful outcomes.

Understand Customer Requirements

• Lead discovery and analysis activities to understand customer Workday configurations and business processes.

• Develop expertise across Workday domains including Payroll, HCM, Financials, Recruiting, and Security.

• Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.

Design & Deliver Smart™ Solutions

• Define and communicate the scope of customer test automation solutions.

• Design, build, and optimise Smart™ test packs that provide measurable value.

• Apply deep product knowledge to determine the most effective use of Smart™ capabilities within customer environments.

• Provide recommendations and guidance based on product functionality, customer objectives, and industry best practices.

Enable Customer Success

• Deliver workshops, demonstrations, training sessions, and knowledge-transfer activities.

• Support customers in building confidence and capability in their use of Smart™ solutions.

• Ensure successful transition of customers to ongoing Customer Success and support teams following implementation activities.

Contribute to Product Innovation

• Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to improve Smart™ capabilities.

• Identify opportunities for new features and product enhancements.

• Participate in feature validation, testing, and rollout activities.

• Share customer feedback and market insights to help shape future product development.

Support Team Growth

• Mentor and coach Associates and less experienced Consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across the team.

• Support onboarding, capability development, and continuous learning initiatives.

• Participate in recruitment and interviewing activities.

• Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture.

Essential Requirements

We're looking for someone who combines strong customer consulting skills with testing expertise and a deep understanding of enterprise business processes.

Experience

• Experience in software implementation, business analysis, quality assurance, testing, consulting, or customer-facing technology roles.

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers and managing stakeholder relationships.

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, quality assurance practices, and test automation concepts.

• Experience working with cloud-based enterprise applications such as Workday, ERP, HCM, Payroll, Financial Management, CRM, or other business systems.

• Experience leading workshops, demonstrations, training sessions, and customer discussions.

• Experience mentoring, coaching, or supporting less experienced team members.

Domain Knowledge

• Experience working within payroll, HR, finance, or other enterprise business process environments.

• Strong understanding of payroll testing, payroll operations, payroll technology, or payroll implementations.

• Knowledge of payroll legislation and payroll processes in at least one of the following regions:

• United Kingdom

• United States

• Canada

Skills & Attributes

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and business audiences.

• Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project delivery within a professional services environment.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in customer-focused environments.

• Ability to build strong relationships and establish credibility with customers and colleagues.

• Experience working effectively within globally distributed teams.

Desirable Experience

• Experience with Workday Payroll, HCM, Financials, Recruiting, or Security.

• Experience with automated testing tools and test automation frameworks.

• Exposure to parallel payroll testing or payroll transformation programmes.

• Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

• Understanding of SaaS and cloud-based product delivery models.

• Experience supporting large-scale software implementation or transformation programmes.

• Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Why Kainos?

At Kainos, you'll join a well-established global organisation recognised for delivering innovative technology solutions and exceptional customer outcomes.

You'll Have The Opportunity To

• Work with leading organisations across international markets.

• Develop expertise in Workday, payroll technology, enterprise applications, and cloud solutions.

• Collaborate with experienced consultants, product specialists, and technology professionals.

• Influence the evolution of Kainos Smart™ products through close partnership with Product and Engineering teams.

• Support the growth of a strategically important Product Services capability in Argentina.

• Build a long-term career through structured development, mentoring, and progression opportunities.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

postings.title: Senior Backend Engineer (LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

Optery helps people get their personal data off broker sites. We're a fully remote team, headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, and we're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer who'll work directly with the founders on product and technical direction.

This position is open to candidates based in Latin America.

The role is backend-focused: Python and Django, with light frontend work when it makes sense (HTMX, the occasional React component). You own features start to finish, including the unglamorous part where you make sure the thing works in production a week after it ships.

What you'd work on in your first quarter

You'd be writing code in our Django backend, which powers both the consumer dashboard and the B2B platform. Expect a mix of:

• New features for the APIs that power our consumer dashboard and customer reporting

• Performance and reliability work in our Celery and RabbitMQ pipelines

• Integrations with third-party services like payment providers and identity providers (Stripe, WorkOS SSO)

• Code review, both giving and receiving, on a small backend team of other Senior Engineers

We don't have a rigid roadmap of "first 30 days, first 60 days" because that's never how it actually plays out. You'd pick up real work in your first week.

What we're looking for

Required:

• 6+ years building production web applications

• 3+ years with Python and Django

• Working knowledge of CS fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, SQL, system design

• Strong written communication; comfortable working async across time zones

• Self-direction and follow-through

Strong plus:

• DRF and/or django-ninja

• Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis in production

• Postgres tuning and query analysis

• Kubernetes and AWS

• Stripe, identity providers, or other third-party API integrations

• HTMX, React, or both

• Background in consumer privacy or adjacent industries

We expect engineers here to use AI coding assistants like Claude Code as part of normal day-to-day work. If you've spent time figuring out how to actually get value out of these tools, that's a real plus.

How we work

Two things matter more than any specific skill.

• The first is ownership. If your feature ships and breaks in production, you're the one who investigates. If a spec is ambiguous, you ask. If you see something off in a teammate's PR, you flag it instead of waiting for someone else to.

• The second is writing. Async-first work means most of our coordination happens in PR descriptions, Slack threads, and Jira tickets. We care about people who can write clearly, and who also know when it's time to give up on writing and just hop on a 15-minute call.

Location and hours

This role is open to candidates based in Latin America. We strongly prefer working hours that overlap with US Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones, because we do a fair amount of real-time collaboration.

Equal opportunity

Optery values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factors.

Compensation Range: $65K - $95K

postings.title: Senior Backend Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our LATAM engineering team. You will design and build the backend systems that power Jeeves's financial platform — working across payments, cards, spend management, and compliance infrastructure that serves businesses across the Americas and beyond.

This is a backend engineering role at its core, we're looking for a strong backend engineer who knows how to work effectively with AI tools, understands where AI can accelerate development and product capabilities, and is comfortable integrating AI-powered features into production backend systems.

Given the global nature of our business and the collaborative nature of our team, fluency in English is required for daily work with engineering, product, and business teams across multiple regions. Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is equally required — our LATAM teams, customers, and operational partners work in both languages, and you will too.

Location : This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

Backend Engineering

• Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services that process financial transactions and serve Jeeves customers across 20+ countries

• Write clean, testable, production-quality code in Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript; participate actively in design and code reviews

• Build and consume RESTful and GraphQL APIs; design inter-service communication using gRPC, message queues, and event-driven architectures

• Design and optimize relational and non-relational database schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) for correctness, performance, and scale

• Own backend features end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration

• Implement security best practices: authentication, authorization, input validation, and data protection across distributed services

AI-Assisted Feature Development

• Integrate LLM API calls (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into backend services as product features — such as spend categorization, document parsing, or natural language workflows — ensuring those integrations are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient

• Build backend pipelines that consume AI-generated outputs safely: validate structured outputs, handle fallback scenarios, and design graceful degradation when AI services are unavailable or return low-confidence results

• Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate model outputs into backend APIs — bridging experimental AI work and production systems

• Use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) fluently as part of your everyday development workflow

Reliability & Operations

• Instrument services with structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for full operational visibility

• Participate in on-call rotation; respond to production incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews

• Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, testing infrastructure, and deployment practices

Cross-Regional Collaboration

• Work closely with engineering, product, compliance, and data teams across multiple time zones and regions — communicating in both English and Spanish or Portuguese as the situation requires

• Contribute to a globally distributed engineering culture through thorough documentation, async design reviews, and thoughtful pull request feedback

• Bring your regional perspective to product and engineering conversations — our LATAM customers have specific needs, and engineers who understand those markets make our product better

Requirements:

Minimum Requirements

• 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

• Fluent in English — professional fluency required for daily work with global teams in written and spoken contexts.

• Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese — required for collaboration with LATAM teammates, customers, and operational partners.

• Strong proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript.

• Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven backend systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

• Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party APIs reliably in production — including error handling, retry logic, and observability.

• Experience working on globally distributed teams across time zones and regions.

• Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday engineering work — integrating LLM API outputs into backend services and using AI coding assistants fluently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or a regulated industry — familiarity with ledger systems, payment rails, or financial compliance (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS) is a strong plus.

• Prior experience at a startup or high-growth scale-up, comfortable building in ambiguity without heavy process support.

• Experience with multi-currency systems or cross-border payment processing.

• Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture.

• Global work experience — prior roles at companies operating across multiple countries and regulatory environments.

• Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a meaningful additional asset.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Your Day-to-day Activities

• Develop and implement our tools and systems.

• Participate in and propose team discussions.

• Do technical analysis of existing code and perform refactors to improve code quality.

• Perform code review.

• Detect and fix problems in production environment.

• Contribute to the best practices of development, reliability, and availability of our systems.

About You

• Software developer, focused on backend.

• Excellent analytical/troubleshooting skills.

• Expertise in data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis.

• Fluent in PHP, Python or Java.

• Previous DevOps experience is a plus

• Great initiative and capacity to take on projects autonomously.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and genuinely interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About Us

Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What We Offer

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
We’re looking for a Mid/Senior Backend Engineer to join a team that keeps frameworks lean and focuses on what matters: clean, maintainable code, shipped fast with TDD, DDD, and continuous integration and delivery.

Our stack includes Java 17/21, GCP, Kubernetes, Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, PostgreSQL, Redis, Spock, jOOQ, and Flyway.

Watch this video to discover how our Engineering department is structured and what we expect from our brilliant engineers.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

• Building mobile APIs

• Developing microservices to evolve our architecture

• Perfecting systems that our business depends on, like risk management, fraud detection, and payment processing

• Focusing on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

What you'll need

• Fluency with Java

• 4+ years of experience in backend development

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, maths, physics, or similar field

• To be a quick learner with an ambitious attitude and results-driven personality

• The ability to work well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication and organisational skills

• Fluency in English

Nice to have

• Proficiency with Kotlin or Scala

• A background in finance

• Experience in a startup or scale-up

• Experience in a product-focused environment

Compensation range

• Krakow: PLN36,000 - PLN40,000 gross monthly*

• Poland: PLN36,000 - PLN40,000 gross monthly*

• Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

postings.title: Software Development Engineer,III (Backend) — Fiat Payments
postings.descriptionText:
About The Company

Our mission is that "Any financial application can onboard any user, anywhere in the world, in 1 click."

Transak provides onboarding to financial applications through authentication, KYC, risk checks, and fiat on/off ramps. This is a next generation of infrastructure for the next generation of financial applications that are built on blockchain and stablecoin rails. Our API and widget-based solutions are used by top partners like MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, and Trust Wallet to enable seamless onboarding of over 10 million users across over 450 active applications.

We have raised over $37M from top-tier investors including Consensys, Tether, and Animoca Brands.

About The Role

Transak's Fiat/Payments team builds and operates the rails that move money between traditional banking systems and crypto — ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, wires, virtual accounts, and card rails. As an SDE 3, you will own critical, high-throughput payment microservices end-to-end: design, build, scale, and operate systems that move real money for users across multiple currencies and jurisdictions, with US,UK/EU regulatory and global banking-partner requirements as a core part of the job.

This is a senior individual-contributor role calibrated against SDE 3 / Senior Engineer, driving architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and being the go-to owner for a payments domain, while staying hands-on in code daily.

Key Responsibilities

• Payment Systems Ownership & Architecture

• Own payment microservices end-to-end — design, build, deploy, and operate Node.js services (orders, payment, reconciliation, virtual accounts, payout orchestration) handling real-time financial transactions at scale.

• Design for correctness and failure: idempotent, retry-safe, reconciliable systems where every transaction is traceable, auditable, and recoverable (partial failures, webhook replays, duplicate detection, distributed state machines).

• Architect for scale and resilience across a distributed microservices architecture; make service-boundary and build-vs-buy decisions; address root causes rather than symptoms.

• Banking & Partner Integrations

• Drive integrations with banking and payment partners (e.g. banking and card providers / risk providers) — API contracts, webhook handling, sandbox-to-production rollout, and reconciliation logic across multiple rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, wires).

• Work with Risk, Compliance on KYC, AML, and fraud-control touchpoints in the payment flow.

• Local Payments experience in Argentina and LATAM

• Hands-on experience integrating with Argentine banking infrastructure CBU/CVU-based transfers, COELSA/BCRA clearing systems, and real-time credit transfer protocols (Transferencias 3.0).

• Experience working with Argentine PSPs or fintechs operating CVU accounts including webhook reconciliation, fund identification by CUIT, and split CBU structures for inflow/outflow segregation.

• Familiarity with BCRA/CNV/ UIF regulatory constraints affecting payment flows including restrictions on card-based crypto purchases and reporting obligations tied to transaction thresholds.

• Experience building reconciliation systems for ARS-denominated transactions, including handling multi-FX environments, intraday rate volatility, and settlement timing differences between CBU and CVU rails.

• Understanding of CUIT/CUIL-based fund identification for compliance and reconciliation purposes.

• PIX and SPEI experience is

• Infrastructure, CI/CD & Operations

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) — automated testing, blue/green or canary deployments, and rollback strategies for services that cannot tolerate downtime or data loss.

• Operate infrastructure on AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch); contribute to infra-as-code, monitoring, alerting, and on-call runbooks for payment-critical systems.

• Optimize the data layer: schema design and query performance in MongoDB, caching and rate-limiting strategies with Redis, and safe migration patterns for high-volume transactional collections.

• Participate in on-call for payment-critical services, including incident response and postmortems.

• Technical Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead technical roadmaps — break down large, ambiguous payments initiatives into shippable milestones; write design docs/RFCs; drive consensus across Engineering, Product, Risk, and Operations.

• Mentor and raise the bar — review code and designs, coach mid-level engineers, and help hire and grow the team.

• Uphold security and compliance best practices for handling PII/financial data in a regulated, PCI-DSS-adjacent environment.

What We're Looking For

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion building backend/distributed systems; prior experience in fintech, payments, on-and-offramp provider, or banking infrastructure strongly preferred.

• Experience with payment rails or card processing.

• Familiarity with banking partner integrations in LATAM.

• Strong hands-on expertise in Node.js (TypeScript preferred) for performant, production-grade backend services.

• Deep experience with MongoDB — schema design, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategy, and performance tuning at scale.

• Proficiency with Redis — caching, distributed locks, rate limiting, and pub/sub patterns.

• Proven experience designing and operating microservices architectures, including inter-service communication (REST/gRPC/event-driven via SQS/Kafka,ELK,New relic, Mixpanel), service discovery, and API contract design.

• Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on experience using Jenkins (pipeline-as-code, multi-stage builds, automated test gates).

• Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure — ECS/EKS/Lambda, VPC networking basics, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch; infra-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) is a plus.

• Strong grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, eventual consistency, retries/backoff, circuit breaking, and failure isolation.

• Track record of owning a service or domain end-to-end in production, including on-call responsibility.

• Excellent written communication — comfortable authoring design docs/RFCs and explaining trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders (Risk, Ops, external partners).

Nice-To-Haves

• Experience with payment rails in LATAM (Pix, Spei and SWIFT/wires) or card processing.

• Exposure to KYC/AML/fraud tooling.

• Prior experience operating in a regulated environment.

postings.title: Member of Technical Staff — Software Engineer (Backend)
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

What You'll Do

As a Member of the Technical Staff, in the role of a Software Engineer at DevRev, you'll build customer-facing product capabilities across the stack. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to understand customer problems, make thoughtful technical trade-offs, and deliver experiences that are useful, intuitive, and reliable.

You'll own features from concept through production: shaping requirements, designing APIs and data flows, implementing backend services, writing tests, and iterating from customer and engineering feedback. You'll contribute to a modern, AI-native SaaS platform that brings product, support, and growth teams together around the customer.

In this role you'll

• Build end-to-end product features across responsive web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

• Design, build, and evolve scalable backend APIs, services, and data flows that support reliable, multi-tenant SaaS capabilities.

• Contribute to user-facing experiences and integrations where needed, partnering with front-end engineers to deliver cohesive product features.

• Write high-quality, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and improve testing, performance, accessibility, security, and observability.

• Investigate production issues, participate in follow-the-sun on-call rotation as well as post-incident follow-ups, and use what you learn to prevent repeat problems.

• Collaborate across product, design, and engineering in a global team, communicating trade-offs clearly and helping ship customer value quickly.

• Build skills and automations that help our infrastructure and application engineering teams implement, build, and deploy services faster and more reliably.

• Improve observability, alerting, and cost visibility across services, in line with our resource tagging and telemetry standards.

• Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate learning, implementation, testing, and documentation.

What You'll Need

• You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production web applications, or SaaS products.

• You have hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure).

• You have strong programming experience in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, Python, or Node.js.

• You have experience designing and developing APIs, backend services, and SDKs.

• You understand relational and NoSQL databases, asynchronous processing, and the trade-offs involved in building scalable, reliable systems.

• You have shipped user-facing features and care deeply about usability, performance, reliability, security, and thoughtful interaction design.

• You write clean, well-tested code and are comfortable with code review, debugging, and working through ambiguous product and technical problems.

• You have strong communication and collaboration skills, and are comfortable working across a distributed, global team.

• Comfortable designing and implementing in an AI-first organization.

• You have a BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus points

• You have experience with multi-tenant SaaS systems, event-driven architecture, message buses or queues, and high-throughput distributed services.

• You have experience with cloud-native development practices, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability.

• You have worked with AI/ML-powered product capabilities, including LLM applications, agentic workflows, search, or recommendation systems.

• You've contributed to reusable component libraries, internal developer tooling, or open-source projects.

• You have exposure to observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) and OpenTelemetry.

• You have solid working knowledge of infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and are comfortable with YAML, Helm charts, HCL, and Argo CD.

• You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and enjoy taking ownership of project outcomes.

Why join DevRev

You'll build products that directly change how companies connect their customers, support teams, product teams, and developers. You'll work on a modern, AI-native platform with a global group of engineers, designers, and product leaders who care about craft, customer empathy, and shipping meaningful outcomes.

This is an opportunity to own work end-to-end, grow quickly through real product challenges, and help shape a platform used by teams building the next generation of SaaS companies.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

postings.title: Sr. Backend Engineer | Gestión de Incidentes & Observabilidad
postings.descriptionText:
Somos MODO, la fintech de los bancos argentinos que está revolucionando la manera de pagar y ahorrar con promociones en la Argentina. Estamos en el centro del ecosistema de pagos, desarrollando experiencias de pago novedosas en QR, NFC y online con todos los medios de pago, y creando el mejor lugar para hacer y disfrutar promociones. Además, creamos el primer hub de open banking de la Argentina para hacer más simple el manejo de tu plata.
En MODO confluyen los principales bancos, procesadores de pagos, comercios y mucho más. Somos líderes en el cambio de una industria que está atravesando su mayor transformación en la historia, y nuestros productos y tecnologías están en la frontera de la práctica a nivel mundial.
Tenemos el propósito de "Conectar tu dinero y tu mundo para simplificar lo cotidiano" y los moders cuentan con todo lo que necesitan para hacerlo realidad.

Nuestro equipo está siempre en transformación, y hoy necesitamos sumar a un/a Sr. Backend Engineer (con foco en gestión de Incidentes & observabilidad) para poder seguir creciendo.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?

• Participar o co-diseñar decisiones de arquitectura para las herramientas del equipo.

• Participar en la construcción end-to-end de producto, interactuando con un equipo multidisciplinario dueño del ciclo completo.

• Diseñar e implementar funcionalidades de gestión de incidentes y monitoreo: automatización de detección, alerting, war rooms, tracking de métricas DORA.

• Idear e implementar funcionalidades disruptivas utilizando las últimas tecnologías del mercado.

• Construir servicios seguros, robustos y preparados para una alta escalabilidad en producción.

• Desarrollar plugins e integraciones con plataformas externas (PagerDuty, Slack, Status Page, herramientas de observabilidad tipo Datadog).

• Participar activamente en discusiones de diseño de sistemas distribuidos y proponer mejoras de proceso que impacten en la organización.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

• Buscamos personas 100% tecnológicas, detallistas, orientadas a resultados, que no tengan miedo de moverse en escenarios cambiantes y con muchas, pero muchas ganas de aprender y pasarla bien.

• Experiencia liderando decisiones técnicas y mentoreando otros desarrolladores.

• Tener ganas de contribuir en equipos encargados de todas las etapas del desarrollo de software.

• Te apasione trabajar en equipo, aprender, recibir feedback y crecer como persona y profesional.

• Experiencia haciendo troubleshooting de incidentes en producción, no solo desarrollo, sino diagnóstico bajo presión.

• Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST siguiendo mejores prácticas de Open/Public APIs.

• Experiencia desarrollando con Node, TypeScript y NestJS.

• Experiencia con DynamoDB/MongoDB, PostgreSQL.

• Conocimientos de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure).

• Tener conocimiento de procesos de release con CI/CD, testing de stress/performance y monitoreo y troubleshooting en producción.

• Experiencia con herramientas de observabilidad (Datadog u equivalentes).

• Tener interés en resolver grandes desafíos de sistemas distribuidos altamente escalables, utilizando las últimas tecnologías del mercado.

• Buenas prácticas de seguridad de datos sensibles (manejo de PII, tokenización, y si aplica, nociones de PCI-DSS).

• Priorizar y fomentar la comunicación efectiva y fluida, dentro y fuera del equipo.

• Conocimiento o interés fuerte en herramientas de incident management (PagerDuty, Opsgenie, o similar).

• Familiaridad con conceptos de SRE: SLIs/SLOs, alerting inteligente, reducción de ruido, postmortems.

• Interés en métricas de ingeniería (DORA: MTTR, frecuencia de despliegue, etc.).

• Valorado: experiencia con bots/automatización para war rooms o respuesta a incidentes.

• Exploración o adopción de herramientas de IA aplicadas a observabilidad o desarrollo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

• 10 días hábiles de vacaciones + 5 días MODO.

• Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar.

• Reintegro en app MODO para almuerzos y traslado.

• Membresía en Wellhub y descuento en Sport Club para actividad física.

• Licencias extendidas (por matrimonio, maternidad, paternidad y otras).

• Día de cumpleaños libre y medio día por cumpleaños de hijos/as.

• Actividades de team building.

• Posibilidad de desarrollarte en un ambiente flexible, dinámico y en pleno crecimiento.

-La vacante es con modalidad híbrida requerida, en CABA, Argentina.

Si te interesa trabajar en un equipo ágil y autónomo dentro de una compañía desde su concepción, donde el margen de acción de cada rol es gigante, ¡te esperamos!

Información Adicional
En MODO creemos que la diversidad de miradas potencia la forma en la que construimos soluciones y tomamos decisiones. Trabajamos en equipo para simplificar lo cotidiano, y eso solo es posible cuando integramos perspectivas distintas en cada desafío.
Promovemos equipos diversos e inclusivos, donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar desde su experiencia. Nuestras oportunidades están abiertas a todas las personas, sin distinción de identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen, religión, edad, discapacidad u otras características individuales.
Si necesitás algún ajuste o accesibilidad para participar del proceso, podés indicarlo en tu postulación.
#MejorEnMODO
