postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

Avature's highly configurable, high-performance platform has been redefining the large-enterprise SaaS market since 2005, resulting in an exciting work environment full of technical challenges and learning opportunities with a team that never stops growing.

Our Senior Software Engineers work in small development teams that act like mini software companies, balancing refactoring and new feature development, defining and presenting road maps quarterly, and fully participating in the fundamental aspects of the commercial software business, from maintainability and usability to competitive positioning. If you are passionate about working in high-powered teams building out the complex components and services of a powerful multi-application SaaS platform and want to use your analytical and technical skills to tackle complex engineering challenges, Avature could be the place for you.

Your Challenges And Objectives

• Achieve expert-level knowledge of our platform by understanding the complex interaction of a wide range of services and feature sets, from framework layer to end user experience.

• Incorporate into your work product several computer science disciplines, such as high availability and high performance system design, industry-leading security standards, and intuitive user interface design.

• Abstract customer feature requests in order to build a highly flexible platform which allows users to customize it through tailored configurations and UI options.

• Learn and collaborate with different teams while tackling complex technical challenges in a fun and encouraging working environment.

Your Day-to-day Activities

• Work with the product team on functional specifications of features (specs): interpret, analyze, and provide feedback.

• Design and write the code for the feature.

• Perform technical analysis of existing code and refactors to improve code quality.

• Review code from your peers in different teams.

• Promote and apply best practices during the entire development process, from the very early stages of technical analysis and design of solutions to the monitoring in production of your team’s code.

About You

• Work experience in software development

• Analytical/troubleshooting skills

• Strong background in OOP, SOLID principles, DDD, and unit testing

• Fluency in one or more of the following: PHP, JavaScript, Python or Java

• Working knowledge of Unix, preferably Linux

• Intermediate/Upper-Intermediate English skills.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and genuinely interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About Us

Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What We Offer

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

• Flexible hours.

• Periodic salary reviews.

• Three weeks vacations from the first year.

• Four weeks paternity leave.

• OSDE 360 health coverage (family plan).

• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.

• Paid internet service expenses.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization.

• Knowing your ideas are heard and matter — think big!

• You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

• Work with smart and creative people

postings.title: Senior, Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What You'll Do

• Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.

• Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.

• Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.

• Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.

• Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.

• Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.

• Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.

• Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.

• Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.

• Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What You Bring

• Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.

• Strong proficiency in Python.

• Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.

• Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.

• Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.

• Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.

• A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.

• Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.

• The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.

• A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

• Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.

• Exposure to agent development frameworks.

• Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy.

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is at its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

postings.title: Senior, Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What You'll Do

• Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.

• Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.

• Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.

• Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.

• Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.

• Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.

• Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.

• Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.

• Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.

• Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What You Bring

• Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.

• Strong proficiency in Python.

• Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.

• Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.

• Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.

• Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.

• A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.

• Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.

• The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.

• A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

• Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.

• Exposure to agent development frameworks.

• Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!

• Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members

• Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases

• Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses

• Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes

• 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub

• Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda

• A flexible vacation policy.

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is at its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s lived experience, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and genetic information. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world, and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

About XBOW

Build the future of offensive security with XBOW. Attackers are already using AI to move faster than defenders can react—we’re creating the platform that puts security ahead in the arms race. Our AI-powered system autonomously discovers, validates, and even exploits vulnerabilities, giving organizations proof-backed results in hours instead of weeks.

Founded by Oege de Moor, creator of GitHub Copilot, and backed by Sequoia, Altimeter, and other leading investors, XBOW is applying cutting-edge AI to one of the world’s most urgent problems. In just over a year, our AI, built by a world-class AI team and legendary security researchers — has uncovered thousands of real-world zero-days across the software billions rely on, and achieved the #1 ranking on HackerOne’s global leaderboard.

We’re a team of builders, hackers, and researchers who thrive on solving problems others think are impossible. If you want to push the boundaries of AI, reshape how security is done, and join the group defining this new era of defense — we’d love to talk.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who’s passionate about building reliable and high quality products with robust backend systems. In this role, you’ll design and implement end-to-end features across the stack: from React-based frontends and TypeScript APIs to backend services in Kotlin and Go, all deployed on AWS.

You’ll be joining a small team of superstars that’s shipping quickly and operating with high trust. This is a role for someone who loves to own open-ended problems and figure things out—whether that’s designing seamless API contracts, optimizing database interactions, or building scalable systems that make powerful AI capabilities accessible. If you like being at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact, you’ll feel right at home.

What You'll Do

• Design and build full-stack systems that integrate frontend and backend seamlessly

• Develop scalable APIs and backend services in TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go

• Deploy and operate services in AWS and other cloud providers

• Own problems end-to-end—from design through deployment to production support

• Navigate ambiguity and help define how we build as much as what we build

• Collaborate closely with teammates across the stack, including AI researchers, Security researchers and backend engineers

Who You Are

• Experience building and operating full-stack systems

• Proficiency with TypeScript

• Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL)

• Strong backend development experience (Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or similar languages)

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with incomplete information

• A thoughtful communicator who values clarity and simplicity

• Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment

Bonus If You Have

• Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or async workflows

• Experience building scrappy, iterative frontends where speed and feedback loops matter more than polish

• Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud platforms

• Comfort working with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform or CDK)

• A strong appreciation for user experience and design, even if you’re not a formal designer — you care about how features feel as much as how they work

• Comfortable prototyping quickly in React/TypeScript and turning ideas into working features fast

• Experience designing and optimizing relational databases (we use Postgres), and you know how to structure data for both performance and clarity.

• Background in systems programming, networking, or performance tuning

• Experience with hybrid deployments (cloud + on-prem) and know how to build resilient systems that handle the complexity of mixed environments.

• Experience working in an early stage startup

• Prior experience building security products or products for technical users

What We Offer

• Compensation & Equity: Competitive salary and a generous equity package, making you a true owner of the company.

• Career Growth: Shape your role, lead the function, and grow with the company as we redefine cybersecurity.

• Meaningful Work: You will tackle technically complex challenges and play a pivotal role in the growth of our business, working alongside an amazing team and some of the world’s experts to shape how AI transforms cybersecurity.

What Else You Should Know

• Location: Remote (all team members are remote but we meet regularly and you’re supported to travel to collaborate with colleagues in person)

• Contract: Full-time.

• Hiring Process:

• 45-min introductory chat with our Talent team.

• 45 minutes with one of our Engineering Leads.

• 2-3 hour technical deep dive around relevant case study.

• 30-min final meeting with the Engineering Lead for the assigned team..

We aren't focused on seniority titles at XBOW—so if you’re worried about “leveling,” don’t be. We care a lot more about mission fit, capability, and impact than what’s on your LinkedIn headline.

We believe in people who are driven by curiosity and a willingness to learn. Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about the role and our mission.

En GIRE llevamos más de 30 años transformando el mercado de pagos y cobranzas en Argentina, siendo un aliado estratégico para empresas grandes y pymes. Somos líderes gracias a la innovación constante, el compromiso con la confiabilidad y el respaldo de tres de los bancos más importantes del país.
Hoy buscamos un/a desarrollador/a Senior que combine criterio técnico sólido con vocación de referente: alguien que no solo escriba buen código, sino que eleve los estándares del equipo, impulse mejoras arquitectónicas y colabore activamente en la evolución de nuestras plataformas críticas.
Si te motiva diseñar sistemas que no fallan, mentorear a otros desarrolladores y proponer soluciones que hagan crecer el negocio… ¡queremos conocerte!
🎯 Objetivo del rol:
Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar funcionalidades críticas en nuestras plataformas de pagos, aportando criterio técnico en decisiones de arquitectura, garantizando la calidad del código que llega a producción y acompañando el crecimiento técnico del equipo.
📋 Lo que vas a hacer:

• Diseñar y desarrollar funcionalidades complejas, escalables y mantenibles en entornos de alta demanda.

• Velar por la calidad del código mediante code reviews, definición de estándares técnicos y buenas prácticas.

• Mejorar y rediseñar funcionalidades e integraciones con sistemas internos y soluciones de terceros.

• Acompañar el desarrollo técnico de desarrolladores del equipo, brindando guía y transferencia de conocimiento.

• Trabajar en conjunto con equipos de Producto, UX, Arquitectura y Seguridad para definir soluciones técnicas alineadas al negocio.

• Investigar nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y prácticas del ecosistema, proponiendo mejoras que optimicen escalabilidad, eficiencia y experiencia del usuario.

• +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con Java como lenguaje principal.

• Experiencia con Spring Boot , microservicios y arquitecturas distribuidas.

• Experiencia usando la IA como herramienta para desarrollar

• Capacidad para participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evaluar trade-offs técnicos.

• Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

• Proactividad, autonomía y vocación de mejora continua.

Deseable:

• Conocimiento de mensajería asíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ).

• Experiencia con herramientas de observabilidad (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, dynatrace).

🎓 Formación deseable:
Graduados/as o estudiantes avanzados/as en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines.
💡 Lo que vas a vivir en esta experiencia:

• Rol con impacto directo en plataformas que procesan transacciones de millones de usuarios.

• Trabajo transversal con equipos de Producto, Infraestructura y Negocio en una empresa en plena transformación tecnológica.

• Cultura de desarrollo técnico genuino: pair programming, feedback continuo y code review como prácticas reales.

• Autonomía para proponer mejoras, explorar nuevas tecnologías y dejar marca en la arquitectura.

• Aprendizaje continuo en un contexto dinámico y desafiante.

🎁 Te ofrecemos:
👩🏻 ⚕️ Cobertura médica para vos y tu grupo familiar. 💰 Bono por objetivos. 💻 Capacitaciones, certificaciones y acceso a plataformas de e-learning. 🎂 Día libre por cumpleaños y festividades religiosas. 👶 Licencia extendida por nacimiento. 🏋️ ♂️ Descuentos en gimnasios. 🤩 Club de beneficios en productos y comercios. ✅ Asesoramiento y asistencia EAP Latina. 🙌 Reintegro por conectividad y guardería.

postings.title: Senior API Engineer / Architect (Omnichannel Commerce — Travel/Hospitality Background)
postings.descriptionText:
Build the Future with AspenView Technology Partners

At AspenView, we are passionate about transforming the way organizations approach technology. We specialize in creating high-performing, nearshore IT teams to help North American clients innovate faster and more efficiently.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for exceptional people to join our team and help drive impactful change across industries.

Why Join AspenView?

At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.

Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Comprehensive perks and wellness support

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

About The Role

AspenView Technology Partners is seeking a Senior API Engineer / Architect to help build a leading omnichannel enterprise commerce platform serving large hoteliers and multi-property operators in the Travel & Hospitality sector. In this role, you will architect and build REST APIs and integrations on .NET / C# using Apigee and AWS—powering omnichannel acceptance, cross-property reconciliation, currency conversion, and split settlement. Working as an embedded, client-side collaborator aligned to U.S. Eastern (EST) hours, you will set the architectural standards that enterprise build teams rely on to deliver secure, scalable, SLA-ready services.

What You Will Do

API Architecture

• Design REST API architecture for enterprise, multi-tenant commerce.

• Set standards for contracts, versioning, and reuse.

Enterprise Integration

• Integrate ERP and e-commerce systems, and manage APIs with Apigee.

• Support omnichannel acceptance and reconciliation across properties.

• NET Services

• Build C# / .NET enterprise B2B services on AWS.

• Design for scale, resilience, and enterprise SLAs.

Security & Compliance

• Apply web-service security, SSL mutual authentication, and Azure AD.

• Work within financial-compliance platform requirements.

Success Indicators

• Enterprise APIs are well-architected, secure, and scalable.

• Cross-property reconciliation and settlement are reliable.

• Integrations meet enterprise SLAs.

• Standards are adopted across build teams.

What You Bring

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

• 8+ years of API engineering and architecture.

• Travel & hospitality industry experience (required)—enterprise hotelier commerce, including omnichannel acceptance, cross-property reconciliation, currency conversion, and split settlement.

• LatAm-based and aligned to U.S. Eastern (EST) time zone for embedded, client-side collaboration.

Technical Expertise

• C# / .NET and REST API architecture.

• Apigee API management, with ERP and e-commerce integration.

• Enterprise / multi-tenant architecture on AWS.

• Web-service security, SSL mutual authentication, and Azure AD.

Certifications

• No specific certifications are required. Certifications and demonstrated delivery in payments or travel / hospitality technology are valued alongside formal credentials.

Soft Skills

• Strong written and spoken English for embedded, client-side collaboration.

Preferred (Nice To Have)

• Kubernetes / Docker.

• Azure AD.

• Financial-compliance platform experience.

• Spanish / Portuguese fluency (LatAm expansion).

Visa Sponsorship

AspenView does not sponsor employment visas for this role. Applicants must be permanently authorized to work in their country of residence and must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Equal Opportunity Employer

AspenView is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe in creating an environment where all employees feel welcome, valued, and empowered to succeed. We celebrate diversity and strive to build a culture of inclusion where all individuals, regardless of their race, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other characteristic, can thrive. We encourage applicants from all walks of life to join our team and make a lasting impact.

Date de début : Dès que possible

Langues : Anglais (obligatoire), français (obligatoire)

À propos du poste

Pragmatike recrute pour le compte d’une entreprise technologique en forte croissance, orientée produit, qui développe des plateformes traitant d’importants volumes de données et utilisées à grande échelle sur plusieurs marchés. Son produit repose sur l’automatisation, l’extraction de données et des workflows intelligents, avec un fort accent mis sur la fiabilité du backend et la rapidité d’exécution.

Nous recherchons un(e) Full-Stack Engineer à dominante backend , capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout. Le poste est réparti à environ 70 % sur le backend et 30 % sur le frontend . Il convient particulièrement aux ingénieurs qui aiment travailler en profondeur sur le backend tout en restant proches du produit et de sa mise en production.

Vos missions

• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des services backend en Python et Node.js

• Prendre en charge les API, la logique métier et les flux de données s’appuyant sur PostgreSQL et MongoDB

• Contribuer aux fonctionnalités frontend (environ 30 %) afin de proposer des expériences produit complètes

• Développer et maintenir des pipelines de web scraping et d’ingestion de données, dans le respect des cadres légaux et éthiques applicables

• Travailler efficacement avec des outils de développement assistés par l’IA (Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et engineering pour transformer les besoins en solutions évolutives

• Améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des systèmes existants

• Participer aux décisions techniques et aux discussions liées à l’architecture

Profil recherché

• 4 ans d’expérience ou plus en Full-Stack Engineering ou Backend Engineering

• Solide expérience backend avec Python et/ou Node.js

• Bonne maîtrise de PostgreSQL et MongoDB

• À l’aise pour intervenir ponctuellement sur des bases de code frontend

• Expérience ou intérêt pour le scraping et les systèmes traitant d’importants volumes de données

• Bonne connaissance des méthodes modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

• Forte capacité à prendre des responsabilités et à travailler de manière autonome

• Être basé(e) en Amérique latine

Les petits plus

• Expérience en OCR, computer vision ou traitement de documents

• Expérience sur des produits fortement orientés automatisation ou data

• Expérience en startup ou scale-up

Pourquoi ce poste peut faire évoluer votre carrière

• Une forte autonomie sur des fonctionnalités directement mises en production

• Un impact concret sur les systèmes backend au cœur du produit

• Une exposition à l’automatisation, au scraping et aux workflows intelligents

• Une utilisation quotidienne d’outils modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

• De réelles possibilités d’évolution au sein d’une équipe engineering orientée produit

Stack technique

• Backend : Python, Node.js

• Bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB

• Frontend : Frameworks JavaScript modernes

• Data : Scraping, pipelines d’ingestion

• Atouts : OCR, computer vision

Avantages

• 100 % télétravail

• Horaires de travail flexibles

• Poste d’ingénieur avec un haut niveau d’autonomie

Pragmatike s’engage à garantir un processus de recrutement équitable, transparent et inclusif. Aucun candidat ne fait l’objet de discrimination fondée sur l’âge, le handicap, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, la situation matrimoniale ou le statut de partenaire civil, la grossesse ou la maternité, la race, la religion ou les convictions, le sexe ou l’orientation sexuelle.

Conformément au Règlement général sur la protection des données (RGPD), vos données personnelles sont traitées de manière légale, équitable et sécurisée. Nous collectons et utilisons vos données personnelles uniquement dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, notamment afin de les partager avec notre ou nos client(s) dans le cadre de l’étude de votre candidature. Vous disposez à tout moment d’un droit d’accès, de rectification ou de suppression de vos données. Nous nous engageons à assurer la confidentialité et la sécurité de vos informations tout au long du processus de recrutement.

With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements

• 5+ years professional software development experience (backend-focused)

• Strong professional experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Experience building low-latency API services in AWS

• Experience building scalable RESTful APIs

• Experience with SDK integrations to other services

• Experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB, including Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Experience building secure multi-tenant environments

• Comfortable writing raw SQL and managing schema migrations (e.g., node-postgres, node-pg-migrate)

• Professional experience with React

• Strong testing practices, including integration tests against real databases and failure-mode/fault-injection testing

• Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development

• CI/CD application creation and maintenance skills

• Solid understanding of full stack development, with the ability to contribute to frontend work when needed

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with append-only, event-sourced, or bitemporal data models

• Experience with Fastify and schema-first validation (e.g., Zod)

• Experience running containerized services on AWS Fargate/ECS

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

postings.descriptionText:
Senior Backend Engineer @ Neticca Job ID: 10017
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Python, AWS)
Location: Remote (Latin America or Mexico; US Eastern (EST) business hours required)
Duration: Full-Time, Long-Term Engagement (12+ Months)

About Neticca:
Neticca is a technology and data consulting company. We help growing companies solve demanding engineering and data problems, from large-scale data migrations to streaming platforms and applied AI. Our engineers work closely with client teams, supported by Neticca's delivery standards, mentorship, and Center of Excellence.

About the Engagement:
We are building out the delivery team for a long-term data engineering engagement centered on large data volumes and data migrations . We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own the design and delivery of Java and Python systems on AWS , working alongside the client's engineers and holding a high bar on code quality and review. We expect disciplined use of AI coding tools: you design first, test in a structured way, and verify every output. Our selection process is rigorous. It includes a recorded video screen followed by several technical conversations with senior engineers.

What You'll Deliver:

• Production Java services and Python data pipelines that handle large data volumes reliably

• Data migrations from plan to cutover: scoping, validation, and rollback

• Streaming and batch workflows on AWS (S3, Kinesis, DynamoDB) and Kafka

• High-quality code reviews that improve design, not just style

• AI-assisted development done with discipline: design first, structured testing, line-by-line review of AI output, and cross-checking between tools

• Work driven by clear acceptance criteria, with tests written first or alongside the code ( TDD / BDD )

• Clear written and spoken explanations of technical trade-offs to the team

Must-Have Qualifications:

• 5+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, shipping and supporting production systems

• Hands-on Java experience in production (required)

• Strong Python skills with Pandas and related data libraries

• Hands-on AWS experience using boto3 , including S3 and at least one of Kinesis or DynamoDB

• Experience with a streaming platform such as Kafka (or Kinesis) in a production setting

• Solid SQL and working knowledge of JSON and Parquet data formats

• Experience with large data volumes or data migrations , and the ability to explain the design trade-offs

• A real code review habit: you review carefully and can show examples

• Disciplined use of AI coding tools : you verify, test, and cross-check AI output rather than accepting it by default

• Working experience with TDD / BDD and writing code against acceptance criteria

• Excellent spoken and written English ; you will be interviewed by several senior engineers

• Based in Latin America or Mexico and available during US Eastern (EST) business hours (mandatory)

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Apache Flink or other stream-processing and OLAP tools

• Experience with StarRocks

• Experience building, monitoring, and fixing AI agents to get the behavior you want

• Experience working in a distributed team with US hours overlap

• Familiarity with Jira or Rally in an agile team

Why Join Neticca?

• Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a generous compensation package for top-tier talent.

• Meaningful Engineering Problems: Work on large-scale data and migration challenges where design decisions matter.

• Delivery Standards & Mentorship: Structured onboarding, peer support, and access to Neticca's Center of Excellence.

• Career Growth: Grow with a company that invests in your development and values your expertise.

• Long-Term Engagement: A stable, full-time role (12+ months) with clear expectations.

Lieu : Amérique latine (télétravail)

Langues : Anglais (obligatoire), français (obligatoire)

À propos du poste

Pragmatike recrute pour le compte d’une entreprise technologique en forte croissance, orientée produit, qui développe des plateformes traitant d’importants volumes de données et utilisées à grande échelle sur plusieurs marchés. Son produit repose sur l’automatisation, l’extraction de données et des workflows intelligents, avec un fort accent mis sur la fiabilité du backend et la rapidité d’exécution.

Nous recherchons un(e) Full-Stack Engineer à dominante backend , capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout. Le poste est réparti à environ 70 % sur le backend et 30 % sur le frontend . Il convient particulièrement aux ingénieurs qui aiment travailler en profondeur sur le backend tout en restant proches du produit et de sa mise en production.

Vos missions

• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des services backend en Python et Node.js

• Prendre en charge les API, la logique métier et les flux de données s’appuyant sur PostgreSQL et MongoDB

• Contribuer aux fonctionnalités frontend (environ 30 %) afin de proposer des expériences produit complètes

• Développer et maintenir des pipelines de web scraping et d’ingestion de données, dans le respect des cadres légaux et éthiques applicables

• Travailler efficacement avec des outils de développement assistés par l’IA (Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et engineering pour transformer les besoins en solutions évolutives

• Améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des systèmes existants

• Participer aux décisions techniques et aux discussions liées à l’architecture

Profil recherché

• 4 ans d’expérience ou plus en Full-Stack Engineering ou Backend Engineering

• Solide expérience backend avec Python et/ou Node.js

• Bonne maîtrise de PostgreSQL et MongoDB

• À l’aise pour intervenir ponctuellement sur des bases de code frontend

• Expérience ou intérêt pour le scraping et les systèmes traitant d’importants volumes de données

• Bonne connaissance des méthodes modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

• Forte capacité à prendre des responsabilités et à travailler de manière autonome

• Être basé(e) en Amérique latine

Les petits plus

• Expérience en OCR, computer vision ou traitement de documents

• Expérience sur des produits fortement orientés automatisation ou data

• Expérience en startup ou scale-up

Pourquoi ce poste peut faire évoluer votre carrière

• Une forte autonomie sur des fonctionnalités directement mises en production

• Un impact concret sur les systèmes backend au cœur du produit

• Une exposition à l’automatisation, au scraping et aux workflows intelligents

• Une utilisation quotidienne d’outils modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

• De réelles possibilités d’évolution au sein d’une équipe engineering orientée produit

Stack technique

• Backend : Python, Node.js

• Bases de données : PostgreSQL, MongoDB

• Frontend : Frameworks JavaScript modernes

• Data : Scraping, pipelines d’ingestion

• Atouts : OCR, computer vision

Avantages

• 100 % télétravail

• Horaires de travail flexibles

• Poste d’ingénieur avec un haut niveau d’autonomie

Pragmatike s’engage à garantir un processus de recrutement équitable, transparent et inclusif. Aucun candidat ne fait l’objet de discrimination fondée sur l’âge, le handicap, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, la situation matrimoniale ou le statut de partenaire civil, la grossesse ou la maternité, la race, la religion ou les convictions, le sexe ou l’orientation sexuelle.

Conformément au Règlement général sur la protection des données (RGPD), vos données personnelles sont traitées de manière légale, équitable et sécurisée. Nous collectons et utilisons vos données personnelles uniquement dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, notamment afin de les partager avec notre ou nos client(s) dans le cadre de l’étude de votre candidature. Vous disposez à tout moment d’un droit d’accès, de rectification ou de suppression de vos données. Nous nous engageons à assurer la confidentialité et la sécurité de vos informations tout au long du processus de recrutement.

postings.title: Senior Payments Engineer — Acquiring & Payment Processing
postings.descriptionText:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation :

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle's acquiring and payment-processing stack — the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient.

This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery.

What You'll Do:

• Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks

• Own critical money-movement flows end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling

• Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)

• Operate within PCI DSS scope — tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable

• Instrument and monitor payment health: authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement

• Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation — within Sezzle's security and data-handling policies

• Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

• 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems

• Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs

• Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes

• Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)

• Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication — you're comfortable making AI a core part of how you work and can show how it's improved your output

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool

• Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.

• DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines

• Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS

• Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

• A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

Nice to Have

• Direct experience with payments acquiring ecosystem like; Adyen, Stripe, Marqeta, Fiserv, etc.

• Exposure to PCI DSS, 3DS/SCA, network tokenization, or payments compliance

• SQL-based RDBMS through an ORM

• Observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic) for production instrumentation and alerting

• DevOps / CI/CD pipeline experience; containerized microservices on Kubernetes / AWS

• A track record of shipping commercial payment APIs and prioritizing based on stakeholder/customer feedback

AI at Sezzle

Sezzle runs an AI-first product and engineering culture — we start projects in Claude and expect engineers to use AI to move faster and think more rigorously. In a payments environment, we do this responsibly : AI tools accelerate how we design, build, and document, but cardholder data, credentials, and secrets never leave our secured environment. We're looking for someone who treats AI fluency and secure-by-default engineering as two sides of the same skill.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

• Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python

• Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native

• Backend: Golang

• Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch

• DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes

• Version Control: Git

• CI/CD: Gitlab

• Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

• Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrated Workflows
postings.descriptionText:
About The Team

The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through.

That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do.

Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on.

This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues.

What You'll Do

• Build and evolve two-way sync with the systems of record where customer work lives (Jira, Linear, Asana, and others), so decisions made on the canvas become tracked work and stay in sync as that work changes

• Design, build, and maintain integrations across the Microsoft ecosystem (Teams, Outlook, Office), video conferencing platforms, and third-party notification targets such as Slack and Teams

• Build and evolve the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns other Mural teams use to ship their own connected experiences

• Own the content pathways in and out of Mural, including the import and image panels, third-party image APIs such as Unsplash, copy/paste to and from outside Mural, file upload handling, iFrame embedding, self-serve PDF to Mural conversion, and Mural exports and downloads

• Partner across teams on shared boundaries and hold up your side of those contracts, including render for exports, the notification engine, and company-level migration

• Maintain and support our public API for existing third-party developers, with the backwards-compatibility discipline a published interface demands

• Lead projects end to end, from research, design, and POC through execution, release, and iteration

• Build flexible and maintainable solutions while being accountable for quality, performance, reliability, and the security posture of everything crossing our system boundary

• Use AI tools as part of your fundamental workflows

• Design, plan, and implement automated testing and documentation strategies, including for the failure modes that only show up when someone else's API misbehaves

• Elevate the team's skills and knowledge by participating in technical designs and talks, and by reviewing and helping improve your and your colleagues' code

• Contribute to constantly improving the team's processes and best practices

What You'll Bring

• Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, or other modern frameworks

• Hands-on experience integrating with third-party APIs and platforms: OAuth and token lifecycle management, webhooks, rate limiting and backoff, pagination, versioning, and graceful degradation when an upstream service fails

• 5+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

• Strong track record of designing and delivering scalable, high-performance systems

• An outcome-oriented and highly-experimental interest in AI-driven development practices

• Proven experience planning technical projects and delivering new systems and features iteratively, with a focus on delivering value to customers quickly

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to lead technical discussions and navigate trade-offs effectively

• Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments or startups is a plus

• Experience building against Microsoft Teams or Office add-in SDKs, or shipping through a partner marketplace or app review process

• Experience designing and maintaining a public developer API

• Experience with Python

• Familiarity with secure file handling at scale, including permissions checks, malware scanning, and content validation on upload

• Experience with content migration or format conversion between products, and the fidelity problems that come with it

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Imagináte emprendiendo proyectos desafiantes, dinámicos e innovadores y siendo responsable de :

• Gestionar y evolucionar la plataforma de orquestación de contenedores en la nube (EKS/GKE), incluyendo networking, gestión de accesos e identidades, automatización con IaC (Terraform) y observabilidad de plataforma: métricas, alertas y dashboards (Datadog/Grafana).

• Colaborar con equipos de seguridad y compliance para garantizar que los flujos de automatización sean robustos, seguros y auditables.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust - Core Services
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our Platform and Core Engineering teams build the systems that make Kraken secure, resilient, and scalable. Their impact isn’t measured by customer-facing features, but by the strength, correctness, and leverage of the foundations they create. These teams power Kraken systems behind the scenes — enabling product teams to move fast while meeting the highest standards for reliability, compliance, and security.

Engineers design shared services, internal platforms, and critical infrastructure that support company-wide initiatives. They optimize for safety, scalability, observability, auditability, and operational excellence — often operating in regulated, security-sensitive, and risk-heavy environments where precision matters.

We’re looking for engineers with deep systems ownership and an architecture-first mindset — builders who take pride in long-lived services, thrive in complex environments, and are motivated by strengthening the backbone of the crypto ecosystem.

The opportunity

• Design and implement robust Rust services and foundational libraries that power Kraken’s core infrastructure, prioritizing correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

• Write reusable, testable, and highly efficient code built for scale, observability, and operational resilience in production environments.

• Collaborate on large-scale distributed systems architecture, shaping low-latency, fault-tolerant services that support global trading and internal platforms.

• Work alongside hundreds of experienced Rust engineers, contributing to a high-bar engineering culture grounded in ownership, rigor, and craftsmanship.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of software engineering experience

• Experience building and scaling shared systems, internal platforms, and supporting multiple product roadmaps

• Proficient in writing network services or asynchronous code in Rust

• Have a security-first mindset during system design to ensure robustness

• Demonstrate the ability to autonomously debug issues across the stack (OS, network, application)

• Apply a solid understanding of distributed systems and technologies, including RPC protocols, Kafka, and Event-Driven Systems, to design scalable solutions

• Collaborate effectively with product teams to gather requirements and constraints for designing appropriate systems

• Take complete end-to-end ownership of systems and libraries

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust - Consumer
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Consumer team. The Consumer team at Kraken focuses on building applications that expose Kraken's product offering to the mass market. Trying to onboard the next 100 million people to the benefits of crypto.

This role involves setting the technical direction for our "Consumer" applications — a suite of products aimed at offering the simplest way for our customers to interact with Kraken — and delivering the hardest parts of it yourself. We expect anyone applying for this role to have an extreme eye for detail, a passion for building genuinely world class user experiences, a "ship fast but don't ship shit" attitude, and the judgment to know which is which without being told.

The opportunity

• Own the architecture and delivery of customer-facing Rust backend services powering trading, payments, and crypto experiences — making the design calls on systems that will outlive the feature you built them for

• Take ambiguous, multi-quarter problems from "we think this matters" to shipped and measured, breaking them down so the rest of the team can move in parallel with you

• Own features end-to-end rather than stopping at the API/backend boundary, and raise the bar on what "end-to-end" means for everyone around you — customer experience, frontend impact, and the product problem behind what you're building

• Partner with product leadership to shape the roadmap for a product area, not just execute against it. You'll bring engineering insight that changes what gets built, and own the outcomes and metrics that follow

• Drive initiatives that cross team boundaries — Kraken's trading infrastructure, platform, and other product teams — building the relationships and technical alignment needed to land them

• Multiply the team: mentor mid-level engineers, review designs before code exists, unblock people quickly, and leave behind patterns and standards that make the next feature easier than the last

• Use AI extensively to amplify scope and speed, moving from manually writing code toward orchestrating AI and validating implementation — and help the team do the same, defining what good AI-assisted engineering looks like here

What You Bring

• 6+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep Rust proficiency across network services, asynchronous code, and distributed systems design (RPC protocols, Kafka, event-driven architectures)

• A track record of owning systems, not just features. You've made architectural decisions in production, lived with the consequences, and can explain the tradeoffs you'd make differently now

• Product engineering mindset. You've shipped features from problem → implementation → launch → user impact, with deep understanding of customer experience and product metrics, and you've influenced what got built and what got cut

• Demonstrated impact through others: mentoring, design review, technical writing, or setting standards that changed how a team worked

• Experience driving work that spans teams or orgs, where the hard part was alignment and sequencing as much as the code

• AI-first development approach where AI is already meaningfully incorporated into your workflow; you actively use AI for coding, understanding unfamiliar codebases, crossing technical boundaries, and validating implementations

• Ownership mindset with collaborative spirit. You personally drive features end-to-end, work across backend/frontend boundaries, and operate outside technical silos

• Openness to how the engineering profession is evolving because of AI, prioritizing shipping valuable products over manual code writing

Nice to haves

• Full-stack experience including React/TypeScript or other frontend frameworks — valuable for demonstrating cross-boundary collaboration mindset

• Cryptocurrency or blockchain domain knowledge

• Experience building and scaling products at consumer-focused technology companies, ideally at meaningful user scale

• Experience introducing AI tooling or workflows to an engineering team

• Handle imperfect data sources, including inconsistent formats, incomplete information, and ambiguous inputs

• Establish approaches that prioritize data accuracy and clearly identify cases where a reliable result cannot be produced

• Experience processing data that may be incomplete, inconsistent, noisy, or difficult to interpret

Our teams are remote and distributed across the US and Latam, working with modern technologies to develop scalable, resilient products across different industries.

At RYZ Labs, you'll have the opportunity to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of meaningful projects, and collaborate with experienced professionals. You'll be exposed to challenging technical problems while continuing to develop your skills in a fast-moving startup environment.

postings.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What We Are Building

Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

• A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.

• Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.

• A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.

• Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.

• Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.

• Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

• A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What Your Impact Will Be

• Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.

• Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.

• Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.

• Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.

• Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.

• Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.

• Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What We Look For In This Role

• A track record of evolving an enterprise-grade authorization system under real production traffic, with strong opinions about the architecture of these systems

• Experience designing a new auth system and migrating to it from a legacy approach (a plus)

• Experience on a platform team supporting other services within a larger engineering organization

• A background at a company that builds authentication or authorization products (a plus)

• A concrete example of an auth system you helped build that solved a recurring class of customer challenges

• A history of helping teams become better engineers by improving designs, velocity, and quality

• Authorization systems: Hands-on experience with relationship-based or fine-grained authorization, including schema design (relations, permissions, caveats) and the tradeoffs versus traditional RBAC

• Identity protocols: Solid grounding in OIDC and SAML, and ideally experience with an IdP such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or ForgeRock

• Cloud identity: Practical experience with workload identity patterns such as AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, or GCP Workload Identity Federation

• Secrets management: Familiarity with a credential management system such as Vault

• Backend engineering: Strong Go, Java, or a comparable language, comfort running services on Kubernetes, and API design instincts from owning a platform others build on

• System architecture: Experience architecting auth frameworks that scale to enterprise customers

• AI-assisted development: Considered, real-world experience using AI coding tools while maintaining code quality and security rigor

What We Value

• We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success

• We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work

• We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

• We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company

• We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply
