The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.

postings.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer — Developer Platform (Remote LATAM)
postings.descriptionText:
Company: Playbypoint

Team: Core Platform

Location: LATAM remote. Open to other timezones with overlap to UTC-3 / UTC-5.

Employment: Full-time

Reports to: Engineering Manager, Core Platform

About Playbypoint

We're a rapidly expanding startup at the forefront of the racquet sports industry. At Playbypoint, we specialize in providing innovative enterprise software solutions that empower clubs, players, and coaches to streamline their operations and enhance their game. We're backed by top investors, trusted by leading clubs, and scaling fast – and we're looking for passionate individuals to join us in revolutionizing the racquet sports world with cutting-edge software.

The Role

We're building the platform that lets the world build on top of Playbypoint — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to be part of it. This goes beyond a traditional external API: you'll design and deliver the full stack of surfaces that enable developers, partners, and AI agents to integrate with us — REST APIs, MCP servers, skills, webhooks, and the developer experience layer that ties it all together.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering and the emerging ecosystem of AI-powered builders.

Our stack: Ruby on Rails (backend), React + TypeScript (frontend), GraphQL and REST APIs, MySQL / Redis / Sidekiq, cloud-native infrastructure on AWS.

What You'll Do

• Design and build Playbypoint's external API — versioned, stable, and built to scale with a growing ecosystem of integrators and partners.

• Develop and maintain MCP servers and skills that expose Playbypoint capabilities to AI agents and developer tools.

• Own the developer experience end to end: API documentation, developer portal, onboarding flows, SDKs, and sandbox environments.

• Define API governance practices: versioning strategy, deprecation policies, backward compatibility, and breaking change management.

• Build the infrastructure that makes our external surfaces observable and reliable — rate limiting, auth, throttling, usage analytics.

• Partner with product and internal engineering teams to expose platform capabilities through well-designed, consistent integration contracts.

• Track and shape how the ecosystem of builders — human and AI — integrates with Playbypoint.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

• Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on API design, platform development, or developer tooling.

• Are comfortable across the full stack — backend API design and frontend developer portal/documentation surfaces.

• Have designed and shipped public or partner-facing APIs at scale — versioning, auth models, rate limiting, and the full lifecycle of an external API are familiar territory.

• Have hands-on experience building for AI-era integration surfaces — MCP servers, agent skills, LLM tool definitions, or similar patterns.

• Care deeply about developer experience: you've built or contributed to developer portals, SDKs, or documentation systems that builders actually love.

• Understand the difference between an internal API and an external one — backward compatibility, contract stability, and the cost of breaking changes are not abstract concepts.

• Are comfortable working across teams to define integration contracts that balance internal velocity with external stability.

• Communicate clearly and default to async. Strong written and spoken English is a must — we work closely with US-based stakeholders and partners, and our developer-facing surfaces are products in themselves.

Engineering in the AI Era

We expect every engineer at Playbypoint to work with AI as a core part of their craft — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier across the entire SDLC. That means:

• Actively using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle — design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and incident analysis.

• Having built AI-powered tooling or agents — whether internal automation, LLM-integrated features, or workflow improvements that shipped to production.

• Knowing when AI adds real value and when it doesn't — judgment matters more than enthusiasm.

We don't expect everyone to be an AI researcher. We do expect you to be fluent in the tools and patterns of the moment, and curious about what's next.

Bonus

• Experience building API gateways, developer portals, or API management platforms.

• Deep familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent skill frameworks, or AI-native integration patterns.

• Background in vertical SaaS, marketplaces, or fintech — where API reliability directly impacts partner revenue.

• Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, webhook infrastructure, or event-driven integration patterns.

• Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend - Consumer
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

The opportunity

• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.

• Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration.

• Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data.

• Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces.

• Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience).

• Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables.

• Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

• Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.

• Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team.

• Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.

What You Bring

• 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on consumer-facing web and/or mobile products.

• Deep expertise in TypeScript and the React ecosystem, you have opinions about state management, data fetching patterns, and component architecture, and you can articulate the trade-offs.

• Production experience with React Native and cross-platform mobile development, including App Store and Google Play release pipelines.

• Experience with Next.js — specifically familiarity with App Router, React Server Components, and the client/server boundary decisions that come with them.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and experimentation frameworks (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar).

• Experience with WebSockets or Server-Sent Events for real-time UI updates.

• Strong testing culture Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, and the judgement to know when to use each.

• Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack, CI/CD pipelines) and performance profiling.

• Experience in fintech, crypto, payments, or other high-trust consumer products where correctness and user confidence matter.

• Strong written and verbal English, you can write a clear RFC, give direct feedback in a PR review, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder.

• An active AI-assisted development workflow, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent with the engineering rigour to review and own what gets produced.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
About vidIQ
vidIQ builds software to help YouTube creators achieve their goals. Our mission is to advance the creator's journey with actionable data-driven insights and AI-powered tools. We are dedicated to our values of being creator-obsessed, lean and fast, and scientific. Having already supported millions of creators, we invite stunning new co-workers to join us in reaching millions more.

Imagine a product that reached over a million users without a traditional sales team. This product stands at the forefront of career evolution, where everyone can be their own brand with unlimited growth potential. That's the opportunity at vidIQ—an infinite market, a large and highly engaged customer base, and the chance to help scale the platform that delivers insights to millions of creators.

Discover more about vidIQ firsthand at www.vidiq.com.

About the Team
Our vision is to build a personal copilot for every YouTube creator. We work in small, focused teams where people are expected to understand the problem, make decisions, and take ownership of the outcome.
We value people who are strong in their craft, communicate clearly, challenge ideas with respect, and follow through from problem to production.
We’re also an AI-native team. We build AI into our product and use it every day in how we work—from writing and reviewing code to debugging, testing, prototyping, and exploring new ideas.

About the role
vidIQ meets creators where they are, through a web app, mobile apps, and browser extensions. Our frontend is built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind. We use a range of AI models to power creator-facing features such as ideation, metadata generation, and content insights.
This is a frontend-leaning role, but you won't stop at the frontend. You'll own entire product surfaces from end to end: the UI, the APIs behind it, the data it depends on, and how it performs in production. We expect you to understand the problem, decide what to build, and ship it.
You'll shape how millions of creators experience vidIQ, and you'll help define how our engineering team builds software now that AI is a real collaborator.

This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide. Employment classification and engagement structure will be determined based on location, legal requirements, and mutual fit.

What you will do:

• Own product surfaces end to end. You'll be the go-to owner for key parts of vidIQ, we serve over 1M daily active creators. You'll set their direction, track how they perform, and decide what to improve next.

• Work across the stack. You'll build and change backend APIs, services, and data flows when a feature needs it, instead of waiting on another team.

• Drive your own roadmap. You'll spot opportunities in user feedback, data, and the codebase, turn them into proposals, align with product and design, and deliver without needing to be managed closely.

• Modernize the frontend. You'll lead the refactor of key features from JavaScript to TypeScript to improve performance and maintainability, using AI-assisted tooling where it speeds up the work without lowering the bar for quality.

• Build AI-powered product experiences. You'll ship LLM-driven features across the stack, from model integration and prompts on the backend to streaming responses, error handling, and clear UX when model output is unpredictable.

• Fix architecture and performance problems. You'll find bottlenecks and weaknesses anywhere in the request path, frontend or backend, and leave the system better than you found it.

• Make AI part of how the team works. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot every day, share what works, and help set team practices for using AI responsibly.

• Improve durability. You'll test important workflows, add useful monitoring and error reporting, and own what you ship after it's live, whether you wrote every line or reviewed and refined AI-generated code.

• Raise the bar through review and mentorship. You'll review code from other engineers, AI-assisted or not, and give feedback that helps others grow.

About You

• You have at least 5 years of professional software development experience.

• You're strongest on the frontend, but you're comfortable on the backend. You can design an API, write server-side code, work with databases, and debug problems that cross the client-server boundary.

• You're self-driven. You don't need a detailed spec to get started, and you're happy making decisions, asking the right questions, and moving work forward on your own.

• You act like an owner. When something you're responsible for breaks, underperforms, or confuses users, you notice and fix it before anyone asks.

• You've led projects from concept to completion, including documenting the work and teaching others about it.

• You care about product quality and leave codebases in better shape than you found them.

• You write and speak clearly, and you can explain technical concepts to non-technical people.

• You're confident with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind.

• You're a heavy, thoughtful user of AI tools. AI coding assistants and agents are part of how you plan, build, debug, test, and review every day. You know where they save you hours and where they fail, and you check AI output as carefully as you'd check a teammate's pull request.

• You keep up with the fast-moving AI landscape and like trying new models, tools, and workflows.

Nice to have

• Backend experience with Node.js , Scala, and/or Python, plus relational databases, caching, and queues

• Experience with Redux, Redux Saga, and/or Zustand

• Experience building LLM-powered features, such as streaming UIs, model APIs, prompt design, or evals

• Experience with agentic coding workflows, such as running AI agents on multi-step tasks, writing custom rules or context files, or using MCP servers

Perks and Benefits

• Work Remotely: Embrace the freedom to choose your ideal workspace anywhere in the world.

• Flexible Time Off: We support a flexible vacation policy allowing you to take time off when you need to recharge.

• Communication Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend to cover your phone and internet expenses, helping you stay connected effortlessly.

• Global Impact: Join our diverse team that’s shaping the future of the creator economy across the globe.

• Competitive Compensation: vidIQ believes in offering competitive compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and contributions. We ensure fairness through internal equity and geo-location based pay, with the upper range reserved for individuals demonstrating exceptional job knowledge and skills.

Our Commitment
At vidIQ, we dedicate ourselves to enabling creators of all kinds to succeed. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and fostering an environment that encourages collaboration, creativity, and personal growth. We are committed to building a company and a community where individuals thrive by being true to themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day.
If you share our enthusiasm for empowering creators, we would love to hear from you. Click the “Apply” button below to start your journey with us.

postings.title: Checkout Champ Funnel Developer (Front-End, DTC Health & Wellness)
postings.descriptionText:
About HarZa Group

HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer health and wellness brands. Our flagship brand is Rejuvacare, with RejuvaKnee as our hero product in chronic pain relief, and we are actively launching new brands across the portfolio. We run entirely on paid digital channels, ship primarily into the United States, and have grown twelve times in a single year with close to 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first by design and async-first by default.

The Role

In this business, an idea only starts producing revenue once it is live as a working page, funnel or checkout. Marketing can develop a concept and write the copy in a day. How fast that becomes a live, accurate and fully functioning funnel is what determines how fast the company moves.

Checkout Champ is where that happens. We are hiring a Checkout Champ Funnel Developer to build and maintain the funnels that carry our revenue: advertorials, landing pages, VSL pages, quizzes, product pages, checkouts, upsells, downsells and post-purchase flows.

This is a front-end and platform role, not a backend one. We do not build backend systems here. Checkout Champ handles that layer. Your work is the front end on top of it, plus the configuration and administration underneath it. You will write HTML, CSS and JavaScript, build interactive funnel experiences, configure offers and checkout logic, implement tracking, and make sure the whole thing actually works before anyone else sees it.

We ship daily, not monthly. If you enjoy the rhythm of building, launching, testing and iterating inside the same week, this will suit you. If you need long release cycles and a fully specified ticket for every task, it will not.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain DTC funnels end to end in Checkout Champ

• Turn Figma designs, approved copy and assets into responsive, production-ready pages

• Develop custom functionality using HTML, CSS and JavaScript

• Build quizzes, selectors, dynamic flows and other interactive funnel experiences

• Configure offers, order forms, checkout flows, upsells, downsells and post-purchase journeys inside Checkout Champ

• Implement and troubleshoot tracking, pixels, events, GTM, scripts and conversion-related integrations

• Work with APIs, webhooks and third-party tools where a requirement calls for it

• Build and launch A/B test variations

• Troubleshoot front-end, checkout, funnel logic, integration and tracking issues on live traffic

• Create reusable components and templates that increase launch speed over time

• Use AI coding tools to move faster, and review and validate what they produce rather than shipping it blindly

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you are shipping funnels independently in Checkout Champ, you know our offer structures and page types, and your work is reaching review in a state that does not need to be sent back.

By day 90, we expect [X] funnels or test variations launched per week, median time from approved brief to live page reduced to [X], more than [X]% of your work passing QA without a second development round, and fewer than [X]% of launched pages generating a defect found after approval.

Beyond that, the measure is whether marketing stops waiting on technology. The components and templates you build should make every subsequent launch faster than the last one.

QA Is Part of the Development

You are responsible for the quality of your own work before it reaches our QA stage. Every implementation is checked across the full customer journey. A task is not complete because the page looks correct. It is complete when the full flow works correctly, from the first click through checkout, upsell, downsell and confirmation, with tracking firing at every step, on mobile and on desktop.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• Strong, hands-on, verifiable experience building funnels in Checkout Champ. This is a hard requirement. You will be asked to show live pages you built and to explain exactly which parts were yours

• Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript skills

• Experience building DTC or performance-driven e-commerce funnels, ideally in a direct-response environment

• Practical experience with checkout flows, offers, upsells, downsells and funnel logic

• Experience implementing A/B tests

• Experience implementing tracking, pixels, GTM and conversion events, and debugging them when they break

• Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, scripts and third-party integrations

• Ability to debug and solve technical problems independently, without detailed instructions for every task

• Experience using AI coding tools, and the judgment to validate their output

• Strong attention to detail and a QA-focused mindset

• Professional working English, written and spoken

• Reliable overlap with the 8am to 12pm EST collaboration window

How We Expect You to Work

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the final result. You should be able to take a requirement, choose a sensible technical approach, flag potential problems early, test your own work thoroughly across the full flow, and solve problems without being walked through them.

We value people who think, not only people who execute. This environment is fast and still being built, which means a share of the work will not arrive fully specified. The people who do well here ask the right question, propose an approach, and move.

Speed matters here. Reliability matters just as much.

Benefits

What We Offer

A fully remote, async-first environment with a team across more than 15 countries. Paid time off, wellness support, equipment support and learning budget, with specifics shared during the hiring process. Direct ownership of quality across a portfolio of fast-growing DTC brands, with the people making decisions one message away.

Our Values

Own It. Make It Count. Find a Way. Master Your Craft. Win Together. These are operational standards here, used in hiring, performance and promotion decisions.

Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack)

We are a global digital innovation agency for the Intelligence Age, specializing in digital product development, brand transformation, media, and communications for major companies. Our Technology team is an integral part of our business; they are perpetual problem solvers, always seeking new and innovative ways to help our creatives bring their ideas to life. We work across a diverse range of projects, from major website builds and core tech platforms to bespoke experiences and strategic innovation with emerging technologies.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on TypeScript, frontend web frameworks and fullstack integrations to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for building scalable, high-performance web experiences that serve global audiences. You will act as a core code contributor within a broader team, moving beyond simple feature implementation to architecting reusable systems, performing rigorous code reviews, and ensuring the seamless integration of diverse technologies. The ideal candidate is a web specialist who understands the full software development lifecycle and is passionate about delivering high-quality, production-ready code in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

On any given day, you will:

• Architect & Build Fullstack Solutions: Design and develop end-to-end web applications that serve a global audience

• Modular Component Development: Build and maintain scalable, modular component libraries designed for use in composable architectures, enabling rapid assembly of new features and pages.

• Collaborate with Design & Product Teams: collaborate with designers to assess design specifications, product requirements, and translate those into technical specifications.

• CMS Implementation: Deliver web experiences leveraging enterprise-grade CMS platforms, translating complex content models into seamless authoring experiences and dynamic frontend displays.

• System & API Integration: Seamlessly connect frontend interfaces with backend services and third-party solutions via REST APIs, SDKs, and custom-built libraries.

• Accessibility & Localization: Ensure every user has a first-class experience by implementing a11y standards (WCAG) and managing multi-region localization best practices.

• Documentation & Technical Mapping: Create documentation to ensure technical clarity, supporting long-term maintenance and team scalability.

• Peer Mentorship & Code Quality: Lead rigorous code reviews and provide mentorship, upholding high standards for TypeScript patterns, CSS architecture, and overall system health.

The Ideal Candidate

• The Complete Architect: You are a seasoned developer who thrives on technical challenges across the entire stack, from refining CSS transitions to planning API integrations for dynamic modules.

• Framework & Language Fluent: You have deep expertise in TypeScript, modern frontend frameworks (such as React, Vue, Angular), and you understand how to bridge them with robust backend logic.

• Composable Mindset: You don’t just build pages; you build systems. You are passionate about creating reusable components that are flexible, performant, and easy for other developers to use.

• Large-Scale Web Delivery: You understand the rigor that needs to go into delivering and maintaining scaled flagship web experiences for major brands, including release orchestration, working closely with QA to remediate issues, and working an agile environment with a scaled team of other amazing developers.

• Detail-Oriented Craft: You possess a passion for product quality, ensuring that your code is not only functional but also clean, maintainable, and well-tested; and can work autonomously to hold yourself and your work to a high standard.

• AI-Enabled: You’re comfortable leveraging AI code-assist tools to accelerate your workflow and are interested in integrating AI services where they add genuine value to work efficiency, productivity, and quality.

You Bring

• 5+ years of professional experience in fullstack software engineering, with a strong portfolio of production-grade web applications.

• Advanced proficiency in TypeScript, modern CSS (Sass, CSS Modules, or Tailwind), and state management libraries.

• Hands-on experience with Enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, Brightspot, AEM) and a deep understanding of building modular components within them.

• Expertise in Web Standards: Deep knowledge of accessibility (WCAG) and localization (i18n) implementation strategies.

• API Proficiency: Strong ability to consume RESTful APIs.

postings.title: Full Stack Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to design, build, and ship features end-to-end across one of our core product teams — from the interface a user touches, through the API, down to the data. You own meaningful parts of the product front to back: shaping the approach with your team, building both the UI and the services behind it, testing them, and running them in production. This is a hands-on role: most of your day is spent writing, reviewing, and debugging real code across the stack, with the autonomy to make sound technical decisions and the judgment to know which ones to raise.

You care about more than making it work. You think about edge cases, failure modes, performance — both on the server and as the user perceives it — accessibility, and the engineers who'll read your code next. You collaborate closely with product managers, QA, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous goals into reliable software, and you push back early when requirements don't add up. You bring an AI-first working style — using AI tooling daily to move faster across design, coding, and review — with the judgment to catch where its output falls short. You’re also comfortable working hands-on with LLM/agent APIs — prompt and context design, retrieval, and orchestrating agent workflows — and understand their behavior and failure modes in production.

This is not a role for someone who lives on only one side of the stack. We need an engineer who's genuinely comfortable building and owning a feature from the component to the database, takes it from ambiguous intent to shipped, reliable software, and raises the bar for the team around them.

Key Responsibilities - What this person will own and do day-to-day

Feature ownership (front to back)

• Build and own features end-to-end — UI, API, and data — from design discussion through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Translate product requirements and architectural direction into working, maintainable code across the stack.

• Break larger pieces of work into shippable increments and sequence them sensibly.

Frontend craft

• Build accessible, responsive UIs with a modern framework (React, Vue, or similar) in TypeScript.

• Make sound component-architecture and state-management decisions, and keep the front end maintainable as it grows.

• Care about perceived performance and the actual user experience — not just that it renders.

Backend, data, and APIs

• Design and build services and APIs (REST/GraphQL or event-driven) with sensible data models across relational and non-relational stores.

• Write clean, well-tested production code; handle failure deliberately with sound error handling and observability.

• Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms and reason about their failure modes.

Code quality and working within the architecture

• Review PRs thoroughly — catching correctness, clarity, and maintainability issues, not just style.

• Implement against the boundaries, contracts, and patterns the architecture defines, flag when a contract or requirement doesn't hold up, and escalate the decisions that aren't yours to make.

• Refactor and pay down technical debt deliberately, where it buys real leverage.

Cross-functional collaboration

• Work directly with Product and Design on scope, feasibility, and trade-offs inside the current iteration.

• Collaborate with your tech lead and fellow engineers to keep the system coherent as it grows.

AI-augmented engineering

• Use modern AI tooling (IDE agents, CLI assistants, MCP servers) as a daily working layer across design, coding, and review.

• Apply judgment to AI-assisted output — treat it as acceleration, not a substitute for understanding the code you ship.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems, working across both frontend and backend.

• Strong fluency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python; comfortable owning non-trivial code in both.

• Frontend depth: production experience with a modern framework (React, Vue, or similar) in TypeScript, plus a working grasp of responsive layout, accessibility, and browser performance.

• Backend depth: building services and APIs (REST/GraphQL or event-driven) with solid data modeling across relational and non-relational stores.

• Hands-on experience building services on AWS — using core compute, data, and identity services (e.g., ECS/EKS, RDS/S3, IAM) and reasoning about their behavior, not just calling them.

• Comfortable with modern CI/CD and Git workflows — GitHub Actions (or equivalent), PR-based review, branching, and automated testing as part of how you ship.

• Hands-on experience building production features on top of LLM/agent APIs (e.g., AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic) — prompt/context design, retrieval, and orchestrating agent workflows, with judgment about cost and failure modes.

• Strong production instincts: writes testable code, handles failure deliberately, and can debug and profile a live system — front and back — under real conditions.

• Reads and works within an existing architecture — implements against defined contracts and guardrails, and knows when to challenge them vs. when to escalate.

• AI-first working style: hands-on daily use of AI tooling (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) with the judgment to verify its output.

• Senior judgment and autonomy: takes ambiguous requirements to ship software with minimal hand-holding, and owns the result.

• Advanced English; comfortable in a fully remote, distributed team.

Nice to have

• Strong design and UX sensibility; experience working from a design system and partnering closely with designers.

• Experience integrating with multiple third-party platforms in production (Slack, GitHub, Atlassian, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Stripe, MCP servers).

• Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation/CDK, or Pulumi) — able to read and extend it, even if not owning it.

• Experience working in multi-tenant or enterprise-facing products with real security and data-residency constraints.

• Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, or similar) and using it to close production feedback loops.

• Experience mentoring engineers or leading the implementation of a sizable feature

Perks

💵 Monthly USD Service Fee

🌴 20 business days of paid Agreed Time Off—Annual + 6 Local Holidays

🐣Caregiver Time Off

💻A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from anywhere!

🚀An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010, our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we've been in permanent evolution: from business consulting to innovation and design, and now to building amazing digital products powered by AI. We scaled globally, launched AI Labs and Reshape Studios, and claimed our space as an AI consulting firm — helping organizations move from pilots to production through accountable AI. Today, we're expanding our impact across industries, driving real AI adoption through accountability, governance, and value at scale. Dreamers first, builders always.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build web applications that connect back-end data to front-end interfaces and automate business workflows.

The mandatory requirements are a BS in Computer Science or Engineering , 5+ years of software engineering experience with Java or Python , 4+ years of React and TypeScript , and an upper-intermediate English level.

What you will do

• Architect and build full-stack software solutions that power business operations, spanning both backend API development and frontend application building.

• Develop custom web applications that give stakeholders an operational front-end interface to review, monitor, and execute complex business logic in a self-serve manner.

• Merge the modern data stack with software engineering capabilities, including API services, microservices, and workflow orchestration engines.

• Build automated workflows and triggers that instantly sync cross-platform systems.

• Transform static and traditional data/analytics solutions into automated operational workflows, closing the loop between data ingestion, analytical insights, and automated operational execution.

Must haves

• Senior-level (5+ years) of hands-on software engineering experience ; as the first core software engineer on the team, must possess the architectural maturity to design and implement solutions, set foundational coding standards, and guide and upskill peers.

• 5+ years of programming experience in at least one of the following languages: Java or Python.

• 5+ years of experience developing backend APIs in a data-driven environment.

• 5+ years of experience with datastores such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB , or similar long-term stores.

• 4+ years of experience building production frontend applications using React and TypeScript.

• Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

• Strong knowledge of REST or GraphQL, RPC, and JSON.

• Working knowledge of a cloud-based environment, with a focus on AWS.

• Experience conducting and leading code reviews.

• Experience impacting a product or project in a tangible, positive manner.

• BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or another technical-related degree.

• Upper-intermediate English level.

Nice to haves

• Experience creating solutions for billing.

• Working knowledge of service-oriented and event-driven system architectures.

• Experience consuming GraphQL APIs from the frontend (Apollo Client or similar).

• Demonstrated use of Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or other messaging frameworks.

• Familiarity with a component-based design system.

• Experience writing frontend tests using Jest and React Testing Library.

• Working knowledge of frontend build tooling (Webpack, Vite, or similar).

• Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and accessible UI development.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for debugging complex issues and maturing code.

• Significant experience with large-scale, high-performance systems, including an understanding of the tradeoffs between consistency and scalability and common patterns for scaling reliable systems through data replication and redundancy.

Perks

• Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget

• Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews

• Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm

• Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands

• Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized

• Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

postings.descriptionText:
¡Sumate a Payway! donde vas a ser parte de la plataforma de cobros con el mejor kit de soluciones para potenciar negocios.
Conectamos tecnología, personas y negocios para gestionar los cobros de millones de transacciones todos los días en Argentina.
Creamos soluciones que impactan en miles de negocios, todos los días y en la vida real.
Nuestro propósito es claro: simplificar la experiencia de pago para que sea más simple, segura y accesible.
Como Developer Full Stack vas a tener la oportunidad de realizar tareas de estimación, diseño, construcción, mantenimiento e integración de soluciones end-to-end, abarcando tanto los microservicios backend como las interfaces de usuario, con la finalidad de asegurar la provisión, experiencia, disponibilidad y seguridad de los servicios brindados por la compañía.

🚀 Este es el desafío que te proponemos:

• Realizar las actividades de análisis, diseño y construcción de soluciones completas, desde la interfaz de usuario hasta los servicios backend que la sustentan.

• Desarrollar y mantener microservicios desplegados en contenedores sobre Kubernetes (EKS), siguiendo los lineamientos de las Semillas de Arquitectura de la compañía (backend y frontend).

• Construir componentes y aplicaciones frontend, e integrarlos con los microservicios a través de API Gateways, contemplando manejo de errores, estados de carga y reintentos.

• Diseñar e implementar integraciones asincrónicas entre microservicios mediante tópicos y colas de mensajería.

• Modelar y optimizar el acceso a datos en bases transaccionales NoSQL y relacionales de la capa de negocio.

• Optimizar la performance de punta a punta: tiempos de respuesta de los servicios, caching y distribución de assets estáticos a través de CDN.

• Incorporar prácticas de desarrollo seguro en ambas capas: gestión de credenciales, validaciones, y remediación de hallazgos de análisis estático de código y de pentesting.

• Instrumentar los servicios con logs, métricas y trazas para garantizar la observabilidad en producción.

• Participar en el diseño de interfaces de usuario (UI/UX) y en la evaluación de nuevos productos, servicios y mejoras de los existentes.

• Elaborar y validar estimaciones de requerimientos, identificando riesgos y dependencias técnicas.

• Realizar revisiones de código y velar por el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad del equipo.

• Realizar investigación de nuevas tecnologías, técnicas, metodologías y herramientas de trabajo.

• Realizar las tareas de soporte y diagnóstico necesarias ante incidentes de producción, en cualquiera de las dos capas.

👌🏼 ¿Qué skills necesitas?

• Estudios de carreras afines a Sistemas.

• Programación orientada a objetos y buenas prácticas de diseño (SOLID).

Backend

• Conocimientos sólidos desarrollando en Java 11+.

• Experiencia desarrollando microservicios con Spring Boot.

• Diseño e integración de WebServices REST.

• Tests unitarios y de integración (JUnit, Mockito).

• Bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL) y NoSQL documentales (MongoDB).

Frontend

• Dominio de HTML5, CSS3 / SASS y JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Experiencia desarrollando con React.js y/o Angular.

• Manejo de estado global (ej. Redux, Context API, NgRx).

• Tests unitarios en el Front (ej. Jest, React Testing Library, Jasmine/Karma).

• Herramientas de empaquetado y build (Webpack, Vite, npm/yarn).

Transversal

• Docker y contenedores.

• Nociones de Kubernetes: deployments, services, configmaps, secrets y troubleshooting de pods.

• Entorno Unix/Linux.

• Git/GitLab y trabajo con pipelines de CI/CD.

Conocimientos adicionales (deseables):

• Conocimiento funcional y técnico de flujos de medios de pago.

• Servicios de AWS: EKS, SQS/SNS, ElastiCache (Redis), Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, API Gateway, CloudFront, WAF.

• TypeScript.

• Mensajería asincrónica y patrones de resiliencia (idempotencia, reintentos, dead letter queues).

• Cachés distribuidos y estrategias de invalidación.

• Conceptos de micro-frontends.

• Optimización de performance web (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

• Desarrollo seguro (OWASP Top 10, XSS, CSRF, CSP) y herramientas SAST como Checkmarx.

• Nociones de accesibilidad (WCAG) y diseño responsive.

• Observabilidad: análisis de logs, métricas y trazas.

• Shell scripting (bash, ksh).

• Metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban).

📢 ¿Qué vas a encontrar acá?

• Modelo #Xmart: nuestro esquema de trabajo flexible.

• Vacaciones por días hábiles.

• Salario competitivo que se adapta al contexto del momento.

• Tu lugar flex: 30 días al año para trabajar desde cualquier parte del mundo.

• Reintegro de gastos de internet y bono anual por performance.

• Crédito mensual en PedidosYa.

• Formación permanente, acceso a certificaciones, becas y descuentos en universidades y posgrados.

• Licencias extendidas de familia.

¡Queremos que más personas puedan encontrar su lugar en Payway!
Por eso impulsamos una cultura inclusiva que celebra las diferencias y potencia el talento de cada persona.
Nuestras oficinas son accesibles y acompañamos con apoyos o adaptaciones en el puesto de trabajo a personas con discapacidad.

Tu talento y tu mirada pueden hacer la diferencia. ¿Nos conocemos?

• USD fixed monthly compensation (through Deel)

If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team.

In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

What You'll Do:

• Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product

• Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements

• Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform

• Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews

• Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path

• Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions

• Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders

• Be on a on-call rotation to respond to production incident.

What We Look For:

• Experience solving technical problems as part of a team

• Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred

• Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language

• Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)

• Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs

• Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture

Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.

We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!

Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with forward-thinking brands and agencies to design and implement custom storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From theme development to complex ERP and OMS workflows, our engineers bring deep expertise in Shopify, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.

The Roles:

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Shopify, to join our remote team. We hire across multiple technical tracks depending on your strengths and focus area:

Front-End Engineer (Shopify)

You Bring:

• Strong experience in Liquid and custom theme development

• Proficiency in React, Next.js, Remix, and TypeScript

• Familiarity with Shopify Storefront API and headless commerce

• Passion for creating accessible, fast, and beautiful web experiences

Back-End Engineer (Shopify Apps & Extensions)

What You’ll Do:

• Design and build Shopify apps (public/private) and backend APIs using Node.js, Remix, or Next.js

• Implement Shopify Functions, custom checkout logic, and performance optimizations

• Work with MongoDB, Supabase, and related databases for data persistence

• Integrate with third-party APIs, tools, and Shopify Admin/Storefront APIs

• Collaborate with front-end engineers and product teams on headless commerce builds

You Bring:

• Strong experience developing within the Shopify ecosystem

• Hands-on experience with Node.js, Remix, Next.js, and Shopify Functions

• Knowledge of API authentication, webhooks, and scalable architectures

• Understanding of deployment pipelines and Git-based workflows

Back-End Engineer (Integrations & Systems Architecture)

You’ll focus on building robust, scalable integrations between Shopify and enterprise systems (ERP, OMS, CMS).

What You’ll Do:

• Develop and maintain backend integrations for Shopify with systems like Netsuite, D365, Manhattan, Contentful, Strapi, and Sanity

• Handle data migrations and manage ETL processes between legacy and Shopify systems

• Build services using Node.js, Remix, Next.js, and PostgreSQL

• Leverage iPaaS tools (Celigo, MuleSoft, Workato) for complex integrations

• Collaborate with client teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance data flows

You Bring:

• Proven experience designing scalable Shopify integrations

• Deep understanding of API data mapping, authentication, and migration

• Strong skills in PostgreSQL, ETL, and cloud deployment

• Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Full-Stack Engineer (Shopify)

• Build and maintain full Shopify applications and headless storefronts

• Work directly with clients to define technical needs and design architecture

• Implement backend services, APIs, and front-end UI with Next.js, Remix, React, and TypeScript

• Handle database design, migrations, and integrations (PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM)

You Bring:

• Strong technical skills in React, Next.js, Remix, and TypeScript

Benefits & Perks

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

• Platform Thinking: Designs systems that are scalable, maintainable, and built to evolve beyond any single project

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits

• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - React Native - Consumer
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer Mobile team builds the Kraken app, the interface millions of people use to interact with their money. We work primarily in React Native, building products that make complex financial experiences intuitive, fast and trustworthy.

We're a product-minded engineering team. Our engineers don't just implement requirements: they work closely with Product and Design to understand the problem behind them, challenge assumptions, shape solutions and measure whether what we ship actually improves the experience for our clients.

The opportunity

• We're looking for a Senior React Native Engineer who thinks like a product builder.

• You'll work across engineering, product and design to turn real client problems into thoughtful mobile experiences, comfortable starting with an ambiguous problem rather than a perfectly defined specification.

• You'll own features end-to-end, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through implementation, launch and iteration, using data and client feedback to drive improvements.

• You'll build high-quality experiences in React Native across a financial product where responsiveness, reliability and trust matter, whether improving product discovery, creating trading experiences, or simplifying journeys.

• You'll partner closely with Product and Design, contributing engineering perspectives early in the product-development process rather than waiting for finished requirements.

• You'll work with APIs and real-time data to create responsive, data-rich mobile experiences, making thoughtful decisions around state management, rendering, performance and architecture.

• You'll operate with the ownership and versatility of a product engineer, comfortable wearing multiple hats and moving between product problems and technical challenges.

• You'll help raise the product-engineering bar across Consumer Mobile through technical discussions, code reviews, collaboration and by demonstrating strong product ownership.

What You Bring

• Strong React Native experience. You've built and shipped meaningful production applications using React Native and are comfortable making architectural and implementation decisions across a modern mobile codebase.

• A product-building mindset with strong product judgment. You start with the client problem rather than the ticket, understand what we're actually trying to solve, know when to challenge requirements or simplify solutions, and work with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into strong engineering solutions.

• Evidence of product impact. You can explain not only what you've built, but why you built it and what happened afterwards. You're comfortable using metrics, experimentation and client behaviour to evaluate the impact of your work.

• End-to-end ownership. You're comfortable working across the lifecycle of a feature: discovery, technical design, implementation, launch, measurement and iteration.

• Comfort with data-rich applications. You've worked with APIs and dynamic or real-time data and understand the engineering considerations involved in turning that data into responsive client experiences.

• Close collaboration with Product and Design. You enjoy working directly with designers and product managers, see building great products as a shared responsibility, and communicate effectively in written and verbal English across a globally distributed team.

• Versatility and AI proficiency. You're comfortable moving beyond a narrowly defined engineering remit, use AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, etc.) thoughtfully to move faster while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and quality, and thrive in environments where you wear multiple hats.

• A track record of taking loosely defined product problems and turning them into features or products that delivered measurable client impact.

Nice to have

• Experience building products in fintech, trading, crypto, payments or another financial technology environment.

• An understanding of how trading, investing or financial products work and an interest in the problems our clients are trying to solve.

• Experience with real-time or streaming data and building interfaces where information changes rapidly.

• Experience working across both mobile and web, bringing valuable perspective from broader frontend or product-engineering work.

• Experience in a startup or small-to-medium-sized technology company where engineers work closely with Product and Design.

• Native mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin and an understanding of when dropping below the React Native layer is the right engineering decision.

• Experience improving application performance, responsiveness and reliability across a range of mobile devices.

• A background in taking loosely defined product problems and turning them into products or features with measurable client impact.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - React Native - Consumer  - Asian Markets
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions globally. We offer spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer Mobile team builds the Kraken app, the interface millions of people use to interact with their money. We work primarily in React Native to make complex financial experiences intuitive, fast, and trustworthy. Our product-minded engineers work closely with Product and Design to understand client problems, challenge assumptions, shape solutions, and measure whether what we ship improves the experience.

We are expanding into Asia and building a new app specifically for Asian users. This requires genuine experience with the region’s distinct user expectations, design language, and technical constraints compared with Western markets.

The opportunity

• Build and own high-quality React Native features end to end, from ambiguous client problems and solution design through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration

• Partner closely with Product and Design to shape thoughtful, responsive, and trustworthy financial experiences, including product discovery, trading, and simplified client journeys

• Work with APIs and dynamic or real-time data, making strong decisions on state management, rendering, performance, architecture, and reliability

• Raise the product-engineering bar through technical discussions, code reviews, collaboration, strong product ownership, and a willingness to move between product and technical challenges

• Help build Kraken’s new app for Asian markets. Act as the team’s subject-matter guide on regional UX and design expectations, practical approaches to firewall and connectivity restrictions, and appropriate vendors and tooling such as telemetry solutions

What You Bring

• Strong React Native experience, including shipping meaningful production applications and making sound architectural and implementation decisions in a modern mobile codebase

• A product-building mindset and strong product judgment. You start with the client problem, challenge or simplify requirements when needed, and turn loosely defined problems into measurable product outcomes

• End-to-end feature ownership, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, client behavior, and feedback to assess and improve what you ship

• Experience building responsive, data-rich applications using APIs and dynamic or real-time data, alongside close collaboration with Product and Design in written and verbal English

• Versatility and thoughtful AI use. You are comfortable wearing multiple hats and use tools such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude to work faster while retaining responsibility for engineering judgment and quality

• Proven experience building and shipping consumer mobile apps for Asian markets. You understand the region’s UX and design conventions, its technical limitations, and how to navigate launch challenges including firewall and connectivity restrictions. You can clearly explain how you have solved these problems before

Nice to haves

• Experience in fintech, trading, crypto, payments, or another financial technology environment, with an understanding of trading, investing, or financial products

• Experience with real-time or streaming data, and improving mobile application performance, responsiveness, and reliability across a range of devices

• Experience across both mobile and web, or in a startup or small-to-medium-sized technology company where engineers work closely with Product and Design

• Native mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin, including sound judgment about when to work below the React Native layer

• Chinese language proficiency, such as Mandarin, or another Asian language

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. postings.title: Senior Software Engineer - Full-stack - Growth Product
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Engineering team builds the experiences that connect people to our ecosystem for the first time — and keeps them coming back. We design and ship the systems behind our marketing funnels, signup and KYC flows, and the key engagement features that help new users fund their accounts and explore our products. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally.

How We Work

• We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability.

• We move quickly, experiment often, and learn fast from data and feedback.

• We work asynchronously across time zones, supporting each other with open communication and shared goals.

Why This Role Matters

Every feature you build will have a visible impact on how people discover, trust, and engage with our products globally. The Growth Engineering team operates at the intersection of product, marketing, and infrastructure — turning ideas into measurable results. If you’re an engineer who enjoys solving business problems through code and believes engineering excellence drives growth, this role is built for you.

The opportunity

As a Senior Product Engineer within the Growth team, you’ll take on complex, high-impact problems that blend product thinking and engineering excellence. You’ll work across web and mobile platforms, collaborating with design, data, and product teams to deliver features that drive measurable business outcomes. This is an ideal role for engineers who use their technical skills to create real-world impact — translating high-level business goals into engineering solutions that improve activation, retention, and monetization worldwide.

• Partner with product managers, designers, and analysts to identify growth opportunities and turn them into high-quality, data-driven engineering solutions.

• Implement reusable services and components that power marketing campaigns, onboarding, KYC, and first-funding experiences across web and mobile.

• Collaborate on distributed systems that handle large volumes of global traffic while maintaining high performance and reliability.

• Participate in design and architecture discussions, balancing user impact, scalability, and maintainability.

• Measure, experiment, and iterate — using data and experimentation frameworks to understand what drives user behavior.

• Uphold and improve engineering standards, performance, and security practices across the stack.

Skills You Should HODL

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production systems at scale.

• Proficiency in building full-stack applications using one of the following: TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or Ruby, and React or React Native.

• Understanding of distributed systems, performance optimization, debugging, and secure software design.

• Familiarity with infrastructure and tooling such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, or GitLab CI/CD.

• A product mindset — you care about how your work moves key metrics, not just about the code itself.

• Ability to operate autonomously in a globally distributed, remote-first environment.

Nice to haves

• Experience with A/B testing, analytics instrumentation, or experimentation platforms.

• Background in growth engineering, user funnels, lifecycle, or conversion optimization.

• Familiarity with data analysis tools or experimentation frameworks.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

El foco principal está en el desarrollo full-stack, con mayor énfasis en la ingeniería backend y la plataforma Unified CMS.

Alcance del Trabajo

• Desarrollar y mantener servicios backend e integraciones de APIs que soporten Unified CMS y experiencias web globales.

• Desarrollar y mantener servicios en Node.js, APIs REST e integraciones GraphQL o gRPC.

• Construir y mantener componentes en React y bloques de contenido para Unified CMS y experiencias de marketing.

• Desarrollar y optimizar flujos de trabajo SSR y SSG utilizando Next.js u otros frameworks similares.

• Implementar modelos de contenido y gestionar cambios de esquema en Contentstack.

• Crear componentes reutilizables de interfaz utilizando Indeed XDS y Emotion.

• Integrar APIs de terceros y resolver problemas de flujo de datos de extremo a extremo.

• Brindar soporte a capacidades de personalización y pruebas A/B.

• Desarrollar y mantener pruebas automatizadas unitarias, de integración y end-to-end (E2E).

• Aplicar prácticas de desarrollo asistidas por IA en el trabajo diario de ingeniería.

• Contribuir al rendimiento, escalabilidad, confiabilidad y estabilidad de la plataforma.

• Participar en flujos de desarrollo basados en Git y procesos de CI/CD.

Requisitos Excluyentes

• Más de 4 a 5 años de experiencia en ingeniería de software.

• Sólidos conocimientos de JavaScript y TypeScript.

• Amplia experiencia en Node.js y desarrollo backend.

• Fuerte experiencia con React.

• Experiencia con Next.js o frameworks equivalentes para SSR.

• Desarrollo de servicios backend y APIs REST.

• Conocimientos de GraphQL o gRPC.

• Experiencia en integración de APIs de terceros.

• Experiencia con plataformas Headless CMS (Contentstack, Contentful, Strapi o similares).

• Desarrollo de componentes reutilizables y formularios dinámicos.

• Experiencia en pruebas unitarias, de integración y E2E.

• Manejo de herramientas como Jest, Playwright, React Testing Library o equivalentes.

• Experiencia con Git y procesos CI/CD.

• Conocimiento de ESLint y Prettier.

• Experiencia en desarrollo asistido por IA (no se requiere experiencia específica en IA generativa o LLMs).

• Experiencia en personalización y pruebas A/B.

Requisitos Deseables

• Experiencia con Emotion o soluciones CSS-in-JS.

• Manejo de Storybook y/o Chromatic.

• Experiencia en pruebas de accesibilidad.

• Experiencia con Koa, Express.js o frameworks similares.

• Conocimiento de Redis u otras tecnologías de caché.

• Experiencia en optimización de rendimiento y estrategias de caché.

• Integraciones con Google Maps.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Salario dolarizado, liquidado en pesos según dólar BNA venta.

Relación de dependencia con Capgemini.

Beneficios:

• Reintegro de gastos virtuales

• Cobertura médica OSDE

• Convenio con Megatlón

• Capacitaciones y descuentos en idiomas (CUI), entre otros
