postings.title: Staff Engineer - Growth - Verifications
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work

• We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.

• Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.

• Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.

• At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.

The opportunity

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.

• Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.

• Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.

• Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

• Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.

• Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.

• Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.

• Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.

What You Bring

• Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.

• Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.

• You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.

• You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.

• You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.

• Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.

• Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI.

Nice to haves

• Direct experience with KYC, KYB, or fraud work, including integrating providers like Trulioo, Persona, or ComplyAdvantage.

• Comfort building with AI in the loop.

• Time spent in crypto, fintech, or another space regulators pay close attention to.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

postings.title: IT System Support Analyst - SAP
postings.descriptionText:
GBS Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting applications for the position of IT System Support Analyst - SAP. Successful candidates will join the team, which is part of a multifunction service and technical center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

Overview

We are looking for individuals with SAP application management and implementation experience in SAP TM, MM, and/or SAP Oil & Gas logistics solutions (including TD and LE-TRA) to join the Digital Core team responsible for the design, delivery, and support of SAP solutions in partnership with multiple product teams.

Join our team and work in an Agile environment with a primary focus on maintaining the application and optimizing evergreen support through configuration, automation, and integration.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

• Collaborate closely with Business Partners to gather business requirements

• Analyze and understand system capabilities

• Configure the SAP software to meet business needs or resolve issues

• Open to develop basic technical expertise on any of the following - ABAP code analysis/low code development, SAP Security, Fiori, continuous integration, or automation

• Partner with developers to design, code and implement custom or complex solutions

• Analyze, devise, and execute system tests to verify solutions’ effectiveness

• Oversee the deployment of solutions to the production environments

• Perform troubleshooting, analysis, and resolution of complex and critical production issues

Requirements

• Knowledge and experience in SAP Transportation Management (TM) and willing to be trained further in IS Oil - Traders and Schedulers Workbench (TSW)

• Solid years of proficiency and hands-on experience on SAP (ECC or S4 Hana) application operations support and/or project implementation

• Experience in SAP Configuration based on functional area of expertise

• Knowledge on ABAP Debugging or code analysis, SAP Security or SAP Integration is a plus

• Proven ability in analytical and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication skills, both oral and written

• Excellent customer focus and results-orientation

Relocation Options:

Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

About You
You are a Senior .NET Engineer who thrives on solving complex production issues across Azure-hosted environments. You enjoy investigating problems beyond the application layer, connecting signals across code, infrastructure, identity, networking, integrations, and data to understand what is happening and drive incidents through resolution.

You bring strong technical judgment and remain composed during high-impact situations, using logs, metrics, traces, and distributed telemetry to isolate root causes and make informed decisions. You take ownership of critical escalations, collaborate effectively across Development, Infrastructure, Security, and Support teams, and can translate complex technical findings into clear business impact, resolution plans, and executive-ready documentation.

Note : This is a temporary 6-month opportunity.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5+ years of professional experience working with C# and .NET applications, including substantial production support or operational troubleshooting responsibilities.

• Advanced experience troubleshooting ASP.NET Core applications, REST APIs, integrations, and background services at production scale.

• Proven experience independently owning and resolving critical P1/P2 production incidents.

• Strong hands-on knowledge of Azure App Services, AKS, storage, networking, and Microsoft Entra ID or Azure AD.

• Ability to navigate the Azure Portal fluently during real-time incident investigations.

• Experience receiving escalations from L1 and L2 support teams and driving them through resolution.

• Strong root-cause analysis capabilities using logs, metrics, traces, and distributed telemetry.

• Hands-on experience configuring and tuning Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerts, and operational dashboards.

• Ability to diagnose code-level issues involving performance, memory, threading, asynchronous processing, and integration failures.

• Practical experience with retry policies, circuit breakers, bulkhead isolation, caching, and asynchronous processing in distributed .NET systems.

• Intermediate to advanced SQL skills for investigating application and data-related production issues.

• Experience coordinating incident resolution across Development, Infrastructure, Security, and Support teams.

• Strong ownership, composure under pressure, and resolution-focused decision-making.

• Professional working proficiency in English, including executive-ready written communication.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with vulnerability remediation and security-patching workflows in Azure environments.

• Experience diagnosing CI/CD and deployment failures using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

• Experience with Docker Compose, Helm, or containerized workloads beyond basic AKS operations.

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.

• Experience with Azure cost optimization, right-sizing, scaling policies, or reserved capacity.

• Experience supporting operational or distribution-related enterprise systems.

• AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-305, AZ-500, Azure Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or another relevant Microsoft certification.

• ITIL Foundation certification or practical experience working within formal incident-management processes.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

• Own and resolve complex P1/P2 incidents affecting Azure-hosted .NET applications and integrations.

• Provide deep technical troubleshooting across application, infrastructure, and platform layers.

• Investigate issues involving Azure App Services, AKS, networking, identity, storage, APIs, and background services.

• Receive escalations from L1 and L2 support teams and drive technical resolution from initial investigation through closure.

• Coordinate incident response across Development, Infrastructure, Security, and Operational stakeholders.

• Perform root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and high-impact outages using logs, metrics, traces, and distributed telemetry.

• Create clear, detailed, and executive-ready root-cause analysis documentation.

• Configure and tune Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerts, and operational dashboards.

• Monitor and improve application performance, availability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.

• Work with Development teams to identify and resolve code-level issues in C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, integrations, and background services.

• Recommend and implement improvements involving retry policies, circuit breakers, bulkhead isolation, caching, and asynchronous processing.

• Use SQL to support production investigations and validate application or data-related findings.

• Support vulnerability remediation, patching, and deployment troubleshooting when required.

• Communicate technical findings, business impact, risks, and resolution plans to technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Additional Information
About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

postings.title: Customer Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About The Role

The Customer Engineer sits inside our Customer Experience (CX) team and is a customer-facing engineer who resolves the platform customer bugs that need an actual code change and builds important customer-facing features. Our CX model pairs two roles — Customer Outcomes (relationship and account ownership) and Customer Engineer (code and incidents) — both powered by Computer, our AI engine that handles L1–L4 diagnosis instantly, 24/7.

You are not a back-room ticket-closer. You are the subject-matter expert for a specific product area, lead the technical response when things break, and ship real fixes and features. Every fix you ship feeds back into Computer, so the next identical issue resolves automatically.

Responsibilities

Product-area specialist

• Own deep expertise in one area of the product (e.g. integrations, workflows, search/AI, platform).

• Be the go-to escalation point for issues in that area, across accounts.

• Keep Computer's knowledge sharp for your area — feed in fixes, edge cases, and known issues.

• Spot recurring problems and drive them to a permanent fix or product change, partnering with the core Engineering team that owns the area.

• Translate customer technical needs into clear product feedback for Product and Engineering.

Resolution and feature development

• Own and resolve complex, code-level platform customer bugs routed from Customer Outcomes for your product area.

• Build important customer-facing features and enhancements that directly address customer pain points and business needs.

• Use Computer's full L1–L4 diagnosis as a head start — you don't start from zero.

• Investigate root cause at the code level: logs, queries, API behavior, service interactions.

• Write, test, and deploy fixes and features — real resolutions, not just workarounds — and confirm them directly with the customer where relevant.

• Document every fix (what broke, why, how to prevent recurrence) and feed it back to Computer.

Incident management

• Participate in the on-call rotation within the Customer Engineering team to front customer-impacting incidents in your product area and mitigate them.

• Act as first responder: detect and confirm incidents, triage severity and impact, and communicate status to affected customers (plain language) and Customer Outcomes owners.

• Drive or support technical investigation and mitigation alongside core Engineering.

• Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, then turn every learning into Computer knowledge and a known-issue entry.

• Build playbooks from mitigated incidents so recurring problems can be handled faster — or resolved automatically by Computer next time.

What This Role Does Not Do

• Own the overall customer relationship or account book — that stays with Customer Outcomes; you own the technical relationship.

• Sit in a separate, deprioritized engineering backlog — you work inside CX, prioritized by customer impact.

Qualifications

• 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

• Strong proficiency in a backend language (Golang strongly preferred), with hands-on, production-grade coding experience.

• Prior experience in Customer Engineering, Sustenance/L4 engineering, or an equivalent support-focused, customer-facing engineering team.

• Strong debugging, logging, and observability mindset for distributed systems and microservices.

• Comfortable investigating root cause at the code level — logs, queries, API behavior, and service interactions — and writing, testing, and deploying both fixes and features end-to-end.

• Experience writing postmortems, root-cause documentation, and reliability/incident reports.

• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana, Datadog, Kibana, or similar).

• Comfortable with on-call responsibilities and leading incident mitigation.

• Excellent communication skills — able to explain root cause and fixes directly to customer engineering and admin stakeholders.

• Good to have: deep expertise in a product area such as integrations, workflows, search/AI, or platform; exposure to multi-tenant SaaS systems; working knowledge of frontend concepts (SPA frameworks, preferably ReactJS); and adoption of modern AI-assisted dev tooling (e.g. Cursor, Claude).

How You'll Be Measured

Code-fix and feature delivery time, % of issues resolved without core engineering, root-cause documentation rate, fix-recurrence rate, incident response / time-to-mitigate for your area, and the technical health of the accounts your product area serves.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.
